atha saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha trayodaśīvratāni |
dharmād apetaṃ kadācid eva yadīyavācī viṣayatvam eti |
sa eva hemādrir anukrameṇa trayodaśīṣu vratavṛndam āha ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa saṃsārārṇavatāraṇa |
vrataṃ kathaya kiṃcin me rūpasaubhāgyadāyaka ||
anaṅgaḥ prīṇito yena phalaṃ yacchati keśava |
ātmavad rūpasaubhāgyaṃ tan me vistarato vada ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
anaṅgaḥ śrūyate devaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ pinākabhṛt |
tasmin sampūjite pārtha kiṃ nāpnoti naro bhuvi ||
tena te kathayiṣyāmi śūlapāṇivrateṣv idam |
yan na kasyacid ākhyātaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam ||
tīrtvā bhaktyā naro martye yad yad icchati pāṇḍava |
tat tad āpnoty asaṃdigdham anaṅgākhyāṃ trayodaśīm ||
kiṃ vratair bahubhiḥ pārtha uktamātraphalapradaiḥ |
trayodaśī tv iyaṃ puṇyā sarvavrataphalapradā ||
[2]        tasmāt kāryā prayatnena bahupuṇyam abhīpsatā |
trayodaśī hy anaṅgākhyā sadyo 'ghaughavināśanī ||
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanī sarvamaṅgaladāyinī |
atulyasukhasaubhāgyarupalāvaṇyadāyinī ||
purā dagdhena kāmena trinetranayanāgninā |
bhasmībhūtena loke 'smin saṅkalpasthena pāṇḍava |
anaṅgena kṛtā hy eṣā tenānaṅgatrayodaśī ||
aparaṃ śrūyate yasyāṃ purāṇeneti viśrutam |
nāma nirvacanaṃ pārtha kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tat ||
anaṅgo bhagavān śambhus tejomūrtir agocaraḥ |
sa eva devo yenāsyāṃ tenānaṅgatrayodaśī ||
prasiddhā samanuprāptā nityā sarvaphalapradā |
mārgaśīrṣa 'male pakṣe taryodaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
snāna(ṃ?) nadyāṃ taḍāge vā gṛhe vā kūpato 'pi vā |
kṛtvābhyarcya mahādevaṃ vidhānāc chaśibhūṣaṇam ||
liṅga(ṃ?) svayaṃbhavaṃ bhūtam abhāve yat pratiṣṭhitam |
tad anaṅgam iti proktaṃ pūjayed bhaktito vratī ||
dadhidugdhaghṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyamṛtaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
sthāpya evāmṛtaiḥ paścāt snāpayed gandhavāriṇā ||
dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ puṣpais tatkālasaṃbhavaiḥ |
[3]        phalair nānāvidhair bhakṣyair gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
śrutanāmāny athoccārya homaḥ kāryas tilākṣataiḥ |
aśvatthajātināraṅgapāyasair madhunā pibet ||
aśvatthādi kramāt kāṣṭhapuṣpaphalanaivedyaprāśanāni | evam uttareṣv api māseṣu |
anaṅgaṃ pūjayed ādau madhumatyā samanvitam |
anaṅganāmnā saṃpūjya madhu prāśya svapen niśi ||
madhuprāśanayogena jāyate madhuradhvaniḥ |
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti bhaktimān ||
puṣpaiś codumbarair vīra śubhadāḍimamodakaiḥ |
candanena ca yogīśaṃ madayantyā yutaṃ yajet ||
snāpya kṣīrādibhiḥ pārtha pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
yogeśvareti saṃspṛśya candanaṃ prāśayen niśi ||
saumyaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaś ca candanaprāśanād bhavet |
rājasūyasya yajñasya tadbhaktaḥ phalam āpnuyāt ||
māghe nyagrodhasaktanda (?) mātuliṅga sumālikaiḥ |
sumālikaṃ somalakaṃ muktā bhautiṃ ca yogīṇaṃ madayantyā sahitaṃ yajet |
māghe smareti saṃsmṛtya prāśayen mauktikodakam ||
prāśanasya prabhāvena nirmalā dhīḥ prajāyate |
rūpāḍhyaṃ ca vapuḥ strīṇāṃ manonayananandanam ||
muktāpūrṇopame netre padmapatrāyate śuciḥ |
saumyaḥ śāntaḥ sugandhaś ca candanaprāśanād bhavet ||
[4]        bahuśramākhyahajñasya prāpnoty avikalaṃ phalam |
phālgune vadarīkaiś ca gīrajīvīraṇodakaiḥ ||
kakkolena ca vīreśaṃ saśītaṃ niśi pūjayet |
vīranāma japed rātrau kakkolaṃ prāśayen niśi ||
tenāsya surabhir gandho jāyate kāyavaktrayoḥ |
tayā guṇagaṇāvāso drutakāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ ||
gomedhasya phalaṃ prāpya śakraloke mahīyate |
caitre krañjadamanadrākṣāvaḍhakaśītalaiḥ ||
śītalaḥ karpūraḥ |
deveśaṃ rūpanāmānaṃ yajñe subhagayā saha |
pūrvoktavidhinā pārtha karpūraṃ prāśayen niśi ||
karpūravān priyāloke gandhagauravasaṃyutaḥ |
candravat sarvalokānāṃ locanāhlādakārakaḥ ||
jāyate sa naraḥ pārtha yaḥ karotīha bhaktimān |
naramedhaphalāvāptir jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
vaiśākhe sahakārārkapuṣpānnaphalasaktubhiḥ |
jātīphalair mahārūpam indrāṇyā sahitaṃ yajet ||
prāśayed rātrisamaye jātīphalam anuttamam |
saphalās tasya sarvāśā bhavanti bhuvi bhārata ||
gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya rudraloke mahīyate |
jyaiṣṭhe jambūbilvapatraiḥ śrīphalaiḥ pūpakais tathā ||
lavaṅganāthaṃ saṃpūjya pradyumnaṃ lalitānvitam |
lavaṅgaṃ prāśayed rātrau lāvaṇyaṃ tena cāpnuyāt ||
[5]        vājapeyaphalaṃ labdhvā modate divi bhārata |
āṣāḍhe 'pāmārganīpanālikerakadambakaiḥ ||
tilaiś comāpatiṃ rātrau pūjayec ca tilottamām |
umāpatiṃ japan prājñaḥ prāśayec ca tilodakam ||
tilottamāvad abhavat rūpasampadanuttamā |
prāpnoti puṇḍarīkasya phalaṃ kurukulodvaha |
śrāvaṇe sumanombho'jakadalīphalamaṇḍakaiḥ ||
sumanā jātī |
gandhatoyaiḥ śūlapāṇiṃ śuklavāso'nvitaṃ yajet |
gandhodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya svaped rātrau vimatsaraḥ ||
sugandhaḥ sarvasaukhyāḍhyaś cirāyś copajāyate |
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya tasya syāt phalam uttamam ||
bhādre pālāśacāmpeyaśarkarājyapurais tathā |
ājyapuro ghṛtapūraḥ |
yajetāguruṇā sadyojātaṃ gauryāsamanvitam ||
aguruṃ prāśayitvā tu gurur bhavati bhūtale |
tulāpuruṣadānasya haimasya phalam aśnute ||
āśvine cāpy apāmārgakarkandhuguḍapūrakaiḥ |
svarṇāmbhobhiḥ suvarṇaṃ ca tridaśādhipatiṃ yajet ||
hemodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya hemavarṇaḥ prajāyate |
naramedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti niścitam ||
ūrje kadambaka droṇakuṣmāṇḍa lavaṇena tu |
phalaiś ca vidyādhipatiṃ yajen madanayā saha ||
[6] phalair amṛtaphalākhyair bhakṣyalavaṇavān jñeyaḥ |
lavaṇaṃ prāśayet tatra śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ |
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktaḥ prāśanād asya jāyate ||
naivedyānām apy alābhe haviṣyānnaṃ prakalpayet |
iha pratiślokaṃ dantadhāvanakusumanaivedyaprāśanānāṃ yathākramam abhihitānāṃ tasya tasyābhāve śrayam anukalpa uktaḥ |
sarveṣu pāraṇeṣv eva bhojayitvā dvijottamān |
sadakṣiṇas tato 'śnīyād bandhubhiḥ sahito vaśī |
vratavighno yadā tasyām aśakto sūtake 'tha vā ||
upoṣya evopavāsya tadahaḥ pārayet punaḥ |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte śaktyā ratnādyalaṅkṛtam ||
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimam adhivāsya tato niśi |
puṣpair dhūpais tathā gandhair naivedyair vividhaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye kṛtahomabalikriyaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇam idaṃ sarvaṃ pradadyāt tu dvijātaye ||
liṅgākāram anaṅgaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ kārayec chivam |
tāmrapātreṣu saṃsthāpya kalaśopari vinyaset ||
śuklavastreṇa saṃcchādya puṣpanaivedyapūjitam |
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śivabhaktāya suśruta ||
śaktimān śayanaṃ dadyāt savatsāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm |
chatropānatpradānaṃ ca kalaśā sodakānvitāḥ ||
dvādaśātra prakartavyāḥ srakcandanavibhūṣitāḥ |
sitapakvānnasaṃchannā brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet ||
[7]        devasyaiva pradātavyāḥ kumbhā dvādaśagandakāḥ |
vitānaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ ca dhvajakiṅkiṇinādinam ||
ghaṇṭāṃ ca sumbanāṃ (?) bhadrām badhnīyāc chivamandire |
tasminn eva dine pārtha saṃpīḍyātmānam arcayet ||
devadevaṃ triśūleśaṃ puṣpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ |
gītavāditranṛtyādiprekṣaṇair vividhair api ||
dānāny atra pradeyāni svavittasyānusārataḥ |
sūryoparāgasadṛśo yataḥ sadivaso mataḥ ||
bhojanaṃ ca yathāśaktyā ṣaḍrasaṃ madhurottamam |
pradadyāc chivabhaktānāṃ deyāni ca viśeṣataḥ ||
arcito nāvamanyeta na kṣipen nānṛtaṃ vadet |
evaṃ tadutsavaṃ kṛtvā śivayajñam anuttamam ||
tataḥ svayaṃ tu bhuñjīyād bhṛtyavargasamanvitaḥ |
śāntācārakaniṣṭas (?) tu hṛdi devaṃ niveśya ca |
evaṃ nirvartya vidhivat kṛtakṛtyaḥ pumān bhavet ||
nārī vā nṛpaśārdūla kṛtvetad vratam uttamam |
phalaṃ tv etad avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyak bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ ||
mucyate sarvapāpodhair brahmahatyādikair api |
iha kīrtim avāpya vai mṛtaḥ svargaṃ mahīyate ||
puṇyaśeṣād ihāgatya sarvabhaumo nṛpo bhavet |
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa mūrtimān madano bhavet ||
saubhāgyadhanasaukhyāḍhyaḥ śāntavitto jitendriyaḥ ||
[8]        putrapautraiḥ susaṃpūrṇaiḥ jīvec ca śaradāṃ śatam |
śivabhaktaparo bhūtvā śivakagatamānasaḥ ||
antakāle śivaṃ smṛtvā śivasāyujyatāṃ vrajet |
kāmena yā kila purā samupoṣitāsīt
śubhrāṃ tithiṃ tridaśadeham avāptihetoḥ |
tāṃ prāśanair uditanāmayutair upoṣya
divyaṃ prayāti paramaṃ padam indumauleḥ ||
iti bhaviṣottaroktaṃ manaṅgatrayodaśīvratam |
caitraśuklatrayodaśyām anaṅgaṃ tu paṭe likhet |
nīladūrvāṅkuraśyāmahastamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ ||
ratigrītyubhayopetaṃ pauṣyasāyakavāpadhṛk |
paṭeṣu susthitaḥ kāryaḥ sarvaiś cāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
nānāpuṣpais tu saṃpūjya vastranaivedyadīpakaiḥ |
dhūpair nānāvidhair hradyair nānātodyaraveṇa tu ||
puṣpamaṇḍapamadhye tu ramyodyāne tu pūjayet |
ācāryo vividhair bhaktyā pūjitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
vastrahemānnapānaiś ca yathāśaktyā tu bhaktitaḥ |
pumān kāmatvam āpnoti sarvasyaiva priyo bhavet ||
saubhāgyaṃ prāpnuyān nārī iha loke paratra ca |
māsi māsi yajed vāpi yathānukramayogataḥ ||
ekasmin vā dine vatsa vatsare vā samarcayet |
[9]        madanaṃ cittabhavanaṃ manmathaṃ tu ratipriyam |
anaṅgaṃ caiva kandarpaṃ saṃpūjya makaradhvajam ||
kusumāyudhasaṃjñaṃ ca tathā pūjya manobhavam |
tatha viṣamavāṇaṃ ca dvādaśaṃ mālatīpriyam ||
māsi bhādrapade yatnād anaṅgaṃ pūjayet sadā |
ity etan niyamenaiva kāmavrataṃ samācaret ||
iti kālottaroktam anaṅgavratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yamasyārādhanaṃ brūhi śrīvatsapuruṣottamam |
yathā na gamyate raudraṃ narakaṃ narakāntakam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
dvāravatyāṃ pure pārtha snāto 'haṃ sravaṇāmbhasi |
dṛṣṭavān munim āyātaṃ mudgalaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||
prajvalantam ivādityaṃ tapasā dyotitaṃ varam |
sa praṇamyātha satkārair idaṃ pṛṣṭo yudhiṣṭhira ||
yamādarśananāmedaṃ vrataṃ jantubhayāpaham |
kathayāmāsa sa munir mudgalo vismayānvitaḥ ||
mudgala uvāca |
vṛttāntaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yad dṛṣṭaṃ svahvarorake (?) |
akasmād rogarahitaḥ patito 'smi dharātale ||
paśyāmi caṇḍapuruṣaiḥ samantād āhṛtaṃ vapuḥ |
[10]        aṅguṣṭhamātrapuruṣo balād ākṛṣyate tu saḥ ||
baddhvā yamabhaṭair gāḍhaṃ nīyate vegavahibhiḥ |
kṣaṇāt sabhāyāṃ paśyāmi yamaṃ piṅgalalocanam ||
kṛṣṇāvadātaṃ raudrāsyaṃ mṛtyuvyādhisamanvitam |
vātapittakaphādyaiś ca mūrtimadbhir upāsitam ||
kāmaśokajvarachardiplīhānāhabhagandaraiḥ |
rājayakṣmapramehādyair netrarogair anekadhā ||
nijāṅgaṃ tu vraṇai raudrair jvālāgardabhakādibhiḥ |
rogair bahuvidhaiḥ kṛṣṇa nānārūpair bhayāvahaiḥ ||
mūrtimadbhiś ca saṃgrāme narakair ghoradarśanaiḥ |
rākṣasaiś ca piśācaiś ca samantāt parivāritaḥ ||
viṣārakair vaśiṣṭhādyaiś citraguptādilekhakaiḥ |
ādityādikadikpālaiḥ karmasākṣibhir āvṛtaḥ ||
dūtai raudramukhādyaiś ca siṃhasarpādivāhanaiḥ |
pāśāṅkuśādihastaiś ca bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaiḥ ||
bṛhatkāyair mahāghoraiḥ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ niyāmakaiḥ |
asipatravanāṅgārakṣāragartāsrapūrakaiḥ ||
asthibhaṅgāmiṣacchedarudhirastrāvakādibhiḥ |
tatrastho vṛkṛto bhāti yamo nānyo jano 'paraḥ ||
sa prāha kiṅkarān sarvān dharmarājo ruṣānvitaḥ |
tyajyatāṃ ki (?) samānīto yuṣmābhir bhāntamānasaiḥ ||
mudgalo nāma kuṇḍinye nagare bhīṣmakātmajaḥ |
[11]        kṣatriyaḥ samānīyatāṃ kṣīṇāyus tyajyatāṃ muniḥ ||
ity uktās te gatās tasmād āyātāḥ punar eva te |
ūcur yamabhaṭāḥ prājñā dharmarājaṃ suvismayāḥ ||
kṣīṇāyus tatra cāsmābhir na kaścil lakṣito gataiḥ |
na jānīmo bhrāntacittāḥ kṣamasva jagatāṃ pate ||
yama uvāca |
prāyeṇa te na dṛśyante puruṣair dharmakiṅkaraiḥ |
kṛtā trayodaśī yais tu narakārtivināśanī ||
ujjayanyāṃ prayāge vā bhairave vāpi ye mṛtāḥ |
tilānnagohiraṇyādi dattaṃ yais tu gavāhnikam ||
kiṅkarā ūcuḥ |
kīdṛśaṃ tad vrataṃ svāmiñ chaṃsa no bhāskarātmaja |
kiṃ tatra caiva kartavyaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye ||
yama uvāca |
pūrvāhne mārgaśīrṣādau varṣam ekaṃ nirantaram |
trayodaśyaṃ saumyadine sūryāṅgārakavarjite ||
mama nāmnā dvijān aṣṭau pañca caiva samāhvayet |
purāṇavedatattvajñān svācārāṃs tatra darśanān ||
sūryaikaśaraṇān sādhūn sarvabhūtahite ratān |
śucau deśe śubhe paṭṭe prāṅmukhān upaveśayet ||
antarvāsoyutān bhaktyā yatnenābhyaṅgayeta tān |
[12]        ārabhya uttamāṅgāṃs tu tilatailena mardayet ||
snāpayed gandhakāṣāyaiḥ sukhoṣṇena ca vāriṇā |
pṛthak pṛthak snāpayitvā sarvān eva dvijottamān ||
sukhasnātān tatācāntān vratī bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
svayaṃ sabhṛtyaḥ śuśrūṣāṃ teṣāṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ ||
prāṅmukhān upaviṣṭāṃś ca trayodaśa pṛthak pṛthak |
saṃsthāpayec cābhimukhān guḍapūpān supūjitān ||
savyañjanaṃ supakvānnaṃ bhūyo bhūyo nivedayet |
yathāsukhaṃ yathātṛpti yathākāmam ayācitam ||
deyaṃ bhāvaṃ samālakṣya icchadbhiḥ śreya ātmanaḥ |
śucir bhūtvā tathā cātra dakṣayet tilataṇḍulaiḥ ||
prasthamātrair athaikaikaṃ tāmrapātrasamanvitaiḥ |
sadakṣiṇaiś ca saṃchannair jalakumbhaiḥ pavitrakaiḥ ||
carmaprāvaraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhair vastrapuṣpaiś ca dūtakāḥ |
mantreṇānena viprendrān dakṣayet tān pṛthak pṛthak ||
brāhmaṇān samarūpāṃs tān paṅktibhedena kārayet |
yamaḥ śanaiścaro mṛtyur daṇḍahasto vināyakaḥ ||
abhāvaḥ pralayaḥ śāntir duḥkhapraśamano 'ntakaḥ |
lokapālo dhanī krūro raudro ghorānanaḥ śivaḥ ||
mama prasādasumukho dadātv abhayadakṣiṇām |
ity uktvā sa prayaccheta deyaṃ datvā vratī punaḥ ||
dvijān ānuvrajet tṛptān (?) svagṛhyavidhinārcitān |
evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścit sakṛd vratam idaṃ caret ||
[13]        sa mṛto 'pi naro dūtā na yāti yamamandiram |
adṛṣṭo 'sau samāyāti vimānenārkamaṇḍalam ||
tasmād yāti purīṃ viṣṇos tataḥ śivapurīṃ vrajet |
nyūnaṃ cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tena mudgalena yathoditam ||
tena nāyāty asau lokaṃ mama kṣatriyapuṅgava |
mudgala uvāca |
yamasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā kvāpi dūtā gatās tu me |
ahaṃ ca sarvam ākarṇya vismayāviṣṭamānasaḥ ||
svaśarīras tataḥ prāpya supta evotthito hareḥ |
tato haratvam āviṣṭo tvāṃ draṣṭum idam āgataḥ |
śrutaṃ tu ca mayā tatra kathitaṃ te mayā tv iha ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ity uktvā mudgalo rājan prayātaḥ svāśramaṃ prati |
idaṃ kuruṣva kaunteya tvam apy atra mahītale ||
tato yāmyasya (?) saṃdigdhaṃ parityajyāntakaṃ divam |
evaṃ ye 'nye 'pi puruṣāḥ striyo vāpi yudhiṣṭhira ||
trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ ye kariṣyanti bhūtale |
ekabhaktena naktena upavāsena vā punaḥ ||
yamādarśananāmnā vai vrataṃ sarvavratottamam |
te sarvapāpanirmuktā vimānenārkavarcasā ||
yāsyantīndrapurīṃ ramyām apsarogaṇasaṃvṛtām |
dodhūyamānāś camarais (?) stūyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
gītavāditranirghoṣaiś chatrapaṅktivirājitāḥ |
[14]        adṛṣṭā ghorarūpais te yamadūtair yudhiṣṭhira ||
anārditā vyādhiśataiḥ piśācādyair agocarāḥ |
atāḍitā mahāraudrair nānāpraharaṇā(ḥ)kṣatāḥ ||
yamadṛṣṭipathān muktāḥ sarvasaukhyasamanvitāḥ |
sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktāḥ svaśiraḥsaumyadarśanāḥ ||
svargaṃ vasanti suciraṃ bhāvitāḥ svena karmaṇā |
snāpya trayodaśamunīn ghṛtapāyasena
saṃbhojya pūjya tilataṇḍulasaṃpradānaiḥ |
kurvanti ye vratam idaṃ tridaśe 'hni pārtha
paśyanti te yamamukhaṃ na kadācid eva ||
iti bhaviṣottaroktaṃ yamādarśanatrayodośīvratam ||
guruvāre trayodaśyām aparāhṇe jalaplutaḥ |
tarpayitvā devapitṝn ṛṣīṃś ca tilataṇḍulaiḥ ||
narasiṃhaṃ samabhyarcya yaḥ karoty upavāsakam |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
iti narasiṃhapurāṇoktaṃ narasiṃhatrayodaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
brūhi me yaduśārdūla vrataṃ gandhavināśanam |
tiktāgrahaṃ ca dehasya daurbhāgyanāśanaṃ tathā ||
[15]                kṛṣṇa uvāca |
imaṃ praśnaṃ purā pārtha jātūkarṇo mahāmuniḥ |
pṛṣṭo rājñyā mahāmatyā kālanandanayā tathā ||
kathayāmāsa tāṃ hṛṣṭa upaviṣṭo śṛṇoti sā |
devī kṛtāñjalipuṭā jātūkarṇyo 'vadad drutam ||
jyaiṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
snātvā puṇyanadītoye pūjayec chubhadeśajam ||
śvetamandāram arkaṃ vā karavīraṃ ca raktakam |
nimbaṃ ca sūryadevasya vallabhaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā ||
dīpanaivedyapuṣpādyair mantreṇānena pāṇḍava |
nirīkṣya gagane sūryaṃ snātvā hṛdi samuccaret ||
sūryaṃ tvaṃ śvetamandāraśvetārkārkasya saṃbhava |
karavīra namas tubhyaṃ nimbavṛkṣya namo 'stu te ||
itthaṃ yo 'rcayate bhaktyā varṣe varṣe pṛthak naraḥ |
drumatrayaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā ||
tasyāḥ śarīre durgandho durbhāgyaṃ vā na jāyate |
na sāptnyabhayaṃ loke na vandhyādoṣajaṃ bhavet ||
jāyate 'tīva saubhāgyam anyastrīdurlabhaṃ nṛpa |
kathitaṃ yāś cariṣyanti gandhadaurbhāgyanāśanam ||
sarvadoṣair vinirmuktāḥ sukham aśnanti bhārata |
nimbaṃ navārkakaravīralalāsupuṇyaṃ
yāḥ pūjayanti kusumākṣatadīpadānaiḥ |
[16]        tāḥ sarvakāmasukhavṛddhisamṛddhibhājo
daurbhāgyadoṣarahitāḥ subhagā bhavanti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ durgandhadaurbhāgyanāśanatrayodaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kāntāravanadurgeṣu praviśadbhir nadīṣu ca |
samudrataraṇe caiva saṃgrāmeṣu varārdane ||
devatāṃ kāṃ smaret tatra paritrāṇakarīṃ vibho |
kathaṃ ca deva kurute paritrāṇakṛte janaḥ ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyāṃ durgāṃ bhagavatīṃ umām |
nāpnoti duḥkhaṃ puruṣaḥ saṃsmaran sarvamaṅgalām ||
alakṣyalakṣaṃ bhūtasya sarvasya hṛdaye sthitām |
na bhayaṃ samavāpnoti saṃsmarañ jagadasvikām ||
yadā tu śāstraṃ vijñātum avanyām aham āgataḥ |
guroḥ saṃdīpane pārśvaṃ valena saha bhārata ||
prāptavidyena ca mayā pratijñātāś ca dakṣiṇāḥ |
divyaṃ bhāvaṃ viditvā me tenāhaṃ bhāvitas tadā ||
prabhāsatīrthaṃ putro me mṛto 'sau dīyate tvayā |
mayā dhyātā tato devī sarvāpatsu ca tāraṇī ||
[17]        aṅkāvaṅketi vikhyātā tadā devī ca maṅgalām ||
tritayaṃ yo 'rcayet pārtha tasya sarvatra maṅgalam ||
saṃhitāntarakṛt valabhadramaṅgalā veti trayam |
tataḥ prabhṛti tatrasthāḥ pūjayanti janāḥ sadā |
māṃ caiva valabhadraṃ ca madhyasthāṃ sarvamaṅgalām ||
vāme nārāyaṇaḥ so 'haṃ kapādo bhavatas tataḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ site pakṣe māsi māsi dhṛtavrataḥ ||
ekabhaktena naktena upavāsena vā punaḥ |
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sadīpaiś ca madhumīdhusurāsavaiḥ ||
palaloḍarakaiḥ kṣipraṃ valibhaktaiś ca bhaktitaḥ |
yo 'bhyarcayeta rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
sarvāpatsu taraty eva tritayaṃ saṃsmarec ca yaḥ |
atha vā dūradeśasthaḥ kārayet pratimātrayam ||
mṛṇmayaṃ kāñcanaṃ cāpi likhitaṃ citrakāpi ca |
pūjayitvā vidhānena sarvaṃ tat phalam aśnute ||
etat trayaṃ tridaśame 'hni site sadaiva
yaḥ pūjayet kusumamāṃsasuropahāraiḥ |
naśyanti tasya bhavaneṣv atibhīṣaṇāni
cīrārijantujanitāni bhayāni sadyaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktasarvamaṅgalātrayodaśīvratam ||
[18]                mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe mahārāja trayodaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
pūjayet kāmadevaṃ tu vaiśākhāt prabhṛti prabho ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā |
dadyād vratānte viprāya gandhavastrayugaṃ tathā ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭam
āsyādya nākaṃ sucire manuṣyaḥ |
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavaty arogaḥ
sukhānvito rūpasamanvitaś ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ kāmadevavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe mahārājaṃ trayodaśyam upoṣitaḥ |
phālgunān tu samārabhya nityaṃ saṃpūjayen naraḥ ||
mahārajaṃ tu dhanadam |
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā |
suvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇendrāya vratānte pratipādayet ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
pakṣeṣu rājan suciraṃ upoṣya |
[19]        mānuṣyam āsādya dhanānvitaḥ syāt
saubhāgyayuktaś ca tathā virogaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ nandavratam |
vyāsa uvāca |
trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāraṃ trilocanam |
dṛṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
iti bhaviṣatpurāṇoktaṃ pradoṣavratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
atha svastyayanaṃ puṃsāṃ śṛṇvatām aghanāśanam |
trayodaśyāṃ mahāyuddhe vratam etan niśāmaya ||
navanītaṃ navaṃ gavyaṃ rajatāṃśusamaprabham |
kapitthaphalamātraṃ yat samādāya susaṃyataḥ ||
raupyatāmramaye pātre sauvarṇe vātha mṛṇmaye |
suvarṇaracite tasya nikṣipet prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ ||
snātaś ca kṛtajapyaś ca śuddhāmbaradharaḥ svayam |
maṇḍalaṃ puṣpanikarair akṣatair vā prakalpayet ||
tasminn aṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ kārayet kusumotkaraiḥ |
tatra lakṣmīpatiṃ devaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ divyayā ||
karṇikāyāṃ samāvāhya daleṣv āvāhayet tathā |
śaktīr aṣṭau tu tanmantrair diśāṃ pālāṃs tu bāhyataḥ ||
[20]        vidhāya devayajanaṃ svādumūlaphalāni ca |
tadagre tat samānīya navanītaṃ navaṃ śuciḥ |
dvidhā kṛtvā tad ekaikaṃ mantreṇaivābhimantrayet ||
mantraḥ |
puruṣaḥ pūrṇakāmaś ca harir bhadraṃ karotu naḥ |
yoṣidvrate sadā lakṣmīr maṅgalaṃ diśatu svayam ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ patnyai dadyād ekaikam agrataḥ |
pūrvaṃ puṃlakṣitaṃ piṇḍam itaraṃ ca tathāparam ||
itaraṃ strīlakṣitam |
prāśyācamya sthitāṃ patnīṃ prayatām abhimantrayet |
yas tv antarātmā bhūtānām anādinidanacyutaḥ ||
sa paraḥ parayā bhaktyā kukṣi(ṃ?) rakṣantu me sadā |
sarvapuṣṭiprajananī sarvārtiśamanī tathā ||
lakṣmīḥ kukṣigataṃ garbhaṃ rakṣatād acyutapriyā |
sarvārtikṣayadakṣāṇi divyaśaktiyutāny api ||
tvā rakṣantu sadā viṣṇoḥ sarvapraharaṇāny api |
tathā dikpatayaḥ sarve rakṣantu grahadevatāḥ ||
pāntu saṃsārasaṃyuktāṃ sarve rakṣantu sarvadā |
iti kṛtvā tataḥ kuryād brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇam ||
gurave ca varaṃ datvā niyamān pratipālayet |
vadhvā sahopavastavyaṃ tad dinaṃ prayatātmanā ||
caturdaśyāṃ tu susnātaḥ kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ śuciḥ |
brāḥmaṇān bhojayitvā tu dadyāc ca gurudakṣiṇām ||
[21]        bhuñjīta bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ niyamān utsṛjet tataḥ ||
evaṃ kurvan naraḥ śuddho bahvapatyaṃ ca vindati |
vandhyāpi labhate putraṃ manonayananandanam ||
kanyāpi supatiṃ vindet vratenānena suvratā |
māṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ prāpya dīrgham āyuś ca vindati ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ trayodaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
gaurīṃ vivāhya jagrāha haraḥ pāśupataṃ vratam |
umāpatiḥ paśupatir dhyānāsakto babhūva ha ||
brahmādibhiś ca saṃmantrya viśuddhaputralabdhaye |
gauryā manobhinaṣitapūraṇāya praharṣitaiḥ ||
prahitaḥ kṣobhaṇārthāya samartha iti manmathaḥ |
tato māro jagāmātha āśramaṃ ratisaṃyutaḥ ||
īśvarasya dhanuḥpāṇir vasantaśrīsahāyavān |
sa cekṣucāpam ākṛṣya madanonmādanaṃ śaram ||
cikṣepa tripuraghnāgre samādhir bhaṅgahetave |
buddhvā tu tasya saṅkalpaṃ rudraḥ krodhajvaladvapuḥ ||
lalāṭe bahnim asṛjat tṛtīyanayanād dharaḥ |
kāmo 'valokitas tena bhasmībhūtaś ca tatkṣaṇāt ||
dagdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā smaraṃ śokād ratiprītyau sthite sadā |
[22]        karuṇaṃ vilapantyau ca sarvam anyadiśāṃ gate ||
tataḥ śokārdrahṛdayā gaurī rudram uvāca ha |
bhagavan madarthe saṃraruḥ kāmaṃ nirdagdhavān asi ||
tenaite paśyatārya dve kāmasya ruditaḥ katham |
kuru prasādaṃ deveśa ratiprītyo vṛṣadhvaja ||
saṃjīvaya punaḥ śambho mūrtimantaṃ punaḥ kuru |
tac chrutvā tu mahādevo hṛṣṭaḥ provāca pārvatīm ||
upaplutaṃ jagat sarvaṃ manmathena śarīriṇā |
mayā dagdhasya kāmasya punar āgamanaṃ kutaḥ ||
kiṃ ca te mānavadvākya karomi saphalaṃ priye |
asmin vasantasamaye śuklapakṣe trayodaśī ||
asyāṃ manobhavo devo bhaviṣyati śarīravān |
etena bījabhūtena jagad vartiṣyate 'khilam ||
evaṃ varam idaṃ datvā manmathāya yudhiṣṭhira |
jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhe kailāśaṃ pārvatīpriyaḥ |
tad etat te samākhyātaṃ smarasya caritaṃ nṛpa ||
pūjāvidhānam aparaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tat |
asyāṃ snātvā trayodaśyām aśokākhyaṃ nagaṃ likhet ||
sindūrarajanīraṅgai ratiprītisamanvitam |
kāmadevaṃ mattavājivaktraṃ tatra vṛṣadhvajam ||
sauvarṇa vā mahārāja vṛkṣaṃ caitram athāpi vā |
līlāvilāsagamanagarvitaṃ cānapsarogaṇam ||
[23]        gandharvagītavāditraprekṣaṇīyasamākulam |
nandyāvartakratukrīḍāprītividyādharīyutam ||
madhyāhne pūjayet bhaktyā bhakṣyair dhūpaiḥ sugandhakaiḥ |
mantreṇānena rājendra naranārīsamanvitam |
namaḥ kāmāya devāya devadevāya mūrtaye ||
brahmaviṣṇusureśānāṃ manaḥkṣobhakarāya vai |
kṛtvaivam arcayitvā tu devadevaṃ manobhavam ||
tatas tadagrato deyā modakāḥ sukhamodakāḥ |
nānāprakārān bhakṣyāṃś ca kāmo me prīyatām iti ||
tato visarjayed viprān datvā yugmaṃ sadakṣiṇam |
yugmaṃ gomithunam |
svapatiṃ pūjayen nārī vastramālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
kāmo 'yam iti saṃcintya prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā ||
manmathāya mahāpūjāṃ yajamānaḥ suhṛdvrataḥ (?) |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sukharātrir yathā bhavet ||
karpūraṃ kuṅkumakṣodagandhatāmbūlasarjanaiḥ |
śūdrāṇāṃ madyadānaiś ca kuryād rāsa mahotsavam ||
dīpaprajvalanaidbhittyauḥ (?) nṛtyaiḥ prekṣaṇakotsavaiḥ |
[24]        evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha varṣe varṣe mahotsavam ||
vasantasamaye prāpte hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭo nṛpaḥ pure |
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat śokarogair vimucyate ||
subhikṣyakṣemam āropya yaśaśrīsaukhyam uttamam |
kāmavarṣī ca parjanyaḥ tasmin rāṣṭre prajāyate ||
tuṣyate nātra saṃdeho dvādaśārdhārdhalocanaḥ |
tathā kāmaś ca viṣṇuś ca vasantaś ca prajāpatiḥ ||
candrasūryādikāḥ sarve grahā brahmarṣayas tathā |
sarve 'pi tasya tuṣyanti yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ||
asurā yātudhānāś ca suparṇaḥ pannagā nagāḥ |
tuṣṭāḥ prayacchanti sukhaṃ tasya kartur na saṃśayaḥ ||
caitrotsave sakalalokamanonivāse |
kāmaṃ vasantamalayādrimarutsahāyam ||
patnyā sahārcya puruṣapravato 'tha yoṣit |
saubhāgyarūpasutasaukhyayutā sadā syāt ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktamadanamahotsavaḥ |
vyāsa uvāca |
mandavārayutā puṇyā śuklapakṣe trayodaśī |
tasyām upoṣya vidhivat saṃpūjya girijāpatim ||
brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpair mukto bhavati mānavaḥ ||
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ sarvavratam |
[25]        puṣyāditas trayodaśyāṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ madhau punaḥ |
aśokaṃ kāñcanaṃ dadyād ikṣuyuktaṃ daśāṅgulam ||
viprāya vastrasaṃyuktaṃ pradyumnaḥ prīyatām iti |
kalpaṃ viṣṇupure sthitvā viśokaḥ syāt pumān nṛpaḥ |
etat kāmavrataṃ nāma sadā śokavināśanam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kāmavratam |
brahmovāca |
kāmaṃ pūjya trayodaśyāṃ surūpo jāyate dhruvam |
iṣṭāṃ rūpavatīṃ bhāryāṃ labhet kāmāṃśca puṣkalān ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasyaḥ (?) kartavyaś ca tathīśvaraḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārā samidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśyābharapratipadvratavat vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ kāmatrayodaśīvratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe trayodaśīvratāni |
[26]
atha aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha caturdaśīvratāni |
digdantāvalakarṇatālavapanapreṅkholabhṛṅgāṅganā
sadgītiśrutimiśritaṃ sumadhuraṃ vaikuṇṭhakuṇṭhasvaraiḥ |
kīrtiṃ kinnarayoṣitaḥ pratidiśaṅ gāyanti yasyāniśaṃ
hemādriḥ sa caturdaśīvratagaṇaṃ brūte mahāsiddhidam ||
śrīkṛṇa uvāca |
anantavratam apy anyattithā vasyām anuttamam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ caiva yudhiṣṭhira ||
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade bhavet |
tasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvapāpād vyapohati ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kṛṣṇa ko 'yam ananteti procyate yas tayā vibho |
kiṃ śeṣanāga āhosvid anantas takṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
paramātmā tathānanta utāho brahma ucyate |
ka eṣo 'nantasaṃjño vai tathyaṃ me brūhi keśava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
ananta ity ahaṃ pārtha mama rūpaṃ nibodha vai |
ādityādigrahā vārā yaḥ kāla upapadyate ||
[27]        kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtādi dinarātriśarīravān |
pakṣamāsartuvarṣāṇi yugakalpavyavasthayā ||
yo 'yaṃ kālo mayā khyātaḥ so 'nanta iti kīrtyate |
so 'haṃ kalāvatīrṇo 'tra bhuvo bhārāvatāraṇāt ||
dānavānāṃ vināśāya sādhūnāṃ pālanāya ca |
anādi madhyamaryantakṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ śivam ||
brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ somaṃ sarvavyāpakam īśvaram |
viśvarūpaṃ mahākālaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakam ||
pratyayārthaṃ mayā rūpaṃ phālgunāya pradarśitam |
sarvam eva mahābāho yogidhyeyam anuttamam ||
viśvarūpam anantaṃ ca yasminn indrāś caturdaśā |
vasavo 'ṣṭau dvādaśārkā rudrā ekādaśāmalāḥ ||
saptarṣayaḥ samudrāś ca parvatāḥ sarito drumāḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi diśo bhūmiḥ pātālaṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaha |
mā kuruṣvātra saṃdehaṃ so 'haṃ pārtha na saṃśayaḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
anantavratamāhātmyavidhiṃ vidhividāmbara |
kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ yat syād anuṣṭhānavatāṃ nṛṇām ||
kena vādau purā cīrṇaṃ martye kena prakāśitam |
evaṃ savistaraṃ kṛṣṇa brūhy ananta vrataṃ mama ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
āsīt purā kṛtayuge sumantur nāma vai dvija |
[28]        vasiṣthagotre cotpannaḥ susurūpāṃ bhṛgoḥ sutām ||
dīkṣāṃ nāmopayeme tāṃ vedoktavidhinā nṛpa |
tasyāḥ kālena saṃjātā duhitā nandadāyinī ||
śīlā nāma suśīlā sā nyavasan mātṛsadmani |
tataḥ kālena kiyatā jvaradāhena pīḍitā ||
vinanāśa nadītoye yayau svargaṃ pativratā |
sumantus tu tato yajñe dharmaṃ puṃsaḥ satāṃ punaḥ ||
upayeme vidhānena karkaśāṃ nāma nāmataḥ |
duḥśīlāṃ karkaśāṃ caṇḍīṃ nityaṃ kalahakāriṇīm ||
sāpi śīlā putur gehe gṛhārcanaratā babhau |
kuḍyastambhākganadvāradehalītoraṇādiṣu ||
varṇakaiś citram akarot nīlapītasitāsitaiḥ |
svastikaiḥ śaṅkhapadmaiś ca arvayantī punaḥ punaḥ ||
tataḥ kāle bahutithe gate māradaśānugā |
pitrā dṛṣṭā tadā tena strīcihne yauvane sthitā ||
kasmai deyā mayā śīlā vicāryaivaṃ suduḥkhitaḥ |
pitā dadau dvijendrāya kauṇḍinyāya śubhe dine ||
gṛhyoktavidhinā pārtha vivāham akarot tadā |
nivartyaudvāhikaṃ sarvaṃ proktavān karkaśāṃ dvijaḥ ||
kiṃcid dāyādikaṃ deyaṃ jāmātuḥ paritoṣakam |
tat śrutvā karkaśā kruddhā procchāya gṛhamaṇḍanam ||
paṭāyāṃ susthitaṃ kṛtvā svagṛhaṃ gamyatām iti |
bhojyāvasiṣṭacūrṇena pātheyaṃ ca cakāra sā ||
[29]        kauṇḍinyo 'pi vivāhyenāṃ pathi gacchan śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
śīlāṃ suśīlām ādāya navoḍhāṃ gauravena hi ||
madhyāhne bhojyavelāyāṃ samuttīrya sarittaṭe |
dadarśa śīlā strīṇāṃ sā samūhaṃ raktavāsasām ||
caturdaśyām arcayantaṃ bhaktyā devaṃ janārdanam |
upagamya śanaiḥ sātha prapraccha (papraccha) strīkadambakam ||
āryā kim etan me brūta kiṃ nāma vratam īdṛśam |
tā ūcur yoṣitas tāṃ tu śīlāṃ śīlavibhūṣaṇām ||
anantavratam etad dhi vrate 'nantas tu pūjyate |
sā vravīd aham etat te kariṣye vratam uttamam ||
vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatra kiṃ dānaṃ ko 'tra pūjyate |
striya ūcuḥ |
śīle sadannaprasthasya punnāmasaṃskṛtasya ca |
ardhaṃ viprāya dātavyam ardham ātmani bhojanam ||
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitām |
kartavyaṃ sa sarittīre vidhinānena mānini ||
snātvānantaṃ samabhyarcya gandhalepanadhūpanaiḥ |
puṣpair gandhaiḥ sunaivedyaiḥ pītataktaiś catuḥsamaiḥ ||
tasyāgrato dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ kuṅkumāktaṃ suḍorakam |
caturdaśagranthiyutaṃ vāme karatale nyaset ||
mantreṇānena suśroṇi yāvad varṣaṃ samāpyate ||
anantasaṃsāramahāsamudre
magnān samabhyūddhara vāsudeva |
[30]        anantarūpī viniyojayasva
anantasūtrāya namo namas te ||
anena ḍorakaṃ baddhvā bhoktavyaṃ svasthamānasaiḥ |
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devam anantaṃ viśvarūpiṇam |
bhuktvā cānto vrajed veśma bhadre uktaṃ vrataṃ tava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
evam ākarṇya rājendra prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā |
sāpi cakre vrataṃ śīlā kare baddhā suḍorakam ||
pātheyam arghaṃ (?) viprāya datvā bhaktaṃ svayaṃ tathā |
punar jagāma saṃhṛṣṭā gorathena pater gṛham ||
bhartrā sahaiva śanakaiḥ pratyayas takṣaṇād abhūt |
tenānantavratenāsyā bālaṃ gorasasaṃkulam ||
gṛhāśramaṃ śriyā juṣṭaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam |
kulam avyākulaṃ ramyaṃ sarvatrātithipūjanam ||
sāpi māṇikyakāñcībhir muktāhāravibhūṣitā |
devāṅgavastrasaṃcchannā sāvitrī pratimābhavat ||
kadācid upaviṣṭāyā hṛṣṭo baddhaḥ saḍorakaḥ |
śīlāyā hastamūle tu bhartā tena (?) dvijanmanā ||
strīmadāndhena kauravya sākṣepaṃ trīṭitaṃ ruṣā |
ko 'nanta iti mūḍhena jalpatā pāpakāriṇā ||
kṣiptā jvālā kule vahnī hāhā kṛtvā pradhāvitā |
śīlā gṛhītvā sūtraṃ ca kṣīramadhye samākṣipet ||
[31]        tena karmavipākena tasya sā śrīḥ kṣayaṃ gatā|
godhanaṃ taskarair nītaṃ gṛhaṃ muṣṭam akāñcanam ||
yad yatraivāgataṃ tatra tatraiva ca vinirgatam |
svajanaiḥ kalaho mitrair vañcanaṃ bharjanaṃ tathā ||
anantākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe |
na kaścid dadato loke tena sārdhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
śarīreṇātisaṃtapto māyayāpy atiduḥkhitaḥ |
nirvedaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ kaiṇḍinyaḥ prāha tāṃ priyāṃ ||
śīle kim etad utpannaṃ sahasā śrīkakārakam |
yenātiduḥkhato 'smākaṃ jātaḥ sarvadhanakṣayam ||
svajanaiḥ kalaho gehe na kaścin me prabhāṣate |
śarīre tīvrasaṃtāpaḥ kṣedaś cetasi dāruṇaḥ ||
jānāsi durnayaḥ ko 'tra kiṃ kṛtaṃ diṣkṛtaṃ bhavet |
pratyuvāca taṃ śīlā suśīlā śīlamaṇḍanā ||
prāyo 'nantakṛtākṣepapāpasaṃbhavajaṃ phalam |
bhaviṣyati mahābhāga tadarthaṃ yatnam ācara ||
evam uktaḥ sa viprarṣir jagāma manasā harim |
nirvedonnirjagāmātha kauṇḍinyaḥ prayato vanam ||
tapase kṛtasaṅkalpo vāyubhakṣyo dvijottamaḥ |
manasyādhyāya cānantaṃ kva drakṣyāmi tato vibhum ||
yasyāprasādāt saṃjātam ākṣepān nirdhanaṃ gatam |
dhanādikaṃ mamātīva sukhaduḥkhapradāyakam ||
evaṃ saṃcintayat so 'tha babhāma vijane vane ||
[32]        tatrāpaśyat mahācūtaṃ phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā |
varjitaṃ pakṣisaṅghātaiḥ kīkaṭe vibhavaṃ yathā||
tam apṛcchat tvayānantaḥ kaścid dṛṣṭo mahātaro |
bhrūhi saumya mamātīva duḥkhaṃ cetasi vartate ||
so 'bravīd bhadra nānantaṃ vedmi drakṣyāmi vā dvija |
evaṃ nirākṛtas tena jagāmātha dvijas tataḥ ||
kva drakṣyāmīti gacchan sa gām apaśyat savatsakām |
tṛṇamadhye pradhāvantīm itaś cetaś ca pāṇḍava ||
apṛcchad venike brūhi yady anantas tvayekṣitaḥ |
sā covācātha kauṇḍinyaṃ nānantaṃ vedmy ahaṃ dvijaḥ ||
tato vrajan dadarśāgre ramyaṃ puṣkariṇīdvayam |
anyonyajalakallolavīciparyaṅkasaṅgamam ||
channaṃ kiñjalkakahlārakamalotpalamaṇḍalaiḥ |
sevitaṃ bhramarair haṃsaiś cakraiḥ kāraṇḍavair vakaiḥ ||
te cāpṛccha dvijā 'nanto bhavatībhyāṃ na lakṣitaḥ |
japatas te dvijaśreṣṭha nānantaṃ vedmi hi kila ||
dadarśātha vane tasmin gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ tathā |
tāvathotau (?) dvijenoktau ūcatur naiva vidmahe ||
evaṃ samyak kva drakṣyāmi tatraiva bhuvi (?) tādṛśaḥ |
kauṇḍinyau vihvalobhūto nirāśo jīvite nṛpa ||
dīrgham uṣṇaṃ ca niśvasya papāta bhuvi bhārata |
prāpya saṃjñām ananteti jalpann utthāya sa dvijaḥ||
nūnaṃ paśyāmy ahaṃ prāṇān iti saṅkalpya cetasi |
[33]        utthāyodbudhya vṛkṣe 'smin tāvad bhārata sattama ||
kṛpayānantadevo 'sya pratyakṣaṃ samajāyata |
vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa ehy ehī cety (?) uvāca tam ||
pragṛhya dakṣiṇe pāṇau guhām āveśya taṃ svataḥ |
svāṃ purīṃ darśayāmāsa divyanārīnarair yutam ||
tasyāṃ niviṣṭam ātmānaṃ divyasiṃhāsane śubhe |
pārśvasthaṃ śaṅkhacakraṃ ca gadāgaruḍaśobhitam ||
darśayāmāsa viprāya viśvarūpam anantakam |
vibhūtibhedaiś cānantair anantam amitaujasam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ rūpam anantam aparājitam ||
vepanāno jagādoccair jayaśabdapuraḥsaram |
jaya kṛṣṇa jayānanta viśvamūrte jayāvyaya ||
jaya sarvaikakarteti saṃharte ca jayācyuta |
anādinidhanā vyakta jaya nitya jayākṣara ||
jaya sarvaga sarvātman sarvasya kṛdayeśayaḥ |
evamādi praṇamyātha punar apy āha taṃ dvijam ||
pāpo 'haṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ pāpātmā pāpasaṃbhavaḥ |
trāhi māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa sarvapāpaharo bhava ||
tac chrutvānantadevaś ca prāha susnigdhayā girā |
mābhais tvaṃ brūhi viprendra yat te manasi vartate ||
kauṇḍinya uvāca |
mayā bhūtvā viluptena troṭito 'nantaḍorakaḥ |
tena pāpavipākena bhūtir me pralayaṃ gatā ||
[34]        svajanaiḥ kalaho gehe na kaścin māṃ prabhāvate |
nirvedāt bhramito 'raṇye tava darśanakāṅkṣayā ||
kṛpayā devadevaś ca tvayāsmākaṃ pradarśitaḥ |
tasya pāpasya me śāṇtiṃ kāruṇyād vaktum arhasi ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
tac chrutvānandeveśa uvāca dvijasattamam |
bhaktyā mātā pitā devaḥ kiṃ na dadyād yudhiṣṭhira ||
ananta uvāca |
svagṛhaṃ gaccha kauṇḍinya mā vilambaṃ kariṣyasi |
varānantavrataṃ kuryāt navavarṣāṇi pañca ca ||
tataḥ pāpaviśuddhātmā prāpsyase ṛddim uttamām |
putrapautrān samutpādya bhuktvā bhogān mano'nugān ||
ante ca smaraṇaṃ prāpya mām upoṣyasya saṃśayam |
anyac ca te varaṃ dadmi sarvalokopakārakam ||
idam ākhyānakaṃ śrutvā śīlānantavratādikam |
kariṣyati naro yas tu kurvan vratam idaṃ śubham ||
so 'cirāt pāpanirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim |
gaccha vipra gṛhaṃ śīghraṃ yathā yenāgato hy asi ||
kauṇḍinya uvāca |
svāmin pṛcchāmi me brūhi kiṃcit kautūhalaṃ mayā |
araṇye bhramatā dṛṣṭaṃ na tad vedmi jagadguro ||
sa cūtavṛkṣas tasmin gaur ekā ca vṛṣabhas tathā |
[35]        kamalotpalakahlāraiḥ śobhitaṃ sumanoharam ||
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ mahāraṇye kiṃ tat puṣkariṇīdvayam |
kaḥ kharaḥ kuñjaraḥ ko 'sau ko 'sau vṛddho dvijottamaḥ ||
ananta uvāca |
sa cūtavṛkṣo vipro 'sau vedārthatvaviśāradaḥ |
so 'rthito 'pi na vai prādāc chiṣyebhyas tarutāṃ gataḥ ||
sā gau vasundharā dṛṣṭā suphalā yā tvayā dvija |
vṛṣo dharmas tayā dṛṣṭaḥ śādvalaṃ satyam āśritaḥ ||
dharmavyavasthānaṃ tac ca yad yat puṣkariṇīdvayam |
brāhmaṇyau kecid apy āstāṃ bhaginyau te parasparam ||
dharmādharmādi yat kiṃcit taṃ nivedayato mithaḥ |
viprāya na kvacid dattam atithau durbalo 'pi vā ||
bhikṣā dattā na cārthibhyo tena pāpena karmaṇā |
vīcīkallolamālābhir gacchatas te parasparam ||
kharaḥ krodhas tayā dṛṣṭaḥ kuñjaro roga ucyate |
brāhmaṇo 'sāv ananto 'haṃ guhāsaṃsāragahvaram ||
ity uktvā devadeveśas tatraivāntaradhīyate |
svapnaprāyaṃ ca tad dṛṣṭvā tataḥ svagṛham āgataḥ ||
kṛtvānantavrataṃ samyak navavarṣāṇi pañca ca |
bhuktvā sarvam anantena yathoktaṃ pāṇḍunandana ||
ante ca smaraṇaṃ prāpya gato 'nantapure dvijaḥ |
tathā tvam api rājendra kathāṃ śṛṇvan vrataṃ kuru ||
[36]        prāpsyase cintitaṃ sarvam anantasya vaco yathā |
yac caturdaśame varṣe phalaṃ prāptaṃ dvijanmanā ||
varṣaikena tad apnoti kṛtvā sākhyānakaṃ vratam |
yat kṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
ye 'pi śṛṇvanti satataṃ tathānye ca paṭhanti ye |
te 'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ prāpsanti ca hareḥ padam ||
saṃsāragahvaraguhāḥ sasukhaṃ vihartuṃ
vāñchanti ye kurukulodvaha śuddhacittāḥ |
saṃpūjya ca tribhuvaneśam anantadevaṃ
badhnanti dakṣiṇakare varaḍorakaṃ te ||
ity anantavratam |
athodyāpanavidhir abhidhīyate |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
devadevaṃ samāpyaiva vratasya paramādbhutam |
udyāpanavidhiṃ kṛṣṇa anugrāhyo 'smi keśava ||
udyāpanavidhiṃ vinā na vratasya phalaṃ bhavet |
tasmād yathā tathā kuryād vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade prāpte paripūrṇe vrate tataḥ |
śuklāyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ brahmacārī vratī nataḥ ||
[37]        ekabhaktena niyamaṃ kṛtvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
snātvā nadyāṃ devakhāte tīrthapraśravaṇe tathā ||
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhais tilakalkair athāmalaiḥ |
vedoktavidhinā samyak tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ ||
tato gṛhaṃ samāgatya vediṃ kṛtvā suśobhanām |
tatrālikhen maṇḍalakaṃ pañcavarṇaiḥ suśobhitaiḥ ||
navanālaṃ susampūrṇaṃ sarvatobhadram eva ca |
tasyopari nyaset kumbham avraṇaṃ suhṛdaṃ navam ||
tāmrapātryā samāyuktaṃ daridreṇāpi pārthivaḥ |
kṛtvānantaṃ prayatnena tāmrapātropari nyaset ||
śayyāṃ suvistarāṃ kṛtvā tatrānantaṃ nyased vratī |
lakṣmyā yuktaṃ vāsudevaṃ muśalena halena ca ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayitvā ca vastrair ābharaṇais tathā ||
varṇāṅgulīyacitraiś ca bhaktyā ca susamāhitaḥ |
tatas taṃ pūjayed devam anantaṃ viśvarūpiṇam ||
vastrayugmasamācchannaṃ pītayajñopavītinam |
candanena sugandhena karpūrāgurumiśriṇā ||
lepayec ca tato 'ṅgāni prīyatāṃ madhusūdana ||
anulepanamantraḥ |
tataḥ puṣpāṇi saṃgṛhya pūjayen nāmabhiḥ pṛthak |
anantāya namaḥ pādau gulpho saṅkarṣaṇāya ca ||
[38]        kāyātmane tu jānubhyāṃ jaghanaṃ viśvarūpiṇe |
koṭiṃ vai viśvarūpāya meḍhraṃ vai viśvarūpiṇe ||
nābhyāṃ tu padmanābhāya hṛdaye paramātmane |
kaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya bāhū sarvāstradhāriṇe ||
vācaspate namas tubhyaṃ mukhe saṃpūjayed dharim |
lalāṭe keśavāyeti śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ ||
sokātmā sarvabhūtātmā nimiṣas truṭisaṃlavaḥ ||
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhisaṃsārabhayanāśana |
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyaḥ sumanoharaḥ |
āhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhūpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
dhūpamantraḥ |
tvaṃ jyotiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejasāṃ teja uttamam |
ātmajyotiḥ paraṃ dhāma dīpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
dīpamantraḥ |
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu bhūtānāṃ jīvanaṃ param |
naivedyaṃ te mayā dattaṃ deva prītyā pragṛhyatām ||
pūgīphalaṃ sahānyena karpūraṃ ca manoharam |
pavitrīkṛtam anyaṃ taṃ tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
vastrayugmaṃ śuci yasmād vāsudevasya vallabham |
anantaḥ prīyatāṃ tena prītavarṇena me sadā ||
evaṃ pūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gacchet kuṇḍasamāśrayam |
svagṛhyoktavidhānena kṛtvāgnisthāpanaṃ tataḥ ||
[39]        prārabhet tu tato homam aśvatthasamidhas tilaiḥ |
vrīhibhiś ca yavaiś caiva vṛtena tu vidhānataḥ ||
puruṣasūktena juhuyād ato deveti vā punaḥ |
idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame tredhā nidadhe padam ||
śatam aṣṭottaraṃ yāvat pratyekaṃ juhuyād guruḥ |
sarvaṃ hutvā vidhānena mantrair etair vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
anantāya svāhā | kālāya svāhā | saṃvatsarāya svāhā | ahorātrāya svāhā | ardhamāsāya svāhā | māsāya svāhā | ṛtubhyaḥ svāhā | saṃvatsarāya svāhā | tato mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ | sarvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ caruṇām ājyatilaiḥ sviṣṭakṛt prajāpatibhyāṃ juhuyāt |
tato vai lokapālāṃś ca grahān pūjya yathākramam |
gītavāditraninadair datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ vratī ||
purāṇaśravaṇais tadvat rātriśeṣaṃ nayed vratī |
tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā śuddhaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena pūjayed viśvarūpiṇam |
pūjayitvā hariṃ devam ācāryaṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||
paridhāpya sapatnīkaṃ vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitam |
mantraiḥ saṃpūjya vidhivad dhenuṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥ ||
surabhī vaiṣṇavī mātā nityaṃ viṣṇupade sthitā |
grāsaṃ gṛhya mayā dattaṃ gomātas trātum arhasi ||
[40]        gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
gāvo me hṛdaye santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham ||
godānasyādhānārthaṃ dadyāt svarṇaṃ yathāvidhi |
mantreṇānena saṃpūjya ācāryāya nivedayet ||
anyac ca parivāsaś ca ācāryāya nivedayet |
āmantritān atho viprān pūjayec ca caturdaśa |
vastropavītaiḥ saṃpūjya bhojayed annavistaraiḥ ||
tatas tu dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyo vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
svaśaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād ācāryāya kṣamāpayet ||
kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ dravyahīnaṃ tathaiva ca |
mantrahīnaṃ paṭhet paścāt vratasaṃpūrṇahetave ||
ananta saṃsāramahāsamudre
magnaṃ samabhyuddhara vāsudeva |
anantarūpe viniyojayasva
anantarūpāya namo namas te ||
ity anantaṃ visarjyātha brāhmaṇāṃś ca tathaiva ca |
dīnebhyaḥ kṛpaṇebhyaś ca dadyāc caiva tathā dhanam ||
tata iṣṭaiḥ samastaiś ca putrasaṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ |
yathopapannaṃ bhoktavyaṃ kṛtvā mānasam avyaye ||
ācāryaṃ (?) ca śucir bhūtvā cintyo viṣṇuś ca taddine |
[41]        evaṃkṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha karmaṇāśu janārdanaḥ ||
anantarūpī bhagavāṃs tuṣṭo bhavati sarvadā |
vratasya phalam āpnoti viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
sūta uvāca |
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā devadevaṃ jagadgurum |
sukhāsīnaṃ (?) tadutsaṅge śāntakopaṃ ramāpatim ||
prahlādo jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pālayan rājyam uttamam |
ekākī ca tadutsaṅge priyaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
prahlāda ucāva |
namas te bhagavan viṣṇo nṛsiṃharūpiṇe namaḥ |
tvadbhakto 'haṃ sureśaikaṃ tvāṃ pṛcchāmi ca tattvataḥ ||
svāmin tvayi mamāmitre bhaktir jātā tv anekadhā |
kathaṃ ca te priyo jātaḥ kāraṇaṃ vada me prabho ||
nṛsiṃha uvāca |
kathayāmi mahāprājña śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ |
bhakter yat kāraṇaṃ vatsa priyatvasya ca kāraṇam ||
purā kāle hy abhūd vipraḥ kiṃ tu tvaṃ nāpy adhītavān ||
nāmnā tvaṃ vāsudevo hi veśyāsv āsaktamānasaḥ |
yasmin janmani naiva tvaṃ cakāra sukṛtaṃ kiyat ||
muktvā tu sadvrataṃ naikaṃ veśyāsaṅgatilālasaḥ |
madvratasya prabhāvena bhaktir jātā tavānagha ||
[42]                prahāda uvāca |
śrīnṛsiṃhocyatāṃ tāvat kasya putrasya kiṃ vratam |
veśyāyāṃ vartamānena kathaṃ tac ca kṛtaṃ mayā ||
yena tad viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ vaktum arhasi sāṃpratam ||
nṛsiṃha uvāca |
purāvantīpure tv āsīt brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ |
tasya nāma suśarmeti bahulokeṣu viśrutaḥ ||
nityahomatriyāṃ caiva vidadhāti dvijottamaḥ |
brāhmakriyāsu niyataḥ sarvāsu kila tatparaḥ ||
agniṣṭomādibhir yajñair iṣṭāḥ sarve surottamāḥ |
tenāpi vidyamānena kṛtaṃ bho duṣkṛtaṃ kiyat ||
tasya bhāryā suśīlābhūd vikhyātā buvanatraye |
pativratā sadācārā patibhaktiparāyaṇā ||
jajñire 'syāṃ sutāḥ pañca tasmād dvijavarāt tathā |
sadācārāḥ suvidvāṃsaḥ pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ||
teṣāṃ madhye kaniṣṭhas tvaṃ veśyāsaṅgatitatparaḥ |
tathā niṣedhamānena surāpānaṃ tvayā kṛtam ||
suvarṇaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ taiś ca samaṃ cīrṇam aghaṃ bahu |
vilāsinyā gṛhe nityaṃ hasase vinivāritaḥ ||
vilāsinī veśyā |
ekadā tadgṛhe hy āsīn (?) mahākalis tayā saha |
tena kalahabhāvena bhojanaṃ na tvayā kṛtam ||
[43]        ajñātāt madvrataṃ cakre vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
tasyāṃ vihārayogena rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtam ||
veśyāyā vallabhaṃ kaṃcit prajātaṃ na tvayā samam |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cīrṇaṃ tyaktaṃ bhogyam anekaśaḥ ||
vratenānena cīrṇena modanti divi devatāḥ |
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ ca purā brahmā cakre hy etad anuttamam ||
madvratasya prabhāvena nirmitaṃ sa carācaram |
īśvareṇa purā cīrṇaṃ vadhārthaṃ tripurasya ca ||
māhātmyena vratasyāśu tripuras tu nipātitaḥ |
anyaiś ca bahubhir devai ṛṣibhiś ca purānagha ||
rājabhiś ca mahāprājñair vihitaṃ vratam uttamam |
etadvrataprabhāvena sarve siddhim upāgatāḥ |
vaiśyāpi matpriyā jātā trailokye sukhacāriṇī ||
īdṛśaṃ madvrataṃ vatsa trailokyeṣu ca viśrutam |
kalahena vilāsinyā vratam etad upasthitam ||
prahlāda tena te bhaktir mayi jātā hy anuttamā |
dūrtayā ca vilāsinyā jñātvā vratadinaṃ mama ||
kalahaś ca kṛto yena madvrataṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhavet |
sā veśyā tv apsarā jātā bhuktvā bhogān anekaśaḥ ||
muktvā karma vilāsi tvaṃ prahlāda suvismayaḥ |
kāryārthaṃ bhagavān āste matsarī ca pṛthak tathā ||
vidhāya sarvakāryāṇi śīghraṃ tvaṃ ca gamiṣyasi |
ya idaṃ vratam āvaśyaṃ prakariṣyati mānavaḥ ||
[44]        na teṣāṃ punar āvṛttir mattaḥ kalpaśatair api |
aputro labhate putrān madbhaktaś ca suvarcasā ||
daridro labhate lakṣmīṃ dhanadasya ca yādṛśīm |
tejaḥkāmo labhet tejo rājyeṣu rājyam uttamam ||
āyuḥkāmo labhed āyur yādṛśaṃ ca śivasya hi |
strīṇāṃ vratam idaṃ sādhu putradaṃ bhāgyadaṃ tathā ||
avaidhavyakaraṃ tāsāṃ putraśokavināśanam |
dhanadhānyakaraṃ caiva jātiśraiṣṭhyakaraṃ śubham ||
sārvabhaumasukhaṃ tāsāṃ divyaṃ saukhyaṃ bhavet tataḥ |
striyo vā puruṣāś cāpi kurvanti vratam uttamam ||
tebhyo dadāmy ahaṃ saukhyaṃ bhuktimuktisamanvitam |
bahunoktena kiṃ vatsa vratasyāsya phalaṃ mahat ||
madvratasya phalaṃ vaktuṃ nāhaṃ śakto na śaṅkaraḥ |
brahmā caturbhir vyaktaiś ca na labhen mahimāvadhim ||
prahlāda uvāca |
bhagavaṃs tvatprasādena śrutaṃ vratam anuttamam |
vratasyāsya phalaṃ sādhu tvayi me bhaktikāraṇam ||
svāmin jātiviśeṣeṇa tvattaḥ pāpanikṛntanam |
adhunā śrotum icchāmi vratasyāsya vidhiṃ param ||
kasmin māse bhaved etat kasmiṃś ca vāsare prabho |
etad vistarato deva vaktum arhasi sāṃpratam ||
vidhinā yena vai svāmin samagraphalabhug bhavet |
mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā brūhi tvaṃ sakalaṃ prabho ||
[45]                nṛsiṃha uvāca |
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga vratasyāsya vidhiṃ param |
sarvaṃ kathayato me 'dya tvam ekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu ||
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ samācaret |
majjanmasaṃbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||
varṣe varṣe tu kartavyaṃ mama saṃtuṣṭikārakam |
mahāguptam idaṃ śreṣṭham ānuṣair (?) bhavabhīrubhiḥ |
tenaiva kriyamāṇena sahasrādvādaśīphalam ||
jāyate matsakhā vacmi mānuṣāṇāṃ mahātmanām |
svātīnakṣatrayogena śanivāreṇa saṃyute ||
siddhiyogasya saṃyoge vaṇije karaṇe tathā |
puṇyasaubhāgyayogena labhyate daivayogataḥ ||
sarvair etais tu saṃyuktaṃ hatvā koṭivināśanam |
etadanyatare yoge taddinaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
kevale tat prakartavyam maddine vratam uttamam |
anyathā narakaṃ yāti yāvac candradivākarau ||
yathā yathā pravṛttiḥ syāt pātakasya kalau yuge |
tathā tathā praṇaśyanti tadvratasya prabhāvataḥ ||
madvratasya prabhāvena matir na syād durātmanām |
vicāryetthaṃ prakartavyaṃ mādhave māsi madvratam ||
niyamaṃ ca prakartavyaṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
śrīnṛsiṃho mahogras tvaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||
[46]        adyāhaṃ ca vidhāsyāmi vrataṃ nirvighnatāṃ naya |
iti niyamamantraḥ |
vratasthena na kartavyā saṅgatiḥ pāpibhiḥ saha |
mithyālāpo (?) na kartavyaḥ samagraphalakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
strībhir hataiś ca ālāpān vratastho naiva kārayet |
smartavyaṃ me mahārūpaṃ maddine sakale śubhe ||
tato madhyāhnavelāyāṃ nadyādau vimale jale |
gṛhe vā devakhāte vā taḍāge vimale śubhe ||
vaidikena ca mantreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
mṛttikāgomayenaiva tathā dhātrīphalena ca ||
tilaiś ca sarvapāpaghnaiḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā mahātmabhiḥ |
paridhāya śucir vāso nityakarma samācaret ||
tato gṛhaṃ samāgatya smaran māṃ bhaktiyogataḥ |
gomayena ca lipyātha kuryād aṣṭadalaṃ śubham ||
kalaśaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya tāmraratnasamanvitam |
tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ taṇḍulaiḥ paripūritam ||
haimī tatra ca manmūrtiḥ sthāpyā lakṣmyā tathaiva ca |
palena ca tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ ||
yathāśakti tathā kāryā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya pūjanaṃ tu samācaret ||
tato brāhmaṇam āhūya tam ācāryam alolupam |
sadācārasamāyuktaṃ śāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam ||
[47]        tenaiva kārayet pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā śāstrānusārataḥ |
ācāryavacanād dhīmān pūjāṃ kuryād yathāvidhi ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tatra puṣpastabakaśobhitam ||
ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayed yatamānasaḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir mantrair nāmabhis tathā ||
tataḥ paurāṇikair mantraiḥ pūjanīyo yathāvidhi |
candanaṃ śītalaṃ divyaṃ candrakuṅkumamiśritam |
dadāmi tava tuṣṭyarthaṃ nṛsiṃha parameśvara ||
iti candanamantraḥ |
kālodbhavāni puṣpāṇi tulasyādīni vai prabho |
pūjayāmi nṛsiṃhaṃ tvāṃ lakṣmyā saha namo 'stu te ||
puṣpamantraḥ |
kālāgarumayaṃ dhūpaṃ sarvadevasuvallabham |
karomi vai mahāviṣṇo sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||
iti dhūpamantraḥ |
dīpaḥ pāpaharaḥ proktas tamorāśivināśanaḥ |
dīpena labhyate tejas tasmād dīpaṃ dadāmi te ||
iti dīpamantraḥ |
naivedyaṃ saukhyadaṃ cāru bhakṣyabhojyasamanvitam |
dadāmi te ramākānta sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kuru ||
[48] iti naivedyamantraḥ |
nṛsiṃhācyutadeveśa lakṣmīkānta jagatpate |
anenārghyapradānena saphalāḥ syur manorathāḥ ||
ity arghyamantraḥ |
pītāmbara mahābāho prahlāda bhayanāśakṛt |
yathābhūtenārcitena yathoktaphalado bhava ||
iti prārthanamantraḥ |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gītavāditranisvanaiḥ |
purāṇapaṭhanair nṛtyaiḥ śrotavyā ca kathā śubhā ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye snānaṃ kṛtvā hy atandritaḥ |
pūrvoktena vidhānena pūjayen māṃ prayatnataḥ ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ tu carec chrāddhaṃ madagre svasthimānasaḥ |
tato dānāni deyāni vakṣyamāṇāni cānagha ||
pātrebhyas tu dvijebhyo hi lokadvayajigīṣayā |
siṃhaḥ svarṇamayo deyo mama santoṣakārakaḥ ||
gobhūtilahiraṇyāni deyāni ca phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
śayyā satūlikā deyā saptadhānyasamanvitā ||
anyāni ca yathāśaktyā deyāni mama tuṣṭaye |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yathoktaphalakāṅkṣayā ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā tebhyo deyā ca dakṣiṇā |
nirdhanair api kartavyaṃ deyaṃ śaktyanusārataḥ ||
sarveṣām eva varṇānām adhikāro 'sti me vrata |
[49]        madbhaktais tu viśeṣeṇa kartavyaṃ matparāyaṇaiḥ ||
madvaṃśe ye narā jātā ye niṣpattiparāyaṇāḥ |
tān samuddhara deveśa dustarāt bhavasāgarāt ||
pātakārṇavamagnasya vyādhiduḥkhāmbuvāribhiḥ |
jīvais tu paribhūtasya mahāduḥkhagatasya me ||
karāvalambanaṃ dehi śeṣaśāyin jagatpate |
śrīnṛsiṃha ramākānta bhaktānāṃ bhavanāsana ||
kṣīrāmbudhinivāsas tu cakrapāṇir janārdana |
vratenānena deveśa bhuktimuktiprado bhava ||
iti prārthanāmantraḥ |
evaṃ prārthya tato devaṃ visṛjya ca yathāvidhi |
upahārādikaṃ sarvam ācāryāya nivedayet ||
dakṣiṇābhiḥ susantoṣya brāhmaṇāṃs tu visarjayet |
madhyāhne tu samāyukto bhuñjīta bandhubhir naraḥ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
pavitraṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ kīrtayed yas tu mānavaḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti vratasyāsya phalaṃ labhet ||
iti śrīnarasiṃhapurāṇe narasiṃhaprādurbhāve
narasiṃhacaturdaśīvratam |
[50]                śiva uvāca |
atha liṅgavratāny atra śṛṇu leśena ṣaṇmukha |
kārtikāt samyag ārabhya vrataṃ vai śaṃsitavrataḥ ||
kārtikasya caturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ pūjayec chivam |
mahāsnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ mahāpūjām atho punaḥ ||
liṅgavratānāṃ sarveṣāṃ tathā naktena vartanam |
pūjāṃ kṛtvātha yatnena vastranaivedyakādibhiḥ |
śālipiṣṭamayaṃ liṅgaṃ kuryād ratnipramāṇataḥ ||
ratnir vahasuṣṭikaraḥ |
tilaprasthaṃ suvarṇasya liṅgasyopari vinyaset |
dhūpo vai kundurur deyaś candanaṃ cāgaruṃ tathā ||
śivarūpāya dātavyaṃ śivaṃ yāty akṣayaṃ gataḥ ||
śivarūpāya viprāya liṅgaṃ dātavyam |
mārgaśīrṣe caturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ |
saṃpūjya pūrvaval liṅgaṃ mahāsnānena tattvataḥ ||
vilipya kuṅkumenaiva śivaṃ tena prapūjayet |
śvetaṃ candanaliṅgaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pūrvamānataḥ ||
suvarṇaṃ taṇḍulaprasthaṃ pṛṣṭhe sarpaṃ śivāgrataḥ |
karpūreṇa tu dhūpaṃ tu caturdikṣu prakalpayet |
mahāvartyādikaṃ deyaṃ dadhipātraṃ śubhāṣṭakam ||
śubhāṣṭakaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakam |
evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena liṅgāya vinivartayet |
[51]        īśānarudrasaṃjñāya ācāryāya prakalpayet ||
īśāno rudraḥ, prīyatām iti liṅgāya samarcyācāryāya dadyāt evam anyeṣv api māseṣu ūhanīyam |
śivasāyujyatāṃ yāti vratenānena ṣaṇmukha |
pauṣaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ pūrvavat pūjayec chivam |
pūjānte guggulaśataṃ śivasya parito vahet ||
śataṃ, palānām |
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ sakhaṇḍaṃ prasthasaṃmitam ||
prasthaṃ taṇḍulānām |
naivedyaṃ purato deyaṃ patākāḥ śaktisaṃkhyayā |
śaktayo aṣṭau |
dhvajā tayā punaḥ (?) śvetaliṅgaṃ vai pālipiṣṭajam |
tilāḍhakaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca liṅgaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset ||
śaṅkarākhyasya rudrasya vratam etat samarpayet |
māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya vartayet ||
śālyodanākṣataṃ liṅgaṃ tilaprasthaṃ suvarṇakam |
śivasya dakṣiṇe bhāge dhāritavyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
mudgodanaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca pūrvasyāṃ prasthasaṃmitam |
agaruṃ sihvakaṃ candraṃ dahed dhūpaṃ śivāgrataḥ ||
vratam evaṃ vidhānena ugram āvāhya nirvapet |
vratānte tu guruṃ bhaktyā yathāśaktyā prapūjayet ||
phalguśuklacaturdaśyāṃ śivaṃ pūjya vidhānataḥ |
gugguluṃ saghṛtaṃ dhūpaṃ mahāvarticatuṣṭayam ||
[52]        modakāni vicitrāṇi kṣorī deyā ghṛtaplutā |
pūrvoktena vidhānena tathā liṅgaṃ nivedayet |
śarvāya ca namaḥ pūjya tv ācāryo bhūridakṣiṇaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛtvā mahāsena prāpnoti tanmayaṃ kvacit (?) |
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ śivaṃ pūjya vidhānataḥ ||
bhavarudrāya nirvartya ācāryaṃ pūjayet tataḥ |
evaṃ kāryaṃ prayatnena cākṣayaṃ lokam icchatā ||
caturdaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe vaiśākhasya prayatnataḥ |
śivaṃ pūjya vidhānena mahāsnapanapūrvakam ||
vilipya kuṅkumenaiva candanaiś carcayec chivam |
liṅgaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā hemapuṣpavibhūṣitam ||
tilaprasthaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dakṣiṇādikaṃ vinyaset |
mahāvartidvayaṃ deyaṃ dīpamālyaṃ ghṛtena tu ||
saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dadyāt palānāṃ tu śatadvayam |
aguruṃ śihvakaṃ candraṃ pratyekaṃ tu phalaṃ dahet ||
tato damanapuṣpais tu śivaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ |
suvarṇatilaliṅgaṃ ca bhavarudrāya nirvapet ||
rudrasaṃkhyās tu guravo dakṣitavyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
bhūdānavastradānaiś ca suvarṇādipravistaraiḥ ||
etad vratottamaṃ nāma vrataṃ saṃvatsaraṃ hitam |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā sa gacchet paramaṃ padam ||
pitaras tasya nandanti rudraloke mahīyate |
divyavarṣāyutaṃ svāgraṃ tadante tu dhaneśvarāḥ ||
[53]        ātmajñānaṃ punas te tu śive nitye layaṃ yayuḥ |
yaḥ karoti mahāsena śivavat sa ca pūjyate ||
jyaiṣṭhe śuklacaturdaśyāṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ japet |
vilipya candanenaiva jātīpuṣpaiś ca pūjayet ||
kuṅkumaṃ laghucandraś ca dhūpaṃ deyaṃ śivāyataḥ ||
laghu aguru |
dīpamālā tu dātavyā ghārikā kiṅkiṇīdhvajam |
lāvaṇāgālakāś caiva kṣīripo ghṛtasaṃyutaḥ ||
khaṇḍapātrāṇi deyāni ghṛtapātrāṇi tadvahiḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vāñchan bhokṣam [mokṣam?] akṣayyam aiśvaram ||
pitṝn uddharate so 'pi daśapūrvān daśāparān |
āṣāḍhasya caturdaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
śivaṃ pūjya vidhānena mahāsnapanapūrvakam |
vilipya candanair devaṃ prapalā tu catuḥsamam ||
candraṃ candanakāśmīraṃ granthilā ca śikhidhvaja |
evaṃ catuḥsamaṃ nāma aṅgarāgaḥ śivapriyaḥ ||
sasyakuṅkumakarpūraṃ laghuvatpalasaṃyutam |
dūpaṃ tu parato dadyāt naivedyaṃ kiraṇān bahūn ||
kiraṇān karpūrān | liṅgākhyān tatra etat |
ghorikā laḍḍukāś caiva ghṛtapūraṃ paṭatrikam ||
nivedya kṣīrapānaṃ ca snehād devasya yatnataḥ |
piṣṭaliṅgaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca pūgapatraṃ ca nirvapet ||
vitānaṃ ca patākāś ca vyajanaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathā |
[54]        ācāryaṃ pūjayet paścād vaham annavāhanaiḥ (?) ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyak sa yāti paramaṃ padam |
pitaras tasya modante rudralokaṃ samantataḥ ||
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca |
śrāvaṇasya caturdaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe vrataṃ caret ||
nityanaimittikaṃ caiva kṛtvā kāmyaṃ samācaret |
snānaṃ pūjā japo dhyānaṃ homaṃ caiva tu pañcamam ||
iti nityaṃ samākhyātām ahany ahani sanmukha ṣaṇmukha (?) |
aṣṭamyādinimitteṣu pūjāsu dviguṇā tathā ||
pavitrārohaṇaṃ tadvan nityāṅgaṃ niyamaṃ sthitam |
dīkṣyā caiva pratiṣṭā ca grahaṇam ayanaṃ tathā ||
ṣaḍaśīti sukhāś caiva nimittakam udāhṛtam |
kāmyavratāni kāryāṇi jñeyāni hi tathā param ||
saṃpūjya parameśānaṃ pūrvavac ca vilepanam |
vānarenuhitaṃ dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā ||
vānaraṃ sihvakam |
vastrapūtodakaṃ candra pānaṃ devāya kalpayet |
tāmbūlapiṭikaṃ jiṅkaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca samarpayet ||
vyajanaṃ pādukaṃ paṭṭaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpakapaṭṭakam |
naivedyaṃ vidhivad bhaktyā bhīmarudrāya bhaktitaḥ ||
ācāryapūjaiparataiḥ (?) kartavyā śāṭhyavarjitaiḥ |
anena vratamukhyena śive yānti layaṃ param ||
pitṝn uddharate so 'pi daśapūrvān daśāparān |
[55]        pitaras tasya nandanti rudralokeṣu sanmukha (ṣaṇmukha?) |
divyavarṣāyutāny aṣṭau tato yāti divākaram ||
māsi bhādrapade śukle caturdaśyām vrataṃ caret |
snānaṃ pañcāmṛtenaiva laghunā tu vilepanam ||
dhūpaṃ ca vartulaṃ dadyāc chaśilālohite na (-lohitena?) ca |
dhūpāntarasamāyuktaṃ tadabhāve ghṛtānvitam ||
khaṇḍakādyāny anekāni modakā kiraṇāni ca |
ghārikā vaṭakāś caiva śvetā śikhariṇī śūbhā ||
śālitaṇḍulaprasthaṃ tu piṣṭaliṅgaṃ suvarṇakam |
tāmbūlaṃ niyataṃ tadvad vasanāsanapādukāḥ |
jānunī bhūmige kṛtvā nivedyānaṃ pinākine ||
pūrvavad gurupūjā ca kartavyā śāṭhyavarjitā |
prayāti śivasāyujyaṃ bandhubhiḥ sahito naraḥ ||
pitaras tasya modante rudralokeṣu rudravat |
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi cāśvayuji vratam ||
snānaṃ pañcāmṛtenaiva rocanāyāḥ palena tu |
vilepanaṃ tu śaśinā tūnmattais tu samarcayet ||
dīpamālāśatenaiva bhakṣyaṃ śālyodanaṃ ghṛtam |
pūpakhaṇḍāni siddhāni kṣīrayā taṃ ghanaṃ śubham ||
pulākakkolapatraṃ tu jātīpūgaphalāni ca |
gandhaliṅgaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca śivāya vinivedayet ||
ācāryas tu tataḥ pūjyo hemavastrānnavāhanaiḥ |
śivasāyujyatāṃ yāti pitṛbhiḥ saha śāṅkare ||
[56]        caturdaśyāṃ kārttikasya śuklapakṣe vrataṃ śṛṇu |
mahāsnānaṃ paraṃ karyaṃ lepanaṃ tu catuḥ samam |
dīpamālāśatenaiva mahāvarticatuṣṭayam ||
dvāre dhvajā vaijayantī madhye dikṣu vidikṣu ca |
paṭṭajaṃ candrakaṃ dadyād dikṣu madhye samudgakam ||
candrakaṃ vitānam, laghunāma raśālaṃ saṃpuṭam |
śītakarpūraḥ | śreṣṭhaś ca dhūpo samugākanāmā |
vidikṣu guggulaghṛtaṃ śatekaikena dhūpanam |
śālipiṣṭenāṣṭaśataṃ pūrvasyāṃ droṇakalpitam ||
tat pṛṣṭhe piṣṭajaṃ liṅgaṃ dvādaśyāṅgulasaṃmitam |
hemamālāsamāyuktaṃ muktādāmavibhūṣitam ||
nivedya parayā bhaktyā śāśvatāya prayatnataḥ |
bhuktārtham bādhamuktārthaṃ brūyād evaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
idaṃ te 'stu mahādeva idam evāstu siddhidam |
nivedya vidhivat samyak vrataṃ samyag yathoditam ||
prāpnoty aiśvaryam atulam icchan mokṣaṃ sanātanam |
kṛtaghno brahmahā caiva so 'pi rudrapadaṃ labhet ||
jāyate parayā bhaktyā guruṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ |
haimavastrānnayānaiś ca maṇibhir mauktikādibhiḥ ||
hastiyānaṃ pradātavyaṃ svabhāvād aśvasaṃbhavam |
evaṃ kṛtena saṃpūrṇe liṅgavratakṛte bhavet ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ liṅgavratam |
[57]        adhunā tu pravakṣyāmi pratimāvratam uttamam |
mahāsnānaṃ mahāvartidīpamālāśataṃ tathā ||
vilepanaṃ kuṅkumena dhūpaṃ vai guggulena tu |
śatenāṣṭottareṇaiva naivedyaṃ payasā ghṛtam ||
tālamātrā caturviṃśatinetrā ca caturbhujā |
śūlāsidhrudhanurvāṇānānābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ (?) ||
śālipiṣṭamayī kāryā vṛṣapṛṣṭhe ca śobhanā |
cāmarair vījyamānaṃ tu śivaṃ tatra prakalpayet ||
darpaṇaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ vyajanaṃ pādukāsanam |
vaijayantīdhvajaṃ yānam ācāryāya prayatnataḥ ||
māsi māsi prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ dine dine |
kārtikaṃ tu samārabhya yāvadāśvayujāvadhi ||
etad vratottamaṃ nāma pratimāvratam īritam |
brahmahā guruhā yas tu pañcapātakasaṃyutaḥ ||
mitraghnaś ca kṛtaghnaś ca yo 'pi viśvāsaghātakaḥ |
so 'pi rudrapadaṃ yāti trisaptakulasaṃyutaḥ ||
koṭikoṭisahasraṃ tu śivaloke tu modate ||
tadante jāyate rājā sa eko vīryavān sudhīḥ |
jñānaiśvaryam avāpnoti śivadīkṣāprabhāvataḥ ||
paraṃ padam avāpnoti yena bhūyo na jāyate |
evaṃ vopadiśet tasya bhūmidānaṃ tu kārayet ||
[58]        mahāgajaṃ mahāśvaṃ vā mahāyānam athāpi vā |
dāpayet tu prayatnena tadante vratam āpnuyāt ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ pratimāvratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito brahman vakṣye māheśvaraṃ vratam |
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ nāmnā śivacaturdaśī ||
mārgaśīrṣe trayodaśyāṃ śitāyām ekabhojanaḥ |
prārthayed devadeveśaṃ tvām ahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya ca śaṅkaram |
suvarṇavṛṣabhaṃ kṛtvā bhojayec cāpare 'hni ||
evaṃ niyamakṛt suptvā prātar utthāya mānavaḥ |
kṛtasnānajapaḥ paścād umayā saha śaṅkaram |
pūjayet kamalaiḥ śulaiḥ gandhadhūpānulepanaiḥ ||
umāmaheśvaraṃ rūpam aviyogadvādaśīvratoktaṃ veditavyam |
pādau namaḥ śivāyeti giraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ |
lalāṭaṃ tu trinetrāya netrāṇi haraye namaḥ ||
mukham indumukhāyeti śrīkaṇṭhāyeti kandharam |
sadyojātāya karṇau tu vāmadevāya vai bhuje |
aghorahṛdayāyeti hṛdayaṃ cābhipūjayet |
stanau tatpuruṣāyeti tatheśāyeti codaram ||
pārśve cānantadharmāya jñānabhūtāya vai kaṭhim |
[59]        urū cānantavairāgyasiṃhāyeti prapūjayet ||
anantaiś caryanāthāya jānunī cārcayed budhaḥ |
pradhānāya namo jaṅghe gulphau vyomātmane namaḥ ||
vyomakeśātmarūpāya keśān pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pūjayet |
namaḥ puṣṭyai namas tuṣṭyai pārvatīṃ cābhipūjayet ||
tatas tu vṛṣabhaṃ hemam udakumbhasamanvitam |
śuklamālyāmbarayutaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam |
bhakṣyair nānāvidhair yuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
prīyatāṃ devadevo 'tra sadyojātaḥ pinākadhṛk |
tatas tu viprān annena tarpayec chaktitaḥ śuciḥ ||
pṛṣadājyaṃ tu saṃprāśya svaped bhūmāv udaṅmukhaḥ |
pañcadaśyāṃ tataḥ pūjya viprān bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
tadvat kṛṣṇacaturdaśyām etat sarvaṃ samācaret |
caturdaśīṣu sarvāsu kuryāt pūrvavad arcanam ||
ye tu māsaviśeṣās tu tān (?) nibodha kramād iha |
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu kramād etad udīrayet ||
āśvinānteṣv iti jñeyam |
śaṅkarāya namas tubhyaṃ namas te karavīraka |
tryambakāya namas te 'stu sthāṇave ca tataḥ param ||
namaḥ paśupate nāma namas te śaṃbhave punaḥ |
namas te paramānanda namaḥ somārdhadhāriṇe ||
namo bhīmāya ity evaṃ tvām ahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
[60]        gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ||
pañcagavyaṃ tathā bilvaṃ pañcagośṛṅgavāri ca |
tilāś ca kṛṣṇā vidhivat prāśanaṃ kramaśaḥ smṛtam ||
pratimāsaṃ caturdaśyām ekaikaṃ (?) prāśanaṃ smṛtam |
mandārair mālatībhiś ca tathā madhurakair api |
sinduvārair aśōkaiś ca mallikābhiḥ sa pāṭalaiḥ ||
arkapuṣpaiḥ kadambaiś ca śatapatryā tathotpalaiḥ |
ekaikena caturdaśyām arcayet pārvatīpatim ||
punaś ca kārttike māsi saṃprāpte tarpayed dvijān |
annair nānāvidhair bhakṣyair vastramālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
kṛtvā nīlavṛṣotsargaṃ śrutyuktavidhinā naraḥ |
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha ||
muktāphalāṣṭhakayutaṃ sitanetrapaṭānvitam |
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktāṃ śayyāṃ dadyāt sakumbhakām ||
tāmrapātropari punaḥ śālitaṇḍulasaṃyutām |
snāpya viprāya śāntāya vedavrataparāya vai ||
jyaiṣṭhe sāmavede deyaṃ na bakavratine kvacit |
guṇajñe śrotriye dadyād ācārye tattvavedini ||
avyaṅgāṅgāya saumyāya sadā kalyāṇakāriṇe |
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
gurau sati gurau deyaṃ tadabhāve dvijātaye |
na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta kurvan doṣāt pataty adhaḥ ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryāc chivacaturdaśīm |
[61]        so 'śvamedhasahasrasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
brahmahatyādikaṃ kiṃcid atra vāmutra (?) vā kṛtam |
pitṛbhir mātṛbhir vāpi tat sarvaṃ nāśam āpnuyāt ||
dīrghāyur ārogyakulābhivṛddhir
atrākṣayāmutra caturbhujatvam |
gaṇādhipatyaṃ divi kalpakoṭi-
śataṃ vasitvā padam eti śambhoḥ ||
na bṛhaspatir apy alaṃ tad asyāḥ
phalam indro na pitāmaho 'pi vaktum |
na ca siddhagaṇo 'py alaṃ na cāhaṃ
yadi jihvāyuktakoṭayo 'pi vaktum ||
bhavaty amaraval lavaḥ paṭhati yaḥ smared vā
sadā śṛṇoty api vimatsaraḥ |
sakalapāpanirmocanīm imāṃ śivacaturdaśī ||
mamarakāminī koṭayaḥ stuvanti (?)
tam aninditaṃ kim u samācared yaḥ sadā ||
yānāthanārī kurute ca bhaktyā
bhartāram āpṛcchya guruṃ sutambā |
sāpi prasādāt parameśvarasya
paraṃ padaṃ yāti pinākapāṇeḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ śivacaturdaśīvratam |
[62]                sanatkumāra uvāca |
athottamaṃ paraṃ brahman aparaṃ śṛṇu bhadradam |
caturdaśyāṃ mahābhāga sarvarogārtiśāṇtaye ||
jvaragulmaplīhaśūlakuṣṭhātisārasaṃyutaḥ |
martye nityam idaṃ kāryaṃ tadārtivyapanuttaye ||
snātvā tu dhṛtasaṃkalpaḥ sarvakāmavivarjitaḥ |
ādityam upatiṣṭheta gāyatrīṃ ca japan muhuḥ ||
udayāt pūrvam ārabhya yāvad astaṃ gato raviḥ |
nirāhāro jitakrodho tāvat tiṣṭhet samāhitaḥ ||
ravāv astaṃ gate devam arcayet puruṣottamam |
upoṣya vidhivat snātvā tathā parvaṇi suvrata ||
parvaṇi paurṇamāsyām | etac ca śuklacaturdaśīvrataṃ purāṇe śuklapakṣasya vrataprakaraṇe paṭhitatvāt |
arcayitvā yathāyogyaṃ paramātmānam acyutam |
gāyatrīm abhyaset tatra devadevasya saṃnidhau ||
sahasraṃ daśasāhasraṃ śataṃ cāpi svaśaktitaḥ |
atha tāmramayaṃ pātraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ (?) vā samācaret ||
ghṛtena pūrṇaṃ tat kṛtvā pañcaprasthamitena ca |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ muktāṃ raktānnāni (?) tilāṃs tathā ||
antar nidhāya tat kuryāt navavastradvayānvitam |
sthāpayitvā tu tasyāgre pūjanānte mahāmatiḥ ||
tatra mārtaṇḍam ārabhya saṃpūjya ca yathāvidhi |
[63]        pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraḥ stotrālāpair mudā yutaḥ ||
sthitaḥ praruḍhatimiranirbhedacaturaprabhaḥ |
nānāvyādhisamutthārtiṃ mama saṃśamayatv itaḥ ||
puruṣaḥ puṣkarākṣaś ca sarvāntarasamāsthitaḥ ||
paramātmāsayakleśaṃ vyapohatu mamācyuta |
ity aneneti mantreṇa sa tadvāso vivṛtya ca ||
ātmānaṃ darśayet tatra yathā suspaṣṭalakṣitam |
viprāya vedaviduṣe daridrāya ca dāpayet ||
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ datvā kuryād brāhmaṇabhojanam |
bhuñjīta bāndhavaiḥ sārdham utsṛjen niyamān api ||
evaṃ kurvan naro loke sarvarogavivarjitaḥ |
saumyagātravṛttaśrīś ciram āyuś ca vindati ||
yathāpaḥ śamapatyagniṃ samiddham atikāmataḥ |
tathā vratam idaṃ brahman rogāgniṃ śamayed iha ||
nānāvyādhibhṛśārtānāṃ narāṇām iha suvrata |
tatpratāpaśamopāyo vratād anyatra vidyate ||
iti gāruḍapurāṇoktaṃ gāyatrīvratam |
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ yadātithyārkasaṃbhavaḥ |
pūjayet sūryaṃ vidhinā upavāsena śūlinam ||
pūrvavad vidhinā liṅgavratoktenety arthaḥ |
[64]        kuṅkumenāṅgarāgaṃ tu gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ||
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ kuryāt prasthapramāṇataḥ |
bhūmidānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śivabhaktāya yatnataḥ ||
anena vratamukhyena pṛthvīpatitvam āpnuyāt |
etad bhūmivrataṃ nāma pṛthvīpālas tu kārayet ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ bhūmivratam |
bṛhaspatimaghāyogo caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
upoṣya pūjayet tasyāṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram ||
mahāsnānapracāreṇa mahāvartipuraḥsaram |
aṅgarāgaś candanena śuklapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ||
dhūpas tu saphalo deyaḥ laghunā candrasaṃyutaḥ |
sitavastrāṇi vāstaṃ ca ācāryāya pradāpayet ||
jātīpalaiḥ prāśanaṃ ca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ hitam |
etad eva vrataṃ nāma āyuḥ śrīkīrtivardhanam ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ devavratam |
āśvinyādityavāre tu yadi śuklā caturdaśī |
snānaṃ viśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ śivasya paramātmanaḥ ||
aṅgarāgaṃ rocanayā raktapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet |
kapilājyaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ naivedyaṃ parikalpayet ||
[65]        śivabhaktāya viprāya hemadānaṃ prakalpayet |
prāśanaṃ kuṅkumenaiva kartavyaṃ sādhakena tu ||
etad guhyaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ bhaktyā putrārthibhir naraiḥ |
putrā vai tasya jāyante sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ sūryavratam |
īśvara uvāca |
bālavṛddhāturāṇāṃ ca bhogināṃ strīṣu bāliśe |
vidhānaṃ teṣu vakṣyāmi mucyante te yathā suta ||
bhūtāyāṃ phālguṇe kuryāt kṛṣṇapakṣe 'tibhaktitaḥ |
daridrāṇām anāthānām akṣamāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sarvakāmapradaṃ kṛṣṇa caturdaśyāṃ śivavratam ||
rātrau viśeṣapūjā tu mahāsnapanasasmitā (?) |
mahādīpadvayaṃ deyaṃ śatam aṣṭottaraṃ punaḥ ||
saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dhūpaṃ śivaṃ paśupatiṃ yajet |
khaṇḍakhādyāny anekāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ||
yathā samarpyate bhaktyā vittaśāḍhyaṃ vinā suta |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ śivasyāgre śivaṃ japet ||
śivaṃ śivapañcākṣaraṃ mantram |
evaṃ vratadharaḥ śambhoḥ prabhāte pūjya nirvapet |
śivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivaḥ sarvam idaṃ jagat ||
śivo jayati sarvatra yaḥ śivaḥ so 'ham eva ca |
karmaṇā manasā vācā sukṛtaṃ yan mayā kṛtam ||
[66]        nyūnādhikaṃ mahādeva dravyamantrakriyātmakam |
tat sarvaṃ parameśāna gṛhāṇa parameśvara ||
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāṃyaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tu mayā śiva |
tat sarvaṃ parameśāna mayā tubhyaṃ samarpitam ||
kalātmanā tathā deva sthito 'si vedavitpate |
kliṣṭaṃ me vāstusāmyaṃ tat yad yat tv adhikaṃ punaḥ ||
kṛpayā sarvabhūtānāṃ kuru deva jagatpate |
na kṛtaṃ tu mayā kuṃcid vrataṃ dānādikaṃ kvacit ||
anena vratamukhyena sarvaṃ saṃpāditaṃ mayā |
vratadānādikaṃ śambho tvatprasādāt tvadājñayā ||
idaṃ vratavaraṃ deva mayā tubhyaṃ samarpitam |
daridraiś ca parītaiś ca jñānibhir yogibhis tathā ||
bālabāliśavṛddhaiś ca strīnarair vyādhipīḍitaiḥ |
prayatnāt phālgune kāryaḥ śivasyāgre tu jāgaraḥ ||
etasmin bhūtadivase veśeṣān nārcayanti ye |
śastrābhūtapatiṃ teṣāṃ bhūtaiś ca paribhūyate ||
phālgunenaiva bhūtāyāṃ tasmād bhūtapatiṃ yajet |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ vratāny uktāni sarvaśaḥ |
tāni sarvāṇi tenaiva vratāny eva kṛtāni tu ||
skanda uvāca |
vratasyodyāpanaṃ karma kiṃ kartavyaṃ ca mānvaiḥ |
ko vidhiḥ kāni dravyāṇi kathaṃ kāryaṃ vada prabho ||
[67]                īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha tattvena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
caturdaśābdaṃ kartavyaṃ śivarātrivrataṃ śubham ||
ekabhaktaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyām upoṣaṇam |
saṃpādya sarvasaṃbhārān maṇḍapaṃ tatra kārayet ||
vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ samācchannaṃ paṭṭakūlaiś ca śobhitam |
tanmadhye lekhayed divyaṃ liṅgato bhadramaṇḍalam ||
atha vā sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍapāntaḥ prakalpayet |
śobhopaśobhāsaṃyuktaṃ dīpaiḥ sarvatra vojvalam ||
ācāryaṃ varayet tatra ṛtvigbhiḥ sahitaṃ śucim |
śivarūpāś ca te viprāḥ pūjyāś candanapuṣpakaiḥ ||
anujñātaś ca tair vipraiḥ śivapūjāṃ samārabhet |
avraṇaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ tasyopari tu vinyaset ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ cāpi kārayet |
vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya vastrapatraiḥ prapūjayet ||
palena vā tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ |
umāmaheśvarīṃ mūrtiṃ pūjayed vṛṣabhasthitāṃ ||
āgaccha devadeveśa martyalokahitecchayā|
pūjayāmi vidhānena prasannaḥ sumukho bhava ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
pādāsanaṃ kuru prājña nirmalaṃ svarṇanirmitam |
bhūṣitaṃ vividhai ratnaiḥ kuru tvaṃ pādukāsanam ||
[68]        hṛdisthaṃ cintayed devaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham |
vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ cintayed avyayaṃ hṛdā ||
gandhodakena puṣpeṇa candanena sugandhinā |
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa bhaktiṃ metyacalāṃ kuru ||
vastraṃ sūkṣmaṃ dukulaṃ ca devānām api durlabham |
gṛhāṇa tvam umākānta prasannas tvaṃ sadā bhava ||
śrīkhaṇḍaṃ candanaṃ divyaṃ malayācalasaṃbhavam |
vilepanaṃ suraśreṣṭha gṛhāṇa parameśvara ||
yajñopavītaṃ sahajaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā |
āyuṣyaśubhavarcasyam upavītaṃ gṛkṣāṇa (gṛhāṇa?) me ||
mālyādīni sugandhīni mālyādīni vai prabho |
mayā hṛtāni puṣpāṇi pūjārthaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
vanaspatiraso dhūpo gandhāḍhyaḥ sumanoharaḥ |
āghreyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo 'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
ājyaṃ ca vartisaṃyuktaṃ vahninā yojitaṃ ca yat |
dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa trailokyatimirāpaham ||
naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ deva bhaktiṃ me acalāṃ kuru |
īpsitaṃ me varaṃ dehi paratra ca parāṃ gatim ||
idaṃ phalaṃ mayā deva sthāpita(ṃ) puratas tava |
tena me saphalāvāptir bhavej janmani janmani ||
pūgīpalaṃ mahādivyaṃ nāgavallīdalair yutam |
karpūreṇa samāyuktaṃ tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām ||
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hemabījaṃ vibhāvasīḥ |
[69]        anantapuṇyaphaladam ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
somaṃ ca sagaṇaṃ caiva pūjayitvā maheśvaram |
homaṃ kuryāt prayatnena raudramantrair yathāvidhi ||
brāhmaṇān pūjayed bhaktyā bhojayec ca caturdaśa |
ācāryaṃ ca sapatnīkaṃ vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
yajñopavītavastrādi dadyāt tebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
gāṃ savatsāṃ savasanāṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām ||
dadyād ācāryavaryāya śivo me prīyatām iti |
tataḥ sakumbhāṃ tāṃ mūrtiṃ savastrāṃ vṛṣabhasthitām ||
sarvālaṅkārasahitām ācāryāya nivedayet |
vratam etat kṛtaṃ yan me pūrṇaṃ me 'pūrṇam eva vā ||
sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu prasādād bhavatāṃ mama |
iti saṃprārthya tāv viprān praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
nāmamantrais tatas tebhyo dadyāt kumbhān pṛthak prthak |
ajaikapād ahirbhudhno bhavaḥ sarvam umāpatiḥ ||
rudraḥ paśupatiḥ śumbhur varadaḥ śiva īśvaraḥ |
mahādevo haro bhīmo nāmāny evaṃ caturdaśa ||
skanda uvāca |
evaṃ vidhānaṃ bhūteśa śrutaṃ bahuvidhaṃ mayā |
pūjāmantravidhānena kathayasva pade pade ||
śiva uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ śivarātrau śivārcanam |
[70]        vrate yena vidhānena svargapuṇyena karmaṇā ||
kṛtvā snānaṃ śucir bhūtvā dhautavastrasamanvitaḥ |
snāpayed devadeveśaṃ mantrair vedasamudbhavaiḥ ||
tataḥ pūjā prakartavyā yathoktavidhinā suta |
namo yajñajagannātha namas tribhuvaneśvara ||
pūjāṃ gṛhṇa mayā dattāṃ maheśa prathame pade |
iti prathamayāme |
dvityaḥ |
namo 'vyaktāya sūkṣmāya namas te tripurāntaka |
pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa yathāśaktyopadakṣiṇām ||
yathāśaktyupapāditām |
tṛtīyaḥ mantraḥ |
baddho 'haṃ vividhaiḥ pāśaiḥ saṃsārabhavabandhanaiḥ |
pātitaṃ mohajālair māṃ tvaṃ samuddhara śaṅkara ||
caturthaḥ |
tataḥ pūjānte pratimāsaṃ puṣpacandanākṣatadurvā |
kuśayutam arghyaṃ dadyāt
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya ca |
śivarātrau mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mama prabho ||
prathamapraharārghyamantraḥ |
mayā kṛtāny anekāni pātakāni ca śaṅkara |
[71]        gṛhāṇārghyam umākānta śivarātrau prasīda me ||
dvitīyapraharārghyamantraḥ |
duḥkhadāridrabhāraiś ca dagdho 'haṃ pārvatīpate |
māṃ tvaṃ trāhi mahādeva gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo 'stu te ||
iti tṛtīyapraharārghyamantraḥ |
kiṃ na jānāsi deveśa tāvad bhaktiṃ prayaccha me |
padābjayugale devadāsyaṃ dehi jagatpate ||
iti caturthapraharārghyamantraḥ |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tu yathā śiva |
tat sarvaṃ parameśāna mayā tubhyaṃ samarpitam ||
prārthanā |
kurvanti ye vatsarakaṃ śivapūjāṃ kuruṣva me |
śubhaktā tu yathā kathaṃcit sakṛt prayānty eva śivasya lokam |
vyādho 'pi yāto 'sau kṛdīśamasyāt (?) ||
iti kālottare soghāpanaṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśīvratam |
sūta uvāca |
kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum |
pañcacakraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ śulapāṇinam ||
kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ dhanuścarmadharaṃ śubham |
pinākadhāriṇaṃ bhīmaṃ varadaṃ cābhayapradam ||
[72]        bhaṣmāṅgavyālaśobhāḍhyaṃ śaṣāṅkakṛtaśekharam |
nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ||
praṇipatya surāḥ sarve upāsantam umāpatim |
krīḍate bhagavāṃs tatra svagaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
visṛjya devatāḥ sarvās tiṣtate umayā saha |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ prahasyotphullalocanā ||
ekākinaṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ pṛcchate tatra pārvatī ||
pārvaty uvāca |
kathayasva prasādena yad gopyaṃ vratam uttamam |
vratāni devadeveśa kathitāni tvayā mama ||
dānadharmāṇy anekāni tapatīrthāny anekaśaḥ |
nānāvidhās tvayā deva bhrāmitāhaṃ tvayā punaḥ ||
vratānām uttamaṃ deva bhuktimuktiprarā(dā?)yakam |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathayasva mama prabho ||
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yan na kasyacid ākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ muktidāyakam ||
yena vai kathyamānena yamo 'pi vilayaṃ vrajet |
tad ahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu caikāgramānasā ||
māghaphālgunayor madhye kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī |
śivarātris tu sā jñeyā sarvayajñottamottamā ||
dānayajñais tathā yajñair anyaiś ca bahudakṣiṇaiḥ |
[73]        śivarātrisamaṃ nāsti kṛtvā yajñasahasrakam ||
kṛṣṇā sā kalihantrī ca yamapathavināśinī |
na te yamapurīṃ yānti upoṣyanti śivāniśām ||
bhuktimuktipradāṃ devi satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane |
śivavrataṃ kariṣyaṃs tu ekacittaḥ samācaret ||
śrīdevy uvāca |
kathaṃ yamapurīṃ deva varjayitvā śivaṃ vrajet |
etad eva mahāścaryaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kuru me prabho ||
śiva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi yathā vṛttaṃ kathām paurāṇikīṃ śubhām |
yamaśāsanahantrī ca śivasthānapradāyinī ||
kaścid āsīt purā kāle niṣādaś cāmiṣapriyaḥ |
pratyantadeśavāsī ca bhūcaro jīvabhakṣakaḥ ||
māṃsāhārī sadā pṛṣṭhe kuṭumbaparipālakaḥ |
sthūlaḥ pīno dhanurdhārī vāmāṅgo nīlakaṃcukaḥ ||
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇo vāmabāhuḥ sacarmakaḥ |
dhanur vāme gṛhītvā tu dakṣiṇe śaram uttamam ||
nirgato 'sau vane durge niṣādo jīvaghātakaḥ |
jīvavṛttiś ca sā tasya kuṭumbaparipālane ||
tasya nirgacchamānasya mātāpy asyāśiṣo dadau |
prahṛṣṭā māṃ prabhedena bharaṇe jaṭharasya ca ||
śīrṣaṃ rakṣatu te śakro bāhū dhanada eva ca |
[74]        hṛdayaṃ pātu te candraś cānanaṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
udaraṃ pātu te vahnir nitambaṃ (?) dakṣiṇāpatiḥ ||
ātmānaṃ pātu te mṛtyuur ādityaḥ sarvam eva ca |
vanaṃ gaccha samākīrṇaṃ śvāpadair bahubhir vṛtam ||
vyāghrāṇāṃ dīrghanirghoṣair nāditaṃ tad vanaṃ mahat |
mahādaṃṣṭrā mahākāyā dīrghajihvā bhayānanāḥ ||
śārdūlās tatra dṛśyante vanaṃ vīrudvaśīkṛtam |
tasmin vane mahādurge bhīṣaṇe drumasaṃkule ||
vanajīvaviśeṣais tu saṃvyāptagirigahvare |
tenaiva vṛttiyoge ca niṣādaḥ kāyapoṣaṇam |
vanaṃ gatvā nirīkṣyeta diśaḥ sarvā itas tataḥ ||
padaṃ ca padamārgaṃ ca āśramaṃ mṛgaśūkarān |
itaś cetaś ca vai dhāvadāmiṣe lubdhacetasaḥ ||
vanaṃ tat pṛṣṭhataḥ sarvaṃ niṣādasya gataṃ tv iha |
na prāpyā śvāpadāḥ ke tu mṛgaśūkaracittalāḥ ||
nirāśo lubdhako tiṣthan vadad astaṃ gato raviḥ |
dadarśa ca saras tatra nirmalaṃ vimalaṃ jalam ||
haṃsasārasasaṃkīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam |
dṛṣṭvā tu cintayāmāsa taḍāge jīvaghātanam ||
prakariṣyāmy rātrau jīvahatyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
vimṛṣya suciraṃ devi taḍāgābhimukhaṃ yayau ||
tatra tīraṃ samāsādya caturdiśam itas tataḥ |
[75]        bhramitvā kārayāmāsa āśramaṃ tv asya guptaye ||
tattīre vṛkṣaṃ tālaṃ ca sādvalaṃ bahupatrakam |
tasya madhye mahāliṅgaṃ tiṣṭhate varavarṇini ||
tanmadhye ca mahāvṛkṣaṃ bilvaṃ caiva varānane |
tena vṛkṣasya patrāṇi gṛhītvā mārgaśodhane ||
kṣiptāni dakṣiṇe bhāge tāni liṅgasya mastake |
na divābhojanaṃ tasya āmiṣe tu sucetasaḥ ||
praviṣṭas tu tatas tatra na nidrāṃ lubdhakokṛtām (?) |
tasya gandhaprabhāvena naśyanti mṛgasūkarāḥ ||
na tiṣṭhanti mṛgās tatra śaraghātavaśānugāḥ |
tatas tu śarvarī (?) kṣīṇā udite sūryamaṇḍale ||
nirāśo lubdhako bhūtvā niḥsṛto jālamadhyataḥ |
calito gṛhamārgeṇa kṣudhārto lubdhakas tataḥ ||
tāvad vālās tu te sarve nirīkṣya pitṛmārgagāḥ |
niṣādam api te dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ rātrim upassthitā ||
nānītam āmiṣaṃ tāta nirāśāḥ śiśavo gatāḥ |
rudanti karuṇaiḥ śabdair bhojanaṃ dīyatām ca naḥ ||
tatas tūṣṇīṃ pitā bhūtvā hy adhovadanaduḥkhitaḥ |
bhojanaṃ kuru he svāmin tasya bhāryā vaco 'bravīt ||
upoṣitas tv ahorātraṃ kāṣṭaṃ tubhyaṃ pravartate |
bhojanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena yathā dattaṃ tu bhāryayā ||
dharmahīno niṣādas tu pāpātmā jīvaghātakaḥ |
akāmo jāgaraṃ rātrau śivarātryāṃ varānane ||
[76]        pūjā tu bilvapatrais tu saṃjātā liṅgamastake |
mṛto 'sau kālaparyāye gṛhīto yamakiṅkaraiḥ ||
śivena preṣitās tasya vimānavarakoṭayaḥ |
śīghram ānīyatāṃ vyādho gṛhīto yamakiṅkaraiḥ ||
nirdagdhaṃ kalmaṣaṃ tasya śivarātryāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
yaḥ pūrvaṃ lubdhako bhūtvā karoti prāṇināṃ vadham ||
iti śrutvā vaco divyaṃ gaṇās te gantum udyatāḥ |
stūyamānāḥ paraṃ devaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ nirāmayam ||
yāvad gacchanti te sarve tāvat paśyanti lubdhakam |
hanyamānaṃ lauhadaṇḍair bahubhir muṣṭibhis tathā ||
sarve kolāhalaṃ cakrur asmākam itare gaṇāḥ |
parasparaṃ vadhyamānā ūcus te yamakiṅkarāḥ ||
yamakiṅkarā ūcuḥ |
na mokṣyāmo vayaṃ cainaṃ niṣādaṃ jīvaghātinam |
yamo yāvan na paśyet tu śuddhaś ca na bhavet tataḥ ||
śivakiṅkarā ūcuḥ |
lubdhako 'yaṃ pūrvam āsīt pāpiṣṭho yamakiṅkarāḥ |
anena śivarātris tu kṛtākāmena kānane ||
tasmāc chivājñayā sarve vimānaiḥ paramāgatāḥ |
yāvac chivaṃ na paśyāma na muñcāmo hy amuṃ naram ||
tato hantuṃ samārabdhāḥ khaḍgamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ |
[77]        pravṛttaṃ tan mahāyuddham anyonyajayakāṅkṣiṇām ||
bhagnāṅgasandhayaḥ kecit kecin mūrcchāṃ samāśritāḥ |
jarjarīkṛtadehās tu krandante yamakiṅkarāḥ ||
trāhi trāhīti jalpanti gatās te yamasādanam |
niṣādo 'pi gaṇair nīto yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ||
dṛṣṭimātras tu devena niṣādo gaṇatāṃ gataḥ |
sthito 'sau divyadehas tu divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
tasya dattaṃ maheśena vimānaṃ sārvakāmikam |
rudrakanyāsamākīrṇaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam ||
nānātūryasamāyuktaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam |
krīḍate suciraṃ kālaṃ yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam ||
evaṃ labdhavaro bhūtvā kṛīḍate yamaśāsane |
athāto yamadūtās tu dharmarājapurogatāḥ ||
rudhirāruṇasarvāṅgāḥ rudante bhagnamastakāḥ |
jarjarīkṛtadehās te bhinnagātrāḥ samantataḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā dharmo vadaty etat ko 'sau kālena yojitaḥ |
preṣayiṣyāmy ahaṃ devaṃ kāmam etad dhi kathyatām ||
kena caiva ca yuṣmākaṃ kṛtaṃ vividhaghātanam ||
yamadūtā ūcuḥ |
śṛṇu rājan yathāvṛttaṃ yuddhaṃ śivagaṇaiḥ saha |
nīto 'sau pāpakarmā ca niṣādo jīvaghātakaḥ ||
asmābhir gṛhyamāṇas tu (?) gaṇaiḥ śaivair balād hṛtaḥ |
[78]        tac chrutvā kupito dharmaḥ pāpiṣṭho vaśago mama ||
kathaṃ śivapuraṃ yāti citragupta vicārayā |
citragupta uvāca |
īkṣitaṃ pustakaṃ yena na kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam |
dharmavuddhiṃ [vṛddhiṃ?] na jānāti dharmādharmaṃ na vindati |
etan me niścitaṃ deva satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmy aham ||
śiva uvāca |
iti jñātvā niṣādasya citraguptaniveditam |
caritraṃ dharmarājas tu svāgataṃ vākyam abravīt ||
dharmarāja uvāca |
nāham adya dinād ūrdhvaṃ jantoś cintāṃ karomi tu |
gatvā samarpayiṣyāmi vyāpāraṃ tu śivasya ca ||
evam uktā tataḥ śīghraṃ citragupto yamaś ca saḥ |
gatvā ca devadeveśaṃ yamaḥ stotuṃ pracakrame |
yama uvāca |
namas te lokanāthāya mahāvalavināśana |
sākṣāt kālavināśāya kālanirdeśine namaḥ ||
trinetrāya namas tubhyaṃ namas te śūladhāriṇe |
kapāline namas tubhyaṃ namaḥ khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇe ||
namo ḍamuruhastāya śaktisarpanidhāya ca |
namo 'stu nīlakaṇṭhāya hasticarmadharāya ca ||
[79]        namas trailokyanāthāya mahāpātakanāśine |
kālakūṭavināśāya namaḥ kāmavidāhine ||
aśodhyaṃ śodhase deva etan me kautukaṃ mahat |
gṛhāpāpī niṣādas tu yataḥ santāritas tvayā ||
na pāpānāṃ kariṣyāmi cintāṃ vai tripurāntaka |
ity uktvā devadeve tu praṇāmo daṇḍavat kṛtaḥ ||
daṇḍamudrāṃ ca pādāgre sthāpya tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha ||
īśvara uvāca |
kim arthaṃ daṇḍamudrāṃ tvaṃ tyajase dharmavardhana |
kenāparādito vatsa mānaṃ te kena marditaḥ ||
dharmarāja uvāca |
tvadgaṇair devadeveśa gatvā pāpasya kāraṇe |
madīyāḥ kiṅkarā deva bahudhā ghātitā bhṛśam ||
pāpakarmā durācāro niṣādo jīvaghātakaḥ |
dharmo nopārjitas tena janmaprabhṛti īśvara ||
ayogyaṃ devadeveśa tvadgaṇair bahudhā kṛtam |
gṛhītaḥ śivapurīṃ nītaḥ sa pāpī na hi me 'rpitaḥ ||
tenāham āgato deva tyaktvā mudrāṃ carāmy aham |
śiva uvāca |
vadaty evaṃ yame gauri prahasyāha mayā kṛtam |
