kadācit sa vanaṃ gatvā na kiṃcit prāptavāṃs tadā |
[80]        dinānte ca nirāśo 'sau kṣutṛtyukto jalāntike ||
akarod āśramaṃ madhye mahājālyāṃ tadā niśi |
jālimadhye mahāliṅgaṃ tiṣṭhate cirakālikam ||
mukhāgre bilvapatrāṇi gṛhītvā mārgato 'kṣipat |
kathaṃcid daivasaṃyogād vāyunā liṅgamūrdhani ||
nikṣiptāni pretarāja komalāny apy akāmataḥ |
śivarātriḥ kṛtā tena jāgratāmṛtahetunā ||
śivarātriprabhāvena sa gato mama śāsanam |
gaṇatvam akṣayaṃ divyaṃ mokṣadaṃ śivaśāsane ||
sa mukto rudravan nitye bhogān bhuṅkte sadā divi |
bhogānte paramaṃ yāti śivaṃ paramakāraṇam |
śivarātriprabhāvena āgato mama śāsane ||
tad gṛhāṇa mahādharma daṇḍaṃ mudrāṃ ca sarvadā |
pāpiṣṭho ye sadā martyā na te yānti mamāntikam ||
adyaprabhṛti dharmeśa avamānaṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ |
gṛhṇa gṛhṇa mahādharma mudrāṃ daṇḍaṃ yadṛcchayā ||
pālanāya svadharmasya pāhi satyaṃ mahāyama |
svagṛhaṃ gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ daṇḍaṃ gṛhya samudrakam ||
tāḍayan pāpakarmāṇaṃ pālayan vai svadharmiṇam |
evam ukto dharmarājo gato 'sau svagṛhaṃ śubham ||
evaṃ devi mayā khyātaṃ śivarātrer mahāvrate ||
pārvaty uvāca |
akāmo lubdhako deva kṛtvā hy amaratāṃ gataḥ |
[81]        āścaryam etad deveśa mamāścaryataraṃ mahat ||
kāmataḥ śāstradṛṣṭena yaḥ karoti śivavratam |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi prasādād vaktum arhasi ||
śiva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge sarvataś cārubhāṣiṇi |
śivarātriprabhāvaś ca kathakaḥ pāpakarmaṇām ||
māghamāse tu vā kṛṣṇā phālgunādau caturdaśī |
sā tu puṇyā tithir jñeyā sarvapāpavināśinī ||
śāntātmā krodhahīnas tu tapasvī hy anasūyakaḥ |
tasmai deyam idaṃ devi gurupādānuge sadā ||
anyathā yo dadātīdaṃ sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet |
varṣe varṣe mahādevi naro nārī pativratā ||
vīkṣayāmi jagat sarvaṃ ko māṃ bhaktyā prapūjayet |
śivamantrair japaṃ kṛtvā homam arcanadīpanam ||
jāgaraṃ śivarātryāṃ tu śivaṃ paśyet samāhitaḥ |
mama bhakto jano devi śivarātrer upoṣakaḥ ||
gaṇatvam akṣayaṃ divyam akṣayaṃ śivaśāsanam |
sarvaṃ kṛtvā tu bhajate bhogān amṛtasaṃbhavān ||
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi śivarātrer poṣakaḥ |
yo māṃ jāgarate rātriṃ manujaḥ svargam āpnuyāt ||
akṛtvā māṃ na jānāti vratam etad udāhṛtam |
śivaṃ ca pūjayitvā yo jāgarti ca caturdaśīm ||
[82]        mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na pibet sa kadācana |
yadīcchec cākṣayān bhogān divi devasamaḥ pumān ||
āgamoktavidhiṃ kṛtvā prāpnoti sakalaṃ phalam ||
ādau mārgaśire māsi dīpotsavadine 'pi vā |
gṛhṇīyān māghamāse vā dvādaśaivam upoṣaṇam ||
niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpadyotitadiṅmukhaḥ |
gītavādyavinodena pūjā jāpyaiḥ śive rataḥ ||
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣe tu dvādaśaiva tapodhane |
ācāryaṃ śivaśāstrajñaṃ brāhmaṇāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
āmantrya parayā bhaktyā gṛhaṃ gatvā tapodhanān |
ācāryaṃ varayitvā tu gṛhṇīyāc caraṇadvayam ||
āgaccha me gṛhaṃ tāta kṛtakṛtyaṃ gṛhaṃ kuru |
āmantrya niśi nān (tān?) evaṃ prabhāte vimale punaḥ ||
gṛhībhyarcya [gṛhy abhy-?] liṅgaṃ tu sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ punaḥ |
pañcāmṛtena divyena snāpya codvartanādibhiḥ ||
snāpayed vārikumbhānāṃ sahasreṇa śatena vā |
pañcāśatā tadardhena snāpayec chītalena tu ||
candanena vilipyātha sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā |
śatapatrair jātipuṣpair arcayed bilvapatrakaiḥ ||
dīpān dikṣu ca sarvāsu prajvālya saghanāṃs tathā |
[83] saghanān sakarpūrān |
naivedyam api bhakṣyāṃś ca kṣīrakhaṇḍasamaṇḍakān |
guḍādyaṃ laḍḍukāṃś caiva annaṃ ca rucidaṃ bahu ||
nivedayet tathaitāni gurudevatapasvināṃ |
devāgre tu guruṃ pūjya kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ śubham ||
susūkṣmāṇi ca vastrāṇi śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tathā ||
dvādaśaiva tu gā dadyāt paridhānādikaṃ tathā |
atha vā dakṣiṇām eva pradadyāt juhuyāt tilān ||
datvā ca bhojayet sarvān gurūṃś caiva tapasvinaḥ |
paścāt kṣamāpayed evaṃ prīyatāṃ me maheśvaraḥ ||
sarvaṃ caiva tathācārye śivavrataparāyaṇe |
gandhādivividhaiḥ sarvān anyāṃs tatra samāgatān ||
dakṣiṇābhiś ca kumbhaiś ca navānnaiś ca prapūjayet |
evaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi na bhūyo deham āpnuyāt ||
yadāsau mriyate devi śivalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ |
tasmān na vyathate sthānāt kalpakoṭiśatair api ||
athātaḥ kālaparyāye draṣṭuṃ yāti svayaṃbhuvam |
sahito lokapālaiś ca vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ ||
tataḥ paśyen mahādevaṃ nānāgaṇasamāvṛtam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā stauti deveśaṃ śivaṃ trubhuvaneśvaram ||
namas tubhyaṃ jagannātha lalāṭe candraśekharaḥ |
namas te umayā yukta bhuktimuktipradāyaka ||
namas te kāmadahana trailokyavyāpine namaḥ |
[84]        namas te kālogra kālabhīto 'smi deva śaṅkara ||
iti stuto bhairvas tu dadāti varam īpsitam |
bhairava uvāca |
tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava bhaktasya śivarātrer upoṣaṇāt |
varaṃ dadāmy ahaṃ tubhyaṃ devadānavadurlabham ||
etāḥ kanyā mahādivyā trinetrāś ca caturbhujāḥ |
rūpayauvanasaṃpannāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ ||
hemagauryo mahātejāḥ saṃyuktāḥ sūryavarcasaḥ |
devāṅgavastrasaṃchannāś candanāgurucarcitāḥ ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ kuṇḍalair dyotitānanāḥ |
evaṃvidhā mayā dattā manasvinyaḥ sumadhyamāḥ ||
vimānakoṭisaṃyuktāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
krīḍasva ca mahābhāga gaṇas tvaṃ mama putraka ||
sarvagāmī bhavādyeha lokalokaṃ carācaram |
tuṣṭo 'haṃ tava bhaktasya śivavrataratasya ca ||
rudraloke tu yā kanyās trinetrāś ca caturbhujāḥ |
atīva bhartṛbhaktāś ca yathāham umayā saha ||
tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ mahābhāga bhuṅkṣva bhogān yathepsitān |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ||
ante vrataprabhāvena śivasāyujyatāṃ vraja |
sarvavyāpī bhava tvaṃ ca līyase parame pade ||
parāt parataraṃ nāsti śivarātrivratāt param |
[85]        na pūjayati deveśaṃ rudraṃ trubhuvaneśvaram ||
jantur janmasahasreṣu bhramate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yadā tadbhāvasaṃyuktaḥ sa rudragaṇatāṃ vrajet |
tatra dattaṃ hutam japtam arcanaṃ gurupūjanam ||
jāgaraḥ śivarātryāṃ tu sarvaṃ tac cākṣayaṃ bhavet |
kaścit puṇyaviśeṣeṇa vratahīno 'pi yaḥ pumān ||
jāgaraṃ kurute tatra sa rudrasamatāṃ vrajet |
sūryagrahe kurukṣetre himavatkurujāṅgale ||
śivarātryāṃ tathā bhaktyā dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam |
akhaṇḍitavrato yo hi śivarātrim upoṣayet ||
sa sarvakāmam āpnoti rudreṇa saha modate |
śivarātridine dattaṃ tathā bhavati cākṣayam ||
akhaṇḍitavrato yo hi śivarātrim upoṣayet |
sarvakāmamanaḥ pūrṇaḥ krīḍate śivasaṃnidhau ||
dhanyās te mānavā loke śivarātriparāyaṇāḥ |
arṇavā yadi śuṣyanti kṣīyate himavān api ||
merumandāralaṅkāś ca śrīśailo vindhya eva ca |
calante 'nekadā sarve niścalaṃ hi śivavratam ||
atas tasyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyām ekabhuṅ naraḥ |
mantreṇānena gṛhṇīyān niyamaṃ bhaktimān naraḥ ||
śivarātrivrataṃ hy etat kariṣye 'haṃ mahāphalam |
nirvighnam astu me cātra tvatprasādāj jagatpate ||
rātrīḥ prapadye jananīṃ mṛdbhyāṃ caiva samāhitaḥ |
[86]        gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇas tv evaṃ niyamaṃ vedavid vibho ||
śivarātrivratam ity anena mantreṇa śūdrādir niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyāt brāhmaṇādiṣu |
rātrīṃ prapadye jananīṃ sarvabhūtaniveśanīm |
bhadrāṃ bhagavatīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ viśvasya jagato niśām ||
saṃveśanīṃ saṃyamanīṃ grahanakṣatramālinīm |
prapanno 'haṃ śivāṃ rātrīṃ bhadre pāram aśīmahi ||
bhadre pāram aśīmantrottamaḥ iti mantrabhyām ṛgvedasiddhābhyāṃ niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyād ity arthaḥ |
śivam iṣṭvā guruṃ dṛṣṭvā svācāntaḥ śucir ātmavān |
saṃkalpyaivaṃ (?) vrataṃ kuryāt pūrvedyuḥ prātar eva ca |
tato 'haś carame bhāge svagāyatryā hy atandritaḥ ||
snānaṃ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kuryād gṛhe vātha jalāśaye |
ramye niśāmukhe gacchec chivasyāyatanaṃ vratī |
dinānte snapanaṃ kuryāc chivaṃ nāmnā prapūjayet ||
dhūpanaivedyagandhaiś ca nṛtyagītaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ |
śaṅkhacakraninādaiś ca kuryāt pustakavācanam ||
dvitīye prahare caiva nāmnā śaṅkaram arcayet |
pūrvoktena vidhānena pūjayet parameśvaram ||
tṛtīye prahare devaṃ nāmnā maheśvaraṃ tathā |
yāme caturthe saṃprāpte rudraṃ nāmnā prapūjayet ||
evaṃ hi bhaktiyuktaś ca jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi |
sakalaṃ phalam āpnoti satyam etad varānane ||
[87]        uṣaḥ snānaṃ japo homaḥ bhojayec chivavatsalān |
śvetān kumbhān pradadyāc ca yathāśaktyā sadakṣiṇān ||
pūjayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā vrate māheśvare sthitān |
vācayec chivaśāstraṃ ca sa gacchec chivamandiram ||
upoṣya puṇyakarmāṇo niyataṃ svargagāminaḥ |
śivavratasya cākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhec chivasaṃnidhau ||
ramate śivaloke ca yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
evaṃ divi samākhyātaṃ śivarātrer mahāvratam ||
śivalokam avāpnoti śivena saha modate ||
iti śrīskandapurāṇoktaṃ sodyāpanaṃ śivarātrivratam |
kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite |
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāratnopaśobhite ||
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe siddhagandharvasevite |
krīḍate bhagavāṃs tatra gaṇaiḥ svaiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
nandyādayo gaṇās tatra krīḍante śivasaṃnidhau |
kautūhalaṃ paraṃ tatra pañcaśabdanināditam ||
vīṇāveṇumṛdacaiś (?) ca pañcacaiś ca tathā giri |
devakanyāsamākīrṇaṃ taṃ giriṃ sumanoharam ||
prasādāt tatra tiṣṭhanti sauvarṇāḥ sumanoharāḥ |
dhvajamālākulaṃ ramyaṃ kailāsaṃ sarvadevataiḥ ||
visṛjya devatāḥ sarvāḥ ramate comayā saha |
tatra sthitaṃ mahādevam umā pṛcchati śaṅkaram ||
[88]                umovāca |
devadeva jagannātha sarvalokanamaskṛta |
kṛtvā prasādaṃ deveśa kathaya tvaṃ (?) mama prabho ||
namo namo mahādeva svasthaṃ tiṣṭhati sarvadā |
udvegas tu mahācitte kasmān me parivartate ||
na mayā hi mahādeva kṛtaṃ kiṃcic chubhaṃ vratam |
kṛtvā prasādaṃ deveśa vrataṃ me kathyatāṃ prabho ||
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yan na kasyacid ākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ muktidāyakam ||
yena vai kathyamānena yamo 'pi vilayaṃ vrajet |
tad ahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ sadā ||
māghaphālgunayor madhye kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī |
śivarātris tu vijñeyā sarvayajñottamā tithiḥ ||
dānayajñais tapoyajñair anyaiś ca bahudakṣiṇaiḥ |
śivarātrisamaṃ nāsti kṛtvā yajñasahasrakam ||
na te yamapurasthās te yaiḥ kṛteyaṃ śivapradā |
bhuktimuktipradā devi satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane ||
devy uvāca |
kathaṃ yamapurīṃ deva varjayitvā śivaṃ vrajet |
etad eva mahāścaryaṃ pratyayaṃ kuru me prabo ||
śiva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi prayatnena kathāṃ paurāṇikīṃ śubhām |
[89]        mama śāsanahantrī ca śivalokapradāyinī ||
na te yamapuraṃ yāti [yānti?] yaiḥ kṛteyaṃ śivapradā |
śṛṇu devi mahāścaryaṃ yaj jātaṃ śivavallabhe ||
āsīd rājā videhāyāṃ prajāpālanatatparaḥ |
sudharmā nāma vikhyātaḥ sadā paramadhārmikaḥ ||
pṛthivyāṃ sarve rājāno vartante vaśavartinaḥ |
tasya rājye na vai kaścit vyādhito duḥkhito 'bhavat ||
sādhūn pālayate rājā putravat surasundari |
evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭasya tasya rājñaḥ priyā śubhā ||
bhāryā tilottamā nāma sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ |
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktā sthirayauvanasaṃsthitā ||
haṃsakokilasaṃbhāṣā mattamātaṅgagāminī |
yathā rūpā tathā śīlā tasya bhāryā mahīpateḥ ||
bhartuḥ priyahite yuktā bhartuś caiva hi vallabhā |
yāś ca ramyā parā bhāryā śatasāhasrasaṃmitāḥ ||
sarvās tā guṇasaṃyuktā dāsya eva vyavasthitāḥ |
evaṃ gacchati kāle tu kasmiṃścit surasundari ||
ataḥ paraṃ svadharmātmā jagāma ripumardana |
dṛṣṭvā tilottamā devī sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ ||
āgacchantaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā rājānaṃ ripumardanm |
tataś ca svayam utthāya dadau rājāsanaṃ tadā ||
vandaty evaṃ tato rājñī śiveti ca punaḥ punaḥ |
upaviṣṭā tato rājñaḥ samīpe vaśavartinī ||
[90]        sa ca rājñā tadā rājñyā śiveti samudīritam |
śrutveti śeṣaḥ |
sasmāra prāktanaṃ karma anyajanmani yat kṛtam |
tatyājāsau tata smṛtvā tāmbūlaṃ karasaṃsthitam ||
cakāra manasā rājā saṅkalpaṃ śivapūjane |
tataḥ prayaccha sā devī kim idaṃ tyāgakāraṇam ||
yadi vakṣyasi me na tvaṃ mariṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ |
so 'pi rājā tato devīṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayām ||
vijñāya kathayāmāsa pūrvajanmani ceṣṭitam |
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā vacanaṃ surasundari ||
śrutvā tvayeritaṃ vākyaṃ śivanāmasamanvitam |
smṛtaṃ me sarvacaritaṃ pūrvajanmani yat kṛtam ||
śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi sāvadhānā bhava priye |
aham āsaṃ purā vaiśyaḥ svadharmanirataḥ śuciḥ ||
kālena gacchatā devi pūrvajanmavaśena ca |
svakarmaniratasyāpi caurye matir ajāyata ||
niśāniṣkramaṇaṃ kṛtvā cauryaṃ kartum ahaṃ gataḥ |
tasmin kāle śubhe devi māghamāso 'bhavat tadā |
tataś caivāsite pakṣe śivayogo 'bhavat tadā ||
caturdaśī tithiś cāsīc chivarātris tu sā smṛtā |
mama vai bhramamāṇasya ardharātram abhūt tadā ||
bhramatā hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ samavāyo janasya ca |
jāgaraṃ tu prakurvāṇaḥ śivasyāyatane śubhe ||
[91]        anantaraṃ tu samāsādyopaviṣṭas (?) tataḥ (?) kṣaṇam |
kasyacit gṛhamedhinyāḥ karṇasaṃsthaṃ ca kuṇḍalam ||
hṛtvā palāyamānas tu dṛṣṭo 'haṃ rakṣapālakaiḥ |
tatas te tad(?)hitā sarve khaḍgapāṇidhanurdharāḥ ||
tatas tv ekena kruddhena śiraś chinnaṃ mahāsinā |
tadbhayāc ca mayā tatra mukhe kṣiptaṃ tu kuṇḍalam ||
tataś ca karmaṇā tena rātrau jāgaraṇena ca |
cauryeṇa ca kṛtenāpi rājāhaṃ sa babhūva ha ||
tataś ca jātismaraṇaṃ jātiṃ mama tilottame |
śivayogas tu cādyaiva māghamāsas tu śobhane ||
caturdaśī tithiś cādya tāmbūlaṃ tan mayojjhitam |
etac chrutvā ca sā devī ācāryaṃ paramaṃ mahat ||
uvācainaṃ tadā rājñī vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatā |
yadi me pratyayaṃ kaṃcid utpādayasi bhūmipa ||
tadā jīvāmi nṛpate nānyatheyaṃ pratāraṇā |
etac chrutvā tadā rājā uvāca surasundari ||
etad eva śiro me 'tra paśyedaṃ kūpasaṃsthitam |
kālena kūpaḥ pūrṇo 'yaṃ loṣṭaiś ca tṛṇasaṃcayaiḥ ||
utthāya (?) ca gatau tatra dampatī vismayānvitau |
khanayitvā tato devyai darśayāmāsa tacchiraḥ ||
kuṇḍalaṃ tu mukhe dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatau |
tatas tu dampatī tatra cakratur niyamaṃ param ||
upavāsasya niyamas (?) tathā jāgaraṇasya ca |
[92]                śiva uvāca |
evaṃ hi māghamāse tu saṃprāpte surasundari |
tad vrataṃ jāgaraṃ caiva kuryāt pūjanam eva ca ||
tataś ca bhagavān īśas tuṣṭo bhavati tatkṣaṇāt |
kālena gacchatā tau tu putrapautrasamanvitau ||
saṃpūrṇe ca tayoḥ kāle maraṇaṃ samupāgatau |
yugmaṃ tu paramaṃ loke śivabhaktisamanvitau ||
śivarātriprabhāvena dampatī śivasaṃnidhau |
śivarātrim imāṃ (?) devi yaḥ karoti naro bhuvi ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate |
ity eṣā kathitā devi śivarātris tavāgrataḥ ||
sarvapāpaharā puṇyā sarvatīrthaphalapradā |
yaḥ karoti naro devi śivarātrim imāṃ śuci ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate |
ya imāṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śivarātrikathāṃ (?) naraḥ ||
kṛtā tena mahādevi śivarātrir na saṃśayaḥ |
iti śrīskandapurāṇe śivayogayuktaśivarātrivratamāhātmyam |
kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum |
pañcacaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam ||
kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇam |
kapāladhāriṇaṃ bhīmaṃ varadaṃ cābhayapradam ||
bhasmāṅgavyālaśobhāḍhyaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharam |
[93]        nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ prahasyotpullalocanā |
devī papraccha bhartāraṃ śaṅkare lokaśaṅkaram ||
devy uvāca |
kathaya tvaṃ prasādena yad gopyaṃ vratam uttamam |
yat kṛtvā devadeveśaḥ (-veśa?) pāpahāniḥ prajāyate ||
śrutāni devadeveśa vratāni tithiniścayam |
dānadharmāṇy anekāni tapastīrthāny anekaśaḥ ||
nāsti me niścayo deva bhrāmitāhaṃ tvayā punaḥ |
tasmād vadasya deveśa ekaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ vratam ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ cāpi sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi kathayasva mahāprabho ||
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
kasyacin na samākhyātaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām ||
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa pātakaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet |
tad ahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye ||
māghānte bahule pakṣe sadā kāryā caturdaśī |
śivarātris tu sā jñeyā sarvayajñottamottamā ||
dānair yajñais tapobhiś ca vratair bahuvidhair api |
tīrthaiś cāpi na tat puṇyaṃ yat puṇyaṃ śivarātritaḥ ||
śivarātrisamaṃ nāsti vrataṃ pāpavināśakṛt |
ajñānāt jñānato vāpi kṛtvā muktim avāpnuyāt ||
[94]        sarvamāṅgalyakaraṇī sarvāśubhavināśinī |
mṛtās te narakaṃ yānti yair eṣā na kṛtā kvacit ||
sarvamaṅgalaśīlā ca sarvāśubhavināśinī |
bhuktimuktipradā caiṣā satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane ||
pārvaty uvāca |
kathaṃ yamapure mārgaṃ tyaktvā devaṃ vrajen naraḥ |
etan me mahad āścaryaṃ pratyayaṃ kuru śaṅkara ||
śiva uvāca |
śṛṇu devi yathāvṛttaṃ kathāṃ pāurāṇikīṃ śubhām |
yamaśāsanahantrī ca śivaśāsanadāyinī ||
kaścid āsīt purā kalpe niṣādaś cāmiṣapriyaḥ |
pratyantadeśavāsī ca bhūdharāsannabhūdharaḥ ||
sīmānte sarvadā tiṣṭhet kuṭumbaparipālakaḥ |
tanvāpīno dhanurdhārī śyāmāṅgaḥ kṛṣṇakañcukaḥ ||
baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇaḥ sadaiva mṛgaghātakaḥ |
evaṃvidho niṣādo 'sau caturdaśyāṃ dinodaye ||
sa hatyārthe vaṇigbhiś ca devatāgre nirundhitaḥ |
tenāpi devatā dṛṣṭā janānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutam ||
upavāsaratānāṃ ca jalpatāṃ śiva śiveti ca |
dinānte sa tadā muktaḥ prātar dravyaṃ pradīyatām ||
tato 'sau dhanur ādāya dakṣiṇena gataḥ svayam |
jagāma ca vanoddeśaṃ janahāsaṃ cakāra ha ||
śivaḥ śivaḥ kim etad vai vadanti nagare janāḥ |
[95]        vane caro nirīkṣan sa caturdikṣu itas tataḥ ||
padaṃ ca padamārgaṃ ca mṛgasūkaracittalān |
dhāvatas tasya sarvāsu dikṣu vai lubdhacetasaḥ ||
vanaṃ saparvataṃ sarvaṃ bhramatas tu dinaṃ gatam |
aprāptā eva gacchanti sakalā mṛgajātayaḥ |
saṃprāptam api cāpaśyan na mṛgaṃ na ca cittalam ||
nirāśo lubdhako yāvat tāvad astaṃ gato raviḥ |
cintayitvā jalopānte jāgaraṃ mṛgaghātanam ||
saṃvidhāsyāmy ahaṃ rātrau niścitaṃ mama jīvanam |
taḍāgasaṃnidhau gatvā tattīre jālamadhyataḥ ||
nilayaṃ kartum ārabdham ātmārthe guptikāraṇam |
jālimadhye mahāliṅgam asti svāyaṃbhuvaṃ śubham ||
tato bilvasya patrāṇi troṭitvā mārgaśodhane |
kṣiptāni dakṣiṇe bhāge gatāni liṅgamūrdhani ||
na divābhojanaṃ jātaṃ sa ruddhasya prabhāvataḥ |
mṛgān nirīkṣatas tasya nidrānāśo 'py ajāyata ||
jālamadhyagatasyāpi prathamaḥ prahato gataḥ |
tato jalārtham āyātā hariṇo garbhasaṃyutāḥ ||
nirīkṣanti diśaḥ sarvā utphullanayanā bhṛśam |
lubdhakenātha sā dṛṣṭā bāṇagocaratāṃ gatā ||
kṛtaṃ ca bāṇasaṃdhānaṃ tenaikāgreṇa cetasā |
troṭitvā bilvapatrāṇi prakṣiptāni śivopari ||
smaran śiveti vādaṃ ca śītena paripīḍitaḥ |
[96]        bilvamadhye sthito dṛṣṭo hariṇyā lubdakas tadā ||
lubdhakaḥ svasvarūpeṇa kṛtānta iva tiṣṭhati |
dṛṣṭvā ca tasya sandhānaṃ yamadaṃṣṭrāsamaprabham ||
sā mṛgī divyayā vācā lubdhakaṃ vākyam abravīt |
mṛgy uvāca |
sthiro bhava mahāvyādha sarvajīvanikṛntana
kim arthaṃ māṃ haniṣye tvaṃ kathayasya mama prabho ||
śiva uvāca |
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā lubdhakaḥ prāha tāṃ mṛgīm |
samātṛkaṃ kuṭumbaṃ me kṣudayā pīḍyate bhṛśam |
dhanaṃ ca madgṛhe nāsti tasmāt tvaṃ hanmi śobhane ||
sūta uvāca |
jātapūjāprabhāvena jāgaro poṣaṇena ca |
caturthāṃśena pāpānāṃ vimukto lubdhakas tadā ||
vismayotpullanayano mṛgīvākyena pārvati |
uvāca vacanaṃ tāṃ vai dharmayuktam asaṃśayam ||
mayā hi pātitā devi uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ |
na śrutā tv īdṛśī vāṇī śvāpadānāṃ kathaṃcana ||
kasmin deśe tvam utpannā kasmāt sthānād ihāgatā |
kathaya tvaṃ prayatnena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||
mṛgy uvāca |
śṛṇu tvaṃ lubdhakaśreṣṭha kathayāmi tavakhilam ||
āsaṃ pūrvam ahaṃ rambhā svarge śakrasya cāpsarā ||
[97]        anantarūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyena ca garvitā |
saubhāgyamadasaṃyukto dānavo madagarvitaḥ ||
mayaiva satkṛto bhartā hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ |
tena sārdhaṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ mayā bhuktaṃ yathepsitam ||
anyasmin divase vyādha krīḍate vai sureṇa ca |
gato bahutaraḥ kālo mahādevasya kopakṛt ||
pratyahaṃ prekṣaṇaṃ nṛtyaṃ śaṅkarasyāgrataś caret |
yāvad gacchāmy ahaṃ tatra tāvad rudro 'vravīt krudhā ||
herambhe kva gatāsi tvaṃ kena vā saṃgatā śubhe |
saubhāgyamadagarveṇa nāgatā mama mandiram ||
satyaṃ kathaya śīghraṃ tvaṃ no vā śāpaṃ dadāmi te |
śāpabhītyā mayā tatra satyam uktaṃ śivāgrataḥ ||
śṛṇu deva pravakṣyāmi śāpānugrahakāraka |
mama bhartā samaḥ prāṇair dānavo baladarpitaḥ ||
tena sārdhaṃ mayā deva krīḍitaṃ nijamandire |
tasya bhogena lubdhāhaṃ śayanād eva notthitā ||
tenāhaṃ nāgatā śīghraṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraka |
rudras tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sakopo vākyam abravīt ||
mṛgaḥ kāmāturo nityaṃ haraṇyākṣo bhaviṣyati |
tvaṃ mṛgī tasyā bhāryā vai bhaviṣyasi mahāvane ||
tasmāt tu nirjale deśe tṛṇāhārā bhaviṣyasi |
dvādaśābdāni bhadraṃ te bhavitā śāpa eṣa te ||
parasparasya śokena śāpānto 'pi bhaviṣyati |
[98]        kṛtas tv anugraho vyādhe śaṅkarena yadṛcchayā |
yadā kaścid vyādhataro mama sāṃnidhyam āśritaḥ ||
bāṇāgre tasya saṃprāptā pūrvajanma smariṣyati |
śaṅkarasya tadā rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mokṣam avāpsyasi ||
śaṅkaro na mayā dṛṣṭo vasanty asmin mahāvane |
tena duḥkham anuprāptā medomāṃsavivarjitā ||
bhartrākrāntā viśeṣeṇa avadhyā ceti niścitam |
sakuṭumbasya te nūnaṃ bhojanaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||
āyāsyati mṛgī tv anyā mārgeṇānena lubdhaka |
rūpayauvanasaṃpannā bahumāṃsamadoddhatā ||
bhojanam akuṭumbasya tayā nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati |
atha vānyo mṛgo vyādha tava bāṇasya gocare ||
prabhāte te kṣudhārtasya niścayād āgamiṣyasi |
muktvātha vā vyādha garbhaṃ bālān ādiśya bandhuṣu ||
śapathair āgamiṣyāmi saṃdiśya ca sakhījanam |
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vyādho vismitamānasaḥ ||
kaṣṭam evaṃ tadā dhyātvā vyādhovāca mṛgāṅganām |
nāgamiṣyati yady anyo mṛgas tvam api gacchati ||
kṣudhayā pīḍito 'haṃ vai kuṭumbaś ca bhaviṣyati |
prātas tvayā mama gṛham āgantavyaṃ yadā bhavet ||
vraja tvaṃ (?) śapathaṃ kṛtvā yathā me niścayo bhavet |
pṛthivī vāyur ādityaḥ satye tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ ||
pālanīyaṃ tataḥ satyaṃ lokadvayam abhīpsubhiḥ |
[99]        tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā sā garbhārtā tadā mṛgī |
cakre satyapratijñāṃ vai vyādhasyāgre punaḥ punaḥ ||
mṛgy uvāca |
dvijo bhūtvā tu yo vyādha vedabhraṣṭo 'bhijāyate |
svādhyāyasaṃdhyārahitaḥ satyaśaucavivarjitaḥ ||
avikrayāṇāṃ vikretā ayājyānāṃ ca yājakaḥ |
tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchāmi punar yadi ||
dhūrte duṣṭe śaṭhe yac ca yat pāpaṃ mānakūṭake |
dānaṃ dātuṃ praśaktaś ca prārthitaṃ na dadāti ca ||
tena pāpena lipyāmi gacchāmi na punar yadi |
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo haret sāgarāṃ varām ||
devadravyaṃ gurudravyaṃ brahmadravyaṃ tathā haret |
tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchāmi punar yadi ||
dīpena dīpo dīpyeta pādaṃ pādena dhāvayet |
bhartāraṃ svāminaṃ mitram ātmānaṃ bālam eva ca ||
gāṃ ca vipraṃ guruṃ nārīṃ vyāpādayati durmatiḥ |
tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchāmi punar yadi ||
dānasya kīrtane pāpam yat pāpaṃ dāmbhike tathā |
asaṃjitendriye nityaṃ paradoṣānukīrtane ||
kṛtaghne ca kadarye ca nāstike vedanindake |
sadācāravihīne ca parapīḍāpradāyake ||
parapaiśunyayukte 'pi kanyāvikrayakārake |
parāpavādasaṃtuṣṭe sarvadharmabahiṣkṛte ||
[100]        vṛṣalīpatau ca yat pāpaṃ mātāpitror apoṣake |
haituke bakavṛttau ca śrāddhatīrthavivarjite |
eteṣāṃ pātakaṃ mahyaṃ nāgacchāmi punar yadi ||
yat pāpaṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ pitṛmātṛvadhe tathā |
yat pāpaṃ lubdhakānāṃ tu bho (?) coraviṣaghātinām ||
tena pāpena lipyāmi yady ahaṃ nāgame punaḥ |
dvibhāryaḥ puruṣo yas tu samadṛṣṭyā na paśyati ||
yas trīn hale balīvardān viṣamān vāhayen naraḥ |
tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchati punar yadi ||
sakṛd datvā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dvitīye dātum icchati |
yasya saṃgrahaṇī bhāryā brāhmaṇo ca viśeṣataḥ ||
ekākī miṣṭam aśnāti bhāryāputravivarjitaḥ |
ātmano guṇasaṃpannāṃ samāne sadṛśe vare ||
na dadāti ca yaḥ kanyāṃ naro vai jñānadurbalaḥ |
tena pāpena lipyāmi nāgacchāmi punar yadi ||
mṛgo vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā lubdhako hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
mumoca hariṇīṃ sadyo muktvā bāṇaṃ dhanus tataḥ ||
tasyā uktiprabhāvena liṅgārcākaraṇena ca |
sa pātakacaturthāṃśāṃ mukto 'sau tatkṣaṇāt dhruvam ||
dvitīye prahare prāpte hy ardharātre varānane |
smaraṇ śiva śivaṃ vākyaṃ na nidrāṃ labdhavāṃs tathā ||
dvitīye 'tha tataḥ prāptā kāmārtā mṛgasundarī |
saṃtrastā bhayasaṃvignā patim anveṣatī tadā||
[101]        jālimadhye sthitenātha dṛṣṭā sā tu vṛkena ca |
punar bilvasya patrāṇi troṭitāni kareṇa tu ||
kṣiptāṇi dakṣiṇe bhāge liṅgasyopari pārvati |
tasyā vadhārthaṃ vyādhena bāṇaṃ dhanuṣi saṃdadhe ||
harṣapūrṇena manasā kuṭumbarthaṃ mṛgaṃ priye |
nirīkṣya lubdhako yāvat tasyāṃ bāṇaṃ vimuñcati ||
tāvan mṛgī susaṃtrastā vyādhaṃ vacanam abravīt |
dhanurdhara śṛṇu vyādha sarvasattvabhayaṃkara ||
dehi me vacanaṃ hy ekaṃ paścān māṃ vinipātaya ||
āyātā hariṇī caikā mārgeṇānena lubdhaka |
samāyātātha vā naiva satyaṃ kathaya (?) suvrata ||
tadvaco lubdhakaḥ śrutvā vismitatas tatkṣaṇād abhūt |
tasyās tu tādṛśī vāṇī amuṣyā api tādṛśī ||
saiveyam āgatā nūnaṃ pratijñāpālanāya vai |
atha kānyā samāyātā yā tayā kathitā purā ||
evaṃ saṃcitya manasā lubdhako vākyam abravīt |
śṛṇu tvaṃ mṛgi me vākyaṃ gatā sā nijamandiram ||
tvaṃ datvā mama nūnaṃ hi sā bhavet satyavāg api |
ahorātraṃ kṛtaṃ kaṣṭaṃ kuṭumbārthaṃ mṛgāṅgane ||
adhunā tvāṃ haniṣyāmi devatāsmaraṇaṃ kuru |
vyādhoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā hariṇī duḥkhitā bhṛśam ||
vyādhaṃ prāha ruditvā sā mā māṃ vyādha nipātaya |
nāsti māṃsaṃ tathā medaḥ śarīre rudhiraṃ mama ||
[102]        tejo balaṃ me sakalaṃ nirdagdhaṃ viharāgninā |
ahaṃ prāṇair viyojyāmi bhojanaṃ te na jāyate ||
balavān sumahātejā medamāṃsapariplutaḥ |
atyantasthūlapīnāṅgo mṛgo hy atrāgamiṣyati ||
tayoktaṃ lubdhakaḥ śrutvā kiṃ karomīty acintayat |
mṛgo bhrūte hy asaṃdigdhaṃ niścayo 'yaṃ paraṃ mama ||
cintayitveti sa prāha mṛgīṃ kāmāturāṃ tadā |
kuru pratijñāṃ satyāṃ tvaṃ niścayo me yathā bhavet ||
tad vyādhavacanaṃ śrutvā mṛgī śokasamākulā |
satyāṃ pratijñāṃ vidadhe vyādhasyāgre punaḥ punaḥ ||
mṛgy uvāca |
kṣatriyas tu raṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃgrāmād yo nivartate |
tena pāpena lipsyāmi yady aham anṛtaṃ vade ||
paradravyaratā nityaṃ māyāvanto 'nupāsakāḥ |
bhedayanti taḍāgāni vāpīnāñ ca gavām api |
mārgaṃ sthānaṃ ca ye ghnanti sarvasattvabhayaṃkarāḥ ||
parityajati sanmārgaṃ paśūn bhṛtyāṃs tathaiva ca |
brāhmaṇān nindate yaś ca tathaivāśramanindakaḥ ||
tena pāpena lipyāmi tad vai tad anṛtaṃ vade |
ākarṇyetthaṃ vacas tena muktā mā tatkṣaṇāt priye ||
jalaṃ pītvā gatā sāpi adṛṣṭaḥ so 'bhavat tadā |
jātimadhyasthitasyāpi (?) dvitīyapraharo gataḥ ||
pīḍitas tīvraśītena kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ |
[103]        śivaṃ śivaṃ prajalpan vai na nidrām upalabdhavān ||
kṛtaṃ śivārcanaṃ tena dvitīye prahare 'pi ca |
vīkṣate sa diśaḥ sarvā jīvanārthaṃ varānane ||
saubhāgyabaladarpāḍhyo mṛgas tāvat samāgataḥ |
bāṇaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ dṛṣṭvā maurvyām āśu nyayojayat ||
ākarṇāntaṃ dhanur nāmya hṛṣṭatuṣṭena cetasā |
yāvan muñcati bāṇaṃ sa tāvad dṛṣṭo mṛgeṇa vai ||
kālarūpaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgaś cintāṃ parāṃ yayau ||
niścitaṃ bhavitā mṛtyur yadi pādo vicālyate |
bhāryā prāṇasamā caiva vyādhenaiva nipātitā ||
tayā parahitasyāpi mama mṛtyur bhaviṣyati |
hā kālavikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yad bhāryā duḥkham āgatā ||
na hi bhāryāsamaṃ saukhyaṃ gṛha vāpi vane 'pi vā |
tayā vinā na dharmo hi nārthakāmo viśeṣataḥ ||
vṛkṣamūle 'pi dayitā yatra tiṣṭhati tad gṛham |
prāsādo 'pi tayā hīnaḥ kāntārād atiricyate ||
dharmārthakāmakāryeṣu puṃsāṃ bhāryā sahāyanī |
videśagamane cāpi saiva viśvāsakāriṇī ||
nāsti bhāryāsamo bandhur nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ sukham |
nāsti bhāryāsamaṃ loke narasyārtasya bheṣajam ||
yasya bhāryā gṛhe nāsti sādhvī ca priyavādinī |
tenāraṇyaṃ na gantavyaṃ yathāraṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ||
tayā vinā jīvato 'pi niṣphalaṃ mama jīvitam |
[104]        ekā prāṇasamā me 'bhūd dvitīyā pramadā mama ||
bhāryā virahitasyādya jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ mama |
evaṃ saṃcintya śanakair lubdhakaṃ vākyam abravīt ||
śṛṇu vyādha mahāsattva āmiṣāhāraniścaya |
tvāṃ hi pṛcchāmi kiṃcid vai satyaṃ kathaya susphuṭam ||
āyāntaṃ hariṇīyugmaṃ kena mārgeṇa tad gatam |
tvayā vināśitaṃ naiva satyaṃ kathaya me 'grataḥ ||
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā lubdhakaś cāpi cintayat (?) |
asāv api na sāmānyo devatā kāpi vidyate ||
dhyātveti sattvaṃ tasyāgre lubdhako vākyam abravīt |
te gate 'nena mārgeṇa pratijñāya mamāgrataḥ (?) ||
tābhyāṃ datto bhojanārthaṃ mama tvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
adhunā tvāṃ haniṣyāmi na hi mokṣāmi karhicit ||
vyādhoktaṃ hi vacaḥ śrutvā hariṇaḥ prāha satvaram |
tat satyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vyādha tābhyām uktaṃ tavāgrataḥ ||
yena te pratyayo jātas tanmuktaṃ hariṇīdvayam |
vyādhena kathitāḥ sarve ye kṛtāḥ śapathāḥ purā ||
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā hariṇo hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
vyādhaṃ prāha tataḥ śīghraṃ vacanaṃ dharmasaṃhitam ||
mṛga uvāca |
tābhyāṃ yad uktaṃ bho vyādha tat satyaṃ hi bhavet mama |
prabhāte tvadgṛhaṃ nyūnam āgamiṣyāmi hiṃsaka ||
bhāryā ṛtumato me 'dya kāmārtāpi ca sāṃpratam |
[105]        gatvā gṛhe 'dya tāṃ bhuktvā anujñāpya suhṛjjanam ||
śapathair āgamiṣyāmi tvadgehaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
na maddehe 'sty asṛṅmāṃsaṃ yat tvaṃ bhoktum īpsasi ||
tad vṛthā maraṇaṃ me syād yadi māṃ tvaṃ haniṣyasi |
tan mṛgasya vacaḥ śrutvā vyādho vacanam abravīt ||
vyādha uvāca |
asatyaṃ bhāṣase dhūrta pratārayasi mām iha |
jñātā mṛtyuḥ sphuṭaṃ yatra tatra gacchati kalpadhīḥ ||
vyādhasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vākyaṃ prāha varaṃ mṛgaḥ |
śapathān vai kariṣyāmi yathā te pratyayo hṛdi ||
vyādha uvāca |
mama tvaṃ śapathān brūhi viśvāso yena jāyate |
yathā hi preṣayāmi tvāṃ svagṛhaṃ prati kāmuka ||
mṛga uvāca |
bhartāraṃ vañcayed yā strī svāminaṃ vañcayen naraḥ |
mitraṃ vañcayate yas tu gurudrohaṃ karoti yaḥ ||
tena pāpena lipyāmi yad etad anṛtaṃ vade |
bhedayed yas tu mitrāṇi pramādaṃ śrāvayet tu yaḥ ||
viṣamaṃ tu rasaṃ dadyād ekapaṅktyāṃ hi bhuñjatām |
tena pāpena lipyāmi yad etad anṛtaṃ vade ||
pravāsaśīlā ye viprāḥ krayavikrayakāriṇaḥ |
saṃdhyāsnānavihīnāś ca vedaśāstravivarjitāḥ ||
[106]        madyapastrīsamāsaktāḥ paranindāratās tathā |
parastrīsevakā nityaṃ parapauśunyasūcakāḥ ||
śūdrānnabhojakāś caiva rasavikrayakārakāḥ |
tena pāpena lipyāmi nāyāmi yadi te gṛham ||
madyādyaṃ vikrayed yas tu śūdrālobhavimohitaḥ |
sarvāśī sarvavikretā viprāṇām api nindakāḥ ||
vipravākyaṃ parityajya pāṣaṇḍābhiratas tathā |
tena pāpena lipyāmi yadi nāyāti te gṛham ||
gāṃ yaḥ spṛśati pādena udite 'rke prabudhyate |
ekākī miṣṭam aśnāti vikarmaṇi tathā rataḥ ||
mātāpitror abhaktaś ca kriyām uddiśya pācakaḥ |
kanyāśulkopajīvī ca devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ ||
eteṣāṃ pātakaṃ sahyaṃ yadi nāyāni te gṛham |
yaḥ paṭhet svarahīnaṃ ca lakṣaṇena vivarjitam ||
rathyāṃ paryaṭamānas tu vedam udgirate yadi |
paṭhamānasya viprasya cāṇḍālaḥ śṛṇute yadi ||
tena pāpena vilipyāmi yadi nāyāmi te gṛham |
veśyāratāḥ sadā ye ca devadāyanivārakāḥ ||
teṣāṃ pāpena lipyāmi yadi nāyāmi te gṛham |
śūdrānneṣu sadā saktāḥ śūdrasaṃparkadūṣitāḥ ||
saṃdhyābhraṣṭā ca ye viprā dātṛdānanivārakāḥ |
teṣāṃ pāpena lipyāmi yadi nāyāmi te gṛham ||
bhartāram arthahīnaṃ ca kurūpaṃ vyādhipīḍitam |
[107]        yā na pūjayate nārī rūpayauvanagarvitā |
tasyāḥ pāpena lipyāmi yadi nāyāmi te gṛham ||
atha kiṃ bahunoktena bho lubdhaka tavāgrataḥ |
yadi nāyāmi te gehaṃ mamāsatyaṃ bhavet tadā ||
tena vākyena saṃtuṣṭo vyādho vai vītakalmaṣaḥ |
saṃhṛtya bāṇaṃ dhanuṣo mṛgaṃ muktvā vanaṃ prati ||
jagāma prītamanasā muktapāpo varānane |
jalaṃ pītvātha hariṇaḥ praviṣṭo gahanaṃ vanam ||
gato 'sau tena mārgeṇa yenāyātaṃ mṛgīdvayam |
lubdhakena tadā tatra jālimadhye sthitena hi ||
chitvā bilvasya patrāṇi nikṣiptāni śivopari |
ajñānāc chivapūjā tu kṛtā tena tathā vratam ||
bruvan śivaśivaṃ so 'tha niḥsṛto jālimadhyataḥ |
udite sūryabimbe tu ajñānāj jāgare kṛte ||
pāpān mukto 'bhavad vyādhaḥ śivarātriprabhāvataḥ |
yāvan nirīkṣate dikṣu niśānte bhojanaṃ prati ||
tāvac chiśuvṛtā cānyā mṛgī tatra samāgatā |
dṛṣṭvā mṛgīṃ tathā vyādho bāṇaṃ dhanuṣi sandadhe ||
yāvan muñcati bāṇaṃ sa tāvad dhovāca (?) taṃ mṛgī |
mṛgy uvāca |
mā bāṇaṃ muñca dharmātman dharmaṃ pālaya suvrata |
aham avadhyā sarveṣāṃ sarvaśāstranidarśanam ||
śayānaṃ maithuāsaktaṃ madanavyādhipīḍitam |
[108]        na hi hanti mṛgaṃ rājā mṛgīṃ ca śiśunāvṛtām ||
atha tvaṃ dharmam utsṛjya māṃ vidhiṣyasi mānada |
bālakān hi gṛhe tyaktvā āgamiṣyāmy ahaṃ punaḥ ||
yā bhartāraṃ samutsṛjya parapuṃsi ratā bhavet |
tasyāḥ pāpena lipyāmi yadi nāyāmite gṛham ||
ye kṛtāḥ śayathāḥ pūrvaṃ tavāgre vyādhasattama |
te sarve mama santy atra yadi nāyāmy ahaṃ punaḥ ||
vyādhena sā tadā muktā jagāma nijamandiram |
vyādho 'pi tat śaraṃ tyaktvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati ||
sarveṣāṃ vacanaṃ dhyāyan mṛgāṇāṃ satyavādinām |
eteṣāṃ ghātako nityam ahaṃ yāsyāmi kāṃ gatim ||
evaṃ saṃcintayan gehe dṛṣṭāḥ kṣuditabālakāḥ |
nirāmiṣaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagmus te 'pi nirāśatām (?) ||
nānnaṃ māṃsaṃ gṛhe tasya bhojanaṃ yena jāyate |
vyādho 'pi sa tadā tatra teṣāṃ vākyāni saṃsmaran ||
na bhojanaṃ ca nidrāṃ ca labhate vismayānvitaḥ |
āgamiṣyanti te nūnaṃ śapathair atiyantritāḥ ||
tān ahaṃ nihaniṣyāmi satāṃ vratam anusmaran |
lubdhakena tadā mukto mṛgo 'sau śapathaiḥ kṛtaiḥ ||
svāśramaṃ cāśu saṃprāpto yatra tad dhariṇīdvayam |
sadyaḥ prasūtā tatraikā dvitīyā ratilālasā ||
tṛtīyāpi samāyātā bālakaiḥ parivāritā |
[109]        sarvāḥ sametā ekatra maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ |
paraspareṇa jalpanti lubdhakasya viceṣṭitam ||
tato mṛgīm ṛtumatīṃ bhuktā vākyaṃ vṛgo 'vravīt |
sthātavyam atra yuṣmābhiḥ kartavyaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam ||
vyāghradvipāt lubdhakebhyo bālakānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam |
aham atra samāyātaḥ śapathair atiyantritaḥ ||
asyā ṛtupradānāya punaḥsantānahetave |
ṛtumatīṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ naiva seveta mohiyaḥ ||
bhrūṇahatyā bhaet tasya dharmaś caiva nirarthakaḥ |
santānāt svargam āpnoti iha kīrtiṃ ca śāśvatīm ||
santatir yatnataḥ pālyā svargasaukhyapradāyakā |
aputrasya gatir nāsti svargo naiva ca naiva ca ||
yena kenāpy upāyena putram utpādayet pumān |
mayā tatraiva gantavyaṃ yatra vyādhasya mandiram ||
satyaṃ tu pālanīyaṃ syāt satye dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
tās tad bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā procur dharmayutaṃ vacaḥ ||
asmākaṃ pāraṇaṃ ślāghyaṃ bhartā (bhartrā ?) saha mṛga prabho |
vayam apy āgamiṣyāmas tvayā sārdhaṃ mṛgottama ||
tathā te vipriyaṃ kānta na smarāmaḥ kadācana |
puṣpiteṣu vanānteṣu nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ||
kandareṣu ca śailānām avatāram itā vayam |
na kāryam apy ataḥ kānta jīvitena vinā tvayā ||
na dīnāṃ patihīnānāṃ jīvitaṃ niṣprayojanam |
[110]        mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ bhrātā mitaṃ sutaḥ ||
amitasya hi dātāraṃ bhratāraṃ kā na pūjayet |
api dravyayutā nārī bahuputrasuhṛdvṛtā ||
śocyā sā bandhuvargasya patihīnā kuraṅgama |
vaidhavyasadṛśaṃ duḥkhaṃ strīṇām anyan na vidyate ||
dhanyās tā yoṣito yās tu mriyante bhartur agrataḥ |
nātantrī vādyate vīṇā nācakro vāhyate rathaḥ ||
nāpatiḥ pūjyate nārī api putraśatair vṛtā |
nidhano vyasanī vṛddho vyādhito vihvalas tathā ||
patitaḥ kṛpaṇo vāpi bhartā strīṇāṃ sadā gatiḥ |
nāsti bhartṛsamo dharmo nāsti bhartāsamaḥ suhṛt ||
nāsti bhartāsamo nāthaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartā gatiḥ parā |
evaṃ vilapya tāḥ sarvā maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ ||
bālakais tāḥ samāyuktā bhartṛśokena pīḍitāḥ |
tāsāṃ vākyaṃ mṛgaḥ śrutvā hṛdi cintāparo 'bhavat ||
sarvathāpi hi gantavyaṃ mayā vyādhasya saṃnidhau |
sarvataḥ satyasaṃrakṣā kuṭumbasya kṣayo 'nyataḥ ||
yadi gacchāmi tatrāhaṃ kuṭumbasya kṣayo bhavet |
no vā prayāmi tatrāhaṃ mama satyaṃ vrajet punaḥ ||
varaṃ putrasya maraṇaṃ bhāryāyā ātmanas tathā |
satyalopān naro nūnaṃ sṛṣṭyantaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
tasmāt satyaṃ pālanīyaṃ naraiḥ śreyo'rthibhiḥ sadā |
satyena dhāryate pṛthvī satyena tapate raviḥ ||
[111]        satyena vāyavo yānti satye na vardhate parm |
evaṃ saṃcintya sa mṛto dharmān hṛdi manoharān ||
tābhiḥ saha kuraṅgībhir āśramāt tatkṣaṇam yayau |
tasmin sarasi snātvā tu karmanyāsaṃ cakāra ha ||
tac ca liṅgaṃ namaskṛtya hṛdi dhyāyan śivaṃ śivam |
snānaṃ pānaṃ parityajya maithunaṃ bhogam eva ca ||
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ māyāṃ mokṣavināśinīm |
khādyapeyādikaṃ caiva lubdhakābhimukho yayau ||
tasya bhāryā tathā putrāḥ pṛṣṭhalagnāḥ vrajanti vai |
anāśakaṃ paraṃ gṛhya maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ ||
bhāryāputraiḥ parivṛto mṛgas taṃ deśam āgataḥ |
kṣudhito bālakair yukto lubdhako yatra tiṣṭhati ||
mṛgas taṃ deśam āgatya kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ |
pālayan satyavākyāni lubdhakaṃ vākyam abravīt ||
mṛga uvāca |
hanyā mām prathamaṃ vyādha paścād bhāryāḥ krameṇa tu |
bālakāni tataḥ paścād vadhyantāṃ (?) mā vilambaya ||
mṛgāṇāṃ bakṣaṇād vyādha na te doṣo 'sti kaścana |
yāsyāmaḥ svargaṃ vai sarve śastrapūtā na saṃśayaḥ ||
tavāpi sakuṭumbasya prāṇayātrā bhaviṣyati |
etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ mṛgoktaṃ lubdhakas tadā ||
ātmānaṃ nindayitvā tu hariṇaṃ vākyam abravīt |
[112]                vyādha uvāca |
aho mṛga mahāsattva gaccha gaccha svam ālayam |
āmiṣeṇa na me kāryaṃ yad bhāvyaṃ tad bhaviṣyati ||
sattvānāṃ hi vadhāt pāpaṃ tarjane bandhane tathā |
naiva pāpaṃ kariṣyāmi kuṭumbārthe kathaṃcana ||
dharmānāṃ ca dayā mūlaṃ satyaṃ śākhā phalaṃ damam |
tvaṃ gurur mama dharmāṇām upadeṣṭā hi sāṃpratam ||
gaccha gaccha kuraṅga tvaṃ kuṭumbena samanvitaḥ |
nyastāni tu mayāstrāṇi satyadharmam āśritaḥ ||
tad vyādhavacanaṃ śrutvā hariṇaḥ prāha taṃ punaḥ |
karmanyāsam ahaṃ kṛtvā tvatsakāśam ihāgataḥ ||
hanyatāṃ hanyatāṃ śīdhraṃ na te pāpaṃ bhaviṣyati |
mayā dattā purā vācā tayā vaddho marāmy aham ||
mayā mama kuṭumbena tyaktalobhaḥ svajīvane |
etac chrutvā ca vacanaṃ lubdhako vākyam abravīt ||
tvaṃ gurur tvaṃ pitā mātā tvaṃ me bandhuḥ sakhā suhṛt |
mayā tyajyāni śastrāṇi tyājya māyādikaṃ balam ||
kasya bhāryā sutaḥ kasya kuṭumbaṃ kasya he mṛga |
tais taiḥ svadharmaṃ bhoktavyaṃ mṛgaṃ gaccha yathāsukham ||
ity uktvā lubdhakas tūrṇaṃ muktvā cāpaṃ śaraiḥ saha |
mṛgān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskṛtya kṣamāpayet ||
procur vyādhaṃ puras tatra vacaḥ pīpūṣasaṃnibham |
[113]        etasminn antare nedur devadundubhayo divi ||
ākāśāt puṣpavṛṣṭiś ca babhūva sumanoharā |
devadūtāḥ samāyātā vimānaṃ guhyaśobhanam ||
devadūta uvāca |
aho vyādha mahāsattva sarvasattvabhayaṃkara |
vimānavaram āruhya sadehas trivaṃ vraja ||
śivarātriprabhāvena pātakaṃ te kṣayaṃ gatam |
upavāsaś ca saṃjātas tathā vai niśi jāgaraḥ ||
yāme yāme kṛtā pūjā ajñānāt tu śivasya ca |
sarvapāpavinirmukto gaccha tvaṃ rudramandiram ||
mṛgarāj mahāsattva sarvabhāryāsamanvitaḥ |
bhāryādvitayasaṃyukto nākṣatraṃ padam āpnuhi ||
tava nāmnā trayaṃ ṛkṣaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati |
etac chrutvā tu vacanaṃ lubdhako 'tha mṛgās tathā ||
vimānāni samāruhya nākṣatraṃ padam āgatāḥ |
hariṇīdvayamārgas tu dṛśyate 'dyāpi pārvati ||
tatpṛṣṭhalagnatārāṇāṃ dvitayaṃ maṇisaṃnibham |
ṛkṣaṃ lubdhakanāmnā tu dṛśyate dotanaṃ śubham ||
tārātritayasaṃyuktaṃ mṛgaśīrṣaṃ tad ucyate |
bālakadvitaraṃ cāgre tṛtīyā pṛṣṭhato mṛgī ||
pṛṣṭhatas tatra saṃprāptā mārgaśīrṣasya saṃnidhau |
mṛgarāṭ dṛśyate 'dyāpi ṛkṣaṃ vyomagam uttamam ||
[114]        akāmāj jāgaraṃ rātrau tathopoṣaṇapūjanam |
jātaṃ lubdhakarājasya tatphalaṃ parivarṇitam ||
ye narā bhaktibhāvena śivarātrivrataṃ śubham |
sopavāsaṃ kariṣyanti jāgareṇa samanvitam ||
teṣāṃ phalaṃ hi vai vaktuṃ brahmāpi ca jaḍāyate |
śivarātrisamaṃ nāsti vrataṃ pāpabhayāpaham ||
yat kṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
yat phalaṃ māghamāse vai prayāge majjatāṃ nṛṇām ||
vaiśākhe dvārakāyāṃ tu tapasyāṣāḍhasevanāt |
gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena kārtike māghavāgrataḥ |
tat phalaṃ jāyate nūnaṃ śravaṇād eva pārvati ||
iti śrīliṅgapurāṇe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde
śivarātrivratamāhātmyam |
ṛṣaya ūcuhuḥ |
śivarātrir iti khyātā kasmin kāle tu sā bhavet |
kiṃphalā kiṃvidhānā sā tattvaṃ no vistarād vada ||
sūta uvāca |
māghasya kṛṣṇapakṣīyatithiś caiva caturdaśī |
tasyā rātriḥ samākhyātā śivarātrir iti dvijāḥ ||
[115]        tasyāṃ sarveṣu liṅgeṣu sadā saṃkramate haraḥ |
viśeṣād amaraiḥ sarvaiḥ khyātā sevaṃ kaṇeśvare ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
śivarātriḥ kathaṃ jātā kena vāpi vinirmitā |
kasmād bahuphalā seti sarvaṃ vai vistarād vada ||
sūta uvāca |
kathayiṣyāmi pūrvaṃ tat pūrvavṛttaṃ kathānakam |
bhartṛyajñasya saṃvādam aśvasenasya bhūpateḥ ||
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvam aśvasena iti smṛtaḥ |
āsīd dharmaparo nityaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||
bhartṛyajñaḥ purā tena idaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ kutūhalāt |
kalikālaṃ samudvīkṣya vardhamānaṃ dine dine (?) ||
bhartṛsena uvāca |
kalikāle kṛte kiṃcid vrataṃ me vada sanmune |
khalāyāṃ saṅgajaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
atyāyuṣaḥ sadā martyā pūtāḥ kṛtayuge purā |
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kiṃ tu prāptau kalau yuge ||
tasmād varṣavrataṃ tyaktvā kiṃcid aikāhikaṃ vada |
śvaḥ kāryam adya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam ||
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vāsya na vā kṛtam |
[116]        tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā bartṛyajña udāradhīḥ ||
abravīt suciraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā |
asti rājan vrataṃ puṇyaṃ śivarātrīti saṃjñitam ||
ekāhnikaṃ mahārāja sarvapātakanāśanam |
tasyāṃ yad dīyate dānaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tathaiva ca ||
sarvam akṣayatāṃ yāti rātrijāgaraṇe kṛte |
aputro labhate putrān adhano dhanam āpnuyāt ||
svalpāyur dīrgham āyuṣyaṃ śatrūṇāṃ caiva saṃkṣayam |
yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāya vratam etat samācaret ||
taṃ taṃ samāpnuyān martyo niṣkāmo muktim āpnuyāt |
tathā varṣakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
paṭhanād ekacittena yadi kuryāt prajāgaram |
yāni kāny atra liṅgāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca |
sa ca saṃkramate devas tasyāṃ rātrau yato haraḥ ||
śivarātris tataḥ proktā tena sā haravallabhā |
prārthitaḥ sa suraiḥ sarvair lokānugrahakāmyayā ||
bhagavan kalikāle 'smin sarvapāpasamanvitaḥ |
varṣapāpavimuktyarthaṃ vināyakaṃ kṣitau vratam ||
etayā pūjayā pūtā martyāḥ śuddhim avāpnuyuḥ |
tato dattaṃ hutaṃ vaiṣām asmākam upatiṣṭhate ||
yathocchiṣṭaiś ca yad dattaṃ tad dattāj jāyate 'khilaṃ |
kalikālena cāsmākaṃ kiṃcid evopatiṣṭhati ||
yat kiṃcin mānavair dattaṃ prabhūtam api śaṅkaram ||
[117]                bhagavān uvāca |
māghamāsasya kṛṣṇāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sureśvara |
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhūmiṣṭho rātrau naiva divā kalau ||
liṅgeṣu ca samasteṣu caleṣu sthāvareṣu ca |
prapūjayet saṃpadicchuḥ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ||
tasyāṃ rātrau hi me pūjāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ |
mantrair etaiḥ suraśreṣṭha vipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati ||
oṃ sadyāya namaḥ | oṃ vāmāya namaḥ | oṃ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ | oṃ īśānāya namaḥ |
pañcavaktrāṇi saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ |
vastrair dīpena naivedyais tato 'rghyaṃ ca pradāpayet ||
mantreṇānena madbhakto māṃ dhyātvā manasi sthitam |
gaurīvallabha deveśa sarpādyaiḥ śiśikeśaraḥ ||
varṣapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ argho me pratigṛhyatām |
tataḥ saṃpūjayed vipraṃ bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ ||
datvā pradakṣiṇāṃ tasmai vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
tato jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
dharmākhyānakathābhiś ca jalāsyais tāṇḍavais tathā |
evaṃ kariṣyate yo 'tra vratam etat sureśvara ||
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tac chrutvā tridaśāḥ sarve praṇamya śaśiśekharam ||
saṃprahṛṣṭā nṛpaśreṣṭhāḥ (?) svāni sthānāni bhejire |
[118]        preṣayām āsur ūrvyāṃ vai nāradaṃ munisattamam ||
prabodhanāya lokānāṃ śivarātirkṛte tadā |
so 'pi gatvā dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ śrāvayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||
śivarātres tu māhātmyaṃ yad uktaṃ śūlapāṇinā |
tataḥ prabhṛti saṃjñāta śivarātrir dharātale ||
sarvakāmapradā puṇyā sarvaghātakanāśinī |
tatra te kīrtayiṣyāmi purāvṛttāṃ kathāṃ varām ||
yad vṛttaṃ naimiṣāraṇye lubdhakasyātra kasyacit |
tatrāsīl lubdhakaḥ kaścij jātimātrā na karmataḥ ||
vyasanenābhibhūto 'yaṃ paravittāpahārakaḥ |
na kadācid vrataṃ tena na dattaṃ na japaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
kevalaṃ tu hṛtaṃ vittaṃ lokānāṃ chalasaṃśrayāt |
kasyacit tv atha kālasya śivarātriḥ samāgatā ||
māghamāse 'site pakṣe sarvapātakanāśinī |
tatrāsty āyatanaṃ puṇyaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ ||
tato jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prārabdham abhito janaiḥ |
nārībhir naraśārdūla bhūṣitābhiḥ subhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
asthāsau cintayāmāsa cauro vittena jāgaraḥ |
gacchāmi yadi kācit strī bhūṣaṇaiḥ paribhūṣitā ||
nidritā vā hy ataḥ śvāśya pravāsād upayāmy aham |
tato hatvā samādāya bhūṣaṇāni vrajāmy aham ||
evaṃ niścitya manasā gatas tasya samīpataḥ |
karṇikāraṃ samāruhya sthito guptas tato hi saḥ ||
[119]        vīkṣyamāṇo diśaḥ sarvā nārī niṣkramaṇodbhavā |
cauryakarmapravṛttasya śītārtasya viśeṣataḥ ||
svalpāpi nidritā yātā na ca nārīti nirgatā |
tasyādhastāt tato liṅgam avadhūtaṃ harodbhavam ||
etasminn eva kāle tu prodgatas tīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ |
asatāṃ caiva caurāṇāṃ kāmināṃ vimukhāvaḥ ||
tato narāś ca nāryaś ca jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam |
umayā taṃ paraṃ śāntaṃ praṇipatya maheśvaram ||
so 'pi cauro nirāśaś ca kṣutkṣāmaḥ śītavihvalaḥ |
avavarya (?) drumāt tasmād dharmāgniḥ kvacid āsate ||
tataḥ kālena mahatā pañcatvaṃ samapadyata |
jāto jātismaro bhūtvā darpaṇādhipater gṛhe ||
upavāsaprabhāvena tasyāṃ rātrau prajāgarāt |
śivarātres tathā tasya liṅgasyāpi prapūjanāt ||
tato rājyaṃ samāsādya pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat |
kārayāmāsa liṅgasya prāsādaṃ tasya śodhanam ||
varṣe varṣe samāgatya śivarātryāṃ prajāgarāt |
upavāsaparo bhūtvā gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
dharmākhyānakathābhiś ca sāmadhvanibhir eva ca |
netraiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ saṃpūjya arghyaṃ datvā vidhānataḥ ||
saṃtarpya brāhmaṇān kāmair jagāma viṣayaṃ jinam |
kasyacit tv atha kālasya śivarātriḥ samāgatā |
[120]        prāsāde tatra munayaḥ prāptāḥ śāṇḍilyapūrvakāḥ ||
śāṇḍilyo 'tha bharadvājo javakrītaś ca jālavaḥ |
pulastyaḥ pulaho gārgyas tathāny bahavo nṛpāḥ ||
so 'pi rājā bṛhatseno daśāśādhipateḥ sutaḥ |
saṃprāpto jāgaraṃ kartuṃ tasya liṅgasya cāgrataḥ ||
pūjayitvā tato devaṃ praṇipatya munīṃś ca tān |
upaviṣṭhas tataś cāgre anujñāto dvijottamaiḥ ||
nṛtyaṃs tasyāyataś cakṣuḥ kathābahuvidho nṛpa |
rājarṣīṇām atītānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
atha tasmin kathayati taiḥ pṛṣṭo brahmavādibhiḥ |
kautukāviṣṭacittaiś ca vismayotpullalocanaiḥ ||
rājan pṛcchāmi he sarve vayaṃ kautūhalānvitāḥ |
yadi bravīṣi naḥ satyaṃ devatāyatane sthitaḥ ||
rājovāca |
yadi jñāsyāmi viprendrāḥ kathayiṣyāmy asaṃśayam |
devasyāgre tu saṃpūjya satyenātmānam ālabhe ||
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
sulabhāni parityajya kasmād dhāmāny anekaśaḥ |
jāgaraṃ kartukāmo 'tra hā deśād upathiṣṭhasi ||
varṣe varṣe sadā prāpte nūnaṃ tvaṃ vetsi kāraṇam |
rahasyaṃ yadi te na syāt tad bravīhi narādhipa |
savilakṣyaṃ smitaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prāha sudurmanāḥ ||
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hy etad avācyaṃ hi dvijottamāḥ |
[121]        tathāpi vedapiṣyāmi aśvadevāgrato yataḥ ||
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa pūrvadehasamudbhavam |
malimlu ca naro nūnaṃ vṛttāntaṃ hi narādhipa ||
cauryabhāvena devasya pūjanaṃ jāgaras tathā |
upavāsaṃ vinā tena śivarātrau purābhavat ||
jātismaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ teṣāṃ sarvaṃ yathātatham |
kathayāmāsa bhūpālo vṛttāntaṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ ||
tatas te munayaḥ sarve sādhuvādān pṛthagvidhān |
nṛpottamasya rājarṣer daśāśīrbhiḥ (?) samanvitān ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā jagmus te ca tathāśramam |
so 'pi rājā samabhyarcya tadaiva tān dvijottamān ||
jagāma svapuraṃ paścāt kṛtvā rātriprajāgaram ||
bhartṛyajña uvāca |
śivarātriḥ samutpannā evaṃ bhūmitale nṛpa |
evaṃvidhaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ tasyāste parikalpitam ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kāryā sā nṛpasattama |
kalikāle viśeṣeṇa yadīcched bhūtim ātmanaḥ ||
eṣā kṛtā viṣṇupena nalena nahuṣeṇa ca |
māndhātrā dhundhumāreṇa sagareṇa yuyutsunā ||
tathānye ca mahīpālāḥ samyak śraddhāsamanvitāḥ (?) |
prāptāś ca īpsitān kāmān nṛpo dviyāya cakṣuṣā ||
satyavatā ca sāvitrā (?) śriyā devyā ca sītayā |
arundhatyā sarasvatyā panayā rambhayā tathā ||
[122]        indrāṇyā ca vṛṣāṇyā ca svadhayā svāhayā tathā |
ratyā prītyā prabhāvatyā gāyatryā ca nṛpottama ||
sarve prāptāḥ parān kāmān atisaubhāgyasaṃyutān |
yaś caitāḥ śṛṇuyād vāpi paṭhed vā śivasaṃnidhau ||
dinajāt pātakāt so 'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
nāsti gaṅgāsamaṃ toyaṃ nāsti devo haropamaḥ ||
śivarātrisamaṃ nāsti vrataṃ satyaṃ mayoditam |
sarvaratnamayo meruḥ sarvāścaryasamannabhaḥ (?) ||
sarvadharmamayī rājan śivarātriḥ prakīrtitā |
garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ yadvat nadīnāṃ sāgaro yathā |
pradhānā sarvadharmāṇāṃ śivarātris tathottamā ||
iti skandhapurāṇīye nāgarakhaṇḍe śivarātrivratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
caturdaśīṃ mahārāja gatam uddhriyate sadā |
naṣṭas tadā havyavāhaḥ punar astitvam āpnuyāt ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
katham agniḥ purā naṣto devakārye hy upasthitaḥ |
kenāgnitaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra kathaṃ hi viditaṃ tava ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā surā mahārāja tārekeṇa parājitāḥ |
apṛcchan viśvakartāraṃ tārakaṃ ko vidhiṣyati ||
[123]        uvācāsau ciraṃ dhyātvā rudro māsaktisaṃbhavaḥ (?) |
gaṅgā svāhāgnitejobhyaḥ (?) śiśur daityaṃ vadhiṣyati ||
evaṃ śrutvā grahā devā yatra śambhuḥ sahomayā |
praṇamya te tam ūcur hi yad uktaṃ brahmaṇā tadā ||
atipannaṃ (?) ca rudreṇa umayā sahito nataḥ |
prayatnam akarot tac ca yad uktam amaraiḥ stutaḥ |
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tataḥ kālo 'tha maithune |
na cāpy uparamas tatra tatorastāt (?) kathaṃcana ||
bhayaṃ ca sumahat teṣāṃ (?) devānāṃ samajāyata |
rudromāsambavo yo vai bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ||
sa daityān dānavagaṇān vadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
kena kālena bhavati retoviratiretayoḥ (?) ||
etad vicintya prahitau devais tatrānilānalau |
gatau tau vāṃ mayā dṛṣṭau samastau viṣamas tathā ||
aśapac ca ruṣā devī devaiḥ sārdhaṃ vivarjitā |
yasmān me janitaṃ viprabhayaṃ hy atidivaukasām (?) ||
athovāca tadā devādevān sarvagaṇān śanaiḥ |
agniṃ gṛhṇātu vīryaṃ me sabhṛtaṃ suciraṃ hi yat ||
evam ukto 'tha rudreṇa naṣṭo 'gnir devasaṅkulāt |
na svastho na bhuvistho vā na sūryastho na bhūtale ||
devatāyatane yatnaṃ na kurtsānn (?) agnigharśanam |
krimikīṭapataṅgāś ca tvapṛṣṭau tridivaukasām |
haṃ ho kekāḥ śuka barhiḥ śīghra śaṅkhagaṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
[124]        śaśāpāgnir dvirjihvā hi dviguṇā vo bhaviṣyati |
pṛṣṭvā tu vibudhā sarvaṃ patriṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ varam ||
jīvaṃjīvakanāmānaṃ bhānoḥ satyaṃ vadasva naḥ |
kvacid dṛṣṭas tvayā vahnir vane 'sminn aṭatā sadā ||
na bhadraṃ nāpy abhadraṃ vā kiṃcid eva vaco 'bravīt |
bhūyo bhūyas tu pṛṣṭo 'pi nānyām uccārayed giram ||
tuṣṭas tasyābravīd vahniś ciraṃjīva vadāmi te |
yasmān na kiṃcid uktaṃ te tasmāc citratanūruhaḥ ||
jīva jīva punar jīva yāvad icchā tathāyuṣaḥ |
dvitīyaṃ te varaṃ dadmi jīvajīvaka śobhanam ||
vyaktā te mānuṣī vācā spaṣṭārthā (?) ca bhaviṣyati |
kaścid yaditta (?) bādhas tādbudhaḥ (?) snānaṃ kariṣyati ||
śahyācāṣoḍośān (?) dīpaḥ kṣaṇād bālo bhaviṣyati |
māṃsaṃ yaś ca tṛtīyaṃ vai bhakṣayiṣyati ninditam ||
ajaraḥ so 'maraś caiva sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati |
idaṃ datvā varaṃ tasya vahnitvam atha āptavān ||
vibudhā api tatraiva tam apaśyan na vaṃśagam |
utpādya jātakarmādyaṃ śāstrasaṃdṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||
tuṣṭā vaṃśam athocus te devās tribhuvaneśvaram |
ūṣmayākalmaṣībhūtvā agnigarbhān variṣyati ||
ye 'graṃ hi vaiṇavī yaṣṭiḥ brahmacārī ca naiṣṭhikaḥ |
yac cāgnipālane puṇyaṃ yadvaṣṭaṃ (?) brahmacāribhiḥ ||
[125]        vahataḥ kalmaṣīṃ yaṣṭiṃ taṃ prāpnoti dvijottamaḥ |
vaṃśasyānugrahaṃ kṛtvā dekāhutim (?) athābruvan ||
gṛhṇīta śulkaṃ bhadrasya tava putro bhaviṣyati |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yadāgnir naṣṭo devānāṃ kenāgnitvaṃ tadā kṛtam |
bhūyo 'pi kena kālena agnir agnitam āpnuyāt ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
trirātraṃ vipra naṣṭo 'gnir yenāgnitvaṃ kadācana |
yasmin kāle tithau yasyāṃ punar agnitvam āpnuyāt |
utathyāṅgirasoḥ pūrvam āsīd vyatikaromahān ||
ahaṃ vidyātapobhyāṃ vai na ca jyāyān sute na ca |
utathyenaivam uktas ta aṅgirā prāha taṃ munim ||
gaccha vo brahmasadanaṃ marīcipramukhair dvijaiḥ |
upetaś cānymunibhir brahmarājarṣisattamaiḥ ||
utathyaḥ prāha sa brahman tān ṛṣīn taptamānasaḥ |
jyāyān vā katamo 'smākam iti naḥ kathyatāṃ sphuṭam ||
athovāca munir brahmā tāv ubhau kruddhamānasau |
ānaya bahudhā gatvā vibudhān bhuvaneśvarān ||
tato vivāhaṃ paśyāmi bhavatāṃ taiḥ (?) samīkṣya ca |
tatas tau sahitau gatvā ṛṣīn eva samānayet ||
lokapālān mahendrādīn sayamān vāruṇānilān |
sādhyamārudgaṇān viśvān bharadvājātrināradān ||
[126]        gandarvān vittapān yakṣān rākṣasān daityadānavān |
nāyātas tv atra tigmāṃśuḥ sarve cānye samāgatāḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā tu vibudhān sarvān brahmā provāca tān ṛṣīn |
ānayadhvam itas tūrṇaṃ sāmnā (?) daṇḍena vā punaḥ ||
evam muktvā gatas tāvad utathyaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam |
sa gatvā prāha mārtaṇḍaṃ śīghram ehy avasañcidam ||
sa utatthyam athovāca kathaṃ brahman vrajāmy aham |
evam uktvāgataḥ sūryo bhuvaṃ me mayi nirgate ||
evam ukto muniḥ prāyāt svaṃ svaṃ devasabhāgatam |
ācacakṣe ca yat proktaṃ bhāsvatā tapanaṃ prati ||
uvācāṅgirasaṃ brahmā śīghram eva tam ānaya |
sa tvayokto gatas tatra yatrāsau tapate raviḥ ||
ehy ehi bhagavān sūrya utatthyabhavane punaḥ |
evam ukto gataḥ sūryo yatra devāḥ sabhāgatāḥ ||
sthitvā muhūrtaṃ provāca kiṃ vā kāryam upasthitam |
pṛcchantam evaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ brahmā provāca sādaram ||
gaccha śīghraṃ na dahate bhuvanaṃ yāvad aṅgirāḥ |
labdhaṃ prayātuṃ golokaṃ vartate kṛṣṇapiṅgalam ||
pāṭalaṃ haritaṃ śoṇaṃ śvetovaṣaṃ praṇāśitam |
śākadvīpaṃ kuśadvīpaṃ krauñcadvīpaṃ sapattanam ||
dagdham aṅgirasā sarvaṃ bhūyo 'pi pradahiṣyati |
yāvantaṃ dahate sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ tapanāṅgirāḥ ||
[127]        gaccha tāvad itaḥ śīghraṃ svasthānena prabhāskara |
evam uktaḥ savidhunā svasthānam adhirūḍhavān ||
viṣṭivānaṅgisaṅkāśaṃ sakāśaṃ daivataṃ raviḥ |
gatvāṅgirā uvācedaṃ gataṃ kiṃ karavāny ahaṃ ||
vibudhāṅgirasaṃ prāhus taporāśim akalmaṣaṃ |
saṃpraśasyāhur agnitvaṃ kuru tāvan mahītale ||
pūrvaṃ yathāgniḥ kṛtavāṃs tathā tvam api sattama |
yāvad agniṃ praśasyāmi kvāsau naṣṭaḥ kva tiṣṭhati ||
evam uktaḥ sa devais tu agnitvaṃ kṛtavāṃs tadā |
devair dṛṣṭo yathāgniś ca sa me sarvaṃ niveditam ||
devakārye kṛte tasmin devā vahnim athābruvan |
agne 'gnitvaṃ kuruṣva tvam āṅgirasam akalmaṣam ||
uvāca muñca matsthānaṃ vacas toṣākaraṃ śṛṇu |
ahaṃ te tanayaśreṣṭho bhaviṣye prathame mune ||
bṛhaspatīti mānāya tathānye bhavaḥ sutāḥ |
evam ukto munis tuṣto bahūṃś ca janayat sutān ||
vahniṃ so janayāmāsa putrān pautrāṃs tadāṅgirāḥ |
avāpa punaratv (?) agnim agnir asyātitho nṛpa ||
svapan sarvacaturdaśyāṃ saṃjāto havyavāhanaḥ |
havyavāhana devānāṃ bhūtānāṃ gṛhyacāriṇām ||
te teṣv iyaṃ tithis tasmai rudreṇa pratipāditā |
pūjaneyaṃ tithir hetur munibhiḥ pārthivais tathā ||
nalasandhātusanvādyair anyaśānapuṣādibhiḥ (?) |
[128]        priyā sahasrahantṝṇāṃ saṃgrāmeṣv eva kutracit ||
ajñānatithayo ye ca vyālavahnijalāśayāḥ |
svāpadair bhakṣitā ye ca tapanādiṣu ye mṛtāḥ ||
udbandhanikṛtā ye ca śūlādyair avidhānakaiḥ |
teṣāṃ śastacaturdaśyāṃ tadvat svargasukhapradam ||
aniṣṭāv eva (?) daśanidānāni vividhāni ca |
prabhūtaphalabhogyāni upatiṣṭhanti te narāḥ ||
evaṃ tithir iyaṃ rājann āgnāyī paṭhyate janaiḥ |
saindrīṃ kecid vadanty anye rudro 'gnir iti paṭhyate ||
asyāṃ manorathāvāptiḥ kṛtāyāṃ śṛṇu pārthiva |
(naktam evopavāsaḥ)
yena vijñānamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
śivārcanaparo bhūtvā jitakrodhaḥ śucir naraḥ |
vasudhābhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyād naktabhojanam (?) ||
upavāsāt paraṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyāt param ayācitam |
ayācitāt paraṃ naktaṃ tasmān naktena vartayet ||
devais tu bhuktaṃ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne munibhis tathā |
aparāhṇe tu pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyām guhyakādibhiḥ ||
sarvavelām atikramya naktabhojī tathā bhavet |
haviṣyabhojanaṃ nānam āhārasya ca lāghavam ||
agnikāryam adhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret |
saṃdhyāyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā śucinā gomayena tu ||
dīpaṃ dadyāt tathārghyaṃ ca puṣpagandhākṣataiḥ phalaiḥ |
[129]        mantreṇānena rājendra dhyātvā cetasi śaṅkaram |
bhūtabhartā vibhur devaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ sarvagaḥ śivaḥ ||
mamārghyadānasaṃprītas tridhā pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
datvārghaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojya svayaṃ bhūñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte vrate pūrṇe sadakṣiṇe |
dadyāc cāmīkaraṃ pātraṃ raupyaṃ vā tāmram eva ca ||
aśakto mṛṇmayaṃ pātraṃ pūrṇaṃ gavyena sarpiṣā |
pūrṇakumbopari sthāpya śvetavastrayugaṃ tathā ||
sauvarṇaṃ ca śivaṃ bhaktyā snāpya pañcāmṛtādinā |
vastropari samāsthāpya pūjayed bhaktitatparaḥ ||
puṣpair gandhais tathā dhūpaiḥ sadīpaiḥ sahacandanaiḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad arghyam aṣṭāṅgam utsṛjet ||
devasya pūjyamantreṇa bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ |
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ gavāṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi dūrvāṅkurās tilāḥ ||
candanaṃ taṇḍulās toyam arghyam aṣṭāṅgam ucyate |
phalādibhir aṣṭabhir yuktaṃ toyam aṣṭāṅgam |
śirasā dhārayitvā tu jānubhyām avanīṅgataḥ |
mahādevāya dātavyaṃ gandhadhūpaṃ yathākramam ||
bhakṣyodanair baliṃ datvā praṇamya parameśvaram |
dhenuṃ sadakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
śrotriyāya ca dātavyaṃ purāṇaviduṣe dvije |
evaṃ bhaktyā pradadyād yaḥ sarvam etad udāhṛtam ||
[130]        sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
dhanadhānyasamāyukto jīvet tu śaradāṃ śatam ||
antakāle śivaṃ smṛtvā śivalokaṃ vrajen naraḥ |
tatra sthitvā sa catvāri yugāni parayā mudā ||
tretāyāṃ pārthivendro 'sau bhūyād bharatasatttama |
yas tv aṣṭamīṣu ca śivāsu caturdaśīṣu
naktaṃ samācarati śāstravidhānadṛṣṭam |
sargāṅganākularavākulite vimāne
āruhya yāti susukhena maheśalokam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ caturdaśīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
ambupūrṇataḍāgeṣu mahātoyāśrameṣu ca |
kasyārghyaṃ saṃprayacchanti kṛṣṇe tāḥ kulapoṣitaḥ ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade pakṣe śukle bhūtatithau nṛpa |
tadā bhaktyā pradātavyaṃ varuṇāyārghyam uttamam ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhis tathaiva ca |
phalapuṣpais tathāvastrair dīpālaktakacandanaiḥ ||
viruddhaiḥ saptadānyaiś ca dadhipiṣṭāmbucandanaiḥ |
anagnipākasiddhais tais tilataṇḍulamiśritaiḥ ||
[131]        kharjūranārikelaiś (?) ca bījapūrṇātukais tathā |
ātukaṃ phalaviśeṣaḥ |
drākṣādāḍimapūgaiś ca puṣpaiś cāpi prapūjayet |
ālikhya maṇḍale devaṃ varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim ||
mantreṇānena rājendra pūjayed bhaktibhāvitaḥ |
varuṇāya namas tubhyaṃ namas te yādasāṃ pate ||
apāṃ pate namas tubhyaṃ rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ |
ākledaṃ mā ca daurgandhaṃ vairamyaṃ mā mukhe 'stu me ||
varuṇo vāruṇībhartā vasudo 'stu samā mama |
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayed bhaktyā puruṣo varuṇaṃ nṛpa ||
madhyāhne 'nagnipākaṃ hi bhuktvā niyatamānasaḥ |
