sarvopaskarayuktāś (?) ca kapilā daśa pañca vā |
dvau tathaikāṃ śubhāṃ dhenuṃ mantreṇaiva prakalpayet ||
[145]        prīyatāṃ mama śivaḥ sanātanaḥ
kalmaṣakṣayakaro maheśvaraḥ |
toṣito vratamahārājo
bhuktimuktiphalado 'stu me sadā ||
tataḥ prabhāte punar āśito vratī
dvijāya dadhyād vidhideśikāya |
munīndrakṛṣṇājinapīṭhapūrvakaṃ
pradānamantreṇa kṛtāñjalisthitaḥ ||
prasīda sarveśvara mām umāpate
samudvārāsmād bhavavāridher natam |
sadā vratādhirājena mayāsi satkṛtas
tv āsīti tāraṃ śaraṇāgato hy aham ||
iti śamīkṣyaṃ namaskṛtipūrvakaṃ (?)
guruvaro yathoktam idaṃ dat (?) |
śivalayaṃ vidadhāti sa śāstrato
na punar eti ghaṭodbhavasaṃnidhim ||
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya vratī tūṣṇī kṛtāśanaḥ |
sarvavighnāni vicchidya prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||
skanda uvāca |
atrāpi śrūyate  'gastya viśvadevo dvijottamaḥ |
krīḍāvinodaparamam umāyā devasaṃsadam ||
ravibrahmādayo devā nirjitās tena tejasā |
[146]        te 'bhibhūtaprabhāsā ca bhītā brahmāṇam āyayuḥ||
brahmovāca |
purāvrataṃ mahārājaṃ cakre caiva pitāmahaḥ |
mudgalakriyamāṇaṃ tad viśvādevo 'yam aikṣata (?) ||
tatprasādāt prabhāvo 'yaṃ sadā kṣipati viprarāṭ |
trilokāt skhalitās tv asya sarvasallokapūrvakāḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā vrataṃ mahārājaṃ bhavadbhyo 'bhyadhikaḥ prabhuḥ (?) |
yathā vrata mahārāja mattaḥ kuruta devatāḥ ||
yas tu svayaṃ vrataṃ cakre mudgato 'syāḥ pitāmahaḥ |
sa mokṣaṃ durlabhaṃ lebhe mudgato na punarbhavaḥ ||
ahaṃ caitad vrataṃ cīrtvā viśvakāritvam āpnuyāt |
lokas tathāpi vyāmohaṃ vittaśāṭhyasya kāraṇāt ||
skando 'pi pitaraṃ saṃbhūṃ lobhe kṛtvā tv idaṃ vratam |
arūpāṃ priyāṃ prāpnoti vittaśṭhyasya kāraṇāt |
surarājyam api prāptaḥ śakro 'muṣmād vrate śriyam ||
bhraṣṭarājyo bhaved bhūyo vittaśāṭhye kṛte sati |
śrīpatitvaṃ harir lebhe bhānur lebhe paraṃ śubham ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ mahārājam umā cāpi patiṃ śivam |
skanda uvāca |
śrutvaitad vratamāhātmyaṃ prāpur vai śāśvatīṃ śriyam |
dṛṣṭvā vrataṃ mahārājaṃ vrataṃ cakruḥ surāsurāḥ ||
paṭhati ya idam itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotīkṣate vā
[147]                kṣayitasakalapāpas tatkṣaṇād vā kameti (?) |
suravarajanapūjyaḥ pretako yasya puṃso
jagati kaluṣahīnaḥ so 'pi yo lekhakaś ca ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ mahārajavratam |
kārtikasyāśite pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa |
sopavāsaḥ pañcagavyaṃ pibann ārdro jitendriyaḥ ||
kapilāpās tu gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā |
śvetadhenos tathā kṣīraṃ raktāyāś ca tato dadhi ||
gṛhītvā karburāyāś ca ghṛtam ekatra melayet |
vedoktamantrai rājendra kuśodakasamanvitam ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā saṃtarpya devatām |
brāhmaṇāṃs toṣayitvā tu bhuñjīyād vāgyataḥ śuciḥ ||
śṛṇu brahman vrataṃ hy etat sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
yac ca bālye 'pi kaumāre vārdhike cāpi yat kṛtam ||
brahmakūrcopavāsena tat pāpaṃ naśyati kṣaṇāt ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ brahmakūrcavratam |
caturdaśyāṃ tu naktāśī samānte goyugapradaḥ |
sa śaivaṃ padam āpnoti yajan traiyambakaṃ vratam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ traiyambakavratam |
[148]        īśvarasya caturdaśyāṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
bahuputro bahudhanas tathā syān nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
mūlamantrasvasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś ca tithīśvaraḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāṭhyena śaṭhyena (?) kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam īśvaravratam |
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ yathāvat pūjayec chivam |
prāsādaśobhāṃ kṛtvaivaṃ samyak saṃmārjanādibhiḥ ||
saṃsnāpya vidhivad devaṃ kṣīrādyaiś carasādibhiḥ |
śrīkhaṇḍāgurukarpūrakuṅkumaiś cānulepayet ||
tato damanakair bilvaiḥ patrair maruvakodbhavaiḥ |
āliṅgapīṭhaparyantaṃ pūjayed granthilais tathā ||
nameruṃ devadāruṃ vā śrīphalāny atha sihlakam |
aguruṃ mahiṣākhyaṃ vā dhvajaṃ vā nirdahet tataḥ ||
[149] nameruṃ śaralam |
śālipiṣṭabhavair dīpaiḥ pañcabhir navabhis tathā |
kuryād ārātrikaṃ śambhoḥ svarṇapātraiḥ samujjvalaiḥ ||
vicitravastrapūjā ca kartavyā mahatī śive |
puṣpamaṇḍalikāṃ citrāṃ sa vitānojjvalaṃ (?) śubham ||
mahotsavena vidhivad geyaṃ turyaraveṇa ca |
vividhair bhakṣyabhojyaiś ca naivedyaṃ copakalpayet ||
samyak saṃpādanīyā syāt rathayātrā pinākinaḥ |
prekṣaṇīyais tathā nṛtyair vādyair yantraiś ca śobhanaiḥ ||
pūjayec chivabhaktāṃś ca viprān anyāṃś ca bhaktitaḥ |
prīyatāṃ śiva ity uktvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca svayam ||
varṣe varṣe prakartavyaṃ etac caitrotsavaṃ mahat |
śivabhaktais tathānyaiś ca kīrtiśreyovivṛddhaye ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ mahotsavavratam |
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi pāvanaṃ dharmam uttamam |
mokṣadaṃ ca tathākleśādihamagadam (?) eva ca ||
ādāya kalaśān gaurān śataṃ śatārdham eva ca |
tasyāpy ardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā bhūṣayaṃś ca sa mānavaḥ ||
kārttike śubhrabhūtāyāṃ haraṃ snāpya ghṛtādibhiḥ |
śubhrabhūtāyāṃ śuklā caturdaśyām |
[150]        samālabhya nyased bhūyaḥ sauvarṇaṃ vā prapañcakam |
surabhībhis tataḥ puṣpair abhyarcya (?) gugguluṃ dahet ||
naivedyaṃ ca punar datvā baliṃ bāhye vinikṣīpet ||
vitānaṃ dīpam ādarśaṃ vastrayugmaṃ dhvajās tathā |
dhūpotkṣepaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ ca datvā devāya saṃbhave ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kuryād daṇḍavad bhairavasya hi |
dakṣiṇe codagagre vā paścime vātha sarvataḥ ||
upalipya śubhe deśe sodakair arcayet tataḥ |
candanenākṣataiḥ puṣpaiḥ sthānaṃ pāṭhāṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ |
bhūtvā svasumukho ratnāny api teṣu nivedayet ||
susugandhākṣataiḥ pūrṇān hiraṇyāṃś caiva sarvaśaḥ |
dīpān prajvālayet tatra vicintya hṛdi śaṅkaram ||
tatas tasyopariṣṭāc ca jāgaraṃ parikalpayet |
bhūyaḥ sūryodaye snātvā snapanaṃ kuśumādikam ||
nivedya devadevāya gṛhagas tad dhariṃ smaran |
gatvā gṛhaṃ samabhyarcya pañcagavyaṃ pibet tataḥ ||
vratibhir brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tuṣṭo bhuñjīta vāgayataḥ |
tatas tān dakṣayitvā tu sarvavittānusārataḥ ||
praṇamya ca punar bhuktvā kṣamāpya ca visarjayet |
vidhinānena pañcābdān dvādaśopavasan naraḥ ||
devabhogān subhuktvā vai paraṃ dhāma prayāti saḥ |
karoty ā nidhanaṃ yas tu etadbhāvapuraḥsaram |
[151]        prāpya jñānaṃ prayāṇānte gamiṣyaty akṣayaṃ padam ||
iti kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ caturdaśījāgaraṇavratam |
vyāsa uvāca |
upoṣitaś caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāhitaḥ |
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave (?) cāntakāya ca ||
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca |
pratyekaṃ tilasaṃyuktān dadyāt saptodakāñjalīn ||
snātvā nadyāṃ ca pūrvāhṇe mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ |
iti kūrmapurāṇoktaṃ yamavratam |
yā kārttikasya māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī |
tasyāṃ snātvā yamaṃ tarpya na paśyanti yamaṃ kvacit ||
pratigṛhya tilān kṛṣṇān dīpaṃ tailasamanvitam |
datvā dānaṃ dakṣiṇā śāntā nirīkṣya ca sarvataḥ ||
apasavyaṃ tilaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ sūrpaṇīyo yamo (?) bhavet |
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave (?) cāntakāya ca ||
vaivasvatāya kālāya dakṣāya manave tathā |
kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇaguptāya pretapretādhipāya ca ||
citrāya citraguptāya dāpayec ca jalāñjalim |
sahiraṇyaṃ tataḥ pātraṃ pūrayitvā tilair dvijaḥ ||
dvijāya dadyād yo vyāsa na śocen maraṇaṃ prati |
iti skandamahākālakhaṇḍoktaṃ yamavratam |
[152]                mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣād athārabhya phālgunasya narādhipa |
pūjayet tu caturdaśyāṃ sopavāso maheśvaram |
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā ||
vratānte gāṃ tathā datvā vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet |
etad eva vrataṃ kṛtvā śuklapakṣe tu vatsaram |
pauṇḍarīkam avāpnoti kulam uddharati svakam ||
caturdaśī dvayaṃ caitat kṛtvā saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ |
māsi māsi tathā bhaktyā sarvān kāmān avāpnute ||
āsādya kāmān maheśvarasya
tatrāpy akālaṃ suciraṃ ca rājan |
sāyujyam āyāti mahreśvarasya
sarveśvarasya pratimasya tasya ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ maheśvaravratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ jyaiṣṭād ārabhya yādava |
vāyuṃ saṃpūjayed devaṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā |
saṃvatsarānte dātavyaṃ vastrayugmaṃ dvijātaye ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭam
āsādya lokaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ |
sukhāni bhuktvā suciraṃ (?) mahīpo
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavatpurogaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ vāyuvratam |
[153]                mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ virūpākṣaṃ tu pūjayet |
pauṣamāsād athārabhya yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ bhavet ||
gandhaṃ mālyaṃ namaskāraṃ dhūpaṃ dīpānnaṃ sampadā |
tat svaṃ dvijātaye dadyāt vratānte tu paraṃtapa ||
tat svaṃ tad upakaraṇaṃ mahācchādikam ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
bhayaṃ na cāpnoti sa rākṣasebhyaḥ |
kāmān avāpnoti bhavaty arogo
bhayaṃ ca rājan na ca tasya kiṃcit ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ virūpākṣavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
yatra kvacana nadyāṃ ca yatra kṛṣṇā caturdaśī |
anarkābhyudite kāle deyaṃ [devaṃ?] saṃpūjayed yamam ||
dhūmravarṇaṃ citraguptaṃ kālapāśaṃ ca yādava |
mṛtyuṃ svargaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā ||
yamo dadhāra ity uktvā tilāṃś ca juhuyāt tataḥ |
namo yamāyeti tathā strīśūdrasya vidhīyate ||
kṛśaraṃ bhojayed viprān yathāśakti narottamam |
dadyād vratānte viprāya tathaiva ca payasvinīm ||
[154]        kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
na yāti rājan narakaṃ manuṣyaḥ |
pāpakṣayaṃ prāpya sa yāti nākaṃ
mānuṣyam āsādya sa dharmavān syāt ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ yamavratam |
nārī copavased abdaṃ kṛṣṇām ekāṃ caturdaśīm |
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā śālipiṣṭamayīṃ śubhām ||
gītānulepanair mālyaiḥ pītavastrais tu pūjayet |
pūrvoktam akhilaṃ kṛtvā śivāya vinivedayet ||
pūrvoktam ity ahiṃsābrahmacaryabhūśaynādi |
saptabhūmair mahāyānais taptacāmīkaraprabhaḥ |
yugakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
śivādisarvalokeṣu bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān |
kramād āgatya loke 'smin rājānaṃ patim āpnuyāt ||
iti śivadharmoktaṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśīvratam |
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ ca pūjanam |
kṛtvā kṣemam avāpnoti kriyāsāphalyam eva ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ kṣemavratam |
[155]        pūjayitvā dhanādhyakṣaṃ tadā vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum |
bahuvittam avāpnoti phalaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ dinam ||
śaṅkhapadmau tadābhyarcya nidhāne yajñapūjite |
maṇibhadraṃ tathābhyarcya dhanam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ dhanāvāptivratam |
māghamāse caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ |
tathā pitṛgaṇān rājan kṣīṇacandre ca pūjayet ||
sarvakāmasamūhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute |
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tathā rājan sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sarvakāmavratam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ mahākālam athārcayet |
tasmāt kāmam avāpnoti tatheṣṭaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ kāmāvāptivratam |
tathā nucutugandharvapañcakaṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
sarvatra jayam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ jayavratam |
devānāṃ mānavānāṃ vā tatpakṣāye tathā pare |
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāṃ sukhī bhavet ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sukhavratam ||
[156]        yas tu kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā devaṃ pinākinam |
ārādhayed dvijamukhe tataḥ svasti punar bhavet ||
iti kūrmapurāṇoktaṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśīvratam |
māghamāse caturdaśyāṃ pūjayed indiśekharam |
bhaktyā bilvadalair maunī haranāma japen niśi ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti śaivaṃ paraṃ padam |
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśīvratam |
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ yakṣaṃ guggulakaṃ dahet |
sa yāti paramaṃ snānaṃ yatra devaḥ pinākadhṛk ||
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśīvratam |
bhaviṣyottarāt |
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya trilocanam |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedye rātrau jāgaraṇena ca ||
pañcagavyaṃ niśi prāśya svaped bhūmau vimatsaraḥ |
śyāmāvān atha vā muktvā tailakṣāravivarjitaḥ ||
homaḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryaḥ śatam aṣṭottaraṃ nṛpa |
agnaye havyavāhāya yamāyāṅgirase namaḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale snāpya pañcāmṛtaiḥ śivam |
pūjayitvā vidhānena homaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva ca ||
[157]        uddiśya mantram etaṃ ca kṛtvā śirasi vāñjalim |
namas trimūrtaye tubhyaṃ namaḥ sūryāgnirūpiṇe ||
putrān yaccha sukhaṃ yaccha mokṣaṃ yaccha namo 'stu te |
nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhojayitvā dvijottamān ||
śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ datvā paścād bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathoditam ||
sauvarṇaṃ kārayed devaṃ trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam |
vṛṣaskandhagataṃ saumyaṃ sitavastrayugānvitam ||
candanenānuliptāṅgaṃ śitapālyopaśobhitam |
sthāpayitvā tāmrapātre brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
sarvakālikamānaṃ te kathitaṃ vratam uttamam |
saṃvatsare samāptir hi vratasya tu sadā bhavet ||
cīrṇe vrate 'smin puṇyaṃ yat tat tu vaṣmin (?) dhanādhipa |
kāle gate bahutithe tīrthasya maraṇaṃ bhavet ||
mṛtaś cādityadehastho dityavyālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ (?) |
divyanārīgaṇavṛto vimānavaram āsthitaḥ ||
devadevaiḥ sameto 'sau krīḍate 'gnipure ciram |
iha vāgatya kālānte jāto nṛṇāṃ kule bhavet ||
dānayajñaḥ kṛtī dakṣo brāhmaṇo brahmaṇaḥ priyaḥ |
śrīmān agnikṛtī dhīmān putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ||
patnīgaṇasamāyuktaś ciraṃ bhadrāṇi paśyati |
ye durlabhā bhuvi suroraga mānavānāṃ
kāmā anāmayaguṇena yutāḥ sadaiva |
[158]        tān āpnuvanti śivabhūtatithau sureśaṃ
saṃpūjayati sumatito vidhivan manuṣyāḥ ||
iti caturdaśīvratam |
śṛṇu naktopavāsasya vidhānaṃ pāṇḍunandana |
yena vijñānamātreṇa naro mokṣam avāpnuyāt ||
yeṣu teṣu ca māseṣu śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm |
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā tu prārabhet śrutato vratam ||
māsi māsi bhavanti dve aṣṭamī ca caturdaśī |
śivārcanarato bhūtvā śivadhyānaikamānasaḥ ||
vasudhāṃ bhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyān naktabhojanam |
upavāsāt paraṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyāt param ayācitam ||
ayācitāt paraṃ naktaṃ tasmān naktena bhojayet |
devaiś ca bhuktaṃ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne munibhis tathā ||
aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ |
sarvavelām atikramya naktabhojī sadā bhavet ||
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyam āhāralāghavam |
agnikāryam adhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī sadā bhavet ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte vrataṃ pūrṇam |
pūrṇakumbhopari sthāpya dāpayet suśobhane (?) |
kapilāpañcagavyena sthāpayen mṛṇmaye śiva |
[159]        phalapuṣpayavakṣīradadhidarbhāṅkurās tilāḥ ||
candanaṃ taṇḍulās toyam arghyam aṣṭāṅgam ucyate |
śirasā dhārayitvā tu jānu gatvā mahītale ||
mahādevāya dātavyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ yathākramam |
bhakṣodanair baliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya parameśvarīm ||
dhenuṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vṛṣaṃ vāpi dhurandharam |
śrotriyāya daridrāya kalpavratavidāya ca ||
yo dadāti śive bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
vimānam arkapratimaṃ haṃsayuktam alaṃkṛtam ||
surūḍho 'psarasaṅgītair yāti rudrālaye sukham |
sthitvā rudrasya bhavane varṣakoṭiśatatrayam ||
ihaloke tu yac chreṣṭhagrāmalakṣeśvaro bhavet |
yaś cāṣṭamīṣu ca śivāsu caturdaśīṣu
naktaṃ samācarati śāstravidhānadṛṣṭam |
svargāṅganā kararavākulitaṃ vimānam
āruhya yāti susukhyena śivālayaṃ ca ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottare caturdaśyaṣṭamīnaktavratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe caturdaśīvratāni |
[160]
athonaviṃśo 'dhyāya |
atha paurṇamāsīvratāni |
vividhavibudhavṛndānandasandohakando
yadi gaṇitaguṇaudhaḥ so 'dya hemādriśūriḥ |
abhimataphalasampatsuddhaye buddhibhājāṃ
vratanivaham idānīṃ paurṇamāsīṃ bravīmi ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
paurṇamāsī mahārāja somasya dayitā tithiḥ |
pūrṇamāso bhaved yasyāṃ pūrṇamāsī tataḥ smṛtā ||
tasyāṃ tu śrotasi snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ |
ālikhya maṇḍale somaṃ nakṣatraiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum ||
pūjayet kusumair hṛdyair (?) naivedyair ghṛtapācitaiḥ |
śuklavastrair dakṣiṇābhiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet ||
śākāhāreṇa munyannair naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
munīnām annaṃ munyannaṃ nīvārādi |
gaganārṇavamāṇikyacandradākṣāyaṇīpate |
vasantabāndhavabidho śītāṃśo svastinaḥ kratuḥ ||
pakṣe pakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ vidhir eṣa prakīrtitaḥ |
śuklapakṣe 'pi yaḥ kaścic chraddhāvān vai vratī bhavet ||
[161]        tatrāpy eṣa vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
amāvāsyā tithir iyaṃ pitṝṇām akṣayā bhavet ||
amāvāsyeyaṃ paurṇamāsī tadvratam |
amāvāsyā mahārāja gayena samupoṣitā |
tenākṣayavaṭodantaḥ pitṛbhyas tīrtham uttamam ||
yaḥ kaścit kurute tasmin pitṛpiṇḍodakakriyām |
tasminn akṣayavaṭe |
sa tārayati rājendra puruṣān ekaviṃśatim ||
bhaveyur akṣayās tasya lokāḥ pitṛniṣevitāḥ |
yadā tu iha lokānte tasya cāgamanaṃ bhavet ||
brāhmaṇaḥ pitṛbhaktaś ca sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ |
pañcajanmāni rājendra bhavel lakṣmyā samanvitaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte haimaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam |
somaṃ nakṣatrasahitaṃ sarvāvayavasaṃyutam ||
saptadhānyasamāyuktaṃ raupyapātropari nyaset |
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ gāṃ ca dadyāt payasvinīm ||
upadeśaṃ ca yo dadyāt tasmin vratavare naraḥ |
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇair mantreṇārghyaṃ nivedayet ||
navo navo 'si māsānte jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
candra sāndrasudhāsaudhaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo 'stu te ||
dadyād dvijendramukhyāya bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ |
māse māse vidhir ayaṃ vratasyāsya narādhipa ||
yena śaknoti vā kartuṃ varṣam ekaṃ nirantaram ||
[162]        ekāpi samupoṣyaiva dadyād udyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ ||
vratodyāpanayor vṛttir mukhyaḥ kalpaḥ vratāvṛttir apy anāvṛttir gauṇaḥ |
yaś caitat kurute pārtha paurṇamāsīvrataṃ naraḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaś candravad divi rājate ||
putrapautradhanopeto gajadātā priyaṃvadaḥ |
santatiṃ vipulāṃ prāpya prayāge maraṇaṃ bhavet ||
tataś caivākṣayān kāmān āpnoti surasevitān |
sevyamānaḥ sa gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
āste varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ divyabhogair alaṅkṛtaḥ |
abhyarcayanti śitapañcadaśīṣu somaṃ
kṛṣṇāsu ye pitṛgaṇāñ jalapiṇḍadānaiḥ |
teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi dhanadhānyasutādisaṃpat
pūrṇāni pārthiva bhavanti vidhau vidhānāt ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ jayapaurṇamāsīvratam |
pulastyam uvāca |
aśokapūrṇimām etāṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama |
upoṣyāsyāṃ naraḥ śokaṃ nāpnoti strī yathāpi vā ||
phālgunāmalapakṣasya paurṇamāsyāṃ nṛpottama |
mṛjjalena naraḥ snātvā datvā śirasi vai mṛdam ||
mṛtprāśanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca sthaṇḍilaṃ mṛdā |
puṣpair gandhaiḥ samabhyarcya bhūdharaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ||
[163]        dharaṇīṃ ca tathā devīm aśoketi ca kīrtayet |
yathā viśokā dharaṇiḥ kṛtakṛtyā janārdana |
tathā māṃ sarvaśokebhyo mocayāśeṣadhāriṇi ||
yathā samastabhūtānām ādhāratve vyavasthitā |
yathā viśokaṃ kuru māṃ sakalecchāvibhūtibhiḥ ||
dhyānamātre yathā viṣṇoḥ svāmyaṃ prāptāsi medini |
tathā mansḥsvacchatāṃ me kuruṣva bhūtadhāriṇi ||
evaṃ stutvā samabhyarcya candrāyārghyaṃ nivedayet |
upoṣitavyaṃ naktaṃ vā bhoktavyaṃ tailavarjitam ||
anenaiva prakāreṇa catvāraḥ phālgunādayaḥ |
upoṣyā nṛpate māsāḥ prathamaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam ||
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu tadvat snātvā mṛdāmbunā |
tathaiva prāśanaṃ pūjā tadvad indos tathārhaṇam ||
caturṣv anyeṣu vai voktaṃ tathā vai kārttikādiṣu |
pāraṇatritayaṃ caiva caturmāsikam ucyate ||
viśeṣapūjādānaṃ ca tathā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
viśeṣeṇa ca kartavyaṃ pāraṇe pāraṇe kṛte ||
prathamaṃ (-me?) dharaṇī nāma smṛtaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam |
dvitīye medinī nāma tṛtīye ca vasundharā ||
pāraṇe pāraṇe rājan vastrayugmena pūjayet |
tathaiva dharaṇīṃ devīṃ ghṛtasnānena keśavam ||
vastrābhāve ca sūtreṇa pūjayed dharaṇīṃ tathā |
ghṛtābhāve tathā kṣīraṃ śastaṃ vā salilaṃ hareḥ ||
[164]        evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāne gauḥ svatsā dvijātaye |
prakalpya dharanī devī vastrālaṅkārasaṃyutā ||
pātālasaṃsthayā devyā cīrṇam etan mahāvratam |
dharaṇyā keśavaprītau tataḥ prāptā samā gatiḥ ||
devena coktā dharaṇī varāhavapuṣā purā |
upavāsavrataparā samuddhṛtya rasātalāt ||
vratenānena kalyāṇi praṇato yaḥ kariṣyati |
vratam etat samāśritya pāraṇaṃ ca yathāvidhi ||
sarvabādhāvinirmukto daśajanmāntarāṇy asau |
viśokaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhājanaṃ syān na saṃśayaḥ ||
yathā tvam eva vasudhe saṃprāptā nirvṛtaṃ padam |
tathā sa parame loke sukhaṃ prāpsyati mānavaḥ ||
evam etan mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvaṃ śāntipradānakam |
viśokākhyaṃ vratavaraṃ tat kuruṣva mahāvratam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam aśokapūrṇimāvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
pañcadaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe phālgunasya narottama |
pāṣaṇḍapatitāṃś caiva tathaivāntyāvasāyinaḥ ||
nāstikān bhinnavṛttāṃś ca pāpinaś cāpi nālapet |
nārāyaṇe gatamanāḥ puruṣo niyatendriyaḥ |
tiṣṭhan bruvan praskhalaṃś ca kṣute vāpi janārdanam ||
[165]        kīrtayet tatkriyākāle saptakṛtvaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
lakṣmyā samanvitaṃ devam arcayeta janārdanam ||
saṃdhyāvyuparame candrasvarūpaṃ harim īśvaram |
rātriṃ ca lakṣmīṃ saṃcitya sasvagarbheṇa cintayet ||
śrīniśā candrarūpā tvaṃ vāsudevajagatpate |
mano'bhilaṣitaṃ deva pūrayasva namo namaḥ ||
mantreṇānena datvārghyaṃ devadevasya bhaktitaḥ |
naktaṃ bhuñjīta maunena tailakṣāravivarjitam ||
tathaiva caitravaiśākhe jyaiṣṭhe ca munisattama |
arcayec ca yathā proktaṃ māsi māsi ca taddine ||
niṣpāditaṃ bhaved ekaṃ pāraṇaṃ dālbhyabhaktitaḥ |
dvitīyaṃ tatra vakṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ taṃ nobodha me ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi māsi bhādrapade tathā |
tathaivāśvayuje 'bhyarcya śrīdharaṃ ca śriyā saha ||
samyak candrasamaṃ (?) datvā bhuñjītārcya yathāvidhi |
dvitīyam etad ākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu |
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu tathaivābhyarcya keśavam ||
bhūtyā samanvitaṃ dadyāc chaśāṅkāyārhaṇaṃ niśi |
bhuñjīta ca yathākhyātaṃ tṛtīyam api pāraṇam ||
pratipūjya tato dadyād brāhmaṇebhyārcya dakṣiṇām |
pratimāsaṃ ca vakṣyāmi prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhaye ||
caturaḥ prathamaṃ māsān pañcagavyam udāhṛtam |
[166]        kuśodakaṃ (?) tathaivānyad uktaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam ||
sūryāṃśutaptaṃ tadvac ca jalaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam |
gītavādyādikaṃ rātrau tathā kṛṣṇakathāḥ śubhāḥ ||
kārayed devadevasya pāraṇe pāraṇe gate |
janārdanaṃ salakṣmīkam (?) arcayet prathamaṃ tathā ||
saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tadvat tṛtīyaṃ bhūtikeśavam |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat sapatnīkaṃ janārdanam ||
nāpnotīṣṭaviyogārttiṃ pumān nāry api vā punaḥ |
yāvad etadvidhānena pāraṇāny arcati prabhum ||
tāvanti janmāny asukhaṃ nāpnotīṣṭaviyogajam ||
devasya ca prasādena maraṇāt prāk mṛteḥ smṛtim |
kule satāṃ sphītadhane bhogān bhuṅkte pañcepsitām ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktalakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ vratam |
dālbhya uvāca |
śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ tāta yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam |
yathā sukhena saṃyānti mānavās tad vadasva me ||
pulastya uvāca |
pratimāsaṃ tu nāmāni pañcadaśyāṃ jagatpateḥ |
kṛtopavāsaḥ susnātaḥ pūjayitvā jagadgurum ||
uccārayan naro yāti sumukhenaiva gacchati |
[167]        tato viprāya vai dadyād udakumbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||
upānadvastrayugmaṃ ca chatraṃ kānanam eva ca |
yad vā māsagataṃ nāma prīyatām iti kīrtayet ||
keśavaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ tathā |
mādhavaṃ māghamāse tu govindam api phālgune ||
caitre viṣṇuṃ ca vaiśākhe kīrtayen madhusūdanam |
jyeṣṭhe trivikramaṃ devaṃ tathāṣāḍhe ca vāmanam ||
śrīdharaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi hṛṣīkeśaṃ tataḥ param |
nāma bhādrapade tadvat jñāyate puṇyakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
tadvad āśvayuje māśi padmanābheti kīrtayet |
dāmodaraṃ kārtike ca sarvāṃ tarati durgatim ||
evaṃ māsakrameṇaiva yadi dātuṃ na śakyate |
tadā saṃvatsarasyānte dadyāc caiva samāgatam ||
viśeṣāś cātra kathita ity anena viśeṣād anyatra pūrvavratasāmyaṃ gamyate |
kṛtvaivaṃ sukham āpnoti maraṇe smaraṇaṃ hareḥ |
yāmyaṃ kleśaṃ samaṃ prāpya svargaloke mahīyate ||
tato mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya nirātakṣo gatajvaraḥ |
dhanadhānyavati sphīte kule mahati jāyate ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ narakapūrṇimāvratam ||
sūta uvāca |
vaiśākhyām paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sṛṣṭāḥ kamalayoninā |
[168]        tilāḥ kṛṣṇāś ca gaurāś ca tṛptaye sarvadehinām ||
tasmāt kāryaṃ tilaiḥ snānaṃ tatrāgnau juhuyāt tilān ||
niveditavyaṃ vidhivat tilapātraṃ tu viṣṇave |
tilatailena dīpāś ca deyā devebhya eva ca ||
kūrmapurāṇe tu viśeṣaḥ |
vaiśākhapūrṇamāsyāṃ tu brāhmaṇān pañca sapta vā |
upoṣya vidhinā śāntāc chucīn prayatamānasaḥ ||
ādityapurāṇe |
modakaiś ca tilaiḥ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
tilaiḥ samadhubhir yuktaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo janārdana ||
dātavyā dakṣiṇā cāpi tilair madhuyutair api |
mantraṃ japec ca paurāṇaṃ pāraṃparyākramāgatam ||
oṃ tilā vai somadaivatyāḥ surasṛṣṭās tu gosave |
svargapradāś ca tantrāś ca te māṃ rakṣanti nityaśaḥ ||
dadyād anena mantreṇa tilapātrāṇi tatra ca |
saptabhyas tv atha pañcabhyo brāhmaṇabhyas tu kīrtayet ||
prīyatāṃ dharmarājaś ca devāś cānye tathāpi vā ||
'gṛhīto' mantraḥ |
evaṃ kṛte sa muktaḥ syāt pāpair janmaśatārjitaiḥ |
ityādipurāṇokto vaiśākhī vidhiḥ |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
saṃvatsare (?) 'pi yāḥ kāścit tithayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ |
[169]        etā eva yaduśreṣṭha snāne dāne mahāphalāḥ ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
vaiśākhī kārttikī māghī tithayo 'tīva pūjitāḥ |
snānadānavihīnāś ca na neyāḥ (?) pāṇḍunandana ||
tīrthasnānaṃ tadā śastaṃ dānaṃ vittānusārataḥ |
vaiśākhyāṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭhā cojjayanī matā ||
kārttikyāṃ puṣkaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ māghyāṃ vārāṇasī matā |
snānenodakadānena tārayed akhilān pitṝn ||
kumbhān svachajalaiḥ pūrṇān hiraṇyānnaiḥ samanvitān |
vaiśākhyāṃ brāhmaṇe datvā na śocati kṛtākṛte ||
madhurānnarasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ bhājanaṃ kanakojjvalam |
bahūni dhanadhānyāni bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi viprāya vidhivan nṛpa |
māghyāṃ snānaṃ tathā samyak tarpya (?) pitṛdevatāḥ ||
tilapātrāṇi deyāni tilāḥ sapalalodanāḥ |
kāryā sadānamantraiś (?) ca dhenudānaṃ praśasyate |
kambalājinaratnāni mocako pāpamocakaḥ ||
upānaddānam atraiva tulyam aśvarathena tu ||
yatra vā tatra vā snānaṃ dānaṃ vittānusārataḥ |
kāle kālodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śasyate pāṇḍunandana ||
kuryāt kurukulaśreṣṭha harer nīrājanaṃ tathā ||
gajāśvarathadānāni ghṛtadhenvādikāni ca |
[170]        pradeyāni dvijātibhyas tās tāḥ saṃsmṛtya devatāḥ |
phalāni yāni vidyante sugandhāny agadāni ca ||
kaṅkolakaphalaṃ jātyā lavaṅgakadalīphalam |
kharjūraṃ nārikelaṃ ca kadalīphalam eva ca ||
dāḍimaṃ mātuliṅgaṃ ca karkoṭaṃ trapuṣaṃ tathā |
vṛntākaṅkāravellaṃ ca ciñcā kuṣmāṇḍam eva ca ||
phalānām apradānena yeṣāṃ tu tithayo gatāḥ |
te vyādhitā daridrāś ca jāyante bhuvi mānavāḥ ||
na kevalaṃ brāḥmaṇānāṃ dānam atra praśasyate |
bhaginī        bhāgineyānāṃ mātulānāṃ pitṛṣvasuḥ ||
daridrāṇāṃ ca bandhūnāṃ dānaṃ koṭiguṇottaram |
mitraṃ kulīnaś cāpanno bandhudāridraduḥkhitāḥ ||
āśayābhyāgato dūrāt so 'tithiḥ sargasakramaḥ (?) |
vanaṃ prasthāpito rāme saśīte sahalakṣmaṇe ||
mātāmahakulād etya viśuddhenāntarātmanā |
sapathaiḥ śrāvitānekaiḥ kauśalyā bharatena vai ||
yadā na pratyayaṃ yāti kadācit kośalātmajā |
tadā viśuddhabhāvena śapathān śrāvitā punaḥ ||
vaiśākhī kārttikī māgho tithayo 'marapūjitāḥ |
apradānavato yāntu yasyāryo 'numate gataḥ ||
etat śrutvā tu kauśakyā sahasā pratyayaṃ gatā |
aṅkam ānīya bharataṃ sāntayāmāsa duḥkhitam ||
etattithīnāṃ māhātmyam ākhyātaṃ bahuvistaram |
[171]        bhūyas tu saṃpravakṣyāmi tava bhāratasattama ||
vaiśākhe kārttike māghe sahitā nṛpendra
yā pūrṇimā bhavati pūrṇaśaśāṅkacihnā |
tasyāṃ jalānnakarakān varam ātapatraṃ
datvā prayāti puruṣaḥ puruhūtalokam ||
iti bhaviṣyottarokto vaiśākhīkārttikīmādhīvidhiḥ |
pulastya uvāca |
tato ratānte bhagavān pinākī
tasyāṃ guhāyām anumodya puṇyam |
devaiś ca sarvair anugamyamāno
babhūva kāmena vihāracārī ||
tasyāṃ manuṣyaḥ suciraṃ pramatto
nabhasya māsasya tu paurṇamāsyām |
bhāryādvitīyaḥ sahasā ya eva
putreṣṭim ādau svagṛhe 'pi kṛtvā ||
gacchet tataḥ sarvasamṛddhiyukto
homaiḥ sajāpyaiś balinā ca rudram |
śailendrakanyāgajavaktranandī
sadbhāvaśaktyāpy atha vārcayitvā ||
saṃpūjya viprān atha deva pūrvān
kṛtopavāso jitaroṣadoṣaḥ |
tataḥ sahāyān api bhojayitvā
[172]                bhāryāṃ ca paścāt svayam atra bhuṅkte ||
tṛpāṃ ca bhāryām atha gopayitvā
pradakṣiṇī kṛtya guhāṃ saguhyam |
gṛhāṃs tu gacchet paripūrṇakāmaḥ
vṛṣaḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ kṛtabhojanaś ca ||
kathāś ca divyās tv atha nandinīś ca
bhāryāṃ tataḥ śrāvaṇayoḥ prayuktām |
kṣīrodanaṃ tridinaṃ bhojayec ca
vandhāṃ ca bhāryām api putrakāmām ||
tato gṛhe sarvasamṛddhikāmaḥ
saṃtarpya bhāryāṃ prayato vidhāya |

puṃścalīnāṃ ca nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
rudhiraṃ nāsikācchedād galitaṃ sā pibaty alam |
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ ḍhoḍhāyāś caritaṃ mahat |
sāṃprathaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yenopāyena hanyate ||
adya pañcadaśī śuklā phālgunasya narādhipa |
śītakālo viniṣkrāntaḥ prātar grīṣmo bhaviṣyati ||
abhayaṃ sarvalokānāṃ dīyatāṃ puruṣarṣabha |
tathā hy aśaṅkitā lokā hasantu ca ramantu ca ||
[187]        dāruṇāni ca khaḍgāni gṛhītvā samarotsukaḥ |
yodhā iva viniryāntu śiśavaḥ saṃpraharṣitāḥ ||
saṃcayaṃ śuklakāṣṭhānāṃ palālānāṃ ca kārayet |
tatrāgniṃ vidhivad datvā rakṣoghnair (?) mantravistaraiḥ ||
tataḥ kilikalāśabdais tālīśabdair manoharaiḥ |
tam agniṃ triḥ parikramya gāyantu ca hasantu ca ||
jalpantu khecchayā lokāḥ niḥśāṅkā (?) yasya yan matam |
bhagair bahuvidhaiḥ śabdaiḥ kīrtayan deśabhāṣayā ||
vistārayaṃś ca gāyaṃś ca sahasraṃ nāma tasya vai |
tena śabdena sā pāpā homena ca nirākṛtā ||
aṭṭāṭṭahāsair ḍinbhānāṃ rākṣasī kṣayam eṣyati |
tasyarṣer vacanaṃ śrutvā sa nṛpaḥ pāṇḍunandana ||
sarvaṃ cakāra vidhivad yad uktaṃ tena dhīmatā |
gatā sā rākṣasī nāśaṃ tena cogreṇa karmaṇā ||
tataḥ prabhṛti loke 'sminn aḍāḍākhyātim āgatā |
sarvaduṣṭadamo homaḥ sarvarogopaśāntidaḥ ||
kriyate 'syāṃ dvijaiḥ pārtha tena sā holikā smṛtā |
sarvasārā tithiś ceyaṃ paurṇamāsī yudhiṣṭhira ||
sāratvāt sarvalokānāṃ paramānandadāyinī |
asyāṃ niśāgame pārtha saṃrakṣyāḥ śiśavo gṛhe ||
gomayenopalipte ca sacatuṣke gṛhāṅgaṇe |
ākārayec chiśuprāyān khaḍgavyagrakarān narān ||
khaḍgakāṣṭhaiś ca saṃspṛśya gītair hāsyakaraiḥ śiśūn |
[188]        rakṣanti teṣāṃ dātavyaṃ guḍapakvānnam eva ca ||
evaṃ ḍhoṇḍheti rākṣasyā kāryaṃ tasmāt tasmin svamālaye ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
prabhāte kiṃ janair deva kartavyaṃ sukham īpsubhiḥ |
pravṛtte māghave māsi pratipady udite ravau ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
kṛtvāvaśyakakāryāṇi saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ |
vandayed dholikābhūtiṃ sarvaduṣṭopaśāntaye ||
mantreṇānena rājendra paṭhyamānaṃ nibodha me |
vanditāsi surendreṇa brahmaṇā śaṅkareṇa ca |
atas tvaṃ pāhi no devi vibhūte bhūtidā bhava ||
maṇḍite carcite caiva upalipte gṛhājire |
catuṣkaṃ kārayet svacchaṃ varṇakaiś cākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
tanmadhye sthāpayet pīṭhaṃ śuklavastrottarachadam |
agrataḥ pūrṇakalaśaṃ sthāpayet pallavair yutam |
sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sitacandanacarcitam ||
āsane copaviṣṭasya brahmadyoṣeṇa bhārata |
carcayec candanair nārī avyaṅgāṅgā sulakṣaṇā ||
padmarāgottarapaṭā śreṣṭhāṃśukavibhūṣitā |
vapurādyaṃ śiro'ntaṃ ca dadhidūrvākṣatānvitam ||
vardhāpayitvā śrīkhaṇḍam āyurārogyavṛddhaye |
[189] vapurādyaṃ śiro'ntam iti pādād ārabhya mūrdhaparyantaṃ candanena carcayed ity arthaḥ | tac candanaṃ vardhāpayitvā kiṃcid avaśeṣya |
paścāc ca prāśayed vidvān cūtapuṣpaṃ sacandanam |
manobhavasya sā pūjā ṛṣibhiḥ saṃpradarśitā ||
yat pibanti vasantādau cūtapuṣpaṃ sacandanam |
satyaṃ satyasya kāmasya pūjeyaṃ kriyate janaiḥ ||
prāśanamantraś ca |
idam agryaṃ vasantasya mākandakusumaṃ tava |
sacandanaṃ pibāmy adya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||
anantaraṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ sūtamāgadhabandināṃ |
dadyād dānaṃ yathāśaktyā kāmo me prīyatām iti ||
tato bhojanavelāyāṃ sṛtapākena tena hi |
prāśayet prathamaṃ cānnaṃ tato bhuñjīta kāmataḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha śāstroktaṃ phālgunotsavam |
anāyāsena sidhyanti tasya sarve manorathāḥ ||
ādhayo vyādhayaś caiva yānti nāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ ||
puṇyā pavitrā sarvatra sarvavighnavināśinī |
evaṃ te kathitā pārtha tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
vṛtte tuṣārasamaye sitapañcadaśyāṃ
prātar vasantasamaye samupasthite ca |
saṃprāśya cūtakusumaṃ saha candanena
[190]                satyaṃ hi pārtha puruṣo 'tha samāṃ sukhī syāt ||
samā varṣaṃ tu yāvat |
iti bhaviṣyottarapurāṇoktaholikotsavavidhiḥ |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
rakṣābandhavidhānaṃ me kiṃcit kathaya keśava |
duṣṭapretapiśācānāṃ yenādhṛṣyo bhaven naraḥ ||
sarvarogopaśamanaṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam |
sakṛt kṛtenābdam ekaṃ yena rakṣā kṛtā bhavet ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pāṇḍavaśārdūla itihāsaṃ purātanam |
indrāṇyā yat kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śakrasya jayavṛddhaye ||
devāsuram abhūd yuddhaṃ purā dvādaśavārṣikam |
tatrāsurair jitaḥ śakraḥ saha sarvaiḥ surottamaiḥ ||
parityajyāmaraiḥ svargaṃ sarvālaṅkāravarjitaḥ |
prāpyāmarāvatīṃ tasthau prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||
tato dānavarājena trailokyaṃ svavaśīkṛtam |
idam uktāḥ samānāyya śṛṇudhvaṃ sanarāmarāḥ ||
māṃ yajadhvaṃ stuvidhvaṃ ca ahaṃ pūjyaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
yaḥ śakraḥ samyag ātiṣṭhet sa gacched vadhyatāṃ mayā ||
dānaveśvaravākyena naṣṭāḥ sarvāḥ kriyās tataḥ |
svāhākārasvadhākāravaṣaṭkārādikāś ca yāḥ ||
[191]        nādhīyīta (?) tathā vedā na pūjyante (?) ca devatāḥ |
utsavā na parvartante sarvam āsīd asaṃṣṭhulam ||
dharmanāśe sureśasya balahānir ajāyata |
jñātvā hīnabalaṃ sarvaṃ dānavāḥ samabhidravan ||
so 'bhidruto 'suragaṇais tyaktarājyo 'pi devarāṭ |
bṛhaspatim upāmantrya idaṃ vacanam abravīt ||
na sthātum atra śaknomi na gantuṃ tair abhidrutaḥ |
sarvathā yoddhum icchāmi yad bhāvyaṃ tad bhaviṣyati ||
naśyate yuddhato vāpi tāvad bhavati jīvitam |
tāvad dātāsṛjat pūrvaṃ na yāvan manasīpsitam ||
jayaṃ me śaṃsate brahman yotsye 'haṃ dānavaiḥ saha |
muhūrtaṃ jvalitaṃ śreyo yena dhūmāyitaṃ ciram ||
karmāyattaṃ suraiśvaryaṃ pauruṣaṃ karma cocyate ||
tad adyāhaṃ kariṣyāmi dhruvaṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati |
śrutvā surapater vākyaṃ bṛhaspatir athābravīt ||
bṛhaspatir uvāca |
na kālo vikramasyādya tyaja kopaṃ puraṃdara |
deśakālavihīnāni kāryāṇi viparītavad ||
kriyamāṇāni dūṣyanti so 'narthaḥ sumahān bhavet |
indra uvāca |
brahman kiṃ bahunoktena yotsye 'haṃ saha dānavaiḥ |
nṝṇāṃ kāryasamārambhe śreyasīty ekacintatā ||
guṇadoṣāv ubhāv etāv ekīkṛtya vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
[192]        kāryam ārabhyate yat tu tasya doṣāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ ||
tayoḥ saṃvadator evaṃ śacī prāha sureśvaram |
adya bhūtadinaṃ deva prātaḥ parva bhaviṣyati ||
ahaṃ rakṣāṃ vidhāsyāmi jayo yena bhaviṣyati |
paulamyās tu vacaḥ sarvaṃ kṛtavān balavṛtrahā ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ paulomīkṛtamaṅgalā |
babandha dakṣiṇe pāṇau rakṣāpoṭhalikāṃ śubhām ||
baddharakṣas tataḥ śakraḥ kṛtasvastyayano dvijaiḥ |
āruhyairāvataṃ nāgaṃ nirjagāma surārihā ||
saṃprāpya dānavānīkaṃ nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ |
pātayāmāsa śatrūṇāṃ śirāṃsi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāyātaṃ dānavāḥ saṃpraharṣitāḥ |
abhijagmuḥ śitair bāṇaiḥ śakraṃ barhinavājinaiḥ ||
uvāca dānavān sarvān prahlādo dānaveśvaraḥ |
diṣṭyādya bhavatāṃ prāptir brahmahā dṛṣṭigocaraḥ ||
hatainam ekīkṛtyāśu rathavaṃśena dānavāḥ |
rathavaṃśena rathasamudāyena |
yāvat sa naśyate pāpas tāvad yatno vidhīyatām |
dānaveśvaravākyena tatas te danunandanāḥ ||
tyaktvā maunaṃ mahātmānaḥ śakram āhur ahaṃ hatāḥ |
tataḥ śacīpatiḥ kruddho vajram udyamya bhāsuram ||
jaghāna dānavānīkaṃ kṣaṇāt kāla iva prajāḥ |
[193]        vadhyamānāḥ sureśena dānavās te mahābalāḥ ||
atyantabhayasaṃtrastāḥ kālo 'yam iti mohitāḥ |
kecit samudraṃ viviśur gahanaṃ kecid āśritāḥ ||
kecil lambitamūrdhāno nagnā bhūtvā vane 'vasan |
dayādharmaṃ pravruvāṇā nirgranthavratam āśritāḥ ||
hetuvādaparā mūḍhā vañcayantaḥ prajāgaṇān |
evaṃ nirjitadaiteyān śakraḥ svasthānam āgataḥ ||
trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
hataharṣā surendreṇa śukraṃ śaraṇam āgatāḥ ||
praṇamya kathayāmāsur jito 'haṃ samare 'riṇā |
brahmarṣe hīnavīryeṇa śakreṇāpi jito yataḥ ||
tasmād dhik paurūṣaṃ loke daivaṃ hi balavattaram |
śukra uvāca |
viṣādaṃ mā kṛthā daityāḥ kāryāṇāṃ gatir īdṛśī |
daivād bhavato bhūtānāṃ kāle jayaparājayau ||
saṃdhānaṃ saha śakreṇa nedānīm ucitaṃ bhavet |
ajeyaḥ sarvaśatrūṇāṃ kṛtaḥ śacyā śacipatiḥ ||
rakṣābandhaprabhāveṇa dānavendro jito mahān |
varṣam ekaṃ pratīkṣadhvaṃ tataḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati ||
bhārgaveṇaiva muktās te dānavā vigatajvarāḥ |
tasthuḥ kālaṃ pratīkṣanto yathoktaṃ guruṇā tathā ||
eṣa prabhāvo rakṣāyāḥ kathitas te yudhiṣṭhira |
jayadaḥ sukhadaś caiva putrārogyadhanapradaḥ ||
[194]                yudhiṣṭhira ucāva |
kriyate kena vidhinā rakṣābandhaḥ surottama |
kasyāṃ tithau kadā deva etan me vaktum arhasi ||
yathā yathā hi bhagavan vicitrāṇi prabhāṣase |
tathā tathā na me tṛptir bahvarthāḥ śṛṇvataḥ kathāḥ ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ghanāvṛte 'mbare pārtha śādvale dharaṇītale |
saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe māsi paurṇamāsyāṃ dinodaye ||
snānaṃ kurvīta matimān śrutismṛtividhānataḥ |
tato devān pitṝṃś caiva tarpayet paramāmbhasā ||
upākarmādi caivoktam ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam |
kurvīta brāhmaṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ vedān uddiśya suvrata ||
śūdrāṇāṃ mantrarahitaṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ ca śasyate |
tato 'parāhṇasamaye rakṣāpīṭalikāṃ śubhām ||
kārayed akṣataiḥ śastaiḥ siddhārthair hemabhūṣitām |
vastrair vicitraiḥ kārpāsaiḥ kṣomair vā malavarjitaiḥ ||
vicitratantugrathitāṃ sthāpayed rājatopari |
kāryā gṛhasya rakṣā, gomayoparacitaiḥ suvṛttakuṇḍalakaiḥ |
dūrvāvarṇasahitaiś citrā duritopaśamanāya |
upalipte gṛhe deśe dattacatuṣke nyaset kumbham |
pīṭhaṃ datvopari viśet rājāmātyair yutaś ca sumuhūrte ||
veśyājanena sahito maṅgalaśabdaiḥ samucchritaiś cihnaiḥ |
rakṣābandhaḥ kāryaḥ śāntidvaninā narendrasya ||
[195]        devadvijātiśastrāṇy astrai rakṣāptir arcayet prathamam |
tad any purodhā nṛpateḥ rakṣām badhnīta mantreṇa ||
yena baddho balī rājā dānavendro mahābalaḥ |
tena tvām abhibadhnāmi rakṣe mā cala mā cala ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyair vaiśyaiḥ śūdraiś cānyaiś ca mānavaiḥ |
kartavyo rakṣikābandho dvijān saṃpūjya śaktitaḥ ||
anena vidhinā yas tu rakṣābandhanam ācaret |
sa sarvadoṣarahitaḥ sukhī saṃvatsaraṃ bhavet ||
yaḥ śrāvaṇe śravati śītajalaṃ surendre
rakṣāvidhānam idam ācarate manuṣyaḥ |
āste sukhena parameṇa sa varṣam ekam
sa putrapautrasahitaḥ sasuhṛjjanaś ca ||
iti bhaviṣyottare rakṣābandhanapaurṇamāsīvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvācety anuvṛttau |
pañca pañcadaśīḥ sthitvā ekabhaktena mānavaḥ |
saṃpūjya pūrṇimāṃ devīṃ likhitāṃ candanādinā ||
pūrṇimāpratimā tu paribhāṣāyāṃ draṣṭavyā |
tataḥ pañca ghaṭān pūrṇān payodadhighṛtena ca ||
madhunā sitakhaṇḍena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
manorathān pūrayasva yathā tvaṃ pūrṇimā hy asi ||
pañcakumbhapradānena bhūtānāṃ tuṣṭir astu me |
[196] dānamantraḥ |
dvijān evaṃ namaskṛtya sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
etat pañcaghaṭanāmavrataṃ (?) tuṣṭipradāyakam ||
iti bhaviṣottare pañcaghaṭapūrṇimāvratam |
kṛṣṇa uvācety anuvṛttau |
triṃśat saṃpūjya dampatyāny upavāsī vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
paurṇamāsyām avāpnoti mokṣam indravratād iha ||
iti bhaviṣyottare indrapaurṇamāsīvratam |
śaṅkara uvāca |
mahatpūrvā bhavaty eṣā paurṇamāsī dvijottama |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tasyāḥ sopavāso janārdanam ||
yaḥ pūjayati darmajña tena saṃvatsaraṃ hariḥ |
pūjitaḥ paurṇamāsīṣu bhavatīti niviścayaḥ ||
tasyāṃ dānaṃ svalpam api mahad bhavati bhārgava |
dānaṃ taptaṃ japo homo yac cānyat sukṛtaṃ bhavet ||
bhārgava uvāca |
saṃvatsare paurṇamāsī mahāpūrvā vṛṣadhvaja |
kathaṃ jñeyā jagannātha tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||
[197]                śaṅkara uvāca |
yasyāṃ pūrṇendunā yogaṃ yāti jīvo mahābalaḥ |
paurṇamāsīti sā jñeyā mahāpūrvā dvijottamaiḥ ||
jīvo bṛhaspatiḥ |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe mahāpaurṇamāsīvratam |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
śrutam etat tvayākhyātaṃ paśupāsavimokṣaṇam |
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ laiṅgaṃ purā daivair anuṣṭhitam ||
vaktum arhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tvayā śrutam |
sūta uvāca |
purā sanatkumāreṇa śailādi sṛṣṭavān prabhuḥ |
nandī prāha ca tasmai yat pravadāmi samāsataḥ ||
devair daityais tathā yakṣair gandharvaiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ |
ṛṣibhiś ca mahābhāgair anuṣṭhitam anuttamam ||
vrataṃ dvādaśaliṅgākhyaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam |
bhogadaṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ (?) śubham ||
aviyogakaraṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhayanāśanam |
devair anuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā ||
kṛtvā kanīyasaṃ liṅgaṃ snāpya candanavāriṇā |
caitramāsādi viprendrāḥ śivaliṅgavrataṃ śubham ||
kṛtvā haimaṃ śubhaṃ padmaṃ karṇikākekasarānvitam |
[198]        navaratnais tu khacitam aṣṭapatraṃ yathāvidhi ||
karṇikāyāṃ nyasel liṅgaṃ sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhasaṃyutam |
tatra bhaktyā yathānyāyam arcayed bilvapatrakaiḥ ||
sitaiḥ sahasrakamalai raktair nīlotpalair api |
jātair anyair yathālābhaṃ gāyatryā snāpya suvrata ||
saṃpūjya caiva gandhādyair dhūpadīpaiś ca maṅgalaiḥ |
nīrājanīyaiś cānyaiś ca liṅgamūrtiṃ maheśvaram ||
agaruṃ dikṣiṇe dadyād aghoreṇa dvijottamaḥ |
paścime sadyamantreṇa dadyāc caiva manaḥśilāṃ ||
uttare vāmadevāya candanaṃ cāpi dāpayet |
puruṣeṇa muniśreṣṭha haritālaṃ ca pūrvataḥ ||
sitāgurūdbhavaṃ viprās tathā kṛṣṇāguror bhavam |
tathā gugguladhūpaṃ ca dadyād īśāya bhaktitaḥ ||
mahācaruṃ nivedyāsmād āḍhakānnam athāpi vā |
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ mahāvratam ||
sarvamāseṣu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo 'pi ca kīrtyate |
vaiśākhe vajraliṅgaṃ tu jyaiṣṭhe marakataṃ śubham ||
āṣāḍhe mauktikaṃ liṅgaṃ śrāvaṇe nīlanirmitam |
māsi bhādrapade liṅgaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ śubham ||
āśvine caiva viprendrā gomedakamayaṃ śubham |
pravālena ca kārttikyāṃ tathā vai mārgaśīrṣake ||
māghe ca sūryakāntena phālgune sphāṭikena tu |
sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimam ekaṃ vidhīyate ||
[199]        alābhe rājataṃ cāpi bilvapatraiḥ prapūjayet |
ratnānām apy alābhe tu hemnā vā rajatena vā ||
rajatasyāpy alābhe tu tāmralohena kārayet |
śailaṃ vā dārujaṃ vāpi mṛṇmayaṃ vā savedikam ||
sarvagandhamayaṃ vāpi kṣatrikaṃ parikalpayet |
haimantike mahādevaṃ śrīpatreṇaiva pūjayet ||
śrīpatraṃ kamalam |
sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimam ekam athāpi vā |
rājataṃ vāpi kamalaṃ hemakarṇikam uttamam ||
rajatasyāpy alābhe tu bilvapatraiś ca pūjayet |
sahasrakamalālābhe tadardhenāpi pūjayet ||
tadardhārdhena vā rudram aṣṭottaraśatena vā |
bilvapatre sthirā lakṣmīr devī lakṣaṇasaṃyutā ||
nīlotpale viśālākṣī utpale ṣaṇmukhaḥ svayam |
pādyair gaṇair mahādevaḥ sarvadevapatiḥ śivaḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śrīpatraṃ na tyajed budhaḥ |
nīlotpalaṃ śvetapadmam utpalaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
sarvavaśyakaraṃ vāraḥ śilā sarvārthasiddhidā |
kṛṣṇāgurusamudbhūtaṃ sarvapāpanikṛntanam ||
guggulaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca dhūpānāṃ ca nivedanam |
sarvarogakṣayakaraṃ candanaṃ sarvasiddhidam ||
saugandhikaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ sarvakāmaprasādhanam |
śvetāgurūdbhavaṃ caiva tathā kṛṣṇāgurūdbhavam ||
[200]        saumyaṃ sitāradhūpaṃ ca sākṣān nirvāṇasiddhidam |
śvetārkakusume sākṣāc caturvaktraḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
karṇikārasya kusume medhā sākṣād vyavasthitā |
karavīre gaṇādhyakṣo bake nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||
suṣṭugandhiṣu sarveṣu kusumeṣu nagātmajā |
tasmād etair yathālābhapuṣpair dhūpādibhis tathā ||
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ |
nivedayet tato bhaktyā pāyasaṃ ca mahācarum ||
saghṛtaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ ca sarvadravyasamanvitam |
śuddhānnaṃ cāpi mudgānnam āḍhakyabandhakaṃ tu vā ||
upahārāṇi puṣpāṇi nyāyenaivārjitāni ca |
nānāvidhāni cānnāni prokṣitāny ambhasā tataḥ ||
kṣīrājyaiḥ sarvadevānāṃ sthityartham amṛtaṃ kṛtam |
viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā sākṣāt toyeṣu supratiṣṭhitam ||
tasmāt saṃpūjayed devam anne prāṇaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
upahāre tathā puṣṭir vyajane pavanaḥ svayam ||
sarvātmako mahādevo gandhatoye hy apāṃpatiḥ |
paṭe vai prakṛtiḥ sākṣān mahādevo vyavasthitā ||
tasmād evaṃ yajed bhaktyā pratimāsaṃ yathāvidhi |
paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ sarvakāryārthasiddhaye ||
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā kṣāntiḥ saṃtoṣo dānam eva ca |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā viprā upavāsaṃ ca kārayet |
saṃvatsarānte godānaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
[201]        bhojayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā śrotriyān vedapāragān|
talliṅgaṃ pūjitaṃ tena sarvadravyasamanvitam ||
sthāpayed vā śivakṣetre dadyād vā brāhmaṇāya ca |
evaṃ sarveṣu māseṣu śivaliṅgaṃ mahāvratam ||
kuryād bhaktyā muniśreṣṭhās tad eva tapasāṃ param |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ nehāyāti kadācana |
atha vā hy ekamāse ca cared evaṃ vratottamam ||
śivalokam avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
atha vāpi vittahīnas talliṅgaṃ cinteyan naraḥ ||
varṣam ekaṃ varaṃ devaṃ sthānaṃ prāpya śivaṃ vrajet |
devatvaṃ ca pitṛtvaṃ ca devarājatvam eva ca ||
gāṇapatyaṃ padaṃ vāpi śakto 'pi labhate naraḥ |
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogam āpnujyāt ||
dravyārthī ca dhanaṃ puṇyam (?) āyuḥkāmāṃś ca nityajān |
yān yāṃś cintayate kāmāṃs tāṃs tān prāpyeha modate ||
ekamāsavratād eva cānte rudram avāpnuyāt |
idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ
vratottamaṃ viśvasṛjā ca dṛṣṭam |
hitāya devāsuramartyam iha
vidyādharāṇāṃ paramaṃ śivena ||
[202]        saṃpūjya devaṃ vidhinaivam īśaṃ
praṇamya mūrdhnā saha bhṛtyaputraiḥ |
vyapohanaṃ nāma japastavaś ca
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śivaṃ prayatnāt ||
purā kṛto viśvasṛjā stavaś ca
hitāya devena jagattrayasya |
pitāmahenaiva surendrasārdhaṃ
mahānubhāvāt tu mahārham etat ||
adhivṛttyā stavaṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham |
nandinaś ca mukhāt śrutvā kumāreṇa mahātmanā ||
vyāsena kathitaṃ tasmād bahumānena vā śrutam |
namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya nirmalāya yaśasvine ||
vṛṣāntakāya sarvāya bhavāya paramātmane |
pañcavaktro daśabhujo hy akṣipañcadaśair yutaḥ ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śāntaḥ sarvopari susaṃsthitaḥ |
padmāsanasthaḥ somo 'yaṃ pāpam āśu vyapohatu ||
īśānaḥ puruṣaś caiva aghoraḥ sadya eva ca |
vāmadevaś ca bhagavān pāpam āśu vyapohatu ||
anantaḥ sarvavidyeśaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
eko rudro hy ekagurus trailokyānumito vidhuḥ ||
śivadhyānaikasaṃpannaḥ same pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
trimūrtir bhagavān īśaḥ śivabhaktiprabodhakaḥ |
[203]        śivadhyānaikasaṃpannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñ chivadhyānarataḥ sadā |
śivāsv anurataḥ sākṣāt sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
śikhaṇḍī bhagavān śāntaḥ śivabhasmānulepanāt |
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
trailokyanāmitā devī oṃkārā ca purātanī |
dīkṣāyaṇī mahādevī gaurī haimavatī śubhā ||
ekavarṇāgrajā māyā pāṭalāyās tathaiva ca |
aparṇā varadā devī varadānaikatatparā ||
umā suraharī sākṣāt kāśīsthā pāpamardinī |
khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇī devī karāgratanupallavī |
naiṣkarmakādibhir divyais tanubhiḥ putrakair vṛtā ||
menayā nandayā devī kālikā vārijekṣaṇā |
ambā yā vītaśokasya nandinaś ca mahātmanaḥ |
śubhāvatyā suśīrṣā vā pañcacūḍā varapradā ||
sṛṣṭārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtiś ca gatāvyayā |
trayoviṃśatibhis tattvair mahadādyair vijṛmbhitā ||
lakṣmyādiśaktibhir nityaṃ namitā naganandinī |
manonmathī mahādevī māyā vā maṇḍanapriyā |
māyayā hi jagat sarvaṃ brahmādya (?) sacarācaram ||
kṣobhanī mohanī nityaṃ yoginī hṛdi saṃsthitā |
ekādaśe sthitā loke indīvaranibhekṣaṇā ||
bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ sarvadevair abhiṣṭutā |
[204]        gaṇendrāmbhojagarbhendrayamavitteśapūrvakaiḥ ||
saṃbhūtā jananī teṣāṃ sarvopadravanāśinī |
bhaktānām ārtihā bhavyā bhavabhāvavilāsinī ||
bhuktidā muktidā devī bhaktānām abhayapradā |
sā me sākṣād umā devī pāpam āśu vyapohatu ||
caṇḍasarvagaṇeśāno mukhāc chambhor viniḥsṛtaḥ |
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
sālaṅkāyanapātraś ca halam agnau sthitaḥ prabhuḥ |
yāmyatāṃ manutāṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇeśvaraḥ ||
sarvadaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvaprabhaḥ prabhur īśvaraḥ |
sanārāyaṇakair devaiḥ sendracandradivākaraiḥ ||
sarvaiś ca yakṣagandharvair bhūtair bhūtividhāyakaiḥ |
uragair ṛṣibhiś caiva brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā ||
stutas trailokyanāthas tu munir antaḥ pure sthitaḥ |
sarvadā pūjitaḥ sarvair nandī pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
mahākālo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ |
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
vṛṣabho muniśārdūlaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ |
śivārcanarato nityaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
merumandarasaṅkāśanavakoṭipramāṇataḥ |
airāvatādibhir divyair divyair yogasamanvitaiḥ ||
baddhā hṛtpuṇḍarīkākṣestambe vṛttiṃ nirudhya ca |
[205]        gajendravakro yaḥ sākṣād āsaptapātālapādakaḥ ||
saptadvīpo bhujaṅgakāḥ |
saptārṇavakupyaiś caiva sarvatīrthānugaḥ śivaḥ |
ākā vā devo devo digdhāhuḥ somasūryāgnilocanaḥ ||
hatāsurā mahāvṛkṣā mahāvidyā mahotkaṭāḥ |
brahmodyā dhāraṇair divyair yogapāśasamanvitaḥ ||
vṛddho hṛtpuṇḍarīkākṣastambe vṛttinivṛtti ca |
gajendravaktro yaḥ sākṣād gaṇakoṭiśatair vṛtaḥ ||
śivadhyānaikasaṃpannaḥ same pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
bhṛgīṣaḥ piṅgalākṣo 'sau bhasitāsiktadehayuk ||
śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
caturbhis tanubhir nityaṃ sarvārivinimardanaḥ ||
skandaḥ śaktidharaḥ śāntaḥ senānīr gajavāhanaḥ |
śivāsenāpatiḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
manvāśarvas tatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatis tathā |
ugro bhīmo mahādevaḥ śivārcanarataḥ sadā |
ye te pāpaṃ vyapohantu mūrtayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śatamur nīlalohitaḥ |
īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ ||
kapīśaś ca divākaraḥ |
ete vai bhairavādyās tu rudrārudrasamā bhavāḥ |
śivaprāṇasamāpannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama ||
vaikartano vivasvāṃś ca mātaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ |
[206]        lokaprakāśakaś caiva lokasākṣī trivikramaḥ ||
ādityaś ca tathā sūryaḥ aṃśumāṃś ca divākaraḥ |
ete vai dvādaśādityā vyapohatu malaṃ mama ||
gaganaḥ sparśanas tejo rasaś ca pṛthivīruhā |
candraḥ sūryas tathā cātmā vasavaḥ śivabhāvitāḥ ||
pāpaṃ vyapohantu malaṃ bhayaṃ nānāvidhaṃ mama |
vasavaḥ pāvakaś caiva cayonair ṛtir eva ca ||
varuṇo vāyuḥ somaś ca īśāno bhagavān hariḥ |
pitāmahaś ca bhagavān śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ||
ete pāpaṃ vyapohantu manasā karmaṇā kṛtam |
gabhastisparśano bāhur anilo marutas tathā ||
prāṇopānaś ca jīveśo marutaś caiva bhāṣitāḥ ||
śivārcanarataḥ sarvo vyapohantu malaṃ mama |
khecarī vasucārī ca brahmahā brahmavit sudhīḥ ||
suṣeṇaḥ śāśvataḥ puṣṭaḥ apuṣṭaś ca mahābalaḥ |
ete vai cāraṇāḥ śambhoḥ pūjayātīva śobhitaḥ ||
vyapohantu malaṃ sarve pāpaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam |
mantrajño mantravit prājño haṃsarāṭ siddhapūjitaḥ ||
siddhivit paramaḥ siddhiḥ sarvasiddhipradāyinaḥ |
vyapohantu malaṃ sarve siddhāḥ śivapadārcakāḥ ||
yakṣo yajñeśadhanadau janmano maṇibhadrakaiḥ |
pūrṇabhadraḥ svairamālī śiviḥ puṇḍalir eva ca ||
narendraś caiva yajñeśā vyapohantu malaṃ mama |
[207]        anantaḥ kulikaś caiva vāsukas takṣakas tathā ||
karkoṭako mahāpadmaḥ śaṅkhapolo mahābalaḥ |
śivapraṇāmam āpannaḥ śivadevaprabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
malaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohantu viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam |
vīṇājñaḥ kinnarajñaś ca śūrasenaḥ pramardanaḥ ||
atiśayaḥ suprabhogī gītajñaś ceti kinnarāḥ |
śivapraṇāmasaṃpannā vyapohantu malaṃ mama ||
vidyāvinīto vidyālīrāśir (?) vedavidāṃ varaḥ |
prabuddho vibudhaḥ śrīmān kṛtajñaś ca mahāyaśāḥ ||
ete vidyādharāḥ sarve śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
vyapohantu malaṃ sarvaṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ ||
hayagrīvo mahājṛmbhaḥ kālanemir mahāyaśāḥ |
sugrīvo mardakaś caiva piṅgalo devamārdavaḥ ||
prahlādaś cānuhrādaś ca śivir brāṣkala eva ca |
jṛmbhakumbau ca māyāvī kārtivīryaḥ kṛtañjayaḥ ||
ete surā mahātmāno mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ |
vyapohantu mahāghoraṃ pāpabhāraṃ mamaiva ca ||
garutmāṃś ca hariś caiva pakṣirāṅgīmamardanaḥ (?) ||
nāgaśatrur hiraṇyābho vainateyaḥ prabhañjanaḥ |
nāgānāṃ viṣanāśaś ca viṣṇuvāhana eva ca ||
ete hiraṇyavarṇābhā garuḍā viṣṇuvāhanāḥ |
nānābharaṇasaṃpannā vyapohantu bhayaṃ mama ||
agastiś ca vasiṣṭhaś ca aṅgirā bhṛgur eva ca |
[208]        kaśyapo nāradaś caiva dadhīciś cyavanas tathā ||
upamanyus tathānye ca ṛṣayaḥ śivabhāvitāḥ |
śivārcanaratā hantu manasā karmaṇā kṛtam ||
gabastisparśano vāyur anilo marutas tathā |
prāṇaḥ prāṇeśajīveśau jīvo maruta eva ca ||
śivārcanaratāḥ sarve vyapohantu malaṃ mama |
khecarī vasucārī ca brahmahā brahmavit sudhīḥ ||
pitaraḥ pitāmahāś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahāḥ |
agnisvattā barhiṣadaś tathā mātāmahādayaḥ ||
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ [-āḥ?] |
lakṣmīś ca dharaṇī caiva gāyatrī ca sarasvatī ||
durgā umā śacī jyeṣṭhā mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ |
devatānāṃ matāś caiva gaṇā mātāmahādayaḥ ||
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ |
lakṣmīś ca dharaṇī caiva gaṇānāṃ mātaras tathā ||
bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvāḥ pannagā gaṇamātaraḥ |
prasādād devadevasya vyapohantu bhayaṃ mama ||
urvaśī menakā caiva rambhā caiva tilottamā |
sumukhī durmukhī caiva kāmukī kāmavardhinī ||
athānyāḥ sarvalokeṣu divyāś cāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ |
śivāya tāṇḍavaṃ nityaṃ kurvanti śivabhāvitāḥ ||
geye śivārcanaratā vyapohantu malaṃ mama |
arkaḥ somo 'ṅgārakaś ca budhaś caiva bṛhaspatiḥ ||
[209]        śukraḥ śanaiśvaraś caiva rāhuḥ ketur mahābalaḥ |
vyapohantu bhayaṃ ghoraṃ śiraḥpīḍāṃ śivārcakāḥ |
maṣo (?) vṛṣo 'tha mithunaṃ tathā karkaṭakāḥ śubhāḥ ||
siṃhaś ca kanthā vipulā tulā vai vṛṣcikas tathā |
dhanuś ca makaraś caiva kumbho mīnas tathaiva ca ||
rāśayo dvādaśāś caitāḥ śivapūjāparāyaṇāḥ |
vyapohantu paraṃ pāpaṃ prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ |
aśvino bharaṇī caiva kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā ||
śrimān mṛgaśirā ārdrā punarvasupuṣyasarpakāḥ |
maghā vai pūrvaphālgunyā uttarāphālguṇī tathā ||
hastā vitrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhakā |
jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ mahābhāgā pūrvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca ||
śravaṇaś ca dhaniṣṭḥā ca tathā śatabhiṣāpi ca |
pūrvabhādrapadā caiva tathā prauṣṭhapadā śubhā ||
pauṣṇyā ca devyā satataṃ vyapohantu malaṃ mama |
jvaraṅkuṇḍodakaś caiva śatakarṇo mahābalaḥ ||
mahākarṇaḥ prabhūtaś ca prabhur vā prītivardhanāḥ |
koṭkoṭiśataiś caiva bhūtā no parivāritāḥ ||
vyapohantu bhayaṃ pāpaṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ |
śivadhyānaikasaṃpannāḥ śiśirā indramūrtibhāḥ ||
kundendusadṛśākārāḥ kundenduvaḍavāmukhaḥ |
vaḍavāmukhyaśatryuryāvaḍavāmukhabhedanaḥ (?) |
vapuṣmāṃś caiva sadbhaktaḥ kṣīroda iva pāṇḍuraḥ ||
[210]        rudrāloke sthito nityaṃ raudraiḥ sārdhaṃ sthito gaṇaiḥ |
vṛṣendro visṛtir devo viśvasya jagataḥ pitā ||
vṛto nandādibhir nityaṃ mātṛbhir meṣamardanaḥ |
śivārcanarato nityaṃ mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
gavāṃ mātā jaganmātā rudraloke vyavasthitā |
mātā gavāṃ mahābhāgā same pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
suśīlā śīlasaṃpannā śivabhaktiparāyāṇā |
śivaloke śīlasaṃpannā śivabhaktiparāyaṇā ||
śivaloke sthitā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
vedaśāstrārthasarvajñaḥ sarvadeveśvaro 'maraḥ ||
jyeṣṭhaḥ sarveśvaraḥ saumyo mahāviṣṇucatuṣṭayam ||
ādyaḥ senāpatiḥ śāstraṃ modate meṣamardanaḥ |
airāvatagajārūḍhāḥ kṛṣṇakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ ||
kṛṣṇagaurāktanayanaḥ śaśipaṇṇagabhūṣaṇaḥ |
etaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācaiś ca kūṣmāṇḍaiś caiva saṃvṛtaḥ ||
śivārcanarataḥ sākṣāt same pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
brahmāṇī caiva māheśī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā ||
vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍāgnāyikā tathā |
etā vai mātaraḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokapūjitāḥ ||
yoginībhir mahāpāpaṃ vyapohantu samāhitāḥ |
vīrabhadro mahātejā himakundendusannibhaḥ ||
rudrasya tanayo raudraḥ śūlaśaktamahākaraḥ |
sahasrabāhuḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvāyudhadharaḥ svayam ||
[211]        tretāgninayanopeto trailokyābhayadaḥ prabhuḥ |
mātṝṇāṃ rakṣako nityaṃ mahāvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ ||
trailokyanirmitaḥ śrīmān śivapādārcane rataḥ |
yajñasya ca śiracchettā pūṣadantavināśanaḥ ||
vahner dantarātaḥ sākṣādgaganetranipātanaḥ |
gaṇeśvaro yaśo nārī sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā varadā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā |
mahālakṣmīr jaganmātā sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
mahāmohā mahābhāgā mahābhūtagaṇair vṛtā |
śivārcanaratā nityaṃ sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
lakṣmīḥ sarvaguṇopetā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā |
śarmadā sarvadā devī sā me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
saṃhārūḍhā mahādevī mahiṣāsuramardinī |
śivārcanaratā rudrā mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu ||
rudrāṇī rudradayitā brahmāṇḍagaṇanāyakā |
kūṣmāṇḍaś ceti me pāpaṃ vyapohatu samāhitāḥ ||
anena devīṃ stutvā tu cānte sarvaṃ kṣamāpayet |
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pratimāsaṃ dvijottamān ||
vyapohanastavam imaṃ yaḥ paṭhet śṛṇuyād api |
vidhūya sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate ||
kanyārthi labhate kanyāṃ jayakāmo jayaṃ labhet |
arthakāmo labhed arthaṃ putrakāmo bahūn sutān |
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogān āpnuyāt ||
[212]        yān yān kāmān prārthayate yajñānāṃ caiva yat phalam |
dānānāṃ caiva yat puṇyaṃ vratānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ japtvā prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
goghnaś caiva kṛtaghnaś ca vīrahā brahmahā tathā |
śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśvāsaghātakaḥ ||
kuṣṭhaḥ pāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā |
nihatya sarvapāpāni śivaloke mahīyate ||
iti liṅgapurāṇoktaṃ malavyapohanaṃ pāśupatavratam |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi vrataṃ pāśupataṃ varam |
brahmādayo 'pi yat kṛtvā sarve pāśupatāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
vāyur uvāca |
rahasyaṃ yat pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpanikṛntanam |
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mayā ca śirasi śrutam ||
kālaś caitrapaurṇamāsī deśaḥ śivaparigrahaḥ |
kṣetrārāmādi anyo vā praśastaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||
tatra pūrvatrayodaśyāṃ susnātas tu kṛtāhnikaḥ |
atulāryaṃ samācāryaṃ saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca ||
pūjāṃ svaśākhikīṃ kṛtvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ svayam |
śuklayajñopavītī ca śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
darbhāsane samāsīno darbhamuṣṭiḥ pragṛhya ca |
pāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukho vāpy udaṅmukhaḥ ||
[213]        dhyātvā devaṃ ca devīṃ ca tadvijñāpanavartmanā |
vratam etat karomīti bhavet saṅkalpya dīkṣitaḥ ||
yāvat śarīrapātaṃ ca dvādaśābdam athāpi vā |
tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā māsadvādaśakaṃ tu vā ||
tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā māsam ekam athāpi vā |
dinadvādaśakaṃ vātha vratasaṅkalpanaṃ vidhiḥ ||
samiddham agnim ādhāya virājo homakāraṇāt |
hutvājyena samidbhiś ca caruṇā ca yathākramam ||
pūrṇāyāḥ purato bhūpa tattvānāṃ śuddhim uddiśet |
juhuyān mūlamantreṇ tāre ca samidhādibhiḥ ||
tattvāny etāni maddehe śuddhāny anyāni saṃsmara |
pañcabhūtāni tattvāni pañca pañcendriyāṇi ca ||
jñānakarmavibhedena pañca pañca vibhāgaśaḥ |
tvagādidhātavaḥ sapta pañcaprāṇādivāyavaḥ ||
manaś cāhaṃkṛtaṃ tadvan nirguṇī prakṛtipūruṣo ||
rāgo vidyā kalā caiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca |
athātha śuddhavidyāś ca maheśvarasadāśivau |
śaktiś ca śivatattvāni tāni ca kramaśo viduḥ ||
mantrais tu virajo hutvā hotās tair vigato bhavet |
atha gomayam ādāya piṇḍīkṛtya nimantrā ca ||
nyasyāgre taṃ tu saṃrakṣya dine tasmin haviṣyabhuk |
prabhāte ca caturdaśyāṃ tac ca sarvaṃ yathoditam ||
[214]        dine tasmin nirāhāraḥ kālaśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
prātaḥ parvaṇi vāpy eva hutvā homaṃ ca tattvataḥ |
upasaṃgṛhya rudrāgniṃ gṛhṇīyād bhasma pātrataḥ ||
tatas tu jaṭilo muṇḍaḥ śiṣyaiś ca kaja eva ca |
hutvāgnau tu punar vītalajjaś ca syād digambaraḥ |
anyaḥ kaṣāyavasanaś carmacīrāmbaro yathā ||
raktāmbaro valkalī ca bhaved daṇḍī ca mūṣalī |
prakṣālya caraṇau paścād dvir ācamyātmanas tanum ||
sakalī kṛtya tad bhasma viṭajāmalasaṃbhavam |
agnir ityādibhir mantraiḥ ṣaḍbhir ātharvaṇaiḥ kramāt |
nirmathyāṅgāni mūrddhādicaraṇāntaṃ ca saṃspṛśet ||
agnir it bhasmavāyur iti bhasmajalam iti bhasmasthalam iti bharma sarvadaṃ hutvā idaṃ bhasmaṇāṅg etāni cakṣuṣi ity ātharvaṇamantrāḥ ṣaṭ |
tatas tena krameṇaiva samunmulya ca bhasmanaḥ |
sarvāṅgodvalanaṃ kuryāt praṇavena śiveti ca ||
tatas tripuṇḍraṃ racayet tirāyuṣasamāhvayam |
śivabhāvaṃ (?) samāgamya śivayogam athācaret (?) ||
kuryāt trisaṃdhyam ity evam etat pāśuparaṃ vratam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitat paśutvaṃ vinivartayet ||
tat paśutvaṃ parityajya kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam |
pūjanīyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ ||
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ haimaṃ navaratnair alaṃkṛtam |
[215]        karṇikākeśaropetam aśanaṃ parikalpayet ||
śvetakṛṣṇanibhaṃ bhānuṃ sitaraktam athāpi vā |
padmaṃ tasyāpy abhāve tu kevalaṃ bhāvanāmayam ||
padmasya karṇikāmadhye kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kanīyasam |
sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhakopetaṃ pūjayed aśritaḥ kramāt ||
pratiṣṭhāpya vidhānena liṅgaṃ kṛtasuśobhanam |
parikalpyāsane mūrtiṃ pañcavakraṃ prabhākaram |
pañcagavyādibhiḥ puṇyair yathāvibhavasaṃbhṛtaiḥ ||
snāpayet kalaśaiḥ pūrṇaiḥ sahasrāṇi susaṃbhavaiḥ |
gandhadravyaiḥ sakarpūraiś candanādyaiś ca kuṅkumaiḥ ||
savedikaṃ samālipya liṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇabhūṣitam |
vilavpatraiś ca padmaiś ca vātra raktais tathotpalaiḥ ||
utpalair nīlotpalaiḥ |
nīlotpalais tathānyaiś ca puṣpais tais taiḥ sagandhibhiḥ |
puṣpaiḥ praśastaiś cetaiś ca puṣpair dūrvākṣatādibhiḥ ||
samabhyarcya yathālābhaṃ mahāpūjāvidhānataḥ |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā cārghyaṃ naivedyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
nivedayitvā vidhivat kalyāṇaṃ ca samācaret |
iṣṭāni ca viśiṣṭāni nyāyenopārthitāni ca ||
sarvadravyāṇi deyāni vrate tv asmin viśeṣataḥ |
(śrīpatrotpalapadmānāṃ saṃkhyām āha trikāmatā) | pratyekamamaṇavyāpitam (?) aṣṭottaraṃ dvijāḥ | tatrāpi ca viśeṣān yad bilvapatrakaṃ paraṃ prāhuḥ | [216] parān padmasahasrakān nīlotpalādiṣṭo 'py atatsamānaṃ bilvapatrakam |
puṣpāntare na niyamo yathālābhaṃ prapūjayet |
aṣṭāṅgam arghyam utkṛṣṭaṃ dhūpadīpau viśeṣataḥ ||
kṛṣṇāgarur aghorākhye raktā sadyamanaḥśilī |
candanaṃ vāmadevākhye mukhe kṛṣṇāguruḥ punaḥ ||
paurapeguggulaṃ (?) savye saumye saugandhike mukhe |
iśāne 'pi tu sītādīn dadyād dhūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
śarkarā madhukarpūraṃ kapilāghṛtasaṃyutam |
candanāgurukuṣṭhāś ca mālyaṃ vai saṃpracakṣyate |
karpūravartijopādyā devī dīpāvalis tataḥ ||
aghoracandanaṃ deyaṃ praticakramataḥ param |
prathamāvaraṇe pūjya kramād dhivakharāmukhī (?) ||
brahmāṅgāni tataś caivaṃ prathamāvaraṇe 'rcayet |
dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyā vidyeśāś cakravartinaḥ ||
tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyā bhavādyāś cāṣṭamūrtayaḥ |
mahādevādayas tatra tathaikādaśamūrtayaḥ ||
caturthāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ |
bahir eva tu padmasya pañcame jyotiṣāṃ gaṇaḥ ||
sarve devāś ca devyaś ca sarvāḥ sarve 'pi khecarāḥ |
pātālavāsinaś caiva sarve munigaṇā api ||
yogino guravaḥ sarve pañcagomātaras tathā |
kṣetrapālāś ca sagaṇāḥ sarvaṃ vaitac carācaram (?) ||
athāvaraṇapūjānte saṃpūjya parameśvaram |
[217]        śayyāsanaṃ srajaṃ hṛdyaṃ havir bhaktyā nivedayet ||
mukhavāsādidattānāṃ tāmbūlaṃ sopadaṃśakam |
alaṃkṛtya ca bhūpo 'pi nānāpuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
nīrājanāntāṃ vistīrya pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
kramukaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ ca śayanaṃ ca samarpayet ||
yad yad yasya hitaṃ hṛdyaṃ tat sarvam anurūpataḥ |
kṛtvā ca kārayitvā ca sthitvā ca pratipūjanam ||
stotravyayohanaṃ japtvā vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet |
(pañcākṣarī vidyā ca vāyusaṃhitoktā) |
asyāḥ paramavidyāyāḥ svarūpam adhunocyate ||
ādau namaḥ prayoktavyaṃ śivāyeti tataḥ param |
saiṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā sarvasthitiśirogatā |
śabdajo tasya sarvasya bījabhūtaḥ samāsataḥ ||
prathamaṃ tanmukhād gīrṇā mama mevātmavācikā (?) |
taptacāmīkaraprakhyā pīnonnatapayodharā ||
caturbhujā trinayanā bālendukṛtaśekharā |
padmotpaladharā saumyā varadābhayapāṇikā ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā |
sitapadmāsanāsīnā nīlakuñcitamūrdhajā ||
asyāḥ pañcavidhāvarṇā prasphuradravimaṇḍalā |
pītakṛṣṇās tathā dhūmravarṇābhārakta eva ca ||
pṛthak prayuktāyevaitā bindunādavibhūṣitā |
ardhacandrākṛtir bindunādadīpaśikhākṛtiḥ ||
[218]        bījaṃ dvitīyabījeṣu mantrasyāsya varānane |
dīrghapūrvaturīyasya pañcamaṃ śaktim ādiśet ||
vāmadevo nāma ṛṣiḥ paṅktichandaś ca āditaḥ |
devatāśiva evāhaṃ mantrasyāsya varānane ||
umātra vai varārohā viśvāmitras tathāṅgirāḥ |
bhāradvājaś ca varṇānāṃ kramaśa ṛṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
gāyatry anuṣṭup triṣṭup (?) ca chandāṃsi bṛhatī virāṭ |
indro rudro harir brahmā skandas (?) teṣāṃ ca devatāḥ ||
mama pañca mukhāny āhuḥ sthāne teṣāṃ varānane |
pūrvādir vārdhapūrvaṃ taṃ nakārādi yathākramam ||
udāttaḥ prathamo varṇaṃ caturthaś ca dvitīyakaḥ |
pañcamaḥ svaritaś caiva madhyamo nihataḥ svayam ||
mūlavidyā śivaṃ śaivaṃ śūktaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ tathā |
nāmāny asya vijānīyād evaṃ me hṛdayaṃ matam ||
nakāraḥ śiva ucyeta makāras tu śikhocyate |
śakāraḥ kavacaṃ tadvad vākāro netra ucyate ||
yakāro 'straṃ namaḥ svāhāvaṣaṭhuṃvoṣaḍ ity athaḥ |
phaḍ ity api ca varṇānām ante 'ṅgatvaṃ yadā tadā ||
tatrāpi mūlamantro 'yaṃ kiṃcid bhedasamanvitam |
tatrāsya pañcamo varṇo dvādaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ ||
tasmād anena mantreṇa manovākkāyabhedataḥ |
śivayor arcanaṃ kuryāj japahomādikaṃ tathā ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kṛtvā snānaṃ samarcayet |
[219]        tataḥ purastād devasya suvidye ca prapūjayet ||
datvārghapuṣṭau puṣpāṇi devam uddiśya liṅgataḥ |
abhiś cāgniṃ ca (?) saṃrakṣya yad vā devasya nāmataḥ ||
pratyahaṃ janayatv evaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ purohita (?) |
tatas tasyāmbujaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitam ||
samarpayet sa gurave sthāpayed vā śivālaye |
saṃpūjya ca gurūn anyān vratinaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
bhaktān dvijān abhuktāṃś ca dīnānāthāṃś ca toṣayet |
svayaṃ cānaśanaprāyaḥ phalamūlāśano 'tha vā ||
payovrato vā bhikṣāśī divaivaikāśano bhavet (?) |
naktaṃ bhuktvāśanaṃ nityaṃ bhūśayo virataḥ śuciḥ ||
bhasmaśāyī śaṇāśāyī vīrāsanaśayo 'tha vā |
brahmacaryarato nityaṃ vratam etat samācaret ||
arkavāre tathendau vā pañcadaśyāṃ ca pakṣayoḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ śaktyā hy upavased api ||
pāṣaṇḍapatitodakyāsūtakāntyajapūrvikān |
varjayet sarvayatnena manasā karmaṇā girā ||
kṣamā dānaṃ dayā satyam ahiṃsā śīlatā bhavet |
saṃtuṣṭaś ca praśāntaś ca japadhyānaratas tathā ||
kuryāt triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ bhasmasnānam athāpi vā |
pūjā vaiśākhikaṃ caiva manasā karmanā girā ||
bahunātra kim uktena nācared aśivavratī |
prasādāt tu sadācāre nirūpya gurulāghavam ||
[220]        ucchritāṃ (?) niṣkṛtiṃ kuryāt pūjāhomajapādibhiḥ |
āsamāptau vratasyaivam ācaren na pramādataḥ |
godānaṃ govṛṣotsargaṃ kuryāt pūjāṃ ca saṃsadaḥ ||
sāmānyam etat kathitaṃ vratasyāsya vidhānataḥ |
pratimāsaṃ viśeṣaṃ ca pravadāmi yathākramam ||
vaiśākhe vajraliṅgaṃ tu jyaiṣṭhe māravrataṃ śubham |
āṣāḍhe mauktikaṃ vidyāt śrāvaṇe nīlanirmitam ||
māse bhādrapade devaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ śubham |
āśvayujyāṃ tu vidhivad gomedakamayaṃ śubham ||
kārtikyāṃ tu drumaṃ liṅgaṃ vaidūryaṃ māgaśīrṣake |
puṣparāgamayaṃ puṣye māghe tu maṇijoratham ||
phālgunyāṃ candrakānto 'yaṃ caitramāse 'tha vā tathā |
sarvamāseṣu ratnānām alābhe hemam eva vā ||
hemālābhe rājate vā tāmrajaṃ loham eva vā |
mṛṇmayaṃ vā yathālābhaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vānyad eva vā ||
sarvaṃ gandhamayaṃ vācyaṃ liṅgaṃ kuryād yathāruci |
vratāvasānasamaye samācaritanaityakam ||
kṛtvā vaiśākhikīṃ pujāṃ hutvā caiva yathāruci |
saṃpūjya yajanācāryaṃ vratinaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
deśikenābhyanujñātaḥ prāṅmukhī vāpy udaṅmukhaḥ |
darbhāsano darbhapāṇiḥ prāṇāpānau niyamya ca ||
japitvā śaktito mūlaṃ dhyātvā liṅgaṃ triyambakam |
anujñāpya yathāpūrvaṃ namaskṛtya kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
[221]        samutsṛjāmi bhagavān vratam etat tvadājñayā |
ity ukto dīrghamūlān tu darbhān uttaratas tyajet ||
tato darbhajuṭādhāramekhalā api cotsṛjet |
yaḥ kuryād vratikīṃ (?) dīkṣām ādehāntamanāḥ (?) kila ||
vratam etat prakurvīta sa tu vai naiṣṭhikaḥ smṛtaḥ |
satyaḥ śamī ca vijñeyo mahāpāśupatas tathā ||
sa eva tapasā śreṣṭhaḥ sa eva ca mahāvratī |
na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścit kṛtakṛtyo mumukṣuḥ ||
yatiś ca naiṣṭhiko yātaḥ tam āhur naiṣthikottamam |
yā nārye tad dvādaśāhaṃ vratam etat samācaret ||
so 'pi (?) naiṣṭhikatulyaḥ syāt śivavratasamanvayāt |
ghṛtākto yaś cared etad vrataṃ vrataparāyaṇaḥ ||
dvitraikadivasaṃ vāpi sa ca kaścana naiṣṭhikaḥ |
kṛtakṛtyaś ca niṣkāmo yaś cared vratam uttamam ||
śivārpitātmā satataṃ tenānyaḥ sadṛśaḥ kvacit |
bhavacchinno dvijo vidvān mahāpātakasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
pāpair vimucyate sadyo mucyate na ca saṃśayaḥ |
rudrāgre padavīṃ kīrya tad bhasma parikīrtitam ||
yasmāt sarveṣu lokeṣu vīryavān kṛtasaṃyataḥ |
bhasmaniṣṭhasya dahyante dāmo bhasmāni saṅgamāt ||
bhasmasnānaviśuddhātmā bhasmaniṣtha iti smṛtaḥ |
bhasmasaṃdigdhasarvāṅgo bhasmaniṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ ||
[222]        bhūtapreteṣu sarveṣu lokeṣv anyeṣu vā bhavet |
arogaḥ sarvasiddhārtho bhavec cātīvaduḥsahaḥ (?) ||
bhasmaniṣṭhasya sānnidhyāvidravīti na saṃśayaḥ||
māsakambhasikaṃ proktaṃ bhakṣakalmaṣabhakṣaṇāt |
bhūti bhūtikaraṃ puṃsāṃ rakṣa rakṣa paraṃ param ||
kim artham iha vaktavyaṃ bhasmamāhātmyakāraṇam |
vratī ca bhasmanā snātaḥ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ ||
paramāstraṃ ca śaucānāṃ bhasmaitat pārameśvaram |
dhaumyagrajasya tapasi vyāpādo 'yaṃ nivāritaḥ ||
yasmāt sarve jayanty enaḥ kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam |
dhanavad bhasma saṃgṛhya bhasmasnānarato bhavet ||
iti vāyusaṃhitoktaṃ pāśupataṃ vratam |
atha gajapūjā |
tatra śrīgajeśvaraprārthanam adhikṛtyāha pālakādyaḥ|
evam astv iti deveśas tam vāca mataṅgajam ||
āṣāḍhyāṃ pūrṇacandrāyāṃ mām abhyarcya narādhipāḥ |
tava pūjāṃ kariṣyanti datto hy eṣa varas tava ||
tasmād bhavasamārājapūjā kāryā narottamaiḥ |
śrīgajāya vidhānena śucibhis tūpavāsitaiḥ ||
[223]        śrīkāmaiś ca viśeṣeṇa sadaiśvaryakarī śubhā |
datvā tasya varaṃ devo bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ |
gataḥ svam ālayaṃ devo gatāḥ sarvāś ca devatāḥ ||
śriyaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ yasmāt pūjāvidhānataḥ |
prakhyātaḥ śrīgajas tasmāj jayado nṛpasattama ||
tenaiṣā kriyate pūjā dviradānām tu nityaśaḥ |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi kalpam asya narādhipa ||
caturṇāṃ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ dravyam anyatu (?) bandhubhiḥ |
upoṣya grāhayed vipro baliṃ homāṃś ca kārayet ||
puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa tataḥ svasti vācya dvijottamān |
pañcāratnipramāṇaṃ syād agranthikam akoṭaram ||
ślakṣṇaṃ (?) caivānupūrvaṃ ca bhakṣakaiḥ sādhuvarjitam |
āyāmātāsya ca bhavet karṇikā dvādaśāṅgulā ||
viṃśatyaṅgulanāhā ca kāryā tu susamāhitā |
velāgavākṣanalinīm agnivyañjanakaṃ tathā ||
vaidalaṃ yājñikaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ tathaivāsanakaṅkatam |
sacandanāṃś ca kalaśāṃś caturaḥ sodakāṃs tathā |
sāmānyaṃ yajñavat sarvaṃ śeṣaṃ dravyam upāharet ||
tato vipraḥ śucir bhūtvā namaskṛtya maheśvaram |
sanatkumāraṃ varadaṃ śrīgajaṃ ca mahābalam ||
sarvān devān namaskṛtya diśaś cāṣṭau samāhitaḥ |
sarvān ṛṣigaṇāṃś caiva tathā nakṣatramaṇḍalam ||
[224]        samudānāpagāḥ sarvāḥ samahoragarākṣasāḥ |
parvatāḥ sarvabhūtāni jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ jagat ||
airāvatāṃś cātha punar namaskṛtya diśāṅ gajān |
upoṣya saṃviśed rātrau vāsobhir ahatair dvijaḥ ||
senānyāṃś ca namaskṛtya śucir bhūtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ |
kuśāstaraṇasaṃvṛtte sthaṇḍile prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
śvobhūte punar utthāya snāto bhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
tasthe yas tu (?) gajendrasya namaskṛtyādhirohayet ||
sacchatraṃ tālavyajanaṃ mālyadāmopaśobhitam |
nanditūryeṇa mahatā codyamānena śobhitam ||
sālaṅkaraṇakaiḥ pūraṃ hemajālavibhūṣitam |
nānākārais tathā vastraiḥ samantāt pariveṣṭitam ||
candanāgurumiśraiś ca sarvagandhair alaṃkṛtam |
strīrūpaveśaiḥ puruṣaiḥ paricaryopaśobhitaiḥ |
jalpadbhir niṣṭhuraṃ vākyaṃ prahasadbhis tathaiva ca ||
catuṣpathe vīthimārge tathaiva catvareṣu ca |
rājamārgeṣu ca bhṛśaṃ ghoṣavantas tatas tataḥ ||
arcayiṣyanti taṃ devaṃ rājāno vijayaiṣiṇaḥ |
senāpatir amātyāś ca ye cānye tadvijānataḥ ||
pūjayanti yathā nyāyaṃ tathaiva gajajīvinaḥ |
[225]        ato 'nyathā tu kurvāṇāḥ sasaptibalavāhanāḥ |
jvarājālair vinaśyanti devatāvikrameṇa vai ||
prayuñjate ca vai tasmai samyak pūjāṃ narādhipa |
saputradārā vardhante sarāṣṭrabalavāhanāḥ ||
ājñāṃ māheśvarasyaitāṃ pratigṛhṇanti ye nṛpāḥ |
saṃgrāme śatrusaṃghāte bhavanti ca vidāriṇaḥ ||
kāle bījāni rohanti samyag varṣati vāsavaḥ |
na bhavaty atra marako vyādhihānis tathaiva ca ||
nirāmayaś ca bhuñjīta rājā kṛtsnāṃ vasundharām |
ratnākaravatīṃ devīṃ saśailavanakānanām ||
arogā balavantaś ca jāyante ca mataṅgajāḥ |
rājopajīvinaḥ sarve kāmabhogaiḥ samanvitāḥ ||
putraiś ca paśubhiś caiva jīvanti ca śataṃ samāḥ |
arogā balavatyaś ca jāyante vai prajā bhṛśam ||
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam |
yāṃś ca prārthayate kāmān sarvāṃs tān prāpnuyān naraḥ ||
evaṃ vṛttaṃ mahārāja śambhor bhaktyānvitaṃ vibho |
śrīgajasya bhayād viddhi triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ||
mayā khyātaṃ mahābaho vistareṇa yathākramam |
iti pālakāprokto gajapūjāvidhiḥ |

athārvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇam |
athāśvayuje māse paurṇamāsyām aparāhṇe hastino nīrājanaṃ kuryāt | prāgudakplavane deśe yatra diśi vā mano ramate girayas te parvatā ity etayā hastaśatam ardhaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ pragṛhya yābhir yam iti saṃprokṣayet tatra ślokāḥ |
daśahastasamutsedhaṃ pañcahastaṃ suvistṛtam |
śāntavṛkṣamayaṃ kuyāt toraṇaṃ puṣṭivardhanam ||

kārayet sthaṇḍile śubhre rasaiś ca paripūrite ||
rasais tvām abhiṣiñcāmi bhūme mahyaṃ śivā bhava |
asapatnā sapatnāghnī mama yajñavivardhanī ||
imau stambhau ghṛtābhyaktau śubhau bhāvasamāvṛto [-vṛtau?] |
yo mā kaścābhidāmeti tam imau stambau nirdahatām ity ucchayasva brāhmaṇasya ta ity abhābhyāṃ suvarṇamālāpatākais stambau saṃyojya tasyādhastāc caturhastāṃ vedīṃ kṛtvā tantram ity uktadarbhaiḥ pavitrapāṇir balipuṣpāṇi ca datvā madhulājāmiśraiḥ svastikaṃ saṃyāvadadhikṛśararūpa-saghṛtavividhānnapānabhakṣyalakṣaphalair agniṃ paristīrya āpo asmān mātaraḥ śundhantv iti caturoḍumbarān kalaśān hradodakena pūrayitvā pratidiśam avasthāpya dadhyād rudrāgneyaṃ vāyavyavāruṇā mantrā rakṣoghnaṃkṛtyā dūṣaṇaṃ yaśasyacaryasyāni ca hutvoṣadhiṃ samādāya dvihastamaṇḍalam ity uktvā | tatra ślokāḥ |
[227]                siṃhī vyāghrī ca hariṇī hy amṛtā cāparājitā |
pṛśṇiparṇī ca dūrvā ca padmam utpalamālinī ||
tām anumantrayed vaidalaṃ kaṭakasavadadhyād (?) vāpi vaiyyāghra-anaḍuccarma paristīrya, vaitasyāṅkumbham anumantrya, tato 'syāsmādadhidevatā tasyai ca baliṃ datvā, piṇḍāni ca dadhyāt |
hastināma vācayed yasyāṃ diśi sa ripur bhavati tāṃ diśaṃ gatvā hastinam ānayed viraṇyena rajatena vajreṇa manimuktāśaṅkhena candanena bhadradāruṇayā kuṣṭhena naladena rocanayāñjanena maṇikuśilayā padmakumudotpalair mamāgner varca iti sūktaṃ dakṣiṇottarapratimukhaṃ pratijapec cheṣeṇa gātrāṇy abhyaṃjayet japet | tatra ślokāḥ |
rakṣaṇe daṇḍaḥ kartavyo vaiṇavo navaḥ |
ṣoḍaśāratnimātras tu cātuparvamanohṛdam ||
tena varaṇāt tārayate daṇḍāgreṣu
tṛṇāni kṛtvā grasati jātaṃ jātam |
jātavedasam ity agniṃ prajvālayet sujātaṃ jātavedasam iti nīrājayitvā nidhiṃ bibhratīti śālās tu praveśayed yena prekṣamāṇāḥ svāni sthānāni vrajanti dīrghāyuṣo balavantaś ca bhavati gosahasraṃ kartur dakṣiṇāgrām avaraṃ ca |
iti gajanīrājanavidhiḥ |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
atha parvaṇi yat kṛtyam tac chṛṇuṣva mahāmate |

iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śakravratam |
