upoṣitacaturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ narottama |
pañcagavyaṃ pibet paścād dhaviṣyāśī tathā bhavet ||
śakravratam idaṃ kṛtvā māsapāpāt pramucyate |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena māsi māsi samācaret ||
saṃvatsarāt prāpya surendralokaṃ
tatroṣya rājā suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ |
mānuṣyam āsādya narendrapūjyo
rājābhaved vā dvijapuṅgavo vā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ brahmakūrcavratam |
kārttikyām upavāsī yaḥ kanyāṃ dadyāt svalaṅkṛtām |
svakīyāṃ parakīyāṃ vā nadīsaṅgamake śubhe ||
etat santānadaṃ nāma vrataṃ sugatidāyakam |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ santānadavratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
kārttikyāṃ naktabhuk dadyān meṣaṃ hemavinirmitam |
mārgaśīrṣaṃ nṛpaṃ paśyen mithunaṃ tadvad eva hi ||
evaṃ krameṇa yo dadyād dāsīṃ vastravibhūṣitām |
paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kartavyam |
[239]        paurṇamāsyām paurṇamāsyāṃ kaunteya bahudakṣiṇam |
etad rāśivrataṃ nāma grahopadravanāśanam |
sarvāśāpūrakaṃ tadvat somalokapradāyakam ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ rājñivratam |
paryovrataḥ pañcadaśyāṃ vratānte goyugapradaḥ |
lakṣmīlokam avāpnoti devīvratam udāhṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ devīvratam |
kālottarāt |
māghaśuklacaturdaśyām upoṣya niyamasthitaḥ |
śivāya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kartavyaṃ ghṛtakambalam ||
kṛṣṇagomithunaṃ paścāt surūpaṃ vinivedayet |
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sārdhaṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
śivadharmaṃ |
āliṅgavediparyantaṃ yo dadyād ghṛtakambalam |
tasyānantaṃ bhavet puṇyaṃ māghapūrṇimaparvaṇi ||
jāgaraṃ gītanṛtyādyaiḥ sakṛt kṛtvā tu parvaṇi |
manvantaraśataṃ sārdhaṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
iti śivadharmottarokto ghṛtakambalavidhiḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yaḥ somaṃ pūjayed bhaktimān naraḥ |
[240]        saubhāgyatvaṃ bhavet tasya iti me niścitā matiḥ ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhiḥ raṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
pūrvavat padmapatrasthaḥ kartavyaś cātithīśvaraḥ ||
tithīśvaraḥ somaḥ tadrūpaṃ ca caturdaśīsthitamahārājavratoktaṃ (?) veditavyam |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjāśāḍhyena śāḍhyena kṛtāpi tu phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvatavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ somavratam |
bhojanaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ madhunopariśobhitam |
dadyāt kṛṣṇatilānāṃ tu prastham ekaṃ tu māgadham ||
dviguṇaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ ca pṛthak prasthaṃ prakalpayet |
aṇḍajair voṇḍajair vāpi vividhaṃ pariveṣṭitam ||
aṇḍajāni kauśeyāni voṇḍajāni kārpāsāni |
liṅgaṃ saṃveṣṭya mantraiś ca balim etaṃ nivedayet |
arcayitvā vidhānena paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
yugakoṭisahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate |
[241]        puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya samṛddhe jāyate kule ||
medhāvī subhagaḥ śrīmān vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ |
iti śrīśivadharmoktaṃ ghṛtabhājanavratam |
paurṇamāsyām upavased abdam ekaṃ suyantritaḥ |
varṣānte sarvagandhāgīṃ pramāṃ vinivedayet ||
suvicitrair mahāyānair dviyagandhavibhūṣitaiḥ |
yugakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
yatheṣṭam aiśvare loke bhogam āsādya yatnataḥ |
kramād āgatya loke 'smin rājānaṃ patim āpnuyāt ||
iti śivadharmoktaṃ gandhavratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
upoṣya ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ hariṃ yajet |
caitre māsi nikumbhaś ca piśācaiḥ sahito balī ||
yāti yoddhuṃ piśācāṃś ca sikatādvīpavāsinaḥ |
tadante gacchatāṃ teṣāṃ madhyāhne tu gṛhe gṛhe ||
pūjā kāryā prayatnena nityaṃ śaktyā yathākramam |
piśācaṃ mṛnmayaṃ kṛtvā ramyaṃ tṛṇamayaṃ ca vā ||
gandhair mālyais tathā vastrair alaṅkārair manoharaiḥ |
bhakṣyais tu pūrikāpūpair māṃsair havyaiś ca pānakaiḥ ||
[242]        svajātivihitaiḥ peyair naivedyaiś ca pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
āyudhair vividhākāraiś chatropānahayaṣṭibhiḥ ||
śuṣkānnapūrikāyuktaiḥ sthirair bhakṣaiś ca bhasrayā |
śikya.uddālapiṣṭair vā ḍhakvāvādyaiś ca carmaṇā ||
tantrīvādyair manojñaiś ca tathā pārthopayogibhiḥ |
madhyāhne taṃ tu saṃpūjya prāpte candrodaye punaḥ ||
pūrvavat pūjayet taṃ tu vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
tataḥ kṛtasvastyayano brāhmaṇas taṃ visarjayet ||
anuvrajed athaitaṃ tu dvitīye divase sati |
gṛhād adūraṃ yo yasya parvatas tu mahīruhāt ||
punar gṛhe praviśyaiva kartavyaḥ sumahotsavaḥ |
gītavāditranirghoṣo janakolāhalas tathā ||
kṛtvā tṛṇamayaṃ sarpaṃ dṛḍhaiḥ kāṣṭhais tu veṣṭitam |
krīḍitavyaṃ punar grāmanagareṣu ca sarvadā ||
tatrāsau duṣṭasarpāṇāṃ tatkṣaṇād yena jāyate |
tribhiś caturbhir divasaiḥ kartavyaṃ khaṇḍakhaṇḍakam ||
sarvopaskāraśamanaṃ navakhaṇdaṃ gṛhe gṛhe |
pūjitavyaṃ sugupte tu rakṣitavyaṃ ca vatsaram |
ityādipurāṇoktā nikumbhapūjā |
kārttikyāṃ yo vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret |
śaivaṃ padam avāpnoti vṛṣavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ vṛṣavratam |
[243]        yā prerayati karmāṇi lokeṣu dvijasattama |
tasyāḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ śuklapañcadaśīṃ sadā ||
mālyānulepanaṃ śuklair dhūpena ca sugandhinā |
raktavastrapradānena dīpadānena vātha vā ||
vaidalaiś ca tathā bhakṣair apūraiś ca tathaiva ca |
pūjayitvā ca tāṃ devīṃ bhoktavyaṃ niśi bhāryayā ||
yadi pañcadaśīṃ sarvāṃ na śaknoti kathaṃcana |
devyāḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryam avaśyam api kārttike ||
umāṃ tu pūjayed yā tu sā tu nārī pativratā |
sadā dharmaratā nārī loke bhavati bhārgava ||
nāśubhe ca matis tasyāḥ kadācid api jāyate ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ pūrṇimāvratam |
prāpya pañcadaśīṃ rāma tathā śuklāṃ ca kārttikīm |
ārāmagṛhabhittiṃ vai ume śauca (?) samālikhet ||
tasya dvāri gṛhe vāśu nānāvarṇais tu varṇikam |
gṛhopakaraṇaṃ śaktyā tayoś caivābhito likhet ||
pītaṃ yad vāsam ādyaṃ tu sakaṭaumukhanāśikam |
tatas tau pūjayen nārī snātvā bhartṛparā śuciḥ ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā |
ikṣuṇekṣuvikārair vā viśeṣeṇa ca pūjayet ||
[244]        tayos tu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā paśyet tu sikatāmayam |
śuklāṃ netraṃ nyaset kṣīraṃ tac ca dadyād dvijātaye ||
tataś ca naktaṃ bhuñjīta tilatailavivarjitam |
anayoḥ pūjanād yā tu gṛhabhaṅgaṃ tu nāpnuyāt ||
pativratā mahābhāgā dīrgham āpnoti jīvitam |
pūrṇam induṃ tato 'bhyarcya saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt ||
iṣṭagraham athābhyarcya nakṣatram atha vā nṛpa |
tasyāḥ kṣemam avāpnoti kāmaṃ ca yadunandana ||
māsanāmasanakṣatraṃ pūrṇimāyogapac ca vā |
pūjayitvā tadā rājan saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt ||
nṛsiṃhapratibaddhaṃ tu pūrṇacandraṃ samarcayet |
naro mātṛgaṇā rājan sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
ekāṃ vā mātaraṃ rājan kāmān āpnoty abhīpsitān |
vānaspatyam avāpnoti pūjayitvā vanaspatīn ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ nānāphalapūrṇimāvratam |
śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
iti vahnipurāṇoktaṃ pūrṇimāvratam |
candravrataṃ pañcadaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ naktabhojanam ||
daśa pañca ca varṣāṇi vratam etat samācaret |
[245]        aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca ||
iṣṭāni tena rājendra etad vrataṃ samācaret |
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaṃ candravratam |
īśvara uvāca |
jyaiṣṭhasya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu dampatī yas tu bhojayet |
paridhāya yathā śaktyā daurbhāgyair mucyate naraḥ ||
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yo 'rcayet |
brāhmaṇyaṃ jāyate tasya saptajanmani sundari ||
iti prabhāsakhaṇḍoktaṃ brāhmaṇyāvāptivratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya sakalakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe pūrṇimāvratāni |
[246]
atha viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
athāmāvāsyāvratāni |
yenātyarthaṃ balibhir aniśaṃ tarpito nāgaloko
rāhūcchiṣṭām iva śaśikalāṃ manyamāno na bhuṅkte |
so 'yaṃ sādhudvijaparivṛḍhaḥ śūrihemādrir asminn
āmāvāsyāvratasamudayaṃ khyātam ākhyātikīrtiḥ ||
agastya uvāca |
bhavavaṃs tvatprasādena śruto 'yaṃ vratavistaraḥ |
ardhodayaṃ tu me brūhi durlabhaṃ sacarācare ||
jīvitaṃ prāṇināṃ puṇyaṃ yadi ced vadasi prabho |
kathaṃ kāryaṃ kṛte kiṃ syāt phalaṃ kathaya ṣaṇmukha ||
śrūyatāṃ puṇyayogo 'yaṃ durlabho 'rdhodayāhvayaḥ |
tiryaṅmanuṣyadevānāṃ duṣprāpyaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
maghāmāyāṃ vyatīpāta āditye viṣṇudaivate |
ardhodayaṃ tad ity āhuḥ sahasrārkagrahaiḥ samam ||
purā kṛtaṃ vasiṣṭhena jāmadagnena suvrata |
sanakādyair manuṣyaiś ca bahubhir bahubhiḥ śrutaiḥ ||
anyaiḥ śatasahasraiś ca dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatu kumbhajaḥ |
dānānāṃ yajñatīrthānāṃ phalaṃ yena kṛtaṃ bhavet ||
[247]        sasāgarādharā tena saptadvīpasamanvitā |
dattā syāt sarvabhāvena yena hy ardhodayaṃ kṛtam ||
mānasādiṣu tīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ snānadānataḥ |
gaṅgāgayāprayāge ca puṣkarāṇāṃ traye tathā ||
tat sarvaṃ vā na vā vipra vratenānena kumbhaja |
aśvamedhāyutaṃ śreṣṭham iṣṭāpūrtaṃ ca yad bhavet ||
ardhodayakṛtaṃ yais tu vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
vājisatraṃ gṛhe lakṣmīḥ santatiś cānapāyinī ||
āyur yaśo hi vipulaṃ vratakartā phalaṃ labhet |
indrāgniyamalokeṣu nirṛtīnām apāṃyateḥ (-pateḥ?) ||
vāyoḥ kuberaśeṣasya lokeṣu sukṛtī prabhuḥ |
vasec candrārkalokeṣu lokapālaiś ca sevitaḥ ||
gokoṭidānād yat puṇyaṃ kṣetratīrthanivāsinām |
ardhodayajapuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
bhūrlokādhipatiś caiva bhuvarlokādhipas tu saḥ |
svarlokeśo janānāṃ ca tayor lokasya ceśvaraḥ ||
maharloke vasen nityaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
tato hiraṇyagarbhasya puruṣo vratakārakaḥ ||
tasya lokādhipaḥ sākṣī lokānāṃ puruṣo 'vyayaḥ |
ardhodayaprasādena brahmaloke vaset tu saḥ ||
tathā vānena viṣṇutvaṃ brahma rudras tathā bhavet |
śivaloko guṇaiḥ pūjyo devarājasamanvitaḥ ||
vasec chākreṇa mānena vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
[248]        tato viṣṇusvarūpeṇa trailokyādhipatir bhavet ||
śaṅkhacakragadādhārī vanamālī hariḥ svayam |
vrataprabhāvāl lakṣmīśo devo nārāyaṇo bhavet ||
agastya uvāca |
skanda kena vidhānena kartavyaṃ vratam uttamam |
ardhodayaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ jīvitaṃ durlabhaṃ bhuvi ||
skanda uvāca |
kṛte kṛtaṃ vasiṣṭhena tretāyāṃ raghuṇā kṛtam |
dvāpare dharmarājena kalau pūrṇodareṇa ca ||
anyair devamanuṣyaiś ca daityaiś ca dvijasattama |
kṛtam ardhodayaṃ samyak pūrṇakāmaphalapradam ||
māghamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ raver dine |
vaiṣṇavena ca ṛkṣeṇa vyatīpāte sudurlabhe ||
vaiṣṇavarkṣaṃ śravaṇam |
pūrvāhṇe saṅgame snātvā śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ niyamastho bhaven naraḥ ||
tridaivatyaṃ vrataṃ devāḥ kariṣye bhuktimuktidam |
bhavantu saṃnidhau me 'dya trayo devās trayo 'gnayaḥ ||
iti niyamamantraḥ |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ sauvarṇapalasaṃkhyayā |
kartavyārcā tadardhena tadardhena dvijottama ||
śāgraṃ śatatrayaṃ śambhor droṇānāṃ tilaparvataḥ |
[249] śambhur atra brahmā |
kartavyau viṣṇurudrāv aṅgiraḥ pūrvoktasaṃkhyayā |
śayyātrayaṃ tataḥ kuryād upaskarasamanvitam ||
devānāṃ trayam uddiśya kartavyaṃ bhaktiśaktitaḥ |
brahmaviṣṇuśivaprītyai dātavyaṃ tu gavāṃ trayam ||
hiraṇyabhūmidhānyādidānaṃ vibhavasārataḥ |
dātavyaṃ śraddhayopetaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
madhyāhne tu naraḥ snātvā śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
tilaparvatamadhyasthaṃ pūjayed devatātrayam ||
ādau brahmapūjā |
namo viśvasṛje tubhyaṃ satyāya parameṣṭhine |
devāya devapataye yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||
oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ pādau hiraṇyagarbhāya nama ūrubhyām |
dhātre namo jānubhyāṃ jaṅghābhyāṃ parameṣṭhine namaḥ |
vadhase namo guhye padmodbhavāya vai namo vastau |
haṃsavāhanāya namaḥ kaṭideśe śatānandāya vakṣasi namaḥ sāvitrīpataye namo namo 'stu bāhuṣu | oṃ ṛgvedāya namaḥ pūrvavaktre yajurvedāya namo dakṣiṇavaktre | sāmavedāya namaḥ paścimavaktre | atharvavedāya namaḥ uttaravaktre | oṃ caturvaktrāya namaḥ śirasi | kakpolau oṃ kapālāya namaḥ |
[250]        tataḥ kāryā lokapālapūjā vipraiḥ svamantrataḥ |
hiraṇyagarbha puruṣapradhānāvyaktarūpavat ||
prasīda samukho bhūtvā pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namo 'stu te |
brahmaprārthanamantraḥ |
nārāyaṇ jagannātha namas te garuḍadhvaja |
pītāmbara namas tubhyaṃ janārdana namo 'stu te ||
anantāya namaḥ pādau viśvarūpāya te namaḥ mukundāya namo jānubhyāṃ ūrubhyāṃ govindāya namo jaṅghābhyām | guhye pradyumnāya namaḥ padmanābhāya namo nābhau | bhuvanodarāya nama udare vakṣasi kaustubhavakṣase namaḥ | caturbhujāya namo bāhuṣu vadane viśvatomukhāya namaḥ | namaḥ sahasraśirase devāyānantāya maulau |
āditya candranayana digbāho daityasūdana |
pūjāṃ dattāṃ mayā bhaktyā gṛhāṇa karuṇākara ||
iti viṣṇuprārthanāmantraḥ |
maheśvara maheśāna namas te tripurāntaka |
namo jīmūtakeśāya namas te vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
īśānāya namaḥ pādau jaṅghābhyāṃ candraśekharaḥ |
jānubhyāṃ paśupatir deva ūrubhyāṃ śaṅkaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
umākāntāya guhye tu nābhau vai nīlalohitaḥ |
udare kṛṣṇavāsase vakṣo nāgopavītine ||
bhogirūpāya vai bāhau nīlakaṇṭhas tu kaṇṭhagaḥ |
[251]        mukhe vai pañcavaktrāya maulau caiva kapardine ||
andhakāre prameyātman namo lokāntakāya ca |
pūjāṃ dattāṃ mayā bhaktyā gṛhāṇa vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
iti maheśvaraprārthanamantraḥ |
iti pūjākramaḥ prokto mantrair etaiḥ prayatnataḥ ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
hastamātrā karṇamātrā pīṭhachatraṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ ||
śvetavastrayugaṃ deyaṃ brahmaṇe sarvamūrtaye |
pītavastrayugaṃ viṣṇor lohitaṃ śaṅkarasya ca ||
pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ pūjanaṃ kusumaiḥ svakaiḥ |
kamalais tulasīpatrair bilvapatrair akhaṇḍitaiḥ ||
tatkālasaṃbhavair divyaiḥ pūjyā devā yathākramam |
yathāśaktyā prakartavyaṃ vratam etat sudurlabham ||
jīvitaṃ prāṇinām etad anityaṃ niścitaṃ yataḥ |
atha vratāṅgahomasya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ ||
devatātrayam uddiśya śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
prajāpate viśvarūpāya rudrāya ca namo namaḥ ||
ity anenaiva mantreṇa vahniṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ |
tato homaṃ prakurvīta yathāvibhavasaṃbhavam |
agnaye prajāpataye svāhā | agnaye viṣṇave svāhā | [252] agnaye rudrāya svāhā | evaṃ vithaś ca homaḥ | prajāpataye na tvadetānyānyena mantreṇa prajāpataye | idaṃ viṣṇur iti dhiṣṇave | tryambakam iti mahādevāya | ity etair mantrair ghṛtahomaḥ |
brahmaṇe viṣṇave mahādevāya svāheti pūrṇāhutyā sarvān kāmān avāpnoti prāpnoti homo vratāṅgahomaḥ |
atha homāvasāne ca gāṃ ca dadyāt payasvinīm |
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām |
sadakṣiṇāṃ suśīlāṃ ca ācaryāya nivedayet ||
tena dattaṃ hutaṃ japtam iṣṭaṃ yajñaiḥ sahasradhā |
kṛtakṛtyo bhaved vipra vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
etat sarvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ durlabhaṃ vratam uttamam |
ardhodayaṃ yathā dṛṣṭaṃ kim anyat śrotum icchasi ||
iti skandapurāṇoktam ardhodayavratam |
amāvāsyāṃ nirāhāraḥ abdam ekaṃ niyantritam |
śūlapiṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā varṣānte vinivedayet ||
śivāya rājataṃ padmaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kṛtavarṇikam |
bhaktyā ca vinyaset mūrdhni śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret ||
[253]        kāmato 'pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyādikaṃ ca yat |
tat sarvaṃ śūladānena hatvā nārīr na saṃśayaḥ ||
mahāpadmavimānena naro nārīsamanvitaḥ |
yugakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
pūrvavad iti ahiṃsābrahmacaryabhūśayanapāṣaṇḍānālāpādikam ācared ity arthaḥ |
īśalokādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogān anekadhā |
iha loke kramāt prāpya yatheṣṭaṃ patim āpnuyāt ||
iti śivadharmoktaṃ śūladānavratam |
agastya uvāca |
sargādau brahmaṇā sṛṣṭās tam ūcuḥ pitaras tadā |
vṛttiṃ no dhehi bhagavān yathāvad vidmahe vayam ||
brahmovāca |
amāvāsyādinā vo 'stu tasyāṃ tilakuśodakaiḥ |
tarpitā mānuṣais tṛptiṃ parāṃ gacchantu nānyathā ||
tilā deyās tathaitasyām upoṣya pitṛbhaktitaḥ |
cirāya tasya saṃtuṣṭā paraṃ yacchantu mā ciram ||
tasmād asyāṃ tithau vidvān etat sarvaṃ samācaret |
iti varāhapurāṇoktaṃ pitṛvratam |
[254]                brahmovāca |
pitaraḥ svaditaiḥ piṇḍair iṣṭāḥ kurvanti sarvadā |
prajāvṛddhiṃ dhanaṃ rakṣām āyuṣyaṃ balam eva ca ||
mūlamantrāḥ svasaṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrtitāḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate ||
pūjāśāṭhyena śāṭhyena kṛtāpi tu pralapradā |
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ ||
pūrvoktaphalado homaḥ kṛtaḥ śāntena cetasā |
etad vrataṃ vaiśvānarapratipadvratavad vyākhyeyam |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ pitṛvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
varṣam ekaṃ bhaved yas tu pañcadaśyāṃ payovrataḥ |
pañcadaśyām ity amāvāsyāyāṃ purāṇāntarasaṃvādāt |
samānte śrāddhakṛd dadyāt pañca pañca payasvinīḥ |
vāsāṃsi ca piṣaṅgāni jalakumbhayutāni ca ||
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārayec chatam |
janmāntare bhaved rājā payovratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktam amāvāsyāpayovratam |
[255]                mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
prabhāsvarā barhiṣada agnisvāttās tathaiva ca |
kravyādāś caiva bhūtāś ca ājyapāś ca sukālinaḥ ||
pūjyāḥ pitṛgaṇā rājan somavāsena nityaśaḥ |
caitre kṛṣṇārathārabhya pañcadaśyāṃ narādhipa ||
śrāddhaṃ tadahni kurvīta yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ bhavet |
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasaṃpadā ||
saṃvatsarānte dadyāc ca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm |
brāhmaṇāya mahābhāga pitṛbhaktāya śaktitaḥ ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
prāpnoti lokān sa tathā ca teṣām |
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ sukhī syāt
prāpnoti mokṣaṃ puruṣapradhānaḥ ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇoktaṃ pitṛvratam |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
kṛṣṇapakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ caitrād ārabhya yādava |
vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā ||
tilahomaṃ tathā kuryān nāmnā vahner narādhipa |
saṃvatsarānte dadyāc ca suvarṇaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca ||
[256]        kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
prāpnoti vittaṃ satataṃ yaśaś ca |
dharme matīrūpam anuttamaṃ ca
kāmān yatheṣṭān puruṣapradhānaḥ ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇoktaṃ vahnivratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
amāvāsyāntavelāyāṃ sopavāso narottama |
padmadvaye pūjayanti candrārkāv ekarāśigau ||
ādityam aṣṭadalake śaśinaṃ ṣoḍaśākare |
ādityaṃ sarvaraktena candraṃ śuklena yādava ||
mālyādinā mahābhāga homayet tilataṇḍulān |
ghṛtakṣīrayutān rājan tathārcayed yathāvidhi |
vratānte brahmaṇendrāya kanakaṃ pratipādayet ||
rajataṃ vā mahābhāga ya icched bhūtim ātmanaḥ |
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
dadyāc ca dīpān vidhivat prabhūtān |
cāndraṃ padaṃ prāpya vivardhate sadaḥ
dhanānvitaḥ syāt tridive ihaiva ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ candravratam |
[257]                bhagavān uvāca |
amāvāsyām anuprāpya brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine |
yat kiṃcid vedaviduṣe dadyād uddiśya śaṅkaram ||
prīyatām īśvaraḥ somo mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
iti kūrmapurāṇoktam amāvāsyavratam |
amāvāsyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ samuddiśya pitāmaham |
brāhmaṇāṃs trīn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
iti kūrmapurāṇoktam amāvāsyāvratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya sakalakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe amāvāsyāvratāni |
atha ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha nānātithivratāni
pratyekam ukteṣu tithivrateṣu
labdhvāvakāśaṃ punar ādade tat |
hemādrir atyantaphalapradāyi
nānātithīnāṃ vratavṛndam āha ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
smārayāmi hṛṣīkeśa yan noktaṃ bhavatā mama |
tat sāvitrīvrataṃ brūhi prasādasumukho bhava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
kathayāmi kulastrīṇāṃ mahimno vardhanaṃ param |
yathā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ pūrvaṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā ||
āsīn mahīndro dharmātmā dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
pārthivo 'śvapatir nāma paurajānapadapriyaḥ ||
sarveśvaro 'napatyaś ca satyavāk saṃyatendriyaḥ |
sa sabhāryo vratam idaṃ cakārāpatyakāmyayā ||
sāvitrīti prasiddhaṃ yat sarvakāmapradāyakam |
tasya tuṣṭā tu sā devī sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ||
bhūr bhuvaḥ svar itīty asyāḥ sākṣān mūrtir (?) iha sthitā |
[259]        kamaṇḍalukarā devī varadā smitabhāṣiṇī ||
uvāca duhitā hy ekā tava rājan bhaviṣyati |
tasyāḥ prasādād apy etat sarvaṃ tava samāgatam ||
mannāmnā sā ca vaktavyā mahākīrtimatī tu sā |
bhaviṣyati mahārāja mā śokaṃ kartum arhasi ||
evam uktvā tu sā devī jagāmādarśanaṃ tadā |
kālena bahunā jātā duhitā devarūpiṇī ||
sāvitrīprītaye vṛttyā sāvitryā pūjayā tathā |
ādiṣṭā caiva sāvitryā sāvitrīsadṛśī yataḥ ||
sāvitrīty eva nāmāsyāś cakrur (?) viprās tathāpi sā ||
sāvitrī vigrahavatī vyavardhata pitur gṛhe |
kāle bahutithe yāte yauvanasthā babhūva sā ||
sā sumadhyā pṛthuśroṇī pratimāṃ kāñcaṇīm iva |
prāpteyaṃ devakanyeti saṃbhramaṃ menire janāḥ ||
sā tu padmapalāśākṣī prajvalantīva tejasā |
cacāra sāpi sāvitrīvrataṃ tadguruṇoditam ||
athopoṣya śiraḥ snātā samyak saṃpūjya devatāḥ |
hutvāgniṃ vidhivad viprān vācayitvenduparvaṇi ||
tebhyaḥ sumanaso mūrdhnā pratigṛhya nṛpātmajā |
sakhīparivṛtābhyetya devaśrīr iva rūpiṇī ||
[260]        sābhivādya pituḥ pādau vinītā cāruhāsinī |
kṛtāñjalir varārohā nṛpateḥ pārśvataḥ sthitā ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaprāptāṃ svāṃ sutāṃ devarūpiṇīm |
uvāca rājā saṃmantrya smṛtyarthaṃ saha mantribhiḥ ||
putrī pradānakālās te na ca kaścid vṛṇoti (?) māṃ |
vicārayan na paśyāmi varaṃ tulyam ihātmanaḥ ||
tathāpi deyāsi mayā doṣaḥ syād anyathā mama |
devādīnāṃ tathā vācyo na bhaveya tathā kuru ||
paṭhyamānaṃ mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu viśrutam |
pitur gṛhe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyaty asaṃskṛtā ||
brahmahatyā pitus tasya sā kanyā vṛṣalī smṛtā |
ato 'tra preṣayāmi tvāṃ kuru putri svayaṃvaram ||
vṛddhair anumatāsi tvaṃ śīghraṃ gaccha ca mā ciram |
devādīnāṃ yathā vācyo na bhaveyaṃ tathā kuru ||
evam astv iti sāvitrī proktvā śīghraṃ viniryayau |
syandanena mahārheṇa mantribhiḥ parivāritā ||
tapovanāni ramyāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ jagāma sā |
mānyānāṃ tatra vṛddhānāṃ kṛtvā pādābhivandanam ||
tato babhrāma tīrthāni parvatāṃś ca vanāni ca |
deśāṃś ca vividhān ramyān āśramān sumanoharān ||
ekasminn āśramapade kṛtakṛtyā babhūva sā |
varayitvā varaṃ sā tu ājagāma svam ālayam ||
[261]        sāvitrī mantrisahitā parituṣṭena cetasā |
tatra paśyati devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ pituḥ ||
āsīnam āsane vipraṃ praṇamya smitabhāṣiṇī |
kathayāmāsa tat sarvaṃ yenāraṇyaṃ gatāgatā ||
sāvitry uvāca |
āsīc chālveṣu dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
dyumatsena iti khyāto daivād andho babhūva saḥ ||
tasyāpy abhavad bhāryā vai rukmiṇī nāma sundarī |
tasya pratihṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vairibhedena yogataḥ ||
sa bālayā tayā sārdhaṃ bhāryayā prasthito varam |
sa tasya balasaṃvṛddhaḥ (?) putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ||
satyavān nāmarūpāḍhyo bharteti manasā vṛtaḥ |
nārada uvāca |
aho kaṣṭam aho kaṣṭaṃ sāvitri kim idaṃ kṛtam |
kṛtas te bālabhāvād yad guṇavān satyavān nṛpaḥ ||
satyaṃ vadaty asau rājā satyāśvas tena sa smṛtaḥ |
nityam aśvāḥ priyās tasya karoty aśvān sa mṛṇmayān |
citre 'pi likhayaty aśvān citrāśvas tena kathyate ||
kiṃ varṇyo rantidevasya bhaktyā dānaguṇaiḥ samaḥ |
brāhmaṇaḥ satyavāg dakṣaḥ śivir auśīnaro yathā ||
yayātir iva codāraḥ somavat priyadarśanaḥ |
aśvināv iva rūpeṇa dyumatsenasuto babhau ||
[262]        eko doṣo 'sti nānyo 'sāv adyaprabhṛti satyavān |
saṃvatsareṇa kṣīṇāyur dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
nāradād etad ākarṇya duhituḥ prāha pārthivaḥ |
putri sāvitri gacchānyaṃ varaṃ varaya satpatim ||
saṃvatsareṇa so 'lpāyur dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati |
sāvitry uvāca |
sakṛj jalpanti rājānaḥ sakṛj jalpanti paṇḍitāḥ |
sakṛt kanyā pradīyante trīṇy etāni sakṛt sakṛt ||
dīrghāyur athālpāyuḥ saguṇo nirguṇo 'pi vā |
sakṛd vṛto mayā bhartā na dvitīyaṃ vṛṇomy aham ||
manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato vācābhidhīyate |
kriyate karmaṇā paścād eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
nārada uvāca |
yady etad iṣṭaṃ duhitus tataḥ śīghraṃ vidhīyatām |
avighnam astu sāvitri bhadraṃ tava kariṣyati ||
evam uktvā kham utpatya nāradas tridivaṃ yayau |
utpādya duḥkham atulaṃ tasya rājño yudhiṣṭhira ||
rājāpi duḥkhasaṃvignaś ciraṃ dhyānaparo 'bhavat |
aho 'tikaṣṭam utpannam apāraṃ mādṛgātmanām ||
etad duḥkham aho dṛṣṭvā varam eṣānapatyatā |
satyam uktaṃ purāṇajñaiḥ kanyā duḥkhaikabhājanam ||
[263]        devair yad uktaṃ tat sarvaṃ vyalokaṃ pratibhāti me |
evaṃ saṃśocya bahudhā dadhāv ātmānam ātmanā ||
devīṃ saṃsmṛtya sāvitrīṃ yayā datto varaḥ purā |
jagau svaduhituḥ sarvaṃ vaivāhikam athākarot ||
svayaṃ gatvā tu sāmagryā vanaṃ muniniṣevitam |
śubhe muhūrte pārśvasthair brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ ||
samarthayitvā kanyāṃ tāṃ datvā pūpāṃś ca puṣkalān |
uvācedaṃ mahābhāgāṃ vyathitenāntarātmanā ||
dyumatsena mahābhāga śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
iyaṃ me duhitātīva vallabhā jīvitād api ||
bhartā samucito hy asyāḥ satyavān satyavallabhaḥ |
tvam apy asyāḥ samucitaḥ śvaśuro dharmavallabhaḥ ||
ato 'parādhāḥ kṣantavyāḥ vāleyaṃ rājyalālitā |
yadābhīṣṭaṃ ca jāmātur yuvayor yad abhīpsitam ||
tat tad ākhyeyam asmākaṃ svasti te 'stu vrajāmy aham |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
ity āmantrya gato rājā nāradoktaṃ vyathānvitaḥ |
sāvitry api ca tal labdhvā bhartāraṃ manasepsitam ||
mumude 'tīva tanvaṅgī deyaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt |
evaṃ tatrāśrame teṣāṃ tadā nivasatāṃ satām ||
kālas tat paśyatāṃ kaścid aticakrāma bhārata |
sāvitryās tu śayānāyāś cintayantyā divāniśam ||
nāradena yad uktaṃ tad dhṛdayān nāpasarpati ||
[264]        tataḥ kāle bahutithe vyatikrānte kadācana |
prāptaḥ kālo hi martavyaṃ yatra satyavatā nṛpa ||
prauṣṭhapade site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe |
gaṇayantyāś ca sāvitryā nāradoktaṃ vaco hṛdi ||
caturthe 'hani martavyam iti saṃcintya bhāminī |
vrataṃ trirātram uddiśya sāvitryākhyaṃ mahāphalam ||
upoṣya saṃsthitā sādhvī sāvitrī sā pativratā |
tatas trirātraṃ nirvartya snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ ||
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau vavande cāruhāsinī |
atha pratasthe paraśuṃ gṛhītvā satyavān vanam |
sāvitry api ca bhartāraṃ gacchantaṃ pṛṣṭhato 'nvayāt ||
vāryamāṇāpi sā bhartrā vṛddhābhyāṃ cābhibhāṣitā |
ūcatus tau ca mā bhadre gaccha kaṇṭakinaṃ vanam ||
sukumārāsi kalyāṇi lālitā pṛthivībhṛtā |
śvāpadāśvapādair yātu kathaṃ śakṣyasi tad vanam ||
upavāsās trayas te 'dya tasmād bhuṅkṣva sumadhyame |
sāvitry uvāca |
naiṣa dharmo varastrīṇāṃ yad bhartari bubhukṣite |
svayam eva ca bhoktavyam ity āhur dharmadarśinaḥ ||
aparaṃ kautuka me 'sti vanasyāsya pradarśane |
bhartrā saha prayāsyāmi sahāyā svāmino 'ciram ||
[265]        yuṣmatpādaprasādena mā niṣedhaṃ kariṣyatha |
tato jñātvā ca sā bālā jagāmātha pativratā ||
sāvitry anupadaṃ bhartur vane tasmin manorame |
gatvāsau dūram adhvānaṃ jayāhātha phalādikam ||
samit kuśaṃ ca kusumaṃ bhāryayā sa vadan priyam |
kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇy ādāya kāṣṭhabhāram akalpayat ||
kāṣṭhaṃ kuṭhāreṇa tathā pāṭayāmāsa līlayā |
atha pāṭayatas tasya jātā śirasi vedanā ||
tataḥ saṃvṛtya tat sarvaṃ vaṭachāyām upāśritaḥ |
satyavān vedanākrāntaḥ kiṃcid varṇitumānasaḥ (?) ||
vaṭaśākhām avaṣṭabhya satyavān prāha gadgadam |
sāvitri paśya śirasi vedanā mā prabādhate (?) ||
na ca kiṃcit pravakṣyāmi bhramaty eva hi me manaḥ |
tavotsaṅge kṣaṇaṃ tāvat svaptum icchāmi sundari ||
viśramasva mahābāho sāvitrī prāha duḥkhitā |
paścād api gamiṣyāvaḥ svāśramaṃ sumanoharam ||
yāvad utsaṅgagaṃ kṛtvā śiraś cāste mahītale |
tāvat karālavadanāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
ājagmur yamadatāś ca (?) raudrāś cātibhayaṅkarāḥ |
na śekur dṛṣṭipāte 'syāḥ sāvitryāḥ (?) sthātum antike ||
gatvā cacakṣus tat sarvaṃ sāvitryās te tu adbhutam |
dṛṣṭipātena nāsmābhiḥ śakyate 'syāḥ pradhāvitum ||
dahatīva ca no dehaṃ dṛṣṭipātena sā satī |
[266]        tat svayaṃ yāhi nosmābhiḥ sādhyate satyavān kvacit ||
ity ākarṇya yamaḥ kopād utthāyātha varāsanāt |
āruhya mahiṣaṃ raudraṃ raudraḥ prāṇaharo balī ||
ājagāma tvarāyukto yatrāste sā pativratā |
sāvitry api ca saṃtrastā vīkṣyamāṇā itas tataḥ ||
sāvadhānā kathaṃ ko 'dya bhartāraṃ mama neṣyati |
tāvad dadarśa sā bālā puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalam ||
kirīṭinaṃ pītavastraṃ sākṣāt sūryam ivoditam |
tam uvācātha sāvitrī praṇamya madhurākṣaram ||
kas tvaṃ devo 'tha daityo vā māṃ dharṣitum upāgataḥ |
na cāhaṃ kenacic chaktyā svadharmād avaropitum ||
praṣṭuṃ vā puruṣaśreṣṭha dīptāṃ vahniśikhām iva ||
yama uvāca |
yamaḥ saṃyamanaś cāhaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraḥ |
kṣīṇāyur eṣa te bhartā saṃnidhau te pativrate ||
na śaktaḥ kiṅkarair jetuṃ tato 'haṃ svayam āgataḥ |
evam uktvā satyavataḥ śarīrāt pāśasaṃyutam ||
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ niścakarṣa yamo balāt |
atha prayātum ārebhe panthānaṃ pitṛsevitam ||
sāvitry api varārohā kṛtvā pādena maṅgalam |
rakṣārthaṃ bhartṛkāyasya yayāv anupadaṃ tataḥ ||
[267]        pativratatvād aśrāntā dhyāyamānā nijaṃ patim |
taccintā tadgataprāṇā tām uvāca yamas tadā ||
nivartya gaccha sāvitri sudūraṃ tvam ihāgatā |
eṣa mārgo viśālākṣi na kenāpy anugamyate ||
sāvitry uvāca |
na śramo na ca me glāniḥ kadācid api jāyate |
bhartāram anugacchantyās tava śiṣṭasya saṃnidhau ||
satāṃ santo gatir nānyā strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā gatiḥ |
vedā varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gatir guruḥ ||
sarveṣām eva jantūnāṃ sthānam asti mahītale |
muktvā bhartāram ekaṃ tu strīṇāṃ nānyaḥ samāśrayaḥ ||
ebhir anyaiḥ samucitair vākyair dharmārthasaṃyutaiḥ |
toṣito dharmarājas tu sāvitrīm idam abravīt ||
tuṣṭo 'smi tava bhadre 'tha varān varaya suvrate ||
sā ca vavre varān pañca vinayāvanatā satī |
cakṣuḥprāptis tathā rājyaṃ śvaśurasya mahātmanaḥ ||
jīvitaṃ ca tathā bhartur dharmaprāptiṃ ca śāśvatī |
pituḥ putraśataṃ caiva tathā ca śatam ātmanaḥ ||
dharmarājo varaṃ datvā preṣayāmāsa tāṃ tataḥ |
ājagāmātha sāvitrī nyagrodhaviṭapaṃ tathā ||
kṛtvotsaṅgaṃ śiras tasya pūrvavan niṣasāda sā |
gātrasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre bhartuḥ śāntasya bhārata ||
[268]        utthitaś cetanāṃ prāpya nīruk prāhedam ādarāt |
kathaṃ na bodhito bhadre kālo 'tīva gato mama ||
kiṃ vakṣyati hi me tātaḥ kiṃ ca mātā ca duḥkhitā |
viruddhaṃ hy adya saṃjātaṃ kālo 'tīva gato vane ||
vihāya mātāpitarau kālo na kvāpi me 'tyagāt |
iti matvā virudhyete kṛtaṃ neha prabodhanam ||
sāvitry uvāca |
kathaṃ tvāṃ bodhayāmy atra pīḍitaṃ tu śirorujā |
mama nātra vilambo 'bhūd akāryeṇa tavānagha ||
prahasyotthāya sāvitrī jagrāha śirasendhanam |
samitkuśādikaṃ sātha jagmatus tau svam āśramam ||
tataḥ pitrā svanetrābhyāṃ dṛṣṭau tau parayā mudā ||
āliṅgya mūrdhnyayāghrāya putram aṅke niveśya saḥ |
uvāca diṣṭyā paśyāmi sabhāryas tvāṃ samāgatam ||
vilambakāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ samācaṣṭe yathātathā |
viditārtho 'tisaṃhṛṣṭaḥ pūjayāmāsa tāṃ satīm ||
avāpa pūrvajair bhuktaṃ rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam |
dyumnaseno mahābhāga iyāja kratubhis tadā ||
tato nṛpatir āsādya putrān ātmaguṇādhikān |
sāvitryā ceṣṭitaṃ jñātvā jāmātur jīvitaṃ tathā ||
rājyaprāptiṃ ca vipulāṃ parāṃ mudam avāpa saḥ |
[269]        sāvitryākhyānakam idaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
avaidhavyapradaṃ strīṇāṃ svargamokṣapradāyakam |
sukhasaubhāgyadaṃ pārtha prātar japyamidaṃ sadā ||
bhādrapade paurṇamāsyām āśu cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tv idam |
māhātmyam asya nṛpateḥ kathitaṃ sakalaṃ mayā ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kīdṛśaṃ tad vrataṃ kṛṣṇa sāvitryā yad anuṣṭhitam |
tasmin bhādrapade māsi vidhānaṃ tasya śaṃsa me ||
kā devatā vrate tasmin ko mantraḥ kiṃ phalaṃ vibho |
etad ākhyāhi me nātha na hi tṛpyāmi mādhava ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha sāvitrīvratam ādarāt |
kathayāmi yathā cīrṇaṃ tayā satyā yudhiṣṭhira ||
trayodaśyāṃ bhādrapade dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
trirātraṃ niyamaṃ kuryād upavāsasya bhaktitaḥ ||
aśaktā ca trayodaśyāṃ naktaṃ kuryāc jitendriyā |
ayācitaṃ caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyām upoṣaṇam ||
nityaṃ snātvā mahānadyāṃ taḍāge nirjhare 'pi vā |
viśeṣataḥ pūrṇamāsyāṃ snānaṃ sarṣapamṛjjalaiḥ ||
gṛhītvā vālukāṃ pātre prasthamātrāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
atha vā dhānyam ādāya yavaśālitilādikam ||
tato vaṃśamaye pātre vastrayugmena veṣṭite |
sāvitrīpratimāṃ kṛtvā brahmaṇaś caiva śodhanam ||
[270]        sauvarṇīṃ mṛṇmayīṃ vāpi svaśaktyā raupyanirmitām |
brahmaṇo rūpanirmāṇaṃ pūrvam abhihitaṃ veditavyam |
raktavastrayugaṃ dadyāt sāvitryā brahmaṇaḥ sitam ||
sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā sārdham evaṃ bhaktyā prapūjayet |
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiś ca naivedyair dīpakair modakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
pūrṇaṃ kośātakaiḥ pakvaiḥ kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ karkaṭīphalaiḥ |
nārikelaiś ca kharjūraiḥ kapitthair dāḍimais tathā ||
bījapūraiḥ sanāraṅgaśākhoṭeḥ panasais tathā |
dhānyakair jīrakair hṛdyair guḍena lavaṇena ca |
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiś ca vaṃśapātraprakalpitaiḥ ||
haridrayā kaṇṭhasūtraiḥ śubhaiḥ kuṅkumakesaraiḥ |
avatāraṃ karoty eva sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ||
tām arcayīta mantreṇa sāvitrīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ svayam |
itarāsāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ purāṇokto vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
oṃkārapūrvake devi vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī |
vedamātar namas tubhyam avaidhavyaṃ prayaccha me ||
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi dehi me |
yathā prasannā sāvitryās tathā māṃ pāhi pāvini ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaj jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet |
gītavāditranirghoṣair hṛṣṭanārīkadambakaiḥ ||
puṇyākhyānaiś ca vividhais tāṃ rātrim ativāhayet |
utsavena nayed rātriṃ sāvitryāś ca kathānakaiḥ ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye ravāv anudite sati |
[271]        sāvitrīṃ brāhmaṇa śreṣṭha naivedyāni nivedayet ||
atha sāvitrikalpajñe sāvitryākhyānavācake |
vedajñe tu svavṛttasthe daridre vā kuṭumbini ||
mantreṇānena kaunteya praṇamya vidhipūrvakam |
dūrvākṣatatilair miśrāṃ pūrvāśābhimukhasthitām ||
śucivastradharo vipra oṃkārasvastipūrvakam |
sāvitrīyaṃ mayā dattā sahiraṇyā hiraṇmayī ||
brahmaṇaḥ prīṇanārthāya brāhmaṇa pratigṛhyatām |
evaṃ datvā dvijendrāya sāvitrīṃ tāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
naivedyādi ca tat sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet |
svayaṃ daśapadaṃ gacchet svaveśma tata āviśet ||
gauriṇyo bhojayed bhaktyā haviṣyānnena śaktitaḥ |
puṣpaiḥ kuṅkumasindūrais tāmbūlaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtrakaiḥ ||
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇaiḥ śaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitā |
visarjayet tatas tāṃś ca sāvitrī prīyatām iti ||
vaktavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvais tuṣṭair bhuktvottare bhṛśam |
sāvitrī varadā tubhyaṃ bhavatāṃ bhāvasuvratā ||
putrā aṣṭau tathā bhartā paramāyur anāmayaḥ |
putraiḥ pautraiś ca saṃbaddhaṃ vardhatāṃ tava satkulam |
vrataṃ ca suvrataṃ tat tad vidhinānena niścitam ||
pañcadaśyāṃ tathā jyaiṣṭhe vaṭamūle mahāsatī |
[272]        trirātropoṣitā nārī vidhinānena pūjayet ||
sārdhaṃ satyavatā sādhvīṃ phalanaivedyadīpakaiḥ |
vaṭāvalambinaṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhabhāraṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
rātrī jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gītanṛtyapuraḥsaram |
tataḥ prabhāte vidhinā pūrvoktena narottama ||
tām api brāhmaṇe dadyāt praṇipatya kṣamāpayet |
etad vratavaraṃ pārtha kathitaṃ vidhivan mayā ||
yāś cariṣyanti loke 'smin putrapautrasamanvitāḥ |
bhuktvā bhogāṃś ciraṃ bhūmau yāsyanti brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapranāśanam |
japatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sāvitrī vratam ādarāt ||
smṛtyarthavedajananīṃ sahabhartṛkāṃ yāṃ
saṃpūjayet kṛtadinatritayopavāsā |
sāvitrīvat pitṛkulaṃ ca tathaiva bhartur
uddhṛtya yā bhuvi bhunakti ciraṃ sukhāni ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ brahmasāvitrīvratam |
skandapurāṇāt |
dharmarājavarapradānānantaraṃ sāvitry uvāca |
madīyaṃ tu vrataṃ deva bhaktyā nārī kariṣyati |
bhartuḥ sābhihitā sādhvī samastaphalabhājanā ||
[273]                dharmarāja uvāca |
nārī vā vidhavā vāpi aputrā pativarjitā |
sabhartṛkā saputrā vā kāryaṃ (?) vratam idaṃ śṛṇu ||
jyaiṣṭhamāse tu saṃprāpte paurṇamāsyāṃ pativratā |
snātvā caiva śucir bhūtvā vaṭaṃ sicya bahūdakaiḥ ||
sūtreṇa veṣṭayed bhaktyā gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
namo vaivasvatāyeti bhramayantī pradakṣiṇam |
rātrau kurvīta naktaṃ ca abdam ekaṃ samāhitā |
tathaiva vaṭavṛkṣaṃ ca pakṣe pakṣe ca pūjayet ||
saṃprāpte ca punar jyaiṣṭhe laghubhuk dvādaśīr nayet |
dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ kṛtvā niyamaṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
trirātraṃ laṅghayitvā ca caturthe divase hy aham |
candrāyārghyaṃ pradatvā ca pūjayitvā ca tāṃ satīm ||
miṣṭānnāni yathāśaktyā pūjayitvā dvijottamān |
bhokṣe 'haṃ tu jagaddhātri nirvighnaṃ kuru me mune ||
niyamamantraḥ |
kṛtvā vaṃśamaye pātre vālukāprastham eva ca |
saptadhānyadhṛtaṃ pātraṃ prasthaikena dvijottama ||
vastradvayopari sthāpya sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā saha |
haimīṃ kṛtvā tayoḥ prītyai trirātram upavāsayet ||
nyagrodhasya tale tiṣṭhed yāvac caiva dinatrayam |
[274]        sauvarṇīṃ caiva sāvitrīṃ satyena saha kārayet ||
raupyaparyaṅkam āropya rathopari niveśayet |
palād ardhaṃ yathāśaktyā rathaṃ raupyamayaṃ śubham ||
tathā ca kāṣṭhabhāre ca vaṭe caiva suvistaram |
evaṃ ca mithunaṃ kṛtvā pūjayed gatamatsarā ||
vartulaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena tapodhana |
pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ gandhapuṣpodakena ca ||
candanāgurukarpūrair mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
saṃpūjya tatra sāvitrīṃ maṇḍale sthāpayed budhaḥ ||
pītapiṣṭena padmaṃ ca atha vā candanena ca |
nyasec caiva tato devīṃ kamale kamalāsanām ||
anena vidhinā sthāpya pūjayed gatamatsarā |
atha sāvitrīpūjā mantraḥ |
namaḥ sāvitryai pādau tu prasavityai ca jānunī |
kaṭiṃ kamalapatrākṣyai udaraṃ bhūtadhāriṇī ||
oṃ gāyatryai namaḥ kaṇṭhe śirasi brahmaṇaḥ priyā |
atha brahmasatyavatoḥ pūjā |
pādo dhātre namaḥ pūjyau ūrūjyeṣṭhāya vai namaḥ |
parameṣṭhī ca meḍhraṃ ca agnirūpāya vai kaṭim |
vedhase codaraṃ pūjya padmanābhāya vai hṛdi ||
[275]        kaṇṭhaṃ tu vidhaye pūjya hiraṇyagarbhāya vai mukham |
brahmaṇe vai śiraḥ pūjya sarvāṅge viṣṇave namaḥ ||
abhyarcyaivaṃ krameṇaiva śāstroktavidhinā nṛpa |
tato rajatapātreṇa arghyaṃ dadyād dvayor api ||
sāvitryai arghyamantraḥ |
oṃkārapūrvakaṃ devi vīṇāpustakadhāriṇi |
devamātar namas tubhyam avaidhavyaṃ prayaccha me ||
pativrate mahābhāge vahnijāte śucismite |
dṛḍhavrate dṛḍhamate bhartuś ca priyavādinī ||
avaidhavyaṃ tu saubhāgyaṃ dehi tvaṃ mama suvrate |
putrān pautrāṃś ca saukhyaṃ ca gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo namaḥ ||
atha brahmasatyavator arghyamantraḥ |
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagat sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam |
satyavratadharo deva brahmarūpa namo 'stu te ||
atha yamasyārcanamantraḥ |
tvaṃ karmasākṣī lokānāṃ śubhāśubhavivecakaḥ |
vaivasvata gṛhāṇārghyaṃ dharmarāja namo 'stu te ||
dharmarāja pitṛpate śāntibhūteṣu jantuṣu |
kālarūpa gṛhāṇārghyam avaidhavyaṃ ca dehi me ||
gandhapuṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ phalaiḥ kuṅkumadīpakaiḥ |
raktavastrair alaṅkāraiḥ pūjayed gatamatsarā ||
[276] atha sāvitrīprārthanamantraḥ |
sāvitrī brahmagāyatrī sarvadā piryabhāṣiṇī |
tena satyena māṃ pāhi duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
tvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ śacī lakṣmīs tvaṃ prabhā candramaṇḍale |
tvam eva ca jaganmātā tvam uddhara varānane |
saubhāgyaṃ kulavṛddhiṃ ca dehi tvaṃ mama suvrate ||
yan mayā duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ janmaśatair api |
bhasmībhavatu tat sarvam avaidhavyaṃ ca dehi me ||
atha brahmasatyavatoḥ prārthanāmantraḥ |
aviyogo yathā deva sāvitryā sahitas tava |
aviyogas tathāsmākaṃ bhūyāj janmani janmani ||
atha prārthanāmantraḥ |
karmasākṣī jagatpūjya sarvavandya prasīda me |
saṃvatsaravrataṃ sarvaṃ paripūrṇaṃ tad astu me ||
sāvitrī tvaṃ yathā devī caturvarṣaśatāyuṣam |
patiṃ prāptāsi guṇinaṃ mama devi tathā kuru ||
sāvitrī prasavitrī ca satataṃ brahmaṇaḥ priyā |
pūjitāsi (?) dvijaiḥ sarvaiḥ (?) strībhir munigaṇais tathā ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ devi bhūtānāṃ vandanīyāsi suvrate |
mayā dattaiva pūjeyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa namo 'stu te ||
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta gītanṛtyādimaṅgalaiḥ |
svavāsinyas tataḥ pūjyā divase divase gate ||
[277]        sindūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ sapavitrakam |
tathā dadyāc ca sarvāṇi bhaikṣyaṃ (?) saubhāgyam aṣṭakam ||
satīṣv eva divārātrau kāmakrodhavivarjitā |
dinatraye 'pi kartavyam evaṃ mārjārapūjanam ||
tataś caturthadivase yat kāryaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva me |
mithunāni caturviṃśa ṣoḍaś dvādaśāṣṭa vā ||
pūjayed vastragodānair bhūṣaṇācchādanāsanaiḥ |
atha vā gurum ekaṃ ca vratasya vidhikārakam ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvaśāstrārthapāragam |
vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ śāntaṃ ca vijitendriyam ||
sapatnīkaṃ samabhyarcya vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ dadyād gṛhaṃ caivātiśobhanam ||
aśaktas tu yathāśaktyā stokaṃ stokaṃ ca kalpayet |
sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ putri patinā saha dāpayet ||
kalpanāmantraḥ |
sāvitri tvaṃ yathā devi caturvarṣaśatāyuṣam |
satyavantaṃ patiṃ labdhvā mayā dattā tathā kuru ||
pratimādānamantraḥ |
sāvitrī jagato mātā sāvitrī jagataḥ pitā |
mayā dattā ca sāvitrī brāhmaṇa pratigṛhyatām ||
atha pratigrahamantraḥ |
mayā gṛhītā sāvitrī tvayā dattā suśobhanā |
[278]        yāvac candraś ca sūryaś ca saha bhartrā sukhī bhava |
guruṃ ca gurupatnīṃ ca tato bhaktyā kṣamāpayet ||
yan mayā kṛtavaikalyaṃ vrate 'smin duradhiṣṭhitam |
tat sarvaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātu yuvayor vacanena tu ||
pratimāsaṃ vaṭasecanamantraḥ |
dharmarājo yamo dhātā nīlaḥ kālāntako 'vyayaḥ ||
vaivasvataś citragupto dadhnā bhṛtyuḥ kṣayo vaṭaḥ |
māsi māsi tathā hy etair nāmabhiḥ secayed vaṭam ||
nyagrodho 'haṃ vaset putri tasmād yatnena secayet |
tato guruṃ sapatnīkaṃ pūjayed gatavismayā ||
bhūṣaṇaiś ca savastraiś ca kuṅkumaiś ca manoharaiḥ |
nyagrodhasya (?) samīpe tu gṛhe vā sthaṇḍile śubhe ||
sāvitryās caiva mantreṇa ghṛtahomaṃ tu kārayet |
pāyasaṃ juhuyād bhaktyā ghṛtena saha bhāvini ||
vyāhṛtyā caiva mantreṇa tilavrīhiyavaṃ tathā |
homānte dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyavivarjitā ||
kṣamāpayet tato vipraṃ vandya pādau prayatnataḥ |
bhuñjīta vāsarānte tu naktaṃ śāṇtā tapasvinī ||
arghyaṃ datvā tv arundhatyā dṛṣṭvā caiva praṇamya ca |
arundhati namas te 'stu vasiṣṭhasya priye śubhe ||
sarvadevanamaskārye pativrate namo 'stu te |
sarvaṃ gṛhya mayā dattaṃ phalaṃ puṣpasamanvitam ||
[279]        putrān dehi sukhaṃ dehi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo 'stu te |
sakhībhir brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhuñjīta vijitendriyā ||
evaṃ karoti yā nārī vratam etad anuttamam |
bhrātaraḥ pitaraḥ putrāḥ śvaśuraḥ svajanās tathā ||
cirāyuṣas tathārogāḥ syuś ca (?) janmaśatatrayam |
bhartrā ca sahitā sādhvī brahmaloke mahīyate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ vaṭasāvitrīvratam |
indrāṇy uvāca |
dṛṣṭvā māṃ nahuṣo brahman kāmenātīva pīḍitaḥ |
māṃ dharṣayitum ārabdhas tatas tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā ||
guro kaścid upāyo 'sti vrataṃ vā dānam eva vā |
yena śokād vimokṣyāmi tan me vada mahāmune ||
tasyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā gurur vākyam athābravīt |
bṛhaspatir uvāca |
asty aśokatrirātrākhyaṃ vrataṃ śokaharaṃ param |
trirātraṃ tac ca kartavyaṃ vrataṃ śokavināśanam ||
pāpaghnaṃ cāgadaghnaṃ ca putrapautravivardhanam |
āyuḥpradaṃ kīrtikaraṃ dhanadhānyapradaṃ param ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ sarvamāyāvināśanam |
tac chṛṇu tvam aśokākhyaṃ trirātravratam uttamam ||
māsi mārgaśire caiva jyaiṣṭhe bhādrapade tathā |
[280]        śuklapakṣe pañcadaśyām ekabhaktaṃ tu kārayet ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya snānaṃ kuryāt tato vratī |
ācamya tu śucir bhūtvā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
aśokaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā brahmaviṣṇusvarūpiṇam |
krameṇānena deveśi purāṇoktena vistarāt ||
aśoka śokanāśārthaṃ saṃbhūto 'si kṣitāv iha |
arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa bho vṛkṣa brahmaviṣṇvīśarūpabhṛt ||
atra brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāṃ saśaktikānāṃ mūrtikaraṇam, uttaratra taddānadarśanāt | tatra brahmasāvitrīrūpaṃ putrakāmapūrṇimā vrate | lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpaṃ tu pūrṇimāsthalakṣmīnārāyaṇavrate | umāmaheśayos tv aviyogadvādaśīvrate 'bhihitam | paribhāṣoktaṃ vā pratimātrayaṃ veditavyam |
arghyamantraḥ |
idaṃ pādyaṃ namas tubhyaṃ kalpitaṃ puṇyavāriṇā |
puṣpākṣataphalair miśram aśoka pratigṛhyatām ||
pādyamantraḥ |
candanaṃ trividhaṃ vṛkṣasaṃbhavaṃ devanirmitam |
tat gṛhāṇa drumaśreṣṭha kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ||
[281] gandhamantraḥ |
puṣpāṇīmāni vṛkṣendra mālatyādīni yāni ca |
gṛhāṇemāni divyāni mama santu manorathāḥ ||
puṣpamantraḥ |
guggulvādyāś caye dhūpās tathā cāgurusaṃnibhāḥ |
niveditā mayā bhaktyā gṛhāṇaitān mahātaro ||
dhūpamantraḥ |
ārātrikaṃ mahāvṛkṣa kalpitaṃ dīpasaṃyutam |
udyotārthaṃ jagatpūjyaṃ kulasya mama so 'stu vai ||
dīpamantraḥ |
arcitas tvaṃ surair divyair dānavaiś ca mahoragaiḥ |
apsarobhiś ca gadharvais tatas tvām arcayāmy aham ||
arcanamantraḥ |
paramānnaṃ mayāśoka (?) bhakṣyabhojyasamanvitam |
bhaktyā niveditaṃ tubhyaṃ ṣaḍbhir ebhī rasair yutam ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ vṛkṣaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ |
aśokaṃ prārthayet paścān mantreṇānena bhaktimān ||
yad atronaṃ kṛtaṃ kiṃcid atiriktaṃ kṛtaṃ vrate |
tat sarvaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātu prasādāt te drumottama ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena pratimāsaṃ ca pūjayet |
yāvad dvādaśa māsān vai kuryād udyāpanaṃ tataḥ ||
[282]        samyag gṛhītvā niyamaṃ trirātraṃ samupoṣayet |
aśokaṃ kārayed raupyaṃ nānāśākhaṃ phalānvitam ||
vastrayugmena saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpaiḥ sudhūpitam |
nānāphalasamāyuktaṃ puṣpamālyopaśobitam ||
gītavādyavinodaiś ca nānābhāvakathānakaiḥ |
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vratasyāsya ca yat phalam. ||
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryād dānāny anekaśaḥ |
mithunāni tu saṃpūjya brāhmaṇānāṃ tu ṣoḍaśa ||
tebhyas tu karakā deyāḥ śūrpāṇi vasanāni ca |
guros tu mithunaṃ pūjya vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
godānair bhūmidānaiś ca veśmadānādibhis tathā |
prathame 'hni tato dadyāt sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā saha ||
umāmaheśvaraṃ deyaṃ dvitīye 'hni varānane |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ caiva tṛtīye 'hni suśobhanam ||
sopaskaram aśokaṃ tu dadyāt sarvaṃ kṣamāpayet |
tato 'haṃ bhojayed bandhūn dīnānāthāṃś ca tarpayet ||
pāraṇaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt pāraṇaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ |
evaṃ kṛte trirātraṃ tu phalaṃ yat kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ||
tac chruṇuṣva mahābhāge saṃkṣepāt kathayāmi te |
aśvamedhādibhir yajñair iṣṭair yat phalam aśnute ||
[283]        tat phalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ trirātreṇa na saṃśayaḥ |
gāṃ datvā vividhair dānair gomahiṣyādibhis tathā ||
tathā yaj jāyate puṇyaṃ tīrthānusmaraṇe kṛte |
yat proktaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ puṇyaṃ tat sarvaṃ labhate phalam ||
iti śrutvā vacas tasya guror amitatejasaḥ |
cakāra sā tadā devī paulomīvratam uttamam ||
sā tadvrataprabhāvena śakreṇa saha saṃgatā |
etad vrataṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā ||
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa prāpto bhartā śriyā saha |
anundhatyā vedavatyā damayantyānasūyayā ||
rukmiṇyādibhir anyābhiḥ prāptāḥ sarve manorathāḥ|
paṭhanti śṛṇvanti ca ye manuṣyāḥ
kurvanti bhaktyā bhuvi sad vrataṃ ye |
te yānti nākaṃ sucirair vimānaiḥ
vimuktapāpāḥ sukhino bhavanti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam aśokatrirātravratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
avaidhavyakaraṃ brūhi vrataṃ kiṃcin maheśvara |
bhartur duḥkham avāpnoti putraduḥkhaṃ tathaiva ca ||
aputratā mahad duḥkhaṃ duḥkhaṃ cāpi kuputratā |
[284]        etāny eva tu duḥkhāni yā ca nārī vṛṣadhvaja ||
nāpnoti martyaloke 'smin vaidhavyaṃ surasattama |
nārīṇāṃ ca hitārthāya brūhi yady asti śaṅkara ||
saubhāgyam atulaṃ yāti bhartāraṃ cātipūjitam |
sarvāyayavasaṃpūrṇam anaṅgam iva cāparam ||
sadvṛttaṃ vittasaṃpannaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam |
jñātiśreṣṭhaṃ pūjyatamam etan me brūhi śaṅkara ||
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā rambhākhyaṃ vratam uttamam |
yena cīrṇena nandīśa kṛtakṛtyāś ca yoṣitaḥ ||
na bhaved vidhavā nandin nānapatyā kadācana |
vidhānaṃ śṛṇu nandīśa yathā tat kriyate nṛbhiḥ ||
śuklapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ māsi jyaiṣṭhe ca suvrata |
trirātraṃ vratam uddiśya bhaktyā tāṃ kadalīṃ śubhām ||
snātvā veṣṭayed bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādi dāpayet |
rātrau kurvīta naktaṃ ca abdam ekaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
tathaiva kadalīvṛkṣaṃ nityam eva prasecayet |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi tataḥ prāpya dvādaśyāṃ caiva suvrata ||
nadyāṃ vātha taḍāge vā śivaṃ saṃpūjya cākṣataiḥ |
snātvā ca pūjayen nandinn umādehārdhadhāriṇam ||
ekabhaktaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā niyamaṃ kārayed vrate |
bhokṣye 'haṃ tridinaṃ laṅghya samyag iṣṭvā sureśvarīm ||
[285]        tvatprasādād vrataṃ me 'stu nirvighnena maheśvari |
rambhāyāḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vicitraṃ ca suśobhanam ||
rambhāyā nikaṭe sthitvā gītavādyasamanvitam |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tatra puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam ||
vitānena ca saṃyuktaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam |
madhye kurvīta kadalīṃ phalapuṣpādisaṃyutām ||
rājatīṃ śobhanākārāṃ jātarūpaphalocitām |
vastrayugmaṃ tato dadyāt sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitām ||
kadalyai kāmadāyinyai medhāyai te namo namaḥ |
rambhāyai ratisārāyai sarvasaukhyaprade namaḥ ||
kadalyai kāmadāyinyai mocāyai te namo namaḥ ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
cintitā tvaṃ hi kadalī cintitaṃ kāmadāyinī |
śarīrārogyam aiśvaryaṃ dedi devi namo 'stu te ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
pūjayet kusumair mantraiḥ kaṇṛhasūtraiś ca suvrata |
haridrārañjitaiḥ sūtrair hṛṣṭanārīkadambakaiḥ ||
saptadhānyair bhṛte pātre prasthamātreṇa pūrite |
umāmaheśvaraśambhuṃ (?) kṛtvā tasmin niveśayet ||
rūpyaparyaṅkam ārūḍhaṃ pūjayed rukmiṇīṃ harim |
vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya candanena vilepayet |
pūjayec ca sugandhāḍhyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavair vratī ||
[286]        mantrair ebhis tu nandīśa pādād ārabhya nāmabhiḥ |
tripurāyai ca ity aṅghriyugmaṃ gauryās tu pūjayet ||
jānunī candranetrāyai aparṇāyai namo namaḥ |
kaṭiṃ manmathanāśāya smarāyai girijāṃ tataḥ ||
nābhiṃ sarveśvarāyeti girijāyai tathāmbikām |
hṛdaye hṛdivāsinyai śūline ca maheśvaram ||
mukhaṃ kāmavināśāya pārvatyai parameśvarīm |
śiraḥ saubhāgyadāyinyai śūline tu kapardine ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśam umayā sahitaṃ prabhum |
nṛtyavāditragītādyair upoṣya kadalīṇ tataḥ ||
jāgaras tatra kartavyaḥ purāṇākhyānakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
evaṃ trirātraṃ nandīśaṃ nayed bhaktyā subhāvitaḥ ||
dināni trīṇi nandīśa pratiliṅkhya ca suvratī |
mithunāni ca saṃpūjya yathāvibhavasārataḥ ||
guruṃ caiva sapatnīkaṃ bhojayitvā prapūjayet |
dinasaṃkhyair bilvapatrair ghṛtahomas tato bhavet ||
pṛṣadājyena dadhnā vā payasā vātha vāgyataḥ |
tat savitur iti mantreṇa juhuyād anale sudhīḥ ||
trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśa caturdaśyāṃ caturdaśa pañcadaśyāṃ pañcadaśāhutaya iti dinasaṃkhyātvam |
gurave pāṇḍurachatraṃ tasya patnyai tathānagha |
[287]        raktavastraṃ pradātavyaṃ vācam etām udīrayet ||
gauryā me sahito devaḥ prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
dānamantraḥ |
yathaivendrasamīpe tu śacī tiṣṭhati śobhane |
aham eva sadā rambhe patiyuḥ pārśve sthitā bhave ||
rūpaṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi yaśaḥ saubhāgyam eva ca |
putrān dehi dhanam dehi sarvān kāmāṃś ca dehi me ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
kapilā tatra dātavyā sarvopaskarasaṃyutā |
umāmaheśvaraṃ caiva kadalyā sahitaṃ tathā ||
garbhiṇī bālavatsā ca yathā kuryāt tathā śṛṇu |
dvādaśyām ekabhaktaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ tathaiva ca ||
naktaṃ samācaren nandiṃ caturdaśyām ayācitam |
pañcadaśyāṃ copavāsam evaṃ caiva vrataṃ caret ||
etad vrataṃ tu nandīśa putrapautrapradāyakam |
yā karoti vrataṃ nandin vidhinānena suvrata |
na tasyāsti kula kācid aputrā vidhavā tathā ||
arundhatīva modec ca yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam |
sadā kīrtiyutā sādhvī yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
vratam etat kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ devapatnībhir ādarāt ||
tābhir bhogāś ca saṃprāptā dvivyāś cātimanoramāḥ |
[288]        virājante svargaloke raver iva ca raśmayaḥ ||
vratasyaiva tu māhātmyād avāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ |
evaṃ prabhāvo nandīśa vratasyāsya mahāmate ||
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi so 'pi svarge mahīyate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ rambhātrirātravratam |
skanda uvāca |
devadeva mahādeva parabrahma maheśvara |
āyuryaśo'rthaputraśrīdharmasatakulakārakam ||
vrataṃ brūhi maheśāna sarvaśokapraṇāśanam |
jātāḥ putrāś ca jāyante arogāḥ sukhinas tathā ||
teṣāṃ putrāś ca vadhvaś ca dṛśyante ca suśobhanāḥ |
saubhāgyaṃ cātulaṃ prāpya sapatnī naiva jāyate ||
yena sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ vrajet ||
īśvara uvāca |
vratānām uttamaṃ skanda tava vakṣye sanātanam |
yenaiva cīrṇamātreṇa sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
yat kṛtvā sarvadānasya phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ |
gotrirātram iti kyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
nārī vātha naro vātha trirātravratam ācaret |
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ māsi cāśvayuje tathā ||
dipotsavasamīpe tu vratam etat samācaret |
[289]        prātaḥ snātvā trayodaśyāṃ kṛtvā vai dantadhāvanam ||
trirātraṃ niyamaṃ kuryād govindabhaktibhāvitaḥ |
govinda jagatāṃ nātha govardhanadharānagha ||
gotrirātraṃ kariṣyāmi śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta ||
niyamamantraḥ |
goṣṭhe vā gopathe vātha kṛtvā bhūmigṛhaṃ śubham |
aṣṭahastaṃ caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ suśobhanam ||
vitānaṃ puṣpamālābhiḥ phalair nānāvidhair api |
madhye vediṃ tataḥ kṛtvā maṇḍalaṃ tatra kārayet |
sarvatobhadranāmātha navanālam athāpi vā ||
tanmadhye vinyased devaṃ govardhanadharaṃ harim |
rukmiṇī mitravindā ca śaivyā jāsvavatī tathā ||
vāmabhāge tu devasya pūjyā vai bhaktibhāvataḥ |
satyabhāmā ca rādhā ca vāsudevāgnijit tathā ||
dakṣiṇe caiva pūjyās tu nandaṃ ca purato yajet |
balabhadraṃ yaśodāṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ pūjayet śubham ||
surabhī ca sunandā ca subhadrā nāma dhenavaḥ |
etāś catasro devyaś ca kṛṣṇasya purato nyaset ||
suvarṇamāṣakāḥ kāryāḥ ṣoḍaśa pratimāḥ śubhāḥ |
govardhanaś ca kartavyo rājataḥ palasaṃmitaḥ ||
chatrākārair mahāvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitaḥ pakṣibhiḥ śubhaḥ |
gopīgopasamākīrṇo mahāvṛkṣasamanvitaḥ ||
[290]        evaṃ saṃsthāpya yatnena tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret |
om āgaccha bhagavān kṛṣṇa gopagopīsamanvitaḥ ||
rukmiṇyādibhī rājñībhir mama pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya pādau ca haraye jāninī namaḥ |
udaraṃ baladevāya mukumdāya namaḥ kaṭim ||
cakriṇe ca bhujau pūjyau kaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhadhāriṇe |
mukhaṃ padmamukhāyeti govindāya namaḥ śiraḥ |
praṇavādinamo'ntaiś ca aṣṭāṅgaṃ pūjayed dhareḥ ||
rukmaṇye namaḥ | mitravindāyau namaḥ | śāntyai namaḥ | jāmbavatyai namaḥ | surabhyainamaḥ | satyabhāmāyai namaḥ | rādhāyai namaḥ | nāmajite namaḥ | yaśodāyai namaḥ | balabhadrāya namaḥ | nandāya namaḥ | sunandāyai namaḥ | subhadrāyai namaḥ | nāmajite namaḥ | kāmadhenave namaḥ |
govardhanadharādhāra gokulatrāṇakāraka |
viṣṇubāhukṛtodvāra pūjayāmi nagottama ||

gavām ādāra govinda rukmiṇīvallabha prabho ||
gopagopīsamīpe tam arghyaṃ gṛhṇa namo 'stu te |

gavām arghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ sāyāhne tu dinatrayam |
[291]        mantreṇānena vidhivad dviśantīnāṃ svaśaktitaḥ ||
rudrāṇāṃ caiva yā mātā vasūnāṃ duhitā ca yā |
ādityānāṃ ca bhaginī sā naḥ śāntiṃ prayacchatu ||
arghyamantraḥ |
namo gobhyaḥ śrīmatībhyaḥ saurabheyībhya eva ca |
namo dharmasutābhyaś ca pavitrābhyo namo namaḥ ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
surabhī vaiṣṇavī mātā nityaṃ viṣṇupade sthitā |
pratigṛhṇātu me grāsaṃ saurabhī me prasīdatu ||
gogrāsamantraḥ |
gāvo me agrataḥ santu gāme me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ |

mā viyogo 'stu me putrair bhartrā ca saha bāndhavaiḥ |
tvatprasādena me bhaktir niścalāstu sadā tvayi ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya gāś caiva govindaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
puṣpair gandhaiś ca dīpaiś ca dhūpair nānāvidhair api ||
[292]        naivedyair ghṛtapakvaiś ca phalair nānāvidhair api |
saptadhānyair virūḍhaiś ca vaṃśapātrasthitaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
suvāsinyas tathā pūjyā nityaṃ tāmbūlakuṅkumaiḥ |
kaṇṭhasūtrais tathā puṣpais tathā ca kanakādibhiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad govindaṃ tu dinatrayam |
kṛtvopavāsatrayaṃ caiva caturthe divase punaḥ ||
tataḥ śuciḥ samutthāya kṛtvā snānaṃ prayatnataḥ |
praṇamyācāryamukhyena homaṃ tatraiva kārayet ||
tilair aṣṭottaraśataṃ gāyatryā homam ācaret |
tato sivṛjya deveśaṃ gurave pratipādya ca ||
gāvaḥ pucche samālambya puraskṛtya dvijarṣabhān |
hṛṣṭena manasā skanda gṛham āgamya yatnataḥ ||
mithunāni dvādaśāṣṭau bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ |
saṃpūjya bhojanaṃ datvā godānāni ca dāpayet ||
guror dampatyam arcitvā vāsobhūṣaṇasaṃyutam |
bhaktyā govardhanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopīgopasamanvitam ||
gṛhopakaraṇair yuktaṃ yathāśaktyā ca bhaktitaḥ |
guroḥ gaṃpādayed dhomān dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ harim ||
kṣamāpya ca guruṃ tatra bhuñjīta śuciḥ (?) saṃskṛtam |
iṣṭaiḥ śiṣṭaiḥ samāsīno vāgyato viṣṇutatparaḥ ||
dīpotsavair vratam idaṃ śucimānasena

[293]        bhuktvopabhoganicayaṃ sukhasaṃprayukto
hy ante prayāti bhavanaṃ manujo murāreḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ gotrirātravratam |
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe kurusainye kṣayaṃ gate |

māgadhaiḥ (?) stūyamānaś ca svasainyagaṇaśobhitaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇena samāyuktaḥ prayayau hastināpuram ||
abhiṣekaṃ tataś cakre purodhā munisaṃyutaḥ |
dūrvāyavāṅkurair yuktaṃ cakrur vardhāpaṇaṃ (?) striyaḥ ||
ratnair dūkūlair dharmātmā toṣayāmāsa tān gaṇān |
nṛpāṃś ca svanaropetān māgadhāṃś cāvanīpakān ||
ṛṣīṃś ca sarvān prasthāpya sve sve sthāne nṛpān api |
stutyā saṃtoṣayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ ||
devadeva jagannātha bhaktānām abhayaprada |
prasādāt tava govinda kauravā yudhi nirjitāḥ ||
rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ prāptaṃ bhaktiyogāt tavānagha |
matsevāpariyuktānāṃ prasādaṃ kuru keśava ||
evam uktvā sthite pāṇḍau putrabhrātṛsamanvite |
pāñcālī parayā bhaktyā praṇamya puruṣottamam ||
baddhāñjalipuṭā sādhvī provāca parameśvaram |
[294]        karuṇākārasaṃpūrṇa kaṃsāsuranikṛntana ||
dukūlaharaṇād yac ca duḥkhaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvitā |
na jñātaṃ devadeveśa prasādaṃ kuru keśava ||
kim api śrotum icchāmi tvatto vratam anuttamam |
yena cīrṇena nārīṇāṃ saubhāgyaṃ patibhaktitaḥ ||

[296]        kṛtvā tatra nyased devaṃ vratasaṃpūrṇahetave ||

[297]        vākyam ekaṃ mahābāho śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ |

ātmā vai rakṣito yena tat karoti na saṃśayaḥ |

na gṛhṇāti ca yo mūrkho hy anandānakaraṃ vrajet |

[298]        satyaṃ hi niścitaṃ vākyaṃ prāṇibhiḥ prāpya cāpadam |

tena pāpena limpe 'haṃ yady ahaṃ nāgame punaḥ |

[300]        tena pāpena limpe 'haṃ yady ahaṃ nāgame punaḥ |

[301]        prasāritakaraṃ tyaktvā gaccha dheno svakaṃ gṛham |

sakhy uvāca |

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |

arghyamantraḥ |

[307]        virūḍhaiḥ puṣpasindūravastrakuṅkumakajjalaiḥ ||

evaṃ yā kurute pārtha gotrirātravratottamam ||
durlabhaṃ tu sadā strīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ nṛpasattama |
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca ||
kṛtvā yat phalam āpnoti gotrirātravrate kṛte |
prabhāse ca kurukṣetre candrasūryagrahe tathā ||
hemabhāraśataṃ dadyāt tatphalaprāptaye nṛpa |
dhenudānaṃ kṛtaṃ yena savastraṃ sarvakāmakam ||
sāgarāmbarasaṃyuktā dattā tena vasundharā |
evaṃ kurute pārtha trirātravatam uttamam ||
bhavāntarakṛtāt pāpāt trividhān mucyate naraḥ |
sā kadācin na paśyeta bhartṛduḥkhaṃ narādhipa ||
[308]        putrapautrasukhaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
janmāntare ca sā nārī vaidhavyaṃ na ca paśyati |
vaidhavyaṃ na mahāduḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati bhavāntare ||
aputro labhate putrān dhanahīno dhanaṃ labhet |
kāyena manasā caiva karmaṇā yad upārjitam ||
tat sarvaṃ pātakaṃ yāti gotrirātravrate kṛte |
iha bhogān vipulān kṛtvā āyuḥ saṃpūrṇam eva ca ||
vratasyāsya prabhāvena goloke ca mahīyate |
kīrtidaṃ dhanadaṃ caiva saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ nṛpa ||
āyurārogyakaraṇaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
tatra snātvādarād rājan sabhāryas tvaṃ kuru vratam ||
yadi rājyaṃ kuru kīrtiṃ nityaṃ prāpyam ihecchasi |
tac chrutvā pāṇḍavaśreṣñho vrataṃ cakre samāhitaḥ ||
vratasyāsya prabhāvena labdhaṃ rājyaṃ akaṇṭakam |
iti śrībhaviṣyottaroktaṃ gotrirātravratam |
brahmovāca |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
kathayāmi vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidam ||
yena cīrṇena nārīṇāṃ vaidhavyam aprajāyate |
āyuṣyaṃ vardhate bhartuḥ putrāś ca dhanasaṃyutāḥ ||
tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
[309]        yatprasādād umā rudraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīḥ śacī harim ||
sāvitrī māṃ yathā prāptā sītā rāmaṃ yathā mune |
dakṣakopād umā devī dehaṃ tyaktvā svakaṃ purā ||
jātā himavato gehe jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇī |
cacārograṃ tapo 'nāthā nirāhārā jitendriyā ||
ekāṅguṣṭhe sthitā bālā pañcāgniparisaṃyutā |
tapasye niścayaṃ dṛṣṭvā gataḥ śabhūs tataḥ svayam ||
kasmād evaṃ tvayā kaṣṭaṃ kriyate gauri sāmpratam |
umovāca |
mahādevo bhaved eva yathā me patir uttamaḥ |
tadarthaṃ kriyate ghoraṃ tapastapanaduḥsaham ||
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu bāle sukhopāyaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
yena cīrṇena te śambhuḥ svadehārdhaṃ pradāsyati ||
sā tvaṃ kuru vrataṃ bhadre trirātraṃ bilvasaṃjñitam |
tac cīrṇam anayā bhaktyā patir labdho maheśvaraḥ ||
kārttikeyaḥ sutas tasmād gaṇeśaś ca mahāmune |
[310]        ity ukto brahmaṇā pūrvam agastimunisattama ||
vismayāviṣṭacetāś ca vidhiṃ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame |
agastya uvāca |
kasmin kāle dine kasmin sthāne caiva narottama |
vidhinā kena kartavyam kathaṃ pūjyo vanaspatiḥ ||
brahmovāca |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi ca saṃprāpte pūrṇamāsyāṃ dvijottama |
jyeṣṭhāṛkṣadine kuryāt siddharthaiḥ snānam uttamam ||
śrīvṛkṣaṃ siñcayet paścād gandhapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet |
vatsaraṃ tv ekabhaktaṃ tu haviṣyānnena kārayet ||
śvaśūkarakharādīnāṃ darśane bhojanaṃ tyajet |
anena vidhinā samyak māsi māsi samācaret ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe gatvā bilvasamīpataḥ |
gṛhītvā vālukāṃ pātre prasthamātraṃ mahāmune ||
atha vā dhānyam ādāya yavaśālitilādikam |
tato vaṃśamaye pātre vastrayugmena veṣṭayet ||
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ śaktyā kuryāt subhūṣitam |
raktavastrayugaṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ phalasaṃyutam ||
puṣpair bahuvidhaiś cāpi phalair nānāvidhais tathā |
[311]        guḍekṣujīrakair dhānyair lavaṇena virūḍhakaiḥ |
saptadhānyais tathā dīpair vaṃśapātraprakalpitaiḥ ||
rajanyā kaṇṭhasūtraiś ca śubhaiḥ kuṅkumakeśaraiḥ |
avatāraṃ karoty eṣā umādevī harapriyā ||
śrīniketa namas tubhyaṃ śivapriya namo 'stu te |
avaidhavyaṃ ca me dehi śriyaṃ vai janmajanmani ||
śriyaṃ dhanaṃ patiputrān ārogyaṃ kulasantatim |
saubhāgyaṃ rūpasampattiṃ pūjitas tvaṃ prayaccha me ||
sahasraṃ bilvapatrāṇāṃ homayet tu yathāvidhi |
pāyasaṃ tatra juhuyād vipraḥ śānto 'tha mantravit ||
rājataṃ śrītaruṃ kṛtvā suvarṇaphalaśobhitam |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvat pītavastreṇa veṣṭayet ||
trayodaśyāṃ samārabhya yāvat pūrṇaṃ bhavet titheḥ |
trirātraṃ jāgaraṃ kṛtvā upavāsair jitendriyaḥ ||
ramāpate paśupate trailokyādhipatiḥ prabho |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā deva gauryā saha maheśvaraḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte snātvā ca tilasarṣapaiḥ |
vastrālaṃkārapuṣpaiś ca guror dampatyam arcayet ||
pādukopānahacchatraśayyā gāṃ ca subhūṣitām |
guruṃ prapūjya bhaktyā tu dadyād etat prayatnataḥ ||
ṣoḍaśāṣṭau catasro vā dvijadampatyo bhūṣitāḥ |
[312]        vastrālaṃkāragodānais tasminn ahani pūjayet |
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojanaṃ dadyād ātmanaḥ śreyaḥ icchatā ||
yā nārī kurute caitad vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam |
sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvad āsthāya śivasaṃnidhau |
tato rājñī bhaven martye putrapautrasamanvitā ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ bilvatrirātravratam |
bilvamūlaṃ samāśritya trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ |
haranāma japel lakṣaṃ bhrūṇahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ haratrirātravratam |
skanda uvāca |
arundhatīvrataṃ vakṣye sadā saubhāgyadāyakam |
yena cīrṇena vai samyak nārī saubhāgyabhājanā ||
jāyate rūpasaṃpannā putrapautrasamanvitā |
vasantartuṃ samāsādya tṛtīyāyāṃ surarṣabha ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā tu vidhivat trirātropoṣitā satī |
mithunāni ca catvāri samāhūya yatavratā ||
[313]        pūjayet puṣpatāmbūlaiś candanaiś ca tathākṣataiḥ |
kuṅkumāgurukarpūrasindūrair mṛganābhibhiḥ ||
śilāpaṭṭe ca saṃsthāpya guḍājyalavaṇānvitam |
loṣṭakena samāyuktaṃ vastrayugmena veṣṭitam ||
loṣṭako nāma śilāpaṭṭoparisthitapeṣaṇopalaḥ etaddṛśadupalopadhānam (?) abhihitaṃ bhavati |
āvāhayen mahādevīṃ vasiṣṭhaprāṇasaṃmitām |
āyāhi varade devi sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru suvrate ||
pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ mukhyā tvaṃ devi bhāmini |
āyāhy ārundhatīṃ devīṃ pūjayet kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
dvibhujāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalum |
pratimāṃ kāñcanīṃ kṛtvā nāmabhiḥ pratipūjayet ||
devavandye namaḥ pādau jānunī lokavandite |
kaṭiṃ saṃpūjayet tasyā mahāsatī ca sarvadā ||
nābhiṃ gambhīranabhīti ṛṣipatnīṃ tataḥ (?) stanau |
jagaddhātrīṃ tathā kaṇṭhabāhū śāntyai namaḥ sadā ||
hastau tu varadāyai tu mukhaṃ dhṛtyai namo namaḥ |
arundhatī tathā pūjyā śiras tu kamalapriyā ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya tāṃ devīṃ gandhapuṣpe nivedayet |
pūjayitvā satīṃ devīṃ tataś cārghyaṃ nivedayet ||
arundhati mahābhāge vasiṣṭhapriyavādinī |
saubhāgyaṃ dehi me devi dhanaṃ putrāṃś ca dehi me ||
[314] arghyamantraḥ |
arghyaṃ datvā tu bhaktyā vai gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ |
prārthayet tāṃ mahābhāgāṃ lokavandyāṃ mahāsatīm ||
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi suvrate |
pautrāṃś ca sarvakāmāṃś ca dehi devi namo 'stu te ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
suvāsinyo 'tha saṃpūjyā divase divase tathā |
śubhagandhākṣatais tadvad dadyāt sarveṣu bhakṣakān ||
homāṃś caiva tathā kuryuḥ samidbhiś ca tilaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ tadvad dinasaṃkhyām athāpi vā ||
mithunāni ca saṃpūjya bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ |
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyākān yathā ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyayā ||
ācāryāya sabhāryāya vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca |
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ dadyāt kāṃsyapātraṃ sadīpakam ||
ādarśaṃ cāmaraṃ caiva dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm |
dadyāt tu bhojayitvā ca striyaḥ śūrpān samodakān ||
sodakān karakāṃs tadvat tayor vastraṃ yathāvidhi |
polikāṃ ghṛtapūpāṃś ca pūrikāś ca viśeṣataḥ |
somālikāś ca dātavyā ekaikaṃ dviguṇaṃ tathā ||
dviguṇaṃ bhojanaṃ dāyaparyāptam |
dīnānāthāṃś ca saṃpūjya svayaṃ naktaṃ samācaret |
dharmam iti śeṣaḥ |
[315]        anenaiva vidhānena nārī vā kurute vrataṃ ||
avaidhavyaṃ samāpnoti tathā janmasahasrakam |
putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitā ||
jīved varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ bhartrā saha mahāsatī |
evam abhyarcayitvā tu padaṃ gacchaty anāmayam ||
devabhāryā tathā svarge ṛṣibhāryā tathaiva ca |
rājabhāryā mahābhāgā sarvakāmapradaṃ vratam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ arundhatīvratam |
pulastya uvāca |
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi dūrvātrirātram uttamam |
nārīṇāṃ sukhasampattiputrapautrapradāyakam ||
tanūruhebhyaḥ saṃbhūtā dūrvā viṣṇor iyaṃ purā |
tasyām upari vinyastaṃ mathitāmṛtam uttamam ||
devadānavagandharvair yakṣavidyādharoragaiḥ |
tatra ye 'mṛtakumbhasya petur nisyandabindavaḥ ||
tair iyaṃ spṛṣṭagātrābhūt dūrvā tenājarāmarā |
vandyā pavitrā devaiś ca vanditā tv arcitā tathā||
śṛṇu dūrvātrirātrasya vidhiṃ kārtsnyena suvrata |
māsi bhādrapade caiva suklapakṣe trayodaśīm ||
trirātraṃ samupoṣyaṃ tu yāvat pūrṇā tithir bhavet |
umāmaheśvaraṃ devaṃ sāvitrīṃ dharmam eva ca ||
[316]        dūrvāmūle tu saṃsthāpya maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tataḥ |
umāmaheśvararūpaṃ tu prathamakṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrate, sāvitrīrūpaṃ putrakāmapūrṇimāyāṃ draṣṭavyam, dharmarūpaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottarāt |
caturvaktraś catuṣpādaś caturbāhuḥ sitāmbaraṃ |
sarvābharaṇavān śveto dharmaḥ kāryo virājate |
dakṣiṇe cākṣamālā ca tasya vāme tu pustakam ||
dūrvāsiñcanamantraḥ |
dūrvāṃ siñcāmi te mūlam udakair amṛtopamaiḥ |
avaidhavyaṃ ca me dehi dūrvāyai te namo namaḥ ||
dūrve hy amṛtajanmāsi vanditāsi surāsuraiḥ |
saubhāgyaṃ santatiṃ caiva sarvakāryakarī bhava ||
yathā śākhāpraśākhābhir vistṛtāsi mahītale |
tathā mamāpi santānaṃ dehi tvam ajarāmare ||
evam uccārya siñceta bhramayasva pradakṣiṇam |
devatāpūjanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ ||
suvāsinyaḥ striyaḥ pūjyā vaṃśapātraiḥ savāsasaiḥ |
anena vidhinā tiṣṭhed yāvac caiva dinatrayam ||
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta nṛtyavāditranisvanaiḥ |
śāntipāṭhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca sāvitryākhyānam uttamam ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale pratipaddivase śubhe |
homaṃ tatra prakurvīta tilājyasamidhādibhiḥ ||
kāṇḍāt kāṇḍāt tu mantreṇa sahasreṇa tu saṃkhyayā |
vasīrdhārāṃ tato dadyād dhatakrodho vimatsaraḥ ||
[317]        brāhmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet |
ācāryaṃ ca tathā pūjya umāmaheśarūpiṇam ||
gāvas tatraiva dātavyā nīlavarṇā viśeṣataḥ |
alābhe sarvavarṇānāṃ savatsāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm ||
tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ raupyakhurāṃ śṛṅge kanakasaṃbhṛtām |
ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣāṃ ca ratnapucchāṃ payomucam ||
īdṛśo 'nyās (?) tathā gāś ca dadyād dūrvātrirātrake |
ācāryaṃ vedavidvāṃsaṃ vṛddhaṃ caiva kuṭumbinam ||
sarvajñaṃ śāstravidvāṃsam ācāryaṃ tatra kārayet |
ācāryāya sabhāryāya paridhānaṃ pradāpayet ||
hastamātrā karṇamātrā strīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇam eva ca |
mithunāni tathā pūjya dvādaśaṃ parisaṃkhyayā ||
bhojanānte pradātavyaṃ bhūṣaṇācchādanādikam |
śayanaṃ teṣu dātavyaṃ vaṃśapātraṃ dṛḍhaṃ tathā||
saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ strīṇāṃ prītikaraṃ param |
datvā dānāni viprebhyaḥ phalānāṃ pāyasāni ca ||
bhojayitvā suhṛnmitraṃ sarvataḥ svajanaṃ tathā |
yā nārī samupoṣyaiva vratam etat purātanam ||
dūrvātrirātraṃ pavitraṃ puṇyaṃ santānadāyakam |
aiśvaryaṃ sukhasaubhāgyaṃ putrasantānavṛddhidam ||
[318]        martyaloke ciraṃ tiṣṭhaṃs tataḥ svargam avāpnuyāt |
devair ānanditās tatra pitṛbhiḥ saha gotrakaiḥ ||
vasanti ramamāṇās tā yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam |
arghyaṃ dadyāt tato rātrāv arundhatyāḥ prayatnataḥ ||
śaṅkhe tokaṃ samādāya sapuṣpaphalacandanam |
bhūmau jānuṃ ca vinyasya arghyaṃ dadyāt prayatnataḥ ||
arghyamantraḥ |
arundhatī satī devī vasiṣthapriyavādinī |
avaidhavyaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ dehi tvaṃ varade sadā ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ dūrvātrirātravratam |
nārada uvāca |
vratānāṃ yat paraṃ puṇyaṃ janmaduḥkhakṣayaṃkaram |
viṣṇor ārādhanāyālaṃ tad vadasva jagadguro ||
brahmovāca |
garbhajanmajarārogyaduḥkhasaṃsāranāśanam |
parituṣṭikaraṃ viṣṇoḥ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama ||
dattaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ śāntais taponiṣṭais tavāgrajaiḥ |
samuddiśya hariṃ bhaktyā marīcipramukhaiḥ purā ||
yat te rājaśatākhyaṃ tu vrataṃ puṃbhiḥ suduṣkaram |
[319]        vidhānaṃ tasya devarṣe phalaṃ ca sumahodayam ||
yat trirātraśataṃ kuryāt samuddiśya janārdanam |
kulānāṃ śatam ādāya sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ ||
navamyādisite pakṣe naro mārgaśirasya ca |
prārabheta trirātrāṇāṃ satataṃ vidhivad vratī ||
śraddadhāno jitakrodho nityasnāyī kṣamānvitaḥ |
abhyarcayet sadā viṣṇuṃ karmaṇā manasā girā ||
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu gataṃ vānudinaṃ japet |
oṃ namo vāsudeveti samabhyarcya janārdanam ||
asatyasteyapāruṣyapāpaiś ca saha saṃkathā |
madhumāṃsāsavarasān sadaiva parivarjayet ||
brahmacaryarataḥ śāntaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
vāsudevaparo nityaṃ bhavec ca vidhivad vratī ||
aṣṭamyāsekabhaktāśī dinatrayam upāvaset |
ekādaśyāṃ śuciḥ snāto vāsudevārcane rataḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed devaṃ gandhamālyavilepanaiḥ |
naivedyadhūpadīpādyair gītanṛtyaiś ca keśavam ||
anena vidhinā kṛtvā trirātrāṇāṃ śataṃ naraḥ |
nirvāpayet tato bhaktyā viśeṣavidhinā vratam |
saṃprāpte kārttike māsi vratam etad anuttamam ||
pratimāsaṃ trirātradvayam iti pañcāśatā māsaiḥ śataṃ tac cādhimāsadvayayogāc caturbhir varṣair iti kārttike samāptiḥ |
[320]        evaṃ bhojya dvijātibhyo dadyād vastrayugāni ca ||
evaṃ pratimāsavidhinā |
tathopavītachatrāṇi śṛṇu tāny āsanāni ca |
evaṃ viprān samabhyarcya guruṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
praṇamya śirasā deva sarvam udyāpayed vratam |
yathoktād dviguṇaṃ tasya vipre bhaktimataḥ phalam ||
pralīyante pare tattve vāsudeve 'vyaye vratī |
śrutvā caitad vrataṃ puṇyaṃ vimānaṃ tad dvijottamāḥ |
sarvapāpair vinirmuktā prayānti paramāṃ gatim ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktaṃ trivikramatrirātravratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
anusūyā śarīre tu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
utpannāḥ kena tapasā kautukaṃ mama keśava ||
anusūyā satīnāṃ tu trailokye vihitā kila |
dānena tapasā caiva tīrthasnānena vā dhruvam ||
śreṣṭhajātau samutpannā sarvalokanamaskṛtā |
etan me kathayasveha atryutpattyā mahāmate ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
tayā kṛte pārtha mahāvrataṃ vai
parā trirātraṃ carujāti bhadram (?) |
[321]        tasya prabhāvāt sutajātirūpaṃ
satītvabhāvaṃ vivide trilokyām ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kasmin kāle dine dine kasmin sthāne kasmin surottama |
vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ jātiḥ sthāpyā kathaṃ vada ||
nārāyaṇa uvāca |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi ca kartavyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāṇḍava |
niyamaṃ ca grahītavyam ācāryānujñayā tataḥ ||
kṛtvaikabhaktaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsatrayaṃ caret |
maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tatra sapatākaṃ manoharam ||
tatra jātiḥ prakartavyā svarṇād vibhavasārataḥ |
raupyapuṣpāṇi kāryāṇi vaṃśapātre nidhāpayet ||
tatra devās trayaḥ pūjyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
sapatnīkāḥ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiś ca vividhais tathā ||
atra viṣṇuśivamūrtikaraṇam aśokatrirātravad veditavyam |
yavaśālitilādyaiś ca vaṃśapātraṃ prapūrayet |
devatātritayaṃ pūjya vaṃśapātre trivastrakaiḥ ||
pītaraktasitaiś caiva nānāpuṣpaiḥ phalais tathā |
vastrālaṃkārapuṣpaiś ca guror dampatyam arcayet ||
pādukopānahaṃ śayyā chatraṃ gauś ca subhūṣitā |
[322]        tilataṇḍulamiśraiś ca yavahomaṃ prakalpayet ||
guḍekṣukṣīrakair dhānyair lavaṇena virūḍhakaiḥ |
saptadhānyais tathā dīpair vaṃśapātraprakalpitaiḥ ||
rajanyā kaṇṭhasūtraiś ca śubhaiḥ kiṃśukakesaraiḥ |
kṛtenānena bhūpāla vratena śṛṇu yat phalam ||
jātiṃ dhanapatiṃ putrānārogyaṃ kulasantatim |
saubhāgyaṃ rūpasaṃpattiṃ pūjitā sā prayacchati ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ jātitrirātravratam |
trirātropoṣito dadyāt phālgunyāṃ bhavanaṃ śubham |
ādityalokam āpnoti dhāmavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
sūryo 'tra devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ dhāmatrirātravratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
ahaspṛkdivasaṃ prāpya trirātropoṣito naraḥ |
mārgaśīrṣāt tathārabhya pūjayet tu trivikramam ||
trivarṇaiḥ kusumair devaṃ tribhiḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
trivarṇaiḥ śvetapītaraktaiḥ |
traye 'nulepanā deyās trisāraṃ dhūpam eva ca |
[323] trisāraṃ guggulukuṭukaśrīveṣṭikāḥ |
baliṃ trimadhuraṃ dadyāt trīṃś ca dīpān narottama |
yavais tilais tathā homaḥ kartavyaḥ sarṣapānvitaiḥ ||
dadyā trilohaṃ ca tathā dvijebhyaḥ
tāmraṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ca rājan |
na kevalaṃ sa kuladaṃ vrataṃ tu
yatheṣṭakāmāptikaraṃ pradiṣṭam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sukulatrirātravratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
caitre tu kumudair devaṃ tribhiḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
trirātraṃ tatra naktāśī nadyāṃ snātvā dvijātaye |
ajāḥ pañca payasvinyaḥ pradadyāt sa suvarṇakāḥ ||
na jāyate punar asau jīvaloke kadācana |
etad bastavrataṃ proktaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam ||
sūryo 'tra devatā |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ bastatrirātravratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
pārtha bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe dinodaye |
tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca śraddhayā parivatsaram ||
[324]        upavāsena gṛhṇīyād vrataṃ nāmnā tu goṣpadam |
snātvā naro 'tha nārī vā puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
dadhnā ca ghṛtamiśreṇa miṣṭakair vanamālayā |
abhyañjayed gavāṃ śṛṅge sapucche caiva bhārata ||
dadyād gavāhnikaṃ bhaktyā vāsaḥ pūrvāparāhayoḥ |
anagnipakvaṃ bhuñjīyāt tailākṣāravivarjitam ||
pūrvāparāhayoḥ dvitīyāpañcamyoḥ gavāṃ padeṣu mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānām amṛtasya nābhiḥ pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāyamāgāmanāgāmad itivad iṣṭayamāvāyuś ceti arghyamantraḥ |
gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
gāvo me hṛdaye santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham ||
iti goprārthanāmantraḥ |
vrajantīnāṃ gavāṃ nityam āyāntīnāṃ kurūdvaha |
pure dvāre 'tha vā goṣṭhe mantreṇānena bhaktimān ||
arghyaṃ dadyāt tathā grāsaṃ tuṣṭaye puṣtaye gavām |
itthaṃ saṃpūjya datvārghyaṃ tato gacched gṛhaṃ prati ||
pañcabhyāṃ krodharahito bhuñjīyād gorasaṃ dadhi |
śālipiṣṭaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ virūḍhakam ||
dināvasāne rājendra saṃyatas tāṃ niśāṃ svapet |
prabhāte gopadaṃ datvā brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
viprāya vedaviduṣe yathāśaktyā hiraṇmayīm |
[325]        kṣamāpayed gavāṃ nātha govindaṃ garuḍadhvajam ||
tathā govardhanaṃ śailaṃ kṛtvā guḍamayaṃ śubham |
yathāśaktyā samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ pṛthak |
yathaivaṃ gopadaṃ pārtha tathā govardhanaṃ girim ||
dadyād bhaktyā dvijendrāya govinda prīyatām iti |
gobhakto govrataṃ cīrtvā bhaktyā datvā ca gopadam ||
saubhāgyaṃ rūpalāvaṇyaṃ prāpnoti vipulāṃ śriyam |
govatsakākulagṛhaṃ gobhaktiṃ samavāpnuyāt ||
bhuktvā bhogān suvipulān mṛtaḥ svargapuraṃ vrajet |
divyān bhogāṃs tato bhuktvā puṇyaśeṣeṇa pārthiva ||
dhanadhānyajanopetaśālīkṣurasaṛddhimān |
kulaṃ ca nirmalaṃ labdhvā punar gāṃ bhaktimān bhavet ||
evaṃ janmatrayaṃ pārtha vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
tato golokam āsādya punarāvṛttivarjitam ||
tiṣṭhate devavad bhūtvā yāvad ācandratārakam |
divyarūpadharaḥ sragvī divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ||
gandharvagītavādyena sevyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ |
divyaṃ yugaśataṃ sthitvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet ||
yo gopadavratam idaṃ kurute trirātraṃ
gāvaś ca pūjayati gorasabhojanaṃ ca |
[326]        govindam ādipuruṣaṃ praṇidhāya citte
lokaṃ sa puṇyam upayāti gavāṃ pavitram ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ gopadatrirātravratam |
sādhu bhakto 'si dharmajña kālarātrivrataṃ mama |
śṛṇu vakṣyāmy ahaṃ te 'dya kartavyaṃ vidhivad yathā ||
māsi cāśvayuje 'ṣṭamyāṃ śuklapakṣe jitendriyaḥ |
satyavāk sthiracittātmā niyamastho bhavet sudhīḥ ||
kṛtvādau maṇḍapaṃ śrīmān bhūmibhāge same śubhe |
caturasraṃ samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam ||
sūtreṇa sūtritaṃ kṛtvā kuṇḍaṃ hastapramāṇataḥ |
dhenvākṛtisamaṃ tatra kārayed vidhivac chubham ||
tato haret susaṃbhārān dharbhāṃś caiva tilāṃs tathā |
pālāśīḥ pippalīś caiva samidhaḥ saptaviṃśatim ||
gargarīḥ kalaśāṃś caiva navāṃś caivāharet śubhān |
gargarī manthanī |
suvarṇapūrṇapātrāṇi vaidalāni śubhāni ca |
naivedyapuṣpatoyārghyaṃ havyāni ca navāni tu ||
āharet sarvam etad dhi vyañjanaṃ ca suśobhanam |
surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi jātīr nīlotpalāni ca ||
anyān api pavitrāṃś ca phalādīn āhared bahūn |
[327]        gandhāni caiva citrāṇi dhūpaṃ guggulapūrvakam ||
praṇītān viṣṭarāṃś caiva sruvaṃ ca srucam eva ca |
evaṃ saṃbhṛtya saṃbhārāṃś caturaḥ sukulodbhavān ||
adhivāsārtham ācāryān samuddiśya prakalpayet |
ye śuddhā vigatakrodhā devabrāhmaṇapūjakāḥ ||
āhośvit satkule jātāḥ satyaśaucakṣamānvitāḥ |
caturbhir īdṛśair vatsa ācāryair niyamasthitaiḥ ||
saptarātroṣitaiḥ pūjya aṣṭāhaṃ naktabhojanaiḥ |
evaṃ pakṣasādhyavratam |
tato niyamam ādāya tatkuṇḍe dhanuṣākṛtau |
homaṃ tu kārayed vatsa vipraiḥ śāṅkaravaṃśajaiḥ ||
śāṅkaravaṃśajāḥ śaivadīkṣāvantaḥ |
tadabhāvena caiveha homaṃ tadbhūmim icchatā |
kārayet kuśalān jñātvā avyaṅgakulajāṃs tathā ||
homābhāve prāpte śaivatulyānāṃ vidhānam |
gaṇānām adhipaṃ mātṛbhūpālaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam |
ādāv eva ca saṃpūjya tato homaṃ samācaret ||
mātṛbhūpālaḥ skandaḥ |
jātarūpeṇa deveśaṃ sarvakarmasusiddhaye |
[328]        āgneyaṃ mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ svarūpeṇa haraṃ yajet ||
bhūpālaḥ kṣetrapālaḥ āgneyaḥ kārttikaḥ | jātarūpaḥ suvarṇaṃ vināyakarūpaṃ kṛṣṇacaturthīvrate | skandarūpaṃ tu kārttikeyaṣaṣṭhīvrate veditavyam | mātṛrūpaṃ tu viṣṇudharmottare |
jātasya prādurbhūtasya rūpaṃ gajamukhādi tena deveśādīn pūjayet |
juhoti saptapālāśān udite juhuyāt tadā |
punaś cāste gate bhānāv āśvatthasamidho hunet ||
ardharātre tilaiḥ kṛṣṇai rājyenāktes tu bhaktitaḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvat kārayed dhomam uttamam ||
mantreṇānena tatraiva sarvāśubhavināśanāt |
varadena susiddhena puṣṭiśītavidhāyinā ||
oṃ hrīṃ namaḥ | kṛṣṇavāsasā saptasahasrakoṭisiṃhavāhane sahasravadane mahābale 'parājite prasaṅgire sarvasainyaparakarmanirvāsini paramantrachedani sarvasattvonmādani sarvabhūtadamani | sarvadoṣāt tvaṃ dhayavadhaya vidyā ucchedaya nikṛntaya sarvaduṣṭān bhakṣaya bhakṣaya jvālājihve karālavaktre sarvajantūn (?) mayaspheṭaya śṛṅkhalān troṭaya troṭaya pratyaṅgire namo 'stu te svāhā |
homaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ dagdhvā caruṃ sarvadiśāsu ca |
kṛśarājyena raktena payasā yojitena ca ||
kṛśarājyaiḥ surākṣīraiḥ kṛtaṃ ca subaliṃ dadyāt |
kuryāt saptadinaṃ caiva saptame 'hni śṛṇuṣva vai ||
āhutīḥ pañca pañca vā balidaśakaṃ hunet |
[329] saptāhabalihome tatra saptame 'hani pañca pañcāśatā nibaddhāvyastamahāvyāhṛtaiḥ kṛtvā daśakaṃ juhuyād daśapūrṇāhutyarthaḥ pṛthak saṅkhyā |
caturbhiḥ sa kulotpannais trirekasaptaśarvarī |
uṣitvā vātha naktena sthātavyaṃ hy arcanāya vai ||
saptarātraṃ trirātrantam ekarātraṃ yathāśaktyupavāsena balihomau kṛtvā pūjāṃ kurvīta naktena pakṣo dhāraṇīyaḥ |
pañcame pūjanaṃ vatsa kartavyaṃ vidhivat sadā |
dharmayajñodbhavair viprais tuṣṭārthaṃ tattvataḥ śṛṇu ||
dharmayajñodbhavaiḥ śaivaiḥ |
dināni sapta saptaikaṃ candanāguruṇā tathā |
devyāḥ paramayā bhaktyā kṣālayen mukhamaṇḍalam ||
lekhe lekhyasya kartavyā kṣālaneyaṃ mukhasya tu |
iyaṃ candanāgaruvarṇā pūrvakṛtā ||
pratimā mṛṇmayī yā tu sthāpya tāṃ pūjayet sadā |
prakṣālya mantrapūtena pramṛjyāmalavāsasā ||
madhunā madhuparkaṃ tu kārayet pūjayet tataḥ ||
tato 'mṛtaṃ punar yojya mukhaṃ gātraṃ ca kārayet |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tato bhūyo daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca ||
dharmapālodbhavetānumantavyā (?) sustavena vai |
[330] dharmapālo bhaktasya nāmastotram |
stutvā ca tatraiva bhaktyā brāhmaṇān vidhivat tataḥ |
kāñcanair arcayed vatsa samāṃsair dharmayojitaiḥ ||
punar gītaṃ tathā nṛtyaṃ vādyaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ |
devyāś ca purato 'tyantayatnād evaṃ tu kārayet ||
svālpam (?) eva kṛtaṃ vatsa gṛhṇāti bhaktitaḥ sadā |
sarvasvaṃ caiva me yuktaṃ madbhaktāya dadāmy aham ||
prītyarthaṃ mama mantreṇa śuciḥ snātvā jitendriyaḥ |
dāntyā kṣantyā samāyuktāṃ tathā bhaktiṃ samācaret ||
na dhārayen malaṅkāre yatas tasyāyam īritam |
na caitaṃ vai nayet svarge na tapo mokṣam eva ca ||
evaṃ niṣpādayitvā tu gṛhaṃ gacchec chanais tataḥ |
gatvā prāśya śucir bhūtvā pañcagavyaṃ mudānvitaḥ ||
aṣṭau caiva kumārīś ca aṣṭau ca dvijasattamān |
homayed vidhivad vahnau mām uddiśya ca mātaram ||
mātaraṃ mātṛgaṇānādi vāṣṭau (?) ||
aṣṭau caiva dvijān bhojya vratasthān śivadhārmikān |
uddiśya śaṅkaraṃ devaṃ tatpatnīṃ ca vināyakam ||
pratyekam aṣṭau saptātha hotāraṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
tataḥ kṣamāpayet paścāt praṇipatya muhur muhuḥ ||
etat sarvaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ bhaktyā vistarato bhavet |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇāṃś caiva kāruṇyāt tatra bhojayet ||
yad dattaṃ vedaviprebhyo yad dattaṃ brahmacāriṇe |
[331]        tato 'tithiṣu yad dattaṃ kāruṇyāc caiva tat tathā |
tat sarvam akṣayaṃ dānaṃ vai mūlyena vidhānataḥ ||
nūnaṃ caiveśvare dattaṃ satyam etan na saṃśayaḥ |
arhānarhāś ca saṃbhojyāḥ sarve caivotsave mama ||
āśayā parayā prāptāḥ strībālavikalākhilam |
bandhubhiś ca tataḥ sārdham udayā parayā yutaḥ |
hutabhug yajñaśeṣaṃ tu bhuñjīta prayatātmavān ||
akāle kaumudīṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇapakṣe ca yaḥ sadā ||
akālakaumudī dīpālikotsavam |
māsi cāśvayuje 'ṣṭamyām ārabhet parvaṇācaret |
uṣitvā vātha naktena ekabhaktena vā punaḥ ||
vihāya pāpasaṅghātaṃ sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim |
parvaṇā pañcadaśyā, ayam utsavo vratasyottarāṅgam, ata eva devakīkāryaḥ |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāḥ pārtha vaiśyā vā śūdrajātayaḥ |
cariṣyanti vrataṃ cedaṃ te 'pi yāsyanty anāmayam ||
evaṃ tu vidhivat kuryāt putravān sadhano bhavet ||
nāliṅganty āpado ghorāḥ śatrubhir na bādhyate |
kālīvratam idaṃ khyātaṃ kartavyaṃ satkulodbhavaiḥ ||
[332]        śāntipuṣṭiramākāmair vidyākāmaiś ca yatnataḥ |
ramākāmair lakṣmīkāmaiḥ |
siṃhāyutasahasreṇa uhyamānena saṃcaret |
vimānenārkavarṇena divaṃ gacched ya ācaret ||
etad vrataṃ tadā tvaṃ hi mayoktaṃ pāpanāśanam |
bhaktyā ca parayā vatsa kartum arhasy atandritaḥ ||
atijātiṣu saṃbandhaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati śaṅkaram |
hīnavarṇena kurvaṃś ca syād anenāpakārakaḥ ||
iti kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ kālarātrivratam |
brahmovāca |
āśvine vātha mādhe vā caitre vā śrāvaṇe 'pi ca |
kṛṣṇād ārabhya kartavyaṃ vrataṃ śuklāvadhiṃ haret ||
śuklāvadhir bhavati śuklapakṣāvadhiḥ |
etac coktamāseṣv eva vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa kṛṣṇāṣṭamyām ārabhya śuklāṣṭamīṃ yāvat kartavyam |
aṣṭamīm āśvinīṃ kṛṣṇām ekabhaktena kārayet |
maṅgalārūpiṇīṃ devīm atha vā rurughātinīm ||
pūjayen navabhedena gandhamālyanivedanaiḥ ||
navabhedena navakṛtvo gandhadharṣaṇena |
kanyakā bhojayed vatsa devībhaktāṃś ca mānavān |
[333]        naktena navamī kāryā yāvan na daśamīṃ kṣipet |
ekādaśyām upavaset punar eṣ vidhir bhavet ||
punar eṣa vidhir iti yathā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ dinacatuṣkam ekabhaktanaktāyācitopavāsāt param api dinacatuṣkatrayaṃ neyam ity arthaḥ |
yāvac chuklāṣṭamīṃ (?) śakra upoṣya tu vidhānataḥ |
dānaṃ homo japaḥ pūjā kanyābhojyaṃ tu pratyaham ||
kartavyaṃ jitaroṣeṇa devyā bhaktiratena ca |
navadhā paśughātena mahiṣājāvikādiṣu ||
kartavyaṃ bhūtavaitāle na caivātmacikīrṣayā ||
kanyā hy alaṅkṛtās tatra dvijā devīparāyaṇāḥ |
navadhāpaśughātena na khaṇḍakaraṇena ca ||
bhūtavaitāle bhūtavaitālārtham ātmacikīrṣayā ātmabhogecchayā | alaṅkṛtāḥ kāryā iti viśeṣaḥ |
naṭanartena prekṣāś ca rathayātrā sajāgaram |
dānaṃ deyaṃ yathāśaktyā sarveṣām api śaktitaḥ ||
mahābhairavarūpeṇa asthimālādharāś ca ye |
pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa vastraśobhāḥ purādiṣu |
kartavyāḥ sarvakāmārthaprāpaṇāya surottama ||
anena vidhinā śakra yatheṣṭaṃ labhate phalam ||
[334]        maṅgalā bhairavī durgā vārāhī tridaśeśvarī |
umā haimavatī kanyā kapālī kaiṭabheśvarī ||
kālī brāhmī maheśī ca kaumārī madhusūdanī |
vārāhī vāsavī carcā nāmāny etāni vai japet |
pūjayed bhojayet kanyāḥ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
vastrālaṃkārakāṃsyādikarakāḥ kaṭisūtrakāḥ |
dātavyāḥ cātmanaḥ śaktyā devyā bhaktaiḥ sukhārthibhiḥ ||
atha vā navarātraṃ ca saptapañcatrikaṃ hi vā |
ekabhaktena naktenāyācitopoṣitaiḥ kramāt ||
navarātrir ekabhaktena sapta naktena pañcāyācitena tisra upavāseneti kramaḥ | aṣṭamīm ante kṛtvā navādigaṇanā | pūrvatrāsamarthasyaite pakṣāḥ |
kṣapayetāśvine śakra yāvac chuklā tu aṣṭamī |
pūjayen maṅgalāṃ tatra maṇḍale vidhivat kṛte ||
sarvasaṃbhārasaṃpanne sarvasiddhividhāyake |
sarvakāmaprade śakra sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt ||
arthakāmasya arthaṃ tu rājyakāmasya rājyadam |
ārogyaṃ putradaṃ vatsa mahāpātakanāśanam ||
sarvavarṇaiś ca kartavyaṃ puṃstrībālanapuṃsakaiḥ |
sarvadā sarvagā devī yasmāc chakra mahāphalā ||
anena vidhinā vatsa sa dadāti vicāraṇā |
sarveṣāṃ vratayonīnāṃ sarvavratamahāphalam ||
navamyākhyaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tava samyak prakāśitam |
[335]        nākhyeyaṃ bhaktihīnasya mūrkhasya hetuvādinaḥ ||
deyaṃ bhaktāya śāntāya śivaviṣṇuratāya ca |
devībhaktaḥ sadācāraḥ kanyāpūjārato naraḥ ||
