ihaiva sarvakāmāni sādhayed avicāraṇāt |
viprā yathā ca pūjyānāṃ dānānāṃ kāṃcanaṃ yathā ||
bhūrlokaḥ sarvalokānāṃ tīrthānāṃ jāhnavī tathā |
yathāśvamedho yajñānāṃ mathurā muktikāṅkṣiṇām ||
vīṇāṃ yathāhibhuk śreṣṭho devānām acyuto yathā |
tathā sarvavratānāṃ tu varoktaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
vasiṣṭhabhṛgugargādaiś cīrṇaṃ kṛtayugādiṣu |
nabhogair amburīṣādyaiś cīrṇaṃ tretāyugādiṣu ||
vīrabhadrādibhir vipraiḥ śūdrair anyaiḥ kalau yuge ||
dināni pañca pūjyāni cīrṇam etat mahāvratam |
brāhmaṇair brahmacaryeṇa japahomakriyādibhiḥ ||
kṣatriyaiś ca tathā satyaśaucavrataparāyaṇaiḥ |
nādhayo vyādhayas tasya na ca śatrubhayaṃ bhavet ||
saṃsārapūjito nityaṃ mahān eko 'pi jāyate |
śravaṇāt sarvakāryāṇi sidhyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ maṅgalāvratam |
[336]
atha bhīṣmapañcakavratam |
nāradapurāṇāt |
nārada uvāca |
yad etad acalaṃ puṇyaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ vratam |
kartavyaṃ kārttike māsi prayatnād bhīṣmapañcakam ||
vidhānaṃ tasya vispaṣṭaṃ phalaṃ ca surasattama |
kathayasva prasādān me munīnāṃ hitakāmyayā ||
brahmovāca |
pravakṣyāmi mahāpuṇyaṃ vrataṃ vratavatāṃ vara ||
bhīṣmenaitad yataḥ prāptaṃ vrataṃ pañcadinātmakam |
sakāśād vāsudevasya tenoktaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
vratasyāsya guṇān vaktuṃ kaḥ śaktaḥ keśavād ṛte |
vrataṃ caitan mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
ato naraiḥ prayatnena kartavyaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam |
kārttikasyāmale pakṣe snātvā samyag yatavrataḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ tu gṛhṇīyād vrataṃ pañcadinātmakam |
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena madhyāhne ca tathā vratī ||
nadyāṃ nijharagarte vā samālabhyaṃ ca gomayam |
yavavrīhitilaiḥ samyaṅ pitṝn saṃtarpayet kramāt |
snātvā maunaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhautavāsā dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
[337]        tataḥ saṃpūjayed devaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim |
snāpayed acyutaṃ bhaktyā madhukṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ ||
tathaivaṃ pañcagavyena gandhacandanavāriṇā |
candanena sugandhena kuṅkumenātha keśavam ||
karpūrośīramiśreṇa lepayed garuḍadhvajam |
arcayed ucitaiḥ puṣpair gandhadhūpasamanvitaiḥ ||
gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dahed akṣayabhaktimān |
dīpakaṃ tu divārātrau dadyāt pañcadināni tu ||
naivedyaṃ devadevasya paramānnaṃ nivedayet |
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ stutvā caiva praṇamya ca ||
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudeveti japed aṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
juhuyāc ca ghṛtābhyaktaṃ tilavrīhiyavaṃ vratī ||
ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa svāhākārānvitena ca ||
oṃ namo viṣṇaveti ṣaḍakṣaro mantraḥ |
upāsya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam |
japitvā pūrvavan mantraṃ kṣitiśāyī bhaven naraḥ ||
sarvam etad vidhānaṃ tu kāryaṃ pañcadineṣv api |
viśeṣoktaṃ (?) vrate cāsmin yad anyūnaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat ||
prathame 'hni hareḥ pādau pūjayet kamalair naraḥ |
dvitīye bilvapatreṇa jānudeśaṃ samarcayet ||
pūjayec ca tṛtīye 'hni nābhiṃ bhṛṅgārakeṇa tu |
[338]        vāṇabilvajayābhiś ca tataḥ (?) skandho samarcayet |
tato 'nupūjayec chīrṣaṃ mālatyā cakrapāṇinam ||
kārttikyāṃ devadevasya bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ |
pūjayej japamantreṇa gandhadhūpaṃ nivedayet ||
arcayitvā hṛṣīkeśam ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
triḥ prāśya gomayaṃ samyak ekādaśyām upāvaset ||
gomūtraṃ mantravadbhyo dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed vratī |
kṣīraṃ caiva trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathā dadhi |
saṃprāśya kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ laṅghanīyaṃ caturdinam ||
prāśanam, homamantreṇa |
pañcame tu dine snātvā vidhivat pūjya keśavam |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
tathopadeṣṭāram api pūjayed vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
tato naktaṃ samaśnīyāt pañcagavyapuraḥsaram ||
evaṃ samyak samāpyaṃ syād yathoktaṃ vratam uttamam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ prakhyātaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
janmaprabhṛti janmāṃsaṃ tyaktvā puṇyam avāpnuyāt |
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti saṃtyaktvā bhīṣmapañcake ||
madyapo yaḥ piben madyaṃ janmanobharaṇāntikam |
tad bhīṣmapañcake tyaktvā (?) saṃprāpnoty adhikaṃ phalam ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
[339]                kṛṣṇa uvāca |
kārttike śuklapakṣasya śṛṇu dharmaṃ purātanam |
ekādaśyāṃ samārabhya vijñeyaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
duṣkaraṃ satvahīnānām aśakyaṃ bālacetasām |
pāpadhīḥ parihartavyā brahmacaryeṇa niścayā ||
madyaṃ māṃsam asatyaṃ ca varjayet pāpabhāṣaṇam |
śākāhāreṇa munyannaiḥ (?) kṛṣṇārcanaparair naraiḥ ||
strībhir vākyena kartavyaṃ svasatyaḥ puṇyavardhanaḥ |
vidhavābhis tu kartavyaṃ putrāṇāṃ śubhavṛddhaye ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ mokṣārthaṃ caiva pāṇḍava |
nityaṃ snānena dānena kārttikīṃ yāvad eva tu ||
vaiśvadevas tu kartavyo viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaiḥ |
vaiśvadevaḥ sarvadevatāhomaḥ tāś ca viṣṇuvibhūtitvena bhāvanīyāḥ |
yā yasya pratimā kāryā raudravakrātibhīṣaṇā |
khaḍgahastātivikṛtā tau hi daṃṣṭrākarālinī ||
tilaprasthopari sthāpyā kṛṣṇavastreṇa veṣṭitā |
raktapuṣpākṛtāpīḍāṃ jvalatkāñcanakuṇḍalām ||
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā dharmarājasya nāmabhiḥ |
[340]        imam uccārayen mantraṃ gṛhītakusumāñjaliḥ ||
yad anyajanmani kṛtam iha janmani vā punaḥ |
pāpaṃ praśamam āyātu tava pādaprasādataḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat pratimāṃ ca sakāñcanām |
sakāñcanā suvarṇadakṣiṇāyuktā |
vācakāya pradātavyā dharmo me prīyatām iti |
tadvac ca devadevasya kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakāriṇaḥ ||
tadvad iti haripratimā deyā |
kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāśaktyā viprāṇāṃ vedavedināṃ |
dadyād dhiraṇyaṃ (?) gāṃ caiva kṛṣṇo me prīyatām iti ||
anyeṣām api dātavyaṃ satkṛtya vasuvāñchitam |
kṛtakṛtyaḥ sthito bhūtvā viraktaḥ saṃyato bhavet ||
śāntacetā nirābādhaḥ paraṃ padam avāpnuyāt |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaś caturdaṃṣṭraś caturbhujaḥ ||
aṣṭapād ekanayanaḥ śaṅkukarṇo mahāsvanaḥ |
jaṭī dvijihvas tāmrāsyo mṛgarājatanucchadaḥ ||
cintanīyo mahādevo yasya rūpaṃ na vidyate |
vratadevatāyā mahāviṣṇor idaṃ rūpaṃ cintyaṃ pūjā deyā ca mṛgarājatanucchedaḥ siṃhatvak |
idaṃ bhīṣmeṇa kathitaṃ śaratalpagatena me |
tad etat te mayā khyātaṃ duṣkaraṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
vrataṃ tad rājaśārdūla pravaraṃ bhīṣmapañcakam |
[341]        yas tasmiṃs (?) toṣayed bhaktyā tasmai muktiprado 'cyutaḥ ||
brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho 'tha vā yatiḥ |
prāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ tat kṛtvā bhīṣmapañcakam ||
brahmahā madyapaḥ steyī gurugāmī sadānṛtī |
mucyate pātakāt samyak kṛtvaikaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
athāsmiṃs toṣito viṣṇur nṛṇāṃ muktiprado bhavet |
śrutvaitat paṭhyamānaṃ tu pavitraṃ bhīṣmapañcakam ||
mucyate pātakān martyaḥ pāṭhako viṣṇulokabhāk |
dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ yudhiṣṭhira mahāvratam ||
yac cīrtvā brahmahā goghnaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
yad bhīṣmapañcakam iti prathitaṃ pṛthivyām
ekādaśīprabhṛti pañcadaśīniruddham |
munyannabhojanaparasya narasya tasminn
iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ diśati pāṇḍavaśārṅgadhanvā ||
iti bhīṣmapañcakavratam |
vyāsa uvāca |
yadajarbhād (?) dānavā pūrvaṃ cārcayitvā janārdanam |
tāṃ yoganidrām asṛjad devīṃ rakṣārtham ātmanaḥ ||
ekāṃśato bhagavatī siddhim ekāṃ tad eva tu |
śuklapakṣe tu saṃpajyā kārttike keśavājñayā ||
[342]        caturthyām atha vāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ vā susiddhikā |
caturdaśyām atho strībhiḥ susnātābhir yathākramam ||
gṛhād bāhye tu yatra syād ekānte tu phaladrumaḥ |
tat tathā puṣpadhūpānnasampadā pūjayec ca tām ||
ekā putravatī nārī manovākkāyasaṃyutā |
sarvopakaraṇair (?) yuktaṃ gṛhītvā grāmam uttamam ||
tato dadāti śyenāya suprītā prītikāminī ||
imam āsanavastrādyaṃ bhagavatyai nivedaya |
ity uktvā svagṛhaṃ yāti tataḥ pūrṇā manorathāḥ ||
kṛte yuge prasiddho 'yaṃ dāsavad bhṛtako yathā |
dāsa iva bhṛtaka iva preṣyatvena kṛte yuge prasiddha ity arthaḥ |
athoparivaro rājā ṛtuparṇaḥ pure svake |
nidhāya pradadau netuṃ śvenāya svāṃ priyāṃ prati ||
yugeṣv anyeṣu mantraṃ tu jape tv anala ity api |
jahāti bhūmau saṃprāptā prāṅmukhī yāti veśma ca ||
āmantraṇaṃ tu yasyāsti pakṣiṇā nirmitaṃ purā |
sa eva pakṣī gṛhṇāti sagrāsam iti niścayaḥ ||
ādau gṛhe tato bhuṅkte sā nārī susamāhitā |
paścād gṛhapatir bhuṅkte sabhṛtyajñātibāndhavaḥ ||
gṛhadevī tu tenaiva vidhinā pūjayet patim ||
śyenagrāso na deyaś ca na ca vṛkṣaṃ samāśraye |
[343]        kiṃ tu guptaṃ gṛhe tv āryā pūjayīta pativratā ||
yugeṣv anyeṣu sadbhāvo dampatyor no bhaved yadā |
tadā svakuladharmaṃ tu tāvanmātraṃ karoti saḥ ||
yāścenayā (?) patyur anujñāṃ vinā tu śyenayā gṛha eva devī pūjayitavyety arthaḥ |
ity ādityapurāṇoktaṃ śyenagrāsanavidhiḥ |
īśvara uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vratānāṃ tu yathākramam |
aṣṭamyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayos tathā ||
upoṣya saṃyato bhūtvā trividhenāntarātmanā |
tato 'parāhṇe śucinā viśeṣāt pūjayec chivam ||
pūrvoktena vidhānena japahomādim ācaret |
pūjayet parayā bhaktyā guruṃ vā sādhanādikaiḥ ||
tatas tu pañcagavyaiś ca prāśayec chalukatrayam |
samāttaś (?) copasaṃspṛśya haviṣyānnena vartanam ||
anena vidhinā yatnād yāvajjīvaṃ vrataṃ caret |
pitā pitāhamaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||
vasanti śivalokeṣu śivavrataprabhāvataḥ |
etac chivavrataṃ nāma vratānām uttamottamam ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ śivavratam |
[344]
maitreya uvāca |
kārttikaḥ khalu māso vai sarvadevamayo mahān |
kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣeṇa tatra pañcadināni tu ||
puṇyāni teṣu yad dattam akṣayaṃ sarvakāmikam |
ekādaśyāṃ parair dattaṃ dīpaṃ prajvālya mūṣikām ||
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya parāṅgatim avāpa sā |
lubdhako 'pi caturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam ||
nirbhaktiḥ parasaṃgatyā viṣṇulokaṃ jagāma saḥ |
śvapākāditrayodaśyāṃ dīpān datvā paraiḥ kṛtān ||
vaiśyā līlāvatī bhūtvā jagāma svargam akṣayam |
kopaḥ kaścid amāvāsyāṃ pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca śārṅgiṇaḥ ||
muhurḍayas tv ajāpālo rājarājeśvaro bhavet |
tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyā rātrāv astam ite ravau ||
gṛheṣu sarvagoṣṭheṣu caityeṣ āyataneṣu ca |
devānāṃ caiva rathyāsu śmaśāneṣu saraḥsu ca |
naktāśinā śubhārthāya yadā pañcadināni tu ||
pāpinaḥ pitaro ye ca luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ |
caturdaśyām amāvāsyāṃ piṇḍadasyāpnuvanti te
svargatim iti śeṣaḥ |
tatra śrīḥ pūjanīyā tu manuṣyāṇāṃ prayatnataḥ ||
śrīkāmais tatra śarvaryāṃ krīḍitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ |
bandhubhiḥ sahitaiḥ patnyā nṛtyagītaprajāgaraiḥ ||
[345]        yadi harṣaṃ prayātīha tasya saṃvatsaraṃ jayam |
dyute tu krīḍite hanau haniḥ syād vijaye dhruvam ||
sukhaprītisulābhaḥ syād vatsaraṃ manujasya tu |
gauryā jitā purā śambhur nagno dyūtair visarjitaḥ ||
tenāsau śaṅkarī duḥkhī sarvadomā sukhānvitā |
śriyā sārdhaṃ jagadyoniḥ śete viṣṇuḥ sukhānvitaḥ |
tasyāṃ rātrau janānāṃ tu ato 'rthaṃ sukhasuptikā ||
nandā sunandā surabhī suśokhā sumanā tathā |
nirgatā mathyamānābdhau uṣaḥ snānaṃ śubhapradam ||
kāmadhenor āvirbhāvabhāvitasvadehāt uṣaḥ praśasta ity arthaḥ |
tatra snātvā samabhyarcya dhenuṃ pūjya prayatnataḥ |
godānaphalam āpnoti naro vigatakalmaṣaḥ ||
ekādaśyām upoṣyātha naro dinacatuṣṭayam |
ghṛtena snāpayed viṣṇuṃ gavyena payasāpi vā ||
naktāśī gorasair havyaiḥ pūjayen madhusūdanam |
gandhapuṣpaiḥ sunaivedyair vastrālaṃkārakuṇḍalaiḥ ||
śaṅkhāsicakroddhṛtabāhuviṣṇoḥ
gadākṣahastasya tu śārṅgapāṇeḥ |
arghyaṃ prayacchāmi janārdanasya
śriyā yutasyāpi dharādharasya ||
[346]        śriyaḥ patiṃ śrīdharam eva kāntaṃ
śriyaḥ sakhāyaṃ hi śriyonumūlam |
nāmāny ahaṃ śrīdharaśrīnivāsaṃ
samarcito me pradadātu kāmān ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena śriyāyuktaṃ tu nāmabhiḥ |
pṛthak jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt śriyā sārdhaṃ jagatpateḥ ||
yā devī bhārgavaṃ tejaḥ kulaṃ sarvatra pūjitā |
āyātu sā gṛhe nandā suprītā varadā mama ||
yāṅgirasaṃ sadā devī sunandā pratyupasthitā |
āyātu me gṛhe sā tu suprītā varadā satī ||
surabhī yā bharadvājaṃ kāmadhenuḥ sukāmadā |
sadā bhajet gṛhaṃ sātra mamāyātu surārcitā ||
suśīlā kaśyapaṃ yā tu bhaje sarvatra kāmadā |
sā me bhavatu suprītā kāmadhenur gṛhe sadā ||
sumanā yā vasiṣthaṃ tu saṃprāpya mumude śubhā |
sā me gṛhaṃ sadāyātu kāmadā surapūjitā ||
evaṃ pūjya vidhānena prabhāte vimale śubhe |
śuklāmbaradharaḥ snātaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ||
kṛtanityakriyo hṛṣṭaḥ kuṇḍalāṅgadabhūṣitaḥ |
prātaḥ pratipadi prītaḥ kāmadhenuprado bhavet ||
kāmadenus tu vahnipurāṇoktā vijñeyā sā ca dānakhaṇḍe eva draṣṭavyā |
[347]        varyaṃ hareḥ sarvam idaṃ pavitraṃ
tatrāpi varyā śaradeva tāsām |
tasmiñ chubhaḥ kārttikanāmamāsas
tatrāpi puṇyo hi babhūva darśaḥ ||
yasyāṃ haro daityabhayād vimukto
urasthalaṃ prāpya sukhena śete |
lakṣmyāṃ purādyāpi vinirmitā vai
kāmapradā denava eva yatra ||
barhir makhe yatra dine samastāḥ
sudhenavo bhūmitale bhramanti |
gṛhena yasmin kathayanti līlā
hānikṣayas tatra ca satyam etat ||
tasmāt tvam atraiva ca kāmadhenuṃ
dadyāḥ samuddiśya tu keśavaṃ tu |
viprāya vai sarvaguṇāya yatra
kṛtvā vrataṃ kṛtsnam ato hares tu ||
saptāparān saptāvarān ātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ |
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpāt mocayaty avanīpate ||
pade pade 'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
dānānām eva sarveṣām uttamaṃ parikīrtitam ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ dhanyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ sarvadaṃ śubham |
[348]        sarveṣām eva pāpānāṃ pāpānāṃ mahatām api ||
prāyaścittam idaṃ śastaṃ kathitaṃ brahmaṇā nṛpa |
brahmaviṭkṣatraśūdrāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ ca vrataṃ nṛpa ||
sarvakāmaphalārthāya kamadhenuvrataṃ satām |
vratānte tilahomaś ca kāmadhenoḥ prayatnataḥ ||
iti vahnipurāṇoktaṃ kāmadhenuvratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
amāvāsyāṃ tu devāś ca kārttike māsi keśavam |
abhayaṃ prāpya suptās tu sukhākṣīrodasānuṣu (?) ||
lakṣmīr daityabhayān muktā sukhaṃ suptā bhujodare |
caturbhujasya hastānte brahmā suptasya paṅkaje ||
ato 'rthaṃ vidhivat kāryā manuṣyaiḥ sukhasuptikā |
divā tatra na bhoktavyam ṛte bālāturān janān ||
pradoṣasamaye lakṣmīṃ pūjayitvā tataḥ kramāt |
dīpavṛkṣāś ca dātavyāḥ śaktyā devagṛheṣu ca ||
catuṣpathe śmaśāneṣu nadīparvataveśmasu |
vṛkṣamūleṣu goṣtheṣu catvareṣu guhāsu ca ||
[349]        vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ śobhitavyāḥ krayavikrayabhūmayaḥ |
dīpamālāparikṣipte predeśe tadanantaram ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvādau vibhajya ca bubhukṣitān |
alaṃkṛtena bhoktavyaṃ navavastropaśobhinā ||
snigdhair mugdhair vidagdhaiś ca bāndhavair nibhṛtaiḥ saha |
śaṅkaras tu purā dyūtaṃ sasarja sumanoharam ||
kārttike śuklapakṣe tu prathame 'hani satyavat |
jitaś ca śaṅkaras tatra jayaṃ lebhe ca pārvatī ||
ato 'rthaṃ śaṅkaro duḥkhī umā nityaṃ sukhoṣitā |
tasmād dhūtaṃ pravartavyaṃ prabhāte tatra mānavaiḥ ||
tasmin bhavej jayo yasya tasya saṃvatsaraṃ śubham |
parājaye viruddhaṃ tu labdhanāśas tato bhavet ||
śrotavyaṃ gītavādyādi svanuliptaiḥ svalaṃkṛtaiḥ |
viśeṣavac ca bhoktavyaṃ praśastair bāndhavaiḥ saha ||
tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ kartavyaṃ śayyāsthānaṃ suśobhanam ||
gandhapuṣpais tathā vastrai ratnair mālyair alaṃkṛtam |
dīpamālāparikṣiptaṃ tathā dhūpena dhūpitam ||
dayitābhiś ca sahitair neyā sā ca bhaven niśā |
navair vastraiś ca sampūjya dvijasaṃbandhibāndhavān ||
ity ādityapurāṇoktaṃ sukhasuptivratam |
[350]
atha kaumudīmahotsavaḥ |
padmapurāṇe |
kārttike māsy amāvāsyā tasyāṃ dīpapradīpanam |
śālāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kuryāt sa gacchet paramaṃ padam ||
pratipadi brāhmaṇyaś ca guḍamiśraiḥ sadīpakaiḥ |
vāsobhir ahataiḥ pūjyā gacched vai brahmaṇaḥ puram ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpair navair vastraiḥ saṃmānaṃ bhūṣayet tu yaḥ |
tasyāṃ pratipadā yā tu sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
mahāpuṇyā tithir iyaṃ balir ājyapravartinī |
brahmaṇas tu priyā nityaṃ baler yā parikīrtitā ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet yo 'syām ātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ ||
caitre māsi mahābhāho puṇyā pratipadā varā |
tatra yaś ca tilāṃ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ kuryān narottamaḥ ||
na tasya duritaṃ kiṃcin ādhayo vyādhayo nṛpa |
bhavanti kuruśārdūla tasmāt snānaṃ samācaret ||
divyanīrājanaṃ tadvat sarvarogapraṇāśanam |
gomahiṣyādi yat kiṃcit tatsārdhaṃ bhūṣayen nṛpa ||
tailavastrādibhiḥ sarvān toraṇādhas tato nayet |
brāhmaṇānāṃ tato bhojyaṃ kuryāt (?) kurukulodvaha ||
tisra etāḥ purā proktāḥ tithayaḥ kurunandana |
kārttikāśvayuje māsi caitre vāpi tathā nṛpa ||
[351]        snānaṃ dānaṃ śataguṇaṃ kārttikāyāṃ tathā nṛpa |
balir ājyeṣu śubhadā pāṃśunāśubhanāśanī ||
vāmanapurāṇe |
valiṃ prati trivikrama uvāca |
tathā yad udbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛtte śakra mahotsave |
vīrapratipadā nāma tava bhāvī mahotsavaḥ |
tatra tvāṃ naraśārdūla hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
puṣpadhūpapradānena arcayiṣyanit yatnataḥ |
tatrotsavo mukhyatamo bhaviṣyati divāniśam ||
tathaiva rājye bhavatas tu sāṃprataṃ
tathaiva bhāviny api kaumudī ca |
bhaviṣyottarāt |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā vāmanarūpeṇa prārthayitvā dharām imām |
baliyajñe hariḥ pūrvaṃ krītavān vikramais tribhiḥ ||
indrāya dattavān rājyaṃ baliṃ pātālavāsinam |
kṛtvā daityapater dattam ahorātratrayaṃ nṛpa ||
ekam evārthabhogārthaṃ balirājyeti cihnitam |
sarahasyaṃ tad etat te kathayāmi narottama ||
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ niśāgame |
yatheṣṭaceṣṭaṃ daityānāṃ rājyaṃ teṣāṃ mahītale ||
[352]                yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
viśeṣeṇa hṛṣīkeśa kaumudīṃ brūhi me prabho |
kim arthaṃ dīyate dānaṃ tasyāṃ kā devatā bhavet ||
kiṃ ca tatra bhaved deyaṃ kebhyo deyaṃ janārdana |
praharṣaḥ ko 'tra nirdiṣṭaḥ krīḍā kātra prakīrtitā ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ dinodaye |
avaśyam eva kartavyaṃ snānaṃ narakabhīrubhiḥ ||
apāmārgān pallavān vā bhrāmayec chirasopari |
śītaloṣṇasamāyukta sakaṇṭhakadalānvita ||
hara pāpam apāmārga bhrāmyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
brāhmaṇamantraḥ | pallavān kṣīradrumāṇām |
tataś ca tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ dharmarājasya nāmabhiḥ |
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca ||
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca |
auḍumbarāya dadhnāya nīlāya parameṣṭhine ||
vṛkodarāya citrāya citraguptāya vai namaḥ |
narakāya pradātavyo dīpaḥ saṃpūjya devatāḥ ||
tataḥ pradoṣasamaye dīpāna dadyān manoramān |
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhavaneṣu maṭheṣu ca ||
[353]        kūṭāgāreṣu caityeṣu sabhāsu ca nadīṣu ca |
prākārodyānavāpīṣu pratolīniskuṭeṣu ca ||
siddhārhabuddhacāmuṇḍābhairavāyataneṣu ca |
mandareṣu vivikteṣu hastiśālāsu caiva hi ||
evaṃ prabhātasamaye hy amāvāsyāṃ narādhipa |
snātvā devān pitṝn bhaktyā saṃpūjyātha praṇamya ca ||
kṛtvā tu pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ |
bhojyair nānāvidhair viprān bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet ||
tato 'parāhṇasamaye ghoṣayen nagare nṛpaḥ |
svasvarājyaṃ baler loko yatheṣṭaṃ ceṣṭatām iti ||
lokaś cāpi purā hṛṣṭaḥ sudhādhavalitājire |
vṛkṣacandanamālābhiḥ (?) svārcite ca gṛhe gṛhe ||
dyūtapānaratodriktanaranārīmanohare |
nṛtyavāditrasaṃtuṣṭasaṃprajvalitadīpake ||
anyonyaprītisaṃhṛṣṭadattatālanake jane |
tāmbūlahṛṣṭavadane kuṅkumakṣodacarcite ||
dukūlapaṭṭanepathyasvarṇamāṇikyabhūṣaṇe |
adbhutodbhūtaśṛṅgārapradarśitakutūhale ||
yuvatījanasaṃkīrṇe vastrojvalavihāriṇi |
dīpamālākule ramye vidhvastadhvāntabandhane ||
pradoṣarahite śaste doṣādirahite śubhe |
yātrāvihārasaṃcārajayajīveti vādibhiḥ ||
[354]        kṣudropasargarahite caurajāyābhayoddhṛte |
mitrasvajanasaṃbandhisuhṛtpremābhirañjite ||
tato 'rdharātrasamaye svayaṃ rājā vrajet puram |
avalokayitū ramyaṃ padbhyām eva śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
mahatā tūryaghoṣeṇa jvaladbhir hastadīpakaiḥ |
harmyaśobhāṃ tu saṃpaśyan kṣatarakṣaiḥ svakair naraiḥ ||
saṃdṛṣṭvā mahad āścaryaṃ cintayitvātmanaḥ śubham |
balirājyapramodaṃ ca tataḥ svagṛham āvrajet ||
evaṃ gate niśīthe tu jane nidrāndhalocane |
tāvan na naranārībhiḥ sūryaḍiṇḍimacandanaiḥ ||
niṣkrāmyate prahṛṣṭābhir alakṣmīḥ svagṛhāṅgaṇāt |
tataḥ prabuddhe sakale jane jātamahotsave ||
mālyadīpakahaste ca snehanirbharavatsale |
veśyā vilāsinī svārthe svastimaṅgalacāriṇī ||
gṛhād gṛhaṃ vrajantī ca pādābhyaṅgapradāyini |
piṣṭakodvartanapare guruśuśrūṣaṇākule ||
dvijābhivādanapare sukharātryādivādini |
suvāsinībhyo dāne ca dīyamāne yadṛcchayā ||
rājā prabhātasamaye yathārhaṃ pūjayej janam |
sadbhāvenaiva saṃtoṣyā devāḥ satpuruṣā dvijāḥ ||
itare vānnapānena vākpradānena paṇḍitāḥ ||
[355]        vastrais tāmbūladānaiś ca puṣpakarpūrakuṅkumaiḥ |
bhakṣyair uccāvacair bhojyair antaḥpuravilāsinī ||
grāmair viṣayadānaiś ca puṣpakarpūrakuṅkumaiḥ |
bhakṣyair uccāvacair bhojyair antaḥpuravilāsinī ||
grāmair viṣamadānaiś ca sāmantanṛpatīn dhanaiḥ |
padātijanasaṃlagnān graiveyaiḥ kaṇṭhakaiḥ śubhaiḥ||
sanāmāṅkaiḥ svayaṃ rājā toṣayet svajanān pṛthak |
yathārhaṃ toṣayitvā tu tato mallān bhaṭān naṭān ||
vṛṣabhān mahiṣāṃś caiva yudhyamānān paraiḥ saha |
gajān aśvāṃś ca yodhāṃś ca padātīn samalaṃkṛtān ||
mañcārūḍhaḥ svayaṃ paśyen naṭanartanacāraṇān |
kruddhāpayet trāsayec ca gomahiṣyādikaṃ tataḥ ||
vṛṣān harṣāpayed gobhir uktipratyuktivāditān |
tato 'parāhṇasamaye pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhārata ||
mārgapālīṃ prabadhnīyād durge stambhe ca pādape |
kuśakāśamayīṃ divyāṃ lambakair bahubhir nṛpa ||
darśayitvā gajān aśvān sāyam asyastale (?) nayet |
gāvo vṛṣāḥ samahiṣā maṇḍitā ghaṇṭikotkaṭāḥ ||
[356]        kṛte home dvijendraiś ca badhnīyān mārgapālikān |
durgāmantreṇa homas tu sarvalokasukhapradaḥ ||
ghṛtenāṣṭottaraśatam |
namaskāraṃ tataḥ kuryāt mantreṇānena suvrata |
mārgapāli namas te 'stu sarvalokasukhaprade ||
viṣayaiḥ putradārādyaiḥ punar ehi vratasya me |
rāṣṭrabhojyena vai rājā sahasreṇa śatena vā ||
svaśaktyāpekṣayā vāpi gṛhṇīyād grāmyabhojanaiḥ |
mātuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulaṃ bālāṃś ca saha bandhubhiḥ ||
saṃtārayet sasakalaṃ mārgapālīṃ dadāti yaḥ ||
yathottare dānaphalādhikyārthaṃ śatasahasrāyutalakṣabhojanāny etāni pratijñayā mārgapālīṃ svīkṛtya sarvebhyaś ca tuṣṭārthaṃ yo dadāti tasyedaṃ phalam | grāmarāṣṭraśabdav ayutalakṣopalakṣaṇau |
nīrājanaṃ ca tatraiva kāryaṃ rāṣṭrajayapradam |
mārgapālītale netthaṃ yānti gāvo gajā vṛṣāḥ ||
rājāno rājaputrāś ca brāhmaṇāḥ śūdrajātayaḥ |
mārgapālīṃ samullaṅghya (?) nīrujaḥ syuḥ sukhānvitāḥ ||
kṛtvaitat sarvam eveha rātrau daityapater baleḥ |
pūjāṃ kṛtvā nṛpaḥ sākṣād bhūmau maṇḍalake vrate ||
balim ālikhya daityendraṃ varṇakaiḥ pañcaraṅgakaiḥ |
[357]        sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ vindhyāvatyā sahāsinam ||
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ ca jayodbhīma (?) urudānavasaṃvṛtam |
saṃpūrṇahṛṣṭavadanaṃ kirīṭotkaṭakuṇḍalam ||
dvibhujaṃ daityarājānaṃ kārayitvā nṛpaḥ svayam |
gṛhamadhye ca śālāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ tato 'rcayet ||
bhrātṛmātṛjanaiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃtuṣṭo bandhubhis tataḥ |
kamalaiḥ kusumaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kahlārai raktakotpalaiḥ ||
gandhapuṣpānnanaivedyair akṣatair guḍapūpakaiḥ |
madyamāṃsasurālehyadīpavartyapahārakaiḥ ||
mantreṇānena rājendra samantrī sapurohitaḥ |
balirāja namas tubhyaṃ virocanasuta prabho ||
bhaviṣyendra surārāte pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
evaṃ pūjāṃ nṛpaḥ kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ||
kārayet prekṣaṇīyādinaṭanṛtyakathānakaiḥ |
lokaś cāpi gṛhasyāntaḥ śayyāyāṃ śuklataṇḍulaiḥ ||
saṃsthāpya balirājānaṃ phalaiḥ puṣpaiś ca pūjayet |
balim uddiśya dīyante dānāni kurunandana ||
yāni tāny akṣayāny āhur mayaiva saṃpradarśitam |
yad asyāṃ dīyate dānaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu ||
tad akṣayaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ param |
viṣṇunā vasudhā labdhā tuṣṭena balaye punaḥ ||
upakārakaraṃ dattam asurāṇāṃ mahotsavam |
tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra pravṛttā kaumudī śubhā ||
[358]        sarvopadravavidrāvā sarvavighnavināśanī |
lokaśokaharī kānyā dhanapuṣṭisukhāvahā ||
kuśabdena mahī jñeyā mudaharṣe tato dvayam |
dhātujñair nirgamajñaiś ca tenaiṣā kaumudī smṛtā ||
kau mudanti janā yasmān nānābhāvaiḥ parasparam |
hṛṣṭās tuṣṭāḥ sukhāyās tās tenaiṣā kaumudī smṛtā ||
kumudāni baler yasmād dīyate 'smai yudhiṣṭhira |
athārghyaḥ pārthivaiḥ pārtha tenaiṣā kaumudī smṛtā ||
evam ekam ahorātraṃ varṣe varṣe viśāmpate |
dattaṃ dānavarājasya ādarśam iva bhūtale ||
yaḥ karoti naro rāṣṭre tasya vyādhibhayaṃ kutaḥ |
kuta iti tatra bhayaṃ nāsti mṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam |
subhikṣaṃ kṣemam ārogyaṃ sasyasampadam uttamam |
nīrujaś ca janaḥ sarvaḥ sarvopadravavarjitaḥ ||
kaumudīkakaraṇād rājan bhavatīha mahītale |
yo yādṛśena bhāvena tiṣthaty asyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
harṣadainyādirūpeṇa tasya varṣaṃ prayāti hi |
rudito roditi varṣaṃ hṛṣṭo varṣaṃ prahṛṣyati ||
bhukto bhoktā bhaved varṣaṃ svasthaḥ svastho bhaviṣyati |
tasmāt prahṛṣṭais tuṣṭaiś ca kartavyā kaumudī naraiḥ ||
[359]        vaiṣṇavī dānavī ceyaṃ tithiḥ paitrī yudhiṣṭhira |
dīpotsavena janitasarvajanapramode
kurvanti ye sumanaso balirājapūjām |
dānopabhogasukhavṛddhiśatākulānāṃ
rājan prayānti sakalaṃ pramudaiva harṣam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaḥ kaumudīmahotsavaḥ |
atha bhūtamahotsavaḥ |
skandapurāṇāt |
ratāvasānaṃ saṃprāpya niṣkrānte pārvatīpatau |
utthāya śayanād devī śaucaṃ cakre 'tiśaucadā ||
tataḥ spṛśantyāṃ pārvatyāṃ vāridhārāsaraḥprabhā |
abhavad iti śeṣaḥ | saro nirjharaḥ |
cintā samabhavat tasyā na putro duhitāpi vā |
tasyāś cintayamānāyā hṛdayāmbusamudbhavā ||
jajñe kamalapatrākṣī kanyā mṛṇmayapaṅkitā |
nīlavastrābhivasanā raktavastrāvaguṇṭhitā ||
girikanyāṃ tu tāṃ kanyāṃ hṛdayāmbusamudbhavām |
uvāsa saṃparityajya mūrdhni cāghrāya pārvatī ||
bhūmipaṅkāṅkaliptāṅgī saṃbhūtāsi yad aṅgane |
[360]        tasmād udakaseveti bhaviṣyati mahotsavaḥ ||
yasminn indramahīloke dine pātam upaiṣyati |
tasmin dine tava janā ārādhyante mahotsavam ||
yaḥ kāmo bhairavasyāsīt bhagavatyā bhavasya ca |
sa mahābhairavo bhūtvā kanyāṃ gṛhya kare sthitaḥ ||
tato 'mbikā bhagavatī patnī bhagavataḥ priyā |
pumāṃsam abravīt kas tvaṃ kiṃ ca gṛhṇāsi me sutām ||
tato daṃṣṭrākarālāsyo bhairavo bhairavākṛtiḥ |
umāṃ nīcais tataḥ prāha vidyunmatta ivāmbudaḥ ||
yo 'bhavad bhairavaḥ kāmo bhagavatyā bhavasya ca |
tatsaṃbhūtāv imau caiṣā bhāryā mama bhaviṣyati ||
dampatī vikṛtāṅgau tau kuveśācchādanau sthitau |
vīkṣāṃ cakre somabhūṣaḥ kāv imāv iti śaṅkitaḥ ||
tāv ubhāv api bhavo bhavapālaś
candracihnitajaṭas tripurāriḥ |
prāha pādapatitaḥ svasamīpe
kau yuvāṃ bhavatha kiṃ ca karomi ||
ambikātha ca vadati sma girīśaṃ
sūryakoṭitaḍidagnisavarṇā |
hāsapūrṇavadanā vadamānā
līlayātra bhavatī calamānā ||
[361]        yo 'bhavat tava mameha ca kāmo
bhairavo bhayakaras tridaśānā |
eṣa te kila pumān bhavajātaḥ
strīyam eva mama yo madanāgniḥ ||
somalakṣas tataḥ proktaḥ umayā somabhāvanaḥ |
gopaveṣadharo devo dampatīty abravīd vacaḥ ||
yadaiva hi tvayā dhyāne dhyāteyaṃ strī varāṅgaṇā |
tadaiva matprabhāvena bhairavo hy eṣa te 'bhavat ||
nāhaṃ tvayā vinā devi tvaṃ vāpi na mayā vinā |
ata eṣa mayā te 'dya datto lambodareṇa ca ||
utsavas teṣu bhavitā tvayā prokto mama priye |
pūrvāgamo 'sya bhavitā dattakāmaṃ mahotsavam ||
atas tadātmako lokaḥ sarvaḥ suravarārcite |
sajjante tena cānyonyaṃ narā nāryaś ca pārvati ||
liṅgeṣu hṛdayaṃ strīṇāṃ bhageṣu hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām |
bhagaliṅgāṅkitaṃ sarvaṃ tad idaṃ jagad aṅgane ||
bhagaliṅgasamutkrośaṃ kurvāṇāḥ sāmarā narāḥ |
anyonyaṃ pātayiṣyanti prakrośantaḥ parasparam ||
ārambhe vāvasāne ca bhavitā bhairavotsavaḥ |
udasevikayā śeṣaṃ kālaṃ ca bhavitotsavaḥ ||
yat puraṃ nagaraṃ grāmaṃ bhairavīyaṃ pravekṣyati |
unmattam iva tat sarvaṃ sastrīvṛddho bhaviṣyati ||
[362]        unmattavad anunmattaṃ cātuvarṇaṃ gireḥ sute |
bhaviṣyati puraṃ mattaṃ bhairavāgamaharṣitam ||
yathā niyuktāḥ pitrarthe viśante devatā dvijān |
evaṃ bhairavi māhātmyād bhairavo viśate narān ||
tato rāsasamārūḍhāḥ śakṛtkardamalepanāḥ |
kadukā tāmbūvallībhiḥ kṛtaveṣṭanabhūṣaṇāḥ ||
tatphalābaddhakucakāḥ prakaṭotkaṭanisvanāḥ |
bhasmabhūṣitasarvāṅgā viṇmūtramalapaṅkilāḥ ||
tālatālair vādyamānaiḥ krūrābaddhavaconvitaiḥ |
avabaddham asaṃbaddhaṃ pūrvāparānanvitaṃ yad vaca ity arthaḥ |
sūcyamāne varārohe bhairavo bhāryayā saha ||
pravekṣyati puraṃ hy eṣa utsavaṃ janayan nṛṇām |
praviṣte bhairave bhīru puruhūtārcitaṃ puram ||
janasya rocako ghoro bhaviṣyati tadotsavaḥ |
rocakaḥ priyaḥ | ghoraḥ utkaṭaḥ |
yeṣāṃ varṣaśataṃ bhīru jarayā caiva jarjarāḥ |
te 'pi vatsakavat sarve kariṣyanty utsavaṃ narāḥ ||
nānābhūṣaṇamṛṣṭāṅgāḥ kuṅkumāgurubhūṣitāḥ |
pītair anekair vastraiś ca vāsobhiḥ pariveṣṭitāḥ ||
karṇapūraiḥ samālyaiś ca sadāmālāḥ sacūḍinaḥ |
sadāmālāḥ sagrajaḥ sacūḍinaḥ sabāhubhūṣaṇāḥ |
tadvat puṣpaiś campakādyaiḥ rukṣe 'pi tu śiroruhāḥ |
[363]         āsphoṭayanto gātrāṇi śrāvayanti priyāṇi ca ||
rathyāsu rājamārgeṣu śrāvayanto yatas tataḥ |
kulaputrāḥ kulastrīṇām anaṅgaprakṛtāni ca ||
vyaṅgāni yāni guhyāni kulāṅganākṛtāni ca |
teṣāṃ ca sarvasaṃdehaṃ darśayantaḥ pade pade ||
gāyantaś ca pranṛtyantaḥ kurvantaś cintanāni ca |
pūrvaṃ salajjā bhūtvā ca nirlajjatvam upāgatāḥ |
lajjanīyeṣv api gurūn ākrośantaḥ parān api ||
udāsarucayo martyāḥ kariṣyanti yathā manaḥ |
na matur lajjate putro na putrasya tathāraṇī ||
pitur na putraḥ putrasya na pitā na pitāmahaḥ |
na mātulasya svasrīyaḥ svasrīyasya ca mātulaḥ ||
muhūrtenaiva svajane nirlajjatvam upāgate |
anyonyarūkṣavacanais tarjayiṣyanti mūḍhavat ||
brahmarūkṣā vaco rūkṣā śvetāṅgā mṛtayāpi ca |
bhaktichedaviliptāṅgāś cārvaṅgāś cāruceṣṭitāḥ ||
sārameyān udvahanta ārūḍhā gardabhīṣu ca |
dāḍimbaveṣā gopaveṣā bahuveṣāviśaḥ pare ||
rājaveṣātmaveṣāś ca taruṇā vṛddharūpiṇaḥ |
nāpitānāṃ ca veṣeṇa nayatām api cāpare ||
palāṇḍuṃ sīdhuvarṣaṃ ca svaśaktyunmiśritaṃ bhṛśam |
[364]        dhūpaṃ saṃcārayiṣyanti ghrāṇavairāgyakārakam ||
jalecaramalaṃ cānye narā nṛṇām ajānatām |
nāsikāyāṃ pradāsyanti durgandham aśubhaiḥ samam ||
anyeṣu puruṣā devi devaveśavibhūṣitāḥ |
kāvyāni śrāvayanto hi te hṛṣyanti yathā narāḥ ||
aśvānāṃ krośate tatra yathā nākrośate param |
bibhyati tasya pitaro brahmaghne tu yathā tathā ||
rājāno hi yathāśvānāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ yathā narāḥ |
hitāya jāyate tadvat narāṇāṃ mudasecikā ||
na tasya deva aśnāti haviḥ pitara eva a |
madhyasya bhāvaṃ kurute udasevikayā hi yaḥ ||
na tvaṃ tuṣyati naivāhaṃ tasya tuṣyāmi pārvati |
viramec ca mahāśokā putrālābhe tvayā kṛte ||
udasevikā tv evaṃ bhavatī bhairavāgame |
atulā harṣasampattiḥ paścād eti yathā tava ||
na bhrājate yathā cedaṃ tacchokād bhavanaṃ tava |
udasevikayā hīnaṃ yathā tadbhavitā puram ||
narā nāryaś ca girije bhasmanā kardamena ca |
niṣprabhāṇi kariṣyanti gṛhāṇy āyatanāni ca ||
caurair udvāsitam iva puraṃ devi bhaviṣyati |
mṛtpiṇḍabhasmaviṇmūtrair naraiḥ pretair ivāvṛtam |
bhairavīyaṃ mṛta iti ghoṣayantas tato narāḥ ||
tṛṇaiś channataras tatra saṃveśyāmbarasaṃvṛtam |
[365]        iti vācā prakurvāṇā bhairavo 'yaṃ jahāti naḥ ||
nirhariṣyanti taṃ martyā mṛtaṃ guptamṛtaṃ priyam |
taḍāgakūle taṃ nyasya saritkūle tathāpi vā ||
snānān nirmuktakaluṣā prayāsyanti tato hṛham |
saṃsādhyaṃ bhairavasnātā utsavotkūlaveditāḥ ||
munivratā iva narā bhaviṣyanti priyāyutāḥ |
yathaiva te pārvati bhairavāgame
narāḥ salajjā muhur eva lajjitāḥ |
tathaiva saṃbhāvitabhairavāḥ punaḥ
babhūvur ekāntatapodhanāvṛtāḥ ||
imaṃ tu yaḥ sundari bhairavotsavaṃ
paṭhed dhi vipro dvijadevasaṃsadi |
putraprapautraḥ samaye ca vardhate
mahāgaṇeśatvam avāpnuyāt śubham ||
iti bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
bhūtamāteti saṃhṛṣṭo grāme grāme pure pure |
gāyan nṛtyan hasan lokaḥ sarvataḥ paridhāvati ||
unmattavat pralapati kṣitau patati mattavat |
kruddhavad dhāvatitarāṃ mṛtavat krandate bahiḥ ||
mukhāṅgabhaṅgaṃ kurute loko vāyugṛhītavat |
[366]        bhūtavad bhasmamūtraṃ tu kardamān avagāhate ||
kim eṣa śāstranirdiṣṭo mārgaḥ kim uta laukikaḥ |
muhyate me manaḥ kṛṣṇa tvam eva vaktum arhasi ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi yat te kiṃcin manogatam |
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaś ca bhavānīti matir mama ||
pārvatyā sahitaḥ pūrvaṃ mandare cārukandare |
krīḍann āste mudāyukto divyakrīḍanakair haraḥ ||
pīnonnatanitambena kumbhabhrājatkucadvayām |
śītāṃśuvadanāṃ hṛṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭvā gaurīṃ jagadguruḥ ||
dagdhakāmataroḥ kandakadalīm iva vistṛtām ||
kāmayāmāsa mudito mahārhaśayane śivaḥ |
ramamāṇā mahākāntaṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ yadā ||
tadā devī samutthāya nirodhān nirgatā bahiḥ |
mūtrotsargāt samuttasthau nārī nirdāritodarāt ||
kṛṣṇā karālavadanā piṅgākṣī raktamūrdhajā |
kapālamālābharaṇā baddhamuṇḍāvapīḍakā ||
khaṭṭāṅgakaṅkāladharā mudrāṅkitakarā śivā |
dvīpicarmāmbaradharā raṇatkiṅkiṇīmekhalā ||
ḍamarumarukārā ca phetkārāpūritāmbarā |
tasyās tu pārśvagāś cānyā gītavādyalayānugāḥ ||
[367]        uttālatālam atulaṃ nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca |
kapālakhaṭṭāṅgadharā gajacarmāvaguṇṭhitā ||
tathaiva śaṅkarāj jātas tadrūpābharaṇaḥ pumān |
anugamyamāno bahubhir bhūtair atibhayaṃkaraiḥ ||
siṃhaśārdūlavadanai radanollikhitāmbaraiḥ |
ekībhūtau kṣaṇenaiva tau bhavānībhavodbhavau ||
dṛṣṭā hṛṣṭamanā devaḥ prāha devīṃ suvismitām |
kalyāṇi paśya paśyaitau mattvadaṅgasamudbhavau ||
bībhatsādbhutaśṛṅgārabhayānakavidāriṇau |
bhrātṛbhāṇḍau yathā devi tadvad etau matau mama ||
nānayor anantaraṃ kiṃcit sādṛśyāt pratibhāṣate |
bhrātṛbhāṇḍā bhūtamātā tathaivodakasevikā ||
saṃjñātrayaṃ tayoḥ kṛtvā tataḥ prādād varaṃ haraḥ |
bhagnārthāvāgatāṃ caināṃ jagattarumale sthitām ||
sevayiṣyanti ye bhaktyā jalasampūrṇagaṇḍukaiḥ |
candanena samālabhya puṣpadhūpair athārcayet ||
bhojayet kṣipraṃ saṃyāvakṛśarāpūpapāyasaiḥ |
ya evaṃ kurute devi puruṣo bhaktibhāvitaḥ ||
sa putrapaśuvṛddhiṃ ca śarīrārogyam āpnuyāt |
na śākinyo gṛhe tasya na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ ||
krīḍāṃ kurvanti śiśavo yānti vṛddhiṃ nirāmayāḥ |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kadā pūjā prakartavyā bhūtamātuḥ sukhārthibhiḥ |
[368]        puruṣaiḥ puruṣavyāghra etan me vaktum arhasi ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
sarvadaiṣā bhagavatī bālānāṃ hitakāriṇī ||
nāmabhedaiḥ kriyābhedaiḥ kālabhedaiś ca pūjyate |
pratipatprabhṛti jyaiṣṭhe yāvatpañcadaśī tithiḥ ||
paurṇamāsyāntamāsābhiprāyeṇa jyaiṣtha ity uktiḥ |
tāvat pūjā prakartavyā preraṇaiḥ prekṣaṇīyakaiḥ ||
vikarmaphalanirdeśaḥ pāṣaṇḍānāṃ viḍambanam |
pradarśyate hāsyaparair narair adbhutaveṣṭitaiḥ ||
viśvasya dhanalobhena svādhyāyī niyataḥ pathi |
āropyamāṇaṃ śūlāgre ye na paśyanti paśyataḥ ||
dṛṣṭo bhavadbhiḥ samhṛṣṭaḥ paradārāvamarṣakaḥ |
chittvāsya hastau kṣipto 'yaṃ vibhunā puṣkarodake ||
śīrṇaḥ sūryātapatreṇa vālātālānumoditaḥ |
śuklasiṃhāsanārūḍhaḥ sukṛtau yāty asau sukham ||
he janāḥ kiṃ na paśyadhvaṃ svam indratvaṃ kare param |
karapatrair dīryamānam ucchalacchoṇitacchaṭam ||
cauraḥ kilāsau saṃprāptaḥ sarvodvegākaraḥ param |
daṇḍaprahārābhihato nīyate daṇḍapāśakaiḥ ||
prekṣakair veṣṭitasteno raṭadbhir yamaḍiṇḍimaiḥ |
saṃyamya nīyate hantuṃ mukham abhyabalekṣaṇa (?) |
śitakeśaṃ śitaśmaśruṃ sitāmbaradharaṃ dvijam ||
viṭaveśyācapeṭābhir hanyamānaṃ ca paśyataḥ |
[369]        gṛhān niṣkramyatāṃ raṇḍā vṛddhiṃ nītvā yathodaram ||
kasmād asau ca kurute mūḍho bharaṇapoṣaṇam |
bhairavābhairavān etān bālān bālopajīvinaḥ ||
pravṛttatāṇḍavapadā nyasyadhvaṃ ghṛtadīpakān |
nirvedaḥ ko 'sya hṛdaye kṣetrastrīdhanakāritaḥ ||
gṛhītaṃ yad anenāpi bālenāpi mahavratam |
raktodakkākakṛṣṇāṅgaṃ sa caran kiṃ na paśyati ||
tarukoṭarāntargatāṃ vicitrāṃ śukasārikām |
bahubhiḥ koṣṭhakīkṛtya śaroghaiḥ savalīkṛtām ||
vimuktahikvāhūṅkārasuprahāranirīkṣitām |
imāṃ kṛṣṇārdhavadanāṃ gṛhītāsi duhitṛkā ||
vimuktakeśāṃ nṛtyantīṃ paśyadhvaṃ yoginīm iva |
gambhīryatūryadhvaninā pravṛddhoddhatatāṇḍavā ||
unmattaveṣābharaṇā bhāvyeṣā ḍiṇḍimaṇḍalī |
kaṭītaṭasthapiṭakā kālakambaladhāriṇī ||
āraṭantyaṭateḍombī (?) tantrī sūryagrahād gṛham |
ity evam ebhir bahubhiḥ prekṣaṇaiḥ prekṣaṇīyakaiḥ ||
prerayet tān jahātītthaṃ putrabhrātṛsuhṛdgatam |
ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā dīpaṃ prajvālya kuṇḍale ||
rakṣibhir bahubhir guptaṃ tūryadhvanipuraḥsaram |
nayet pradoṣasamaye yatra devī janair vṛtā ||
vīracaryāsu kathitā dīpaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ |
evaṃ niṣkrāmayed dīpaṃ yāvat pañcadaśī tithiḥ ||
[370]        pañcadaśyāṃ prakurvīta bhūtamātur mahotsavam |
snāpayet pūjayed dadyān naivedyaṃ palalodanam ||
praṇamya svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṣamayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet |
sa evaṃ kurute pārtha varṣe varṣe mahotsavam ||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat gṛhe vighnaṃ na jāyate |
ye mānayanti janahāsakarair vilāsair
āsecayed abhayadāṃ bhūvibhūtadhātrīm |
te bhrātṛbhṛtyasutabandhujanaiḥ mahābdaṃ
sarvopasargarahitāḥ sukhino bhavanti ||
iti bhūtamātrutsavaḥ |
pṛthivy uvāca |
pitṛmātṛpatibhrātṛputraśokavivarjitā |
vratena yena bhavati nārī tad vada keśava ||
varāha uvāca |
dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ tasya kanyābhavat satī |
mahādevāya sā dattā dharmapatnī śubhavratā ||
dakṣeṇa yajñaḥ prārabdho devāḥ sarve nimantritāḥ |
arcitāś ca yathānyāyaṃ śaṅkaro na nimantritaḥ ||
tenāpamānitā devī dehaṃ tyaktvābhavat punaḥ |
himavatparvatasutā jātā jātismṛtā dhare ||
srag namerudharā tatra vartamānāṣṭavārṣikī |
[371]        vāryamāṇā pitṛbhrātṛmātṛbhis (?) tapase gatā ||
ugraṃ tapaḥ samākhyāya sakhībhiḥ sahitācale |
yāte varṣasahasraṃ tu śuṣkaparṇam abhuṅkta sā ||
anyavarṣasahasraṃ tu jalapānena sā sthitā |
tṛtīyaṃ ca punas tadvad āhārābhāvato mahat ||
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi daśa taptaṃ tayā tapaḥ |
tathāpi ca na tuṣṭo 'sau deveśo vṛṣaśūladhṛk ||
tathā khinnāparā dīnā kṛśāsāv aniśaṃ tataḥ |
punar agnipraveśāya matiṃ cakre ruṣānvitā ||
tataḥ kālī samutthāya kṛtvā pūrvāhṇikīṃ kriyām |
kathā hy anekāś ca tataḥ sahasā cāvadat kṣite ||
sakhībhir bhaktiyuktābhir veṣṭitā sthānakāṅkṣiṇī |
devarṣir nāradaḥ prāpto lokālokavicāraṇaḥ ||
himavadduhitā gaurī śivārādhanatatparā |
bhartāraṃ devam icchantī tathā varṣagaṇān bahūn ||
devo na tuṣyati yadā nirvinneyaṃ tadā mune |
agniṃ praveṣṭum udyuktety āha gauryāḥ sakhī munim ||
tasyā vākyam idaṃ śrutvā nāradaḥ karuṇānvitaḥ |
tatsamīpe tatogamya vākyam āha vasundhare ||
nārada uvāca |
himavadduhitā kamaṃ nāmni prāviśa śobhane |
haras tuṣyati yeneha karmaṇā tat śṛṇuṣva me |
vrataṃ saṅghāṭanaṃ nāma tat kuruṣvācalātmaje ||
[372]        vrataṃ saṅghāṭakaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ prāpsyasi taṃ patim |
devy uvāca |
tad vrataṃ me kṛpāṃ kathayasva mune mama |
prāpsye 'haṃ tena cīrtvā vai bhartāraṃ taṃ maheśvaram ||
nārada uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhadre saṅghāṭakam idaṃ vratam |
kathayāmi mahāpūrvaṃ brahmaṇā kathitaṃ mama ||
māsasya kārttikasyāpi śuklapratipadi vratam |
gṛhṇīyād ekabhaktaṃ tu kṛtvā dantādiśodhanam |
sāyaṃ saṃkalpam ādāya dvitīyāyām upāvaset ||
tṛtīyāyām api tathā caturthyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet |
śivaṃ saṃpūjayed bhaktyā upavāsadvaye 'pi ca ||
yatra vinopacāreṇa rātrau dadyāt tato bhuvi |
svapet prātaḥ samutthāya smṛtvā devaṃ samarcayet ||
dambhena vinā varaṃ patraṃ dadhyānnaṃ dadate na raktam |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān sapta śaktito vāpi bhojayet ||
tebhyo 'pi dakṣiṇāṃ datvā namaskṛtya visarjayet |
paścāc ca pāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ saptasaṃghāṭake vidhiḥ ||
upoṣya tu tataḥ saptamāsaiḥ sārdhaṃ tribhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ saṅghāṭe saptame tataḥ ||
[373] etac ca vrataṃ śuklapakṣe 'pi kartavyam | evaṃ pakṣadvaye kurvan tataḥ sārdhais tribhir māsaiḥ saptasaṅghāṭakā bhavanti |
vidhivad brahmamukhyasya tad ihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu |
strīpuṃsau kāñcanau kāryau śaktito bhaktipūrvakam ||
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyau mañcakasyopari sthitau |
pañcāmrtena saṃsnāpya tato gandhodakena tu ||
sarvauṣadhijalenāpi kuṅkumena samālabhet |
kausumbhavastrasaṃchannair nānāpuṣpasraganvitaiḥ ||
mañcakopari vinyasya rātrau jāgaram ārabhet |
gītavādyādinṛtyais tu jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi ||
mahāmāṅgalyanirghoṣair mṛdaṅgapaṭahādikaiḥ |
nirvartya jāgaraṃ rātrau prabhāte samupasthite |
viprān nimantrya bhaktyā tu śaktito bhojanaṃ tataḥ ||
tebhyo 'pi dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt strīpuṃsau mañcake sthitau |
sarvopastaraṇaiḥ sarvam upadeṣṭre nivedayet ||
bhāryayā sahitāyaiva vastādyaiḥ pūjitāya ca |
nivedayet svayaṃ sarvaṃ tato vipraṃ kṣamāpayet ||
oṃ śambhavāya namaḥ | umayā bhavāya namaḥ | uṃ śaṅkarāya namaḥ |
[374]        iti pūjāmantraḥ |
oṃ mayaskarāya namaḥ svāhā | oṃ śivāya namaḥ svāhā | oṃ śivatarāya svāhā |
iti homamantrāḥ |
bhāryayā sahitaṃ vipraṃ bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet |
samarpayitvā tat sarvaṃ namaskṛtya visarjayet ||
samāpyaivaṃ vrataṃ nārī samaṃ prāpnoti yat phalam |
tat śṛṇuṣva mahābhāge kathayāmi suniścitam ||
yāvat kalpaśataṃ nārī bhavej janmani janmani |
patiputraviyogotthayogaduḥkhavivarjitam ||
tasmin kule sa jāyeta janmāntaraśateṣv api |
dhanadhānyasamāpūrṇaṃ tat kulaṃ jāyate dhruvam ||
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃyuktaṃ sukhasaṃpatsamāyutam |
māhātmyena vratasyāsya bhavej janmani janmani ||
paṭhyamānaṃ vrataṃ nārī naro vā śṛṇuyād yadi |
sarvaduḥkhavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
varāha uvāca |
nāradaḥ kathayitvā tu vrataṃ samyag vidhānataḥ |
gato javiṣthayā gatyā devī vrataparābhavat ||
saṅghāṭavratamāhātmyāc chīghraṃ labdhā patiṃ śivam |
saṃjātā sukhinī gaurī strī tathānyāpi jāyate ||
[375]        etat śrutvā dharitri tvaṃ vratam etat kuru priye |
yathābhilaṣitaṃ sarvaṃ prāpsyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktaṃ saṅghāṭakavratam |
paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyām ekabhaktaṃ samācaret |
tatraikabhaktaṃ kurvāṇo narakaṃ nopsarpati ||
tatra puṇyāhavācyena jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ |
hariṃ caivārcayed yatnāt snāpya sauvarṇapaṅkajaiḥ ||
tatas tu pātram ādāya gītavedādinisvanaiḥ |
kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ tasmai viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave ||
tataś cāmantrya vidhivat pūjayet taṃ viśeṣataḥ |
ekaṃ priyaṃ tu saṃbhojya praṇamya ca kṣamāpayet ||
ekaṃ viprāya saṃmantrya saṃpūjya tat pradakṣiṇam |
ghṛtayuktam annapātraṃ saṃbhojya ca kṣamāpayet ||
brāhmaṇān paramān bhojya dakṣiṇābhiś ca dakṣayet |
vratinaś cānnadānena vastrādyena ca tarpayet ||
ye tu dīnāndhakṛpaṇā anivāryo dinaṃ vrajet |
iti narasiṃhapurāṇoktaṃ harivratam |
[376]
anilāda uvāca |
narasiṃham atho raukyaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ caturbhujam |
tāmrapātre pratiṣṭhāpya bahudaṃṣṭraṃ prakalpayet ||
bāhubhyām padmarāgau tu nakhānāṃ vidrumās tathā |
puṣparāgau stanoddeśe karṇayor nīlakāv ubhau ||
rājāvartekṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā nīlavaiduryamastakam |
kṛtvā rūpam idaṃ ramyaṃ tatpātre madhunā yute |
pūrayed vārimiśreṇa pūritaṃ tu punar dahet ||
idaṃ rūpaṃ tatpātre madhuyuktena kṛtvā saṃsthāpya vārimiśreṇa madhunā pātraṃ (?) pūrayet | punar anyat pātraṃ madhuvāripūrṇaṃ tadupari dadyāt |
vastrayugmena vācchannam āsane viniveśayet |
gandhapuṣpais tathā dhūpaiḥ pūjanaṃ cāsya kalpayet ||
naivedyaṃ kalpayed (?) dravyaṃ bhaktair nānāvidhair budhaḥ |
vitānopari saṃyuktaṃ puṣpadāmabhir arcayet ||
kārttikyāṃ vātha vaiśākhyām āśritya dvādaśīm atha |
kṛtvā nivedayet samyak yatas tat padam aśnute ||
dvādaśīm āśritya tadādidinacatuṣṭayaṃ hastikrīḍā yatas tam utsavaṃ kṛtvā kārttikyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ vā dānaṃ kartavyam |
araṇye vātha saṃgrāme dasyusaṅghasamākule |
na bhayaṃ jāyate tasya sakṛd yas tv idam ācaret ||
na viśanty āpado ghorā dhanam āyuḥ prayacchati |
[377]        santatiṃ caiva rūpaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ ca manoramam ||
etat te kathitaṃ samyak hareḥ krīḍāyanaṃ mahat |
tatsthānaprāpakaṃ caiva dharmyāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ kriyāḥ ||
śrutvā yāti padaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
dhanam āyur vivardheta śrāvaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ||
śrāvaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāc chaktyā yugmaṃ vibhūṣayet |
śrotavyam tena varṣāsu purāṇaṃ cāpare 'hani ||
iti narasiṃhapurāṇoktaṃ harikrīḍāyanam |
yajiṣṇuḥ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ yamān yo bhojayed dvijān |
aṣṭamīm atra kaunteya śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm ||
upoṣya vyādhirahito rūpavān ti jāyate |
iti mahābhāratoktaṃ yamavratam |
anilāda uvāca |
mahāvratam aho vakṣye yenārohati tat padam |
surāsuramunīnāṃ ca durlabhaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu ||
parvaṇy āśvayujasyānte pāyasaṃ ca ghṛtaplutam |
naktaṃ bhuñjīta śuddhātmā candanaṃ caikṣavānvitam ||
āśvayujasyānte karttike | pavarṇi amāvasyāyāṃ kārttikyanta ity arthaḥ | aikṣava ikṣurasaḥ |
ācamyātha śucir bhūtvā bilvajaṃ dantadhāvanam |
[378]        bhuktvā caitan mahādevaṃ natvā bhaktiyuto vratī ||
ahaṃ deva vratam idaṃ kartum icchāmi śāśvatam |
tavājñayā mahādeva tatra nirvahanaṃ kuru ||
uktvemaṃ niyamaṃ gṛhṇan varṣāṇy eva tu ṣoḍhaśa |
titheḥ pratipadāyāś tu pārayiṣyāmy anuttamam ||
tato mārgaśire māsi pratipady apare 'hani |
upavāsena guruṃ pṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ smaran muhuḥ ||
mahādevaratān viprān bhasmasaṃcchannavigrahān |
ṣoḍaśāṣṭau (?) tadardhaṃ vā dampatyaś ca nimantrayet ||
devaṃ ca bhaktam āsādya dīpān prājvalya ṣoḍaśa |
paśunāthaṃ mahādevaṃ bhaktyā natvā nivedayet ||
āmantrya ca gṛhaṃ gatvā mahādevaṃ smaran kṣitau |
śucivastrāstṛtāyāṃ tu nirāhāro niśi svapet ||
athodaye sahasrāṃśoḥ snātvā cādāya dīpakān |
naivedyaṃ snapanādyaṃ vā sa gacchet śaṅkarālayam ||
gatvā vitānakaṃ tatra vastrayugmaṃ ca ghaṇḍikām |
dhūpotkṣepaṃ patākāṃś ca datvā snānaṃ tu kārayet ||
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ kaśāyair ujajhayed (?) vratam |
snāpayet pañcagavyena ghṛtena tadanantaram ||
madhunā ca tathā dadhnā bhūyaś ca payasā tathā |
rasena vātha khaṇḍena phalaiś ca snāpayet punaḥ ||
tilāmbunā tataḥ snāpya paścād uṣṇena vāriṇa |
[379]        lepayet sudhanaṃ paścāt karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ bhaktyā hema nyasya vrajed gṛham |
hema nyasya bhujopari suvarṇapuṣpaṃ nidhāya |
nānāvakṣyaphalaiś (?) caiva dadyān naivedyam eva hi |
gṛhaṃ gatvā yathānyāyaṃ hiraṇyaretasam vibhum ||
jātavedasam ādhāya tarpayet tilasarpiṣā |
vratinaś ca tathācāryaṃ mithunāni ca bhojayet ||
hemavastrādidānena yathāśaktyā tu dakṣayet |
evaṃ visṛjya tān sarvān sārdhaṃ bandhujanaiḥ svayam ||
pītvādau pañcagavyaṃ ca hṛṣṭo bhuñjīta vāgayataḥ |
yat kiṃcid etad ucchiṣṭaṃ mahādevam udīrayet ||
tam uddiśya ca tat sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ śreya icchatā |
prārambhe tu vidhiṃ kuryur daridro 'py atha veśvaraḥ ||
vittasāmarthyataś (?) caiva pratimāsaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ |
svalpavitto 'tha vā kaścit puṣyādau kārttikāvadhau ||
kṛtvā naktaṃ tv amāvāsyāṃ prāguktavidhinā tataḥ |
pratipadām upoṣyaivaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pibec chuciḥ ||
mahādevaṃ smaran sārdhaṃ bhaktyā bhuñjīta liṅgibhiḥ |
māsasya kārttikasyānte kṛtsnaṃ prāg vidhim ācaret ||
pratipadā dvitīyā ca ubhe tithī upoṣayet |
evaṃ pauṣe tu saṃprāpte pratipannaktam ācaret ||
dvitīye 'bde dvitīyāyām upavaset kārttikāvadhau |
ādadīta tithiṃ caikāṃ mārgamāse tathāparām ||
[380]        pūrvavat saṃtyajet pauṣe pratyabdaṃ caivam ācaret |
asya ślokasya phalitārthaḥ | amāvāsyāyāṃ naktaṃ pratipady upavāsa iti prathamavarṣaṃ prathamasyām amāvāsyāyāṃ naktaṃ pratipadi dvitīyāyām upavāsaḥ śeṣeṣu pratipadi naktaṃ dvitīyāyām upavāsa iti dvitīyaṃ prathame māsi pratidi naktaṃ dvitīyātṛtīyayor upavāsaḥ śeṣeṣu dvitīyāyāṃ naktaṃ tṛtīyāyām upavāsa iti tṛtīyam | evaṃ śeṣeṣu varṣeṣu kṛtvaivaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣaṃ paurṇamāsyāḥ kārttikyāḥ samudgame udayakāle |
pūrvavad devam abhyarcya kṛśānuṃ dhanni tarpayet |
dhyanni arciṣaḥ |
mahādevāya gaṃ dadyād dīkṣitāya dvijāya ca ||
haimaśṛṅgāṃ savatsāṃ ca saghaṇṭāṃ kāṃsyadohanām |
śivavratadharān viprān sahācāryāś ca ṣoḍaśa ||
saṃbhojya hemavastrādyair yathāśakti tu dakṣayet |
chatropānahakumbhāṃś ca dadyāt tebhyaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
bhojayet tān visṛṣṭvaiva mithunāni tu ṣoḍaśa |
visṛṣṭvā visṛjya |
brāhmaṇāṃś ca yathāśaktyā bhojayed vedapāragān |
anyeṣāṃ ca kṣudhārtānāṃ dadyād annaṃ ca taddine ||
evaṃ mahāvrataṃ caitad brahmaghno 'py aghamarṣaṇam |
bhūrbhuvādiṣu śeṣeṣu lokeṣu bahubhogadam ||
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ yat tu sopānavat sthitam |
[381]        tat kuryād yauvanaṃ prāpya samuddiṣṭam ihaiva hi ||
dhanyam āyuḥpradaṃ nityaṃ rūpasaubhāgyadaṃ param |
strīpuṃsayoś ca nirdiṣtaṃ vratam etat purātanam |
vidhavayāpi kartavyaṃ bhaved avidhavā ca yā ||
mugdhayāpi ca kartavyam aviyogāya tad vratam |
upoṣya pratimāsaṃ tu bhuñjīta vratibhiḥ saha ||
etad dvitricaturbhir vā sarveṣv abdeṣu śaktitaḥ |
ante ca bhinnavarṣāṇāṃ prārambhe vidhim ācaret ||
puṣpasaṃbhāram anvicchann anāmayapadaṃ ca tat |
athārabdhavrate kaścid asamāpte mṛto bhavet ||
so 'pi tatphalam āpnoti satprārambhaprabhāvataḥ |
vācakaḥ śrāvakaś caiva śrītāraś ca vratasya ye ||
bhavanti puṇyasaṃśliṣṭās tatpadābhimukhāś ca ye |
iti kālikāpurāṇoktaṃ mahāvratam |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ śuklāṃ māghamāse 'tha pūrnimām |
kuryād vidhim imaṃ samyak sadā tasya vrajet padam ||
tad dhi rūpapradaṃ caitad vrataṃ saubhāgyadāyakam |
putradaṃ sukhadaṃ caiva vidhinā caritaṃ tv idam ||
vratasyāsya pravaktāraṃ samayuktaṃ guṇānvitam ||
[382]        pūjayed bhūmikāmo 'tha pādukādyaiḥ subhāvitaḥ |
rukmamālyayutaṃ cātha pātraṃ nīlāṃ ca gām api ||
abhāve ca tathā hemnaḥ karṣārdhena tu rājatam |
vastrayugmaṃ navaṃ sūkṣmaṃ puṣpaprakaracitritam ||
āśritya tatra tat pātraṃ śudau deśe niveśayet |
tato jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt gītavādyādimaṅgalaiḥ ||
prabhāte tu nayet pātraṃ harer āyatanaṃ mahat |
snāpya kṣirādibhir devaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya vai svayam ||
nivedayet tu tat pātraṃ prīyatām ity udīrayet |
tato nānāvidhair bhakṣyaiḥ sugandhenodakena ca ||
dadhikhaṇḍājyadugdhāḍhyaṃ naivedyaṃ ca baliṃ haret |
tato natvā gṛhaṃ gacched ācāryaṃ prīṇayet punaḥ ||
praṇamya bhojayed bhaktyā vratinaś ca dvijaiḥ saha |
kalpayed bhojanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarveṣv eva tapasviṣu ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣām anivāritam |
anenāpi vratenaiva samyak prāpya padaṃ śubham ||
modate suciraṃ kālam āyuṣmān dhanavān iha |
iti narasiṃhapurāṇoktaṃ pātravratam |
[383]                yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
jātismaratvaṃ deveśa duṣprāpyam iti me matiḥ |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi prāpyate kena karmaṇā ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
brāhmaṇaiś caiva śūdro 'pi kule mahati janmavān |
dātā kṣamī dhanī vāgmī rūpavān bhadrakair bhavet ||
catvāri rājan bhadrāṇi catuṣpādāni tāni vai |
tāny eva bahuvighnāni duṣpāpyāṇy akṛtātmabhiḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe tu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ phālgune tathā |
jyeṣṭhe tṛtīyaṃ rājendra khyātaṃ bhādrapade param ||
phālgunāmalapakṣādau trīn māsāṃs ta narottama |
tripuṣkaraṃ samākhyātam audāryakaraṇaṃ param ||
jyaiṣṭhasya śuklapakṣādau trīn māsāṃś ca yudhiṣṭhira |
taṃ tripuṣkakam ākhyātaṃ sattvaśauryapradāyakam ||
tathā bhādrapadasyādau trīn māsān pāṇḍunandana |
varadānena devānām ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanena vā |
tīrthasnānena vā deva tapohomavratena vā ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
catvāri ṛjan bhadrāṇi samupoṣyāṇi yatnataḥ |
tat prabhāvād bhaven nyūnaṃ rājan jātismaro naraḥ ||
śubhodayaḥ purā vaiśyo babhūva yamunā taṭe |
[384]        tena vratapadaṃ cīrṇaṃ mṛtaḥ kālakramād asau ||
sañjayasya suto jātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti viśrutaḥ |
vrataprabhāvāj jātijñaḥ sa ca caurair nipātitaḥ ||
nāradasya prabhāvena punar ujjīvito 'py asau |
sasmāra pūrvavṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ varatadharmataḥ ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
sañjayasya kathaṃ putraḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti vā katham|
dasyubhiś ca kathaṃ nīto mṛtyave jīvitaḥ katham ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
sañjayo nāma rājāsīt kuśāvatyāṃ narādhipa |
tasya mitre ca devarṣī sadā nāradaparvatau ||
ekadā sañjayagṛhaṃ saṃprāptau tau yadṛcchayā |
svāgatāv annadānādyair upacārair apūjayat ||
teṣām athopaviṣṭānāṃ pūrvavṛttāntabhāṣiṇām |
sañjayasya sutā prāptā varuṇī pitur antikam ||
parvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ kanyeyaṃ varavarṇinī |
guptagulphā saṃhatoruḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharā ||
padmapatrekṣaṇanakhā padmakiñjilkasaṃnibhā |
ākuñcitamṛdusnigdhaiḥ keśair atitatair dhanaiḥ ||
savilāsā gajagatā sunāśā kauśalasvarā |
aho rūpamaho dhairyam aho lāvaṇyam uttamam ||
tilapuṣpasphuṭā nāsā rūpaṃ saṃparilakṣyate |
[385]        kasyeyaṃ bhadrakā bhadrā mamātihṛdayaṃgamā ||
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ taṃ vipraṃ vismayotpullalocanam |
rājā prāha tato brahman duhitā mama parvata ||
athovāca vaco dhīmān nāradaḥ kṣubhitendriyaḥ |
rājan nirveṣṭukāmo 'haṃ kanyeyaṃ dīyatāṃ mama ||
īpsitaṃ te pradāsyāmi varam atyantadurlabham |
evam ukto nāradena prītātmā sañjayas tadā ||
kṛtāñjalir uvācedaṃ praharṣotpullalocanaḥ |
putro me dīyatāṃ kṣipram akṣīṇakanakākaraḥ ||
yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā śleṣmāṇaṃ kṣipati kṣitau |
jātarūpaṃ hi tat sarvaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavatu sthiram ||
evam astv iti taṃ tājā nāradaṃ pratyabhāṣata |
suvarṇaṣṭhīvinaṃ putraṃ dadāmi tava suvrata ||
evam uktvā satīṃ kanyāṃ sālaṃkārāṃ sumadhyamām |
vivāhayāmāsa tadā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ||
tat tasya ceṣṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā parvataḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ |
uvāca nāradaṃ roṣad roṣād dīptākṣasphuritādharaḥ ||
mayeyaṃ prārthitā pūrvaṃ tvayā yā syād vivāhitā |
tasmān mayā samaṃ svargān na gantāsi kadācana ||
dattas tvayāsya yaḥ putro varadānena nārada |
so 'pi caurair upahataḥ pañcatvam upayāsyati ||
evam uktaḥ parvatena nāradaḥ prāha durmanāḥ |
na tvaṃ dharmaṃ vijānāsi kiṃcin mūḍho 'si durmate ||
[386]        sāmānyā sarvabhūyānāṃ kanyā bhavati suvrata |
na tasyā varaṇe doṣaṃ paśyantīha bahuśrutāḥ ||
na sevitā tvayā vṛddha tena māṃ śapase ruṣā |
pāṇigrahaṇamantrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syāt prathame pade ||
yasmād etad avijñāya śapase mām anāgasam |
tasmāt tvam apy aho svargaṃ na gantāsi mayā vinā ||
sañjayasya sutaḥ śāpād yadi pañcatvam eṣyati |
ānayiṣye tathāpy enaṃ yamalokān na saṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ śaptā tadānyo'nyaṃ devarṣī tāv ubhau punaḥ |
pūjitau sañjaye nātha jagmatuḥ svāśramaṃ prati ||
athāsya saptame māsi jātaḥ putro nṛpasya saḥ |
svarṇaṣṭhīvīti nāmāsya yathārtham akarot pitā ||
jātismaraḥ smaravapuḥ suvarṇotpattikāraṇam |
sarvabhūtasya tajjño 'bhūd bhadravrataphalād iha ||
tatra śleṣmapurīṣādi yat kiṃcit kṣipate kṣitau |
jāyate kanakaṃ sarvaṃ prasādān nāradasya ca ||
tenāsau yajate rājā vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
rājasūyādibhir yajñair vividhair adhipūjitaḥ ||
babhara bhṛtyān itarān pupoṣa svajanātithīn |
cakāra devatāgārān sarārāmādivāpikāḥ |
jātasnehaṃ ca taṃ putraṃ rarakṣa rakṣibhir vṛtam ||
[387]        rāśayaḥ kanakānāṃ ca babhūvur bhūpateḥ sutāt |
athāsya dasyavaḥ kecit śrutvā taṃ kanakākaram ||
dhanalobhena taṃ jaghnur dākṣiṇātyā mahoddhatāḥ |
tasmin vinaṣṭe tan naṣṭaṃ varadānasamudbhavam ||
kanakaṃ naśyate rājño jagāmānyo'nyataḥ kṣayam |
ghātitaṃ dasyubhiḥ putraṃ jñātvā rājā suduḥkhitaḥ ||
vilalāpākulamatiḥ saṃmohena papāta ca |
vilapantaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha satvaram ||
rājan viṣādaṃ mākārṣīḥ śṛṇv imāṃ bhāratīṃ kathām |
ity uktvā sa samācakhyau caritāni mahaujasām ||
vinaṣṭānāṃ narendrāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ dakṣiṇāvatām |
śrutvā rājā narendrāṇāṃ caritāni mahātmanām ||
vinaṣṭaśokaḥ sahasā prakṛtistho babhūva saḥ |
nārado 'pi narendrasya mṛtaṃ putraṃ yamālayāt ||
ānayāmāsa tarasā yathārūpaṃ yathāhatam |
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā sa putraṃ taṃ parituṣṭena cetasā ||
vrīḍito vismitaś caiva kṛtāñjalir athābravīt |
kim āścaryaṃ prasannena bhavatā mama nārada ||
dattaḥ putras tathā bhūto dasyubhir nihato yathā |
ṣaṇmāsān te punar asau jīvitaṃ sarvam eva tat ||
sasmāra pūrvavṛttāntaṃ jātismaraṇakāraṇam |
vrataṃ vrataśreṣṭham idaṃ kim anyat kathayāmi te ||
tathā bhādrapadasyādau trīn māsān pāṇḍunandana |
[388]        tat tripuṣkaram ākhyātaṃ bahuvidyāpradāyakam ||
tathā mārgaśirasyādau trīn māsāṃś ca narādhipa |
tad viṣṇupadam ity uktaṃ sarvadharmapradāyakam ||
munibhiḥ kathitāny evaṃ bhadrāṇy etāni bhārata |
kartavyāni naraiḥ strībhir brāhmaṇānumatena vai ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
vistareṇaiva me brūhi devadeva janārdana |
bhadrāṇāṃ niyamādhānaṃ pradhānaṃ madhusūdana ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu rājann avahito bhadrāṇāṃ vistaraṃ param |
kathayiṣye na kathitaṃ yan mayā kasyacit purā ||
śuklā mārgaśirasyādau catasras tithayo varāḥ |
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca caturthī pañcamī tathā ||
ekabhaktāśanas tiṣṭhet pratipadi jitendriyaḥ |
prabhāte tu dvitīyāyāṃ kṛtvā yat karaṇīyakam ||
prahare vai samadhike gate snānaṃ samācaret |
mṛdgomayaṃ tu saṃgṛhya mantrair ebhir vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
ahaṃ te pravadiṣyāmi viprāṇāṃ vidhim uttamam |
etan na deyaṃ deyān vā kathayiṣyāmi tān api ||
brāḥmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śudrā ye sudhiyo 'malāḥ |
teṣāṃ mantrāḥ pradeyā vai na tu saṃkīrṇadharmiṇām ||
[389]        yā strī bhartrā vimuktāpi svācāraviratāḥ sadā |
sāpi vrataṃ pragṛhṇīyāt sabhartā śīlasaṃyutā ||
snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāgeṣu vāpīkūpagṛheṣu ca |
daśavāraṃ phalaṃ jñeyam adhikaṃ hi samantrakam ||
mṛdaṃ mantreṇa saṃgṛhya sarvagātreṣu dāpayet |
tvaṃ hi mṛd vanditā devaiḥ samalā vimalāḥ kṛtāḥ ||
mayāpi vanditā bhaktyā mām adyaivāmalaṃ kuru |
evaṃ japan mṛdaṃ datvā svahastāgre (?) samantrakam ||
jalāvagāhanaṃ kuryāt kuṇḍam ālipya dharmavit |
siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilair vacāsarvauṣadhaiḥ kramāt ||
tvam ādiḥ sarvadevānāṃ jagatāṃ ca jaganmaya |
bhūtānāṃ tu viśuddhānāṃ rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ ||
gaṅgāsāgarajaṃ toyaṃ pauṣkaraṃ nārmadaṃ tathā |
yāmunaṃ saṃnidhātavyaṃ saṃnidhau tad ihāstu me ||
śarīrālambhanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ mṛdgomayāmbubhiḥ |
evaṃ snātvā samāplutya trir ācamya taṭasthitaḥ ||
nivasya vāsasī śubhre śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
devān pitṝn manuṣyāṃś ca tarpayet susamāhitaḥ ||
evaṃ gṛhītaniyamo gṛhaṃ gacchet śucivrataḥ |
na hasen na ca saṃjalped yāvac candrasya darśanam ||
snātvā caiva tato nāma dvitīyādau caturdine ||
[390]        namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānantahṛśīkeśeti ca kramāt |
caturdine dvitīyādi devam abhyarcayed vratam ||
prathame 'hni smṛtā pūjā pādayoś cakrapāṇinaḥ |
nābhipūjā dvitīye 'hni kartavyā vidhivan naraiḥ ||
puradvipas tṛtīye 'hni pūjāṃ vakṣasi vinyaset |
caturthe 'hni jagaddhātuḥ pūjāṃ śirasi vinyaset ||
puṣpair vilepanair dhūpair arghyaṃ dadyād vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
pravarair bhūrinaivedyair dīpadānaiś ca bhaktitaḥ ||
pūjayitvā vidhānena viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ vratī |
tato dināvasāne tu muhūrte vimale satī ||
arghyaṃ pradadyāt somāya bhaktyā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ |
sa cārdhyo yādṛśo deya ṛgbhir mṛdbhis tathetaraiḥ ||
tat te samyak pravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha me |
candanāgurukarpūradadhidūrvākṣatādibhiḥ ||
ratnaiḥ samudrajaiś cānyair vajravaidūryamauktikaiḥ |
puṣpaiḥ phalaiś ca kallolaiḥ kharjūrair nārikelakaiḥ ||
vastrācchādanagovājibhūmihemasamanvitaiḥ |
sattvayuktasya kṛtsnasya vidhir eṣa prakīrtitā ||
itarasya yathā śaktyā phalapuṣpākṣatodakaiḥ |
lavaṇājyaguḍais tailapayaḥkumbhatilaiḥ saha ||
śaśin cantra śaśāṅgendo nāmāni kramaśo naraḥ |
dvitīyādiṣu candrasya saṃkīrtyārghaṃ nivedayet ||
arcayitvā niśāyāṃ tu śaśivṛddhyā vivardhayet |
[391]        pratyahaṃ vardhayorghyaṃ (?) śaśivṛddhyā nṛpottama ||
evam arghyaḥ pradātavyaḥ śṛṇu mantravidhikramam |
navo navo 'si māsānte jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
trir agnisamavetān vai devān āpyāyase haviḥ |
gaganāṅgaṇasandīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava ||
bhābhāsitadigābhoga rāmānuja namo 'stu te |
datvārghyaṃ dvijarājāya tad viprāya nivedayet ||
nivartyārghyaṃ krameṇaiva tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
bhūmiṃ tu bhājanaṃ kṛtvā padmapatrasamāśritam||
pālāśair madhupatrair vā sudhaute vā śilātale |
samālabhya darāṃ devīṃ mantreṇānena mantravit ||
tvattale bhoktukāmo 'haṃ devi sarvarasodbhave |
madanugrahāya susvādu kurvantīm amṛtopamam ||
evaṃ japtvā ca bhuktvā ca śākapākaguṇottaram |
ācamya khāny athālabhya smṛtvā somaṃ svaped bhuvi (?) ||
bhoktavyaṃ tu dvitīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ gorasottaram |
ghṛtāktāḥ saguḍā rājan pañcamyāṃ kṛśarā bhuvi ||
bhojyāḥ sarveṣu bhadreṣu sadā śyāmākataṇḍulāḥ |
prasādhitaghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ phalaṃ śākamayānvitam ||
prātaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ |
[392]        bhojayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā datvā dānaṃ visarjayet ||
bhṛtyabandhujanaiḥ sārdhaṃ paścād bhuñjīta kāmyayā |
evaṃ bhadreṣu sarveṣu trimāseṣu yatavrataḥ ||
karoty evaṃ naro bhaktyā varṣam ekam amatsarī |
tasya śrīr vijayaś caiva nityaṃ somaḥ prasīdati ||
etat karoti yā kanyā bhavyaṃ prāpnoti sā patim |
durbhagā subhagā sādhvī bhavaty avidhavā sadā ||
rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī dhanam āpnuyāt |
putrārthī prāpnuyāt putrān ity āha bhagavān raviḥ ||
yoṣitkulākulavivāhamanoramāṇi
śayyānnapānaśayanāśanaśobhitāni |
bhadrāṇy avāpya dhanaputrakalatrajātīḥ
jātismaro bhavati bhāratabhadrakartā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ bhadracatuṣṭayavratam |
sumantur uvāca |
śṛṇu kaurava karmāṇi tithiguhyāśritāni tu |
śrutvaiva pāpahāniḥ syāt kṛtvānantaṃ phalaṃ labhet ||
kṣīrāśanaḥ pratipadi | puṣpāhāro dvitīyāyām | [393] lavaṇavarjitaṃ tṛtīyāyām | tilānnāśī caturthyām | kṣīrāsanaḥ pañcamyām | phalāśanaḥ ṣaṣṭyām | śākāśanaḥ saptamyām | bilvāhāro 'ṣṭamyām | piṣṭāśano navamyām | anagnipakvāhāro daśamyām | ekādaśyām upavāsaḥ | ghṛtāśano dvādaśyām | pāyasāhāras trayodaśyām | yavānnāhāraś caturdaśyām | gomūtrāhāraḥ kuśodakaprāśanaḥ paurṇamāsyām | evaṃ prāśanavidhiḥ |
uktāni prāśanāny evaṃ didhipūrvam udāhṛtam |
kṣīrapratipadāyāṃ tu sa sarvāsu vidhīyate ||
sa kṣīrapratipadokto vidhiḥ kathyate | tatra vratadināt pūrvadine trikālasnānam upavāsaś ca pavitraḥ sūktajapaḥ śirasā saha gāyatrījapaś ca tatpūrvadine ekabhaktaṃ vidhāyopavāsasaṅkalpaḥ vratadivase dvijebhyo dakṣiṇādānam iti eṣa pūrvaḥ prāśanavidhis tithīnām | evam anena vidhinā pakṣam ekaṃ yo vartayati aśvamedhaphalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ prāpnoti svarge manvantaraṃ yāvat prativasati upagīyamānāpsarogandharvaiḥ saha vāsaḥ | māsacatuṣṭaye tu so 'śvamedharājasūyānāṃ śataguṇaṃ phalam āpnoti | svarge upagīyamānāpsarobhir gandharvaiś caturyugānāṃ saptatiṃ yāvat pravasati | samekaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ | ya evaṃ niyamād rājann āśvayujanavamyāṃ vaiśākhatṛtīyāyāṃ kārttike paurṇamāsyāṃ vā tithivratāni gṛhṇāti |
[394]        brahmacārī gṛhastho nārī naro vā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ
puṣpadantavibhusālokyaṃ vrajati ||
puṣpadantivibhuḥ sūryaḥ |
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktaṃ mahāphalavratam |
jyaiṣthe pañcatapāḥ sāyaṃ hemadhenuprado divam |
yāty aṣṭamīcaturdaśyau rudravratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
aṣṭamīcaturdaśāv iti ca | catvāri dināni pañcāgnisādhanaṃ taccaturthe dine sāyaṃ suvarṇadhenuṃ dadyāt |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ rudravratam |
dve pañcamyau hi māsasya dve ca pratipadau naraḥ |
sopavāsaḥ sugandhāḍhyaḥ śayīta priyayā saha ||
khaganiścalacittas tu ratiprītivivarjitaḥ |
khaganiścalacittaḥ sūryadhyānaparaḥ |
samaś ca smṛtiśīlaś ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā ||
tatas tu bhāvayaty enaṃ mahādevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ sambhogavratam |
[395]        paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṣṭamīṣu ca |
naktam abdaṃ tu kurvīta haviṣyair brahmacāriṇī ||
umāmaheśapratimāṃ hemnā kṛtvā suśobhanām |
rājatīṃ vāpi karṣārdhe snāpayitvā ghṛtādibhiḥ ||
gandhapuṣpair alaṃkṛtya vastrayugmaiś ca śobhanaiḥ |
bhakṣybhojyair aśeṣaiś ca vitānadhvajacāmaraiḥ ||
bhojayec chivabhaktāṃś ca dīnān anāthān pratarpayet |
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāc chivamantraiḥ kṣamāpayet ||
tāmrakāṃsyādipātraṃ vā sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitam |
kṛtvā vāyatanaṃ madhye pratimāṃ tūpakalpayet ||
pātram evāyatanam upakalpayet sthāpayet |
śirasy ādhāya tat pātraṃ śobhitaṃ puṣpamālayā ||
dhvajaśaṃkhyādivibhavaiḥ śivasyāyatanaṃ nayet |
liṅgamūrter maheśasya vratasyānte nivedayet ||
tad dvedhā sthāpayet pātram upaśobhāsamanvitam |
śive pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
samāpyaitad vrataṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu yac ca phalaṃ labhet |
dvādaśādityasaṃkāśair mahāyānair manoharaiḥ ||
yatheṣṭam aiśvare loke rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭigatāni ca ||
tadante sa mahābhāgo viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
iti śivadharmoktam umāmaheśvaravratam |
[396]        aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ niyatabrahmacāriṇī ||
varṣam ekaṃ na bhuñjīta mahībhogajigīṣayā |
varṣānte pratimāṃ kṛtvā pūrvavad vidhim ācaret ||
snānārghyais (?) tad vrataṃ prāpya pūrvoktāṃs tu guṇān labhet |
atrāpy umāmaheśvarapratimā kartavyā | pūrvavad iti pūrvavratoktavad ity arthaḥ |
jāmbūnadamayair yānaiś caturdvārair alaṃkṛtaiḥ ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyam aśeṣaṃ bhogam āpnuyāt |
umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma vratam īśvarabhāṣitam ||
kāruṇyāt sarvanārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena umāmaheśvaravratam ||
kartavyaṃ naranārībhiḥ sukham akṣayam āpnuyāt |
umādevīpriyārthaṃ tu naṣṭena paramārthataḥ ||
iti śivadharmottaroktam aparam umāmaheśvaravratam |
bilvavṛkṣaṃ samāśritya (?) dvādaśāham abhojanam |
yaḥ kuryād bhrūṇahāt pāpān mukto bhavati nārada ||
śivo 'tra devatā |
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ pāpamocanavratam |
[397]                sūta uvāca |
paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ varṣam ekam atandritā |
upavāsaratā nārī naro vā dvijasattamāḥ ||
varṣānte sarvagandhāḍhyāṃ pratimāṃ ca nivedayet |
sā bhavānyās tu sāyojyaṃ sārūpyaṃ vātha suvratā ||
labhate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ munīśvarāḥ |
iti liṅgapurāṇoktaṃ bhavānīvratam |
dvedhāṣṭamyau tu māsasya caturdaśyau tu dve tathā|
amāvāsyāpaurṇamāsyau saptamīdvādaśīdvayam ||
saṃvatsaram abhuñjānaḥ satataṃ ca jitendriyaḥ |
brahmacaryaphalaṃ yac ca yat phalaṃ satrayājinaḥ ||
ṛtugāmiphalaṃ yac ca tad avāpnoty abhojanāt |
eṣu tithisvāmino devatāḥ |
iti yamasmṛtyuktaṃ tithiyugalavratapañcakam |
caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayo śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ |
yo 'bdam ekaṃ na bhuñjīta śivārcanarataḥ śuciḥ ||
yat puṇyam akṣayaṃ proktaṃ satataṃ satrayājinām |
tat puṇyaṃ sakalaṃ tasyāṃ śivalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śaivopavāsavratam |
[398]        kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu naktena kṛtvā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm |
iha bhogān avāpnoti paratra śivam ṛcchati ||
iti śrībhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ śivanaktavratam |
sūta uvāca |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
varṣam ekaṃ tato bhuktvā naktaṃ yaḥ pūjayec chivam ||
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
iti liṅgapurāṇoktaṃ mahāvratam |
pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte pakṣayor ubhayoḥ suta |
caturdaśyām athāṣṭamyāṃ paurṇamāsyām athāpi vā ||
nityaṃ nirvartya vidhivat tataḥ kāmyaṃ samācaret |
viśeṣapūjā tatraiva kartavyā śuddhacetasā ||
naivedyaṃ yāvakaprasthaṃ khaṇḍaṃ kṣīrājyasaṃskṛtam |
rudrasaṃkhyāṃs tu vai viprān bhojayec caiva dakṣayet ||
vitastimātrāṃ prakṛtiṃ yāvapiṣṭena nirmitām |
saśṛṅgakhuralāṅgūlīkṛtabhūṣāṃ tu kārayet ||
śivāya tu pradātavyā kapilā gurave tataḥ |
svavāhanasamāyuktā vratapuṇyam ataḥ śṛṇu ||
[399]        sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ |
rudravṛndasamākīrṇai rudrakanyāsamāvṛtaiḥ ||
vṛṣabhasyandanair yukto nānāgītaravānvitaḥ |
triḥsaptakulasaṃyukto yāty asau yatra śaṅkaraḥ |
yāvattadromasaṃkhyānaṃ tat prasūte kuleṣu ca ||
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate |
sāmīpyaṃ tu samāsādya sāyojyaṃ yāti vā tataḥ ||
anena vidhimārgeṇa khaḍgaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ śive |
samarpya ca vidhānena cakravartipadaṃ labhet ||
phālgune tu tathā cakraṃ nivedya tat padaṃ labhet |
caitre śivaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ nivedya ca śivāgrataḥ ||
sa muñcati brahmahatyāṃ śivalokam avāpnuyāt |
vaiśākhe māsi daṇḍāgraṃ śivasyāgre nivedayet ||
hastārdhaṃ piṣṭajaṃ kāryaṃ pūjānte tu nivedayet |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudraloke mahīyate ||
jyaiṣṭhe piṣṭamayaṃ khaḍgaṃ śivāya vinivedayet |
mucyate tu kṛtaghnatvād rudraloke tu gacchati ||
āṣāḍhe piṣṭajaṃ pātraṃ śivāya vinivedayet |
mucyate duṣkṛtaiḥ sarvair iha janmani saṃcitaiḥ ||
dhvajaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ yas tu śivasyāgre nivedayet |
śrāvaṇe tu vidhānena so 'kṣayaṃ mokṣam āpnuyāt ||
[400]        māse bhādrapade yas tu gadāṃ piṣṭamayīṃ dadet |
nidhīśatvaṃ tu saṃprāpya śivaloke mahīyate ||
māsi cāśvayuje śūlaṃ datvārdhapiṣṭasaṃbhavam ||
śivāya purato deyaṃ bhrūṇahatyāṃ vyapohati |
kārttike tua gadāṃ cakraṃ śivasyāgre nivedayet ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dahaty agnir ivendhanam |
māse vai mārgaśīrṣe tu kamalaṃ piṣṭasaṃbhavam ||
śivāya vidhinā deyaṃ sarvaiśvaryam avāpnuyāt |
sarveṣāṃ caiva naktaṃ tu vratānāṃ kīrtitaṃ mayā ||
nityapūjāṃ tu nirvartya kāmyapūjāṃ tu kārayet |
māsi māsi guroḥ pūjā kartavyaṃ tu vratārpaṇam ||
mahāpūjā vatsarānte kartavyā tu vidhānataḥ |
guravo dakṣitavyās tu hemavastrānnavāhanaiḥ ||
tataḥ phalam iyāt tūrṇaṃ yathoktaṃ kṛttikāsu ca |
vittaśāṭhyān mahāsena iṣṭāpūrtair viyujyate ||
iti kālottaroktaṃ śivavratam |
[401]
atha śakradhvajocchāyavidhiḥ |
devīpurāṇe |
śakra uvāca |
kena sā vidhinā labdhā mama vaṃśakramāgataiḥ |
dhvajayaṣṭir viśeṣeṇa tadvidhiṃ kathaya prabho ||
brahmovāca |
gaṅgāyāḥ sikatāsaṃkhyā kriyate surasattama |
na bhaved daityavaṃśasya devarāja jigīṣataḥ ||
viṣṇunā ghātitāḥ kecit kecid devena śaṃbhunā |
guhena nihatāḥ kecit mayā kecij jighāṃsitāḥ ||
devībhir bahavaś cānye na tathāpi kṣayaṃ gatāḥ |
suvalo nāma daityendro haṃsaketur mahābalaḥ ||
mama vaṃśasamutpanno daṇḍaghātaś ca vāsava |
tena pūrvaṃ jitā devāḥ bhānor manvantare vibho ||
samāgatāḥ samastās tu saha śakreṇa vāsava |
yathā na śaktāḥ samare daityān yoddhuṃ pitāmaha ||
śatruṇā paribhūtāś ca śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ gatā vayam |
tadāhaṃ cintayan śakta (?) viṣṇurakṣāṃ divaukasām ||
[402]        ketunā śaṃbhudattena ucchritena na saṃśayaḥ |
uktā mayā surāḥ sendrā viṣṇur ārādhyatāṃ prabhuḥ ||
sa dāsyati mahāketuṃ sarvadaityavimohanam |
te gatā mama cādeśāt kṣīrode yatra keśava ||
parāparasvarūpastham ajam avyayaśāśvatam |
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ mahābāhuṃ kaustubhoraskabhūṣitam ||
stuvanty ete tadā sendrā devāḥ śatrubhayārditāḥ |
tutoṣa keśavas teṣāṃ varaṃ brūhi purandara ||
tadā tair yācito devaḥ ketuṃ dehi surāriham |
tenāsau bhūṣayitvā tu datto devabhayāpahaḥ ||
śvetachatraṃ mahātejaḥ sumālākaṭakānvitam |
sūryāyutasamaprakhyaṃ kiṅkiṇīravakānvitam ||
cāmaravyajanopetaṃ śatrulakṣaṇalakṣitam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāsau balaṃ sainyaṃ bhagnaṃ sa ca nipātitaḥ ||
tadāprabhṛti he śakra ketus tava kulāgataḥ |
anyeṣāṃ caiva rājñāṃ taducchrāyo vijayāvahaḥ ||
mayā hareṇa devena viṣṇunā vāsavena ca |
dattaṃ yaḥ kaścid evemaṃ nṛpatis taṃ śrayiṣyati ||
sa samastāshipo bhūmau ajeyaś ca bhaviṣyati |
evaṃ śakrasya brahmaṇā kathitaṃ ketukāraṇam ||
mayāpi tava vidyeśa sarvaṃ tac ca prakāśitam |
[403]                nṛpavāhana uvāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi tasya cocchrāyaṇaṃ yathā |
kriyate dinaṛkṣe tu dravyaṃ mantravidhiṃ vada ||
agastya uvāca |
brahmaṇā kathitaṃ śakre bṛhaspatisamīpataḥ |
yathā pravakṣyāmi tathā vidhiṃ ketoḥ samucchraye ||
śubhāhe ṛkṣakaraṇe muhūrte śubhamaṅgale |
daivajñaḥ sūtradhāraṃ ca vanaṃ gacchet sahāyavān ||
devīpratiṣṭhā vidhinā yātrā yā ca pracoditā |
yātrāvidhinā (?) ca vanaṃ gacchet |
gatvā vṛkṣaṃ śubhaṃ vīkṣya dhavārjunapriyaṅgukam |
uḍumbarāśvakarṇau ca pañcaite śobhanā nṛpa ||
priyaṅguko bījakaḥ aśvakarṇaḥ sarjaḥ |
dhvajārthaṃ varjayed vatsa devatodyānajān drumān |
kanyamadhyottamā yaṣṭīḥ karamānena kalpayet ||
ekādaśakarā vatsa navapañcakarāparā |
avanaddhāṃ kṛmicitāṃ yathāpakṣiniketanām ||
valmīkapitṛvanajāṃ suśuṣkāṃ koṭarāṃ tathā |
kubjāndhaṣaṇḍasiktāṃ ca tathā strīnām agarhitām ||
vidyudvajrahatāṃ caiva dagdhāṃ ca parivarjayet |
alābhe candanaṃ cāmraṃ śālaṃ śākamayaṃ tathā ||
kartavyaṃ śakracihnārthaṃ nānyavṛkṣodbhavaṃ kvacit |
[404]        śubhambūmibhavaṃ grāhyaṃ śubhatoyaṃ śubhāvaham ||
tataḥ saṃpūjayed vṛkṣaṃ prāṅmukhodaṅmukho 'pi vā ||
namo vṛkṣapate vṛkṣa tvām ācarati pārthivaḥ |
dhvajārthaṃ tattvato nātha nānyathā upagamyatām ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
rātrau deyo balis tatra yugavṛkṣe tathaiva ca |
vāsavārthaṃ mahāvṛkṣa kṛtvānyatra ca gamyatām ||
dhavjārthe devarājasya na klāntis tava tatra ca |
balimantrāḥ |
varāhasaṃhitoktāś cātra mantrāḥ |
yānīha vṛkṣe bhūtāni tebhyaḥ svasti namo 'stu te |
upahāraṃ gṛhītvemaṃ śriyatāṃ vāsam arpaya ||
pārthivas tvāṃ varayate śvastites tu nagotrama |
dhvajārthaṃ devarājasya pūjeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām iti ||
pūjayitvā tato vṛkṣaṃ baliṃ bhūteṣu dāpayet |
prabhāte chedayed vṛkṣaṃ śubhasvapnādidarśanaiḥ ||
śuklāmbaraṃ naraṃ caiva samudrataraṇaṃ nadī |
vṛkṣān grāmān śubhān kīrān ārohed devatālayam ||
devadvijās tathā sādhuliṅgabrahmaharer api |
pratimā pūjitā svapne kṣipraṃ siddhipradāyakā ||
matsyamāṃsaṃ dadhilābhaṃ rudhiraṃ mṛtarodanam |
agamyāgamanaṃ kṛtvā āśusiddhiphalapradā ||
[405]        drumādrilaṅghanaṃ dhanyaṃ śatrunāśaṃ tathāśubham |
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ sitaṃ dūrvā svapne labdhvā jayen manīm ||
śaṅkhā gāvas tathā dantilābho rājyapradāyakaḥ |
gauḥ savatsā navasūtā dṛṣṭvā putraphalapradā ||
paṅke uttaraṇaṃ kūpe vyādhimokṣakaraṃ cirāt |
evaṃ svapnān śubhān dṛṣṭvā tataś chindeta pādapam ||
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā madhuvat prāk paśuṃ dadet |
pūrvottare patan śasto aśabdo avraṇaḥ śubhaḥ ||
anagnapādapettānye (?) anyathā tu parityajet |
aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tyajen mūlam agrārdhaṃ tu jale kṣipet ||
ardhaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ śeṣavṛkṣaṃ jale kṣipet |
tathā tam ānaye vatsa śakaṭena vṛṣair api ||
taṃ jalakṣiptaṃ vṛkṣam |
pradhānair lakṣasaṃpannair nayeta purataḥ puram |
nīyamānā yadā yaṣṭiḥ samā vā caturasrakā ||
vṛttā vā bhaṅgam ādhatte rājñaḥ putrapurohitān |
ārabhaṅge baliṃ bhindhyān naimyanāśe kṣayaṃ tathā ||
[bhindhyāt nāśāayet] rājādīna naimyaṃ nemisaṃbandhi kāṣṭham |
rathasya akṣabhaṅgena śāntis tatra tu kārayet |
indakṣatreti mantreṇa jātavedasayāpi vā ||
tathā nītvā śubhe lagne purastād upaveśayet |
[406]        dvāraśobhāṃ pathirathyāgṛhe ca deva kārayet ||
padupaṭahaninadāṃś ca veśyāḥ śaṅkhadvijātayaḥ |
maṅgalair vedaghoṣaiś ca nayeyur yatra cocchrayaḥ ||
vastrair aṇḍajalomotthaiḥ śubhaiḥ ślakṣṇair yathākramam |
nandopanandasaṃjñāś ca kumāryaḥ prathamāṃśakāḥ ||
devyo jayavijayākhyā ṣoḍaśāṃśavyavasthitāḥ |
adhike śakrajananī jayantaś caiva devatāḥ ||
ṣoḍaśeṣu adhike sati ayam arthaḥ | athottaraṃ ṣoḍaśādhikāḥ | dhvajabhāgāt dhvajastmbhas tasya bhāryāḥ (?) | tatra prathame dvitīye ca bhāge pratidiśaṃ dve kumāryo kārye tṛtīye tv ekā | tāsām āyāmavistārau bhāgāv imau tatra prathamāṃśagāḥ kumāryaḥ pratiyugmaṃ nadnopanandāv eti dvitīyāṃśagā jayā vijayā ceti | tṛtīyāṃśagāḥ pratyekaṃ śakrajananī devyo jñeyāḥ | dhvajamastake dattopadattātreyā devatāḥ dhvajapramāṇatryaṃśīyaṃ paridhiḥ prathamaḥ (ṣoḍaśāṃśavihīnāni kuryāc cheṣāṇi buddhimān) vakṣyamāṇabhūṣaṇānām idaṃ mānam | dhvajaṃ tribhāgaṃ kṛtvā ekasya bhāgasya dairgheṇa prathamabhūṣaṇaparidhiṃ nirdhārya śeṣāṇi yathottaraṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśahīnaparithīni kuryāt | ata eva bhūṣaṇapraveśayogyaṃ dhvajasya sthaulyaṃ kāryam ity uktaṃ bhavati | bhūṣaṇāni vicitravarṇāni svayaṃbhuve prathame dadyāt |
[407]        suraktāṃ caturasrāṃ ca viśvakarmād dvitīyakām |
aṣṭamyāṃ tu svayaṃ śakro nīlaraktāṃ pradāpayet ||
kṛṣṇāṃ yamasya vṛttāṃ ca varuṇasya ṣaḍasrikāḥ |
mañjiṣṭhājaladākārā vāyur devo mayūrakām ||
nīlavarṇāṃ ca tāṃ dadyāt skando bahuvicitritām |
vṛttāṃ tu dahane dadyāt svarṇābhāṃ viṣṇum aṣṭamīm |
vaidūryasadṛśam indau graiveyaṃ dāpayet svayam ||
ardhacandrākṛtiḥ sūryo viśvedevās tu padmavat |
ṛṣayo nivasan dadyā (?) nīlanīlopalopamam ||
guruṇā śukreṇa tato nakṣatraiś ca samantataḥ |
nyastaṃ gṛhe vicitraṃ ca tathaiva bahumātṛbhiḥ ||
yad yad yenaiva dattaṃ tu keto yas tasya bhūṣaṇam |
tad daivataṃ vijānīyād yatrāhani samucchrayet ||
ucchrayadine tāṃ tāṃ devatāṃ pūjayed ity arthaḥ |
prathamaṃ praviśati bhūmau yaṣṭiḥ sāhaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca prathamaṃ puruṣa prayasnāt (?) pūrvaṃ ucchritamātraiva | bālānāṃ tālaśabdair deśavighātaṃ samācaṣṭe | nṛpabandhakarī viśīrṇā śubhāvahā sarvaśāntā ca śambhusūryayamaśakrasomadhanadavāruṇāḥ |
vahnīśa ṛṣimantraiś ca hotavyā dadhi vākṣatāḥ |
śambhubrahmā īśvaraḥ dadhyakṣataiś ca miśrā hotavyāḥ |
śukraskandagururudra.apsarādīn prapūjayet |
hutvā tu vidhivad vahnijvālāṃ lakṣeta buddhimān ||
sutejāḥ suprabho dīptaḥ saṃhato ravisaprabhaḥ |
[408]        raktāṃśukasamākāro rathabherīsvanaśubhaḥ ||
śaṅkhadundubhimeghānāṃ nādāḥ śastās tu pāvake |
tataḥ kadalīkṣudaṇḍān patākāṃś ca samucchayet ||
anyāś ca vividhāh śobhāḥ śakraketusamucchaye |
prauṣṭhapade tu aṣṭamyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śobhanarkṣake ||
āśvine vātha śuklāyāṃ śrāvaṇe vā samucchayet |
paurajananagnavṛndaiḥ paṭubherīvinoditam ||
vitānadhvajaśobhāḍhyaṃ palākābhiḥ samujjvalam |
viṣṇvīśaśakramantreṇa siddharakṣākṛtena ca ||
siddhaṃ janitāniśayaṃ rakṣā kṛte na bhasyanā (?) prayuktena |
dṛḍhaṃ mātṛkadaṇḍasya śubhatoraṇamaṅgalam |
mātṛkadaṇḍau toraṇastambau |
avilambitam utthānam abhagnapīṭakaṃ samam |
pīṭakaṃ bhūṣaṇam |
nadrutaṃ vā samutthāpya ketuvāsavayor vibho |
varāhasaṃhitāyām |
chatraṃ dhvajādarśahalārdhacandra-
vicitramālākadalīkṣudaṇḍakaiḥ |
savyālisiṃhaiḥ piṭakair gavākṣair
alaṃkṛto dikṣu ca lokapālaiḥ ||
acchinnarajjuṃ dṛḍhakāṣṭamātṛkaṃ
suśliṣṭayantrāgralayādatoraṇam |
utthāpayel lakṣmasahasracakṣuṣaḥ
[409]                sāradrumā magnakumārikātv iti ||
ucchinnaṃ lakṣayet prājñaḥ kākolūkakapotakaiḥ |
na copaveśanaṃ dadyād anyeṣām api pakṣiṇām ||
pathoddeśaṃ tataḥ kuryānn akhaṇḍitair yathāvidhi |
uddeśo bhūbhāgaḥ |
tathāstu saṃsthitaṃ pūjya sukhayantrasuyantritām ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād indramantrānukīrtanaiḥ |
purohitaḥ sadaivajñaḥ śubhaśāntirataḥ sadā ||
yantrapāte nṛpaṃ hanyāt yātakān mahiṣī vadham |
piṭake yuvarājasya savitānānukampane ||
rāṣṭre toraṇapātena dhvaje annakṣayo bhavet |
dhvaje dhvajotsave kriyamāṇe |
patane śakradaṇḍasya nṛpamanyuṃ samādiśet |
kṛmijālaka.utthānaśalabhātaskarād bhayam ||
sasame saṃsthite śāntir nṛpasya nagarasya ca |
yāvac cocchrita āste tāvat paurāḥ sadā hṛṣṭāḥ ||
ketor niratāyajane bhuñjīran viprakanyāś ca |
bhuñjīran bhojayet |
vihataś chinnaketus tiṣṭhati divasāṣṭakaṃ yāvat |
ghāte pāte kuryād ucchrāyaṇe yādṛśī pūjā ||
rātrau śubhakṛt patanannodaṣṭaṃ kākakapotikādyaiḥ |
nṛpaṃ yāti saharāṣṭraṃ yas tv evaṃ kārayet ketum ||
nagare vā pure vā kheṭe vā yady evaṃ kurvanti paurāḥ |
[410]        puranagarasya dvāre vṛṣasiṃhakhagaspṛśet punaḥ ketum ||
samas tu doṣāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ jayadaṃ param |
evaṃ pūrvaṃ hariḥ ketuṃ prāptavān vṛṣavāhanāt |
tathā brahmāpy anenaiva brāhmaṇaḥ śakram āgataḥ ||
tena somāya datto 'sau tato dakṣaṃ samāgataḥ |
tadā prabhṛti kurvanti nṛpā adyāpi votsavam ||
evaṃ yaḥ kārayed rājā ketur vijayakārakaḥ |
tasya pṛthvī vanopetā sadvīpā vaśagā bhavet ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
puṣkara uvāca |
śivirāt pūrvadigbhāge bhūmibhāte tathā śubhe |
prāgudakplavane kuryāc chakrārthaṃ bhavanaṃ śubham ||
vāsobhiḥ śayanaiḥ śubhrair nānārāgais tathaiva ca |
tataḥ śakradhvajasthānaṃ madhye saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ ||
maghavantaṃ paṭe kuryāt tasya bhāge tu dakṣiṇe |
vāmabhāge paṭe kuryāc chacīṃ devīṃ tathaiva ca ||
prauṣṭhapade site pakṣe pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
tayos tu pūjā kartavyā satataṃ vasudhādhipaiḥ ||
[411]        vanapreveśavidhinā śakrayaṣṭiṃ tato nṛpaḥ |
nānayed gorathenātha nānayet puruṣair atha ||
arjunasyājakarṇasya priyakasya vacasya ca |
priyako vījakaḥ |
suradārukasya tathā tathaivoḍumbarasya ca |
candanasyātha vā rāma padmakasyātha vāpadi ||
alābhe sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ yaṣṭiṃ kurvīta vaiṇavīm |
suvarṇabaddhāṃ dharmajñas tāṃ ca samyak praveśayet ||
prauṣṭhapade site pakṣe aṣṭamyāṃ ripusūdana |
durmapramāṇā vijñeyā śakrayaṣṭir dvijottama ||
caturbhir aṅgulair hīnā sāgrair bhavati śarmadā |
aṣṭābhiś ca tathā mūle chittvā toye ca saṃkṣipet ||
toyād uddhṛtya nagaraṃ samyag eva praveśayet |
toyād uddhṛtya nagaraṃ patākādhvajamāli ca ||
siktarājapathaṃ kuryāt tathālaṃkṛta vālaka (?) |
naṭanartakasaṃkīrṇaṃ tathā pūjitadaivatam ||
saṃpūjitagṛhaṃ rāma tathā pūjitavāṅmayam |
paurair anugato rājā suveśaiḥ phalapāṇibhiḥ ||
[412]        aṣṭamyāṃ vādyaghoṣeṇa tāṃ tu yaṣṭiṃ praveśayet |
tatas tu paṭayor madhye yantranyastāṃ tu kārayet ||
tasminn evāhni dharmajña vastrachannāṃ nidhāpayet |
prākcchannāṃ tāṃ tataḥ kuryād vastraiḥ saṃchāditāṃ śubhaiḥ ||
pūjitāṃ pūjayet tāṃ tu yāvat sā dvādaśī bhavet |
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso nṛpaḥ kuryāt prajāgaram |
saṃvatsareṇa sahito mantriṇāṃ sapurodhasā ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ nāgareṇa janena tu |
sthāne sthāne mahābhāgair deyāḥ preṅkhās tathā madhu ||
preṅkhā hindolikā | madhu madyam |
pūjayen nṛtyagītena rātrau śakraṃ narādhipaḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ tu śiraḥsnāto nṛpatiḥ prayatas tataḥ ||
mantreṇodyāpanaṃ kuryāc chakraketoḥ samāhitaḥ |
devīpurāṇe tv aṣṭamyām udyāpanam uktaṃ tenānayor vikalpaḥ |
suyantritaṃ tu kuryāt tadgṛhastambhacatuṣṭayam |
pūjayet taṃ mahābhāga gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā ||
nityaṃ ca paṭayoḥ pūjāṃ yaṣṭipūjāṃ tu kārayet |
balibhis tu vicitrābhis tathā brāhmaṇapūjanaiḥ ||
nityaṃ ca juhuyān mantrān sa purodhāṃś ca vaiṣṇavān |
nityaṃ gītena nṛtyena tathā śakraṃ ca pūjayet ||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed rājā brāhmaṇān dhanasaṃcayaiḥ |
viśeṣeṇa ca dharmajña sāṃvatsarapurohitau ||
[413]        utthāne ca praveśe ca śakraṃ sūyān narādhipaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa kālavit sa purohitaḥ ||
prayataḥ pūjayed rājā tadā dinacatuṣṭayam |
pañcame divase prāpte śakraketuṃ visarjayet ||
pūjayitvā mahābhāga balena ca turaṅgiṇā |
nītvā karīndrais tritayaṃ tato nadyāṃ pravāhayet ||
paṭadvayaṃ dhvajaṃ ceti tritayam |
vādyaghoṣeṇa mahatā saṅgītis tatra kīrtitā ||
paurajānapadās tatra krīḍāṃ kuryus tathāmbhasi |
utsavaś ca tathā kāryo jalatīragatair mahān ||
etad vidhānaṃ nṛpatis tu kṛtvā
prāpto 'tivṛddhiṃ janavāhanānām |
nāśaṃ tathā śatrugaṇasya rāma
mahat pradādaṃ tridaśādhināthāt ||
indradhvajaśiro bhajyet pated indradhvajo yadi |
bhakṣyate śakrayaṣṭir vā nṛpater niyataṃ vadhaḥ |
yantrabhaṅge tathā jñeyaṃ rajjucchede tathaiva ca ||
mātṛkāyās tathā bhaṅge paracakrabhayaṃ dvija |
mātṛkā toraṇastambhaḥ |
divyāntarikṣabhaumāś ca utpātās tatra vai sadā |
teṣāṃ tīvrabhayāg neyaṃ phalam atyantadāruṇam ||
nilīyate ca kravyādāḥ śakrayaṣṭau tathā dvija |
rājā vā mriyate tatra sarvadeśo vinaśyati ||
[414]        indradhvajāpakaraṇaṃ yat kiṃcid dvijasattama |
vināśe 'nyasya vijñeyā pīḍā nagaravāsinām ||
anyasya ekatamasya |
indradhvajanimitte tu prāyaścittam idaṃ smṛtam |
indrayāgaṃ punaḥ kuryāt sauvarṇe nandake vane ||
rājyaṃ datvā ca gurave bandhanāni pramocayet |
saptāhaṃ pūjayitvā ca dhvajaṃ dadyād dvijātiṣu ||
śāntir aindrī bhavet kāryā brāhmaṇānāṃ dine dine |
gāvaś ca deyā dvijapuṅgavebhyo
hiraṇyavāsorajataiḥ sametāḥ |
evaṃ kṛte śāntim upaiti pāpaṃ
vṛddhis tathā syān manujādhipasya ||
śrīrāma uvāca |
śakrocchrāyeti ye mantrāḥ sopavāso nṛpaḥ paṭhet |
tān ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||
puṣkara uvāca |
śṛṇu mantrān imān samyak sarvakalmaṣanāśanān |
prāpte śakradhvajocchrāye yān paṭhet prayato nṛpaḥ ||
parasvendrajitāmitra vṛtrahatyākanāśana |
[415]        deva deva mahābhāga tvaṃ hi bhūyiṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ ||
tvaṃ prabhuḥ śāśvataś caiva sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
anantatejā virajā yaśovijayavardhanaḥ ||
prayatas tvaṃ pabhur nityam uttiṣṭha surapūjitaḥ |
brahmā svayaṃbhūr bhagavān sarvalokapitāmahaḥ ||
rudraḥ pinākabhṛd dṛptaḥ śatarudriyasaṃyutaḥ |
yajñasya netā kartā ca tathā viṣṇur urukramaḥ ||
tejas tad vardhayaty arko nityam eva mahābalaḥ |
tejo dhāraya deveśa jaya śakra suvṛṣṭida ||
viṣṇur gadādharaḥ śrīmān śaṅkhacakrāsiśārṅgavān |
sa te tejo dadhāty adya jaya śakra mabābala ||
anādinidhano devo brahmakāyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
agnitejā mahābāho rudrātmā pārvatīsutaḥ ||
kārttikeyaḥ śaktidharaḥ ṣaḍvaktro 'su gadādharaḥ |
sa te vareṇyo varadaḥ tejo vardhayatāṃ prabho ||
devasenāpatiskandaḥ surapravarapūjitaḥ |
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā devās tathāśvinau |
bhārgavo 'ṅgirasaś caiva viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ||
lokapālās trayaś caiva candraḥ sūryo 'nilo 'nalaḥ |
devāś ca ṛṣayaś caiva yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ ||
samudrā girayaś caiva nadyo bhūtāni yāni ca |
[416]        tejas tu prāptiḥ satyaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ kīrtir eva ca ||
pravartayantu te tejo jaya śakra śacīpate |
tava cāpi jayaṃ nityam iha saṃpadyate śubham ||
prasīda rājñāṃ viprāṇāṃ pūjanād api sarvaśaḥ |
tava prasādāt pṛthivī nityaṃ sasyavatī bhavet ||
śivaṃ bhavatu nirvighnaṃ śāmyantāṃ munayo bhṛśam |
namas te devadeveśa namas te balasūdana ||
namo vighna namas te 'stu sahasrākṣa śacīpate |
sarveṣām eva lokānāṃ tvam ekaḥ paramā gatiḥ ||
tvam eva paramaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvasyāsya jagatpate |
īśo hy asi ca saṃhṛṣṭaḥ tvam anantaḥ purandaraḥ ||
tvam eva meghas tvaṃ vāyus tvam agnir vaidyuto raviḥ |
tvam atra ghanavijñaptā meghabāhuḥ punarghanaḥ ||
tvaṃ ca tejaḥ paraṃ ghoraṃ ghoṣavāṃs tvam balāhaka |
sraṣṭā tvam eva lokānāṃ saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ ||
tvaṃ jyotiḥ sarvalokānāṃ tvam ādityo vibhāvasuḥ |
tvaṃ mahābhūtam āścaryaṃ tvaṃ rājā tvaṃ surottama ||
tvaṃ viṣṇus tvaṃ sahasrākṣas tvaṃ devas tvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ |
tvam evam amṛtaṃ deva tvaṃ mokṣaḥ parmārcitaḥ ||
muhūrtas tvaṃ sthitiḥ sarvaḥ naras tvaṃ vai punaḥ kṣaṇaḥ |
śukras tv abahūlaś (?) caiva kalāḥ kāṣṭhās trūṭis tathā ||
saṃvatsarartavo māsā rajanyaś ca dināni ca |
[417]        tvaṃ muhūrttasagirivarā (?) vasundharā
sa bhāskaraṃ vitimiram ambaraṃ tathā |
mahodadhiḥ satimiṅgilas tathā
urmimān bahukaramākarākulaḥ ||
mahad yaśas tvam iha sadābhipūjyaḥ
maharṣibhir muditamanomahātmabhiḥ |
abhiṣṭutaḥ pibasi ca somam adhvare
vaṣaṭkṛtāny api ca haviṃṣi bhūtaye ||
tvaṃ vipraiḥ satatam ihejya saphalārthaṃ
vedārtheṣv atula balodyagīyase ca |
tvaṃ vedair yajana parāyaṇā dvijendrāḥ
vedāṅgāny abhiyanti sarvavedaiḥ ||
yajñasya hartā bhuvanasya goptā
vṛttasya hantā namucer nihantā |
kṛṣṇe vasāne ca sadā mahātmā
satyānṛte yo vivinakti loke ||
yaṃ vājinaṃ garbham evāsurāṇāṃ
vaiśvānare vāhanam abhyupaiti |
