namaḥ sadāsyai tridaśeśvarāya
lokatrayeśāya purandarāya ||
ajo 'vyayaḥ śāśvata ekarūpo
viṣṇur varāhaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ |
[418]        tvam adhvaraḥ sarvaharaḥ kṛśānuḥ
sahasraśīrṣaḥ tamaśanyur indraḥ ||
kaviṃ saptajihvaṃ trātāram indraṃ savitāram indraṃ sureśaṃ śaśāṅkaṃ śaṅkaraṃ śaṅkhaśatruṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ susenam asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantu |
trātāram indrendriyakāraṇātmā
jagatpradhānaṃ ca hiraṇyagarbham |
lokeśvaraṃ devavaraṃ vareṇyam
ānandanityaṃ praṇato 'smi nityam ||
evaṃ devavarasya kīrttanair
mahātmanas tridaśapateḥ susaṃyataḥ |
avāpya kāmān manaso'bhirāmān
svargāl lokān āyāti ca dehabhedaiḥ ||
varāhasaṃhitāyām |
saṃpūraṇe vocchrayaṇe praveśe
snānaṃ yathā mālyavidhau visarje |
paṭhed imān nṛpatiḥ sopavāso (?)
mantrāḥ śubhāḥ puruhūtasya ketoḥ ||
saṃpūraṇaṃ patākāropaṇaṃ tatra viśeṣamantraś ca |
harārka vaivasvata śakra somair
dhaneśa vaiśvānara pāram ṛgbhiḥ ||
maharṣisaṅghaiḥ sadigapsarobhiḥ
śukrāṅgiraskandamarudgaṇaiś ca |
[419]        yathārjapūjyas karataikarūpaiḥ
samarthitaś cābharaṇair udāraiḥ ||
tatheha tāny ābharaṇāni deva
śubhāni saṃprītamanā gṛhāṇa |
iti śakradhvajochāyavidhiḥ |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi pañcamūrtivrataṃ tava |
saṃvatsaraḥ smṛto vahnis tathārkaparivatsaraḥ ||
iṣṭāpūrtas tathā somo anupūrvaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
utpūrvaś ca tathā prokto devadevo maheśvaraḥ ||
teṣāṃ maṇḍalavinyāsaḥ prāgvad eva vidhīyate |
prāgvad iti nīlaśvetaraktaśvetapītakṛṣṇakaiḥ maṇḍalavinyāsāḥ kartavyāḥ |
prāgvat prapūjanaṃ kāryaṃ homaḥ kāryas tathā vidhiḥ |
tilair vrīhiyavaiś caiva ghṛtena sitasarṣapaiḥ ||
talliṅgai rathakāmantrair nāmabhiḥ pratyahaṃ kramāt |
naktāśanas tathā tiṣṭhet prāgvad divasapañcakam ||
caitraśuklaṃ samārabhya pañcamīprabhṛti kramāt |
saṃvatsarākhye varṣe tu vratam etat samācaret ||
pūjāvasāne dātavyāḥ suvarṇāḥ pañca (?) yādava |
caturvedavide deyaṃ śākhābhedena yādava ||
ekaikaṃ pañcamaṃ deyaṃ tathā kālavido bhavet |
[420]        yatheṣṭaṃ lokam āpnoti kāmacārī vihaṅgamaḥ ||
vratenānena dharmajñaḥ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
mānuṣya māsādya bhavaty arogo
vareṇa rūpeṇa balena yuktaḥ |
nṛpapratāpānvitaśatrusaṅgho
dvijottamo vā bahuyajñayājī ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ saṃvatsaravratam |
brahmovāca |
bhūyas te saṃpravakṣyāmi devyārādhanam uttamam |
yat kṛtvā sarvakāmānāṃ prāptis tṛptir bhaviṣyati ||
dantidantamayair daṇḍair hemabandhaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
vicitrapadmarāgādyair maṇibhis tu suśobhitam ||
tathā taiḥ kārayed devyāḥ sārvabhaumaṃ manoramam |
dukūlavastrasaṃchannam ardhacandropaśobhitam ||
ghaṇṭākiṅkiṇiśobhāḍhyaṃ darpaṇair upaśobhitam |
taṃ rathaṃ pūjayec chakra jātīkusumamallikaiḥ (?) ||
pārijātakapuṣpaiś ca yakṣakardamacandanaiḥ |
sugandhidhūpitaṃ kṛtvā devīṃ tatra niveśayet ||
pratimāṃ śobhanāṃ vatsa mahādaityakṣayaṃkarīṃ |
pūjayed rathavinyastāṃ vinyastāṃ sarvamaṅgalām ||
durgā kātyāyanī devī varadā vindhyavāsinī |
[421]        niśumbhaśumbhamathanī mahiṣāsuravimardinī ||
umā kṣamāvatī mātā śaṅkarasyārdhakāyinī |
prasīdatu sadā me 'stu yac ca no vāñchitaṃ hṛdi ||
anena balipūrveṇa namaskārayutena (?) ca |
pūjayitvā tato rājā samantād vyāpya gītakaiḥ ||
pañcamīsaptamīpūrṇā navamyekādaśīṣu ca |
tṛtīyāśivavighneśadivaseṣūtsaveṣu ca ||
mahānadīvanotsaṅgaparvataśravaṇeṣu ca |
tatra maṇḍapavinyāsaṃ mahadiṣṭakanirmitam ||
śailaṃ vā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi kṛtvā vāstuvibhāgavit |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitām |
pūrve ca kārayec chakraṃ paścād yātrāṃ samārabhet ||
mahājanapadopetāṃ mahāstrīsaṅghasaṅkulām |
sarvānnapānanaivedyaiḥ samastair apu pūjayet ||
dadyāc ca digbaliṃ śakra pūrvadiṣu samaṃ tataḥ |
bhūtavetālasaṅghasya mantreṇānena suvrata ||
jayatvaṃ kālikā bhūte sarvabhūtasamāvṛtā |
rakṣa māṃ nijabhūtebhyo baliṃ gṛhṇa sadā priyam ||
mātar mātar vare durge sarvakāmaprasādhani |
anena balidānena sarvān kāmān prayaccha me ||
evaṃ datvā baliṃ śakra tathā devyāvatārayet |
[422]        vinyased bhadrapīṭhe tu maṇḍalair upaśobhitām ||
tatrasthāṃ prāpayed devīṃ hemarūpyaiś ca tāmrajaiḥ |
kalaśair aṣṭasahasreṇa gandhodakasupūritaiḥ ||
samastaphalasaṃpūrṇair yājñiyair atha pallavaiḥ |
snāpayed ekabhaktena ratnagarbhair navair dṛḍhaiḥ ||
vedamaṅgalaśabdena śaṅkhavāditranisvanaiḥ |
veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṅgaiś ca ghaṇṭākiṅkiṇirāvitaiḥ ||
snāpayitvā tato devīṃ nirmañched varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
nirmañchen naroyajet (?) |
gomayādikṛtaiḥ padmaiḥ dīpavartyādiboditaiḥ |
svastikair nandikāvartaiḥ śaṅkhair nīlotpalodajaiḥ ||
yavaśālyaṅkuradbhinnair yavacārair nimanthayet ||
udajaiḥ kamalaiḥ | yavacārair yavatṛṇaiḥ |
pratyekaṃ tu dahed dhūpaṃ pratyekaṃ kalaśaṃ snapet |
tathā karpūrakṣodena candanakuṅkumena (?) ca ||
gorocanāsametena devīm ālipya pūjayet |
hemajair jātimālyaiś ca ratnanyāsair anekadhā ||
vāsobhiḥ sumanobhiś ca pādadvayaṃ samutkṣipet |
vastrapuṣpopari caṃkramaṇaṃ kārayed ity arthaḥ |
dakṣayec ca tathā kanyādvijān dīnāndhaduḥkhitān |
bhakṣyabhojyānnapānena tatra sarvāś ca prīṇayet ||
bhojayitvā kṣamāpayed devī me prīyatām iti |
[423]        tathā devīṃ rathe kṛtvā punar eva gṛhaṃ nayet ||
mahatā janasaṅghena samastavibhavānvitaiḥ |
sāntareṇa rathaṃ sarvaṃ puṣpadūrvākṣatair (?) jalaiḥ |
prakṣipyamāṇaiḥ kanyābhis strībhir maṅgalavādibhiḥ ||
salilena pathe pāṃśuṃ kṛtvā pañca tataḥ kramāt |
puraśobhāṃ pathaḥ śobhāṃ dvāraśobhāṃ gṛhe gṛhe ||
kārayīta tathā śakra sarvabādhāṃ nivārayet |
acchedyās taravas tasmin prāṇihiṃsāṃ vivarjayet ||
bandhanasthāś ca moktavyā vadhyāḥ krodhādiśatravaḥ |
akāle kaumudīṃ śakra rathayātrāṃ tu kārayet ||
akāle kaumudīṃ dīpotsavaḥ | tasminn akāle kuryād ity arthaḥ |
sarvadā sarvadevais tu śaṅkarādyaiḥ pratiṣṭhitā |
rathayātrā tathā śakra suraiḥ svarge sadā kṛtā ||
tathā kinnaragandharvair bhūpātālanivāsibhiḥ |
rathayātrā prabhāvena modate divi devatā ||
ādityai ratharājendra rathena nabhasaḥ kramet |
devādityā vimānasthā rathayātrāprabhāvataḥ ||
krīḍante vividhair bhogaiḥ sarvātaṅkavivarjitāḥ |
tathā tvam api devendra rathayātrākaro (?) bhava ||
śivāyā śivadāyās tu parameṇa samādhinā |
agastya uvāca |
rathayātrāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ brahmaṇā vāsavasya tu |
[424]        pūrvavat kathitaṃ tāta tat te sarve mayākhilam ||
sthāpitaṃ nātra saṃdeho devīmāhātmyam uttamam |
yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād vāpi bhaktimān nṛpasattama ||
sa sukhaṃ yaśaḥ saubhāgyaṃ putraprāptim abhīpsitām |
labhate nātra saṃdeha ity eva brāhmaṇo 'bravīt ||
suvalena hite rājye purā śakrasya kīrtitā |
dhanadasya purīprāptir varuṇasya ca vāyunā ||
hate sthāne kṛtā tena tathā śrutvā ca nairṛte |
bhuñjate parayā tuṣṭyā purīṃ nāgavatīṃ śubhām ||
iti devīpurāṇoktā rathayātrā |
rudra uvāca |
rathayātrā kathaṃ kāryā bhāskarasyeha mānavaiḥ |
phalaṃ ca kiṃ bhavet teṣāṃ yātrāṃ kurvanti yatra vai ||
vidhinā kena kartavyā kasmin kāle surottama |
kathaṃ ca bhrāmayed devaṃ rathārūḍhaṃ divākaram ||
devasyemaṃ rathaṃ bhaktyā bhrāmayanti dadanti ca |
teṣāṃ kiṃ ca phalaṃ proktaṃ ye ca kṛtyakarā narāḥ ||
bhramantam arcayanty enaṃ nṛtyagītaparā narāḥ |
prajāgaraṃ ca kurvanti bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitāḥ ||
[425]        teṣāṃ ca kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ rathaṃ yacchanti ye raveḥ |
varṣabhaktaṃ ca yo bhaktyā daśakāni ca bhojanam ||
varṣabhaktaṃ dhānyodanaṃ daṃśakāni khādyāni |
etan me brūhi nikhilaṃ suraśreṣṭha suvistaram |
lokānāṃ śreyase deva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ tu me ||
brahmovāca |
sādhu pṛṣṭo 'si bhūteśa gaṇeśeśa trilocana |
śṛṇuṣyaikamanā (?) vacmi yathāpṛṣṭaṃ suvistaram |
devasya rathayātraiṣā bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ |
indrotsavas tathā rudra matau hy etau samau yataḥ |
martyaloke śāntihetor lokāloka prapūjitau ||
pravartete imau tasmin deśe deśe mahotsavau |
imau indradhvajaravirathau |
na tatropadravāḥ santi rājataskarasaṃbhavāḥ |
tasmāt kāryāv imau bhaktyā durbhikṣasyopaśāntaye ||
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ māsi mārgaśire hara |
ghṛtenābhyañjayed devaṃ pañca bhūtān yajeta vai ||
abhyañjayed graheśaṃ yaḥ sarpiṣā śraddhayānvitaḥ |
dine dine jagannāthapraviṣṭaṃ varṇake ravim ||
varṇake udvartanagṛhe |
sa gacched yānam ārūḍho gairikaṃ kiṅkiṇīvṛtam |
[426]        vaiśvānarapuraṃ divyaṃ gandharvāpsaraśobhitam ||
śālyodanaṃ khaṇḍamiśraṃ bahuvajrasamanvitam |
vajrasamanvitaṃ ājyasamanvitam ity arthaḥ |
varṇabhaktaṃ prayacched yo bhāskarāya dine dine |
ārūḍhaḥ sadvimānaṃ tu dhvajamālākulaṃ śubham |
gacchen mama puraṃ deva stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena bhāskarasya naraiḥ saha ||
varṇabhaktaṃ pradātavyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyeha varṇakam |
ghṛtapūrṇāṃ khaṇḍaveṣṭāṃ kāsāraṃ modakāṃś ca yaḥ ||
dadhyodanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca saṃyāvaṃ guḍapūpakān |
ye prayacchanti devasya bhāskarasyeha varṇakam ||
te gacchanti na saṃdeho narā vai mandiraṃ mama |
ahany ahani yo bhaktyā bhāskarāya prayacchati ||
abhyaṅgāya ghṛtaṃ deva sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
tathā yo varṇabhaktaṃ ca ahany ahani bhaktitaḥ ||
saṃprāpyeha śubhān kāmān gacchet so 'pi mamālayam |
cūrṇam udvartanaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ prayacchec chubhaṃ raveḥ ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ |
tatas taṃ tarpayed devaṃ pauṣe māsi vidhānataḥ ||
saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya śṛṇuṣvaikamanā yathā |
tīrthodakaṃ samānīya anyad vātha jalaṃ śubham ||
[427]        vedoktena vidhānena pratimāṃ snāpayed budhaḥ |
japed dhi tīrthanāmāni manasā saṃsmaran budhaḥ ||
prayāgaṃ puskaraṃ caiva kurukṣetraṃ sanaimiṣam |
pṛthūdakaṃ bhadravaṭaṃ somaṃ gokarṇam eva ca ||
brahmāvartaṃ kuśāvartaṃ bilvakaṃ nīlaparvatam |
gaṅgādvāraṃ tathā puṇyaṃ gaṅgāsāgaram eva ca ||
kālasūryaṃ mitravanaṃ muṇḍīrasvāminaṃ tathā |
cakratīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ tathā śivam ||
gaṅgāsarasvatīsindhucandrabhāgāḥ sanarmadāḥ |
vipāśā yamunā tāpī śivā vaitravatī tathā ||
godāvarī payoṣṇī ca kṛṣṇaveṇī tathā nadī |
śatarudrā puṣkariṇī kauśikī sarayūs tathā ||
tathānye sāgarāś caiva sāṃnidhyaṃ kalpayantv iti |
tathāśramāḥ puṇyatamā divyāny āyatanāni ca ||
evaṃ snānavidhiṃ kṛtvā arcayitvā praṇamya ca |
dhūpam arghyaṃ pradatvā tu pratimām adhivāsayet ||
trirātraṃ saptarātraṃ vā māsārdhaṃ māsam eva ca |
sthitasthānaṃ gṛhe devaṃ bhojayed bhaktito naraḥ ||
tatas tv āropayed vediṃ caturasrāṃ suveṣṭitāṃ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya saptamyāṃ tripurāntaka ||
kṛtvāgnikāryaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
śaṅkhabherīninādaiś ca brahmaghoṣaiś ca puṣkalaiḥ ||
[428]        puṇyāhaghoṣair vividhair brāhmaṇasvastivācanaiḥ |
tato 'sya kārayed yātrāṃ śāntihetor janasya ca ||
rathena darśanīyena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā |
suṅlapakṣe tu māghasya ratham ārohayed ravim ||
kṛtvāgnikāryaṃ vidhivat tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
prīṇayitvā janaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣiṇābhojanādinā ||
prapūjya brāhmaṇān divyān homāṃś cāpi savācakān |
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vācakā brāhmaṇottamāḥ ||
mato devaś ca dṛṣṭaś ca saṃpūjyo 'yaṃ tataḥ sadā |
mādhasya śuklapakṣasya caturthyām ekabhojanam ||
ayācitaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam |
saptamyām upavāsas tu aṣṭamyāṃ rohayed ravim ||
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rathasya purataḥ śiva |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu rātrau bhūteśa rathasyehādhivāsanam ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu divyān bhaumāṃś ca vācakān |
ratham āropayed devaṃ saptamyāṃ bhūtabhāvanam |
sitāyāṃ māghamāsasya tasya devālayāgrataḥ ||
tatrasthasyaiva devasya kuryād rātrau prajāgaram |
nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakair dīpavṛkṣopaśobhitaiḥ ||
śaṅkhatūryaninādaiś ca brahmadyoṣaiś ca puṣkalaiḥ |
kuryāt prajāgaraṃ tasya devasya purato niśi ||
[429]        tato 'ṣṭamyām āyatanaṃ devaṃ rathagataṃ nayet ||
nagarasyottaraṃ dvāraṃ śaṅkhabherīnināditam |
tataḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ ca dvāraṃ vāpi tathāparam ||
evaṃ hi kriyamāṇāyāṃ yātrāyāṃ vatsarāvadheḥ |
mānavāḥ sukham edhante rājā jayati vāhinīm ||
nīrujaś ca janāḥ sarve gavāṃ śāntir bhavet tathā |
kartāraś cāpi yātrāyāḥ svargabhājo bhavanti hi ||
voḍhāraś ca tathā rudra sūryaloke vrajanti vai |
rudra uvāca |
kathaṃ ca cālyate brahman sthāpitā prathamāsakṛt |
evaṃ no vada deveśa sumahān saṃśayo 'tra me ||
brahmovāca |
pūrvam eva sahasrāṃśor yānaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ |
saṃvatsarasyāvayavaiḥ kalpitasya ratho mayā ||
sarveṣāṃ tu rathānāṃ vai sa rathaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tatas tv anye syandanā viśvakarmaṇā ||
kalpitāḥ sarvadevānāṃ somādīnām anekaśaḥ |
viśvakarmakṛtaṃ prāpya rathaṃ devena śaṅkara ||
pūjātham ātmano datto mānave krodhasaṃbhavaḥ |
maunekṣvākave datto martyaiḥ saṃpūjyate raviḥ ||
atas tu rathayānena cālanaṃ vihitaṃ raveḥ |
tasmān na cālane doṣaḥ savituḥ śūladhāraṇa ||
[430]        tasmād rathena paryeti bhāskaraḥ pṛthivīm imām |
gacchan na tiṣṭhate caitan maṇḍalaṃ savituḥ sadā ||
pradiṣṭaṃ calate yasmāt tasmād vai cālanaṃ smṛtam |
tad evaṃ rathayātrāsu dṛḍhaṃ bhānor manīṣibhiḥ ||
anyeṣāṃ cālanaṃ neṣṭaṃ devānāṃ pārvatīpriya |
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sthāpitānāṃ vidhānataḥ ||
tasmād rathena devasya yātrā kāryā vidhānataḥ |
prajānām iha śāntyarthaṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ sadā ||
kāñcano vātha raupyo vā dṛḍhadārumayātha vā |
dṛḍhākṣayugacakraś ca tathā kāryaḥ suyantritaḥ (?) ||
yasmin rathavaraśreṣṭhe kalpite sumanorame |
āropya pratimāṃ yatnād yojayed vājinaḥ śubhān ||
karīn lakṣaṇasaṃpannān sumukhān vaśavartinaḥ |
kuṅkumena samālabhya cāmarasragvibhūṣitān ||
sadaśvān pūjayitvā tu dhvajamālyānulepanaiḥ |
āhārair vividhaiś cāpi bhojayitvā dvijottamān ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇādīṃś ca sarvān saṃtarpya śaktitaḥ |
na kaṃcid dvimukhaṃ (?) kuryād uttamādhamamadhyamam ||
sūryakratau savitata evam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
yaḥ prayāti hi bhagnāśaḥ kṣudhārto vyādhipīḍitaḥ ||
sa dātur hi pitṝṃs tena svargasthān api pātayet |
[431]        yajñaś ca dakṣiṇāhīnaḥ savitur na praśasyate ||
tasmān nānāvidhaiḥ kāmair bhakṣyalehyasamanvitaiḥ |
prīṇayitvā phalaṃ sarvam imam uccārayed ravim ||
baliṃ gṛhṇantu me devāḥ ādityā vasavas tathā |
maruto 'thāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ ||
asurā yātudhānāś ca rathasthā yāś ca devatāḥ |
ākṛṣṇena rajasā ṛcam etām udāharet ||
tataḥ puṇyāhaśabdena kṛtavāditranisvanaiḥ |
rathaprabhramaṇaṃ kuryād vartmanā sa samena tu ||
puruṣaiś cāpi voḍhavyaḥ sūryabhaktisamanvitaiḥ |
sukṛtapragrahair dānair balivardair athāpi vā |
yathā praśamanaṃ dadyād viṣame pathi gacchataḥ ||
upavāsasthitair viprair divyair bhogaiś ca suvrataiḥ |
viṃśadbhiḥ ṣoḍaśair vāpi pratimāṃ bhāskarasya tu ||
snāyāt pracānyate rudra ratham āropayec chanaiḥ |
rājñī ca nikṣubhā rudra bhāryā tasya mahātmanaḥ ||
śanair āropayet tatra ubhayoḥ pārśvayorathai |
nikṣubhā dakṣiṇe pārśve rājñī vāpy uttare tathā ||
dvāre ca brāhmaṇau tasmin divyau bhaumaś ca pārśvayoḥ |
brahmā cāsya tathā somaḥ kūberasyoparisthitaḥ ||
garuḍaṃ pṛṣṭhataś cāsya kalpyamānaṃ prakalpayet |
ātapatraṃ tathā śvetaṃ svargadaṇḍam anūpamam ||
[432]        suvarṇabindubhiś citraṃ maṇimuktāphalolvalam |
tatas tv indradhanuḥprakhyaṃ svarṇadaṇḍam athāparam ||
dhvajaṃ prakalpayet tasya patākābhir alaṃkṛtam |
nānāvarṇavicitrābhiḥ saptabhiḥ kāmanāśana ||
dhvajopari varavyoma mukārādhiṣṭhitaṃ mahat |
rathyāsu saṃgato vipo (?) nayed rathavaraṃ raveḥ ||
rathyārūḍhaṃ tu kuryād vai śreyo'rthaṃ cātmanaḥ sadā |
nārohet tad rathaṃ śūdro yadīcchet śreyātmanaḥ (?) ||
ratham ārohatas tasya kṣayaṃ gacchati santatiḥ |
sa ratho devadevasya voḍhavyo brāhmaṇaiḥ sadā ||
kṣatriyaiś caiva vaiśyaiś ca na ca śūdraiḥ kadācana |
ye tv anyadevatā bhaktā ye ca madyapravartakāḥ ||
na taiḥ śūdraiś ca voḍavyaḥ tair naraiś ca madoddhataiḥ |
upavāsasamopetair voḍhavyaḥ pārvatīpriya |
svasthānāc cālito rudra pūrvadvāraṃ vrajeta vai ||
dinam ekaṃ vaset tatra pūjyamāno nṛpeṇa tu |
nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakaiḥ purāṇaśravaṇena ca ||
nānāvidhair brahmaghoṣair brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ |
sthitvā ca aṣṭamīṃ tatra navamyāṃ cālayet tataḥ ||
vrajet tu dakṣiṇaṃ dvāraṃ nagarasya trilocana |
tatrāpi dinam ekaṃ tu tiṣṭhate tripurāntaka ||
kṣatriyaiḥ pūjyamānas tu tathā rājā tathaiva taiḥ |
[433]        tataḥ paraṃ vrajet tasya paścimaṃ dvāram āśu vai ||
tatrāpi dinam ekaṃ tu tiṣṭhate madhusūdana ||
kṣatretaraiḥ pūjyamāno yathā rājā tathā nṛpaiḥ |
tasmād api cared rudradvāraṃ yāyāt tathottaram ||
tathāpi pūjyaḥ śūdraiś tu vidhivat priyadarśanaiḥ |
tasmāt tu cālayed rudra vrajen madhyaṃ purasya tu ||
tatrasthaṃ pūjayanty enaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ |
śaṅkhavāditranirghoṣais tathā prekṣaṇakair varaiḥ ||
brahmaghoṣaiś ca vividhaiḥ samantād dīpavṛkṣakaiḥ |
nānāvidhair vittadānair brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāthatarpaṇais tripurāntaka |
puramadhyāt tu calitas tiṣṭhet prāpya svamandiram ||
itthaṃ prāpya sthitaṃ devaṃ purato mandirasya tu |
tataḥ sthitaḥ pūjanīyo bhavet paureṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
pūjyamānas tv ahorātraṃ rathārūḍhas tu tiṣthati |
pare dine vrajet snānaṃ taṃ nirantaram ādarāt ||
trayodaśyām atītāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ trilocana |
sadaiva bhrāmayed devaṃ graheśaṃ duritāpaham ||
parivārakṛtaṃ rudraṃ sānugaṃ parameśvaram |
rudra uvāca |
kathaṃ pracālayed brahman rathasthaṃ tam anāśanam |
[434]        anugāṃś ca kathaṃ cāsya keśavam anugakramāt ||
bhūyo bhūyaḥ suraśreṣṭha vistarān mama śreyase |
veda sarvajagannātha paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ||
brahmovāca |
śanaiḥ pracālayed rudra vartmanā śobhanena tu |
tathā na tasya bhaṅgaḥ syād viṣame pathi gacchataḥ ||
pratihāraṃ rathaṃ pūrvaṃ nayen mārgaviśuddhaye |
tasmād anantaraṃ rudra daṇḍanāyakam ādarāt |
piṅgalaṃ ca tatas tasya pṛṣṭhagaṃ cādarān nayet ||
purato dvāratas tasmāt rathārūḍhas tu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
rathārūḍhas tathā daṇḍidevasya purataḥ sthitaḥ ||
tasmād api tathā rudra lekhako bhāskarapriyaḥ |
śanaiḥ śanair nayed rudra rathaṃ devasya helinaḥ ||
rathasya cakrabhaṅgī vā yathā na syāt trilocana |
īṣābhaṅge dvijabhayamakṣe (?) tu nṛpatikṣayaḥ ||
tulālābhe tu vaiśyānāṃ śamyāṃ śūdrabhayaṃ vrajet |
yugabhaṅge tv anāvṛṣṭiḥ pīṭhabhaṅge prajābhayam ||
paracakrāgamaṃ vidyāc cakrabhaṅge rathasya tu |
dhvajasya patane cāpi pitṛmanyuṃ vinirdiśet ||
pratimādyaṅgikāyāṃ tu rājño maraṇam ādiśet |
utpanneṣv evam ādyeṣu utpāteṣu śubheṣu ca ||
[435]        balikarma budhaḥ kuryāc chāntihomaṃ tathaiva ca |
gobhyaḥ śāntiḥ prajābhyaś ca jagataḥ śāntir astu vai ||
sve sve cāstu tathā śāntiḥ sarvatrāstu tathā raveḥ |
tvaṃ deva jagataḥ sraṣṭā poṣṭā caiva tvam eva hi ||
prajāpālin graheśāna śāntiṃ kuru divaspate |
idam anyac ca vakṣyāmi śāntyāḥ paramakāraṇam ||
yat tu kāraṇabhūtasya puruṣasya svajanmanaḥ |
duṣṭān grahāṃś ca vijñāya tryahaśāntiṃ samācaret ||
evaṃ kṛtvā prajāśāntiṃ kṛtvā sa svastivācanam |
punaḥ sajjaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt prakramaṇaṃ hara ||
mārgaśeṣaṃ nayitvā tu nayed devālayaṃ ravim |
pūjayitvā tataḥ sarvāḥ śāstroktā atha devatāḥ ||
yathā pūjyāḥ grahāḥ sarve uktās te ca trilocana |
rathadevās tathā pūjyā yā sthitā ratham āśritāḥ ||
kṣīraṃ yavāgūṃ mama vai paramānnaṃ taveśvara |
phalāni kārttike yasya dadyād bhūteśaprītaye ||
vivasvate paśumāṃsaṃ tathā madyaṃ sureśvara |
puruhūtāya bhakṣyāṇi sānugāya nivedayet ||
haviṣyam agnaye dadyād vajrānnaṃ viṣṇave tathā |
rākṣasebhyaḥ samaṃ deyaṃ dadyān māṃsodanaṃ hara ||
saṃskṛtaṃ piśitānnaṃ tu revantāya nivedayet |
tilānnaṃ pitṛrājāya dadyāt tripurasūdana ||
[436]        aśvinābhyām apūpāṃs tu vasubhyo māṃsam odanam |
pitṛbhyaḥ pāyasaṃ dadyāt ghṛtāktaṃ madhunā saha ||
kātyāyanyai yavāgūṃś ca śriyai dadyāt tathā dadhi |
sarasvatyai trimadhuraṃ varuṇāyekṣurasaudanam ||
khāṇḍavānāṃ dhanapatau tava mitre trilocana |
sasnehena tu takreṇa marudbhyas tarpaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
māṣān apūpān mātṛbhyo bhaktyā tu vinivedayet |
ullopikāś ca bhūtebhyo jalaṃ svargāya vai hara ||
dadyād gaṇapatau vidvān modakāṃs tripurāntaka |
śaṣkulīnair ṛtendrāya deyā syād gaṇanāyaka |
sarvabhakṣyāṇi viśvebhyo dātavyāni samantataḥ ||
kṣīrodanaṃ ṛṣibhyas tu kṣīraṃ nāgebhya eva ca |
sūryarathāya ca baliṃ kuryād vai sārvabhautikam ||
māṃsodanaṃ (?) surām ājyaṃ tad vahebhyaś ca śaṅkara |
pūpān ājyayutān dadyāt tubhyaṃ rudra tilāṃs tathā ||
svāhāsutāya lājāś ca dātavyās tripurāntaka |
bhāskarāya sadā dadyāt suradāru trilocana ||
rājavṛkṣaṃ surendrāya haviṣyaṃ pāvakāya ca |
cakriṇe saptadhānyaṃ tu māṃsam ājyaṃ subhūṣaṇa ||
yakṣebhyo vividhān gandhān niryāso vaitasoṇḍajeḥ (?) |
baikaṃkatī sadā rudra yamāya parikīrtitā ||
[437]        deyaṃ syāt karṇikāraṃ tu aśvibhyāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja |
śriyai deyāni padmāni candrikāyai tu candanam ||
navanītaṃ sarasvatyai vinatāyai tathāmiṣam |
puṣpāṇy apsarasāṃ rudra mālatyāḥ parikīrtayet ||
varuṇāyāgnim itthaṃ tu phalamūlaṃ tu nairṛteḥ |
bilvaṃ dadyāt kuberāya kapitthaṃ marutāṃ tathā ||
gandharvebhyaś cārugandhaṃ dadyāt tripurasūdana |
vasubhyaś cārukarpūraṃ dadyāc cānugaṇādhipe ||
pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍamūlāni bhūtebhyaś ca vibhītakam |
gobhyo yavān pradadyād vai mātṛbhyas tv akṣatān hara ||
guggulaṃ vighnapataye viśvebhyo deyam odanam |
ṛṣibhyo brahmavṛkṣaṃ tu nāgebhyo viṣam uttamam ||
bhāskarasyeha deyāni saṃkalpāni narādhipa |
madhusarpirbhyāṃ tathāktāni gaurikasya trilocana ||
nyagrodas tasya bāhubhyo bhaktyā rudre nivedayet |
sāyaṃ prātaś ca madhyāhne sadaikāgramanā hara ||
sarveṣāṃ bhaktitaḥ śaktyā dehe rūpaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
mantrato devaśārdūla yo yasyeha prakīrtitaḥ ||
śāntyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyas tu tilān dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
vaiśvānare yavān juhuyād ghṛtena sahitān naraḥ ||
devānām amṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ pitṝṇāṃ hi svadhāmṛtam |
śaraṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sadā hy etān vidur budhāḥ |
kaśyapasyāṅgajā hy ete pavitrāś ca tathā hara ||
[438]        snāne dāne tathā home tarpaṇe hy aśane varāḥ |
itthaṃ devān grahāṃś caiva pūjayed eva prayatnataḥ ||
avatārya rathāc cainaṃ sthāpayen maṇḍale punaḥ |
kṛtvā trirātrikaṃ yatnād dīpatoyaphalākṣataiḥ ||
kārpāsabījalavaṇajhasaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tu śāntaye |
vedīm āropayet paścāt patnībhyām saha suvrata ||
tatrasthaṃ pūjayed devaṃ dināni daśa suvrata |
dāśāhiketi vikhyātā yā bhūtā bhūtale hara ||
tayā saṃpūjayed deva caturthena kṛto bhava |
caturthe 'hani kartavyaṃ yatnād viśramaṇaṃ raveḥ ||
abhyaṅgabhojanādyaiś ca pūjāsatkāramaṇḍalaiḥ |
anena vidhinā pūjya daśāhāni divākaram |
tato nayed varaṃ sthānaṃ yatra pūrvaṃ sadācalam ||
anena vidhinā yas tu kuryād vā kārayīta vā |
yātrāṃ bhagavato bhaktyā bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ ||
sa parārdhaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate |
kule na jāyate tasya daridro vyādhito 'pi vā ||
abhyaṅgāya ghṛtaṃ yas tu bhāskarāya prayacchati |
kṛtvā suvarṇatilakaṃ sa gacchet surabhīpuram ||
tīrthodakaṃ tu yo dadyād gaṅgāyāś ca tathodakam |
snānārtham ānayed yas tu bhāskarāya trilocana ||
saṃprāpyehākhilān kāmān prāpnuyād varuṇālayam |
bhaktavarṇaṃ tu yo dadyād haviṣyānnaṃ guḍodanam ||
[439]        gacchet surapuraṃ bhadraṃ yatra devaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
snāpayed yas tu vai bhaktyā bhāskaraṃ pūjayet tathā ||
sa gacched dīptimān rudra sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
ratham āropayed yas tu rathamārgaṃ pramārjati ||
sa yāti sūryasālokyaṃ vāyutulyaparākramaḥ |
rathasya gacchato yas tu mārge kuryāc ca maṅgalam ||
sa lokaṃ prāpnuyāt puṇyaṃ marutāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ |
sūryasya gacchato bhaktyā yaḥ kuryān mārgam ādarāt ||
puṣpaprakaraśobhāḍhyaṃ śubhatoraṇamaṇḍitam |
śaṅhatūryaninādāḍhyaṃ tathā prekṣaṇakānvitam ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo vibhāvasuḥ |
devena sahito yas tu nṛtyan gāyan tathā svayam ||
sarvaṃ mahotsavaṃ bhaktyā bhāskaraṃ bhaktavatsalam |
atha saṃvatsaraṃ prāpte bhānor yatra dinodaye ||
rathaprakramaṇaṃ tatra na kathaṃcit kṛtaṃ bhavet |
tato dvādaśame varṣe kartavyaṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
indravajrasya capy evaṃ yaddine yajanaṃ kṛtam |
tato dvādaśame varṣe kartavyā nāntarā punaḥ ||
yātrāyāṃ cāpi te bhaṅgaṃ kurvate vṛṣabhadhvaja |
mandehā nāmato jñeyā rākṣasā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
ye kurvanti tathā yātrāṃ narā dharmadhvajasya tu |
indrādidevatā jñeyā gatāś ca paramaṃ padam ||
[440]        ity eṣā kathitā bhadra rathayātrā divaspateḥ |
yaḥ śrutvā vācayitvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
śrutvā ca vidhivad bhaktyā yānti sūryasado narāḥ |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto rathayātrotsavaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
ekādaśyāṃ māghamāse caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca |
ekabhaktena yo dadyāt celakāny arjunāni ca ||
upānahau kambalaṃ ca chatraṃ citraṃ tathodakam |
karapātrādikaṃ vatsa yathāśaktyārthine nṛpa ||
ārttatrāṇaparo nityam aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
etat saukhyavrataṃ nāma ārttatrāṇakaraṃ param ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ saukhyavratam |
nārada uvāca |
śrutā mayā vidhānoktā viṣṇor ārādhanakriyā |
tvatprasādāt suraśreṣṭha janmaduḥkhajayapradā ||
bhūyo 'tha śrotum icchāmi samyak pūjāphalapradā |
alpagranthena deveśa mahāpuṇyaphalapradam ||
pavitrārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇubhaktisamanvitaiḥ |
kiṃ phalaṃ prāpyate deva narais tadgatamānasaiḥ ||
[441]        yasmin kāle ca kartavyaṃ vidhānaṃ ca tathā bhavet |
tithau yasyāṃ yathāsūtraṃ pramāṇaṃ ca yathāvidhi ||
yāvantas tatavas (?) tasmin tatra yac cānumantraṇam |
tattvanyāsavidhānaṃ tu tathā caivādhivāsanam ||
ārohaṇavidhānaṃ ca upavītasya cakriṇaḥ |
visarjanavidhānaṃ tu pavitrārohaṇādikam ||
kiṃ kṛtvā phalam āpnoti hīyate kim akurvataḥ |
etat sarvaṃ samācakṣva vidhānaṃ tridaśeśvara ||
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu vatsa paraṃ guhyaṃ vidhānaṃ devanirmitam |
mayā śrutaṃ purā samyak sakāśāc cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
pavitrārohaṇaṃ viṣṇor bhuktimuktipradāyakam |
āyuḥ kīrtir yaśo nṝṇāṃ sukhasaṃvardhanāvaham ||
puṇyānāṃ tu yathā puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham |
pavitrārohaṇaṃ tasmāt pavitraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ||
saṃvatsaraṃ naro bhaktyā samabhyarcya janārdanam |
yat phalaṃ samavāpnoti pavitrārohaṇena tu ||
na karoti vidhānena pavitrārohaṇaṃ tu yaḥ |
tasya sāṃvatasrī pūjā niṣkalā munisattama ||
tasmād bhaktisamāyuktair narair viṣṇuparāyaṇaiḥ |
varṣe varṣe prakartavyaṃ pavitrārohaṇaṃ hareḥ ||
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe karkaṭasthe (?) divākare |
[442]        dvādaśyāṃ vāsudevasya pavitrārohaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
siṃhasthe vā ravau kāryaṃ kanyāyāṃ tu gate 'tha vā |
tasyām eva tithau samyak tulāsthe na kathaṃcana ||
viṣṇo rudrasya sūryasya viriñceḥ ṣaṇmukhasya ca |
devyā gaṇādhināthasya mātṝṇāṃ dhanadasya ca ||
pavitrārohaṇaṃ kāryam anyeṣāṃ ca yathāvidhi |
akṛtvā phalahāniḥ syāt saṃvatsarakṛtārcanāt ||
sarveṣāṃ tu mahat puṇyaṃ pavitrārohaṇe kṛte |
tithayas tvattvavinyāsāḥ pṛthag uktās tapodhana ||
pratipaddhanadasyoktā pavitrārohaṇe sthitiḥ |
trayo devā dvitīyāṃ tu tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
tṛtīyā tu bhavānyās tu caturthī tatsutasya tu |
pañcamī somarājasya ṣaṣṭhī proktā guhasya ca ||
saptamī bhāskare proktā durgāyāś cāṣṭamī smṛtā |
mātṝṇāṃ navamī proktā daśamī vāsukeḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ekādaśī ṛṣīṇāṃ tu dvādaśī cakrapāṇinaḥ |
trayodaśī by anaṅgasya śivasyoktā caturdaśī ||
mama deva muniśreṣṭha paurṇamāsī tithiḥ smṛtā |
yathoktāḥ śuklapakṣe tu tithayaḥ śrāvaṇasya ca |
sarveṣām eva devānāṃ kāryaṃ tāsu yathāvidhi ||
nārada uvāca |
kasmin sūtre tu kartavyaṃ pavitraṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ |
[443]        pramāṇaṃ caiva tantūnāṃ puṇyaṃ caiveha kīdṛśam ||
kaniṣṭhe madhyame caiva uttame ca pavitrake |
kṛte yathā phalaṃ kartas tad vadasva pitāmaha ||
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu vatsa yathākāryaṃ yat sūtraṃ yat pramāṇakam |
vidhānaṃ ca yathā tasya phalaṃ caiva yathā bhavet ||
prathamaṃ darbhasūtraṃ tu padmasūtraṃ tataḥ param |
tataḥ kṣaumaṃ supuṇyaṃ syāt paṭṭasūtraṃ tataḥ param ||
śucikārpāsasūtreṇa nirmitaṃ vā śubhāśubam |
śucir bhūtvā śucau deśe kārayīta prayatnataḥ ||
tadvidhānopayuktaṃ tu yathoktaphaladāyakam |
kanyā kartayate sūtraṃ nārī vātha pativratā ||
vidhavā sādhuśīlā vā sūtram etat tu kartayet |
keśayuktaṃ kṣataṃ dagdhaṃ madyaraktādidūṣitam ||
malinaṃ nīlaraktaṃ vā prayatnena vivarjayet |
yathoktaṃ sūtram ādāya triguṇaṃ triḥ prayojayet ||
pavitraṃ tena kurvīta kaniṣṭhottamamadhyamam ||
kaniṣṭhaṃ tantubhir jñeyaṃ saptaviṃśatibhiḥ śubham |
martyaloke tu tat kīrttisukhāyurdhanaputradam ||
catuḥpañcaśatā jñeyaṃ tantūnāṃ madhyamaṃ param |
divyabhogāvahaṃ puṇyaṃ svargāvāsasukhapradam ||
[444]        uttanaṃ caiva tantūnāṃ śatam aṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
datvā tad vāsudevāya viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu tantūnāṃ parisaṃkhyayā |
vanamālā smṛtā viṣṇor datvā bhaktipradā hi sā ||
kaniṣṭhaṃ nābhimātraṃ syād ūrumātraṃ tu madhyamam |
pavitraṃ cottamaṃ proktaṃ jātumātraṃ pramāṇataḥ ||
vanamālāpramāṇena pratimāyāḥ praṇīyate |
narāṇāṃ janmasaṃsāraduḥkhamṛtyupraṇāśinau ||
kaniṣṭhe dvādaśaivoktā madhyame dviguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
triguṇās tūttame proktā granthayas tu pavitrake ||
śatam aṣṭottaraṃ kāryaṃ granthīnāṃ tu vidhānataḥ |
munīndravanamālāyāṃ viṣṇupūjanatatparaḥ ||
adhivāsanasūtre tu granthayo dvādaśa smṛtāḥ |
tattvanyāsavidhānaṃ tu śrūyatāṃ guhyakottama ||
idaṃ viṣṇur iti khyātaṃ mantram etad dvijanmanām |
śūdrāṇāṃ tattvavinyāsaḥ mantro vai dvādaśākṣaraḥ ||
tāvad āvartayen mantraṃ yāvanto granthayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva tridhā caiva pavitrake ||
haste pratigranthi sakṛn mantrajapaḥ madhye dviḥ śeṣe triḥ |
kuṅkumośīrakarpūraiś candanādivilepanaiḥ |
pavitrāṇi vilipyātha tattvanyāsaṃ tu yojayet |
adhivāsapavitrāṇi ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ ||
puṣpādibhiḥ saṃpūjyātha nyased viṣṇoḥ pure niśi |
[445]        tattvanyāsaṃ paraṃ kāryaṃ pavitrārohaṇaṃ hareḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ ca tadrātrau mūlamantreṇa bhaktimān |
ekādaśyāṃ śubhair gandhaiḥ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
naivedyaṃ dīpavastrādyaiḥ pūjayed garuḍadhvajam |
nṛtyagītaśubhākhyānair mallayuddhaiḥ pracālitaiḥ ||
vādyair mārutaśaṅkhādyair jāgaraṃ kārayen niśi |
kṣīrakṛśarasayāvavaṭakāpūpamodakaiḥ |
phalaiḥ sugandhair madhurair naivedyaṃ kārayed dhareḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ naro bhaktyā saṃpūjya madhusūdanam |
pavitrārohaṇaṃ kuryād devadevasya cakriṇaḥ |
sopavāsaḥ śucisnātaḥ kṛtajapyo jitendriyaḥ ||
datvā dānaṃ dvijāgrebhyaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam |
pūrvādhivāsitaṃ samyak samādāya pavitrakam ||
ato deveti mantreṇa viṣṇor mūrdhni nivedayet |
ayaṃ mantro dvijātīnāṃ pavitrārohaṇe smṛtaḥ ||
śūdrasya mūlamantro vā yena vai pūjayed dharim |
vāśabdād dvādaśākṣaro vā, yena vai pūjayed dharim iti mūlamantravyākhyā |
stutimaṅgalanirghoṣair gītavāditanisvanaiḥ |
pavitrārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā devatāyās tv imaṃ varam ||
maṇividrumamālābhir mandārakusumādibhiḥ |
eṣā sāṃvatsarī pūjā tavāstu garuḍadhvaja |
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ janārdana ||
[446]        yat pūjitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ tad astu me ||
vanamālā yathā deva kaustubhaḥ satataṃ hṛdi |
pavitram astu te tadvat pūjā ca hṛdayāvahā ||
kṛtvā pavitrakaṃ viṣṇor varṣadvādaśavārṣikam |
phalaṃ prāpnoty akṛtvā tu pūjāhanim athāpnuyāt ||
evaṃ saṃprārthya deveśaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ |
bhūyo 'pi dadyād viprebhyo harim uddiśya dakṣiṇām ||
tato 'nubhojayed bhaktyā guruṃ jñānapradāyinam |
vastragandhānulepādyaiḥ puṣpais tu varabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
prāpyānujñāṃ guroḥ śiṣyo bhaktyā nārcayate gurum |
sa gacchati vimūḍhātmā narakaṃ hi narādhamaḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yathā viṣṇuṃ tathā gurum |
ānandenārcayed yas tu sa mukthiphalam āpnuyāt ||
yathā viṣṇus tathā vidyā yathā vidyās tathā guruḥ |
vitathaṃ pūjayed yas tu sa muktiphalam arhati ||
tāmbūlaṃ puṣpagandhādyaiḥ pūjayitvā visarjayet |
tato bandhūn viśiṣṭāṃś ca jñātimitrasamāśritān ||
bhojayed āgatāṃś cānyān bhikṣukāṃś ca svaśaktitaḥ |
evaṃ vidhiṃ vinirvartya pavitrārohaṇe hara ||
viṣṇoḥ sāyujyam āpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham |
sthaṇḍile devadevasya eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
[447]        pavitrārohaṇe viṣṇor viśeṣaḥ śrūyatām iha |
yāvat tantusamāyuktaṃ bhāvayeta janārdanam ||
tāvad aṅgulakaṃ tasya eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
yāvanto granthayaḥ proktāḥ svatattvaiś cānumantraṇam ||
tatraiva mūlamantreṇa dadyād viṣṇoḥ pavitrakam |
pratimāṃ sthaṇḍile vātha. kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ pavitrakam ||
kulanāśaṃ samuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
evaṃ saṃpādya vidhinā pavitrārohaṇaṃ hareḥ |
arcayitvā vidhānena hariṃ ca sapavitrakam ||
visarjayeta mantreṇa anenaiva pavitrakam |
sāṃvatsarīṃ śubhāṃ pūjāṃ saṃpādya vidhivan mama ||
vrajed ānīṃ tu govinda viṣṇulokaṃ visarjitaḥ |
mantreṇānena tat sūtram avatārya yathāvidhi ||
uttārya brāhmaṇe dadyāt toye vātha visarjayet |
yāvat puṇyaṃ smṛtaṃ samyak pavitrārohaṇe kṛte ||
upavīte kṛte bhaktyā tat phalaṃ cāpnuyān naraḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ||
pavitrārohaṇaṃ kuryāt sthaṇḍile prayato naraḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena tasya pūjāvisarjanam ||
prārthanāvāhanaṃ dānaṃ samastavidhim ācaret |
[448]        tattvamantraiḥ samāveśya visarjanavidhikriyām ||
arcane (?) tu surendrāṇāṃ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt |
āyur balaṃ dhanaṃ vidyām ārogyaṃ kīrtim avyayām ||
prayacchanti yathāśaktyā prasannās tu divaukasaḥ |
arcite devadeveśa śaṅkhacakragadādhare ||
arcitāḥ sarvadevāḥ syur yataḥ sarvagato hariḥ |
arcite sarvalokeśe surāsuranamaskṛte ||
keśave kaṃsakeśighnena yāti narakaṃ naraḥ |
prātar madhye 'parāhṇe ca surāsuraguruṃ harim ||
ye namanti narā nityaṃ na te narakagāminaḥ |
tapas taptvā naro ghoram araṇye vijitendriyaḥ ||
yat phalaṃ samavāpnoti smṛtvā tu garuḍadhvajam |
ity guhyatamaṃ viṣṇoh pūjākalpaṃ mayoditam ||
samācarati yo martyaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim |
śivāgame śivapavitralakṣaṇam |
ekādaśātha vā sūtrais triṃśatā vāṣṭayuktayā |
pañcaśatā vā kartavyaṃ tulyagranthyantarālakam ||
dvādaśāṅgulamānāni vyāsād aṣṭāṅgulāni ca |
liṅgavistāramāṇāni caturaṅguṣṭhikāni vā ||
tathaiva piṇḍikāsparśe cāturthaṃ sārvadaivatam |
sāṅgāvatārakaṃ kāṛyaṃ pavitram atisundaram ||
[449]                nārada uvāca |
bhagavan devadeveśa paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me |
pavitrārohaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prasādād vaktum arhasi ||
pavitreti kathaṃ saṃjñā kutrotpannaṃ kim ucyate |
kṛte ca kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛśam ||
dravyena kena vā kuryāt kiṃ pramāṇaṃ hi tat smṛtam |
kiṃ daivatyaṃ ca kiṃ chandaḥ ko vā tasya ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
adhyātmaṃ vādhibhūtaṃ vā adhidaivaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
kena mantreṇa tat kuryād vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛśam ||
kasmin kāle tu kartavyaṃ nakṣatre vā tithau katham |
kriyate vā kiyatkālam etad brūhi sureśvara ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
sādhu nārada dharmajña toṣiton 'haṃ tvayānagha |
śṛṇuṣva tava vakṣyāmi pavitrārohaṇaṃ kramāt ||
pavitraṃ tena vikhyātaṃ brahmatejo hi gīyate |
viṣṇvākhyayā tu vikhyātaṃ tadā loke nigadyate ||
tad eva sūtrarūpeṇa yajñeśaḥ karmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
tad eva triguṇībhūtaṃ mataṃ nārāyaṇākhyayā |
tridevātmā tridevātmā tryakṣaraḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
te parvatāt samudbhūtā varāhārdhāṅgam āśritāḥ |
kuta eṣa samutpanna iti praśnasya idam uttaram |
saṅghātena ca tantūnāṃ navātmā parikīrtitaḥ |
[450]        tantūṇāṃ prathamo devo vāsudevo jagadguruḥ ||
halāyudho dvitīyas tu pradyumnaś ca tṛtīyakaḥ |
apare tv aniruddhas tu tato nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
brahmā viṣṇus tathā nṝṇāṃ varārohe samāśritāḥ ||
adhidaivena rūpeṇa adhyāthye (adhyātmye ?) ca nibodha me |
mano buddhir ahaṃkāras tanmātrāṇi tathaiva ca ||
jīvaś ceti navaitac ca adhyātmye suvyavasthitā |
dyaur antarikṣaṃ pṛthivī bhūr bhuvaḥ svas tathaiva ca ||
ākāraṃ cāpy ukāraṃ ca makāraṃ cādhibhūtakam |
agnitrayaṃ tathā karma trayaṃ ca sadanatrayam ||
jñeyaṃ pavitre tadvidvān adhidaivam udāharet |
chandaś caivātra gāyatrī pradyumno ṛṣir ucyate ||
vāsudevaḥ parā tasya devatā parikīrtitā |
yogo 'sya brahma karaṇe brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
alaṃkāro dvijātīnāṃ kartavyaḥ prativatsaram |
saridvarṣāsu kurvīta pavitrārohaṇaṃ śubham ||
yāvac ca dhārayet tantūs tāvat kurvīta vai vratam |
tathā pavitrakaṃ kṛtvā trīn māsān māsam eva vā ||
pakṣadvimāsaṃ sadyo vā trirātraṃ pañca eva vā |
avadhiṃ kārttikaṃ kṛtvā sitapakṣādyanukramāt ||
yathāśaktyā yajanty enaṃ kāmasaṃkalpanā tathā |
pavitre dhriyamāṇe vai na tyājyaṃ devatāntikam ||
upavītīkṛte paścāt patheṣu vicared budhaḥ |
[451]        maṅgalaṃ śobhanaṃ rudraṃ vijayaṃ ca caturthakam ||
āṣāḍhādikramād devaṃ nāmānīmāni dhārayet |
dvādaśyāṃ śrāvaṇe cāpi pañcamyām atha vā dvija ||
anukūle tu kartavyaṃ pañcadaśyām athāpi vā |
sūtraṃ tu yājñikaṃ kṛtvā tṛṇavalkalasaṃbhavam |
kārpāsikaṃ tathā kāryaṃ dārbhikaṃ cāpi kārayet ||
brāhmaṇīkartitaṃ sūtram anyad dhautam athāpi vā |
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya kṣālayen nirmalāmbhasā ||
yatnena śodhayed doṣān keśādyāṃś ca svayaṃ budhaḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryāt catuḥpañcāśad eva vā ||
saptaviṃśatir evāyaṃ jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyasaḥ |
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāṇi tathā strīśūdra eva tu ||
sarvadharmāśritāḥ sarve bhaktāś ca madhusūdane |
pūrvoktaṃ gurum āsādya bhaktyā saṃtoṣayec ca tam ||
yajñārthaṃ prārthayet paścād uddhāraṃ kuru me prabho |
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrās tu granthayaś cottamāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tadardhaṃ madhyame caiva tadardham adhamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
adhamaṃ nābhimātraṃ syād uttamāṅgaṃ dvitīyakam ||
lambito jānumātre ca pratimāyāṃ nigadyate |
evaṃ hi rūpataḥ kuryād adhamādhamamadhyamam ||
yathāśobhaṃ prakurvīta granthayo viṣamāḥ smṛtāḥ |
[452]        saiva proktā bhaved eva proktā yatra kvacit kvacit ||
ārogyadaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha evaṃ vidyāvicakṣaṇa |
sthaṇḍile vātha vakṣyāmi prathamaṃ karṇikāntaram ||
divyāgraṃ ca dvitīyaṃ ca diśāpālāntagaṃ param |
yathāśaktyā tu kartavyaṃ prayavāyo hy atikramāt ||
pitṛto mātṛtaḥ śuddhaḥ ātmaśuddhas tathaiva ca |
sadācārasthito mantrī vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ||
alubdo 'pisunaḥ saumyaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
ācāryaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmarato hi saḥ ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo yajñeyo madhusūdanaḥ |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyas tathā strīśūdra eva vā ||
svadharmāvasthitāḥ sarve bhaktāś ca madhusūdane |
pūrvoktaṃ gurum āsādya bhaktyā saṃtoṣayec ca tam ||
yajyārthaṃ prārthayet paścād uddhāraṃ kuru me prabho |
pavitreṇaiva yajñeyo yajñeyamadhusūdanaḥ ||
evaṃ kariṣyāmīty ukte saṃbhārāṃś ca samāharet ||
hareḥ sūtrādi yat sarvaṃ gurave tan nivedayet |
yathāśaktyā pavitraṃ ca śuciḥ kuryād atandritaḥ ||
aṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa granthyante granthayas tathā |
kuṅkumaṃ rocanāṃ caiva karpūreṇa samanvitam ||
ādāv uktena mantreṇa vyastena ca viniḥkṣipet |
samastena tato mantrī mantrayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
uktenaiva tu mantreṇa varjayeta pavitrakam |
[453]         om iti kuṅkumaṃ nikṣikpya nama iti tadupari rocanāṃ nārāyaṇāyeti tadupari karpūram
iti vyastena mantreṇa melayitvā | oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti samastena mantreṇa nimantrya samastenaiva malaṃ kuryāt |
iti viṣṇurahasyoktaḥ pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ |
brahmovāca |
catrādau kārayet pūjāṃ mama vatsa yathāvidhi |
gandhapuṣpārcanādānair mālyādyair damanodbhavaiḥ ||
sadā saṃpūjayed devaṃ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt |
sarvatīrthābhiṣekasya phalam āpnoti (?) dānava ||
umāṃ śivaṃ hutāśaṃ ca pūjayet pratipattithau |
pitāmahaṃ damanakair dvitīyāyāṃ tu pūjayet ||
haviṣyam annaṃ naivedyaṃ deyaṃ gandhārcanaṃ purā |
phalam āpnoti viprendra umayā yat prabhāṣitam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ yajed devīṃ śaṅkareṇa samanvitām |
kuṅkumāgarukarpūramaṇivastrasragarcitām ||
sugandhapuṇyadhūpaiś ca damanena sumālitām |
āndole dolayed vatsa śivo me tuṣyate sadā ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ prātar deyā tu dakṣiṇā |
hemavastrānnapātrāṇi tāmbūlāni srajas tathā ||
[454]        saubhāgyāya sadā strībhiḥ kāryā putrasukhārthibhiḥ |
geṇeśe kārayet pūjāṃ laḍḍukādibhir āvṛtām ||
caturthyāṃ vighnanāśāya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye |
pañcamyāṃ pūjayen nāgān tathā dadyān mahoragān ||
kṣīrasarpis tu naivedyaṃ deva sarpaviṣāpaham ||
ṣaṣṭyāṃ skandasya kartavyā pūjā sarvopahāriṇī |
ihaiva sukhasaubhāgyam ante skandapadaṃ vrajet ||
bhāskarasya tu saptamyāṃ pūjā damanakādibhiḥ |
kratvā (?) prāpnoti bhogādi vigatārimahātapāḥ ||
mātṝṇām (?) api cāṣṭamyāṃ pūjāṃ sarvānnagandhikām |
kṛtavāṃl labhate (?) vatsa siddhim iṣṭāṃ tu damanakaiḥ ||
navamyāṃ pūjayed devīṃ mahāmahiṣamardinīm |
kuṅkumāgarukarpūrair dhūpānnadhvajatarpaṇaiḥ ||
damanair marupatraiś ca vijayākhyapadaṃ labhet ||
dharmarajaṃ daśamyāṃ tu pūjā kāryānugandhikī |
dhanavān putravān kanto ṛṣiloke mahīyate ||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed (?) viṣṇuṃ karpūrāgarucandanaiḥ ||
haviṣyānnair mahābāho kartā viṣṇupadaṃ labhet |
kāmadevas trayodaśyāṃ pūjanīyo yathāvidhi ||
ratiprītisamāyukto (?) aśokamaṇibhūṣitaḥ |
vāme gṛhītadhanvā ca pañcabāṇakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
kumbhe vā sitavastre vā lekhyaṃ pañcaphalādibhiḥ |
[455]        khaṇḍaśarkaranaivedyaiḥ saubhāgyam atulaṃ labhet ||
caturdaśyāṃ tu deveśaṃ śaśāṅkāṅkitaśekharam |
kṣīrādisnapanaiḥ snāpya dhūpapuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||
pūjanīyo yathanyāyaṃ madanair hemasaṃjñitaiḥ
vastrānnamaṇipūjā ca kartavyā mahatī śive ||
vitānadhvajachatraṃ ca devaṃ kāryaṃ ca jāgaram |
mahāpuṇyam avāpnoti aśvamedhaphalādikam ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā kāryā sarvakāmasamṛddhaye |
indrāya saha sacyā ca kāmikaṃ labhate phalam ||
evaṃ pañcadaśāhaṃ tu ye ca pūjāṃ prakurvate |
sarvayajñatapodānaphalānīha labhanti te ||
vicitradevabhogeṣu krīḍante devi svecchayā |
puṇyakṣayād ihāyātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ khalu te nṛpāḥ ||
gatārayo na saṃdeha ity āha bhagavān śivaḥ |
iti devīpurāṇoktadamanakapūjāvidhiḥ |
sūrya uvāca |
śivaṃ ye pūjayiṣyanti danaṃ dāsyanti suvratāḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktā divam eṣyanti te dvijāḥ ||
yathā paśupatir nityaṃ datvā sarvam idaṃ jagat |
na lipyate punaḥ so 'pi yo nityaṃ vratam ācaret ||
iha janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ ca yat |
[456]        vrataṃ pāśupataṃ nāma kṛtvā hanti dvijottama ||
dvādaśyām ekabhaktāśī trayodaśyām ayācitam |
caturdaśyāṃ tathā naktam upavāsaṃ pare 'hani ||
pare 'hani amāvāsyāyām |
govṛṣaṃ caiva hiraṇyaṃ raupyaṃ tāmramayaṃ tathā |
sauvarṇaṃ kārayet patraṃ guñjāśītyā pṛthak pṛthak |
tatraivollekhayen mūrttiṃ śivāyāś ca śivasya ca ||
tatpramāṇaṃ vṛṣaṃ kuryād raupyaṃ hemnaś caturguṇam |
raupyāṣṭaguṇatāmraṃ tu tadardhaṃ vāpi kārayet ||
tatpramāṇaṃ tu guñjāśītipramāṇam | tadardhaṃ veti hemarūpyatāmreṣu yogyaṃ vṛṣatrayaṃ kāryaṃ vṛṣān dadyād iti vacanāt |
kumbhe patraṃ samāropya vastrottamayutaṃ tathā |
trayodaśyām ekabhaktaṃ riktāyāṃ naktam ācaret ||
anukalpo 'yam |
gandhapuṣpaiḥ savaivedyaiḥ vastrābharaṇadīpakaiḥ |
gaṅgādharaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayet pravarambaram ||

sarvapāpavināśāya sahasrākṣauhiṇīpatiḥ ||

yaḥ karoti vrataṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
na lipyati sa pāpena padmapatram ivāmbhasā ||

[458]                maitreya uvāca |

tad dinaṃ caiva saṃprāpya sabhāryaḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ |
gatvā prabhātasamaye snānārthaṃ jalasaṃnidhau |
taḍāge vā nadīdeśe gatvā praśravaṇe 'tha vā ||

evaṃ vidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ yāvat syāt pratipaddinam |

rasālam uttamaṃ sājyaṃ devānāṃ ca sadā priyam ||
[485]        tena tvaṃ snāpito deva nidhikāntiprado bhava |
yasyoccāraṇamātreṇa tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ ||

īpsitaṃ me varaṃ dehi paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim |

iti pūjā |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā saṃkalpaḥ kriyate tataḥ |

ājanmopārjanāt pāpāt śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |

evaṃ pālayato rājyaṃ hariścandrasya dhīmataḥ |
ṣaṭkarmaniratā nityaṃ viprā yajanatatparāḥ ||

evaṃ kālakrameṇaiva śrāvaṇī pūrṇimā gatā |
taddinaṃ prāpya vipreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā nadījale ||
[488] taddinaṃ śrāvaṇyuttaradinam |

śaṅkaraṃ pūjayitvā tu dvijān bhojya tathātithīn ||
saputraḥ svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtavān dvijaḥ |
iṣṭadharmavaśād devi vaṇigveśmagato dvijaḥ ||

saṃnyaste ca tadā sūra idaṃ vākyam uvāca ha ||
ṛṣir śambovāca |
bho bho mitra vaṇikputra śivamaunavrataṃ kuru |
putrapautrapradaṃ loke śivasthānapradaṃ tathā |
tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā śravaṇadhyānam āsthitaḥ ||
svacitte cintayaty evaṃ vyavasāyasya bhaṅgataḥ |
parvajanmāntare tvaṃ me mitratvaṃ samupāgataḥ ||
na karomi yadā vākyaṃ tadā śāpaṃ pradāsyasi |
adya yāvan mayā pūrve na śrutaṃ na kṛtaṃ vratam ||
saṃpraty ahaṃ kariṣyāmi tvadvākyabhayaśaṅkitaḥ |
vratasaṃkhyāvidhānaṃ ca brūhi me dvijasattama ||
ṛṣiśarmovāca |
śṛṇu mitra vrataṃ puṇyaṃ dhanaputrakalatradam |
tāvad vratam idaṃ kāryaṃ yāvat syāt pratipaddinam ||
dināni ṣoḍaśaivātra vratam etad udāhṛtam |
nityaṃ jalāśayaṃ gatvā īśvaraṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||
[489]        dūrvāṣoḍaśakāṇḍaiś ca samaunaṃ pūjayec chivam |
ekabhaktaṃ brahmacaryaṃ yāvad vrataṃ samāpyate ||
pūrvoktaṃ savidhānaṃ ca dvijena kathitaṃ tadā |
etac chrutvā vaṇikputro vismito vākaym abravīt ||
etan me mānuṣāḥ sarve vyavasāyena me vinā |
vartiṣyante kathaṃ vipra yāvad vratasamapanam ||
madveśmani dinaikasya vyayaśuddhir na vidyate |
ṛṣiśarmovāca |
īśvare niyatā bhaktir dṛḍhabhāvena cet tava |
evaṃ hi gṛhacintānte kariṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ saṃbodhitas tatra brāhmaṇena mahātmanā |
vaṇikputro daridro 'pi vratārthe niścito 'bhavat ||
cakāra caivaṃ yat proktaṃ vratasyāsya vidhānakam |
ṛṣiśarmā dvijaśreṣṭhaḥ śrīkaraś ca vaṇiksutaḥ ||
vratam etat kṛtaṃ bhavyaṃ lokānugrahakāmyayā |

vrataprabhāvāt tat sarvaṃ bhakṣayatvaṃ jagāma vai |

vrataṃ samāpya vidhivat tadā dānāny anekadhā |
gobhūvastrahiraṇyāni phalaṃ tāmbūlavāsasī ||

vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa gṛhe lakṣmīḥ parābhavat ||
[490]        putrapautrādisaṃyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ |
babhūva sa vaṇikputraḥ svavratasya prabhāvataḥ ||
sa tu varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ bhogān bhuktvā mahītale |

yamena preṣitā dutāḥ pāśamudgarapāṇayaḥ |
raktākṣā raktavastrāś ca raktakeśā bhayānakāḥ ||
śuṣkodarā mahākāyā raktapuṣpair alaṃkṛtāḥ |

baddhāḥ pāśair tadā dūtāḥ procuś ca śrīkaraṃ tadā |
dūtā ūcuḥ |

vrataprabhāvād vipro 'pi sarvadharmasamanvitaḥ |
prāpya dhanyatamaṃ sthānaṃ śivaloke ca modate ||
durlabhaṃ svalpabuddhīnām ādhivyādhivivarjitam |

sarvasiddhipradaṃ puṇyaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ śubham |

etasmāt kāraṇāt pūrvaṃ mayaitan na prakāśitam |

[492]        saṃsevyamānāpsarasāṃ gaṇana (?)

[493]        yathā vibhavamānena kuryād devaṃ caturbhujam |

phalaiś ca mṛttikābhiś ca tataḥ pañcāmṛtena tu |

prasādena, prasādena bījena |

[494]        homaṃ tatra prakurvīta bahupātsamidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |

pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ pañcaprasṛtisaṃkhyayā ||

brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyeta ātmānaṃ prāśayet tataḥ ||
phalāni ca samāhṛtya pradīpān aṣṭasaṃkhyayā |
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāras tataḥ pūjāṃ samārabhet |
sitacandanaliptāṅgāṃ sitapuṣpāvalambitām ||
sitavastrayugacchaṇṇāṃ śvetapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet |

stanau manmathavāsinyai lalitāyai bhujadvayam ||

namaḥ śriyai śiraḥ paścād dadyān naivedyam ādarāt ||
dadyād arghyaṃ vidhānena nārikerādibhiḥ phalaiḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ karkaṭīvṛndair anyais tatkālasaṃbhavaiḥ ||

candrodaye tato dadyād arghaṃ candrasya bhaktitaḥ ||
pravālaphalasaṃdīpaiḥ puṣpaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhis tathā |
[498]        navo navo 'si māsānte jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
kṣīrābdhisamavetas tvaṃ devān āpyāyase hariḥ |
kṣīrodārṇavasadbhūta atrinetrasamudbhava ||
bhābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namo 'stu te |

hiraṇyavastragodānair dakṣiṇābhiś ca bhūriśaḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā tasya śrīr gṛham āvaset ||
iti śrutvā nṛpaś cakre yathoktaṃ vratam ādarāt |
kālena gacchamānena vismṛtaḥ sa ca ḍorakaḥ ||
tasya rājñī samādāya jvalite 'gnāv athāsṛjat |
anyat kṣīragataṃ kṛtvā svahastasthaṃ cakāra ha ||
tasyāḥ karmavipākena daurbhāgyaṃ patitaṃ tathā |
anyathā bhartṛsaṃmānaṃ rājñā lakṣmīsamudbhavam ||
ya idaṃ kurute devyā varṣe varṣe mahotsavam ||
tasya śrīr janmatritayaṃ na kadācid vimuñcati |
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ dhanaṃ pūjāṃ ca vindati ||
atheśvaro viśeṣeṇa kuryāl lakṣmīvrataṃ śubham |
vratāt samāpnuyāt lakṣmīṃ vāsudevaprasādajām ||
nārī vā kurute yā tu prāpyānujñāṃ svabhartṛtaḥ |
subhagā darśaṇīyā ca bahuputrā ca jāyate ||
yaḥ śohanaṃ vratam idaṃ dayitaṃ murāret
bhaktyā samācarati pūjya bhṛgos tanūjām |
[499]        rājyaṃ śriyaṃ sa bhuvi bhavyajanopabhogyāṃ
bhuktvā prayāti bhavanaṃ madhusūdanasya ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ mahālakṣmīvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
dvidhā tu devadevasya mūrtir bhavati yādava ||
ghorā saumyā śivā cānāghorā bhavati pāvakā |
śitā cāgnipatir yasmād agnīṣomātmakaṃ jagat ||
dvidhā ghorā vinirdiṣṭā dvidhā saumyā tataḥ punaḥ |
ghorā vahniś ca sūryaś ca saumyā somajalādhipau ||
teṣāṃ tu pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
śuklapakṣāt tathārabhya phālgunasya dvijottama ||
ādityaṃ pūjayed rājan prathame 'hni paraḥ śuciḥ |
dvitīye 'hni tathā vahniṃ tṛtīye 'hni jalādhipam ||
caturthe 'hni śaśāṅkaṃ ca yathāvan mānavottamaḥ |
teṣāṃ tu rūpanirmāṇaṃ kṛtvā tān arcayed budhaḥ ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā |
vacā haridrayā snānaṃ prathame 'hni samācaret ||

priyaṅgunā tṛtīye 'hni caturthe gaurasarṣapaiḥ ||
[500]        godhūmatiladhānyaiś ca yavaiś ca divasakramāt |

kṣīreṇa caiva kartavyaṃ pratyahaṃ prāṇadhāraṇam ||
etat saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ narottama |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute ||
vimānenārkavarṇena svargalokaṃ sa gacchati |
tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ kule mahati jāyate ||

dharme sthitaḥ satyaparo vinīto

iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ guṇāvāptivratam |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtavrataṃ tava |
śakrakīnāśavaruṇadhanādhyakṣā yadūttama ||

teṣāṃ tu rūpanirmāṇaṃ kṛtvā tān arcayed budhaḥ ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasampadā |
ādye 'hni caitraśuklasya yajeta tridaśeśvaram ||
[501]        dvitīye 'hni yamaṃ devaṃ tṛtīye salilādhipam |
caturthe 'hni dhanādhyakṣaṃ pratyahaṃ snānam ācaret ||
nadīpradeśam āsādya devadikpravahakramāt |
yavais tilais tathājyena homaḥ syāt tilataṇḍulaiḥ ||
raktaṃ pītaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ vastraṃ dinakramāt |
śubham etad vrataṃ kṛtvā pūrṇasaṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ||
nākalokam avāpnoti yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam |
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavaty arogo
vasundareśo vijitāripakṣaḥ |
janābhirāmaḥ subhagaḥ prakṛtyā

iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ brahmaṇyaprāptivratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
viṣṇur bhūmir nabho brahmā tasya rūpacatuṣṭayam |
teṣāṃ tu rūpanirmāṇaṃ kṛtvā tān arcayed budhaḥ ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasampadā |
ādye 'hni caitraśuklasya viṣṇudevaṃ samarcayet ||
dvitīyādiṣu dharmajña bhuvaṃ devaṃ pitāmaham |
pūrvavartokaṃ sakalaṃ vidhānam aparaṃ bhavet ||
[502]        vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā kalpaṃ svargam avāpnuyāt |

iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ dhanāvāptivratam |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
balaṃ jñānaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ śaktiś ca yadunandana ||
vikhyātaṃ devadevasya tasya mūrticatuṣṭayam |
yad eva rūpaṃ kūrmasya balasyoktaṃ tathaiva tu ||
rūpaṃ jñānasya te proktaṃ narasiṃhaṃ tathā nṛpa |
rudrarūpaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ kathitaṃ tu mayā tava ||
pūrvaṃ balamukhaṃ tasya vāsudevamukhaṃ bhavet |
dakṣiṇaṃ vadanaṃ jñānaṃ devaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ viduḥ ||
aiśvaryaṃ paścime vaktraṃ raudraṃ pāpāharaṃ tathā |
vārāhaṃ ca tathā vaktram aniruddhaṃ prakīrtitam ||
trirātropoṣitaś caitre pūrvaṃ saṃpūjayen mukham |
śuklapakṣapratipadi vaiśākhe māsi dakṣiṇam ||
jyaiṣṭhe ca paścime vaktram āṣāḍhe ca tathottaram |
[503]        gṛhopayogi dātavyaṃ caitre māsi dvijātaye ||
raṇopayogi dātavyaṃ vaiśākhe yādavottama |
yogopayogi dātavyaṃ jyaiṣṭhe māsi dvijātaye ||
yajñopayogi dātavyaṃ māsy āṣāḍhe tathaiva ca |
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā pūrṇamāsacatuṣṭayam ||
pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā svargaloke mahīyate |
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu dvitīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaṃ bhuktvā yathoditam |
saubhāgyādiṣu bhogeṣu tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||

bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ mṛdvīkāśarkarāyutam ||
prāpte dvitīye vratapāraṇe tu
prāpnoti devasya salokatāṃ saḥ |
svargendraloke ca yathoktakālaṃ
bhuṅkte sukhaṃ sarvasamṛddhikāmaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sarvāptivratam |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |

[504]        caitraśuklasamārambhe prathame 'hani pūjayet ||

siddhārthakaiḥ kuṅkumena tathaiva ca haridrayā |
tathaivāmalakaiḥ snānam amalair divasakramāt ||

caturyugaṃ modati nākapṛṣṭhe |

iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ caturyugavraam |
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |

[505]        dadhnā tilair yavair homo ghṛtena ca tathā bhavet |
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva tathaivāgurucandanam ||

etat saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ puruṣasattama ||

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |

[506]        vratāvasāne dadyāt tu rajatasya phalaṃ (palam?) dvije ||

vratāvasāne dadyāt tu dīpakān dvijaveśmasu ||
śuklavastrāṇi rājendra yathā varṇāni vāpy atha |
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā nṛparārdhapatir bhavet ||
pātālagataṃ tu naraṃ daityakanyāsahasraśaḥ |
[507]        ramayanti mahārāja yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |

atrir uvāca |
pūjayantyāś ca lalitāṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyinīm |

anasūyā uvāca |

ke mantrāḥ kasya pūjeyaṃ dānaṃ kasya vidhīyate ||

śṛṇu tvam anavadyāṅgi lalitārādhanakriyām |

[511]        vāpī kāryā śubhe deśe tanmadhye vedikā śubhā ||

avraṇaṃ sajalaṃ kumbhaṃ tāmrapātrasamanvitam ||

candraṃ tu rohiṇīyuktaṃ rājataṃ kārayet puraḥ ||
