mūlamantreṇa gāyatryā sarvaṃ tatra prapūjayet ||
abhayaṃ varadaṃ savyaṃ vāme ca bījapūrakam |
kumbhopari savastrāṃ tu pratīmām arcayed budhaḥ ||
samīpe karakaṃ sthāpya supuṣpaphalacandanam |
pratheme ghṛtapūrāṃś ca karakopari saṃsthitān ||
gandhapuṣpādinaivedyaiḥ pūjayet pratimāṃ śubhām |
prathame śatapatrais tu dvitīye jātipuṣpakaiḥ |
tṛtīye campakaiś caiva caturthe pāṭalais tathā |
saptame bilvapatraiś ca aṣṭame yūthikodbhavaiḥ ||
navame kūṣmāṇḍikāpuṣpaiḥ daśame svarṇapuṣpakaiḥ |
oṃ tvaṃ devī devadevānāṃ tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ jagatpitā |
tvatprasādena me devi na vaidhavyaṃ bhaved iha ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
sadā tvaṃ lalitā devī pūjanīyā surāsuraiḥ |
[512]        rūpasaubhāgyam āyuś ca tvatprasādāt sadāstu me ||
arcanāmantraḥ |
nīlotpaladalaśyāme puṇḍarīkaśubhānane |
puṣpaṃ gandhaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo namaḥ ||
arghyamantraḥ |
laliteti śiraḥ pūjya umā pādau prapūjayet |
girijā jānunī pūjya āsyadeśe ratiḥ smṛtā ||
nābhau tu pūjayed devīṃ candrikāṃ kukṣideśayoḥ |
lakṣmīṃ stanapradeśe tu bhujayor menakātmajām ||
mukhe ca subhagā nāma lalāṭe śaṅkarapriye |
evaṃ pūjyā tu sā devī naivedyaṃ pratipādayet ||
īdṛśī pratimā pūjyā pratyahaṃ daśavāsarāt |
ghṛtapūrā daśa deyā naivedyārthe tu bhakṣayet ||
dvitīyā laḍḍukaiḥ pūjyā somālisphuṭakāriṇaiḥ |
sudhāphalaiḥ khaṇḍamaṇḍaiḥ pūrikākhaṇḍaveṣṭakaiḥ ||
udumbaraṃ kokarasaṃ pratyahaṃ paripūjayet |
karake caiva naivedyaṃ daśaikaikaṃ pradāpayet ||
kālodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayed daśabhir dinaiḥ |
nāraṅganārikerāṇi mātuliṅgāni dāpayet ||
rañjitaiś caiva vastraiś ca sarvālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ pūjyā dināni daśasaṃkhyayā ||
daśame divase prāpte rātrau candrodaye tathā |
[513]        devīṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat candrāyārghyaṃ nivedayet ||
śaṅkhe toyaṃ samādāya sapuṣpaphalacandanam |
navo navo 'si māsānte jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
gṛhāṇārdhyaṃ śaśaṅkemaṃ rohiṇyā sahito mama |
candrārghyamantraḥ |
karakān jalasaṃpūrṇān phalabhojyaiḥ samanvitān |
evaṃ karoti niyataḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhaven naraḥ ||
anena vidhinā yoṣit na vaidhavyaṃ labhet kvacit ||
etad vrataṃ mayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ yan munisattama |
karakaṃ bhakṣasaṃyuktaṃ suvāsinyai pradāpayet ||
daśāhe pratimāṃ dviyām ācāryāya nivedayet |
ācāryaṃ vastraratnaiś ca sabhāryaṃ paripūjayet ||
varṣe varṣe pradātavyā pratimā cārulocane |
anena vidhinā yas tu prakuryād daśavāsarān ||
varṣāṇi yāvad devasya pūjanīyāḥ surāsuraiḥ |
varṣaikaikena yenaivaṃ phalaṃ prāptaṃ tvayā śubhe ||
etat te sarvam ākhyātam anyajanmakṛtaṃ śubhe |
na spṛśanti ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni vai ||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ putraḥ pautraś ca vardhate |
[514]        yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya śṛṇoti nu (?) tathā naraḥ ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ parāṃ siddhim avāpnuyāt |
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ daśarathalalitāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
punar me devadeveśa tvadbhaktyā bhāvitaṃ manaḥ |
kathyamānam ihaivāsi śrotuṃ dharmapadaṃ mahat ||
yatrāṇu vāpi dattaṃ hi iṣṭaṃ vā sumahad bhavet |
śrutaṃ vā kathitaṃ vāpi puṇyākhyānaṃ janārdana ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pāṇḍava te vacmi rahasyaṃ devanirmitam |
yan mayā kasyacin noktaṃ supriyasyāpi bhārata ||
vaiśākhamāsasya tu yā tṛtīyā
navamy asau kārttikaśuklapakṣe |
nabhasyamāsasya tu kṛṣṇapakṣe
trayodaśī pañcadaśī ca māghe ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā tu samā kṛtayugena sā |
navamī kārttike yā tu tretāyugasamā hi sā ||
trayodaśī nabhasye tu dvāpareṇa samā matā |
māghe pañcadaśī rājan kaler ādir ihocyate ||
etāś catasro rājendra yugānāṃ prabhavāḥ smṛtāḥ |
yugādayaś ca kathyante tenaitāḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ || iti |
[515]        upavāsas tapo dānaṃ japahomakriyās tathā |
yadā tu (?) kriyate kiṃcit sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīsametaṃ jagadgurum |
nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayethāḥ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ ||
vastrālaṃkārasaṃbhārair naivedyair vividhais tathā |
tatas tasyāgrato dhenur lavaṇasyāḍhakena tu ||
kāryā kurukulaśreṣṭha caturbhāgena vatsaka |
avicarmopari sthāpya kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
śāstroktakramayogena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
śrīdharaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmān śrīśaḥ sa prīyatām iti ||
anena vidhinā datvā dhenuṃ viprāya bhārata |
gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
tathaiva kārttike māsi navamyāṃ naktabug naraḥ |
snātvā nadyāṃ taḍāge vā devakhāte 'tha vā punaḥ ||
umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ nīlakaṇṭham athārcayet |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyair dīpagandhādibhis tathā ||
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyāt purāṇoktavidhānataḥ |
aṣṭamūrtir nīlakaṇṭhaḥ prīyatām iti kīrtayet ||
tad anu prāpyate puṇyaṃ pārtha naktena varṇyate |
datvā tilamayīṃ dhenuṃ śivalokam avāpnuyāt ||
trayodaśī nabhasye yā pitṝn tatra samarcayet |
pitṝn pāyasadānena sumanobhir ghṛtena ca ||
[516]        bhojayed brāhmaṇān bhaktyā vedavedāṅgapāragān |
pitṝn uddiśya dātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanā ||
pratyakṣā gor mahābhāga taruṇī supayasvinī |
pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ||
mātāmahaprabhṛtayas tathaivātra trayo mama |
priyātāṃ gopradānena iti datvā visarjayet ||
kṛtenānena rājendra yat puṇyaṃ prāpyate punaḥ |
tadanyena na śakyantu vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api ||
putrāṃś ca pautrāṃś ca dhanaṃ sarvaṃ sumahad īpsitam |
ihaivāpnoti puruṣaḥ paratra ca parāṃ gatim ||
pañcadaśyāṃ tu māghasya pūjayitvā pitāmaham |
gāyatryā sahitaṃ devaṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitam ||
navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ phalair nanāvidhair yutām |
sahiraṇyāṃ savatsāṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
kīrtayet prīyatāṃ me 'dya padmayoniḥ pitamahaḥ |
yat svarge yac ca pātāle yan martye kiṃcid durlabham |
tad avāpnoty asaṃdigdhaṃ padmayoneḥ prasādataḥ ||
yāni cānyāni dānāni dīyante subahūny api |
[517]        yugādiṣu mahārāja akṣayāṇi bhavanti hi ||
vittahīnaḥ svaśaktyā yo dadāti svalpakaṃ vasu |
tad apy akṣayatāṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
vittānusāraṃ svaṃ dadyād dhanī vā nirdhano 'pi vā |
anyam alpaṃ hi yaḥ kaścit pradadyān nirdhano 'pi san ||
tad akṣayaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ yugādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ |
anusāreṇa vittasya ṛksādhyena samādhinā ||
bhūhiraṇyaṃ gṛhaṃ vāsaḥ śayanāny āsanāni tu |
chatropānahayanāni deyāni śubham icchatā ||
evaṃ datvā yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijān api |
paścād bhuñjīta sumanāḥ vāgyato bandhubhiḥ saha ||
yat kiṃcid vācikaṃ pāpaṃ mānasaṃ kāyikaṃ tathā |
tat sarvaṃ nāśam āyāti yugāditithipūjanāt ||
gīyamāno 'tha gandharvaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ |
kalpam ekaṃ vaset pārtha rudraloke na saṃśayaḥ ||
yad dīyate kim api koṭiguṇaṃ tad āhuḥ
snānaṃ japo niyatam akṣayam eva sarvam |
syād akṣayāsu yugaparvatithīṣu rājan
vyāsādayo munivarā iha nānyathaitat ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ yugādivratam |
[518]                sanatkumāra uvāca |
vaiśākhamāsi śuklāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ janārdana ||
yarān (?) utpādayāmāsa yugaṃ cārabdhavān kṛtam |
brahmalokātripathagāṃ pṛthivītalam ānayet ||
bhagīrathaś ca nṛpatiḥ sāgarāṇāṃ sukhāvahaḥ |
tasyāṃ kāryo yavair homo yavair viṣṇuṃ samarcayet ||
yavān dadyād dvijātibhyaḥ prayataḥ prāśayed yavān |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaḥ śrāddhaṃ tathā homajapādikam ||
śraddhayā kriyate tatra tad ānantyāya kalpate |
sandhau saridviśeṣeṇa sarvam akṣayam ucyate ||
ity ādipurāṇokto yugādividhiḥ |
brahmovāca |
māsi prauṣṭapade yat tu kṛṣṇapakṣe tryodaśī |
avatīrṇaṃ yugaṃ tasyāṃ tretāyāṃ tu samāhitaḥ ||
tretāyāṃ vinivṛttāyām etasyāṃ tithau yugam avatīrṇam iti saṃbandhaḥ athārddhāparam iti labhyate |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ dūrvāṃ samālabhya ca mṛttikām |
snāyād dhrade taḍāge vā tithau tasyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
[519]        kṛtaṃ tena bhavec chrāddhaṃ gayāyāṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ |
yugādau yas trilokeśaṃ snāpayed garuḍadhvajam ||
ghṛtakṣīrajalaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sa gacched vaiṣṇavīṃ purīm |
snāpito 'tha vilipto 'tha pūjito 'tha namaskṛtaḥ ||
yugādau yugakartā tu nṝṇāṃ muktiprado hariḥ |
varte vai sarvaprayatnena yugādau jagatīpatiḥ ||
pūjanīyo janair bhaktyā sarvaduḥkhaharo hariḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ yugāvatāravratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe nānātithīvratāni |
[520]
atha dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha vāravratāni |
ādityādikramam anusaran saptavāravratāni
brūte saṃpraty avahitamatiṣṭhasodya hemādrisūriḥ |
ānandāya prabhavati satāṃ yasya vācā vilāsī
nityaṃ lakṣmīr dayitacaritstotramaitrīpavitraḥ ||
tatra tāvad ādityavratāni |
ḍihī uvāca |
ye tv ādityavrate brahman pūjayanti divākaram |
snānadānādinā teṣāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ yad bravīhi me ||
brahmā uvāca |
ye tv ādityadine prāpte śrāddhaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
sapta janmāni te prāptāḥ saṃbhavanti virogatām ||
vairāgyam iha vai prāpya sūryalokaṃ vrajanti te ||
upavāsaṃ tu kurvanti ye tv ādityavrate sadā |
japanti tu mahāśvetām īpsitaṃ labhate phalam ||
viśeṣād ādityadine japamāno gaṇādhipān |
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāśvetaṃ japan vairocanaṃ padam ||
[521] ādityahṛdayaṃ yantram |
mahāś caitāṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ sa iti mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ |
hrāṃsīṃ sa śūryāyeti namaḥ |
yo yaḥ sūryadine bhānuṃ saṃpūjya śraddhayānvitaḥ |
naktaṃ karoti puruṣaḥ sa yāty amaralokatām ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktam ādityavratam |
āditya uvāca |
yo 'bdam ekaṃ prakurvīta naktaṃ hi maddine naraḥ |
brahmacārī jitakrodho mamārcanaparaḥ khaga ||
saṃvatsarāntam āsādya madbhaktāṃś ca dvijottamān |
bhojayitvā prīto brūyāt prīyatāṃ me divākaraḥ ||
yaś ca bhaktisamāyukto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati |
sa ca bhānukṛtaṃ lokaṃ dhruvaṃ saṃprāpnuyān naraḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam ādityavratam |
hastayukte vārkadine sauranaktavrataṃ caret |
snātvābhyarcya tu viprān vai virogo jāyate naraḥ ||
iti nṛsiṃhapurāṇoktaṃ sauranaktavratam |
[522] athādityavāre nandādividhiḥ |
brahmovāca |
dvādaśyāṃ hastabhaṃ vāro ādityasya mahātmanaḥ |
nando bhadras tathā saumyaḥ kāmadaḥ putradas tathā |
jayo jayanto vijaya ādityādim upāsthitaḥ ||
hṛdayo rogahā caiva mahārogavināśanam |
mālatīkusumānīha śvetacandanam uttamam ||
dhūpaṃ guggulaśreṣṭhena naivedyaṃ pūpam eva tu |
datvāpūpāṃs tu viprāya tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
prasthamātraṃ bhavet pūpaṃ godhūmottham anuttamam |
yavodbhavaṃ vā kurvīta sugandhasarṣapānvitam ||
sahiraṇyaṃ tu dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo hitepsunā |
bhaume divye 'tha vā deyaṃ nyased āpūraṇaṃ raveḥ ||
devā brāhmaṇāḥ bhaumāḥ taditare brāhmaṇāḥ |
dātavyo mantravat pūpo maṇḍako gṛhya eva tu |
pūpādiś canakair bhaktyā ādityaparamaś ca tu ||
dānamantraḥ |
ādityatejasotpannaṃ rājñīkaravinirmitam |
śreyase mama vipra tvaṃ pratīcyāpūpam uttamam ||
grahaṇamantraḥ |
kāmadaṃ sukhadaṃ dhanyaṃ putradaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā |
sadā te tu prayacchāmi maṇḍakaṃ bhāskarapriyam ||
[523]        etāv eva mahāmantrau dānādāne ravipriyau |
apūpasya gaṇaśreṣṭha adya me nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
eṣa mantravidhiḥ prokto narāṇāṃ śreyase vibho |
anena vidhinā yas tu devaṃ pūjayate ravim ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate |
na dāridraṃ na rogās tu kule tasya mahātmanaḥ ||
yaś cainaṃ pūjayed bhanuṃ akṣayaṃ tanute sadā |
sūryalokāśrayaṃ kṛtvā rājā bhavati bhūtale ||
bahujñātisamāyuktaḥ sa naro ravisaṃnibhaḥ |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto nandāvidhiḥ |
māsi bhādrapade vīra śuklapakṣe tu yā bhavet ||
ṣaṣṭhī kurukulaśreṣṭha sā bhadrā parikīrtitā |
tatra naktaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād upavāsam athāpi vā ||
hasayānaṃ samārūḍho yāti hasasalokatām |
mālatīkusumānīha tathā śvetaṃ tu candanam ||
vijayaṃ ca tathā dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ param |
vijayo, dhūpaḥ bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto yathā |
avraṇaṃ sihlakaṃ vipra śrīkhaṇḍam agaruṃ tathā |
karpūraṃ ca tathā mūlaṃ śarkarā tvacaṃ dvija ||
itthaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ madhyāhne bhuvanādhipam |
datvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
[524]        pāyasaṃ saguḍaṃ deyaṃ guḍaṃ ca sarpiṣā saha |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti putrakāmadhanādikān ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktabhadrāvidhiḥ |
nakṣatraṃ rohiṇī vīra yadā vāro raver bhavet ||
jātyā sa saumyatā vīra sa saumyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homas tathā devādipūjanam ||
akṣayaṃ syān na saṃdehas tasya vāre mahātmanaḥ |
naktaṃ samāhito yatra pūjayed bhāskaraṃ naraḥ ||
yāti lokaṃ sa devasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ |
rakotpalāni vai tatra tathā raktaṃ ca candanam ||
sugandhaś cāpi dhūpo 'tra naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ param |
brahmeti, me bhāvitaṃ manaḥ |
iti saṃpūjitaḥ putra bhāskaraḥ putrado bhavet |
ato 'yaṃ putrado vāro devasya parikīrtitaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaḥ purāputrado vidhiḥ |
dakṣiṇe tv ayane yaḥ syāt sa jayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
atropavāso naktaṃ tu snānaṃ dānaṃ tapas tathā |
bhavec chataguṇaṃ deva bhāskarasya dine kṛtam ||
tasmān naktādi kartavyam asmāc chataguṇo vidhiḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto jayavidhiḥ |
[525]        jayanta uttararkṣeye ādityagaṇanāyaka |
vāro devasya caivātra pūjyo devo gaṇādhipaḥ ||
pūjitas tatra deveśaḥ sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam |
phalaṃ dadāti deveśaḥ snānadānādikarmaṇi ||
ghṛtena payasā hy atra snānam ikṣurasena tu |
vilepahaṃ kuṅkumasya praśastaṃ bhāsakarapriyam ||
dhūpakriyā guggulunā naivedyaṃ māṣakaṃ priye |
itthaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ kuryād vā mantravat kila ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścāt modakāṃs tilaśaṣkulī |
itthaṃ yaḥ pūjayed bhānuṃ prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutaḥ ||
sa śokavijayo nāma sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ |
tatra kīṭaguṇaṃ sarvaṃ phalaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ ||
dadāti bhagavān devaḥ pūjitaḥ sagaṇādhipaḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevādipūjanam ||
naktaṃ vā sopavāso vā saṃpūjyo 'tra divākaraḥ |
sarvalokādhipo bhūtvā prāpyate saptasaptikaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ sūryasya vāre tripurasūdanavratam |
prātaḥ kṛtvā tataḥ snānaṃ pūjayitvā divākaram |
ādityābhimukhas tiṣṭhed yāvad astamanaṃ raveḥ ||
japamāno mahāśvetāṃ stambham āśritya bhaktataḥ |
mahādevasya bhaktyā tu devadevaṃ divākaram ||
paśyan japan mahāśvetāṃ tiṣṭhed astamayaṃ raveḥ |
[526]        gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca pūjayitvā divākaram ||
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
ittham eva vrataṃ kuryād bhāskaraprītaye naraḥ ||
bhānumāṃs tasya tu prīto dadyāt sarvamanorathān |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto āditābhimukhavidhiḥ |
ravisaṃkramaṇe yasmāt raver vāro gaṇādhipa |
ādityahṛdayo nama ādityahṛdayapriyaḥ ||
māṃ tatra naktam āśritya devaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ |
gatvā mama puraṃ paścāt pṛthivyāṃ syān narādhipaḥ ||
gacched āyatanaṃ bhānor ādityābhimukhasthitaḥ |
japed ādityahṛdayaṃ saṃkhyāṣṭaśataṃ budhaḥ ||
yo naraḥ pūjayed bhānuṃ bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
sa kāmān labhate sarvān ādityahṛdaye sthitaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam ādityahṛdayavidhiḥ |
kṛṣṇe vāre yadā bhaumaṃ bhaved vai bhagadaivatam |
sa varo hi mahāproktaḥ sarvarogabhayāpahaḥ |
bhagadaivataṃ pūrvāphalguni |
yo 'tra pūjayate bhānuṃ śubhagandhavilepanaiḥ ||
sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti bhāspater gṛham |
arkapatraṃ puṭe kṛtvā puṣyārke caiva suvrata ||
[527]        devasya purato rātrau bhaktyā saṃpūjayed budhaḥ |
pūjayed atra vai bhaktyā etena vidhinā dvijam ||
sarvarogair viyuktas tu gacched ādityakālayam |
tasmād api vrajel lokaṃ huṅkārarahitas tataḥ ||
dvijaṃ sūryaṃ huṅkārarahito brāhmaṇaḥ |
iti bhaviṣyottarokto rogahavidhiḥ |
yas tv ādityagraheśasya vāro devasya suvrata |
pūjayet sa mitho nityaṃ khyāto gośrutibhūṣaṇaḥ ||
gośrutiḥ cakṣuḥ śravāḥ | sa bhūṣaṇaṃ yasya sa sarpabhūṣaṇa ity arthaḥ |
yas tu saṃpūjayen nityaṃ pataṅgaṃ pannagādhipam |
gandhapuṣpādidhūpais tu stotrair vā vividhais tathā ||
sopavāso gaṇaśreṣṭha ādityagrahaṇe śuciḥ |
japamāno mahāśvetāṃ svaśākhoktagrahādhipam ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
ādityagrahayukto 'smin vāre tripurasūdana ||
etat karmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tat sarvaṃ śubhadaṃ bhavet |
snānadānajapādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja ||
anantaṃ hi phalaṃ teṣāṃ bhavaty asmin na saṃśayaḥ |
kṛtānāṃ tu guṇaśreṣṭha bhāskarasya vaco yathā |
tasmāt sūryadine kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ karma vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
evaṃ bhuktvā ca naktaṃ ca upavāsam athāpi vā |
[528]        ye tv ādityadine kuryus te yānti paramāṃ gatim ||
dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca āyuṣyaṃ kāmadaṃ tathā |
tasmin yad dānam aparaṃ tad godānasamaṃ matam ||
dvādaśaite mahābāho vācā bhānor mahātmanaḥ |
anuṣṭhitās tu kathitāḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahāḥ ||
kṛtvaitad eṣāṃ vidhivad vāraṃ vṛṣabhavāhanam |
tato yāyād varaṃ lokaṃ vṛṣaketor mahātmanaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ nandādivratavidhiḥ |
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca |
kṛtvā bhūmau likhet padmaṃ śobhanaṃ karṇikācitam |
patrair dvādaśabhir yuktaṃ śobhamānaṃ manoramam ||
teṣāṃ tu madhye catvāri tanmadhye bhāskaraṃ nyaset |
teṣāṃ dvādaśapatrāṇāṃ saṃbandhīni catvāri patrāṇi padmamadhye karṇikāsaṃlagnāni kāryāṇi aṣṭau tu tadbhāhye, patraṃ dvādaśadale ity arthaḥ |
pūrvapatre nyaset sūryam āgneyyāṃ tu divākaram |
yāmyāyāṃ tu vivasvantaṃ nairṛtyāṃ tu bhagaṃ nyaset ||
varuṇaṃ paścime patre vāyavye indram eva tu |
ādityam uttare caiva savitāraṃ tataḥ param ||
karṇikā pūrvapatreṣu nyased ekasya vājinaḥ |
dakṣiṇena sahasrāṃśuṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ paścime dale ||
[529]        uttare tu raviṃ devaṃ madhye bhāskaram eva ca |
evaṃ vinyasya sarvāsu dikṣu sūryārcanaṃ bhavet ||
karavīrārkapuṣpair vā candanāgurucampakaiḥ |
kālodbhavaiś ca puṣpaiś ca pūjayet sarvatomukham ||
janmamṛtyujarāśokasaṃsārabhayanāśanam |
dāridravyasanadhvaṃsaṃ śrīmān kuru divākara ||
namaskāreṇa mantreṇa vyāhṛtyā praṇavādibhiḥ |
agnim īle namas tubhyaṃ jātaveda namo 'stu te ||
īṣe tvāya namas tubhyaṃ (?) īṣe tverje namo namaḥ |
agna āyāhi vītaye agnigarbha namo 'stu te ||
śan no devī namas tubhyaṃ jagaccakṣur namo namaḥ |
ādityavāraṃ hastena pūrvaṃ gṛhṇīta pāṇḍava ||
tataḥ pratyādityadinaṃ saptavārān prapūjayet |
ekabhaktena naktāśī brāhmaṇān pūjayet divā |
dakṣiṇāṃ tu yathāśaktyā dadyād viprāya bhaktitaḥ ||
sthitvāgrata idaṃ brūyād bhāskaraḥ prīyatām iti |
tatas tavīti tigmāṃśuṃ stotreṇānena bhaktitaḥ ||
tvaṃ bhāno jagataś cakṣus tvam asmatsarvadehinām |
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvasāṃkhyānāṃ yogināṃ tvaṃ parāyaṇam ||
anāvṛttārgaladvāraṃ tvagastistvaṃ mumukṣuṇām |
tvayā saṃdhāryate lokas tvayā lokaḥ prakāśyate ||
tvayā pavitrī kriyate nirbījaṃ pālyate tvayā |
tvām upasthāya kāle tu brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ||
[530]        svaśākhāvihitair mantrair arcyam ṛṣigaṇārcitaḥ |
tava divyaṃ rathaṃ yātuḥ pātu pātā varārthinaḥ ||
siddhacāraṇagandharvā yakṣaguhyakapannagāḥ |
trayas triṃśac ca vai devā devā vaimānikāgaṇāḥ ||
sopendraś ca mahendraś ca tvām iṣṭāṃ siddhim āgatāḥ |
upayānty arcayitvā vai prāptāś caiva manorathāḥ ||
divyamandāramālābhiḥ svargavidyādharopamāḥ |
divyāḥ pitṛgaṇāś caiva sasūryā ye ca mānuṣāḥ ||
te pūjayitvā tvām eva gacchanty āśu pradhānatām |
vasavo maruto rudrā ye ca sādhyā manīṣiṇaḥ ||
vālakhilyādayaḥ siddhā śreṣṭatvaṃ prāṇināṃ gatāḥ |
sabrahmaghoṣalokeṣu samastvaṃ hy akhileṣu ca ||
na tad bhūtam ahaṃ manye yad arkād atiricyate |
santi cānyāni sattvāni vīryavanti mahānti ca ||
na tu teṣāṃ tathā dīptiḥ prabhāvo vā yathā tathā |
jyotīṃṣi tvaṃ hi sarvāṇi tvaṃ sarvajyotiṣāṃ patiḥ |
tvayi satyam asatyaṃ ca sarvabhāvāś ca sāttvikāḥ ||
tvaṃ vajrasāt kṛtaṃ cakraṃ sunābhaṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
tvaṃ baliś ca madopeto nāśitaḥ śārdhadhanvanā ||
tvām ādāyāṃśubhis tejo nidāghe sarvadehinām |
saghoṣavirasānāṃ ca punar varṣāsu muñcasi ||
tapanty anye dahanty anye garjanty anye mahāghanāḥ |
vidyotante pravarṣanti tava prāvṛṣi raśmayaḥ ||
[531]         na tathā sukhayaty agnir na prāvārā na kambalāḥ |
śītavātārditaṃ lokaṃ yathā tava marīcayaḥ ||
trayodaśadvīpapatir nomi (?) bhāsayate mahīm |
trayāṇām api lokānāṃ hitāyaikaḥ pravartase ||
tava yady udayo na syād dagdhaṃ jagad idaṃ bhavet |
na ca dharmārthakāmeṣu pravarteran manīṣiṇaḥ ||
pradhānaṃ paśuvanbheṣṭimantrayajñatapaḥkriyāḥ (?) |
tvatprasādād avāpyante brahmakṣatraviśāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
yad ahar brahmaṇaḥ proktaṃ tad ahar yugasaṃmitam |
tasya tvam ādit antaś ca kālajñaiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
saṃvartakāgnis trailokyaṃ bhasmīkṛtyāvatiṣṭhate |
tvaddīdhitisamutpannā nānāvarṇā mahādhanāḥ ||
sairāvatāḥ sāśanayaḥ kurvanti bhūtasaṃskṛtam |
kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānaṃ dvādaśādityatāṃ gataḥ ||
saṃhṛtyaikārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ śoṣayasi raśmibhiḥ (?) |
tvam indram āhus tvaṃ rudras tvaṃ viṣṇus tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ ||
tvām agniṃ tvāṃ manaḥsūkṣmaṃ prabhus tvaṃ brahmaśāśvataḥ |
tvaṃ haṃsaḥ savitā bhānur aṃśumālī vṛṣākapiḥ ||
vivasvān mihiraḥ pūṣā mitro dharmas tathaiva ca |
sahasraraśmir ādityas tapas tvaṃ tvaṃ gavāṃ patiḥ ||
mārtaṇḍo 'rko raviḥ sūryaḥ śaraṇyo dinakṛt tathā |
divākaraḥ saptasaptir vyomakeśī virocanaḥ ||
[532]        āśugāmī tapoghnaś ca haritāśvaś ca kīrtyase |
saptamyām atha vāṣṭamyāṃ bhaktyā pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ ||
anirviṇṇāndakārī (?) lakṣmīs taṃ bhajate naram |
te teṣām āpadaḥ santi nādhayo vyādhayas tathā ||
etāvān anyamanasā kurvan padyena vandanam |
sarvarogair virahitāḥ sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ ||
tvadbhāvabhaktāḥ sukhino bhavanti cirajīvinaḥ |
tvaṃ mamāpy atra kāmasya sarvāptiṃ vicikīrṣataḥ ||
annam annapater dātum amitaṃ śraddhayārhasi |
ye cānye 'nucarāḥ sarvāḥ pādopāntaṃ samāśritāḥ ||
māṭharāruṇadaṇḍādyās tāṃs tāṃś caiva sanikṣubhān |
kṣubhayā sahitā maitrī pārśvabhūtasamādarāḥ ||
tāś ca sarvā namasyāmi pātu māṃ śaraṇāgatam |
imaṃ stavaṃ pūtamanāḥ samādhinā
paṭhed ihānyo 'pi varaṃ samarthayan |
na tasya dadyāc ca ravir manīṣitaṃ
tad āpnuyād yady api tat sudurlabham ||
ubhe saṃdhyā paṭhen nityaṃ nārī vā puruṣo yadi |
āpadaṃ prāpya mucyeta vandhyā sutadhanaṃ labhet ||
kāmajaṃ krodhajaṃ vāpi madajaṃ darpajaṃ tathā |
api janmasahasrotthaṃ pāpaṃ naśyeta tatkṣaṇāt ||
dhanadhānyasamāyukto naraḥ saubhāgyam aśnute |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ||
[533]        vimānavaram ārūḍhaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate |
aputrā yā bhaven nārī dhanasaubhāgyavarjitā ||
surūpā labhate putrān dhanaṃ saubhāgyam eva ca |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ divākaravratam |
skanda uvāca |
śṛṇu divyaṃ paraṃ puṇyam ādityārādhanaṃ param |
yat kṛtvā sarvakāmānāṃ sakalaṃ phalam āpnuyāt ||
samudratīre prāvārā purī dvāravatī śubhā |
vāsudeve yaduvare yuvarājyaṃ praśāsati ||
durvāsā śaṅkarasyāṃśaḥ ājagāmāvalokakaḥ |
kṛṣṇena pūjitas tatra arghyapādyāsanādibhiḥ ||
bhojanaṃ tasya yad dattaṃ yathābhilaṣitaṃ muneḥ |
saṃpūjitaḥ sa kṛṣṇena yāvad gacchaty asau muniḥ ||
śāmbena kathitaṃ tasya sutena sahasā kila |
kruddho 'pi muniśārdūlaḥ kopaṃ sa kṛtavān svayam ||
pūjitena mayedānīṃ manyuṃ kartuṃ kathaṃ kṣamaḥ |
sa gatvā nāradaṃ prāha śāmbena hasito 'smi bhoḥ ||
prakārāntarataḥ kāryaṃ tasya śikṣāpanaṃ tvayā |
ity ukto nāradaḥ prāyād dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau ||
svakaṃ sainyaṃ darśayasva mama devakinandana |
deva jānāmy ahaṃ kṛtvā hastyaśvarathasaṅkulam ||
nāradenaiva muktas ta (tu?) tathaiva kṛtavān vibhuḥ |
[534]        darśite tu bale prāha nātra śāmbaḥ pradṛśyate ||
mayaivānīyate śīghraṃ dvāravatyās tavāntikam |
gatvaivam ukto muninā śṛṇu jāmbavatīsuta ||
sa śṛṅgāras tathānīto makaradhvajadarśanāt |
gatvāliṅgya cucumbus taṃ gopyaḥ kṛṣṇaparigrahāḥ |
nāradaḥ prāha bhagavān duścaritraṃ tathānagha ||
kruddhena sauriṇā śaptaḥ kuṣṭhī bhava narādhipaḥ |
evam ukte tathā putraḥ kuṣṭharogāturo 'bhavat ||
śāmbaḥ praṇamyāha pitaḥ kim arthaṃ śapitas tvayā |
svaśaktijñānadṛṣṭyā tu vicāraya suniścayam ||
dhyānād durvāsaso jñātā vikriyā hy asya kāraṇam |
anugraho mayā putra kāryas te hy ayane śucau ||
ādityasya vrataṃ caiva kuru kuṣṭhavināsanam |
śāmba uvāca |
kathaṃ tv etan mayā kāryaṃ vrataṃ sarvaphalapradam |
kiṃ vidhānaṃ tu ke mantrāḥ kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ ca pūjanam ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
māsam āśvayujaṃ prāpya yadādityadinaṃ bhavet |
tadā vratam idaṃ grāhyaṃ naraiḥ strībhir viśeṣataḥ ||
yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ tāvad vidhinānena putraka |
gomayena kṣitau kuryāt maṇḍalaṃ vartulaṃ punaḥ |
raktapuṣpair akṣatābhir arghyaṃ tatra pradāpayet ||
mantreṇānena bhāsvantam ācārye prativāsaram |
[535]        yathāśā vimalāḥ sarvāḥ sūryabhāskarabhānubhiḥ ||
tathāśā sakalā mahyaṃ kuru nityaṃ mayārcitaḥ |
arghyamantraḥ |
evaṃ tam arcayet tāvad yāvad varṣaṃ samāpyate |
samāpte tu vrate vatsa kuryād udyāpane vidhim ||
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmau maṇḍalam ālikhet |
raktacandanarekhābhiḥ kuṅkumena viśeṣataḥ ||
tanmadhye dvādaśadalaṃpadmam ākārayed budhaḥ |
sindūrapūritadalaṃ javākusumapūritam ||
tanmadhye sthāpayet kumbhaṃ pravālāṅkurasaṃnibham |
śālitaṇḍulasaṃpūrṇaṃ śarkarācandanānvitam ||
tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ tāmraṃ śaktyā vinirmitam |
sauvarṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ kṛtvā padmahastaṃ svaśaktitaḥ ||
ādityarūpaṃ tu nikṣubhābhāskarasapatamīvratoktaṃ veditavyam |
raktavastrayugopetaṃ pātropari niveśayet ||
snāpya pañcāmṛtenādau javākusumalepitam |
raktapuṣpais tu naivedyaiḥ phalaiḥ kālodbhavais tathā ||
pūjayej jagatām īśaṃ dīpadhūpais tathottamaiḥ |
sūryāya namaḥ | varuṇāya namaḥ | mādhavāya namaḥ | dhātre namaḥ | haraye namaḥ | bhagāya namaḥ | suvarṇaretase namaḥ | aryamne namaḥ | divākarāya namaḥ | tapanāya namaḥ | bhānave namaḥ | haṃsāya namaḥ | iti dvādaśabhiḥ pujā kāryā
[536]        namo namaḥ pāpavināśanāya
viśvātmane saptaturaṅgamāya |
sāmargyajurdhāmanidhe vidhātar-
bhavābdhipotāya namaḥ savitre ||
prārthanāmantraḥ | anena mantreṇārghyam |
evaṃ saṃpūjya bhānuṃ tu naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
ācāryaṃ pūjayitvā tu vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
tasmai tāṃ pratimāṃ kumbham ahiraṇyaṃ pradāpayet |
prīyatāṃ bhagavān devo mama saṃsāratārakaḥ ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet paścād dvādaśānnādivistaraiḥ |
tebhyas tu kalaśān dadyād yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇām ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyak vratam etad anuttamam |
āśādityeti vikhyātaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ||
nirvyādhir nipuno jasvī putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
bhuktvā ca bhogān amalān amarair api durlabhān ||
dehānte ravisāyujyaṃ prāpnuyād uttamottamam |
prāpsyase paramām ṛddhiṃ vimuktaḥ kuṣṭarogataḥ ||
āśābhaṅgo na tasyāsti kadācij janmajanmani |
etasmāt kāraṇād vatsa kuruṣva vratam uttamam ||
etac chrutvā vacaḥ śāmbaḥ pitrā kṛṣṇena bhāṣitam |
[537]        vrataṃ caritvā saṃprāptaḥ sarvasiddhiṃ sudurlabhām ||
idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā śrāvayed vāpi mānavaḥ |
tāv ubhau puṇyakarmāṇau ravilokam avāpnutaḥ ||
iti skandhapurāṇoktam āśādityavratam |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hy etad uttamam |
yena lakṣmīr dhṛtis tuṣṭi puṣṭiḥ kāntiś ca jāyate ||
sarvagrahāḥ sadā saumyā jāyante yatprasādataḥ |
ādityavārahastena pūrvaṃ saṃgṛhya bhaktitaḥ ||
mantroktavidhinā sarvaṃ kuryāt pūjādikaṃ raveḥ |
pratyekaṃ saptanaktāni kṛtvā bhaktiparo naraḥ ||
tatas tu saptame prāpte kuryād brāhmaṇavācanam |
bhāskaraṃ śuddhasauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā yatnena mānavaḥ ||
ādityarūpam āśādityavratavad veditavyam |
tāmrapātre sthāpayitvā raktapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ||
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ chatropānadyugānvitam |
ghṛtena snāpayitvā tu laḍḍukān vinivedya ca ||
homaṃ ghṛtatilaiḥ kuryād ravināmnā tu mantravit |
samidho 'ṣṭottaraśatam aṣṭāviṃśatir eva vā ||
hotavyā madhusarpibhyāṃ (?) dadhnā caiva ghṛtena vā |
samidho 'tra arkasamidhaḥ |
[538]        mantreṇānena viduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
ādideva namas tubhyaṃ saptasapte divākara ||
tvaṃ rave tārayasvāsmān asmāt saṃsārasāgarāt |
vratenānena rājendra bhaved ārogyam uttamam ||
dravyasaṃpatsutaprāptir iti paurāṇikā viduḥ |
avisaṃvādinī ceyaṃ śāntiḥ puṣṭiḥ sadā nṛṇām ||
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktam ādityaśāntivratam |
nārada uvāca |
yadārogyakaraṃ nṝṇāṃ yad anantaphalapradam |
vrataṃ tad brūhi me nandin sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||
nandikeśvara uvāca |
yat tad viśvātmano dhāma paraṃ brahma sanātanam |
sūryāgnicandrarūpeṇa tridhā jagati saṃsthitam ||
tadārādhya śubhaṃ vipra prāpnoti kuśalaṃ sadā |
tasmād ādityavāreṇa sadā naktāśano bhavet ||
yadā hastena saṃyuktam ādityasya ca vāsaram |
utpadyate yadā bhaktir bhānor upari śāśvatī |
tadādityadine kuryād ekabhaktaṃ vimatsaraḥ ||
tadārabhya sadā kāryaṃ naktam ādityavāsare |
naktam ādityavāreṇa bhojayitvā dvijottamān ||
tato 'stasamaye bhāno raktacandanapaṅkajam |
[539]        vilikhya dvādaśadalaṃ pūjya sūryeti pūrvataḥ ||
divākaraṃ tathāgneye vivasvantam ataḥ param|
bhagaṃ tu nairṛte devaṃ varuṇaṃ paścime dale ||
mahendraṃ mārutadale ādityaṃ tu tathottare |
śāntm īśānabhāge tu namaskāreṇa vinyaset |
karṇikā pūrvabhāge tu sūryasya turagān nyaset ||
dakṣiṇe yamanāmānaṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ paścime dale |
uttareṇa raviṃ devaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu bhāskaram ||
arghyaṃ datvā tato vipra satilāruṇacandanam |
yavākṣatasamāyuktam imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā savitā sarvatomukhaḥ |
yasmād agnīndurūpas tvam ataḥ pāhi prabhākaraḥ ||
agnim īle namas tubhyam iṣe tvorjeti bhāskaraḥ |
agna āyāhi varadaṃ namas te jyotiṣāṃ pate ||
arghyaṃ datvā visṛjyātha niśi tailavivarjitam |
bhuñjīta bhāvitamanā bhāskaraṃ saṃsmaran muhuḥ ||
prāktane 'hni śanau caiva tailābhyaṅgaṃ vivarjayet |
vatsarānte kārayitvā kāñcanaṃ kamalottamam ||
puruṣaṃ tu yathāśaktyā kārayed dvibhujaṃ tathā |
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ kapilāṃ mahārghyāṃ
raupyaiḥ khuraiḥ kāṃsyadohāṃ savatsām |
[540]        pūrṇe guṣasyopari tāmrapātre
nidhāya padme puruṣaṃ ca dadyāt ||
saṃpūjya raktāmbaramālyadhūpaiḥ
dvijaṃ ca raktair atha vā piśaṅgaiḥ |
pakṣālayitvā puruṣaṃ sapadmaṃ
dadyād anekavratadānakāya ||
avyaṅgarūpāya jitendriyāya
kuṭumbine śuddham anuddhatāya |
namo namaḥ pāpavināśanāya
viśvātmane saptaturaṅgamāya ||
sāmargyajurdhāmanidhe vidhātre
bhavābdhipotāya jagat savitre |
trayīmayāya triguṇātmane namaḥ
trilokanāthāya namo namas te ||
ity anena vidhanena varṣam ekaṃ tu yo naraḥ |
naktam ādityavāreṇa kuryāt sa nirujo bhavet ||
dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
martye sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ sūryalokam avāpnuyāt ||
karmasaṃkṣayam avāpya bhūpatir
duḥkhaśokabhayarogavarjitaḥ |
dvīpasaptakapatiḥ punaḥ punar
dharmamūrtir amitaujasā yutaḥ ||
[541]        yā ca devagurubhartṛtatparā
vedamūrtidinanaktam ācaret |
sāpi lokam amareśapūjitā
yāti nārada raver na saṃśayaḥ ||
vedamūrtiḥ sūryas taddine naktam ity arthaḥ |
yaḥ paṭhed atha śṛṇoti vā naraḥ
paśyatīdam atha vānumodayet |
so 'pi śakrabhavane divaukasaiḥ
kalpakoṭiśatam eva modate ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ sūryanaktavratam |
atha veśyāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
varṇāśramāṇāṃ prabhavaḥ purāṇeṣu mayā śrutaḥ |
paṇyastrīṇāṃ samācāraṃ śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ ||
kā hy āsāṃ devatā kṛṣṇa kiṃ vrataṃ kim upoṣitam |
kena dharmeṇa caivaitāḥ svargam āpsyanty anuttamam ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
mama patnīsahasrāṇi śataṃ pāṇḍava ṣoḍaśa |
rūpaudāryaguṇopetā manmathāyatanāḥ śubhāḥ ||
tābhir vasantasamaye kokilālikulākule |
puṣpitopavanotpullakalhārasarasas taṭe ||
[542]        nidgarāpānagoṣṭībhir atha dānair alaṃkṛtaḥ |
kusumānayanaḥ śrīmān mālatīkṛtaśekharaḥ ||
gacchet samīpam etāsāṃ śāmbaḥ purapuraṃjayaḥ |
sākṣāt kandarparūpeṇa sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
anaṅgaśarataptābhiḥ sābhilāṣam avekṣitaḥ |
pravṛddho manmathas tāsāṃ sarvāṅgakṣobhadāyakaḥ ||
tad īkṣitaṃ mayā sarvaṃ vikāraṃ dhyānacakṣuṣā |
aśapaṃ ruṣitaḥ sarvā hariṣyantīha dasyavaḥ ||
mayi svargam anuprāpte bhavatīḥ kāmamohitāḥ |
etad vākyam upāśrutya bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ ||
mām ūcur vada govinda katham etad bhaviṣyati |
bhartāraṃ jagatām īśaṃ tyaktvā yāmo parāntikam ||
divyānubāvaṃ ca purīṃ ratnavanti gṛhāṇi ca |
dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarvaṃ devarūpāḥ kumārakāḥ |
bhagavan sarvalokasya kathaṃ bhogaṃ bhajāmy aham ||
dāsabhāvam anuprāptā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ punaḥ |
ko dharmaḥ kaḥ samācāraḥ kathaṃ vṛttir bhaviṣyati ||
tathā lālapyamānās tā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ |
mayā proktā yuvatayaḥ saṃtāpaṃ tyajatām imam ||
padmapurāṇe dālbhyagopīsaṃvāde |
dālbhya uvāca |
jalakrīḍāvihāreṣu purā sarasi mānase |
[543]        bhavatīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ nārado 'bhyāsamāgataḥ ||
hutāśanasutāḥ sarvā bhavatyo 'psarasaḥ purā |
apraṇamyāvalepena paripṛṣṭaḥ sa yogavit ||
kathaṃ nārāyaṇo 'smākaṃ bhartā syād ity upādiśa |
tasmād varapradānaṃ ca śāpaś cāyam abhūt purā ||
yasmād eṣā pradhānaiva madhumādhavamāsayoḥ |
suvarṇopaskarotsargadvādaśī śuklapakṣataḥ |
bhartā nārāyaṇo nūnaṃ bhaviṣyaty anyajanmani ||
yad akṛtvā praṇāmaṃ me rūpasaubhāgyamatsarāt |
paripṛṣṭo 'smi te nātha viyogo vo bhaviṣyati ||
caurair apahṛtāḥ sarvā veśyā tvaṃ samavāpsyatha |
evaṃ nāradaśāpena keśavasya ca dhīmataḥ ||
veśyātvam āgatā sarvā bhavatyaḥ śāpamohitāḥ |
idānīm api yad vakṣye tac chṛṇudhvaṃ varāṅganāḥ |
purā devāsure yuddhe heteṣu śataśaḥ suraiḥ ||
devatāsurasainyeṣu rākṣaseṣu tatas tataḥ |
teṣāṃ nārī sahasreṣu śatamo 'tha sahasraśaḥ ||
parinītāni yāni syuḥ balād uktāni yāni ca |
tāni sarvāṇi deveśa provāca vadatāṃ vara ||
veśyādharmeṇa vartadham adhunā nṛpamandire |
bhaktimatyo varārohās tathā devakuleṣu ca ||
rājānaḥ svāminas tulyaṃ brāhmaṇāś ca bahuśrutāḥ |
[544]        teṣāṃ gṛheṣu tiṣṭhadhvaṃ sūtakaṃ vāpi tatsamam ||
bhaviṣyati ca saubhāgyaṃ sarvāsāṃ mayi bhaktitaḥ |
na kadācid ratiḥ kāryā puṃsi dhanavivarjite ||
anumānāḥ prasādyaś ca śulkado devavat sadā |
surūpo vā virūpo vā dravyaṃ tatra prayojanam ||
dravyopahārtham (?) evātra sarvadambhavivarjitam |
yaḥ kaścit munikṛṣṭo 'pi gṛham eṣyati vaḥ sadā ||
niśchadmatvena sevyo vaḥ sa evānyatra dāmbhikān |
dveṣācāro na kartavyaḥ svāminā saha karhicit ||
rūpayauvanadarpeṇa dhanalobhena vā sadā |
kāmaś ca kānte yā kācit vyabhicāraṃ karoti ca ||
svāminā saha pāpiṣṭā pāpiṣṭo yāty adhogatim |
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca puṇye 'hni samupasthite ||
gobhūhiraṇyadānāni pradeyāni ca śaktitaḥ |
brāhmaṇebhyo varārohā kāryāṇi suvratāni ca ||
yathāpy anyad vrataṃ samyag upadeṣyāmi tattvataḥ |
avicāreṇa sarvābhir anuṣṭheyaṃ ca tat punaḥ ||
saṃsārottaraṇāyālam etad vedavido viduḥ |
yadā sūryadine hastaḥ puṣyo vātha punarvasuḥ ||
bhavet sarvauṣadhīsnānaṃ samyaṅgārī samācaret |
tadā pañcaśaravyāpisannidhānatvam iṣyate ||
[545]        arcayet puṇḍarīkākṣam anaṅgasyāpi kīrtanam |
kāmāya pādau saṃpūjya ūrū vai manmathāya ca ||
meḍhre kandarpanidhaye kaṭiṃ prautipataye namaḥ |
nābhiṃ saukhyasamudrāya vāmanāya tathodaram ||
hṛdayaṃ hṛdayeśāya stanāv āhlādakāriṇe |
utkaṇṭhāyeti vai kaṇṭham āsyam ānandajāya ca ||
vāmāṃśaṃ puṣpacāpāya puṣpavānāya dakṣiṇaṃ ||
lalāṭaṃ puṣpavāṇeti śiraḥ pañcaśarāya vai |
namo 'naṅgāya vai mauliṃ vilomāyeti jaṅghayoḥ ||
sarvātmane śirañ pūjyaṃ devadevasya pūjayet |
namaḥ śrīpataye tārkṣadhvajāṅkuśadharāya ca ||
gadine padmahastāya śaṅkhine cakrapāṇaye |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti kāmadevātmane namaḥ ||
namaḥ śāntyai namas tuṣṭai namo ratyai namaḥ śriyai |
namas tuṣṭai namaḥ puṣṭai namaḥ sarvapradeti ca ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindam anaṅgātmakam īśvaram |
gandhair mālyais tathā dhūpair naivedyair navabhāmini ||
tata āhūya dharmajñaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
[546]        avyaṅgāvayavaṃ pūjya gandhapuṣpādibhis (?) tathā ||
śāleyataṇḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam |
tasmād viprāya dātavyaṃ hṛcchrayaḥ prīyatām iti |
yathecchāhārabhug naktaṃ tam eva dvijasattamam ||
rathyarthaṃ kāmadevo 'yam iti cittena dhāryatām |
yad yad icchati viprendras tat tat kuryād vilāsinī ||
sarvabhāvena (?) cātmānam tarpayet smitabhāṣiṇī |
evam ādityavāreṇa sadā tad vratam ācaret ||
taṇḍulaprasthadānādi yāvan māsās trayodaśa |
tatas trayodaśe māsi saṃprāpte tasya kāminī ||
viprasyopaskarair yuktāṃ śayyāṃ dadyād vilakṣaṇām |
sopadhānakaviśrāmaṃ svāstarāvaraṇāṃ subhām ||
dīpakopānahachatrapādukāsanasaṃyutām |
sapatnīkam alaṃkṛtya hemasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ ||
sūkṣmavastraiḥ sakaṭakaḥ dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ |
kāmadevaṃ sapatnīkaṃ guḍakumbhoparisthitam ||
kāmadevarūpaṃ tu madanatrayodaśīvratoktaṃ vijñeyam |
tāmrapātrāsanagataṃ haimanetrapaṭāvṛtam |
[547]        sukāṃsyabhājanopetam ikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam ||
dadyād yathoktavidhinā tathaikāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm |
yathāntaraṃ na paśyāmi kāmakeśavayoḥ sadā ||
tathaiva sarvakāmāptir astu viṣṇoḥ sadā mama |
yathā na kamalā dehāt prayāti mama keśave ||
tathā mamāpi deveśa śarīrasthaṃ patiṃ kuru ||
tathaiva kāñcanaṃ devaṃ pratigṛhya dvijottamaḥ |
kodād iti paṭhen mantraṃ dhyāyaṃś cetasi mādhavam ||
kodād iti, yajurvedaśākhāprasiddho mantraḥ |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya visṛjya dvijapuṃgavam |
śayyādikaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet ||
tataḥ prabhṛti yo 'nyo 'pi ratyarthī gṛham āgataḥ |
sa samyak sūryavāreṇa sa supūjyo yathecchayā ||
evaṃ trayodaśaṃ yāvat māsam ekaṃ dvijottama |
tarpayīta yathākāmaṃ proṣito ravimandire ||
tadanujñāṃ niṣeveta yāvad asyāgamo bhavet |
evam ekaṃ dvijaṃ śāntam ācārajñaṃ vicakṣaṇam ||
saṃpūjayec catuḥprājñam aparaṃ varadājñayā |
ātmano 'pi yadā vighnaṃ garbhasūtakajanmajam ||
[548]        daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ vā syād uparāgeṇa vā punaḥ |
lakṣmīr viyujyate deva na kadācid yathā tava ||
śayyā mamāpi śūnyās tu tathaiva madhusūdana |
gītavāditranirghoṣaṃ devadevasya kārayet ||
etad dhi kathitaṃ samyag bhavatīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sudharmo 'yaṃ paro bhāvo veśyānām iha sarvathā ||
puruhūtena yat proktaṃ dānaveṣu purā mayā |
tad idaṃ sāṃprataṃ sarvaṃ bhavatīṣv api yujyate ||
sarvapāpapraśamanam anantaphaladāyakam |
sācārān aṣṭadaśa vā yathāśaktyā prapūjayet ||
eṣa proktaṃ mayā rājan dānaveṣu tato mayā |
tad idaṃ ca vrataṃ sarvaṃ veśyānāṃ ca prakāśitam ||
purāṇaṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ veśyājanasukhapradam |
karoti vāśeṣam akhaṇḍam etat
kalyāṇinī mādhavalokasaṃsthā |
sā pūjitā devagaṇair aśeṣair
ānandakṛtsthānam upaiti viṣṇoḥ ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottare kāmadāne veśyāvrataṃ nāma |
[549]                sūta uvāca |
merupārśve bhadrapīṭhe sukhāsīnaṃ (?) jagadgurum |
kaśyapaṃ sṛṣṭikartāraṃ tāpasaṃ śuddhamānasam ||
nārado vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhas trailokyabhramaṇapriyaḥ |
kadācid durdaśāṃ prāpya kaśyapaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ||
nārada uvāca |
devadānavagandharvaṛṣipannagamānavāḥ |
sraṣṭā tvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmādharmau hi vetsi ca ||
duṣṭagrahābhibhūtānāṃ durdaśāhatacetasām |
upāyaṃ vada teṣāṃ tvaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsala ||
kaśyapa uvāca |
tāṃ chettuṃ brūhi viprendra kena muktā bhavanti te |
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahābhāga jagadānandakārakaḥ ||
vakṣye sauravrataṃ puṇyaṃ durdaśāntakaraṃ param |
daśākaraṃ hi bhūtānāṃ manorathakaraṃ param ||
bhānuvāre site pakṣe daśamyāṃ caiva nārada |
prātaḥ kāle 'tha madhyahne snānaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi ||
bhānuṃ dhyāyet trimūrtiṃ hi sarvadaityavināśanam |
sarvapūjā prakartavyā tathā gandhānulepanaiḥ ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir naivedyais tu phalānvitaiḥ |
pūjayed durdaśāṃ tatra likhitvā daśaputrikāḥ ||
durmukhā dīnavadanā malināsatyavādinī |
[550]        subuddhināśinī hiṃsrā bahucintāpradāyinī |
etāḥ pūjyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā bhaktiyuktena cetasā ||
ādau pūjyā prayatnena gomayenopalepayet |
nityaṃ pāpakarā pāpā devadvijavirodhinī ||
gaccha tvaṃ durdaśe devi nityaṃ śatruvivardhini |
anena prārthaye līhi prayatnena visarjayet ||
tataḥ pūjā parkartavyā ḍorarūpe ca bhāskare |
daśagranthisamāyuktaṃ daśasūtropaśobhitam ||
ḍorakaṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya pūjāṃ kṛtvā kare nyaset |
āvāhanādidānāntaṃ pūjanaṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
tatra devaṃ kṣamāpyātha daśāpūjāṃ samārabhet |
bhūmibhāge ca pīṭhe vā likhitvā daśaputrikāḥ ||
subuddhidā sukhakarī sarvasaṃpattidāyinī |
ity aṣṭabhogapradā lakṣmīḥ kīrtidā duḥkhanāśinī ||
buddhidātrī sukhakarā sarvasaṃpattidāyinī |
putrakṣemyā ca vijayā daśamī dharmadāyinī ||
ebhis tu nāmabhir mantraiḥ pūjanīyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
pratiṣṭhāpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ naivedyaṃ ca yathāvidhi ||
viśuddhavasanāṃ devīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām |
dhyāyed daśadaśādevīṃ varadābhayadāyinīm ||
iti dhyānaṃ prakurvīta daśāyāḥ prāptaye rataḥ |
[551]        phalas tu daśasaṃkhyākair bhuñjīyāt tailavarjitam (?) ||
evaṃ vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ daśāprāptikaraṃ param |
nārada uvāca |
kaśyapa tvatprasādena śrutaṃ hi vratam uttamam |
daśāvrataṃ kṛtaṃ kena kasya tuṣṭo hi bhāskaraḥ ||
kaśyapa uvāca |
purā tu nalabhūpālaś cakracartiṣu dhārmikaḥ |
rājyabhraṣṭo daśāhīno dyūtenaiva hi nārada ||
tenāpi pūjitaḥ sūryo vrataṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ |
durdaśāṃ nāśayativā tu rājyaṃ prāptaṃ striyā saha ||
tataś ca dvāpare viprāḥ pīḍayā durdaśānvitāḥ |
bhramamāṇā vane ghore prāptāḥ satyavatīsutam ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
rājyabhraṣṭo daśāhīno rājāhaṃ kena karmaṇā |
idānīṃ me hitaṃ brūhi rājyaprāptikaraṃ param ||
ghṛṇiṃ dhyātvā muniśreṣṭho dṛṣṭvāpi ca daśākaram |
vratopadeśanaṃ cāsya cakāra munipuṅgavaḥ ||
asya vratasya sāmarthyāt prāptaṃ rājyam akaṇṭakam |
vrataṃ kṛtvā ca vidhinā caturbhir bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ||
śrutvedaṃ nārado vākyaṃ punaḥ papraccha kaśyapam |
nārada uvāca |
kena karmavipākena durdaśābhihato naraḥ |
jāyate muniśārdula tattvaṃ me vaktum arhasi ||
[552]                kaśyapa uvāca |
śṛṇu nārada tattvajña durdaśā pāpyate naraiḥ |
tuṣabhasmāsthimusalaṃ kadācil laṅghayen na tu ||
kumārī rajakī vṛddhā paśuyoniratāś ca ye |
ayonigudagāmī ca brāhmaṇīgamanena ca ||
saṃdhyāsu parvasamaye ramate ca rajasvalām |
pitṛmātṛparityāgī svāminaṃ raṇasaṃkaṭe ||
tyajet svadharmapatnīṃ yo durdaśā pāpyate naraiḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena nānyamārgeṇa vartayet ||
tasmāt tu tad vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye |
iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe kaśyapanāradasaṃvāde daśādityavratam |
sauradharme māndhātṛvasiṣṭhasaṃvāde māndhātovāca |
bhagavan jñānināṃ śreṣṭha kathayasva prasādataḥ |
tvadvaktrāc chrotum icchāmi vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ caiva sarvāmayavināśanam |
pūjārghyadānasahitaṃ naivedyaṃ prāśanācitam ||
etat kathaya sarvaṃ tvaṃ prasanno yadi me prabho |
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi yad guhyaṃ vratam uttamam |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ kuṣṭhādivyādhināśanam ||
bhānos tuṣṭikaraṃ rājan bhuktimuktipradāyakam |
yasyodaye suragaṇā munisaṅgāḥ sacāraṇāḥ |
[553]        devadānavayakṣāś ca kurvanti satatārcanam ||
yasyodaye tu sarveṣāṃ prabodho nṛpasattama |
tasya devasya vakṣyāmi vrataṃ rājan savistaram ||
pūjārghyaprāśanaṃ dānaṃ naivedyaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ |
sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yat phalam ||
sarvadānena tapasā yat puṇyaṃ samavāpyate |
prātaḥsnānena yat puṇyaṃ yat puṇyaṃ ravivāsare ||
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśasv api bhūpate |
sūryavrataṃ kariṣyāmi yāvad varṣaṃ divākara ||
vrataṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yātu tvatprasādāt prabhākara |
niyamamantraḥ |
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya nadyādau vimale jale |
snātvā saṃtarpayed devān pitṝṃś ca vasudhādhipa ||
upalipya śucau deśe sūryaṃ tatra samarcayet |
saṃlikhet tatra padmaṃ tu dvādaśāraṃ sakarṇikam ||
tāmrapātre tathā nadyā raktacandanavāriṇā |
tatra saṃpūjayed devaṃ dinanāthaṃ sureśvaram ||
māse māse ca ye rājan viśeṣās tān śṛṇuṣva vai |
mārgaśīrṣe yajen mitraṃ nālikerārghyam uttamam ||
naivedyaṃ taṇḍulā deyāḥ sa.ājyāḥ saguḍāḥ smṛtāḥ |
patratrayaṃ tulasyāstu prāśya tiṣṭej jitendriyaḥ ||
dadyād viprāya bhojyaṃ tu dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ nṛpa |
pauṣe viṣṇuṃ samabyarcya naivedyaṃ kṛśaraṃ tathā ||
[554]        bījapūreṇa caivārghyaṃ prāśyaṃ ghṛtapalatrayam |
dadyād ghṛtaṃ tu viprāya bhojanena samanvitam ||
māghe varuṇanāmānaṃ saṃpūjya satilaṃ guḍam |
bhojanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ kadalīphalam ||
arghyaṃ tenaiva datvā tu prāśyā muṣṭitrayaṃ tilāḥ |
phālgune sūryam abhyarcya jambīrārghyaṃ nivedayet ||
palatrayaṃ dadhi prāśyaṃ naivedyaṃ saghṛtaṃ dadhi |
dadhitaṇḍuladānaṃ ca bhojane samudāhṛtam ||
caitre bhānuṃ tu saṃpūjya naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūrikā |
phalaṃ tu dāḍimaṃ proktaṃ prāśyaṃ dugdhapalatrayam ||
viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyāt miṣṭānnaṃ tu sadakṣiṇam |
vaiśākhe tapanaḥ prokto māṣānnnaṃ saghṛtaṃ smṛtam ||
arghyaṃ dadyāt tu drākṣābhiḥ prāśanaṃ gomayasya tu |
kuryān māsānumāsaṃ tu saghṛtaṃ vai sadakṣiṇam ||
indraṃ jyaiṣṭhe yajed rājan naivedyaṃ tu karambhakam |
arghyaṃ ca sahakāreṇa prāśyaṃ jalāñjalitrayam ||
dadhyodanasamāyuktaṃ bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇāya tu |
āṣāḍhe ravim abhyarcya pūjā vibhītakaṃ tathā ||
viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyāt prāśayet maricatrayam |
bhagastimāṃcchrāvaṇe 'rcyas trapuṣāphalam eva ca ||
muṣṭitrayaṃ ca śaktūnāṃ prāśane samudāhṛtam |
viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ nṛpa ||
yadā bhādrapade pūjyaḥ kūṣmāṇḍaṃ taṇḍulātmakam |
[555]        gomūtraṃ prāśane yuktaṃ brāhmaṇe bhojanaṃ tathā ||
hiraṇyaretā āśvine ca naivedyaṃ śarkarā smṛtam |
dāḍime nārghyadānaṃ tu prāśyaṃ khaṇḍapalatrayam ||
viprāya parayā bhaktyā bhojane śāliśarkarā |
kārttike caiva rambhāyāḥ prāśane phalam eva ca ||
pāyasaṃ caiva naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ prāśane smṛtam |
evaṃ vrataṃ samāpyaitat tata udyāpanaṃ caret ||
tato gurugṛhaṃ gatvā gṛhṇīyāc caraṇāv ubhau |
udyāpanaṃ kariṣye 'ham āgaccha mama veśmani ||
māṣakena suvarṇasya pratimāṃ kārayed raveḥ |
ratho rūpyamayaṃ kāryaḥ sarvopaskarasaṃyutaḥ ||
kṛtvā dvādaśapatraṃ tu kamalaṃ raktataṇḍulaiḥ |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam ||
tasyopari nyaset pātraṃ tāmraṃ taṇḍulapūritam |
raktavastrasamāchannaṃ puṣpamālābhiveṣṭitam ||
pañcāmṛtena snāpayeta matputtāraṇapūrvakam |
pratiṣṭhāpy tataḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ devasya kārayet ||
candanaiḥ kusumair anyair vividhaiḥ kālasaṃbhavaiḥ |
akhaṇḍapaṭṭavastraiś ca kamaṇḍalum upānahau ||
vardhanītritayaṃ tatra sthāpayed devasāṃnidhau |
saṃjñayā vastrayugmaṃ tu kausumbhaṃ tu mahīpate ||
pratipadeṣu saṃpūjyaḥ sūryadvādaśanāmabhiḥ ||
mitro viṣṇuḥ savaruṇaḥ sūryo bhānus tathaiva ca |
[556]        tapanendro raviḥ pūjyo gabhastiḥ śamanas tathā ||
hiraṇyaretā dinakṛt pūnya ete prayatnataḥ |
madhye sahasrakiraṇaḥ saṃpūjya saṃjñayā saha ||
pūgīphalair dhūpadīpair vastranaivedyasaṃyutaiḥ |
nārikelena caivārghyaṃ dadyād devasya bhaktitaḥ ||
mantreṇānena rājendra vratasya paripūrttaye |
namaḥ sahasrakiraṇa sarvavyādhivināśana ||
gṛhāṇārghaṃ mayā dattaṃ saṃjñayā sahito rave |
arghyamantraḥ |
ārātrikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjāsaṃkalpam eva ca |
saṃkalpaṃ ca tataḥ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vai sūryadaivatam ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā miṣṭānnair dvādaśa prabho |
dampatyor bhojanaṃ deyaṃ paramānnasamanvitam ||
tatas tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt samabhyarcye sragādibhiḥ |
upahārādi tat sarvaṃ gurave pratipādayet ||
guruṃ tatraiva saṃtoṣya brāhmaṇāṃś ca visarjayet |
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidhihīnaṃ tu yat kṛtam ||
tat sarvaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātu bhūmidevaprasādataḥ |
anuvrajya guruṃ viprān bhojanaṃ tu samācaret ||
vṛddhāṃś ca bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ natvā devaṃ divākaram |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute martyo vittaṣāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
sūryavrataṃ mahārāja tas puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
brāhmaṇo labhate vidyāṃ kṣatriyo rājyam āpnuyāt ||
[557]        vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhiṃ ca śūdraḥ sukham avāpnuyāt |
aputro labhate putraṃ kumārī labhate patim ||
rogārto mucyate rogāt baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmaṃ sa tasya bhavati dhruvam ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā hy ekacitto nṛpottamaḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti prasādād bhāsvato nṛpa ||
iti sauradharmoktaṃ sūryavrataṃ samāptam |
atha somavārvratāni |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ tad anuttamam |
yena lakṣmīr dhṛtis tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kāntiś ca jāyate ||
tatvac citrāsu saṃgṛhya somavāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
naktoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kuryāt pūjādikaṃ vidhoḥ ||
saptame tu tataḥ prāpte datvā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
kāṃsyapātre tu saṃsthāpya somaṃ rajatasaṃbhavam ||
somarūpaṃ tu caturdaśīsthamahārājavratokaṃ veditavyam |
pātre kṛtvā somarājaṃ śvetavastraiḥ prapūjitam |
pādukopānahachatrabhājanāsanasaṃyutam ||
homaṃ ghṛtatilaiḥ kuryāt somanāmnā tu mantravit |
samidho 'ṣṭottaraśatam aṣṭāviṃśatir eva ca ||
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā caiva ghṛtena tu ||
[558] palāśasamidho jñātavyāḥ |
dadhyannaśikhare kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
mantreṇānena rājendra samyag bhaktyā samanvitaḥ ||
mahādeva jaṭāvallī puṣpagokṣīrapāṇḍura |
soma saumyo bhavāsmākaṃ sarvadā te namo namaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte mahāsaumya somatuṣṭikaro bhavet |
saṃtuṣṭe 'trisute tasya sarve santu grahā grahāḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktacandranakṣatraśāntiḥ |
īśvara uvāca |
atha vratavidhānaṃ hi kathayāmi samāsataḥ |
yathā caranti manujāḥ siddhasarvārthakāmadam |
vyutkrānte kārttike māsi śuklamārgadine bhavet ||
prathamaḥ somavāras tu taṃ naktena prapūjayet |
yadā śraddhā bhavet kartuḥ somavāravrataṃ prati ||
tadā sarvaṃ kārayitvā brāhmaṇādyaiḥ samārabhet |
mārge māse tathā caitre gṛhṇīyāt somavārakam ||
yasmin māse prārabheta tasmin māse prapārayet |
susnātas tu śucir bhūtvā śuklāmbaradharo naraḥ ||
kāmakrodhādyahaṃkāradveṣaśūnyavivarjitaḥ |
[559]        āharet śvetapuṣpāṇi mallikāmālatīs tathā |
śvetapadmāni divyāni campakaṃ bilvapāṭalāḥ ||
kundamandārajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ punnāgaśatapatrakaiḥ |
carcayen malayajenātha divyadhūpena dhūpayet ||
annāni yāny abhīṣṭāni tāni sarvāṇi dāpayet |
pūjayed bhaktibhāvena somanāthaṃ jagatpatim ||
kāmikena tu mantreṇa prāyakena maheśvaram |
nivedayet sarvam eva śṛṇu mantravaraṃ hitam ||
oṃ namo daśabhujāya trinetrāya pañcavadanāya śūline |
śvetavṛṣabharūḍhāya sarvābharaṇabhūṣite ||
umādehārdhasaṃsthāya namas te sarvamūrttaye (?) |
anenaiva tu mantreṇa pūjāhomaṃ tu kārayet ||
sidhyanti sarvakāryāṇi manasā cintitāni ca |
pūjayen naktavelāyām ṛkṣāṇāṃ darśanena tu ||
pradāya bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇāya subhaktitaḥ |
saṃyuktaśākatāmbūladakṣiṇābhis tathaiva ca ||
etadvidhisamāyukto rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ ||
ekabhaktasya yat puṇyaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ |
śatajanmārjitaṃ pāpam asahyaṃ devadānavaiḥ ||
[560]        naśyate hy ekabhaktena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
māsayaikasya yat puṇyaṃ śṛṇu tattvena sundari ||
abhāgyaṃ jāyate bhāgyaṃ durbhagaṃ subhagaṃ bhavet |
putrārthī labhate putrān daridro dhanavān bhavet ||
gṛhe tasya varārohe saukhyāṇi vividhāni ca |
rudrāṃśo dhanabhāgī syād vighnahīnaḥ kṣitiṃ caret ||
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
svarge bhuktvākhilān bhogān jāyate mānavottamaḥ ||
naktāni somavārasya pauṣamāse maheśvari |
teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye saṃkṣepeṇa tavāgrataḥ ||
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet |
tat phalaṃ labhate devi pūrvadeṣasamanvitaḥ ||
māghasyaiva tu māsasya somavāreṇa pūjayet |
snāpayen madhudugdhābhyāṃ tathaivekṣurasena tu ||
dvijahatyādipāpāni tāni sarvāṇi nāśayet |
viśuddhas tejasā yukto jāyate 'tyantanirmalaḥ ||
bahusvarṇasya yat puṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ tridaśair iha |
labhate nātra saṃdeho mama bhaktipracoditaḥ ||
phālgune kathayiṣyāmi somavāraphalaṃ śubham |
kṛte nakte tu kalyāṇi guṇās te vistareṇa tu ||
caturvedasahasrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca |
[561]        yajñānāṃ sarvaśāstrajñair nānāyājñikasattamaiḥ ||
gavāṃ lakṣasya dattasya candrasūryagrahe priye |
phalam apy adhikaṃ tasya labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
caitre 'pi śṛṇu kalyāṇi mamaiva bruvato vacaḥ |
somavāreṇa naktena kṛtena surasundari ||
yat phalaṃ labhate nārī lakṣaikena tu pārvati |
gaṅgodakasya nītasya somanāthādisaṃgame ||
ghṛtasya madhunā vāpi śatadhā hi kṛtaṃ phalam |
guggulaś ca tathā pañcasahasraṃ parameśvari ||
evaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaved asya mānavasya na saṃśayaḥ |
vaiśākhe kārayen naktaṃ somavāre na saṃśayaḥ ||
pūjayec chvetapuṣpaiś ca yathālabdhaiḥ sureśvari |
apūpā hi pradātavyāḥ kadalīphalasaṃbhavāḥ ||
ekacittena bhāvena nirmalena yaśasvini |
kalpānāṃ surayogyānāṃ sahasreṇa varānane ||
dānena vidhivad devi narāṇāṃ rūpaśālinām |
etad dānena yat puṇyaṃ labhate mānavo bhuvi ||
tat phalaṃ labhate satyaṃ somavārakṛtena tu |
jyaiṣṭhamāse mahādevi somavāravratasya tu ||
cīrṇasya yad bhavet puṇyaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayāmi te |
gavāṃ suvarṇaśṛṅgīṇāṃ puṣkare vidhivat priye ||
[562]        dattānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
padaṃ ca labhate puṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ devadānavaiḥ ||
īśasya kalpam ayutaṃ krīḍate tatra sundari |
āṣāḍhe somavārasya bhāvitātmā cared vratam ||
vidhipūrvaṃ tu kalyāṇi śreyaḥ śṛṇu vadāmi te ||
naramedhaśataikena vidhiyuktena yat phalam |
tad bhaven mānave devi puṇyaṃ sarvaśubhānvitam ||
sādhituṃ naiva śakyante devi naktam idaṃ yataḥ |
tasmād vratam idaṃ sāraṃ yataḥ kaṣṭena siddhyati ||
śrāvaṇe tu mahādevaṃ somavāreṇa pūjayet |
rātrau tu bhojanaṃ kuryān madakauṭilyavarjitaḥ ||
bhaved gaṇavaraḥ prāṇī jīvamāno maheśvari |
iha tv etādṛśī ceṣṭā paratra kathayāmi te ||
aśvamedhaśataṃ sāgraṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
mama loke sa vasati yāvac candrārkatārakāḥ ||
bhādre ca bhāvasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayet parameśvarīm |
puṇyaṃ vānuttamaṃ tasya śṛṇu devi viśeṣataḥ ||
gavāṃ koṭipradānasya savatsasya suśīlinaḥ |
yat tat phalam āpnoti mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
āśvine kathayiṣyāmi tv agniṣṭomaphalaṃ śatam |
rasadhenusahasrasya guḍadhenuśatasya ca ||
sūryagrahe kurukṣetre brāhmaṇe vedapārage |
[563]        dattasya phalam āpnoti mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kārttike varadaṃ devi kāmikaṃ mokṣadāyakam |
smaraṇāt pāpasaṃghānāṃ bhedakaṃ parameśvari ||
somavāravrataparo vidhivat pūjayec chivam |
naktāśī śraddhayāyukto dayāsatyasamanvitaḥ ||
dattasya vedapārajñe rathānāṃ ca śatasya ca |
vājibhiḥ śubhacihnaiś ca yuktānāṃ vedavādibhiḥ ||
caturvideṣu vipreṣu pradattasya ca yat phalam |
tat phalaṃ labhate devi mānavo bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||
vratānte pratimāṃ kuryād raupyaṃ somaṃ caturbhujam |
trayodaśaghaṭān śvetavastrayugmasamanvitān ||
saṃpūrṇāni subhakṣyaiś ca vaṃśapātrāṇi pārvati |
teṣām upari yatnena dadyāt sarvārthasiddhaye ||
suśubhena sugandhena susnigdhenojjvalena ca |
bhaktena ghṛtapakvaiś ca mudgaśālighṛtais tathā ||
brāhmaṇān atha saṃpūjya bhaktiyuktena cetasā |
trayodaśaghaṭān dadyād gāś ca śvetā manoramāḥ ||
tathānena vidhānena viprā vastravicitritāḥ |
[564]        upānahayutāḥ kāryāś cittavittānusārataḥ ||
dadyāt svācārasaṃpannabrāhmaṇeṣu maṇīṣiṣu |
dakṣayed gṛhasāreṇa punar eva kṣamāpayet ||
tato guruṃ bhaktipūrvam āsane copaveśayet |
arcayed gandhapuṣpādyair dhūpadīpavilepanaiḥ ||
na guroḥ sadṛśī mātā na guroḥ sadṛśaḥ pitā ||
saṃsārād uddhared yo hi vratadānopadeśataḥ |
gosvāmī pūjito yasmāt pārvatyā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ||
tasmāt saṃpūjayed bhaktyā gurubhāryāsamanvitam |
arcayet prathamaṃ tatra pūjayā pādasaṃsthayā ||
dadyād vastrāṇi dviyāni suvarṇābharaṇāni ca |
amūlyāni tu ratnāni grāmakṣetrapurāṇi ca ||
nagarāṇi gṛhaṃ divyaṃ yac cānyat surasundari |
vāhanāni vicitrāṇi gajavājirathādikam ||
anyāni yāny abhīṣṭāni tāni sarvāṇi dāpayet |
gaur guroḥ (?) saṃpradātavyā suvastrāṃ ca surūpiṇī ||
svarṇaśṛṅgī raupyakhurā kāṃsyadohā payasvinī |
tāmrapṛṣṭā suśīlā ca vastraprāvṛtadehikā ||
abhyarcya vidhinā dadyād vratasaṃpūrṇahetave |
saptadhānyaṃ yathāśaktyā dāpayet prayato vratī ||
dīpadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ gurave jñānadāyine |
evaṃ guruṃ praṇamyātha śaktyā dakṣiṇayā yajet ||
[565]        dīpadānaṃ prakartavyaṃ gurave jñānadāyine |
kṣamāpayec ca tat sarvaṃ devādipratimāṃ dadet ||
tatas tapasvināṃ devi mama darśanahetunā ||
sugandhaghṛtasaṃmiśrapūpaiḥ kṛśarapāyasaiḥ |
dhārikāśokavallībhiḥ pūrikāmaṇḍakais tathā ||
dadhidugdhasamopetaṃ bhojanaṃ dāpayet sudhīḥ |
tapasvino brāhmaṇāṃś ca liṅgamūrtiś caturvidhā ||
mama rūpam idaṃ yasmāt tasmāt pūjyaṃ catuṣṭhayam |
śivāṅkitaiś ca śāstrajñair deśakair dharmacintakaiḥ ||
jaṭāmudrādisaṃyuktair bhasmocchalitavigrahaiḥ |
brahmacaryarataiḥ śāntair lobhamatsaravarjitaiḥ ||
īdṛśaiḥ śivapātraiś ca bhuktaiḥ phalam anuttamam |
bhojanānte pradātavyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsakam ||
śvetacandanakaupīnaṃ datvā tāṃś ca visarjayet |
śaktito bhojanaṃ deyaṃ yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ ||
kṛpaṇānāthadīnānāṃ suhṛdāṃ yācatām api |
evaṃ vidhisamāyukto gacchate paramaṃ padam ||
bhogān bhuṅkte sarvaloke śatakoṭiyugaṃ taret |
kanyābhir veṣṭito devi ramate svecchayā priye ||
mama loke vaset tāvad yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam |
mama vīryabalopetas trinetraḥ śūlapāṇikaḥ ||
māhātmyāt somavārasya ante muktim avāpnuyāt |
pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇena saṃcīrṇaṃ tathā vai padmayoninā ||
devadānavagandharvaiḥ piśācoragarākṣasaiḥ |
[566]        ṛṣibhiḥ kṣitipais tadvat svāyaṃbhuvamukhaiḥ priye ||
anyaiś ca mānavaiḥ śuddhair āstikair dharmatatparaiḥ |
na deyaṃ duṣṭacittāya śuddhihīnāya na kvacit ||
śāstradharmadviṣe naiva viḍambakajanāya ca |
ācāryadevaviprāṇāṃ vratināṃ vrataśīlinām ||
vahnidevasutīrthānāṃ nindakāya na vai kvacit |
ārttau naiva parityājyaṃ vratam etat sudurlabham ||
vratatyāgān mahādoṣa iti jñātvā samārabhet ||
guroḥ samīpe kurvīte vratam etan na saṃśayaḥ |
anyathā guruhīnasya niṣphalaṃ jāyate vratam ||
saṃdehaḥ sarvakāryeṣu guruhīnasya vai bhavet |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gurum eva samāśrayet ||
atha saṃkṣepato vakṣye vratamāhātmyam uttamam |
ye caranti narā devi striyaś cāpi subhāvitāḥ ||
teṣāṃ janmasahasre 'pi na śoko jāyate kvacit ||
na dāridryaṃ na rogaś ca santaticcheda eva ca |
kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya sthāpayed indrasadmani ||
itthaṃ śṛṇoti māhātmyaṃ padyamānaṃ vratasya ca |
śrāvayed bhaktisaṃyukto rudrasyānucaro bhavet ||
kriyamāṇaṃ tathā paśyed vratam etat priyaṃ mama |
bhaktiyukto naraḥ śrutvā yaś cāivānupramodate ||
matiṃ dadāti yaś cāpi sa yāti śivamandiram ||
iti skandapurāṇoktasomavratam |
[567]
atha bhaumavratam |
svātyām aṅgārakaṃ gṛhya kṣapayen naktabhojanam |
saptame tv atha saṃprāpte sthāpitaṃ tāmrabhājane ||
haimaṃ raktāmbaracchannaṃ kuṅkumenānulepanam |
naivedyaṃ śubhrakaṃ sāraṃ pūjya puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ||
mantreṇānena taṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine |
kujanmaprabhavo 'pi tvaṃ maṅgalaḥ paṭhyate budhaiḥ ||
amaṅgalaṃ nihiṃsyāśu sarvadā yaccha maṅgalam |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ bhaumavratam |
bhaumo 'yam aiśvaraḥ putraḥ pṛthivyāṃ janito mahān |
rūpeṇaiva sadā ramyo varadānād divaukasām ||
asyaiva divase prāpte tāmrapātraṃ suśobhanam |
paripūrṇaṃ guḍenaiva varṣam ekaṃ pradāpayet ||
vratānte dāpayed dhenuṃ yathoktaphalasaṃyutām |
brāhmaṇāya surūpāya avyaṅgitaśarīriṇe ||
evaṃ vratavidhiṃ divyaṃ yaḥ kaścit kurute naraḥ |
rūpavān dhanavāṃś caiva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ bhaumavāravratam |
[568]                yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
devadeva jagannātha purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
sarvārthasādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ kathaya me prabho ||
bhaumīyam arcanaṃ brūhi māhātmyaṃ tasya me prabho |
vratena yena cīrṇena naro duhkhāt pramucyate ||
śrībhagavān uvāca |
yad uktaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvakāmārthasādhanam |
grahāṇām adhipo bhaumaḥ pūjayed bhaumavāsare ||
maṅgalo bhūmiputraś ca ṛṇahartā dhanapradaḥ |
sthirāsano mahākāyaḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakaḥ ||
lohito lohitāṅgaś ca sāmagānāṃ kṛpākaraḥ |
dharātmajo kujo bhaumo bhūtido bhūminandanaḥ ||
aṅgārako yamaś caiva sarvarāgāpahārakaḥ |
sṛṣṭikartā prahartā ca sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ ||
etāni kujanāmāni prātar utthāya yaḥ paṭhet |
ṛṇaṃ na jāyate tasya dhanaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
trikoṇaṃ ca sakā kāryaṃ madhye chidraṃ prakalpayet |
kuṅkumena sadā lekhyaṃ raktacandanam eva ca |
koṇe koṇe prakalpyāni trīṇi nāmāni bhūmija ||
āraṃ vakraṃ bhūmijaṃ ca raktagandhaiś ca pūjayet |
sthāpayed avraṇe kumbhe jalapūrṇe savastrake ||
raktadhānyaiś ca naivedyair arghyaṃ raktaphalais tathā |
raktagandhaiś ca dūpaiś ca puṣpadīpādibhis tathā ||
[569]        maṅgalaṃ pūjayed bhaktyā maṅgale 'hani sarvadā |
ṛṇarekhā prakartavyā aṅgāreṇa tadagrataḥ ||
tāṃ tu pramārjayet paścād vāmapādena saṃspṛśan |
ekaviṃśatināmāni paṭhitvā tu dināntake ||
rūpavān dhanavāṃś caiva jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā yaḥ paṭhet susamāhitaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte na saṃdeho ṛṇaṃ hatvā sukhī bhavet |
pūjito devadeveśo maṅgalo maṅgalapradaḥ ||
ujjayinyāṃ samutpanno bhaumo bhaumaś caturbhujaḥ |
bharadvājakule jātaḥ śaktiśūlagadādharaḥ ||
varado meṣam ārūḍhaḥ skandaprāyas taḍitprabhaḥ |
syonāpṛthivī mantreṇa dale yāme pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
pratiṣṭhāmantraḥ |
bhūmiputro mahātejāḥ kumāro raktavastrakaḥ |
jvaladaṅgārasadṛśo bhaumaḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
prasīda devadeveśa vighnahartā dhanaprada |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ mama śāntiṃ prayaccha vai ||
bhūmiputro mahātejāḥ svedodbhavaḥ piṇākinaḥ |
dhanārthī tvāṃ prapanno 'smi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo 'stu te ||
arghyamantraḥ |
gautamena purā pṛṣṭo lohitāṅgo mahāgrahaḥ |
[570]        kathaya tvaṃ mahābhāga guhyaṃ pūjārcane vidhim ||
gautama uvāca |
mantram ārādhanaṃ brūhi sarvaprāṇibhayāpaham |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam ||
sarvayajñaphalaṃ yena sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet |
tapojapyāny anekānāṃ phalaṃ yenaiva labhyate ||
rūpaṃ ca sakalaṃ yena vāhanāyudhasaṃyutam |
yena pūjitamātreṇa jāyate sukham uttamam ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kāle navaphalapradam |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam ||
sarvasaukhyapradānānāṃ phalaṃ yena ca labhyate |
tad vrataṃ brūhi me deva lohitāṅgo mahāgrahaḥ ||
bhauma uvāca |
śṛṇu sādho mahābhāga dharmaśārada gautama |
vrataṃ pūjā paraṃ dānaṃ yad gopyaṃ bhuvanatraye ||
āsīt pūrvaṃ sunandiko brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ |
tasya bhāryā sunandīkā vandhyā tu bahulobhinī ||
[571]        tasyāpatyaṃ na saṃjātaṃ bṛddhatvavandhyabhāvataḥ |
tenānyasya sutā jātu suśīlā rūpasaṃyutā ||
brāhmaṇasya kule jātā gṛhītvā poṣitā svayam |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā madvratena tu gautama ||
pūrvajanmani tenāhaṃ pūjitaś caiva bhāvitaḥ |
tāṃ putrīṃ ca gṛhe tasya brāhmaṇī sā hy apālayet ||
nityaṃ prasūyate svarṇam aṣṭāṅgāt kanakadyutiḥ |
tena svarṇenāsau vipro dhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ ||
koṭikoṭīśvaro vipro rājate bhūmimaṇḍale |
varṣaiḥ katipayair vipra sā kanyā yauvanottamā ||
dṛṣṭvā nandīkavipreṇa daśavarṣāṃ manasvinīm |
vivāhārthaṃ tu viprasya datvā someśvarasya ca ||
vedoktavidhinā tatra vivāham akarot tadā |
vaiṣaiḥ katipayair vipras tāṃ kanyāṃ prauḍhayauvanām ||
ādāya śvaśuragṛhān nirgatā śubhavāsare |
svadeśoparimārgeṇa gacchamānas tv aharniśam ||
vanānte gahvare ghore 'raṇye parvatamadhyage |
sunandī ca vane tasmin mandalobhaprabhāvataḥ ||
sarvasunye vane tasmin mahālobhena bhāvitaḥ |
mārge calati vipro 'sau ghātituṃ viddhatiṃ svakam ||
tenāsau ghātito vipraś caurarūpeṇa sādarāt |
[572]        patiṃ mṛtaś ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā sā nārī bhayapīḍitā ||
yāvat prakṣipya kāṣṭānāṃ madhye caive hutāśanam |
patideham upādāya cikṣepa citimadhyataḥ ||
patinā saha vipreṇa maraṇe kṛtaniścayā |
patir brahma svayaṃ devaṃ dhyāyantrī ca pade pade ||
patiṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya citāyāś ca samīpataḥ |
cityāṃ yāvat praviśati tadāham avadañ ca tām ||
tasmin kāle ca tuṣṭo 'haṃ yācayasva manoratham |
brāhmaṇī uvāca |
yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva tadā jīvatu me patiḥ |
bhauma uvāca |
ajaro 'py amaro vatse tvadbhartāyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
anyathā ca mahāsādhvi cirāṃ tribhuvanakṣamam ||
brāhmaṇī uvāca |
yadi tuṣṭo 's deveśa grahāṇām adhipa prabho |
ye tvāṃ ghaṭe samālikhya raktacandanacarcitam |
raktapuṣpaiś ca saṃpūjya pratyūṣe bhaumavāsare ||
vaidhavyaṃ tu kṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ vyādhirājamayaṃ tathā |
sarpāgniśatrusaṃvādaṃ viyogaṃ svajanasya ca ||
mā kuruṣva mahīputra yadi tuṣṭo 'si me prabho |
śrībhauma uvāca |
ekaviṃśatibhaumāś ca madbhaktāś ca jitendriyāḥ |
[573]        ekāhāraiḥ sītānnaiś ca caturdīpālikair gṛhe ||
arghyas tu sakalair mantrair vedapaurāṇikodbhavaiḥ |
svaśaktyā bhojanaṃ vipre dātavyaṃ sahiraṇyakam ||
yuvānaṃ raktam anaḍvāhaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
teṣāṃ pīḍā kadā kasya grahasya na bhaviṣyati ||
bhūtavetālaśākinyaḥ prabhavanti na hiṃsakāḥ |
evam astu tadā tasya ity uktvāntaradhīyate ||
vratamātre tu ye lokāḥ pīḍitā vipadaṃ gatāḥ |
yaḥ paṭhati imaṃ vrataṃ sa prāpnoti viṣṇupuram ||
tat prāpnoti naraḥ samyak gatiḥ syāc ca prabhāvataḥ |
udyāpanaṃ prakartavyaṃ madvratasya samāptaye ||
udyāpanaṃ vinā vipra phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ na jāyate |
ekaviṃśatibhaumāś ca kartavyā ekabhāvataḥ ||
āpado vilayaṃ yānti sukhaṃ caiva pravardhate |
yaḥ śṛṇoti vrataṃ vipra mānavaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
tasya māsakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vilayaṃ yānti vardhate |
sadā niyamasaṃyuktaḥ pratyūṣesu samāsthitaḥ |
yāvajjīvaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ karoti bhuvanatraye ||
susamṛddho bhaved vipraḥ putrapautras tu vardhate |
ante cāpi paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra sūryādayo grahāḥ ||
[574]        evam uktvā tadā tatra maṅgalo 'pi divaṃ gataḥ ||
idaṃ vrataṃ tvayā khyātaṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakam |
idaṃ vrataṃ kariṣyanti teṣāṃ pīḍā na jāyate ||
strībhir vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ puruṣaiś ca viśeṣataḥ |
teṣāṃ muktir na saṃdehaḥ svargavāso na saṃśayaḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇe bhaumavratam |
kanakamayaśarīras tejasā durnirīkṣyo
hutavahasamakāntir mālave labdhajanmā |
avanitanaya eṣa stūyate bhārate yo
dadatu mama vibhūtiṃ maṅgalaḥ suprasannaḥ ||
gautama uvāca |
udyāpanavidhiṃ tasya samyag brūhi prasādataḥ |
yena jñātena jagata upakāro mahān bhavet ||
maṅgala uvāca |
vijñeyo maṇḍapa svasmiṃs tv aṣṭahastapramāṇataḥ |
sthaṇḍilaṃ madhyataḥ kāryaṃ hastaikasya pramāṇataḥ ||
maṇḍalaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ māmakaṃ raktaśālinam |
pūrvoktāni ca nāmāni maṇḍale pūjayet tataḥ ||
[575]        maṇḍalaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ patrair viṃśatibhir yutam ||
dvāropadvārasahitaṃ vīthikākarakair yutam |
pūjā tatra prakartavyā raktacandanapūrvikā ||
javāpuṣpais tu pūjyāni mama nāmāni pūrvataḥ |
sallakyā dhūpadānaṃ ca naivedyaṃ paulikaḥ smṛtām ||
pūjāphalair mahārghyaṃś ca dātavyā nārikelayuk |
javāpuṣpeṇa dātavyo vratodyāpanasiddhaye |
kumbhe me pratimāṃ snāpya sauvarṇīṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ ||
raktavastreṇa saṃśchādya pūjāṃ pūrvoktamantrataḥ |
aṣṭottaraśataṃ homaṃ pūjānte kārayed budhaḥ ||
javāyāḥ kusumānāṃ tu ghṛtasya tu yathāvidhi |
tilākṣatānām ācārya.ṛtvigbhir vedapāragaiḥ ||
agnir mūrddhotamantreṇa raktaśāleś carus tathā |
śāntikaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ yathoktena vidhānataḥ ||
padmamadhye karṇikāyāṃ mama sūktam atandritaḥ |
pūjayed yajamānas (?) tu śeṣanāmāni pūrvataḥ ||
maṅgalāya namaḥ pādau bhūmiputrāya jānunī |
ṛṇahartar namaṃs tūrū (?) kaṭiṃ dhanapradāya ca ||
sthirāsanāya guhye tu mahākāyāya (?) corasi |
sarvakāmapradātre tu vāmabāhuṃ prapūjayet ||
[576]        lohitāya dakṣabāhau lohitākṣāya kaṇṭhataḥ |
āsye saṃpūjayen māṃ ca sāmagānāṃ kṛpākaram ||
dharātmajaṃ nāsikāyāṃ kūjaṃ ca nayanadvaye |
bhaumaṃ lalāṭapaṭṭe ca bhūmijāya namo bhruvau ||
mūrdhni saṃpūjayen māṃ ca bhūminandananāmataḥ |
aṅgārakaṃ śikhāyāṃ tu yamaṃ kavacadeśataḥ ||
sarvarogāpahāraṃ ca astre saṃpūjayet sadā |
ākāśe sṛṣṭikartāraṃ prahartāram adhas tathā ||
sarvāṅgeṣu prapūjyo 'smi sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
evaṃ pañcopacāreṇa pūjānte vratakāriṇā ||
acchidraṃ yācanīyaṃ tu bhaktiyuktena cetasā |
ācārya.ṛtvijo brūyuḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ vratam astv iti ||
vratānte pūjayed vipraṃ guruṃ patnīsamanvitam |
raktavastraṃ parīdhāpya padaṃ dadyād yathoditam ||
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ caiva bhojanam vividhaṃ tathā |
bhaktyā dadyād anaḍvāhaṃ vratānte mama tuṣṭaye ||
ṛtvijo 'pi tadā pūjyā matprītyarthaṃ svaśaktitaḥ |
bhojanācchādanādyaiś ca saṃskārair vividhair girā ||
ittham udyāpanaṃ ye tu kurvanti vratakārakāḥ |
teṣāṃ pīḍā kadā kasya grahasya na bhaviṣyati ||
bhūtavetālaśākimyaḥ prabhavanti na hiṃsakāḥ |
na ṛṇaṃ ca bhavet teṣāṃ dhanaṃ teṣāṃ bhaved dvayaṃ (?) ||
[577]        yeṣāṃ santānavāñchā syāt te labhante bahūn sutān |
ity uktvā gautamasyāgre divaṃ prāpto mahāgrahaḥ ||
vratamātre tu ye lokāḥ pīḍitāḥ vipadāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
āpado vilayaṃ yānti sumukhaṃ caiva pravardhate ||
ya stavīti vrataṃ bhaktyā mānavas tu jitendriyaḥ |
tasya māsakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tatkṣanāt ||
sadā tu niyamārūḍhaḥ pratyūṣe susamāhitaḥ |
yāvajjīvaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ karoti bhuvanatraye ||
susamṛddho bhaved vipraḥ putrapautraiḥ sa vardhate |
ante yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra sūryodayo grahāḥ ||
avāpnoti naraḥ samyag vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
yāvajjīvaṃ na śaknoti vrataṃ kartuṃ naro yadi ||
udyāpanaṃ vidhāyaiva moktavyaṃ vratam uttamam |
udyāpanaṃ tu śāstroktaṃ kartavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ ||
aśakto brāhmaṇānujñāṃ gṛhītvā tu visarjayet |
anyathā kurute yas tu kuṣṭhī cāndhaḥ prajāyate ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇānujñayā vratam |
kartavyaṃ tu susaṃpūrṇam udyāpanasamanvitam ||
[578]        dharāmarāṇāṃ vacanair avasthitā
divaukasas tīrthamakhaiḥ sametāḥ |
na laṅghayec cāpi vacāṃsi teṣāṃ
śreyo'bhikāmī puruṣo vijānan ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ maṅgalavratodyāpanam |
atha budhavratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
viśākāsu budhaṃ prāpya sapta naktāni cācaret |
budhaṃ hemamayaṃ kṛtvā sthāpitaṃ kāṃsyabhājane ||
śuklamālyāmbaradharaṃ śuklagandhānulepanam |

tattvāvabodhaṃ kurute rājaputrāya te namaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottare budhavratam |
[579]
atha guruvratam |
anurādhāsv athācāryaṃ devānāṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ |
pūrvoktakramayogena sapta naktāny athācaret ||
haimaṃ hemamaye pātre sthāpayec ca bṛhaspatiḥ |

pādukāchatrasahitaṃ sadaṇḍaṃ sakamaṇḍalum |

dharmaśāstrārthaśāstrajña jñānavijñānapāraga |
pralabdhabuddhigāmbhīrya devācārya namo 'stu te ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ guruvratam |
atha śukravratam |
śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṃprāpya pūjayen naktabhojanaḥ |
pūrvoktakramayogena dvijasaṃtarpaṇena tu ||
saptame 'tv atha saṃprāpte sauvarṇaṃ kārayet sitam |
raupye vā kāṃsyapātre vā sthāpayitvā bhṛgoḥ sutam ||
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā śvetavastrānulepanaiḥ |
agre tasya pradātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam ||
[580]        dadyād anena mantreṇa brāhmaṇāya vicakṣaṇaḥ |

hatvā grakṛtān doṣān āyurārogyado bhava ||

viṣamasthe bhṛgusute mahāśāntikaraṃ vratam |

hotavyaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā kṣīrair ghṛtena ca |
iti bhaviṣyottaroktā mahāśāntiḥ |
atha śanivratam |
bhaviṣyapurāṇāt |
kadācid āśramapadaṃ pippalādasya nāradaḥ |
jagāma kāmacāreṇa paryaṭann avanītalam ||
tam ātitheyaḥ śreyo'rthī pippalādo 'tha nāradam |
vihitāyāṃ saparyāyāṃ yogajñaṃ tam athābravīt ||
mune vane ciraṃ kālam ālambya sthitavān aham |
aśvatthavṛkṣam akṣīṇachāyam āyatasatphalam ||
[581]        kva gatau māṃ nidhāyeha madīyau pitarau mune |
taṃ prāha nāradaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvalokāśaniḥ śaniḥ ||
pīḍayāmāsa vasudhāṃ sarveṣām asudhāriṇām |
rogāṃś cakāra deheṣu geheṣu dhanasaṃkṣayam ||

ādāya kāyapoṣāya sāyam āyāti te pitā ||
klībabhāvaṃ puraskṛtya śaner durbhikṣaśikṣitam |
tvāṃ vihāya sa cāpatsu gataś cetas tataḥ kvacit ||
evam uktaḥ śiśukrodhāt prajvalann iva pāvakaḥ |
ālokya gaganād bhūmau pātayāmāsa vai śanim ||
yatamāno giraḥ śṛṅge lagnaḥ kañjo babhūva ha |
dharaṇyāṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāskarātmajam āturam ||
nanarta bhujam utkṣipya nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ |
harṣād devān athāhūya darśayāmāsa taṃ śanim ||
atha devās tadā prāptā brahmarudrendrapāvakāḥ |
śaniṃ te sāntvayāmāsuḥ krodhamugdhaṃ muniṃ ca tam ||
svasti te 'stu mahābhāga pippalāda mahāmune |
bhadraṃ te 'tra kṛtaṃ nāma nāradena maharṣiṇā ||
anvarthayuktaṃ viprendra jīvitaṃ pippalādanāt |
[582]        atas tvaṃ pippalādeti loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi ||
ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti snātvā puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
gṛhāśramapade ramye kṣipeyur bhaktibhāvitāḥ ||
saptajanmāntaraṃ yāvat putrapautrānugāminī |
teṣāṃ lakṣmīr na dūrasthā bhaviṣyati kadācana ||
smariṣyanti ca ye 'pi tvāṃ pippalādeti nāmataḥ |
teṣāṃ śanaiścarakṛtā na pīḍāpi bhaviṣyati ||
kṣamasvāsya mahābhāga nirdoṣo 'yaṃ grahāgraṇīḥ |
caran vṛkṣaṃ śanair eṣa śubhāśubhaphalapradaḥ ||
haṭhasādhyā grahāś caite na bhavanti kadācana |
balihomanamaskāraiḥ śāntiṃ yacchanti pūjitāḥ ||
ato 'rtham asya divase snānam abhyaṅgapūrvakam |
kāryaṃ deyaṃ ca viprāya tailam abhyaṅgahetave ||
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat prāpte śanidine naraḥ |
tailaṃ dadāti viprāṇāṃ svaśaktyānyajanasya tu ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte prāpte tasya dine punaḥ |
lauhaghaṭārpitaṃ sauriṃ tailakumbhe vinikṣipet ||
lauhe vā mṛṇmaye vātha kṛṣṇavastrayugānvitam ||
[583] śanirūpaṃ tu matsyapurāṇāt |
indranīladyutiḥ śūlī varado vṛṣavāhanaḥ |
vāṇavāṇāsanadharaḥ kirīṭy arkasutaḥ sadā ||
kṛṣṇagodakṣiṇāyuktaṃ kṛṣṇakambalaśāyinam |
abhyaṅgena svayaṃ snātvā kṛṣṇapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet ||
dhūpair dīpaiś ca naivedyaiḥ kṛśarānnais tilodanaiḥ |
pūjayitvā sūryaputraṃ kṣamasveti punaḥ punaḥ ||
kṛṣṇāya dvijamukhyāya tadabhāvetarāya ca |
deyaḥ śanaiścaro bhaktyā mantreṇānena vai dvija ||
śannodevīti viprāṇām itareṣāṃ śṛṇuṣva yaḥ |
krūrāvalokanavaśād bhuvanaṃ nāśayati yo graho ruṣṭaḥ |
tuṣṭo dhanakanakasukhaṃ dadāti so 'smān śanaiśvaraḥ pātu ||
yaḥ purā naṣṭarājyāya nalāya paritoṣitaḥ |
svapne dadau nijaṃ rājyaṃ sa me sauriḥ prasīdatu ||
koṇaṃ nīlāñjanaprakhyaṃ mandaceṣṭāprasāriṇam |
chāyāmārtaṇḍasaṃbhūtaṃ namasyāmi śanaiśvaram ||
[584]        namo 'rkaputrāya śanaiśvarāya
nīhāravarṇāñjanamecakāya |
śrutvā rahasyaṃ tava kāmadas tvaṃ
phalaprado me bhava sūryaputra ||
namo 'stu pretarājāya kṛṣṇadehāya vai namaḥ |
śanaiśvarāya krūrāya śuddhabuddhipradāyine ||
ya ebhir nāmabhiḥ (?) stauti tasya tuṣṭo dadāty asau |
tadīyaṃ tu bhayaṃ tasya svapne 'pi na bhaviṣyati ||
ity anena vidhānena śaktiṃ datvā visarjayet |
etad vadantu ye vipra cariṣyantīha mānavāḥ ||
śanes tu vāsare prāpte vatsaraṃ yāvad eva tu |
teṣāṃ śanaiścarī pīḍā deśe 'pi na bhaviṣyati ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
purā tretāyuge pārtha nāvarṣat pākaśāsanaḥ |
kathaṃcid durṇayād rājñas tasya rāṣṭre samantataḥ ||
tato rāṣṭraṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ babhūvātīva dāruṇam |
pataṅgamūṣakākīrṇaṃ cauravyālabhayākulam ||
tasmin ghorākule kāle sapatnīkaḥ sabālakaḥ |
kauśikaḥ svagṛhaṃ tyaktvā pararāṣṭram agāc chanaiḥ ||
mārgaṃ ca gacchatā tena yena kena maharṣiṇā |
tyaktaḥ sa bālakas tv eko durbharaṃ hi kuṭumbikam ||
tasmin kāle viśeṣeṇa kṣīṇe hy auṣadhisaṃcaye |
[585]        kṛtvā tan nirghṛṇaṃ karma tato 'sau kauśiko gataḥ ||
so 'pi bālaḥ kṣudhādīno diśā vīkṣya dṛśā api |
utthāya pippalasyādhomūlāny attuṃ pracakrame ||
kūpe jalaṃ papau nityaṃ tatraivāśramamaṇḍale |
kṛtvā samāśrito raudraṃ tepe ca vipulaṃ tapaḥ ||
athājagāma bhagavān nārado vedapāragaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnavadanaṃ kṣudhāktaṃ dvijapotakam ||
tadāsau tasya saṃskāraṃ cakre mauñjādibandhanam |
vedān adhyāpayāmāsa saharasyapadakramāt |
dadau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ dvādaśākṣaram ācyutam ||
vedābhyāsaratasyāsya viṣṇudhyānaparasya ca |
pratyahaṃ pippalādasya viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ yayau ||
vainateyasamārūḍhā nīlotpaladalacchaviḥ |
caturbhujaḥ pītavāsāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ ||
sa uvāca tadā tuṣṭo varaṃ brūhi yam icchasi ||
tac chrutvā nāradamukhaṃ samālokya śiśus tadā |
nāradenāpy anujñāto yogavidyām avāpa ca ||
datvā jñānaṃ sopadeśaṃ yogābhyāsaṃ ca nirmalam |
nāgārigamano viṣṇus tatraivāntaradhīyata ||
tato 'bhavan mahājñānī maharṣiḥ sa śiśus tadā |
nāradaṃ paripapraccha kenāhaṃ pīḍito mune ||
graheṇa graharūpeṇa bālarūpo 'tiduḥkhitaḥ |
na me pitā na me bhrātā jīvato 'smy asya pīḍayā ||
[586]        brāhmaṇyaṃ bhavatā dattaṃ mama daivād dvijottama ||
etac chrutvā tato vākyaṃ kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ |
śanaiścareṇa krūreṇa graheṇa tvaṃ hi pīḍitaḥ ||
pīḍitaś ca samasto 'pi deśo 'yaṃ mandacāriṇā |
tathaiva ca phalaṃ prāpta eṣa sauriḥ śanaiśvaraḥ ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
evam uktvā surāḥ sarve pratijagmur yathāgatam |
śanaiśvaro 'pi sve sthāne grahatvena pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
pippalādo 'pi brahmarṣir brahmājñāṃ pratipālayan |
śanaiśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya tuṣṭāva racitāñjaliḥ ||
koṇasthaḥ piṅgalo vakraḥ kṛṣṇo raudro 'ntakopamaḥ |
sauriḥ śanaiśvaro mandaḥ prīyatāṃ me grahottamaḥ ||
śanaiścaram iti stutvā pippalādo mahāmuniḥ |
raver jvalan vimānastho dṛśyate 'dyāpi mānavaiḥ ||
idaṃ śanaiśvarākhyānaṃ ye paṭhiṣyanti mānavāḥ |
teṣāṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha punaḥ pīḍā na bādhate ||
kṛṣṇāyasena ghaṭitāṃ graharājamūrtiṃ
lauhe nidhāya kalaśe tilatailapūrṇe |
yo brāhmaṇāya ravijaṃ pradadāti bhaktyā
pīḍā śanaiśvarakṛtā na h bādhate tam ||
[587]
iti bhaviṣyottare śanaiśvaravratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hy etad uttamam |
yena lakṣmīr dhṛtis tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kāntiś ca jāyate ||
mūlena sūryatanayaṃ gṛhītvā bharatarṣabha |
tasmin dine pūjanīyaṃ grahatritayam ādarāt ||
śanaiśvaraś ca rāhuś ca ketuś ceti kramān nṛpa |
homaṃ ghṛtatilaiḥ kuryād grahanāmnā ca mantravit ||
pṛthag aṣṭottaraśatam aṣṭāviṃśatir eva vā |
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā caiva ghṛtena tu |
yathākramaṃ śamīdūrvākuśāś ca samidhas tu tāḥ ||
saptame caiva saṃprāpte naktaṃ sūryasutasya ca |
grahās trayo 'pi kartavyā rāja lauhamayāḥ śubhāḥ ||
lauhapātre sthitāḥ sarve sauvarṇe vā kurūdvaha |
kṛṣṇavastrayugaṃ dadyād ekaikasya kramān nṛpa ||
atra śanirūpaṃ nirantaravratoktaṃ veditavyam |
karālavadanaḥ khaḍgacarmaśūlī varapradaḥ |
nīlasiṃhāsanayuto rāhur atra praśasyate ||
dhūmrā dvibāhavaḥ sarve gadino vikṛtānanāḥ |
gṛdhrāsanagatā nityaṃ ketavaḥ syur varapradāḥ ||
mṛganābhyā samālepya dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ tathā |
[588]        datvā naivedyakaṃ sāraṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet ||
śanaiścara namas tubhyaṃ namas te rāhave tathā |
ketave 'tha namas tubhyaṃ sarvaśāntiprado bhava ||
evaṃ kṛte bhaved yat tu tan nibodha dvijottama ||
yadi bhaumo raviyuto bhāskaro rāhuṇā saha |
ketavo mūrdhni tiṣṭhanti sarve pīḍākarā grahāḥ ||
anena kṛtamātreṇa sarve śāmyanty upadravāḥ ||
ya evaṃ kurute rājan sadā bhaktisamanvitaḥ |
tasya sānugrahāḥ sarve yacchanti vijayaṃ sukham ||
ya etāṃ śṛṇuyāc chāntiṃ grahāṇāṃ paṭhate 'pi vā |
tasya sānugrahāḥ sarve śāntiṃ yacchanti bhūpate ||
sūryaṃ vidhuṃ kujabudhau guruśukrasaurīn
hastādi.ṛkṣasahitān uditakrameṇa |
saṃpūjya hemaghaṭitān dvijapuṅgavāya
datvā pumān grahaṇena na pīḍyate 'tra ||
śanaiścaraṃ rāhuketūn lauhapātre vyavasthitān |
kṛṣṇāguruḥ smṛto dhūpo dakṣiṇā cātmaśaktitaḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktā śanaiścarādiśāntiḥ |
nakṣatratithiyogena tithīnāṃ grahayogataḥ |
punar eva pravakṣyāmi vratāni tu yathā sthitam ||
rauhiṇyāṃ cāṣṭamīyogo yadā bhavati saumyake |
[589]        viśeṣapūjā kartavyā putrakāmena yatnataḥ ||
puṣye śuklacaturdaśyāṃ guruyogo yadā bhavet |
atha vā somasaṃyogo viśeṣāt pūjya śaṅkaram ||
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ śivāya vinivedayet |
dhūpadīpopahārādyaiḥ pūrvavat pūjayec chivam ||
prāśanaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ kāryaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ vratam ||
ādityarevatīyogaś caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
aṣṭamyāṃ vā maghāyogo śivaṃ saṃpūjya pūrvavat ||
tilās tu prāśane śastā ādityavratam īritam |
ārogyaṃ jāyate tasya putrabandhugaṇaiḥ saha ||
rohiṇīcandrayogaś ca caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
aṣṭamyāṃ somasaṃyogāt tadā candravrataṃ caret ||
prāg uktena vidhānena śivaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ |
dadhi kṣīraṃ tu naivedyaṃ prāśanaṃ kṣīram eva ca |
kīrtim ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ prāpnuyān nānṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||
aśvinībhaumasaṃyogaś caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
aṣṭamyāṃ bharaṇīyogas tadā bhaumavrataṃ caret ||
saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā śivaṃ pañcopacārataḥ |
raktotpalaprāśanaṃ tu sāmrājyaṃ prāpnuyāc chubham ||
rohiṇībudhasaṃyogaś caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
aṣṭamyāṃ vā samāsena budhavrataṃ samācaret ||
śivaḥ pūjyo vidhānena mahāsnānapuraḥsaram |
mahāvartisamopetaṃ prāśanaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛtam |
[590]        putrārthadārāś ca yaśo vardhate tasya nānyathā ||
revatīgurusaṃyogaś caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
aṣṭamyāṃ tiṣyasaṃyogād guruvrataṃ tadā caret ||
prāśanaṃ kapilājyaṃ tu brāhmaṇīrasasamanvitam |
vāgīśatvam avāpnoti vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
śravaṇaṃ bhārgavayutaṃ caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
śukravrataṃ tadā viddhi punarvasvaṣṭamī yadā ||
saṃpūjya parameśānaṃ yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ |
prāśanaṃ madhu caivātra kartavyaṃ saṃyatātmanā |
mahāphalam avāpnoti vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
bharaṇīśaniyogas tu caturdaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
ārdrāyogas tathāṣṭamyāṃ tadā śanivrataṃ caret ||
śivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat prāśanaṃ sasyam eva ca |
śanir ekādaśastho hi phalaṃ yacchati śobhanam ||
viruddhaṃ śobhate vatsa tadarthaṃ vratam ācaret |
hemakupyapravālaṃ ca kambalaṃ tu krameṇa ca ||
śaṅkhaṃ ca tīkṣṇalauhaṃ ca kramād yatnena dāpayet |
yathā saṃbhavate vatsa ācāryāya prayatnataḥ ||
iti kālottaroktāni tithinakṣatravāravratāni |
indra uvāca |
svalpenaiva tu dravyeṇa mahāpuṇyaṃ yathā bhavet |
tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi grahayogaṃ sureśvara ||
[591]                brahmovāca |
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi yathā tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
alpakleśāṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ graharkṣatithiyaugikam ||
bhṛgupauṣṇāṣṭamīyogaṃ śivayogeṣu cottamam |
mṛduvargaś ca saubhāgyaṃ bhadrayā bhṛguvāsare ||
daivayogād yadā ṣaṣṭhī puṣarkṣaravivāsare |
skandayāgas tadā kāryaḥ sarvakāmaprasādhakaḥ ||
vāre caiva yadā sūrye saptamī vijayā matā |
tadā tu śobhano yogo bhavet sarvaguṇāvahaḥ ||
śaśiriktāsu saṃyoga ārdrakṣasya sureśvara ||
navamyāṃ maṅgalo yogo bhānubhūtadinaṃ yadā |
aṣṭamyāṃ cātha candro hi śravaṇena sukhāvahaḥ ||
ahivradhne kujāhe tu gaṇanāthasya cāhani ||
punarvasau guror vāro dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇena ca |
somaśambhuṃ tadā yāgaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvārthsādhakam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ yadā saumye kṛttikarkṣaṃ bhavet kvacit |
grahayāgas tadā kāryaḥ sarvaśāntipradāyakaḥ ||
svātyāṃ śanicaturthī ca umāyāge varā smṛtā ||
uttarāsu ca pūrvāsu bhānupūrṇāṣṭamīṣu ca |
grahaśāntyādikaṃ kṛtvā sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
guror ekādaśī puṣye rohiṇyāṃ vā śanaiścare |
sutasaubhāgyakāmāya yāgo raudravināyakaḥ ||
pūrṇimāsu ca sarvāsu aṣṭamīdvādaśīṣu ca |
[592]        caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāsu graharkṣeṣu śubheṣu ca |
sarveṣāṃ saṃbhaved yāgo bhaktipūrvo mahāmune ||
mantrasādhanam iṣṭāyū rudrayāgād avāpyate ||
śrīm edhā jñānam āyuṣyam amāyāgān mahāmune |
yogajñānaṃ yaśaḥ siddhiṃ mahādevād avāpnuyāt ||
ārogyaṃ suvratīyatvaṃ bhāskarāt prāpyate dhruvam |
gatim iṣṭāṃ yathākāmaṃ prayacchati trivikramaḥ ||
vijñānaṃ saṃbhavet tasya yas tu paśyed vināyakam ||
vigatārir bhavet ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ tu tatkṣaṇāt |
mātṛyāgān mahāsiddhiḥ sarveṣām api jāyate |
bhavet sa dhanavān puṃsāṃ prathamāhe hutāśanāt ||
svargāpavargasaṃsiddhir durgāyāgāt prajāyate |
māyādyair maṅgalādyaiś ca jyeṣṭhāyāṃ brahmavittamaiḥ ||
īśādyaiḥ kālikādyās tu yaṣṭavyā vidhinā muneḥ ||
ityādye devīpurāṇe grahatithyarkṣayāgamāhātmyakīrtanam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe vāravratāni |
[593]
atha trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
atha nakṣatravratāni |
manīṣī hemādrir nayavinayasaṃpattibhavanaṃ
dvijanmā sanmārgaprathitapadasaṃcāracaturaḥ |
trilokīlokānām avikalaphalaśreṇiracanā
vicitraṃ nakṣatravratagaṇam idānīṃ vitanute ||
puṣkara uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ karma tavānagha |
upoṣitau sadā puṣṇi yajamānapurohitau |
aśviny ṛkṣe śubhe snānaṃ kuryātāṃ tan nibodhata ||
akīlabhūmau dvau kumbau madhūkakusumānvitau |
aśvagandhayutau kṛtvā sthāpyāv atha sadā samau ||
tataḥ saṃpūjayed dvidvān nāsatyau śaśinaṃ tathā |
aśvinīṃ varuṇaṃ caiva śucivāsās tathā harim |
gandhamālyanamaskārair dīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā ||
tato 'śvamithunaṃ kāryaṃ sarvauṣadhiyutaṃ mṛdā |
praṇatena tato mūrddhā nāsatyābhyāṃ nivedayet ||
dhūpam aṣṭāṅgakaṃ dadyād devānāṃ tu dvijottama ||
aśvaloma tathāśvatthaphalamūle ca vā sadā |
[594]        ekatra nibhṛtaṃ kṛtvā maṇir dhāryas tu śobhanaḥ ||
alaṃ dadhattvāśvinam etad eva
snānaṃ prakurvan prayato manuṣyaḥ |
aśvān avāpnoti nirastasaṅkhyān
kulodbhavān vīryabalopapannān ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ aśvinīsnānam |
brahmovāca |
ity ete kathitāḥ kṛṣṇa tithiyogā mayā tava |
nakṣatradevatāḥ sarvāḥ nakṣatreṣu vyavasthitāḥ ||
iṣṭān kāmān prayacchanti yathāsthānaṃ sureśvara |
candramā yatra nakṣatre yadā samadhitiṣṭhati |
uktas tu devayajñas tu tadā sa saphalo bhavet ||
devatāś ca pravakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathātatham |
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi yajñaṃ caiva pṛthak pṛthak ||
aśvinyām āśvināv iṣṭvā dīrthāyur jāyate naraḥ |
vyādhibhir mucyate kṣipraṃ yo 'tyarthaṃ vyādhipīḍitaḥ ||
bharaṇyāṃ yamarāḍ iṣṭaḥ kusumair asitaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
tathā gandhādibhiḥ śubhrair apamṛtyuṃ vimocayet ||
analaḥ kṛttikāyāṃ tu ṛddhiṃ saṃpūjitaḥ parām |
raktamālyādibhir dadyād ghṛtahomena ca dhruvam ||
prajāḥ prajāpatiḥ prīta iṣṭo dadyāt paśūṃs tathā |
[595]        rohiṇyāṃ devaśārdūla gojanmāha jagatpate ||
mṛgaśīrṣe tathā somaṃ jātim ārogyam eva ca ||
ārdrāyāṃ tu śivaṃ pūjya paśūn vijayam eva ca |
sitaiḥ padmādibhir divyair devatvaṃ payasā ca vai |
putrān punarvasau dadyāc caruṇā tarpitā ditiḥ ||
tiṣye bṛhaspatir buddhiṃ vipulaṃ sukham eva tu |
bhogān gandhādibhir nāgā aśleṣāyāṃ prapūjitāḥ ||
tarpitāś ca prayacchanti bhakṣādyair madhuraiḥ śubhaiḥ |
maghāsu pitaraḥ puṣṭiṃ ghṛtapāyasatarpitāḥ ||
pūrvāyāṃ vijayaṃ dadyād bhago devaḥ sutarpitaḥ ||
bhaktyā prapūjito dadyād uttarāyāṃ tathāryamā |
bhartāram īpsitaṃ nāryāḥ puṃsaś ca varayoṣitam ||
nīrogatvaṃ tathāyuṣyaṃ saṃpadaṃ cārurūpatām |
puṣpavastrārcito haste dadyāt tejonidhis tathā ||
citrāsu pūjitas tvaṣṭvā (?)dadyād ārogyam eva ca |
svātyāṃ saṃpūjito vāyuḥ pitrān iṣṭān prayacchati ||
indrāgnau tu viśākhāyāṃ pītaraktaiḥ prapūjya ca |
dhanaṃ rājyaṃ ca labdhveha tejasvī nivaset sadā||
ratnair mitram anūrādhāsv evaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ |
