priyo janānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ciraṃ jīvati sarvadā ||
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūrvavat tv indram iṣṭvā puṣṭim avāpnuyāt |
[596]        guṇaiḥ sarvais tu saṃpūrṇaḥ karmaṇā vacanena ca ||
mūle nirṛtim iṣṭvā ca bhakṣais tu palalādibhiḥ |
pūrvavat phalam āpnoti svasthāne ca dhruvo bhavet ||
apa iṣṭvā jalair etair hutvā tatraiva pūrvavat |
saṃtāpān mucyate kṣipraṃ śārīrān mānasāt tathā ||
āṣāḍhāsu tathā viśvaviriñcyuturayogataḥ |
saṃpūjya śriyam āpnoti paraṃ vijayam eva tu ||
śravaṇe pūjito viṣṇuḥ sarvān kāmān prayacchati |
dhaniṣṭhāsu vasūn iṣṭvā na bhayaṃ prāpnuyāt kvacit ||
mahato 'pi bhayāt tīrṇo gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
varuṇaṃ śatabhiṣāsv arcya vyādhibhir mucyate naraḥ ||
ajam bhādrapadāyāṃ tu śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham |
saṃpūjya muktim āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
uttarāyām ahibradhnaṃ parāṃ śāntim avāpnuyāt ||
revatyāṃ pūjitaḥ pūṣā dadāti vividhān paśūn |
sitaiḥ puṣpais tathā dīpair dhūpair vijayavardhanaiḥ ||
ya ete vai samākhyātā yajñāḥ saṃkṣepato mayā |
nakṣatradevatānāṃ hi sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai |
tasmād vittānusāreṇa bhavanti phaladāyakāḥ ||
gantum icched yadānyatra kriyāprārambha eva ca |
[597]        nakṣatradevatāyajñaṃ kṛtvā taṃ sarvam ācaret ||
evaṃ kṛte hi tat sarve yātrāphalam avāpnuyāt |
kriyāphalaṃ tu saṃpūrṇam ity uktaṃ bhānunā svayam ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇokto nakṣatrapūjāvidhiḥ |
śrīrāma uvāca |
agnyaṃ daivam avāpnoti śatrunāśam athāpi vā |
svecchayā karmaṇā kena sadā manujapuṅgava ||
pūjayed vāsudevaṃ tu kuṅkumena sugandhinā |
śvetaiś ca kusumair hṛdyair dhūpaṃ dadyāc ca guggulam ||
ghṛtena dīpaṃ dadyāc ca raktavastraṃ tathaiva ca |
nivedanīyaṃ devāya tathā sarvaṃ nivedayet ||
hotavyaṃ ca samṛddhe 'gnau tathaiva ca surarṣabha |
āyudhāni ca deyāni brāhmaṇebhyas tu dakṣiṇā ||
kṛtvaitad agnyaṃ ripunāśakāri
kāryaṃ sadā śatrugaṇapramāthi |
kṛtvaitad agnyaṃ ripunāśam āśu
prāpnoti martyo na hi saṃśayo 'tra ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śatrunāśanavratam |
śrīrāma uvāca |
karmāṇi śrotum icchāmi kāmyāni gṛhiṇām aham |
tvattaḥ sarvajña dharmajña yāgogaṇanṛpātmaja ||
[598]                puṣkara uvāca |
kṛtopavāso yāmyarkṣe sopavāsasya bhārgava |
purodhāḥ snapanaṃ kuryāt kṛttikāsu yathāvidhi ||
prakīrṇamūlaiḥ kalaśair mṛnmayair atha kāñcanaiḥ |
pūrṇaiḥ sarvauṣadhigaṇais tathā tīrthodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
agnyaśvatthaśirīṣāṇāṃ nyagrodhānāṃ phalais tathā |
pātrapūrṇais tathā yuktais tilaiḥ kṛṣṇair dvijottama ||
raktamālyena sūtreṇa baddhakaṇṭhais tathaiva ca |
āgneyyāśāmukhaḥ snāpyo nīlavāsā dvijottamaḥ ||
vahniṃ kumāraṃ śaśinaṃ khaḍgaṃ varuṇam eva ca |
pūjayet kṛttikāsv eva gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā ||
pītaraktais tathā vastrair ghṛtadīpais tathaiva ca |
dadhnā gavyena lājābhir agnimantreṇa vāpy atha ||
kṛśarāpūpikābhiś ca apūpaiś ca pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
devatānāṃ yathoktānāṃ priyaṅguṃ juhuyāt tataḥ ||
gardabhāśvamayūrāṇāṃ lomāni manujottama |
dhārayed dakṣiṇe samyak śaktyā kanakam eva ca ||
śvetavāsās tataḥ paścāt pūjayen madhusūdanam |
karmaitat satataṃ kṛtvā gacched vahneḥ puraṃ sadā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ kṛttikāsnānam |
nandir uvāca |
rohiṇī janmanakṣatraṃ sākṣād devasya cakriṇaḥ |
[599]        tāmrarukmamayīṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnena saṃyutām ||
sthāpayed vastrayugmena puṣpadhūpaiḥ prapūjayet |
kālodbhavaphalair divyair naivedyair ghṛtapācitaiḥ ||
dvitīye 'hni samāpyaitad brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
śrotriyāya surūpāya bhikṣukāya kuṭumbine ||
svayaṃ naktena bhuñjīta rohiṇyā darśane kṛte |
evaṃvidhaṃ vrataṃ divyaṃ divi devāś ca cakrire ||
varṣe varṣe samāyāte devāś cādyāpi kurvate |
yaṃ yaṃ kāmam abhidhyāyan taṃ tam āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ rohiṇīvratam |
puṣkara uvāca |
upoṣitau kṛttikāsu yajamānapurohitau |
rohiṇyāṃ snapanaṃ kuryād yajamānasya bhārgava ||
kṣīravṛkṣaprarohājyasitamālyavibhūṣitān |
priyaṅgucandanopetān pañca kumbhān prakalpayet ||
prāṅmukho vrīhirāśisthaṃ kumbhais tair abhiṣecayet |
viṣṇuṃ śaśāṅkaṃ varuṇaṃ rohiṇīṃ ca prajāpatim ||
pūjayet saṃyataḥ sragvī gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
dhūpaḥ prajāpater deyas tathā viṣṇuśaśāṅkayoḥ ||
[600]        pañca piṣṭavṛṣān divyān dhūpaṃ ca vinivedayet |
pūjāsiddhāya homaṃ tu devatānāṃ ca kārayet ||
ghṛtena sarvabījaiś ca śuklavāsā jitendriyaḥ |
dakṣiṇā gurave deyā kāṃsyaṃ gaurvāsasau śubhe ||
suvarṇaṃ ca mahābhāga viprāṇām atha bhaktitaḥ |
pāṃśukardamasaṃyuktam aśvalomaśaphlaṃ tathā ||
śṛṅgaṃ ca trivṛtaṃ kṛtvā maṇir dhāryaḥ śubhapradaḥ |
alaṃ kriyārthaṃ tad idaṃ sadaiva
snānaṃ tu kurvan puruṣo 'tha vā strī |
putrān avāpnoti tathepsitāṃś ca
puṣṭiṃ tathāgryāṃ vipulāṃ ca kīrtim ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rohiṇīsnānam |
manur uvāca |
grahadoṣopasṛṣṭasya rājño rājasutasya ca |
mahiṣyo vā mṛtāpatyā dvijādiṣv atha vā jane ||
vipadyate phalaṃ yatra suprayatnakṛtodyame |
gajāśvagovṛṣāṇāṃ ca yatra hāniḥ prajāyate ||
yatra bhaumāntarīkṣe ca upasargaḥ pradṛśyate |
tatra kuryān mahābhāga yāgaṃ puṣpābhiṣecanam ||
mūla rājā samākhyātas tasya śākhā prajādikam |
upasaṃhārasaṃskāre śubhe vāpy aśubhe 'pi vā ||
[601]        yatnaḥ kāryaḥ sadā vatsa mūle śākhādikaṃ bhavet |
mūle vinaṣṭe naśyanti śākhādyāḥ phalasaṃcayāḥ ||
tadarthaṃ mūlarakṣāyāṃ yatitavyaṃ mahāmune |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sa hi hetuḥ prapadyate ||
brahmaṇā yā purā śāntir mahendrārthaṃ bṛhaspateḥ |
vyākhyātā kīrtayiṣyāmi tāṃ te śaunaka śṛṇv atha ||
puṣyasnānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
utpātaśamanaṃ divyaṃ yatra kutrāvadhāraya ||
valmīkatuṣakeśāsthikaṭukaṇṭakivarjite |
śigruśleṣmātadaurgandhivigate ca mahītale |
kaṅkakāpotagṛdhrolūkakākaparivarjite ||
suplute campakāśokavakulāmrātaśādvale |
taruṇavallivitate nirupahatadalānvite ||
sumadhuravṛkṣaprāye phalapallavaśobhite |
pakṣiśāvagaṇākīrṇe kṛkavākūpaśobhite |
jīvajīvakahārītaśatapatraśukākule ||
cakoracāsasaṃyukte cakravākopaśobhite |
śikhipārāvatāśrīkakokakokilanādite ||
madhupuṣpāsavasurāmadhūkakusumākule |
yāgaṃ kuryād dinoddeśe kṣetre 'raṇye 'tha vā śubhe ||
himādrāv ujjayante vā sahye vindhyācale 'pi vā |
nadīnāṃ puline vāpi saṅgame vā manorame ||
[602]        gorocanālaktarukmaśaṅkhakuṅkumaśobhite |
samudratīre kuryāc ca āśrame vā gṛhe 'pi vā ||
pūrodakplavabhūbhāge pradakṣiṇapathe jale |
śvāvimūṣikavirate karkaṭāvāsavarjite ||
varṇagandharasopetā ghanā snigdhā samā mahī |
yā kṛṣṭabījarohādyair bahuśaḥ suparīkṣitā ||
gatvā tāṃ sumuhūrte 'tha kauveryām adhivāsayet |
balipuṣpopahāraṃ ca mantrayuktaṃ nivedayet ||
āgacchantu surāḥ sarve ye 'tra pūjābhilāsinaḥ |
diśo nagā dvijāś caiva ye cānye aṃśabhāginaḥ ||
āvāhyaivaṃ tataḥ sarvān evaṃ brūyāt purohitaḥ |
svaḥ pūjāṃ prāpya yātāro datvā śāntiṃ mahībhūje ||
kṛtvā pūjāṃ tatas teṣāṃ rātrau tasyāṃ vratī vaset |
snātvā śubhāśvagovatsadadhiśarṣapadarśanam ||
puṣpadūrvākṣataphalalājadarśanam eva ca |
chatracāmaraśaṅkhābjaśitavastrādidarśanam |
lābho vā sarvakāmānāṃ pūraṇāya prakīrtitaḥ ||
phalapuṣpayutā vṛkṣāḥ kṣīriṇaḥ śubhadā matāḥ |
teṣām ārohaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāsāde bhaṣṭaṣādiṣu ||
candrākagrahaṇaṃ śastaṃ parvatārohaṇaṃ śubham |
nigaḍaṃ bandhanaṃ svapne vidviṣaś ca jayāvahaḥ |
parivartaṃ gireḥ kuryāc chakraṃ vācāvagūhati ||
[603]        veṣṭayed yas tu prāsādaṃ svapne tasya jayo bhavet |
labhate cepsitaṃ sarvaṃ lābho tasya tu vai bhavet ||
mṛtarodanahīnastrīgamanaṃ ca śubhāvaham |
svapne tu kūpapaṅkeṣu garteṣu taraṇaṃ śubham ||
nadīṣu taraṇaṃ śastaṃ samudrataraṇaṃ tathā |
nirjitya śatrusainyaṃ ca jayaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
kaṭakādyā alaṃkārāḥ putrarājyasukhapradāḥ |
suhṛdaṃ janavaipañcīlābhāḥ strīdhanadāyakāḥ ||
rudhirārambhaḥ pibed yas tu tarate vā yadi kvacit |
māṃsāsthibhakṣaṇe lābho labhate vā hitaṃ phalam ||
hāsyanṛtyacarotsāhapatanāḥ kalikārakāḥ ||
yāmye yātāgatākṛṣṭānayanaṃ bhayamṛtyudam |
paścime yānagāmitvaṃ tathā kūpapraveśanam |
uttare bhayadaḥ svapne raktamālyāmbarāgamaḥ ||
kharoṣtrakapikāpotavarāhāhiniśācarān |
dṛṣṭvāśubhān jayaḥ kāryo ghātapātaphalapradān ||
vātapittakaphottheṣu yānāgnitaraṇādiṣu |
grīṣmaśaradvasanteṣu prapādānaphalapradāḥ ||
śrutānukīrtaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam anubhūtaṃ vigarhitam |
na ceṣṭā yadi vā dṛṣṭāḥ pradoṣaprathame tathā ||
madhye madhyaphalāḥ sarve cānte śīghraphalapradāḥ |
govisargaṃ ca ye dṛṣṭās te tathā parikīrtitāḥ ||
[604]        dṛṣṭvā svapnān śubhān yāgaṃ kuryāt tv iṣṭaṃ tu kārayet |
snānaṃ devārcanaṃ homaṃ jayaṃ śāntiṃ samārabhet ||
kṛtvā sarvān labhet vatsa tato maṇḍalam ālikhet |
caturhastaṃ samārabhya yāvad dhastaśataṃ bhavet ||
maṇḍalaṃ tatra kartavyam ata ūrdhvaṃ na kārayet |
vimalaṃ vijayaṃ bhadraṃ vimānaṃ śubhadaṃ śivam ||
vardhamānaṃ ca devaṃ ca latākhyaṃ kāmadāyakam |
sacakaṃ svastikākhyaṃ ca iti dvādaśa maṇḍalāḥ ||
sitādiharitānāṃ ca rajaḥ kāryaḥ suśobhanaḥ ||
śāliṣaṣṭikakausumbharajanīharipatrajāḥ |
maṇividrumarāgāś ca bhaṣmanā abhimantritāḥ |
sitasarṣapadhūpāḍhyaṃ rajaḥ kṛtvā tu pātayet ||
astrarājaṃ nyasen mantrī sambhavanti padāni vā |
saumyaṃ sthānaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā gomayenopalepitam ||
candanāgurukarpūrakṣodadhūpādivāsitam |
bhūbhāgaṃ sumitaṃ siddhaṃ pūrvaṃ paścimam uttaram ||
yāmyaṃ svastikaśaṅkhādyaiḥ sūtraiḥ kāṇḍakamaṇḍitaiḥ |
padmapatrāṣṭakaṃ madhye triguṇatriguṇīkṛtam ||
dvārāṇi samasūtrāṇi kalikākeśarojjalam |
padmaṃ tathā ca śeṣāṇi svastikāny utpalāni ca ||
savye 'valambya haste tu rajaḥpātaṃ samārabhet |
madhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭhair upariṣṭād yathecchayā ||
adhomukhāṅgulī kṛtvā pātayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ |
[605]        samā rekhā tu kartavyāvicchinnā puñjavarjitā ||
aṅguṣthaparvavatsthūlā samā kāryā vijānatā ||
sasaktaṃ viṣamaṃ sthūlaṃ vicchinnaṃ kṛśalāvṛtam |
paryantam arpitaṃ hrasvam ālikhen na kadācana ||
sasakte kalahaṃ vidyād vakrarekhe ca vigraham |
atisthūle bhaved vyādhir nityaṃ pīḍā vimiśrite ||
bindubhir bhayam āpnoti śatrupakṣān na saṃśayaḥ |
kṛśāyāṃ cārthahāniḥ syād vicchinne maraṇaṃ dhruvam |
viyogo vā bhavet tasya iṣṭadravyasutasya ca ||
aviditvā likhed yas tu maṇḍalaṃ tu yathecchayā |
sarvadoṣān avāpnoti ye doṣāḥ pūrvabhāṣitāḥ ||
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ likhen maṇḍalam uttamam |
maṇḍalasya pramāṇena padmaṃ dvāre samālikhet ||
hastonaṃ na ca kartavyaṃ padmaṃ vipra kadācana |
nādhikaṃ caturūrdhvaṃ tu likhitavyaṃ vijānatā ||
pratāpāyuḥ śriyo dharmo rājyastrīrūpasaṃpadaḥ |
avāpyante 'rthalābhaś ca pūrvadvārae ca maṇḍale ||
buddhir medhā yaśaḥ saukhyam ārogyaṃ janavallabha |
sarvakāmārthasiddhiś ca uttaradvāri maṇḍale ||
putra āyur balaṃ caiva saubhāgyaṃ ripumardanam |
yajñakarmābhivṛddhiś ca paścimadvāri maṇḍale ||
tasya madhye punaḥ padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam |
caturvitastikaṃ vipre rājanye trivitastikam |
[606]        ardhadvayaṃ (?) tu vaiśyasya strīśūdair dvivitastikam ||
padmasyaivānupūrveṇa nālaṃ tadanupūrvaśaḥ |
vāruṇīṃ diśam āśritya nālaṃ tu parikalpayet ||
saptapātālagaṃ nālaṃ bhuvanāntaṃ prakīrtitam ||
karṇikā tu bhaven merur bījair grahagaṇaiḥ (?) sthitā |
keśaras tu bhaven nadyaḥ karṇikaiḥ parvatāsthitāḥ |
aṣṭau dalā diśaḥ proktā ṛṣayaḥ padmasaṃsthitāḥ ||
saptapātālabhūloko nālaṃ tu parikīrtitam |
īdṛśaṃ kalpitaṃ padmaṃ devadevena śambhunā ||
dhvajatoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ patākābhir alaṃkṛtam |
bhūrlokas tu dalā jñeyā digātmā śūnyagocaraḥ ||
svarlokaḥ karṇikā khyātas trailokyaṃ padmasaṃjñitam |
karṇikāyāṃ nyased devaṃ pujakale maheśvaram ||
mātaro grahanāgāś ca yakṣarakṣā divākarāḥ |
vasavo sunilokeśāḥ sarudrā bhuvanādhipāḥ ||
kalāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kṣaṇā yāmā rātry ahaḥ sasitāsitāḥ |
pakṣā māsā ṛtur bhāgāḥ samā yugayugāntarāḥ |
kalpāntāś ca mahākalpāḥ padme caivaṃ samālikhet ||
prathame maṇḍale devaṃ śivaṃ vighneśasaṃyutam |
gaṇanāyakasaṃyuktaṃ dvitīye varaṇe yajet ||
sagrahaṃ bhāskaraṃ prācyāṃ aiśānyāṃ tu pinākinam ||
saumyāsyaṃ keśavaṃ rakṣet paścimāsyaṃ pitāmaham |
[607]        tṛtīye varaṇe caivaṃ medinyām upakalpayet ||
nānāratnākarākīrṇe bhūyo devān samālikhet |
purohito yathāsthānaṃ nāgān yakṣān pitṝn surān ||
gandharvāpsarasaś caiva munīn siddhān nidhāpayet |
grahāṃś ca saha nakṣatraiḥ sarudrāś caiva mātaraḥ ||
skandaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśākāṃ ca lokapālān surastriyaḥ |
suvarṇair vividhaiḥ kṛtvā hṛdyair gandhaguṇānvitaiḥ ||
yathā saṃpūjayed vidvān gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
bhakṣyair anyaiś ca vividhaiḥ phalamūlādibhis tathā ||
pānaiś ca vividhair hṛdyaiḥ surākṣīrāsavādibhiḥ |
viśeṣād vihitā pūjā grahayajñe mayā purā ||
mātṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sāpy atraivopakalpyate |
piśācān dānavān rakṣān māṃsamadyaiḥ prapūjayet ||
abhyañjanāñjanatilair māṃsena pitaras tathā |
munayaḥ sāmargajubhir mālyais trimadhureṇa ca ||
nāgān aśeṣai ratnaiś ca varṇakaiś caiva pūjayet |
dhūpādyāhutidānaiś ca devān ratnaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ ||
gandharvāpsaraso gandhair mālyaiḥ sumanasā tathā |
śeṣāṃs tu sarvān balibhiḥ puṣpagandhaiś ca pūjayet ||
pratināmnā patākāś ca vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca |
sarveṣāṃ ca pradeyāni suyajñopahitāni ca ||
dakṣiṇe paścime vāpi vāyavyāṃ maṇḍalasya ca |
grahayajñavidhānena homaṃ mātṛmakhoditam ||
[608]        kṛtvā dravyair imair vatsa yathoktair lakṣaṇānvitaiḥ |
lājākṣataghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ tu sarṣapāḥ ||
siddhārthāḥ sumanogandhā dhūpāś ca sasitotkaṭāḥ |
gorocanā tilā darbhā mudgajātiphalāni ca ||
ghṛtapāyasasaṃpūrṇān sarāvān vinivedayet |
paścimāyāṃ tu vai vedyāṃ pūjāyāṃ snātako bhavet ||
kalaśān sudṛḍhān kuryāt lakṣaṇena vadāmi te |
utpattilakṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ kathayami mahāmune |
vācakāḥ kalaśāś caiva yena loke prakīrtitāḥ ||
amṛte mathyamāne tu sarvair devaiḥ sadānavaiḥ |
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim ||
utpannam amṛtaṃ tatra mahāvīryaparākramam |
tasya saṃdhāraṇārthāya kalaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
kalāṃ kalāṃ gṛhītvā ca devānāṃ viśvakarmaṇā |
nirmito 'yaṃ surair yasmāt kalaśas tena ucyate ||
kalaśasya mukhe brahmā grīvāyāṃ tu maheśvaraḥ |
mūle tu saṃsthito viṣṇur madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ ||
śeṣās tu devatāḥ sarvā veṣṭayanti caturdiśam ||
kukṣau tu sāgarāḥ sapta sapta dvīpās tu madhyataḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi grahāḥ sarve tathaiva kulaparvatāḥ ||
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadho merur eva ca |
rohito mālyavāṃś caiva sūryakāntiś ca parvatāḥ ||
gaṅgā sarasvatī sindhusubhagā yamunā nadī |
[609]        airāvatī śatadruś ca tathā vaitaraṇī nadī |
godāvarī narmadā ca mahī nāma mahānadī ||
kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaś ca ekahastaṃ pṛthūdakam |
amareśaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ gaṅgā sāgara eva ca ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni kalaśe nivasanti vai |
svāhā śāntiś ca puṣṭiś ca prītir gāyatrir eva ca ||
ṛgvedo 'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmadevas tathaiva ca |
atharvavedasahitāḥ sarve kalaśasaṃsthitāḥ ||
navaiva kalaśāḥ puṇyāḥ śambhumūrtisamudbhavāḥ |
gobhyopagobhyo marutaḥ sumandaś ca tathāparaḥ ||
manoharaḥ khalubhadraḥ pañcamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
virūjastanadūṣaś ca ṣaṣṭhasaptamakāv ubhau |
aṣṭamas tv indriyātīto navamo vijayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
navaiva kalaśāḥ khyātā adhidaivaṃ nibodha me |
śṛṇu vatsa yathā teṣāṃ diśo nyāse vyavasthitāḥ ||
navamo yaḥ samākhyāto vijayo nāma nāmataḥ |
śivas tatra sthitaḥ sākṣāt sarvapāpaharaḥ śubhaḥ ||
sa tu pañcamukhaḥ khyāto loke sarvārthasādhakaḥ |
pañcabrahmātmako yasmāt tena pañcamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
paścime tu mukhe sadyo vāmadevas tathottare |
pūrve tatpuruṣaṃ vidyād aghoraṃ cāpi dakṣiṇe ||
īśānaḥ pañcamo madhye sarveṣām uparisthitaḥ |
ete pañca mukhā vatsa pāpaghnā grahanāśanāḥ ||
[610]        sadyojāto bhavec chuklo vāmadevas tu pītakaḥ |
raktas tatpuruṣo jñeyo aghoraḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca ||
īśānaḥ paścime teṣāṃ sarvair varṇaiḥ samanvitaḥ |
kāmadaḥ kāmarūpī syāt jñānādhāraḥ śivātmakaḥ ||
kṣtīndro jyeṣṭhakalaśo dvitīyo jalasaṃbhavaḥ |
tṛtīyaḥ pavanaś caiva caturthas tu hutāśanaḥ |
pañcamo yajamānas tu ṣaṣṭhaś cākāśasaṃbhavaḥ ||
somas tu saptamaḥ prokta ādityaś ca tathāṣṭamaḥ |
ete cotpāditā divyāḥ śivenādhiṣṭhitāḥ purā ||
indrasya mūrtayaś cāṣṭau sūryasya tu nava sthitāḥ |
kṣitīndraḥ pūrvato nyasyaḥ paścime jalasaṃbhavaḥ ||
vāyavye vāyavo nyasya āgneye agnisaṃbhavaḥ |
nirṛte yajamānas tu aiśānyāṃ kāmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
saumya uttarato yojyaḥ sauraṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset |
nyasyaivaṃ kalaśānāṃ tu pūrvarūpaṃ vicintayet ||
kalaśānāṃ mukhe brahmā grīvāyāṃ viṣṇur eva hi |
madhye mātṛgaṇāḥ sarve sendrā devāś ca pannagāḥ ||
kukṣau tu sāgarās teṣāṃ saptadvīpā ca medinī |
śriyā caiva tathomā ca gandharvā ṛṣayas tathā |
pañcabhūtās tathā ghorās teṣām adharataḥ sthitāḥ ||
pūrṇāḥ pūtena toyena sitās tv ekāntatojjvalāḥ |
saritsaraḥkhātajena tāḍāgena jalena vā |
[611]        vāpīkūpāditoyena sāmudreṇa sukhāvahāḥ ||
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyāḥ sarvakilbiṣanāśakāḥ |
abhiṣeke sadā grāhyāḥ kalaśā īdṛśāḥ śubhāḥ ||
yātrāvivāhakāle vā pratiṣṭhāyajñakarmaṇi |
yojanīyā viśeṣeṇa sarvakāmaprasādhakāḥ ||
mṛtāpatyā tu yā nārī yā ca vandhyā prakīrtitā |
mūḍhagarbhā tv agarbhā ca durbhagā vyādhipīḍitā |
etāsāṃ (?) ca sadā kāryaṃ snāpanaṃ puṣyamaṇḍale ||
sarvaratnauṣadhīgandhaphalapuṣpasamanvitāḥ |
grahadoṣe prakartavyāḥ kalyāṇe maṅgale tathā ||
grahān cārayate yasmān mātaro vividhās tathā |
duritāṃś ca mahāghorāṃs tena te cārakāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ekaikāṃ tu kalāṃ mūrtaiḥ kṣityādyaiś ca yathākramam |
saṃhṛtya saṃsthitā yasmāt tena te kalaśāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
haimarājatatāmrā vā mṛnmayā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ |
pañcāṅgulāś ca vistīrṇā utsedhāḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulāḥ ||
kalaśānāṃ pramāṇaṃ tu mukham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavet |
aṣṭamūrtisthito yo 'sau sa śivaḥ padmasaṃbhavaḥ ||
mūrtayo 'ṣṭau gaṇās tasya karṇikāyāṃ śivaḥ sthitaḥ |
ye gaṇās te dalā nāgā ye nāgāḥ kalaśāś ca te ||
kalaśāś ca grahāḥ proktā lokapālā diśaś ca te |
etaiḥ sarvam idaṃ vyāptam ā brahmabhuvanaṃ jagat ||
durādharṣair mahāsattvaiḥ sarvapāpaviśodhakaiḥ |
[612]        ratnāni bījapuṣpāṇi phalāni kalaśe kṣipet |
puṣpamālāś ca vasrānnaṃ (vastrānnaṃ ?) sitacandanacarcitāḥ ||
vajramauktikavaidūryamahāpadmaiś ca sphāṭikaiḥ |
sarvaiḥ subhaiḥ phalair bilvanāraṅgoḍumbarais tathā ||
bījapūrakajambīra.āmrāmrātakadāḍimaiḥ |
yavaśālinivāraiś ca godhūmasitaśarṣapaiḥ ||
kuṅkumāgurukarpūramadarocanacandanaiḥ |
māṃsyelākuṣṭhakarpūrapatracaṇḍāsurājalam ||
niryāsāmbudaśaileyasarñjadevadalaṃ phalam |
jātīpatrakanāgāhvāḥ pṛkvā gaurī saparṇikā ||
vacā rātriḥ samañjiṣṭhā turaṣkaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakam |
durvā mohanabhṛṅgāraṃ śatamūlī śatāvarī ||
bālā nāgabalā devī sahadevījayākṣumāḥ |
punnāgomāsitāpāṭhā guñjā surasikālatā ||
bālakaṃ gajadantaṃ tu śatapuṣpā punar navā |
brāhmī devī śivā rudrā sarvagandhāni kāñcanam |
samāhṛtya śubhāny evaṃ kalaśeṣu nidhāpayet ||
kalyāṇaṃ vijayaṃ dhūpaṃ candraṃ dadyāt samaṅgalam |
sarvaratnam alaṃkāraṃ rocanākhyaṃ tu paṭṭakam ||
dvyaṅgulaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ vṛddhyā ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāvadhi |
vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā padmakaṃ trikagārbhikam ||
vāsavaṃ padmamadhye tu bhagasvastivināyakaiḥ |
[613]        śrīśrīvṛkṣasamārohaiḥ sarvadevaiḥ śubhānvitam |
sarvaratnasamopetaṃ padmaṃ kuryād dvihastakam ||
hastavistāram ucchrāye daśāṅgulasuśobhanam |
snānākhyaṃ sārdhahastaṃ tu patraṃ vṛntasamanvitam ||
śayyākhyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dadhyād dhanurmānaṃ sapīṭhakam |
gajasiṃhapadākīrṇaṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitam ||
siṃhākhyaṃ sārdhavistāraṃ daṇḍāsanam athāpi vā |
samapādaṃ grahākhyaṃ vā hemapatravibhūṣitam ||
vajrendranīlavarṇākhyaṃ mahārghamaṇicarcitam |
catuṣpādo 'tha vā kāryas trimaṇḍalasamo 'pi vā ||
vyāghracitrakapadmair vā upadhānāni kārayet |
anyair vā rañjitair vastrair mṛdutūlakapūritā ||
śayyā dairghyātha vistīrṇā caturhastā sulakṣaṇā |
padmapādāśvapādā vā gajasiṃhapadātha vā ||
dantidantavicitrā vā hemaratnavibhūṣitā |
śubhapatrorṇayā kāryāḥ kariṇyo hastam ucchirtāḥ ||
kinnarādyāś ca kartavyāḥ sarvaśobhāsamanvitāḥ |
subhagandhasamopetāḥ (?) sakuntā atha saṃgrahāḥ ||
śivopalasamaṃ sthānaṃ kāryaṃ vai śiradhāraṇam |
padmasvastikasandhānam utpalaṃ vihagānvitam ||
patravallīkṛtāpīḍaṃ hemadantasusañcitam |
vajrapadmamahāpadmarāgavaidūryabhūṣitam ||
gajakumbhasamākāram ardhacandrāktam eva vā |
[614]        sahasrakinnarīmānaṃ saptapañcaśatair api ||
nṛpeśaṃ sarvalokānāṃ triśataṃ dviśataṃ param |
tūlā śayyāsamā kāryā mṛdukoṣṭhakapūrakaiḥ |
upadhānaṃ vicitraṃ tu kartavyaṃ mṛdu vartulam ||
vṛttaṃ śṛṅgāṭakākāraṃ śravaṇākhyānam uttamam |
yānaṃ śayyāsanaṃ kāryaṃ vṛttapādaṃ suśobhanam |
vitasti-ucchritaṃ kāryam pādasthānaṃ suśobhanam ||
evaṃ samastaṃ pratyagraṃ kṛtvā śayyāsanādikam |
vastrālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyam abhiṣekaṃ samācaret ||
tato vṛṣasya yodhasya carmarohitam akṣayam |
siṃhasyātha tṛtīyasya vyāghrasya ca tataḥ param ||
catvāri tāni carmāṇi tasyāṃ vedyām upastaret |
śubhe muhūrte saṃprāpte puṇyayukte niśākare ||
haimaṃ vā rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṣīravṛkṣamayaṃ śubham |
bhadrāsanaṃ prakartavyaṃ sārdhahastaṃ samucchritam ||
sapādahastamānaṃ tu rājñāṃ maṇḍalikaṃ tathā |
susaṃhṛṣṭamanā rājā homānte cātha saṃviśet ||
daivajñāmātyakañcūkivandipaurasuhṛdvṛtaḥ |
dvijavedadhvaniyutaḥ śubhavādyaravānvitaḥ ||
mṛdaṅgaśaṅkhaturyaiś ca śabdakaiś ca śubhāvahaiḥ |
ahatakṣaumanivasaṃ nṛpaṃ kambalaśāyinam |
kalaśair balipuṣpādyaiḥ sarpiḥpūrṇaiś ca snāpayet ||
aṣṭaḍoṣaśaviṃśāṣṭaśatam aṣṭādhikaṃ bhavet |
[615]        kalaśānāṃ samākhyātam adhikaṃ tūttarottaram ||
kalyāṇena tu mantreṇa maṅgalena jalena vā |
devīśambhusavenātha snāyād ājyena vā vibho ||
ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddhiṣṭam ājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham |
ājyaṃ surāṇām āhāram ājye lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
bhaumāntarikṣaṃ divyaṃ vā yatrikalmaṣanāśanam |
sarvaṃ tadājyasaṃsparśāt praṇāśam upagacchatu ||
kambalam upanīya tataḥ puṣpāmbupūritaiḥ kalaśaiḥ snāpayed rājānam
ācāryo 'nena mantreṇa |
surās tvām abhiṣiñcantu ye ca siddhāḥ purātanāḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca sādhyāś ca samarudgaṇāḥ ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca niṣadvarau |
aditir devamātā ca svāhā siddhiḥ sarasvatī ||
kīrtir lakṣmīr dyutiḥ śrīś ca sinīvālī kuhūs tathā |
ditiś ca surasā caiva cinatā kadrur eva ca ||
devapatnyaś ca pūrvoktā devamātara eva ca |
sarvās tvām abhiṣiñcantu śubhāś cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||
nakṣatrāṇi muhūrtāś ca pakṣāhorātrasandhayaḥ |
saṃvatsaradineśaś ca kalāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ ||
sarve tvām abhiṣiñcantu kālasyāvayavāḥ śubhāḥ |
vaimānikāḥ suragaṇā manavaḥ sāgaraiḥ saha ||
saritaś ca mahābhāgā nāgāḥ kiṃpuruṣās tathā |
vaikhānasā mahābhāgā vānaprasthadvijaiḥ saha ||
[616]        dvijā vaihāyasā horā dhruvasthānāni yāni ca |
marīcir atripulahaḥ pulastyaḥ kratur aṅgirāḥ ||
bhṛguḥ sanatkumāraś ca sanako 'tha sanandanaḥ ||
sanātanaś ca dakṣaś ca tathā sanakanandanaḥ ||
ekataś ca hitaś caiva trito jābālikaśyapau |
dūrvāsā durvinītaś ca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanas tathā ||
mārkaṇḍeyo dīrghatapāḥ śunaḥśepho vidūrathaḥ |
dvaipāyano yavakrīto devarātaḥ sahānujaḥ ||
ete cānye ca munayo devavrataparāyaṇāḥ |
saśiṣyās te 'bhiṣiñcantu sadārāś ca tapodhanāḥ ||
parvatās taravo vallāḥ puṇyāny āyatanāni ca |
prajāpatir ditiś caiva gāvo viśvasya mātaraḥ ||
vāhanāni ca divyāni sarvalokāś carācarāḥ |
agnayaḥ pitaras tārā jīmūtāḥ khandiśo jalam ||
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ puṇyasaṃkīrtanāḥ śubhāḥ |
toyais tvām abhiṣiñcantu sarvotpātanibarhaṇaiḥ (?) ||
kalyāṇaṃ te prakurvantu āyur ārogyam eva ca |
athābhiṣikto maghavān etair muditamānasaiḥ ||
ity evaṃ śubhadair etair mantrair divyais tathāparaiḥ |
śaivair nārāyanai raudrair brahmaśakrasamudbhavaiḥ ||
āpohiṣṭā hiraṇyeti śambhaveti tathaiva ca |
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyair vastraṃ kārpāsikaṃdhriyāt ||
[617]        śaṅkhaveṇuravais tūryair (?) ācānto maṅgalair nṛpaḥ |
tataḥ saṃpūjayed devān gurūn viprān dhvajāyudhān ||
chatraṃ vādyaṃ gajān aśvān parijaptāni dhārayet |
vedena ca jayeneti alaṃkārāṇi pārthivaḥ ||
dvitīyāyāṃ tato vidyāṃ natvā hūyād dhutāśanam |
devānāṃ vadane sthāne nimittāni tu lakṣayet ||
svāhā rudrāya candrāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe śive |
prājāpatye kumārāya vighnahāya vināyake ||
sūryāya graharājāya varāhāya trivikrame |
mātṝṇāṃ varade mātre cāmuṇḍāyai svadheti ca ||
nāgarāja-anantāya tato rājā samāharet |
krameṇa saṃsthite carmaṇy upaviṣṭo narādhipaḥ ||
vṛṣasya vṛṣadaṃśasya kharāśvavṛṣatasya ca |
teṣām upari siṃhasya vyāghrasya ca tataḥ param ||
upaviṣṭe punar homaṃ tair mantraiḥ saghṛtais tilaiḥ |
kṛtvā śeṣasamāptiṃ sa prāñjaliḥ saṃsthito vadet ||
yāntu devagaṇāḥ sarve pūjām ādāya pārthivāt |
siddhiṃ datvā suvipulāṃ punarāgamanāya ca ||
āpohiṣṭā ity tryṛcam | hiraṇyavarṇā iti caturbhir ṛcaiḥ | namaḥ saṃbhave ca mayo bhavetyādimantraṃ snāpyamāno japed iti śeṣaḥ | yad āha gargaḥ |
āpohiṣṭātryṛcaṃ caiva hiraṇyeti caturṛcam |
[618]        puṇyāhaśaṅkhaninadair japet snāto narādhipaḥ |
dhṛtvā caivāhate vastre yugavastrābhimantrite ||
iti sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaiś candanādibhiḥ saha dhautaṃ kārpāsayutaṃ bibhṛyāt |
viṣṇudharmottare |
evaṃ snāto ghṛte dṛṣṭvā vadanaṃ darpaṇe tathā |
maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā dhautavāsāḥ samāhitaḥ ||
abhyarcanaṃ tataḥ kuryād devādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
āyudhābhyarcanaṃ kṛtvā vāhanābhyarcanaṃ tathā ||
rājacihnārcanaṃ kṛtvā hy alaṃkuryāt tanuṃ svakam |
anulepanam ādadyāt śrīsūktenābhimantritam ||
śriyaṃ dhātar mayi dhehi mantraḥ sumanasāṃ labhet |
āyuṣyaṃ varcasyam iti mantro 'laṃkaraṇe smṛtaḥ ||
tato 'nuliptasurabhiḥ sragvī rucirabhūṣaṇaḥ |
keśavābhyarcanaṃ kṛtvā vahnisthānaṃ vrajed iti ||
atharvapariśiṣṭe |
puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvāsya prārabdhaṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
tithinakṣatrasaṃyuktamuhūrtakaraṇe śule ||
uccair ghoṣa iti tūryāṇy abhimantrya purohitaḥ |
sarvatūryaninādena hy abhiṣeke hy alaṃkṛtaḥ ||
tataḥ saṃpūjayed iti śeṣaḥ |
abhiṣekānantaraṃ dhautavāsāḥ svācānto devaguruviprān [619] saṃpūjayet | dhvajāyudhādīni tu saṃpūjya svasvamantrābhimantritāni aparasmāt puṣyasnānād yathākālaṃ dhārayet | daivenetyādivijayākhyena devīmantreṇa śaivāgamaprasiddhenālaṃkāradhāraṇam |
dhvajādimantrās tu viṣṇudharmottare |
rāma uvāca |
chatrāśvaketukariṇāṃ patākākhaḍgacarmaṇām |
tathā dundubhicāpānāṃ brūhi mantrān samānagha ||
puṣkara uvāca |
śṛṇu mantrān mahābhāga bhagavān yān parāśaraḥ |
gālavāya purovāca sarvadharmabhṛtām varaḥ ||
yathāmbudaś chādayati śivāyemāṃ vasundharām |
tathācchādaya rājānaṃ vijayārogyavṛddhaye ||
chatramantraḥ |
gandharvapatrarājas tvaṃ mā bhūyāḥ kuladūṣakaḥ |
brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca ||
prabhāvāc ca hutāśasya vadasva tvaṃ turaṅgama |
tejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasā tathā |
rudrasya brahmacaryeṇa pavanasya balena ca ||
smara tvaṃ rājaputro 'si kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ smara |
yāṃ gatiṃ brahmahā gacchet pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā ||
bhūmyarthe 'nṛtavādī ca kṣatriyaś ca parāṅmukhaḥ |
[620]        sūryācandramasau vāyur yāvat paśyati duṣkṛtam |
vrajetaitāṃ gatiṃ kṣipraṃ tac ca pāpaṃ bhavet tava ||
niṣkṛtiṃ yadi gacchen no yuddhe tasmin turaṅgama |
ripūn vijitya samare saha bhartrā sukhī bhava ||
aśvamantraḥ |
śakraketo mahāvīra suparṇas tvām upāśritaḥ |
pavitrārdhena te yas tu tathā nārāyaṇadhvajaḥ ||
kampameyo 'mṛtāhartā nāgārit viṣṇuvāhanaḥ |
āyāmayo durādharṣo raṇe devārisūdanaḥ ||
garutmān mārutagatis tvayi saṃnihitaḥ sthitaḥ |
sāśvavarmāyudhān yodhān yatrāsmākaṃ ripūn daha ||
dhvajamantraḥ |
kumudairāvaṇaḥ padmaḥ puṣpadanto 'tha vāmanaḥ |
supratīko 'ñjano nīla ete 'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ ||
teṣāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca balāny aṣṭau samāśritāḥ |
mado mando mṛduś caiva gajaḥ saṃkīrṇa eva ca ||
vane vaṃśe prasūtās te smara yoniṃ mahāgaja |
pāntu tvāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ |
bhartāraṃ rakṣa nāgendra samayaḥ pratipālyatām ||
avāpnuhi jayaṃ yuddhe gamane svasti no vraja |
śrīs te somād balaṃ viṣṇos tejaḥ sūryāj javo 'nilāt ||
sthairyaṃ meror jayaṃ rudrād yaśo devāt purandarāt |
yuddhe rakṣantu nāga tvāṃ diśaś ca saha daivataiḥ |
[621]        aśvinau sahagandharvaiḥ pāntu tvāṃ parvatāḥ sadā ||
hastimantrāḥ |
hutabhug vasavo rudrā vāyuḥ somo maharṣayaḥ |
nāgakinnaragandharvā yakṣabhūtagaṇagrahāḥ ||
pramathās tu sahādityair bhūteśo mātṛbhiḥ saha |
śakraḥ senāpatiḥ (?) skando varuṇaś cāśritas tvayi |
pradahantu ripūna sarvān rājā vijayam ṛcchatu ||
yāni prayuktāny aribhir bhīṣaṇāni samantataḥ |
patantūpari śatrūṇāṃ hatāni tava tejasā ||
kālanemivadhe yadvad yadvat tripuraghātane |
hiraṇyakaśipor yadvad vadhe sarvāsureṣu ca |
nīlāṃ śvetām imāṃ dṛṣṭvā naśyanty āśu nṛpārayaḥ ||
vyādhibhir vividhair ghoraiḥ śastraiś ca yudhi nirjitāḥ |
pūtanā revatīnāmnā kālarātrīti paṭhyate |
dahatvāśu ripūn sarvān patāke tvām upāśritaḥ ||
patākāmantraḥ |
asir viśasanaḥ khaḍvas tīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ |
śrīgarbho vijayaś caiva dharmapālo namo 'stu te ||
ity aṣṭau tava nāmāni svayam uktāni vedhasā |
nakṣatraṃ kṛttikākhyaṃ tvaṃ gurudevo maheśvaraḥ ||
rohiṇaś ca śarīraṃ te daivataṃ tu janārdanaḥ |
[622]        pitā pitāmaho devaḥ sa tvaṃ pālaya sarvadā ||
khaḍgamantraḥ |
carmapradas tvaṃ samare carmasainyopamo hy asi |
rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo 'haṃ tavānagha namo 'stu te ||
carmamantraḥ |
dundubhe tvaṃ sapatnānāṃ tathā vijayavardhanaḥ |
yathā jīmūtaghoṣeṇa hṛṣyanti jalacāriṇaḥ |
tathāstu tava śabdena harṣo 'smākaṃ mudāvaha ||
yathā jīmūtaśabdena śrīṇāṃ trāso 'bhijāyate |
tathā ca tava śabdena trasyantv asmaddviṣo raṇe ||
dundubhimantraḥ |
sarvāyudhamahāmātra sarvadevārisūdana |
cāpa tvaṃ sarvadā rakṣa sākaṃ śaravaraiḥ sadā ||
cāpamantraḥ |
dvitīyāyāṃ vedyām (?) iti pūrvaṃ tāvad veditrayaṃ kāryam ity upapāditam | tatra paścimavedyāṃ snānam | dakṣiṇavedyāṃ grahayajñāḥ | iyaṃ tu grahahomāpekṣayā vakṣyamāṇadvitīyahomasaṃbandhitayā vāyavyavedī vastugatyā tṛtīyāpi dvitīyāśabdenocyate | devānāṃ vadane sthāna iti svagṛhyakalpoktavidhinā kṛte agnimukhe rudrādidevatābhyaḥ pūrvapūjitamaṇḍaladevatābhyaś ca praṇavādibhiś caturthyantaiḥ svāhāyuktair nāmabhiḥ pratyekam aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ vā ghṛtāhutāhutīr juhuyāt |
[623] tad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
teṣām eva tato vahnau caturthyantaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ |
oṃkārapūrvaṃ juhuyād ghṛtaṃ bahu purohita iti ||
nimittānītyādi home kriyamāṇe pradakṣiṇaśikhatvam uddāmadīptitvaṃ śubhadhvanitvam adhūmatvam ityādīni śubhasūcakāni (?) nimittāni vahnau layet |
āha gargaḥ |
tataḥ purohito vahnāv anvārabdhe nṛpe yajet |
tryambakaṃ yajāmahe yata indraṃ bhajāmahe ||
bṛhaspateḥ paridīyata idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame |
āvāyo bhūṣaśucinā bhūṣaśucinā mantrair etair yathākramam ||
samittilājyadūrvābhis tathā bilvaphalair api |
pratyekaṃ śatam aṣṭau ca homo vā syur daśāvarāḥ ||
ātharvaṇapariśiṣṭe |
caturhotravidhānena juhuyāc ca purohitaḥ |
caturdikṣu sthirair viprair vedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ ||
bilvāhāraḥ phalāhāraḥ payasā vāpi vartayet |
saptarātraṃ ghṛtāśī vā tato homaṃ prayojayet ||
gavyena pāyasaṃ kuryāt sauvarṇena śruveṇa tu |
vedānām ādibhir mantrair mahāvyāhṛtipūrvakaiḥ ||
śarmavarmagaṇaś caiva tathā syād aparājitaḥ |
āyuṣyāś cābhayaś caiva tathā svastyayano gaṇaḥ ||
[624]         etān pañca gaṇān hutvā vācayet tu dvijottamān ||
śarmavarmādyaḥ sapanna ityādiḥ | aparājitaḥ viśarasyamāna ityādiḥ | āyuṣyādyaḥ prāṇāpānādītyādiḥ | abhayaḥ svastidāviśāmibhādiḥ (?) | svastyayano sūpārepātam ityādiḥ | tato gṛhyoktavidhinā puṇyāhavācanam | tato rājāsanam iti | tato homānantaraṃ tasyām eva vedyām agner uttarabhāge prāguktānaḍuhāni carmāṇy āstīrya tadupari rājāsanaṃ siṃhāsanam āhṛtya sthāpayet | tasya tasyoparikrameṇa vṛṣadaṃśādicarmāṇy āstīrya rājopaveśayet | upaviṣṭe tu rājani svasvamantrais tābhya eva devatābhyaḥ ghṛtaplutais tilaiḥ purohito hutvā śeṣasya sviṣṭakṛt prāyaścittapūrṇāhutyantasyottarottarasya samāptiṃ kṛtvā yāntu devagaṇā ityādimantreṇa prāñjalir devatāvisarjanaṃ kuryāt |
tad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
vahner uttaradigbhāge tathā prāguktacarmaṇā |
siṃhāsanaṃ nyaset pṛṣṭhe śubhāstaraṇasaṃyutam ||
tatas tu tatra carmāṇi prāggrīvāṇi tu vinyaset ||
vṛṣasya vṛṣadaṃśasya ruroś ca pṛṣatasya ca |
teṣām upari siṃhasya vyāghrasya ca tataḥ param ||
dhruvo 'si 'dyor asi mantreṇa nṛpaṃ tatropaveśayet |
vṛṣo balīvardaḥ | vṛṣadaṃśo mārjāraḥ | rurur gauramṛgaḥ | pṛṣataś citramṛgaḥ |
[625]        darbhapāṇir bhaved rājā tathaiva ca purohitaḥ |
tayor hastagatāv anyo darbhau saṃgranthayed dvijaḥ ||
tayor nṛpapurohitayoḥ pāṇigatau dharbhāv anyo dvijo homakāle grahadeśe saṃgranthayet |
tataḥ purodhā juhuyād brāhmair mantrair ghṛtaṃ śuciḥ |
raudravaiṣṇavavāyavyaśakrasaumyaiḥ savāruṇaiḥ |
bārhaspatyais tataḥ kuryāt tantram uttarasaṃjñakam ||
brāhmair brahma jajñānam ityādayaḥ | raudrā asmerudrā (?) ityādayaḥ | vaiṣṇavā viṣṇor nukam ityādayaḥ | vāyavyā āvāya ityādayaḥ | śakraḥ trātāram indra ityādayaḥ | saumyā āpyāyasvetyādayaḥ | varuṇā imaṃ me varuṇa ityādayaḥ | bārhaspatyā bṛhaspate atīya ityādayaḥ |
nṛpatis tv atha daivajñān purodhsamathārcayet (?) |
gobhūhiraṇyaratnaiś ca anyān api kramāgatān ||
sthānadevān purodevān nadīkūlaṃ catuṣpatham |
abhayaṃ ca jane deyaṃ gogotsargaṃ samācaret ||
alaṃkṛtya yathānyāyaṃ sitau tau vastrabhūṣitau |
devaṃ devīṃ ca vijñāpya bandhanasthāṃś ca mocayet ||
na moced rājñaḥ sanduṣṭān antaḥpurakṛtāgamaḥ |
vibhavānurūpabhāvaiḥ pure pūjāṃ samārabhet ||
siṃhāsanaṃ samāsthāya catuṣkīghṛtadyotitaiḥ |
dīpai rajatapātrasthais toyārghyaghṛtavanditaiḥ |
rocanādi tathā paśyed darpaṇaṃ maṅgalāni ca ||
[626] tato jyotiṣikān purohitaṃ ca gobhūhiraṇyādibhir abhyarcya anyān api śrotriyādīn kramāgatāṃś ca saṃpūjya gṛhadevān pūrodevāṃś ca nadīkūlaṃ ca catuṣpathaṃ ca pūjopahārair arcayet | 'gogotsargaṃ' gomithunam ity arthaḥ | tau ca dhenuvṛṣabhau śvetavarṇau vastrāṃkārādibhūṣitau | devaṃ maheśvaraṃ devīṃ ca bhagavatīṃ prītyartham utsṛjāmīti vijñāpyotsṛjet | nṛpaśarīre antaḥpure ca kṛtāparādhān vihāya bandhanaṃ mocayitvā patākātoraṇādibhiḥ pure pūjāṃ kuryāt | catuṣkī raṅgavallīracanā sabhāviśeṣo vā | dīpair nīrājita iti śeṣaḥ | vanditaṃ vandanaṃ viśeṣaṇe tṛtīyā | tato gorocanādadhidūrvādīni ca darpaṇaṃ maṅgalāni ca paśyet |
ātharvaṇapariśiṣṭe |
proktāni maṅgalāny aṣṭau brāhmaṇo gaur hutāśanaḥ |
bhūmisiddhārthakāḥ sarpiḥ śamī vrīhiyavau tathā ||
etāni satataṃ paśyan spṛśann apy arcayann api |
na prāpnoty āpadaṃ rājā śriyaṃ prāpnoty anuttamām ||
tathā siṃhāsahaṃ ruhya patākāṃ vā kramāgatām |
cāmarachatrasaṃyuktaṃ pratīhāravibhūṣitam |
mattadviṣaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca caturdikṣūpakalpayet ||
upaviṣṭas tato rājā prajānāṃ kārayed dhitam |
ākarā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ (?) strībālajaḍarogiṇaḥ ||
tatas tu darśanaṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpeṇa tu |
śreṇīprabhṛtimukhyānāṃ strījanaṃ ca namaskaret ||
[627]        āśiṣaś ca pradadyus te tuṣṭā janapadā bhuvi |
evaṃ prajānurajyeta pṛthvī ca vaśagā bhavet ||
purohitaṃ mantriṇaṃ ca senādhyakṣaṃ tathaiva ca |
aśvādhyakṣaṃ gavādhyakṣaṃ goṣṭhāgārapatiṃ tathā ||
bhāṇḍāgārapatiṃ vaidyaṃ daivajñaṃ ca yathākramam |
yathārheṇa tu yogena sarvān saṃpūjayen nṛpaḥ ||
dūrvāsiddhārthakān sarpiḥ śamīr vrīhiyavau tathā |
śuklāni caiva puṣpāṇi mūrdhni dadyāt purohitaḥ ||
atharvavihito hy eṣa vidhiḥ puṣyābhiṣecane |
rājā snāto mahīṃ bhuṅkte śakralokaṃ ca gacchati ||
devīpurāṇe |
evaṃ puṣye avāpnoti kartā rājyāyuḥsaṃpadaḥ (?) |
vināpi cārdhaphaladaṃ puṇyaṃ puṣyābhiṣecanam ||
rāṣṭrotpātopasargeṣu dhūmaketoś ca darśane |
grahopamardane caiva puṣyasnānaṃ samācaret ||
nāsti loke sa utpāto yo hy anena na śāmyati |
maṅgalaṃ cāparaṃ nāsti yad asmād atiricyate ||
ādhirājyārthino rājñaḥ putrajanmābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
tatpūrvam abhiṣeke ca vidhir eṣa praśasyate ||
devena brahmaṇe dattaṃ tenāpy uśanase punaḥ |
uśanaso guroḥ prāptaṃ tato devasabhāṃ gatam ||
mahendrātham uvācedaṃ bṛhatkīrtir bṛhaspatiḥ |
snānam āyuḥprajāvṛddhisaubhāgyakaram uttamam ||
[628]        anenaiva ca toyena hastyaśvaṃ snāpayen nṛpaḥ |
tac cāmayavinirmuktaṃ parāṃ vṛddhim avāpnuyāt ||
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryam abhiṣekaṃ tu pārthiva |
maṇḍalīkanarendrāṇāṃ sāmantādhipater api ||
sāmantānāṃ sadā kāryaṃ vighneśvaramakhaṃ śubham |
striyo lakṣaṇayuktāyā yasyā na bhavane sukham |
tasyedaṃ kārayet snānaṃ sarvakāmaprasiddhidam ||
iti puṣyasnānavidhiḥ |
udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣasyaikarātram avarārdham upoṣya tiṣyeṇa puṣṭikāmaḥ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā mahārājam iṣṭvā tena sarpiṣmatā brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā puṣyārgheṇa siddhiṃ vācayet | evam aparāparasmāt tiṣyād dvau dvitīye trīstṛtīye evaṃ saṃvatsaram abhyuccayena mahāntam poṣaṃ puṣnāti ādita evopavāsaḥ | avarārdham avaram | avaratācaikarātropavāsasyāpūtasya puṃso bahūpavāsapakṣāpekṣayā mahārājaḥ kuberaḥ | tena hutaśiṣṭena caruṇā puṣyārdheṇa siddhiṃ vācayet puṣṭiḥ siddhir astv iti vācayet | evaṃ pūrvavac caruṇā mahārājeṣṭibrāhmaṇabhojanādi kāryam | dvau dvitīye dvau brāhmaṇau dvitīye bhojayed ity arthaḥ | evaṃ saṃvatsaram abhyuccayena pūrvavat tṛtīyaṃ caturthaṃ tiṣyeṣūttarottaravṛddhyā brāhmaṇā bhojanīyā ity arthaḥ | ādita eva prathamapuṣye pūrve 'hy uttare cety arthaḥ |
ity āpastamboktaṃ puṣyavratam |
dālbha uvāca |
strīṇāṃ dharmaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha upavāsasamudbhavam |
[629]        kathayasva yathātattvam upavāsavidhiś ca yaḥ ||
kumāryāḥ svagṛhasthāyā vidhavāyāś ca sattama |
dharmaṃ prabrūhy aśeṣeṇa bhagavan prītikārakam ||
pulastya uvāca |
śrūyatām akhilaṃ brahman yad etad anupṛcchasi |
upakārāya ca strīṇāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ||
praśnam etaṃ purā devī śailarājasutā patim |
papraccha śaṅkaraṃ brahman kailāsaśikharasthitam ||
devy uvāca |
kumārībhiś ca deveśa gṛhasthābhiś ca keśava |
vidhavābhis tathā strībhiḥ katham ārādhyate vada ||
īśvara uvāca |
sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭam etan nārāyaṇāśrayam |
upavāsādi yat karma śrūyatām asya yo vidhiḥ ||
yajñaṃ parisamāsādya nārīha sukham edhate |
duḥśīle 'pi hi kāmārthau nārī prāpnoti bhartari ||
anādhārā jagannāthaṃ sarvalokeśvaraṃ harim |
katham āpnoti cen nārī sarvalokaguṇānvitam ||
sukalatrayutaṃ tasmād vratam acyutatuṣṭidam (?)|
kartavyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya śrūyatāṃ varavarṇini ||
yac cīrtvā sarvanārīṇāṃ śreyaḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
aihikaṃ ca sukhaṃ prāpya mṛtā svargasukhāny api ||
anujñāpya svapitṛto mātṛtaś ca kumārikā |
[630]        pūjayet tu jagannāthaṃ bhaktyā pāpaharaṃ harim ||
triṣūttareṣv atharkṣeṣu patikāmā kumārikā |
mādhavāyeti vai nāma japen nityam atandritā ||
priyaṅguṇā raktapuṣpair madhukaiḥ kusumais tathā |
samabhyarcyācyute dadyāt kuṅkumenānulepanam ||
sarvauṣadhibhiḥ susnātā tam ārādhya jagatpatim |
namo 'stu mādhavāyeti homayen madhusarpiṣā ||
sadaivam uttarāyoge samabhyarcya janārdanam |
śobhanaṃ patim āpnoti pretya svargaṃ ca gacchati ||
atibālye ca yat kiṃcit tayā pāpam anuṣṭhitam |
tasmād vimucyate pāpāt sukhinī caiva jāyate ||
abdenaikena tanvaṅgi vrataṃ prāptā yad icchati |
tad eva prāpnuyād bhadre nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ||
ṣaṇmāsaprīṇanaṃ kāryaṃ yathāśaktyā ca vai hareḥ |
pāraṇānte mahābhāge bhojayed brāhmaṇottamān ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sukalatraprāptivratam |
atha jyeṣṭhāvratam |
ṛṣāya ūcuḥ |
māyāvitvaṃ śrutaṃ viṣṇor devadevasya cakriṇaḥ |
kathaṃ jyeṣṭhāsamutpattir devadevāj janārdanāt |
vaktum arhasi cāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa tattvataḥ ||
[631]                sūta uvāca |
anādinidhanaṃ śrīmān dhyātvā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
jagaddidham (?) idaṃ cakre mohanāya jagatyatiḥ ||
viṣṇur vai brāhmaṇān veda vedadharmān sanātanān |
śriyaṃ padmāṃ tathā yojya bhāgam ekam akārayat ||
jyeṣṭhām alakṣmīm aśubhāṃ vedabāhyāṃ narādhamān |
adharmaṃ ca mahātejā bhāgam ekam akārayat ||
alakṣmīm agrataḥ sṛṣṭvā paścāt padmāṃ janārdanaḥ |
jyeṣṭhā tena samākhyātā hy alakṣmīr dvijasattamāḥ ||
amṛtodbhavavelāyāṃ sudhānantaram utthitā |
agrataḥ sā samutpannā jyeṣṭhā iti ca vai śrutā ||
śrīr anantaram utpannā padmā viṣṇuparigrahā ||
duḥsaho nāma viprarṣir upayeme 'śubhāṃ tadā |
jyeṣṭhāṃ tāṃ paripūrṇārtho manasā vīkṣya niṣṭhitām ||
loke cacāra hṛṣṭātmā tayā saha munis tadā ||
yasmin ghoṣo hareś caiva harasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
vedaghoṣas tathā viprā homadhūmras tathaiva ca ||
śrotriyo vātha yatrāsīt tatra tatra bhayārditā |
pidhāya karṇau saṃyāti dhāvamānā itas tataḥ ||
jyeṣṭhām evaṃvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥsaho moham āgataḥ |
tayā saha vanaṃ gatvā cacāra sa tadā muniḥ ||
tatrāyāntaṃ mahātmānaṃ mārkaṇḍeyam apaśyata |
praṇipatya mahātmānaṃ duḥsaho munim abravīt |
[632]        bhāryeyaṃ bhagavan mahyaṃ na sthāsyati kathaṃcana ||
kiṃ kariṣyāmi viprarṣe hy anayā saha bhāryayā |
praviśāmy anayā kutra kutra na praviśāmi vai ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śṛṇu duḥsaha sarvaṃ tvam akīrtir aśubhānvitā |
alakṣmīr atulā ceyaṃ jyeṣṭhā ity abhiśabditā ||
nārāyaṇaparā yatra vedamārgānusāriṇaḥ |
rudrabhaktā mahātmāno bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ |
sthitā yatra janā nityaṃ na viśethāḥ kathaṃcana ||
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava |
acyutānanda govinda vāsudeva janārdana ||
nṛsiṃha vāmanācintya rāghaveti ca ye janāḥ |
vakṣyanti santataṃ hṛṣṭās teṣāṃ dhanagṛhādiṣu |
ārāme caiva goṣṭheṣu na viśethāḥ kathaṃcana ||
jvālājālakarālaṃ yat sahasādityasaṃnibham |
cakraṃ viṣṇor atīvograṃ teṣāṃ hanti sadāśubham ||
svāhākāro vaṣaṭkāro gṛhe yasmin pravartate |
tadvidhā cānyato gaccha sāmaghoṣo 'tha yatra vā ||
vedābhyāsaratā nityaṃ nityakarmaparāyaṇāḥ |
vāsudevārcanaratā dūratas tān visarjaya ||
agnihotraṃ gṛhe yeṣāṃ liṅgārcā vā gṛheṣu ca |
vāsudevatanur vāpi caṇḍikā yatra tiṣṭhati ||
dūrato vraja tān hitvā sarvapāpavivarjitān |
[633]        nityanaimittikair yajñair ye yajanti maheśvaram |
tān hitvā vraja vānyatra duḥsaha tvaṃ sahānayā ||
śrotriyā brāhmaṇā gāvo guravo 'tithayaḥ sadā |
rudrabhaktāś ca pūjyante yair nityaṃ tān visarjaya ||
duḥsaha uvāca |
yasmin praveśo yogyo me tad brūhi munisattama |
tvadvākyād bhayanirmukto viśāmy eṣāṃ gṛhe sadā ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
yatra bhāryā ca bhartā ca parasparavirodhinau |
sabhāryas tvaṃ gṛhaṃ tasya viśethā bhayavarjitaḥ ||
devadevo mahādevo rudras tribhuvaneśvaraḥ |
vinidro yatra bhagavān viśethā bhayavarjitaḥ ||
vāsudeve ratir nāsti yatra nāsti sadā hariḥ |
japahomādikaṃ nāsti bhasma nāsti gṛhe nṛṇām ||
parvaṇy abhyarcanaṃ nāsti caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ca rudrasya saṃdhyāyāṃ bhayavarjitaḥ ||
caturdaśyāṃ mahādevaṃ na yajanti ca yatra vai |
viṣṇor nāmavihīnāsyair aśrubhāsyair durātmabhiḥ ||
namaskāraṃ ca sarvāya śivāya parameṣṭhine |
brāhmaṇe ca narā mūḍhā na vadanti durātmakāḥ |
tatra vai satataṃ vatsa sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
vedaghoṣo na yatrāsti gurupūjā na yatra ca |
pitṛkarmavihīnāś ca sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
[634]        rātrau rātrau gṛhe yasmin kalaho vartate mithaḥ |
anayā sārdham aniśaṃ viśa tvaṃ bhayavarjitaḥ ||
liṅgārcā nāsti yasyaiva yasya nāsti tapo damaḥ |
rudrabhaktivinindā vā tatraiva viśa nirbhayaḥ ||
atithiḥ śrotriyo vāpi gurur vā vaiṣṇavo 'pi vā |
na santi yadgṛhe gāvaḥ sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
bālānāṃ prekṣyamāṇānāṃ yatra vṛddhā hi bhakṣakam |
bhakṣanti tatra saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
anabhyarcya mahādevaṃ vāsudevam athāpi vā |
ahutvā vidhivad dravyaṃ yatra tatra samāviśa ||
pāpakarmaratā mūḍhā dayāhīnāḥ parasparam |
gṛhe yasmin samāsanne deśe tatra samāviśa ||
prākārāgārabhid yāsāv anvavekṣā kuṭumbinī |
tadgṛhaṃ tu samāsādya vasa nityam ananyadhīḥ ||
yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā yatra niṣpāvavallarī |
brahmavṛkṣaś ca yatrāsti sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
agastyārkādayo vāpi bandhujīvo gṛheṣu vai |
karavīraṃ viśeṣeṇa nandyāvartam athāpi vā |
mallikā vā gṛhe yeṣāṃ sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
kanyā ca yatra vai vallī rohito 'tha jaṭī gṛhe |
vakulaḥ kadalī yatra sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
tālas tamālo bhallātas tintiḍīkhaṇḍam eva ca |
[635]        kadambaḥ khadiraṃ vāpi sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
nyagrodho vā gṛhe yeṣām aśvatthaś ca tathaiva ca |
uḍumbaraḥ sapanasaḥ sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
yasya kāko gṛhaṃ vinded ārāme vā gṛhe 'pi vā |
ḍimbena muṇḍito vāpi sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
ekachāgaṃ dvirāveyaṃ trigavaṃ pañcamāhiṣam |
ṣaḍaśvaṃ saptamātaṅgaṃ sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
yasya kālī gṛhe devī pretarūpā ca ḍākinī |
kṣetrapālo 'tha vā tatra sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
bhikṣabimbaṃ ca vai yasya gṛhe kṣapaṇakaṃ tathā |
bauddhaṃ vā vimbam āhṛṣṭaṃ tatra tūrṇaṃ samāviśa ||
śayanāsanakāleṣu bhojanāsanavṛttiṣu |
yeṣāṃ vadati vai vāṇī nāmāni na hareḥ sadā |
tadgṛhaṃ te samākhyātaṃ sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
pāṣaṇḍā vāraniratāḥ śrautasmārtabahiṣkṛtāḥ |
viṣṇubhaktinivirmuktā mahādevavinindakāḥ |
nāstikāś ca śavā yatra sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
brahmā ca bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śakraḥ sarvasureśvaraḥ |
śivaprasādajāś ceti na vadanti durātmakāḥ ||
brahmā ca bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śivasya sama eva ca |
vadanti mūḍhāḥ khadyotaṃ bhānor vā mūḍhacetasaḥ ||
teṣāṃ gṛhe tathā kṣetre āvāse vā sahānayā |
viśa bhuṅkha gṛhe teṣāṃ miṣṭānnaṃ tvam ananyadhīḥ ||
[636]        aśnanti kevalaṃ mūḍhā pakvam annaṃ vicetasaḥ |
snānamaṅgalahīnāś ca teṣāṃ tvaṃ gṛham āviśa ||
yā nārī śaucavibhraṣṭā dehasaṃskāravarjitā |
sarvabhakṣaratā nityaṃ tasyā sthānaṃ samāviśa ||
madyapānaratāḥ pāpā māṃsabhakṣaṇatatparāḥ |
paradāraratā martyās teṣāṃ tvaṃ gṛham āviśa ||
parvaṇy anarcanaratā maithune vā divā ratāḥ |
saṃdhyāyāṃ maithune vāpi gṛhe teṣāṃ samāviśa ||
pṛṣṭhato maithunaṃ strīṇāṃ śvānavan mṛgavac ca yaḥ |
jale vā maithunaṃ kuryāt sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
rajasvalāṅganāṃ gacchec cāṇḍālīṃ vā narādhamaḥ |
kanyāṃ vā gām ajāṃ vāpi sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
bahunā kiṃ pralāpena nityakarmabahiṣkṛtāḥ |
rudrabhaktivihīnā ye gṛhe teṣāṃ samāviśa ||
śṛṅgair divyauṣadhaiḥ kṣaudraiḥ śepam ālipya gacchati |
bhagadrāvaṃ karoty asya sabhāryas tvaṃ samāviśa ||
ity uktvā sa muniḥ śrīmān nimīlya nayane tadā |
brahmarṣir brahmasaṅkāśas tatraivāntaradhīyate ||
duḥsaho 'pi yathoktāni sthānāni samupeyivān ||
viśeṣād devadevasya viṣṇor nindāratātmanām |
sabhāryo muniśārdūla saiṣā jyeṣṭhā iti smṛtā ||
duḥsahas tām uvācedaṃ taḍāgāśrayasaṃstare |
āssva tvam atra caivāhaṃ prapaśyāmi rasātalam ||
[637]        āvayoḥ sthānam ālokya nivāsārthaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||
āgamiṣyāmi te pārśvam ity uktā tam uvāca sā |
kim aśnāmi mahābhāga ko ma dāsyati vai balim ||
ity uktas tāṃ muniḥ prāha yāḥ (?) striyas tvāṃ yajanti vai |
balibhiḥ puṣpadhūpaiś ca na tāsāṃ tvaṃ gṛhaṃ viśa ||
ity uktvā prāviśat tatra pātālanilayaṃ gataḥ |
adyāpi sa ca nāyātas tena sā jalasaṃstare |
grāme karkaṭavāhye tu nityam āste 'śubhā punaḥ ||
prasaṅgād devadeveśo viṣṇus tribhuvaneśvaraḥ |
lakṣmījuṣṭas tathālakṣmīḥ sā tam āha janārdanam ||
bhartā gato mahābāho baliṃ tyaktvā mama prabho |
anāthāhaṃ jagannātha vṛttiṃ dehi namo 'stu te ||
ity ukto bhagavān viṣṇuḥ prasahyāha janārdanaḥ |
jyeṣṭhām alakṣmīṃ deveśo mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ ||
ye rudram anaghaṃ sarvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam |
ambāṃ haimavatīṃ vāpi janitrīṃ jagatām api ||
madbhaktā nindayanty atra teṣāṃ vittam tavaiva ca ||
evam eva mahādevaṃ vinindyaiva yajanti mām |
mūḍhā hy abhāgyā madbhaktā api teṣāṃ dhanaṃ tava ||
yasyājñayā hy ayaṃ brahmā prasādād vasate sadā |
ye vinindya yajanty enaṃ matpadabhraṃśakārakāḥ ||
madbhaktā naiva te bhaktā evaṃ vartanti durmadāḥ |
teṣāṃ dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣetram iṣṭāpūrtaṃ tavaiva ca ||
[638]        ity uktvā tāṃ parityajyālakṣmīṃ lakṣmījanārdanaḥ |
avāpa bhagavān rudram alakṣmīkṣayasiddhaye ||
tasmāt pradeyas tasyai ca balir nindyo nareśvaraiḥ |
viṣṇubhaktair na saṃdehaḥ sarvayatnena sarvadā |
aṅganābhiḥ sadā pūjyā balibhir vividhair dvijaiḥ ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
mṛtavatsā tu yā nārī kākavandhyā tathāparā |
garbhasrāvā tṛtīyā ca nānādoṣaiś ca dūṣitā ||
nirdvanāś ca narāś caiva dāridropahatā sthitāḥ |
karmaṇā kena mucyante tan me brūhi janārdana ||
vratena kena tat sarvaṃ sukhaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
cīrṇena ca jagannātha tat sarvaṃ kathayasva me ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
māse bhādrapade śukle pakṣe jyeṣṭhā yadā bhavet |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ |
evaṃvidhavidhānena ebhir mantraiḥ supūjayet ||
ehy ehi tvaṃ mahābhāge surāsuranamaskṛte |
jyeṣṭhe tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ matsamīpā sadā bhava ||
āvāhanamantraḥ |
śvetasiṃhāsanasthā tu śvetavastrair alaṃkṛtā |
varaṃ ca pustakaṃ pāśaṃ bibhṛtyai (?) te namo namaḥ ||
[639] āsanamantraḥ|
jyeṣṭhe śreṣṭhe taponiṣṭhe brahmiṣṭhe brahmavādini |
kṣīrābdhau ca samudbhūte arghyaṃ jyeṣṭhe namo 'stu te ||
arghyamantraḥ |
śārṅgavāṇaiś khaḍgaiś ca toranārohadarpaṇaiḥ |
anyair apy āyudhair yuktāṃ jyeṣṭhe tvām arcayāmy aham ||
prārthanāmantraḥ |
surāsuranarair vandyā yakṣakinnarapūjitā |
pūjitāsi mayā devi jyeṣṭhe tvām arcayāmy aham ||
putradārasamṛddhyarthaṃ lakṣmyāś caiva vivṛddhaye |
alakṣmyāś ca vināśāya jyeṣthe tvām arcayāmy aham ||
pūjāmantraḥ |
mantreṇa pūjayej jyeṣṭhāṃ strī vātha puruṣo 'pi vā |
lakṣmīḥ santānavṛddhiś ca aṇimādiguṇo bhavet ||
arcitā carcitā jyeṣṭhā sadā kāle nṛpottama |
guruṃ saṃpūjayed bhaktyā vastrair ābharaṇādibhiḥ ||
dvādaśaiva ca varṣāṇi pūjanīyā prayatnataḥ |
yāvaj janma tathā pūjyā vidhinānena mānavaiḥ ||
dadāti vittaṃ putrāṃś ca arcanīyā sadā striyā |
anena vidhinā yukto yo hi pūjayate naraḥ ||
nārī ca pūjayej jyeṣṭhāṃ tasyā lakṣmīr vivardhate |
vandhyā ca labhate putrān durbhagā subhagā bhavet ||
mṛtavatsā jīvavatsā kākavandhyā prajāvatī |
[640]        duhkhito hi naraḥ kaścit sa sukhī vasate sadā ||
evaṃvidhavidhānena jyeṣṭhāṃ yas tv arcayet sadā |
vighnaṃ tasya praṇaśyeta yathāpsu lavaṇaṃ tathā ||
etad vrataṃ mahāśreṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpavināśanam |
tan mayā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ jyeṣṭhāyās te vrataṃ mahat ||
yathā grāhyaṃ kuruśreṣṭha jyeṣṭhāvrataṃ suśobhanam |
nīrājane kṛte caiva dīpo grāhyaḥ subhaktitaḥ ||
naivedyasahitaṃ prāśya vratasyāgre yudhiṣṭhira |
guruhastād sadā grāhyo dīpaḥ prajvalito mahān ||
vratastho bhaktiyuktas tu śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
anena vidhinā caiva vrataṃ grāhyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira ||
jyeṣṭhā nāma parā devī bhuktmuktiphalapradā |
yas tu pūjayate rājaṃs tasmai svargaṃ prayacchati ||
skandapurāṇe |
īśvara uvāca |
māse bhādrapade pakṣe śukle jyeṣṭhārkṣasaṃyute |
tasmin kāle dine kuryāt jyeṣṭhāyāḥ paripūjanam ||
tatrāṣṭamyāṃ yadā bhānudinaṃ jyeṣṭharkṣam eva ca |
nīlajyeṣṭhā tu sā proktā durlabhā bahukālikā |
kṛtasnāno naraḥ kuryāt tasyām anyatra vā dine ||
bhaktiyuktaḥ śuciḥ kuryāt jyeṣṭhādevyāḥ prapūjanam |
nadyāḥ pūrve dyu āhṛtya sikatāḥ śuddhadeśajāḥ ||
devīrūpaṃ tu tatraiva dhyātvā vai brāhmaṇaiḥ saha |
maṇḍale tāṃ tu saṃsthāpya devīṃ hemamayīṃ tataḥ ||
[641]        sthāpayed rājatīṃ tāmrīṃ lekhyāṃ vā dvijasattama |
āvāhayet tato devīm atha vā pustake 'pi vā ||
trilocanāṃ śukladantīṃ bibhratī rājatī tanum |
vitatāṃ raktanayanāṃ jyeṣṭhām āvāhayāmy aham ||
ehy ehi tvaṃ mahābhāge surāsuranamaskṛte |
jyeṣṭhā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ matsamīpagatā bhava ||
iti mantreṇa tāṃ devīm āvāhya sukṛtavratī |
dadyād gandhajalaiḥ pādyaṃ pādayor ubhayor dvijaḥ ||
śrīkhaṇḍakarpūrayutaṃ dadyād ambhas tathārhaṇam |
bhaktyā prayatnena mayā yad atra dīyate tava |
tad gṛhāṇa sureśāni jyeṣṭhe śreṣṭhe namo namaḥ ||
ity uccārya suvarṇādipātreṇāñjalināpi vā|
arghyaṃ datvā smared devīṃ gandhadhūpais tathārcayet |
godhūmayavaśālyādi tadvad dravyaiḥ supārayet ||
pañcaprasṛtimātrais taiḥ pūrikādīni sarpiṣā |
nivedayec ca tair eva dadyād devyai yatavrataḥ ||
tataḥ stutvā mahādevīṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām |
jyeṣṭhāyai te namas tubhyaṃ śreṣṭhāyai ta namo namaḥ ||
jyeṣṭhe śreṣṭhe toponiṣthe variṣṭhe satyavādini |
ehy ehi tvaṃ mahābhāge arghyaṃ gṛhṇa sarasvati ||
arghyamantraḥ |
stutvā stotrakathānṛtyagītāni puratas tataḥ |
[642]        sauvīre caiva saṃyuktāṃ dadyāc chudrebhya eva ca ||
suvāsinībhyaḥ śaktyā tat pradadyāt sukṛtavratī |
devīm anujñayārcitvā tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
sakhibhiḥ saha cānnāni sa vratī sukṛtavrataḥ |
bhuktvā pītvā tadācamya devīṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ |
śayīta brahmacaryeṇa kuryāt prātar visrajanam ||
evam eva prakuryād vai vrataṃ tu prativatsaram |
visarjanānte tu tataḥ śivāṃ tāṃ vāriṇi kṣipet ||
apūpavaṭakān dadyād brāhmaṇebhyas tato dvijaḥ |
kuryād evaṃ prayatnena sāyaṃ vātha visarjayet ||
vidyārthī prāpnuyāḍ vidyāṃ strīkām astriyam āpnuyāt |
śirastaraṇakārī tu devyai dadyād asaṃśayaḥ ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavet tadā |
vrataṃ svayaṃ ca kṛtavān siddhiṃ vātha kṛtārhaṇaḥ ||
devyā mahattvaṃ kathitaṃ tadedam
vidhiś ca mantrārcanasaṃprayuktaḥ |
mantro 'pi sāyujyakaro vratastas
tasyāṃ sadācāravatāṃsadaiva |
yasyāḥ siṃho rathe yukto vyāghraś cāpi mahābalaḥ |
śreṣṭhām aham imāṃ devīṃ prapadye śaraṇaṃ śubhām ||
tām agnivarṇāṃ tapasā jvalantīṃ vairocanīṃ karmaphaleṣu juṣṭāṃ durgadevīṃ śaraṇam ahaṃ prapadye | sutarasitarāsanāya namaḥ | ity āvāhayat [643] āpohiṣṭeti tisṛbhir hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti tisṛbhir abhiṣekaṃ kuryāt |
nāmnātha viṣṭaraṃ datvā pādyam arghyam athāsanam |
vastram ācamanaṃ caiva madhuparkādi sarvataḥ ||
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyam eva ca |
punarācamanaṃ caiva kārayitvā visarjayet ||
oṃ jyeṣṭhāyai namaḥ | oṃ satyāyai namaḥ | oṃ kālyai namaḥ | oṃ kapālāya namaḥ | oṃ kalipriyāyai namaḥ | oṃ vighnāyai namaḥ | oṃ vināyakāya namaḥ | oṃ bhāgyai namaḥ | oṃ tāpyai namaḥ | oṃ śriyai namaḥ | oṃ kṛṣṇāyai namaḥ | oṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalāyai namaḥ | ebhir nāmabhis tarpaṇam |
homaṃ dadhimadhukṣīraghṛtaiḥ kuryāt susaṃyataḥ |
haviṣyaṃ svayam aśnīyād brahmaṇāṃs tena bhojayet ||
anena vidhinā yas tu vatsarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam |
vratānte pratimāṃ kuryāt sauvarṇīṃ phalasaṃmitām |
kṛṣṇavastreṇa saṃyuktām ācāryāya nivedayet ||
vastrābharaṇamālyais tu lepanaiḥ pūjitaṃ dvijam |
praṇipatya tataḥ paścāt tasmai sarvaṃ nivedayet ||
brāhmaṇā bhuktavantas te prakuryuḥ svastivācanam |
evaṃ kṛte vrate samyak sarvaśāntiḥ prajāyate |
dhanadhānyasamṛddhiś ca ārogyaṃ caiva jayate ||
iti jyeṣṭhāvratam |
[644]                puṣkara uvāca |
śakre tūpoṣito vidvān yajamānam upoṣitam |
mūlena snāpayen nityaṃ tatsvāmyāśāmukhasthitam ||
tatsvāmyāśāmukhaṃ nairṛtyabhimukham |
pūrvoktāśāsaṃmukhaṃ vā pūrṇena sudṛḍhena ca |
kumbhadvayena snātas tu pūjayen madhusūdanam ||
virūpākṣaṃ savaruṇaṃ candraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca |
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā ||
eteṣām eva juhuyāt tathā nāmnā ghṛtaṃ dvijaḥ |
pītavāsās tato bhūtvā matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ ca śūkaram ||
surākṛśarasaṃyāvaiḥ snānoktāśāmukhasthitaḥ |
balaṃ nṛpataye dadyāc jānu kṛtvā tataḥ kṣitau ||
tato 'ṣṭādaśabhiḥ puṣpair mūlaiḥ pañcabhir eva ca |
suvarṇagarbhaṃ tu maṇiṃ vidvān śirasi dhārayet ||
kṛtvaitat sakalaṃ karma kṛṣiṃ bahuphalāṃ labhet |
dakṣiṇāṃ cātra ye dadyur mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
sitāni caiva vastrāṇi kanakaṃ rajataṃ tathā |
bhojanaṃ cātra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇānām abhīpsitam ||
alaṅghayan mūlam idaṃ ca kurvan
snānaṃ sadā mārgavavaṃśamukhyaḥ |
kṛṣiṃ sa samāpnoti sadaiva vṛddhiṃ
yathepsitaṃ nātra vicāram asti ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ mūlasnānam |
[645]        gargaṃ munivaraśreṣṭhaṃ bhārgavaḥ paripṛcchati |
nairṛtena tu ṛkṣeṇa śiśor jātasya kiṃ phalam ||
pāde pāde tu yat proktaṃ tan mamācakṣva suvrata |
snānadānādihomāṃś ca darśanīyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet \\
garga uvāca |
prathame pitaraṃ hanti dvitīye hanti mātaram |
tṛtīye ca dhanaṃ hanti caturthe śobhanaṃ bhavet ||
prathame chedanaṃ kṛtvā raktasrāvo vidhīyate |
dvitīye dīyate bālaḥ parastrīpuruṣasya vā ||
atha vāsya tṛtīye tu paścāc chāntiṃ tu kārayet |
caturthe śasyate snānaṃ kṛtvā caiva śiśoḥ pitā ||
svayam utpāṭayet prājño mūlānāṃ ca śataṃ pitā |
maṅgalyāś ca pavitrāś ca oṣadhyaḥ kathayāmy aham ||
lakṣmaṇā śatamūlā ca śirīṣo vetasas tathā |
siṃhakā śvetamūlā ca viṣṇukrāntā ca śaṅkinī |
sarpākṣī mīnanetrā ca putrāparikṛtāñjalī ||
palāśo bilvakaś caiva rocanā candanadvayam |
kṛṣṇamāṃsī murośīraṃ dhavakaṃ ca tathāmalam ||
gojihvā tulasī dūrvā śatapuṣpā śatāṅgalī |
brahmadaṇḍī droṇapuṣpī priyaṅguḥ śvetasarṣapāḥ ||
[646]        pippalaḥ kākajaṅghā ca trāyamāṇā ḍuhus tathā |
jyotiṣmatī ca gāndhārī nirgandhā pūrṇakauśikā ||
bhagakṣumā subhadrā ca guḍacī sendravāruṇī |
alambukā ca dantī ca kadalī ketakas tathā ||
gokṣuraḥ śatapatrī ca ariṣṭakāparājitā |
citraparṇī śatapatrā ca nikumbho 'tha suvarcalā ||
aśvagandhā hastikarṇī haridrādvitayaṃ tathā |
uṣṭravo madhukāraś ca aśvattho vakulas tathā ||
sarjarājo apāmārgo mandāraś cātimuktakaḥ |
mālatī svarṇapuṣpī ca śrīkarṇī śrīphalaṃ tathā ||
darbhamūlaṃ karavīraṃ madayantī vikaṅkataḥ |
pāṭalā suradāruś ca ardhasūdanikā tathā ||
phalaṃ manmathavṛkṣasya palāśasya ca pallavam |
rāsnā nandīvṛkṣamūlaṃ suradārur vidārikā ||
śvetavīthī śvetapākā nīlotpalaṃ tathaiva ca |
nāgakeśarasindūrī kumārī caiva nikṣipet ||
tīrthāmbu pañcagavyaṃ ca sarvauṣadhyaś ca kāñcanam |
yathāsaṃbhavato vāpi grāhyaṃ mūlīśataṃ śubham |
vīratvacā sametaṃ ca śatachidre ghaṭe nyaset ||
nadyā ubhayakūlasthā gośṛṅgakhanitā ca yā |
barhirmūlagatā yā ca tathā mātṛgṛhodbhavā |
valmīkapallalasthā ca rajasā raktakāś ca ye ||
rajasā raktakāḥ, gorajoraṃjitā rathyāmṛttikā ity arthaḥ |
[647]        snānakāle tu sā proktā mṛttikā pāpanāśanī |
tatkāle karakaiḥ śāntiṃ te cāṣṭau toyapūritāḥ ||
catvāro vātha tāṃ datvā śiraḥsnāne triveṣṭitāḥ |
sabālāyās tataḥ kuryād vilipte maṇḍale śubhe ||
vedamaṅgalaghoṣaiś ca mantraiḥ puṣyābhiṣecanaiḥ |
ācāryaḥ kalaśaṃ divyaṃ abhimantrya tataḥ snapet ||
snānaṃ kāryam idaṃ divyaṃ sūtakānte tataḥ śiśoḥ |
mātaraṃ snāpayet paścād grahapūjāṃ tu kārayet ||
ācāryaṃ pūjayitvā tu brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam |
sauvarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ dadyād ācāryāya guṇānvitaḥ ||
dhenuṃ dadyāt tathā dhānyaṃ śatamānaṃ ca dakṣiṇām |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
tair vratair nanu jātasya grahariṣṭodbhavasya ca |
gaṇḍānte caiva bhāvasya bālasyeti vidhīyate |
kṛṣṇatilānāṃ tu ṣaṣṭyā hairaṇyaṃ mānam ucyate ||
ṣaṣṭikṛṣṇatilamitaṃ suvarṇamānam | nikumbho dantībhedaḥ suvarcasā sūrpasaktā | hastikarṇī eraṇḍaḥ | uṣṭravaḥ pīluḥ | madhukāro madhukaḥ | sarjarājo bījakaḥ | apāmārgaḥ ghāṭakaḥ | atimuktaṃ mādhavī | malatiḥ jātiḥ | svarṇapuṣpī muṣalā | śrīphalaṃ bilvam | madayantī pūtikā |
ardhasudanikā pālaṅkī | manmaśravṛkṣaś (?) cāmraḥ | suradāruḥ devadārubhedaḥ | vidārikā kuṣmāṇḍī | śvetavīthī girikarṇikā | śvetakākā guñjā | śeṣāṇi svanāmaprasiddhāni |
[648]        indrāya svāhā | agnaye svāhā | somāya svāhā | pavamānāya svāhā | marute svāhā | yamāya svāhā | mṛtyave svāhā | antakāya svāhātattvāyā | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā | trātāram indra | tvan no agne | sugantupanthām | asunvata | tattvāyāmi ānoniyuddhiḥ | vayaṃ soma | tam īśānam | asmai rudrā | syonā pṛthivī | ityādimantrāḥ |
iti mūlaśāntiḥ |
rāma uvāca |
kāmyaṃ karma samācakṣva vāṇijyaṃ yena sidhyati |
kṛṣiṃ ca bahulāṃ caiva karmaṇā kena vāśnute ||
puṣkara uvāca |
mūleṣūpoṣitaḥ kuryād idaṃ karma purohitaḥ |
upoṣitasya dharmajña yajamānasya nityaśaḥ ||
prāptāsu pūrvāṣāḍhāsu prāṅmukhaṃ snapayen naram |
yuktair vaitamamulaiś ca śaṅkhamuktāphalais tathā ||
maṇibhiś ca yathālābhaṃ kanakena tathaiva ca |
akālamūlaiḥ kalaśaiś caturbhir bhṛgunandana ||
akālamūlaiḥ navaiḥ |
tatas tu pūjayed devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
prāṅgaṇe tu tathaivātra varuṇaṃ ca niśākaram ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā |
[649]        eteṣām eva juhuyāt tathā nāmnā ghṛtaṃ dvijaḥ |
nīlavāsās tathā bhūtvā kṣiped apsu samāhitaḥ ||
nīlāni caiva vāsāṃsi deyāni vividhāni ca |
candanaṃ ca surā caiva maireyaṃ vividhaṃ tathā ||
śuklāni caiva mālyāni dhūpaṃ dadyād vratī tathā |
niṣpattimakarasyāsthi śaṅkhamuktāphale tathā |
suvarṇāntaritaṃ kṛtvā dhārayec ca tathā maṇim ||
kṛvaitat siddhim āpnoti vāṇijyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
samudrayāne ca tathā karṣaṇe ca na sīdati |
nīlāni sapta vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇā nātra śasyate ||
śaṅkhaṃ suvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ ca tathā muktāphalāni ca |
hartre kartre dvijebhyas tu sarvam etad vidhīyate |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cātra paramānnaṃ susaṃskṛtam ||
abhyarcya pratyekam athāṣtamūrtīḥ
karoti karmaitad aninditātmā |
na jātu lābhād vinivartate 'sau
samudrayānād iva nimnagā vai ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ vāṇijyalābhavratam |
sūta uvāca |
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro vasiṣṭha iti viśrutaḥ |
[650]        tasya śaktir abhūt putras tasya putraḥ parāśaraḥ ||
tapaś cakāra sumahadduṣkaraṃ devadānavaiḥ |
putrārthī brahmacārī ca tato labdhavaro bhavet ||
suputraṃ lapsasīty evaṃ bhavair ukto mahātmabhiḥ |
kuru saṃvatsaraṃ snānaṃ śravaṇe śravaṇe mune ||
so 'pi putrān avāpāṣṭau cakāra śraddhayānvitaḥ |
pārāśaryaḥ sutaṃ lebhe vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||
evam anyo 'pi rājendras tāvat siddhim avāpnuyāt |
putrān pautrāṃś ca labhate sukhaṃ cātyantam aśnute ||
ity ādityapurāṇoktaṃ putrotpattivratam |
śrīrāma uvāca |
snānānām iha sraveṣāṃ yaḥ snānam atiricyate |
tan mamācakṣva sakalaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ||
puṣkara uvāca |
śṛṇu pādodakasnānaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
caturātmā harir yatra bhavaty anvāgato dvija ||
tatra kāryam idaṃ snānaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
athottarāṣāḍhāsu nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ ||
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhair devadevasya śaktitaḥ |
pādaṃ prakṣālayed vidvān krameṇa caturātmanaḥ ||
tataḥ sukalaśān kuryāc caturaḥ sudṛḍhānnavān |
[651]        sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmram atha vāpi mahīśayān ||
tato niruddhacaraṇaḥ kūpādbhiḥ kṣālayet tataḥ ||
tābhis tu kalaśaṃ pūrṇaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ tadagrataḥ ||
tataḥ pradyumnacaraṇau kṣālyau praśravaṇodakaiḥ |
tais tu saṃpūrṇakalaśaṃ bhavet sthāpyaṃ tadagrataḥ ||
saṅkarṣaṇasya caraṇau kṣālyau toyaiś ca sārasaiḥ |
kalaśaṃ pūritaṃ taiś ca sthāpyaṃ tasyāgrato bhavet ||
vāsudevasya caraṇau nādeyaiḥ kṣālayed budhaḥ |
kalaśaṃ pūritaṃ taiś ca sthāpanīyaṃ tadagrataḥ ||
tatas tu pūjā kartavyā tathā vai caturātmanaḥ |
kalaśān pūrayet tāṃś ca gandhamālyaphalākṣataiḥ ||
tataḥ prāpte dvitīye 'hni snātaḥ pūrvam upoṣitaḥ |
saṃmukhaś cāniruddhaś ca snāpyaś cotkaṭuko bhavet ||
pradyumnasya ca devasya tataḥ saṅkarṣaṇasya ca |
tataś ca vāsudevasya sarvāvāsasya cakriṇaḥ ||
pavitramantraiḥ sarveṣāṃ ghaṭānām abhimantraṇam |
kartavyaṃ sānvayenātha śucinā bhārgavottama ||
atha mantrān pravakṣyāmi caturṣu kalaśeṣu te |
maṅgalyāṃś ca yaśasyāṃś ca sadyo 'ghaviniṣūdanān ||
aruddhamārgaḥ sarvatra sarvagaś cāparājitaḥ |
vāyumūrtir acintyātmā so 'niruddhaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ||
pādodakena divyena śivenāghavināśanaḥ |
tathādyam upahṛtyāśu svayaṃ vardhayati prabhuḥ ||
[652]        lokān pradyotayati yaḥ pradyumno bhāskaraḥ prabhuḥ |
hutāśanaḥ sa tejasvī maṅgalaṃ vidadhātu te ||
kāmadevo jagadyoniḥ sargavaḥ prabhur īśvaraḥ |
rogahartā jagannātho maṅgalāni dadātu me ||
jagatāṃ karṣaṇād devo yaḥ sa saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
rudramūrtir acintyātmā sarvagaḥ sarvadārakaḥ ||
kāmapālo 'ridamanaḥ sarvabhūtavaśaṃkaraḥ |
viśvayonir mahātejā maṅgalāni dadātu me ||
sarvāvāso vāsudevo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ |
sarvagaś cāprameyaś ca puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
anantaḥ sarvadeveśo jagattāraṇakāraṇaḥ |
aghāpahārī varado 'pi (?) dadhātu śriyaṃ mama ||
evaṃ snātaḥ (?) stutiṃ kṛtvā paridhāpya suvāsasī |
śuklavāsā upaspṛśya pūjāṃ kuryāt krameṇa tu ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ puṇyair dīpadhūpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
naivedyair vividhaiś caiva pāyasānnais tu pūjanaiḥ ||
evaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā sannatāśīr gatāśubhaḥ |
bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhed atandritaḥ ||
prādurbhāvāni mukhyāni śṛṇuyāt keśavasya ca |
pāṣaṇḍapatitānāṃ ca varjayed darśanaṃ tathā ||
iti pādodakasnānaṃ proktaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ tava |
maṅgalyam pāpaśamanam alakṣmīnāśanaṃ param ||
sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvabādhāvināśanam |
[653]        sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ sarvavyādhiharaṃ param ||
yātrāsiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhikārakam |
śatrughnaṃ buddhidaṃ madhye balāyuḥsmṛtivardhanam |
saubhāgyadaṃ kāmaparaṃ yaśaḥputravivardhanam ||
amoghavīryaṃ puruṣottamasya
pādokasnānam idaṃ pratiṣṭham |
snānottamaṃ te raṇacandravega-
bhuvas tu te kiṃ karavāṇi rāma ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ pādodakasnānam |
śrīrāma uvāca |
ārogyakārakaṃ snānaṃ dvitīyā pratipat tathā |
ārogyaṃ vrataṃ caiva vaiṣṇavaṃ kathayasva me ||
puṣkara uvāca |
dhaniṣṭāsu mahābhāga yajamānapurohitau |
upoṣya vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ yajamānasya kārayet ||
kṛtvā kumbhaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ śaṅkhamuktāphalodakaiḥ |
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭaḥ san snātaś caivāhatāmbaraḥ ||
keśavaṃ varuṇaṃ candraṃ nakṣatraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā |
pūjayet prayato rāma gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
dīpadhūpanamaskārais tathā caivānnasaṃpadā |
devatānāṃ yathoktānāṃ kurvītāvāhanaṃ tataḥ ||
sarvauṣadhais tathājyena yathāśakti vicakṣaṇaḥ |
[654]        gurave vāsasī deye rasagokumbhakāñcanam |
brāhmaṇān tu dātavyāvittaśāṭhyena dakṣiṇā ||
śamīśālmalijaiḥ patrair vaṃśāgreṇa tathaiva
trivṛtas tu maṇir dhāryaḥ sarvarogavināśanaḥ ||
śākāni haritaṃ mālyaṃ sarvaśasyāni vāsasī |
varuṇāya vinikṣipya gandhadhūpaṃ nivedayet ||
alaṅghayānasya hi vāruṇaṃ tat
snānena dānena kṛtena samyak |
rogāḥ samagrāḥ praśamaṃ prayānti
baddhas tathā mokṣam avāpnuyāc ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śatabhiṣāsnānam |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ karma tavānagha |
kartā tūpavaset tatra kārakaś ca tathaiva ca ||
parvabhādrapadāyoge ahibradhnagate tathā |
snānaṃ niśānte kurvīta dvitīye iti śāstravit ||
uḍumbarasya patrāṇi pañcagavyaṃ kuśodakam |
rocanā candanaṃ vāsaḥ kṣipet kumbhadvaye budhaḥ ||
kumbhadvayaṃ tataḥ kuryād gandhamālyāñjanair dṛḍham |
akālamūlaṃ saṃsnāpyaḥ kartā tena tadā bhavet ||
snātvā gobālavīrāṇi paridhāni samāhitaḥ |
pūjayec cāpy ahibradhnam ādityaṃ ca tathaiva ca ||
[655]        varuṇaṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ ca gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā |
dīpadhūpanamaskārais tathaiva balikarmaṇā ||
akṣatānāṃ tu pātrāṇi tato rāma caturdaśa |
ahibhradhnāya rudrāya sapharīś ca nivedayet ||
ṣaḍaṅgena tu dadyād vai tathā dhūpaṃ dvijottamaḥ |
tatas tu pūjā kartavyā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
oṃkārapūrvam ājyaṃ tu sarvāsāṃ juhuyāt tataḥ |
devatānāṃ yathoktānām ekaikasya śataṃ śatam ||
gopālaśaphaśṛṅgais tu trivṛtaṃ (?) kārayen maṇim |
dhāraṇaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ kare mūrdhny atha vā bhuje ||
kartre caivopadeṣṭre tu śaktyā deyā ca dakṣiṇā |
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
alaṅghayan bhādrapadām athānyāṃ
karoti yaḥ snānam idaṃ sadaiva |
bhavanti tasyāyutaśas tu gāvaḥ
parām avāpnoti tathaiva vṛddhim ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ ahibradhnasnānam |
valagur uvāca |
vratāny anyāni me brūhi kāmyāni dvijapuṅgava |
nārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca sarvajñas tvaṃ yato mama ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
kṛttikāsv arcayed devaṃ kārttikīprabhṛti kramāt |
[656]        yāvat syāt kārttikī bhūyo narasiṃham upoṣitaḥ ||
anulepanapuṣpādyaiḥ sarvaratnaiḥ sadaiva tu |
vratāvasāne dadyād gāṃ tathā śvetāṃ dvijātaye ||
śvetavatsayutāṃ caiva rajataṃ ca tathā nṛpa |
upoṣitaḥ sadā kuryād vrataṃ syāc chatruvarjitaḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣam athārabhya mṛgarkṣe pūjayen naraḥ |
anantaśayanāsīnam anantaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
anantapuṣpopacayam anantasukhasaṃpradam |
yathābhilaṣitāvāptiḥ kuru me puruṣottama ||
ity udīryābhipūjyainam upoṣaṇaparo naraḥ |
viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād anantaḥ prīyatām iti ||
pauṣamāsād athārabhya puṣye nityam upoṣitaḥ |
yāvat pauṣo bhaved bhūyo baladevam athārcayet ||
anulepanapuṣyādyaiḥ sarvaratnais tathaiva ca |
vratāvasāne dātavyaṃ kāṃsyaṃ kanakam eva ca |
bhaktyā viprāya bhavati nityaṃ puṣṭiyuto naraḥ ||
māghamāsād athārabhya maghāsu satataṃ naraḥ |
varāham arcayed devaṃ tathā nityam upoṣitaḥ ||
ghṛtābhyaṅgena vidhivac candanena sugandhinā |
tathā ca paramānnena ghṛtahomena vāpy atha ||
dadyād vratāvasāne tu ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipaḥ |
[657]        pitṛprasādanam āpnoti kṛtvaitad vratam uttamam ||
phalgunītas tathārabhya phālgunīṣu samarcayet |
naranārāyaṇo devo yāvat syāt phālgunī punaḥ |
vratāvasāne śayanaṃ svāstīrṇaṃ pratipādayet ||
vratenānena nārī syāt sabhartrī samalaṃkṛtā |
bhāryāṃ naras tathāpnoti rūpadraviṇasaṃyutām ||
anukūlāṃ priyāṃ nityaṃ tathā pakṣavatīṃ nṛpa |
aviyogam avaidhavyaṃ karoty etan mahāvratam ||
caitramāsād athārabhya nityaṃ citrāsv athārcayet |
yāvac caitrī bhaved bhūyo nityaṃ viṣṇum upoṣitaḥ ||
vratāvasāne dadyāc ca citraṃ vastraṃ dvijanmane |
vratenānena puruṣaḥ putrān āpnoty athepsitān ||
nārī vā puruṣavyāghra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
vaiśākhe ca tathā viṣṇuṃ viśākhāsu samarcayet ||
yāvad bhūyāt tu vaiśākhī sopavāsaḥ pṛthuṃ vibhum |
datvā vratānte kanakaṃ jñātiśraiṣṭhaṃ narottamaḥ ||
jaiṣṭhamāse tathā jyeṣṭhāsūpoṣito naraḥ sadā |
kṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayed devaṃ vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
vratāvasāne dātavyaṃ gavāṃ śatam anuttamam |
vastrāṇi kanakaṃ bhūri kṛṣṇasāyujyam āpnuyāt ||
āṣāḍhotas tathārabhya dinadvayam upoṣitaḥ |
āṣāḍhāsv arcayed devaṃ pradyumnam aparājitam ||
bhūyaḥ syāt tu yadāṣāḍhī dadyāc ca śayanaṃ tataḥ |
[658]        vistīrṇaṃ tena cāpnoti nityaṃ rūpayutāḥ (?) striyaḥ ||
śrāvaṇītas tv athārabhya graheṇa saṃyutaṃ harim |
pūrvavat sopavāsas tu yāvat syāt śrāvaṇī punaḥ ||
vratāvasāne dadyāc ca brāhmaṇāya ghṛtaṃ bahu |
vratenānena cīrṇena dīrghajīvitam āpnuyāt ||
ārabhya prauṣṭhapādīto nityaṃ bhādrapadādvaye |
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ pūjayet tu yāvad bhādrapadī punaḥ ||
vratāvasāne dadyāc ca gavāṃ mithunam uttamam |
vratenānena bhavati nityam ājñāyuto naraḥ ||
āśvayujyām athārabhya nityam evāśvinīṣu ca |
arcayet padmanābhaṃ tu vāsudevam upoṣitaḥ |
vratāvasāne dadyāc ca kāṃsyaṃ raupyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā ||
vratāny athaitāni mayā narendra
proktāni te pāpaharāṇi nityam |
nākapradāny uttamapuruṣāṇāṃ
kāmāptidāny eva yatheṣṭadāni ||
etadrūpāṇy āha viśvakarmā |
balabhadro nīlavāsā lāṅgalī muṣalī śitaḥ |
naranārāyaṇau nīlau sākṣāt śuklajaṭājiinau ||
rathasthaikaikacaraṇau madhyasthau sadṛśītanū |
vāṇavāṇāsanayutau dvicaturbāhudhāriṇau ||
pṛthuḥ sacāpo dvibhujo rājalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ |
śaṅkhakaumodakīpadmacakrī pradymna ucyate |
[659]        saṅkarṣaṇaḥ śaṅkhapadmacakrakaumodakodharaḥ ||
śeṣāṇi dharaṇīvrate vilokanīyāni |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sarvakāmāptivratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
aprāptena yathā duḥkham aiśvaryāder narottama |
tathā manorathair labdhanāśād duḥkhaṃ bhaven nṛṇām ||
aiśvaryād vicyuter vāpi santater vāpi lopataḥ ||
abhīṣṭād anyato vāpi svapadād yena vicyutim |
naro nāpnoti nārī vā vrataṃ tad brūhi me une ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
satyam etan mahābhāga duḥkhaprāptiś ca saṃkṣayaḥ |
aiśvaryasyaiva vittasya bandhuvargasutasya ca ||
tad eva śrūyatāṃ pārtha yathā neṣṭāt padācyutiḥ |
svargādir jāyate samyag upavāsavrate nṛṇām ||
dvādaśarkṣāṇi rājendra pratimāsaṃ tu yāni vai |
puṣpair dhūpais tathāmbhobhir abhīṣṭair aparair api ||
āditaḥ kṛttikāṃ kṛtvā kārttike nṛpasattama |
kṛśarām annanaivedyaṃ pūrvamāsacatuṣṭayam ||
nivedayet phālgunādau saṃyāvaṃ tu tataḥ param |
āṣāḍhādiṣu devāya pāyasaṃ vinivedayet ||
[660]        tena kṛśarāmānnanaivedyaṃ pūrvamāsacatuṣṭaye nivedayet | phālgunādiṣu saṃyāvaṃ tataḥ param āṣāḍhādiṣu caturṣu māseṣu pāyasaṃ vinivedayet |
tenaivānnena rājendra brāhmaṇān bhojayed budhaḥ |
pañcagavyajale snānaṃ tasyaiva prāśanāc chuciḥ ||
samyak saṃpūjya rājendra tam eva puruṣottamam |
praṇamya prārthayed vidvān śuciḥ (?) snāto yathāvidhi ||
namo namas te mama saṃkṣayo 'stu
pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyam |
aiśvaryavittādi sadākṣayaṃ me
'kṣayā ca me santatir acyutās tu ||
tathācyuta tvaṃ parataḥ parātmā
brahmātmabhūtaḥ parataḥ parātmā |
tathācyutaṃ me kuru vāñchitaṃ tat
pāpaṃ hare me tu harāprameyam ||
acyutānanda govinda prasīda yad abhīpsitam |
tad akṣayam ameyātman kuruṣva puruṣottama ||
evaṃ devaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayitvā yathāvidhi |
naivedyaṃ svayam aśnīyān nityaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte sukhaṃ suptotthite 'cyute |
saghṛtaṃ tāmrapātraṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād acyutaḥ prīyatām iti |
evaṃ trisaptame varṣe kuryād udyāpanaṃ tataḥ ||
[661]        tadagre brāhmaṇī sthāpyā sthavirā śāmbharāyaṇī |
mahāsatī raupyamayī tanmanārhā sadaiva sā ||
tatas te pūjayitvā tu mālyavastrānulepanaiḥ |
mantreṇānena rājendra praṇipatya vidhānataḥ ||
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ dadyād annapānaṃ dvijātaye |
brāhmaṇāya tilān dadyāt sahiraṇyājyasaṃyutān ||
gāś cātha dadyād viprāya savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ |
śayyāṃ ca śaktito dadyād bhaktyā tiṣṭhet tu keśavaḥ |
ghaṭasaptātra nirdiṣṭāḥ sthāpyāḥ pūrṇajalojjvalāḥ ||
chatropānadyugaiḥ sārdhaṃ datvā na cyavate naraḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena datvā viprān visarjayet ||
nṛtyagītena rājendra naraḥ prāpnoti vāñchitam |
santatiṃ svargasaubhāgyam aiśvaryaṃ ca tathaiva ca ||
tadvat timitam atyantaṃ tato na cyavate naraḥ |
tasmāt sarvaṃ prayatnena ātmanā caiva pūjayet |
yatetākṣayakāmas tu sadaiva puruṣottama ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
atrāpi śrūyate kācit siddhā svarge mahāvratā |
nārī tapasvinī bhūtvā prakhyātā śāmbharāyaṇī ||
samastasaṃdehaharā sadā svargaukasāṃ hitā |
kasmiṃścid eva kāle tu devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ |
pūrvendracaritaṃ rājan papracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim ||
pūrvendrāt parataḥ pūrve ye babhūvuḥ sureśvarāḥ |
[662]        teṣāṃ caritam icchāmi śrotum aṅgirasāṃ vara ||
evam uktas tadā tena devendreṇāmaladyutiḥ |
prāha dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ paramarṣir bṛhaspatiḥ ||
ātmanaḥ samakālīnaṃ mām avehi sureśvara |
tataḥ param ayaṃ devī bṛhaspatisamanvitaḥ ||
yayau yatra mahābhāgā samyag āste tapasvinī |
sā tau dṛṣṭvā samāyātau devarājabṛhaspatī ||
samyag dharmeṇa saṃpūjya praṇipatyāha suvratā |
namo 'stu devarājāya tathaivāṅgirase namaḥ ||
yad vā kāryaṃ mahābhāgaiḥ sakalaṃ tad ihocyatām |
yadi kartuṃ mayā śaktaṃ tat kariṣye 'vimṛśya ca ||
bṛhaspatir uvāca |
āvābhyām āgatau bhadre praṣṭum atrābhikāṅkṣiṇau |
yac ca kāryaṃ mahābhāge tat pṛṣṭaṃ kathayasva mām ||
yadi smarasi kalyāṇi pūrvendracaritāni vai |
tad ākhyāhi mahābhāge devendrasya kutūhalam ||
śāmbārāyaṇy uvāca |
yat te pūrvaṃ surendrasya tataś ca prathame hi yaḥ |
tasmāt pūrvatarā ye ca tasyāpi prathamaś ca yaḥ ||
teṣāṃ pūrvatarā ye vai vedmi tān akhilān aham |
teṣāṃ ca caritaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jānāmy aṅgirasāṃ vara ||
manvantarāṇy anekāni sṛṣṭayas tridivaukasaḥ |
saptarṣīṃś ca brahman vedmi manūnāṃ ca sutāṃś ca yān ||
[663]        evam uktvā surendrāṇāṃ sā śakraṃ śāmbarāyaṇī |
kathayāmāsa ācāryaṃ tad vāpi kathayāmi te ||
śṛṇu vatsa nakukarṇo devadaivatadurjayaḥ |
sa lokapālān samare vijitya sahadaivataiḥ |
indrasyāyatanaṃ paścāt praviveśa sunirbhayaḥ ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā prāptaṃ śakraḥ śayyātale luṭhan |
jugopa sahasā śrāntaṃ nakukarṇabhayād divam |
dānavaṃ śakraśayane praṇipātapuraḥsaraḥ ||
vāsudevas tu durvṛttaṃ dṛṣṭvā daivatakaṇṭakam |
cakāra kaṇṭhagrahaṇaṃ vāmadevas tena harṣitaḥ ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇaś ca tarasā gṛhya dorbhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
pīḍayāmāsa vihasan nadantaṃ bhairavān ravān ||
mamāra dānavendro 'sau balād bhagnārtapañjaraḥ |
nirjagāma tataḥ so 'pi śayyāmūlam avākśiraḥ ||
tuṣṭāva harim āsīnaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
etad dṛṣṭaṃ mayā śakra uvāca surarāṭ prati ||
tataḥ kuru tapo raudraṃ devarājas tapasvinīm |
uvāca jānāsi kathaṃ tvam etat śāmbarāyaṇi ||
śāmbharāyaṇy uvāca |
sarva eva hi devendra svargasthā ye sureśvarāḥ |
babhūvus caritaṃ teṣāṃ śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca ||
indra uvāca |
[664]        kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vada dharmajñe tvayānaghe yadṛcchayā |
svarloke vasatiṃ prāptā yathānyāyena kenacit ||
aho sarvavratānāṃ ca hy upoṣitamayohatam |
pradhānataram atyantaṃ svargavāsapradaṃ matam ||
evam uktvā tatas tena devendreṇa tapasvinī |
pratyuvāca mahābhāgā yathā tac chāmbharāyaṇī ||
samarthair arcito devaḥ pratimāsaṃ sureśvara |
yathoktavratam āsādya saptavarṣāṇi pūjitaḥ ||
tasyeyaṃ karmaṇo vyāptir acyutārādhanasya me |
devalokād abhimatād devarāja yad acyutiḥ ||
svargaṃ dravyam athaiśvaryaṃ satataṃ yāni vāñchati |
naraḥ prāpnoti tat sarvaṃ toṣaṇīyas tataḥ prabhuḥ ||
etat te pūrvadevendracaritaṃ sakalaṃ mayā |
svargavāsākṣayatvaṃ ca māsād acyutapūjanāt ||
yathā ca kathitaṃ deva pṛcchatas tridaśeśvara |
dharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ ca vāñchitaṃ vibudhādhipaiḥ |
viṣṇor ārādhanāyānyat paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam ||
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā devarājabṛhaspatī |
tāṃ tathety ūcatuḥ sādhvīṃ caratuś cāpi tad vratam ||
tasmāt pārtha prayatnena pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ |
māsi māsy acyutaṃ pūjya bhavethās tanmanās tadā ||
ye śāmbarāyaṇikathāṃ caritavratena
varṣāṇi sapta vidhinā sudhiyo nayanti |
[665]        te svargalokam abhilabhya kṛtādhivāsāḥ
kalpāyutaṃ sutaśatair api na cyavanti ||
iti śrībhaviṣyottare śāmbharāyaṇīvratam |
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
śṛṇuṣva ca mahīpāla vrataṃ viṣṇupadatrayam |
sarvapāpaśamanaṃ yaj jagāda purā hariḥ ||
dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ viṣṇum ārādhya pṛṣṭavān |
bahuśaś ca vipannāyāṃ sa sṛṣṭāv arisūdanaḥ ||
dakṣa uvāca |
bhagavan sarvakartṛtvam ādiṣṭaṃ me svayaṃbhuvā |
brahmaṇā devadevena tavādeśena keśava ||
vipannena jagannātha samasṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā tava |
viṣayāsaṅgaviśamāt tan mamācakṣva cācyuta ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
ity evam ukto dakṣeṇa devadevo janārdanaḥ |
ācaṣṭa duḥkhakṣayadaṃ vrataṃ viṣṇupadatrayam ||
sarvārambhaviniṣpattikārakaṃ pāpanāśanam |
saṃsārocchedakair dhīrair yatheṣṭaṃ sthirabuddhibhiḥ ||
tad ahaṃ tava rājendra vratānām uttamottamam |
kathayāmi samācaṣṭa yathāpūrvaṃ samāsataḥ ||
āṣāḍhe māsi rājendra pūrvāṣāḍhāsu pārthiva |
[666]        samabhyarcya jagannātham acyutaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
puṣpair dhūpais tathā hṛdyair gandhaiḥ sāgurucandanaiḥ ||
yathāvibhavataś cānyai ratnair vāsobhir eva tu |
kṣīrasnehasthitaṃ tadvad dravyair viṣṇupadatrayam ||
samabhyarcya yathāśaktyā keśavasyāgrato nyaset |
yavāṃś ca dadyād viprāya śrīpatiḥ prīyatām iti ||
naktaṃ bhuñjīta rājendra haviṣyānnaṃ suśobhanam |
tathaivottaraṣāḍhāsu śrāvaṇe māsi mānavaḥ ||
tathaivābhyarcya govindaṃ tathā viṣṇupadatrayam |
viprāya ca ghṛtaṃ datvā prīṇayitvā bhuvaḥpatim ||
bhuñjīta gorasaprāyaṃ mānavo maunam āsthitaḥ |
strī vā rājendra pūrvāsu tathā bhādrapadāsu vai ||
phālgune phālgunī pūrvā bhaved iti yadā nṛpa ||
trivikramaṃ tadā devaṃ pūrvoktavidhinārcayet |
padatrayaṃ tu devasya samabhyarcya tu pārthiva ||
hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt svargatiḥ prīyatām iti |
naktaṃ bhuñjīta rājendra ājyapākavivarjitam ||
eṣa evottarāyoge caitre māsi vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
aputro labhate putram apatir labhate patim ||
samāgamaṃ pravāsac ca tathā prāpnoti bāndhavaiḥ |
bhadram aiśvaryam ārogyaṃ pūjayitvā padatrayam |
yān yān kāmān naraḥ strī vā hṛdayenābhivāñchati ||
[667]        tāṃs tān āpnoti niṣkāmo viṣṇulokaṃ prapadyate ||
pūrvaṃ kṛtvāpi pāpāni naraḥ strī vā narādhipa |
padatrayaṃ vrataṃ cātra mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ viṣṇupadavratam |
dakṣa uvāca |
aputratā mahāduḥkham atiduḥkhaṃ kuputratā |
kuputraḥ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ hetubhūto yato mama ||
dhanyās te tu sutaṃ prāpya sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ |
śaktaṃ praśāntabalinaṃ bhaktaṃ guṇavicakṣaṇam ||
svakarmanirataṃ nityaṃ devadvijaparāyaṇam |
astrajñaṃ vedadharmajñaṃ dīnānāthasamāśrayam ||
daivānukūlatāyuktaṃ (?) yuktaṃ samyagguṇena tu |
prāpnoti putraṃ vai yo 'smān nānyo dhanyataro bhuvi ||
so 'ham icchāmi tat śrotuṃ tvattaḥ karma mahāmune |
yena tallakṣaṇaḥ putro labhyate mānavair iha ||
pulastya uvāca |
evam etan mahābhāga pitroḥ putrasamudbhavam |
sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ yenaitat kathayāmi te ||
kṛtavīryo mahīpālo haihayānāmabhūt (?) purā |
tasya śīlavatīnāmnī babhūva varavarṇinī ||
sā tv aputrā mahābhāgā maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata |
[668]        guṇāṃś ca putralābhasya kṛtāsanaparigrahā |
kathayāmāsa maitreyī nāmnānantavrataṃ śubham ||
maitreyy uvāca |
yo 'yam icchen naraḥ kamaṃ nārī vā varvarṇinī |
sa taṃ samārādhya vibhuṃ (?) samyag āpnoti keśavāt ||
mārgaśīrṣe mṛgaśiraṛkṣaṃ yasmin dine bhave |
tasmin saṃprāśya gomūtraṃ snātvā niyatamānasaḥ ||
puṣpair dhūpais tathā gandhair upahāraiś ca śaktitaḥ |
vāmapādam anantasya pūjayed varavarṇini ||
anantaḥ sarvakāmāya anantaṃ bhagavān phalam |
dadātv anantaṃ ca punas tad ihaivānyajanmani ||
anantapuṇyopacayaṃ karoty etan mahāvratam |
tathābhilaṣitāvāptiṃ kuru me puruṣottama ||
ity uccāryārcanaṃ tasya yathāvidhi vidhānataḥ |
samāhitamanā bhūtvā praṇipātapuraḥsaram ||
viprāya dakṣiṇān dadyād anantaḥ prīyatām iti |
ity uccārya tathā naktaṃ bhuñjīyāt tailavarjitam ||
tathaiva puruṣaṃ pauṣe puṣparkṣe bhagavatkaṭim |
vāmām abhyarcya kartavyaṃ gomūtraprāśanaṃ tataḥ |
anantaḥ sarvakāmānām iti coccārayet punaḥ ||
bhuñjīta ca tathānyāyaṃ vācayitvā dvijottamān |
māghe maghāsu tadvad vai bāhū devasya pūjayet ||
skandhaṃ ca phālgunīyoge phālgune māsi bhāmini |
[669]        caturṣv eteṣu māseṣu gomūtraprāśanaṃ matam ||
brāhmaṇāya tathā dadyāt tilān dhānyakam eva ca |
devasya dakṣiṇaṃ skandhaṃ caitre citrāsu pūjayet ||
tathaiva prāśayec cātra pañcagavyaṃ mahīpate |
kiṃcit tu kanakaṃ dadyād yāvan māsacatuṣṭayam ||
vaiśākhe tu viśākhāyāṃ bāhuṃ saṃpūjya dakṣiṇam |
tathaiva dadyāt kanakaṃ naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
jyeṣṭhāsu ca kaṭiṃ pūjya jyaiṣṭhe māsi śubhavrata |
āṣāḍhāsu tathāṣāḍhe kuryāt pādārcanaṃ vibhoḥ ||
pādadvayaṃ tu śravaṇe śrāvaṇe māsi pūjayet |
ghṛtaṃ viprāya dātavyaṃ prāśayīta yathāvidhi ||
kārttikānteṣu māseṣu prāśanaṃ dānam eva tu |
mukhaṃ prauṣṭhapadāyoge māsi bhādrapade 'rcayet ||
tadvad evāśvine pūjye hṛdayaṃ cāśvinīṣu ca |
kuryāt samāhitamanā snānaṃ prāśanam arcanam ||
anantaśirasaḥ pūjāṃ kārttike kṛttikāsu ca |
yasmin yasmin dine pūjā tatra tatra dine dine ||
nāma tasya tu japtavyaṃ kṣutaḥ prasvalitādiṣu |
ghṛtenānantam uddiśya pūrvamāsacatuṣṭayam ||
tataś caturṣu māseṣu madhunā kulanandana |
kṣīreṇa śrāvaṇādau ca homo māsacatuṣṭayam ||
praśastaṃ sarvamāseṣu haviṣyānnena bhojanam |
evaṃ dvādaśabhir māsaiḥ pāraṇatritayaṃ bhavet ||
[670]        vratāvasāne cānantaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kārayec chubham ||
rājataṃ muṣalaṃ caiva tatpārśve vinivedayet |
puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaṃ pūjā kāryā yathāvidhi ||
nāmnā pīṭhopari hariṃ mantrair ebhir yathākramam |
namo 'stv anantāya śiraḥ pādau sarvātmane namaḥ ||
śeṣāya jānuyugalaṃ kāmāyeti kaṭiṃ namaḥ |
namo 'stu vāsudevāya pārśve saṃpūjayed dhareḥ ||
saṅkarṣaṇāyety udaraṃ bhujau sarvāstradhāriṇe |
kaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhanāmnā vai mukham indumukhāya ca ||
halaṃ ca muṣalaṃ caiva svanāmnā pūjayed budhaḥ |
evaṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ sitavastravibhūṣitam ||
chatropānatsamāyuktaṃ sragdāmālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā ||
nakṣatradevatāḥ pūjyā nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ |
somaṃ nakṣatrarājānaṃ māsān saṃvatsaraṃ tathā ||
nakṣatradevatās tu bhaviṣyatpurāṇāt |
aśvinau yamarāḍ agnir dhātā candra umāpatiḥ |
aditir vākpatiḥ sarpāḥ pitaraś ca bhago 'ryamā ||
ravis tvaṣṭā maruc caiva śakrāgnī mitra eva ca |
maghavā nirṛtis toyaṃ viśvedevāḥ śriyaḥpatiḥ ||
vasavo varuṇas tasmād ajo 'hivradhnapūṣaṇau |
nakṣatradevatā hy etā kathitās tava devatāḥ ||
dvādaśātra ghaṭāḥ kāryāḥ satoyāś cānnasaṃyutāḥ ||
[671]        evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivad devadevaṃ janārdanam |
brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā tu vastrair ābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
ekaṃ vā vedavedāṅapāragaṃ saṃyatendriyam |
purāṇajñaṃ dharmavidam avyaṅgaṃ tu priyaṃvadam ||
tasya deyaṃ samastaṃ tadantataḥ prīyatām iti |
anyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu deyaṃ vittānusārataḥ ||
anena vidhinā bhadre vrataṃ caitat samāpyate |
pārite ca samāpnoti sarvān eva manorathān ||
putrārthibhir vittakāmair bhṛtyadārān abhīsubhiḥ |
prārthayadbhiś ca martye 'smin nārogyabalasaṃpadaḥ |
etad vrataṃ mahābhāge puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ param ||
anantavratasaṃyuktaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
tat kuruṣv etad eva tvaṃ vrataṃ śīladhanapradam |
variṣṭhaṃ sarvalokasya yadi putram abhīpsasi ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam anantavratam |
purūravā uvāca |
śrotum icchāmi bhagavan rūpasatraṃ mahāphalam |
yatsamāptau bhaviṣyāmi divyarūpadharo mune ||
atrir uvāca |
tad etad vratakāmena anviṣyau brāhmaṇau guruḥ |
jyotiṣaṃ yo 'bhijānāti itihāsāṃś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
tatpradiṣṭena vidhinā pādākṣaprabhṛtikramāt |
[672]        phālgunyāṃ samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī tu yā |
samūlāṃ tāṃ tu saṃprāpya vrataṃ gṛhṇīta mānavaḥ ||
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ nakṣatrasya ca daivatam |
varuṇaṃ ca tathā candraṃ pūjayed vidhinā naraḥ ||
pūjayed devadevaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ janārdanam |
upoṣyāṅgāni devasya prayatnena ca pūjayet ||
tato 'gnivahanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tathā gurum |
upavāsas tu kartavyo dvitīye 'hani pārthiva ||
upoṣya ṛkṣe vigate snātvā saṃpūjya keśavam |
kṛtvāgnihavanaṃ śaktyā pūjayitvā dvijottamān ||
haviṣyānnaṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ śṛṇu cāṅgakramaṃ mama |
