pādayoḥ kathitaṃ mūlaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu jaṅghayoḥ ||
aśvinau jānuyugalaṃ ūruyugme ca pārthiva |
sahite dve tathāṣāḍhe guhyaṃ ca sahite smṛte ||
pūrvottare ca phālgunyau kṛttikā ca kaṭir bhavet |
pārśvayoḥ kukṣiyutayor nakṣatratritayaṃ samam |
ubhe proṣṭhapade rājan revatī ca tathā bhavet ||
uro'nurādhāsu pṛṣṭhaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu prakīrtitam |
bhujau jñeyau viśākhāsu haste proktau tathā karau ||
aṅgulyaś ca tathā proktā rājasiṃhapunarvasau |
aśleṣāyāṃ nakhāḥ proktā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ nṛpa kandharaḥ ||
śravaṇe śravaṇau jñeyau mukhaṃ puṣye prakīrtitam |
[673]        dattāḥ svātau śatabhiṣā hanuḥ proktā tathā nṛpa ||
maghāyāṃ nāsike prokte mṛgaśīrṣe ca locane |
citrā lalāṭe vijñeyā bharaṇyāṃ ca tathā śiraḥ ||
śiroruhās tathārdrāsu vratasyānte narādhipa |
caitraśuklāvasāne tu satraṃ parisamāpyate ||
yady antarāyaṃ na bhavet kiṃcic chaucaṃ nimittajam |
aṅgakrameṇa sakalam ṛkṣavargam upoṣitaḥ ||
vratānte prayataḥ snātvā pūjayen madhusūdanam |
candanāgurukarpūramṛgadarbhaiḥ sakuṅkumaiḥ ||
jātīphalaiḥ sakakkolair lavaṅgakusumais tathā |
bālagugguluniryāsaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
dhūpo narendrāguruṇā candanena sugandhinā |
dīpāś ca deyā rājendra tilatailena pūritāḥ ||
aśeṣā vartayaḥ kāryā mahārajatarañjitāḥ |
naivedyaṃ ca tathā kāryaṃ paramānnena pūriṇā ||
dadhnā kṣīraghṛtābhyāṃ ca madhunā ca guḍena ca |
sitayā ca tathā bhakṣyaiḥ phalair mūlair yathāvidhi ||
apūpaiḥ pānakair hṛdyaiḥ śitalaiś ca sugandhibhiḥ ||
lavaṇasya ca pātrāṇi kṛśaraṃ ca nivedayet |
sarvabījāni rājendra bhūṣaṇāni ca śaktitaḥ ||
mahārhāṇi ca vastrāṇi bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ |
tad viṣṇoḥ param ity evaṃ homaḥ kāryo hy anantaram ||
dvādaśākṣarako mantraḥ strīśūdrṣu vidhīyate |
[674]        ghṛtamākṣikasaṃyuktān juhuyāt tilataṇḍulān |
tatas tu dakṣiṇā deyā gurave nṛpasattama ||
nāgāni ca pradeyāni grāmāṇi vividhāni ca |
turagāṇi ca mukhyāni ratnāni vividhāni ca ||
brāhmaṇas tu pitā jñeyo rūpasatrapradarśakaḥ |
rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyajanmārogyapradāyakaḥ ||
rājyasya vā dvijatvasya bahuvittasya dāyakaḥ |
na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā gantuṃ dānena bhūriṇā ||
guruprasāda evātra dakṣiṇā na tu kāraṇam |
tasmāt prasādam ākāṅkṣed rūpasattrapradarśakaḥ ||
avaśyaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ ghṛytapūrṇaṃ tu bhājanam |
catuḥpalaṃ tu kāṃsyasya suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasya ca ||
tataḥ paraṃ bhojanīyāḥ svaśaktyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ |
lavaṇakṣīradadhyājyaguḍabhakṣasitoṅkaṭam ||
bhojanaṃ pānakopetaṃ paścād deyā ca dakṣiṇā |
vastrayugmaṃ pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇasya navaṃ śubham |
bahumūlyaṃ śumbaṃ caiva mahārajatarañjitam ||
sapta bījāni deyāni lavaṇaṃ kupyam eva ca |
yac cānyad apy abhīṣṭaṃ syāc chatropānaham eva ca ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ chatradāne mahīpate |
avaśyadeyaṃ sattre 'smin ghṛtapūrṇaṃ tu bhājanam ||
catuḥpalaṃ tu kāṃsaysa suvarṇaṃ kāñcanasya ca |
vratenānena cīrṇena dehatyāge divaṃ vrajet ||
[675]        tatrāste suciraṃ kālaṃ mānuṣye yadi jāyate |
rājā bhavati dharmajño brāhmaṇo vā dhanānvitaḥ ||
kule mahati saṃbhūto rūpeṇāpratimo bhuvi |
ārogyaṃ mahad āpnoti saubhāgyam api cottamam ||
lāvaṇyaṃ buddhimedhāṃ ca matiṃ dharme 'tiśāśvatīm |
saṃpūrṇacandrapratimaḥ sarvasattvavaśaṃkaraḥ ||
narā bhavati rājendra nārī cāpsarasāṃ samā |
subhagā darśanīyā ca lāvaṇyaguṇasaṃyutā ||
bahudhānyā bahudhanā bahubhūṣaṇasaṃyutā |
bhartuś cātyantadayitā loke khyātā ca sadguṇaiḥ |
nityārogyavatī kāntā sarvadoṣavivarjitā ||
candrānanā nīlasarojanetrā
trailokyakāntā pativallabhā ca |
bhavaty avaśyaṃ subhagā suśīlā
lāvaṇyayuktā yaśasā śriyā ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rūpasattravratam |
atha nīrājanavidhiḥ |
rāma uvāca |
nīrājanaṃ vidhiṃ tvattaḥ śrotum icchāmi sattama |
kathaṃ kāryā narendrasya śāntir nīrājanī prabho |
puṣkara uvāca |
[676]        pūrvottare tu digbhāge nagare ca manohare |
vistīrṇaṃ kārayed rājan sumanoharam āśramam ||
kaṭair guptaṃ kuśāstīrṇaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam |
toraṇatritayaṃ tatra prāṅmukhaṃ kārayec chubham ||
kāryaṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ tu toraṇaṃ tu samucchrayet |
vaipulyaṃ daśahastaṃ tu tathā kāryaṃ bhṛgūttama ||
toraṇād dakṣiṇe bhāge tatra kāryam athāśramam |
devatārcā bhavet tatra tathāgnivahanakriyā ||
aṣṭahastāyatotsedham ulmukānāṃ tu vāmataḥ |
kāryaṃ bhavati śuṣkāṇāṃ kūṭaṃ bhṛgukulodvaha ||
pañcaraṅgakasūtreṇa śatagranthir manoramā |
madhyame toraṇe kuryāc chatapāśān tu madhyagām |
chādayitvā kuśais tāṃ tu mṛdā saṃchādayet punaḥ ||
tasmāc (?) laṅganaṃ varjaṃ prapannāt sarvajantubhiḥ |
na laṅghitā ca yāvat syāt prathamaṃ rājahastinā ||
citrān tyaktvā yadā svātiṃ savitā pratipadyate |
tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyā yāvat svātau raviḥ sthitaḥ ||
āśrame pratyahaṃ devāḥ pūjanīyā dvijottama |
brahmā viṣṇuś ca śambhuś ca śakraś caivānilānalau ||
vināyakaḥ kumāraś ca varuṇo dhanado yamaḥ |
viśve devā mahābhāgā uccaiḥśravasa eva ca ||
[677]        aṣṭau mahāgajāḥ pūjyās teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu |
kumudai rāvaṇaḥ padmaḥ puṣpadanto 'tha vāmanaḥ ||
supratīko 'ñjano nīla ete 'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ |
pūjā kāryā graharkṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca purodhasā ||
tatas tu juhuyād ahnau purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ |
yathābhihatadevānāṃ mantrais talliṅgasaṃjñakaiḥ ||
tathā ca mantrahīnānāṃ praṇavena mahābhuja ||
samidhaḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ tathā siddhārthakāni ca |
hutvā ca kalaśān kuryāt sodakān ghanasaṃyutān ||
pūjitān mālyagandhaiś ca vanaspativibhūṣitān |
pañcaraṅgakasūtreṇa kuryād vastrayugaṃ tathā |
bhallātaśālisiddhārthavacākuṣṭhapriyaṅgavaḥ ||
tīraṇāt paścime bhāge kalaśaiḥ pūrvakalpitaiḥ |
snātaḥ saṃsnāpanīyāḥ syur mantrapūtair gajottamāḥ ||
turagāś ca mahābhāga alaṃkṛtya tatas tu tān |
tato 'bhiṣekaṃ nāgasya tathā taṃ turagasya ca ||
annapiṇḍaṃ tato deyam abhimantrya purodhasā |
tasyābhinandane rājño vijayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
tyāge ca tasya vijñeyaṃ mahad bhayam upasthitam |
niṣkrāmayet toraṇais tu tato hi prathamaṃ gajam ||
tatrāpi prathamaṃ rāma abhiṣiktaṃ gajottamam |
tasyādau turagaṃ caiva rajño maraṇam ādiśet ||
durbhikṣaṃ tatra vijñeyaṃ gokhuroṣṭrasya laṅghane ||
[678]        laṅghayed vāmapādena yadi taṃ nṛpa kuñjaraṃ |
rājñīpurohitāmātyarājaputrāhitaṃ bhavet ||
rājñas tu maraṇaṃ brūyād ākrāmet taṃ padā yadā |
rājño vijayam ācaṣṭe laṅghayed dakṣiṇena tam ||
rājahastini niṣkrānte sānvayasya kṣayo bhavet |
niṣkrāmeyus tataḥ sarve prāṅmukhās toraṇair gajāḥ ||
tato 'śvāḥ sumahābhāga tatas tu narasattama |
tataś chatraṃ dhvajaṃ caiva rājaliṅgāni yāni ca ||
tatas tu tāni saṃsthāpya pūjayed āyudhāni ca |
pañcaraṅgakasūtreṇa yās tāḥ pratisarākṛtāḥ ||
dūṣyādūṣyeti mantreṇa nibadhnīyāt purohitaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ nṛpa nāgānāṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ ca bhārgava ||
svagṛheṣv atha te neyāḥ kuñjarās turagaiḥ saha |
svātisthaḥ savitā yāvat tāvac chālāsu saṃsthitān ||
pūjayet satataṃ rāma mā krośen na ca tāḍayet |
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi pūjayed āśrame sadā ||
pūjayed varuṇaṃ nityaṃ tathā suvidhivad dvijān |
bhūtejyā ca tadā kāryā rātrau balibhir uttamaiḥ ||
āśramo rakṣaṇīyaḥ syāt puruṣaiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ |
vasetām āśrame nityaṃ saṃvatasarapurohitau ||
aśvavaidyapradhānaś ca tathā nāgabhiṣagvaraḥ |
dīkṣitaiś ca tathā bhāvyaṃ brahmacāribhir eva ca ||
svātiṃ tyaktvā yadā suryo viśākhāṃ pratipadyate |
[679]        alaṃkuryād dine tasmin vāhanaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
pūjitā rājaliṅgāś ca kartavyā narahastagāḥ ||
hastinaṃ turagaṃ chatraṃ khaḍgaṃ cāpaṃ ca dundubhim |
dhvajaṃ patākaṃ dharmajña cāpaṃ tam abhimantrayet ||
abhimantrya tataḥ sarvān kuryāt kuñjaradhūrgatān |
kuñjaroparigau syātāṃ saṃvatsarapurohitau ||
aśvavaidyapradhānaś ca tathā nāgabhiṣagvaraḥ |
tato 'bhimantritaṃ rājā samāruhya turaṅgamam ||
niṣkramya toraṇair nāgam abhimantritam āruhet |
toraṇena viniṣkramya kuryāt suravivarjitam ||
baliṃ vibhajya vidhivad rājā kuñjaradhūrgataḥ |
ratnair alaṃkṛtaḥ sarvair vījyamānaś ca cāmaraiḥ ||
unmukānāṃ tu nicayam adīpitam anantaram |
rājā pradakṣiṇīkuryāt trin vārān susamāhitaḥ ||
caturaṅgabalopetaḥ sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ |
pauraiḥ kilikilāśabdaiḥ sarvavāditranisvanaiḥ |
balitaiś ca padātīnāṃ dṛṣṭvā tān manujottama ||
evaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ gacched rājasainyapuraḥsaraḥ |
janaṃ saṃpūjya ca mahat sarvam eva visarjayet ||
śāntir nīrājanākhyeyaṃ kartavyā vasudhādhipaiḥ |
kṣemavṛddhikarī rāma narakuñjaravājinām ||
dhanyā yaśasyā ripunāśanī ca
sukhāvahā śāntir anuttamā ca |
[680]        kāryā nṛpai rāṣṭravivṛddhihetoḥ
sarvaprayatnena bhṛgupravīra ||
iti viṣṇudharmottarokto nīrājanavidhiḥ |
bhīṣma uvāca |
upavāseṣv aśaktasya tad eva phalam icchataḥ |
anabhyāsena rogād vā kim iṣṭavratam ucyatām ||
pulastya uvāca |
upavāseṣv aśaktānāṃ naktaṃ bhojanam iṣyate |
yasmin vrate tad apy atra śrūyatāṃ vai vrataṃ mahat ||
ādityaśayanaṃ nāma yathāvac chaṅkarārcanam |
yeṣu nakṣatrayogeṣu purāṇajñā pracakṣate ||
yadā hastena saptamyām ādityasya dinaṃ bhavet |
sūryasya vātha saṃkrāntau sā tithiḥ sarvakāmikī ||
umāmaheśvarasyārcām arcayet sūryanāmabhiḥ |
sūryārcāṃ śivaliṅgaṃ ca ubhayaṃ pūjayed ataḥ ||
umāpate raver vāpi na bhedaḥ kvacid iṣyate |
yasmāt tasmān nṛpaśreṣṭha gṛhe śuṃbhuṃ samarcayet ||
arcā pratimā | umāmaheśvararūpaṃ tu prathamakṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratoktaṃ veditavyam |
hastena sūryāya namo 'stu pādāv
arkāya citrāsu ca gulphadeśam |
[681]        svātīṣu jaṅghe ca surottamāya
dhātre viśākhāsu ca jānudeśam ||
tathānurādhāsu namo 'stu pūjya
ūrudvayaṃ devasahasrabhānoḥ |
jyeṣṭhāsv anaṅgāya namo 'stu guhyam
indrāya somāya kaṭiṃ ca mūle ||
pūrvottarāṣāḍhayuge ca nābhiṃ
tvaṣṭre namaḥ saptaturaṅgamāye (?) |
tīkṣṇaṃśave tu śravaṇe ca vakṣaḥ
kakṣe dhaniṣṭhāsu vikartanāya ||
vakasthalaṃ dhvāntavināśanāya
jalādhiparkṣe pratipūjanīyam |
jalādhiparkṣam śatatārā |
pūrvottarābhādrapadadvaye ca
bāhū namaś candrakarāya pūjyau ||
sāmnām adhīśāya karadvaye ca
saṃpūjanīyaṃ nṛpa revatīṣu |
nakhāni pūjyāni tathāśvinīṣu
namo 'stu saptāśvadhurandharāya ||
kaṭhoradhāmne bharaṇīṣu pṛṣṭhaṃ
divākarāyety abhipūjanīyā |
grīvāgniṛkṣe 'dharam ambujeṣaṃ
saṃpūjayed bhāratarohiṇīṣu ||
[682] agniṛkṣaṃ tu kṛttikā |
mṛgottamāṅge daśanāḥ purāre
saṃpūjanīyā haraye namas te |
namaḥ savitre iti śāṅkare tu
nāsākṣipūjyātha punarvasau ca ||
śāṅkaram ārdrā |
lalāṭam ambhoruhavallabhāya
puṣye 'lakān vedasamīraṇāya |
sārpye 'tha mauliṃ vibudhapriyāya
maghāsu karṇāv iti gogaṇeśaḥ ||
sārpyam aśleṣā |
pūrvāsu gobrāhmaṇanandanāya
netrāṇi saṃpūjyatamāni śambhoḥ |
athottarāphālguniṣu bhruvau ca
viśveśvarāyeti ca pūjanīyau ||
namo 'stu pāśāṅkuśapadmamūla-
kapālasarpendudhanurdharāya |
gajāsurānaṅgapurāndhakāre
vināśamūlāya namaḥ śivāya ||
ityādi cāstrāṇi ca pūjya nityaṃ
viśveśvarāyeti śiro 'bhipūjyam |
bhoktavyam atraiva satailam annam
amāṃsam akṣāram abhaktaśeṣam ||
[683]        ityevaṃvidhanaktāni kṛtvā dadyāt punar vṛṣam |
śāleyataṇḍulaprastham uḍumbaramaye ghṛtam ||
uḍumbaramaye tāmramaye |
saṃsthāpya pātre viprāya sahiraṇyaṃ nivedayet |
saptame vastrayugmaṃ ca pāraṇe tv adhikaṃ bhavet ||
caturdaśe tu saṃprāpte pāreṇe bhāratābdike |
ābdike sāṃvatsarike | saptaviṃśatyā divasair ekaikaṃ pāraṇam iti saṃvatsare aṣṭādaśadinādhike caturdaśapāraṇāni bhavanti |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā guḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ ||
kṛtvātha kāñcanaṃ padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam |
śuddham aṣṭāṅgulaṃ tac ca padmarāgadalānvitam ||
śayyāṃ vilakṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā viruddhagranthivarjitām |
sopadhānakaviśrāmāṃ svāstīrṇāṃ caraṇāśrayām ||
pādukopānahachatracāmarāsanadarpaṇaiḥ |
bhūṣaṇair api saṃyuktāṃ phalavastrānulepanaiḥ ||
tasyāṃ nidhāya tat padmam alaṃkṛtya guṇānvitam |
kapilāṃ vastrasaṃyuktām atiśīlāṃ payasvinīm ||
raupyakṣurāṃ hemaśṛṅgīṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanīm |
dadyān mantreṇa pūrvāhne vahninābhilaṅghayet ||
yathaivādityaśayanam aśūnyaṃ tava sarvadā |
kāntyā dhṛtyā śriyā ratyā tathā me santu siddhayaḥ ||
yathā na deyāḥ śreyāṃsi tvadanyam anaghaṃ viduḥ |
tathā mām uddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt |
[684]        tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya ca visarjayet ||
śayyāsanādi tat sarvaṃ dvijasya bhavanaṃ nayet |
idaṃ mahāpātakabhinnarānām
aghakṣayaṃ vedavido vadanti |
na bandhputreṇa dhanair niyuktaḥ
patnībhir ānandakaraḥ surāṇām |
nābhyeti rogaṃ na ca duḥkhaśokaṃ
yā vāpy nārī kurute 'tha bhaktyā ||
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ
hariśayanaṃ puruḥutavallabhaḥ syāt |
api narakagatān pitṝn aśeṣāan
api divam ānayatīha yaḥ karoti ||
iti padmapurāṇoktam ādityaśayanavratam |
aśvinyām ahorātraṃ vā dināni tiḥ viṃśa (?) rogo jāyate | aśvinau deva te | kṣiralaḍḍukanaivedyam | nīlotpalapuṣpam | ghṛtagugguludhūpaḥ | devasyeti pūjāmantraḥ | kṣīravṛkṣasya samidho homadravyam || 1 ||
bharaṇyāṃ mṛtyuḥ saṃdeho vā | dināni ekaviṃśatiḥ | yamo devatā | guḍapūpārkanaivedyam | kṛṣṇasurabhipuṣpam | surabhī tulasī | putrakeśaguḍadhūpaḥ | tryambakaṃ yajājaha iti pūjāmantraḥ | ghṛtamadhutilān juhuyāt || 2 ||
[685]        kṛttikāyāṃ dināni sapta | agnir devatā | ghṛtodanaṃ naivedyam | yūthikāpuṣpam | sarpir dhūpaḥ | punantu māṃ devajanā iti pūjāmantraḥ | ghṛtaṃ pradhānadravyam || 3 ||
rohiṇyāṃ devāny aṣṭau | prajāpatir devatā | kṣīrodanaṃ naivedyam | kamalapuṣpaṃ | saralo dhūpaḥ | namo brahmaṇe namo 'gastaya iti mantreṇa pūjā | sarvadhānyāni juhuyāt || 4 ||
mṛgaśirasi pañcadināni | saumo devatā | pāyasanaivedyam | kuṅkumapuṣpam | daśāṅgo dhūpaḥ | navo navo bhavati iti pūjāmantraḥ | gavyaṃ payaḥ pradhānadravyam || 5 ||
ārdrāyāṃ mṛtyuḥ | rudro devatā | sauhālikā naivedyam | vīrikāpuṣpam | jīvakaḥ dhūpaḥ | namaḥ śaṃbhavāyeti pūjāmantraḥ | madhvājyaṃ pradhānadravyam || 6 ||
punarvasau dināni sapta | aditir devatā | guḍodanaṃ naivedyam | mallikāpuṣpam | malayajadhūpam | aditir dyaur aditir iti pūjāmantraḥ | ghṛtataṇḍulaṃ pradhānadravyam || 7 ||
puṣye dināni sapta | guru devatā | khaṇḍamaṇḍakā naivedyam | saroruhapuṣpam | ṣaṭhikādhūpaḥ | bṛhaspate atīyeti mantreṇa pūjā | ghṛtapāyasaṃ pradhānadravyam iti || 8 ||
aśleṣāyāṃ dināni daśa | nāgā devatāḥ | ghṛtanaivedyam | agastipuṣpam | ghṛtaguḍadhūpaḥ | namo 'stu sarpebhya iti pūjāmantraḥ | dadhighṛtaśāliyavaṃ pradhānadravyam || 9 ||
maghāyāṃ mṛtyuḥ saṃdeho vā | dināny ekaviṃśatiḥ | pitaro devatāḥ | ghṛtapurāṇe naivedyam | campakapuṣpam | gugguludhūpaḥ pitus [686] tustoṣam iti pūjāmantraḥ | tilataṇḍulamadhugṛtapātrāṇi pradhānadravyam || 10 ||
pūrvaphālgunyāṃ dināni pañcadaśa | bhago devatā | kṛśarā naivedyam | śvetakaravīrapuṣpam | bilvaphaladhūpaḥ | yan me garbhe vasata iti pūjāmantraḥ | saptavrīhayaḥ pradhānadravyaḥ || 11 ||
uttaraphalgunyāṃ dināny ekaviṃśatiḥ | aryamā devatā | raktaśālyodanaṃ naivedyam | raktotpalapuṣpam | ghṛtagugguludhūpaḥ | ahaṃ rudrebhir vasubhir iti pūjāmantraḥ | priyaṅgavaḥ pradhānadravyam || 12 ||
haste mṛtyusaṃdeho | dināni pañcadaśa | savitā devatā | apūpanaivedyam | raktakaravīrapuṣpam | śallakīdhūpaḥ | ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam iti pūjāmantraḥ | dadhi pradhānadravyam || 13 ||
citrāyāṃ dināni daśa | tvaṣṭā devatā | modakā naivedya | jayāpuṣpam | yūthikāparṇakadhūpaḥ | citraṃ devānām iti pūjāmantraḥ | citrodanaṃ pradhānadravyam || 14 ||
svātyāṃ māsā navadhā | vāyur devatā | dadhyodanaṃ naivedyam | damanakapuṣpam | kṛṣṇāgurudhūpaḥ | sanaḥ piteva sūnava iti pūjāmantraḥ | ghṛtayavānnadravyam || 15 ||
viśākhāyāṃ dināni pañcaviṃśatiḥ | indrāgnī devate | dhuṇako (?) naivedyam | tumbarikā puṣpam | devadārudhūpaḥ | indrāgnī āgatam iti pūjāmantraḥ | dadhyodanaṃ pradhānadravyam || 16 ||
anurādhāyāṃ dināni daśa | mitro devatā | kṛśarā naivedyam | pauṇḍarīkapuṣpam | candanasihlarasadhūpaḥ | deva savitaḥ prasuva yajñam iti mantraḥ | sūraṇakandaṃ pradhānadravyam || 17 || [687]
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ dināni pañcadaśa | indro devatā | citrodananaivedyam | karpūrāgurudhūpaḥ | pāṭalikāpuṣpam | indro māyābhir iti pūjāmantraḥ | sūraṇakandamūlaṃ pradānadravyam || 18 ||
mūle mṛtyuḥ | rākṣaso devatā | sastamāṃsasurāpolikānaivedyam | kṛṣṇasombarikā puṣpam | meṣaśṛṅgadhūpaḥ | brāhmaṇāgnisaṃvidhāna iti pūjāmantraḥ | mūlakandaḥ pradhānadravyam || 19 ||
pūrvāṣāḍhāyāṃ dināni saptaviṃśatiḥ | āpo devatā | maṇḍako naivedyam | kahlārapuṣpam | śailajadhūpaḥ | kiṃ cedaṃ varuṇeti pūjāmantraḥ | raktaśālayaḥ pradhānadravyam || 20 ||
uttarāṣāḍhāyāṃ dināni viṃśatiḥ | viśvedevā devatā | bilvapañcakanaivedyam | pañcavarṇapuṣpam | bālakadhūpaḥ | viśve devāsa āgata iti pūjāmantraḥ | śallakīkhaṇḍāni pradhānadravyam || 21 ||
śravaṇe dināni nava | viṣṇur devatā | kṣīraśarkarāghṛtamaṇḍakānaivedyam | jāgīpuṣpam | daśāṅgadhūpaḥ | ato devā avantu na iti pūjāmantraḥ | raktataṇḍulāḥ pradhānadravyam || 22 ||
dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ dināni pañcadaśa | vasavo devatā | vaṭavaṭakānaivedyam | śatapatrikā puṣpam | ghṛtagugguladhūpaḥ | trāyantām iha devā iti pūjāmantraḥ | uḍumbara-udakodbhavāni pradhānadravyam || 23 ||
śatabhiṣāyāṃ dināni daśa | varuṇo devatā | ghṛtavaṭakānaivedyam | udakodbhavāni puṣpam | karpūrāgurudhūpaḥ | imaṃ meṅgeti pūjāmantraḥ | udakodbhavāni puṣpāṇi pradhānadravyāṇi ca || 24 ||
pūrvabhādrapadāyāṃ mṛtyuḥ | ajaikapād devatā | dadhisarpiṣī naivedyam | śatapatrapuṣpam | sarvauṣadhidhūpaḥ | śam agnir agnibhiḥ [688] karad iti pūjāmantraḥ | grāmyaṃ pūtikarañjakūṣmāṇḍāni ca pradhānadravyam || 25 ||
uttarabhādrapadāyāṃ dināni pañcadaśa | ahivradhno devatā | guḍapalalaśītodanaṃ naivedyam | karpūrapatrikā puṣpam | ghṛtanimbapatrabhūpaḥ | viṣṇur yoniṃ kalpayatu iti pūjāmantraḥ | ārdrameṣarudhiradugdhāni pradānadravyam || 26 ||
revatyāṃ dināny aṣṭau | pūṣā devatā | tilalaḍḍukapinyākaṃ naivedyam | mandārapuṣpam | gugguladhūpaḥ | haṃsaḥ śuciṣad iti pūjāmantraḥ | ghṛtadugdhāni phalāni juhuyāt || 27 ||
yathoktabrāhmaṇena yasya nakṣatrasya yad uktaṃ dravyaṃ tad aṣṭottaraśataṃ juhuyād gāyatryā |
yathoktavidhir evaiṣaḥ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ |
nakṣatratarpaṇaṃ yāgas tathārogyaṃ prayacchati ||
pūrvasamidbhis tilaiḥ kṣīrājyenāṣṭaśataṃ juhuyāt | dvādaśanāmāni maṇḍale likhya pūjayet | madhye nakṣatradevatāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vastrayugmena veṣṭitāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | rogaśāntir bhavati |
iti gargokto nakṣatrahomavidhiḥ |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
yasmin hi jananaṃ yasya jananaṃ tasya tat smṛtam |
caturthaṃ mānasaṃ tasmād daśamaṃ karmasaṃjñitam ||
[689]        sāṅghātikaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ syād viṃśaṃ samudayaṃ smṛtam |
vaināśikaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ karmarkṣākhyaṃ trayodaśam ||
ṣaḍnakṣatras tu puruṣaḥ sarvaprokto mahīpate |
rājā ca navanakṣatro nakṣatratritayaṃ śṛṇu ||
nityam abhyadhikaṃ ṣaḍbhyaḥ pārthivasya nṛpottama |
deśo 'bhiṣekanakṣatraṃ jātinakṣatram eva ca |
jātyāśritāni vakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇi tavānagha ||
pūrvātrayam athāgneyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prakīrtitam |
pauṣṇaṃ maitraṃ tathā pitryaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tathā smṛtam ||
ādityam āśvinaṃ hastaṃ śūdrāṇām abhijit tathā |

pratilomodbhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitam |
iha dehārthahāniḥ syāt janmarkṣe tūpatāpite ||
karmarkṣe karmaṇāṃ hāniḥ pīḍā manasi mānase |
mūrtidraviṇabandhūnāṃ hāniḥ sāṅghātike hate ||

pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe rājyabhraṃśaṃ vinirdiśet ||
deśarkṣe pīḍite pīḍā deśasya ca purasya ca |
pīḍite jātinakṣatre rājño vyādhiṃ vinirdiśet ||
graharkṣajātāṃ samavāpya pīḍāṃ
pūjā tu kāryā vidhinā svakena |
tataḥ śūbhaṃ vindati rājasiṃha
[690]                vidhūtapāpaḥ puruṣaḥ sadaiva ||
śakṛnmūtre tu saṃgṛhya śvetasya vṛṣābhasya tu |
śvetagoḥ payasā sārdhaṃ snātavyaṃ kuśavāriṇā ||
janmanakṣatrapīḍāyāṃ tasmāt kleśād vimucyate |
śirīṣacandanāśvatthanāgadānāmbubhir naraḥ ||

siddhārthaṃ ca priyaṅguṃ ca śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm ||
snātavyam ambhasi kṣiptvā karmarkṣe nṛpa pīḍite |
priyaṅgubilvasiddhārthayavāśvatthasurāhvayā ||
surāhvā devadāruḥ |
candanodakasaṃyuktaṃ snānaṃ sāṅghātike hite |
sarvagandhodakaiḥ snānaṃ tathā siddhārthakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||

vṛṣaśṛṅgāhṛtamṛdā tathā bilvodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
śatapuṣpāsamopetaiḥ snānaṃ vaināśike bhavet |
pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe sarvaratnodakais tathā |
pīḍite deśanakṣatre mṛdbhiḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate ||
mṛttikāṃ ca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama |
nadyāḥ kūladvayān madhyāt saṅgamāt sarasas taṭāt ||
aśvasthānād gajasthānād gosthānād girimastakāt |
śakrasthānāt savalmīkād rājasthānāt surālayāt ||
gajaśṛṅgoddhṛtāṃ caiva vṛṣaśṛṅgoddhṛtāṃ tathā |
sarvabījodakaiḥ snāto jātinakṣatrapīḍane |
[691]        mucyate kilbiṣād rājan nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||

manur uvāca |
yadīcchasi subhartāram iha janmany athāpare |

sarvāpahāraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |

proṣṭhāśvine tathā māse mṛge bhāgye 'tha vā mune |

pūrve 'hani sapatnīkaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śubhasaṅgatam |

[692]        āmantrya mama coddeśaṃ prātaḥ kāryas tv anugrahaḥ |
mudānvitas tadā kuryāt kalidvandvavivarjitaḥ ||

sitasūkṣme tathā rakte śubhe deye ca pāsasī ||
nirmale sadaśe vatsa devadevīprasādhake |
snātvā umeśvaraṃ pūjya sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca ||
umāmaheśvarapratimālakṣaṇapramāṇaṃ tu aviyogadvādaśīvrate veditavyam |

śaṅkromaṃ samādhyāya śakrāsyaṃ śubhacarcitam |

sukhalepena saṃbhojya dhyāyet tu tam umeśvaram ||
ācamya cārghyapādyaṃ ca dadyād gandhodakaṃ tathā |
sahiraṇyaṃ saratnaṃ tu punar datvā kṣamāpayet ||

umāmantreṇa caivomām īśamantreṇa śaṅkaram ||
pūjitaḥ sarvakāmān vai prayacchaty avicārataḥ |
anena prāpnuyān nārī aviyogaṃ sureśvara ||
[693]        iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ dhanaputrasukhāni ca |

indra uvāca |

rambhā kadalī |

svātyāṃ tu radanā devyāḥ suraktaiḥ kamalair yajet ||
haṃsaṃ śatabhiṣarkṣe ca nāgakeśaracandanaiḥ |
kharjūraśarkarābhojyaṃ yajen nāsāṃ maghāsu ca ||
jayāpuṣpais tathā bhojyaṃ godhūmaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtam |
mṛge netradvayaṃ devyāḥ sugandhaiḥ kusumair yajet |
ghṛtamāṣānnabhojyaṃ tu vicitraṃ parikalpayet ||
citrāṃ citrasrajā pūjyaṃ lalāṭaṃ citrabhojanam |
bharaṇīṣu śiro devyāḥ pañcakādisrajā yajet ||
kṣīrānnaṃ bhojanaṃ deyaṃ keśān ārdrāsu pūjayet |
jātyādikusumair devyāḥ sarvānnāni ca bhojayet ||
[698]        nakṣatreṣv iti pūjyāryā rūpaputrārthibhiḥ sadā |
śambhur vāpy athavā viṣṇur ghṛtahemānnadakṣiṇā ||

devīśāstrārthakuśale śivajñānaviśārade ||
saṃpūrṇacandravadanā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā |
śobhanā daśanā śubhrāḥ karṇau cāpi sumāṃsalau ||
ṣaṭpadaughanibhaiḥ keśair yutā kokilavādinī |
tāmrauṣṭhī padmapatrābhā suhastā stananāmitā ||
nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvarttā rambhādaṇḍanibhorukā |
suśroṇī tanumadhyā ca suśliṣṭāṅguliśobhanā ||
pramadā subhagā bhartur manuṣyo 'pi mahābhujaḥ |
pīnavakṣāḥ pṛthuskandhaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ ||
sitadanto gajagāmī mahābalaparākramaḥ |
priyaḥ sarvasya lokasya padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ||
sarvaśāstrārthavettā ca strīṇāṃ cetopahārakaḥ ||
kāmatulyo mahāvīryo (?) vratenānena jāyate |
aviyogaś ca iṣṭānām arthānāṃ ca samāgamaḥ |
nakṣatrārthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vratam ||
āpatsv api na bhedas tu striyā kāryaṃ na duṣyate |
api doṣātmakair bhāvair na tyājyaṃ munisattama ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ nakṣatrārthavratam |
[699]                nārada uvāca |
śrīmadārogyarūpāyuḥsaubhāgyasarvasampadā |

nārī vā vidhavā sarvaguṇasaubhāgyasaṃyutā |
kramān muktipadaṃ deva kiṃcid vratam ihocyatām ||
rudra uvāca |
samyak pṛṣṭas tvayā brahman sarvalokahitāvaham |
śrutam apy atra yac chāntyai tad vrataṃ śṛṇu nārada ||
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ nāma paraṃ nārāyaṇārcanam |
pādau hi kuryād vidhivad viṣṇunāmāni kīrtayet ||
pratimāṃ vāsudevasya mūlarkṣādy abhipūjayet |
caitramāsaṃ samāsādya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam ||
mūle namo viśvadharāya pādāv
anantadevāya ca rohiṇīṣu |
jaṅghe 'bhipūjye varadāya caiva
dve jānunī vāśvikumārakarkṣe ||
pūrvottarāṣāḍhayuge ca pādau
namaḥ śivāyety abhipūjanīyau |
pūrvottarāphālguniyugmake ca
meḍhraṃ namaḥ pañcaśarāya pūjām ||
kaṭiṃ namaḥ śārṅgadharāya viṣṇoḥ
saṃpūjayen nārada kṛttikāsu |
[700]        tathārcayed bhādrapadādvaye ca
pārśve namaḥ keśinisudanāya |
kukṣidvayaṃ nārada revatīṣu
dāmodarāyety abhipūjanīyam ||
akṣe 'nurādhāsu ca mādhavāya
namas tathorasthalam eva pūjyam |
pṛṣṭhaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu ca pūjanīyam
maghāsu vidhvaṃ sakarāya tadvat ||
śrīśaṅkhacakrāsigadādharāya
namo viśākhāsu bhujāś ca pūjyāḥ |
haste tu hastā madhusūdanāya
namo 'bhipūjyā it kaiṭabhāreḥ ||
punarvasāv aṅguliparvabhāgāḥ
sāmnām adhīśāya namo 'bhipūjyāḥ |
bhujaṅganakṣatradine nakhāni
saṃpūjayen matsyaśarīriṇaś ca ||
kūrmasya pādo śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
jyeṣṭhāsu kandhe harir arcanīyaḥ |
śrotre varāhāya namo 'bhipūjye
janārdanasya śravaṇe ca samyak ||
puṣye mukhaṃ dānavasūdanāya
namo nṛsiṃhāya ca pūjanīyam |
damo namaḥ kāraṇavāmanāya
svātīṣu dantāgram athārcanīyam ||
[701]        āsyaṃ hareḥ kautukabhārgavāya
saṃpūjanīyaṃ dvija vāruṇe tu |
namo 'stu rāmāya madhāsu nāsā
saṃpūjanīyā raghunandanasya ||
mṛgottamāṅge nayane ca pūjye
namo 'stu te rāma vighūrṇitākṣa |
mṛgottamāṅgaṃ mṛgaśīrṣam |
budhāya śāntāya namo lalāṭaṃ
citrāsu saṃpūjyatamaṃ murāreḥ ||
śiro'bhipūjyaṃ bharaṇīṣu viṣṇor
namo 'stu viśveśvara kalkirūpa |
ārdrāsu keśāḥ puruṣottamasya
saṃpūjanīyā haraye namas te ||
upoṣite rukṣadineṣu śaktyā
saṃpūjanīyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ syuḥ |
pūrṇe vrate sarvaguṇānvitāya
vāgrūpaśīlāya ca śāmagāya ||
haimīṃ viśālāyatabāhudaṇḍāṃ
muktāphalendropalavajrayuktām |
gūḍhasya pūrṇe kalaśe niviṣṭām
[702]                arcāṃ harer vastrayutāṃ sahaimīm ||
śayyāṃ tathopaskarabhājanādi-
yuktāṃ pradadyād dvijapuṅgavāya ||
yad yat priyaṃ kiṃcid ihāsti deyaṃ
tat tad dvijāyātmahitāya sarvam |
manorathānnaḥ saphalī kuruṣva
hiraṇyagarbhācyutarudrarūpa ||
sa lakṣmīkaṃ sabhāryāya kāñcanaṃ puruṣottamam |
śayyāṃ dadyāc ca mantreṇa granthabhedavivarjitām ||
yathā na viṣṇubhaktānāṃ vṛjinaṃ jāyate kvacit |
tathā surūpatāramye keśave bhaktir uttamā ||
yathā lakṣmyā na śayanaṃ tava śūnyaṃ (?) janārdana |
śayyā mamāpy aśūnyās tu kṛṣṇa janmani janmani ||
evaṃ nivedya tat sarvaṃ vastramālyānulepanaiḥ |
nakṣatrapuruṣajñāya viprāyātha visarjayet ||
bhuñjītātailalavaṇaṃ sarvarkṣeṣv apy upoṣitaḥ |
bhojayec ca yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||
iti nakṣatrapuruṣam (?) upoṣya vidhivat svayam |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
brahmahatyādikaṃ kiṃcid yad atrāmutra vā kṛtam |
ātmanā cātha pitṛbhis tat sarvaṃ nāśam āpnuyāt ||
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vātibhaktyā
puruṣavaro vratam aṅganātha kuryāt (?) |
[703]        kalikaluṣavidāraṇaṃ murāreḥ
sakalavibhūtiphaladaṃ ca puṃsaḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ nakṣatrapuruṣavratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
upavāseṣv aśaktasya tad eva phalam icchataḥ |
anabhyāsena rogād vā kim iṣṭaṃ vratam ucyatām ||
śivasyopari (?) yasya syād bhaktiḥ sūryasya vā vibho |
nakṣatrākhyaṃ vrataṃ tena kathaṃ kāryam ihocyatām ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
upavāseṣv aśaktānāṃ naktaṃ bhojanam iśyate |
yasmin vrate tad apy atra śrūyatām akṣayaṃ mahat ||
śivanakṣatrapuruṣaṃ śivabhaktimatāṃ nṛṇām |
tasmin nakṣatrayoge ca purāṇajñāḥ pracakṣate ||
phālgunasyāmale pakṣe yadā hastaḥ prajāyate |
tadā grāhyaṃ vrataṃ caitan naktenābhyarcya śūlinam ||
śivāyeti ca hastena pādau saṃpūjayed vibhoḥ |
śaṅkarāya namo gulphau pūjyau citrāsu pāṇḍava ||
bhīmāya jaṅghe svātīṣu devadevasya pūjayet |
ūrūdvayaṃ viśākhāsu trinetrāya tu pūjayet |
meḍhraṃ caivānurādhāsu anaṅgāya hareti ca ||
sadā jyeṣṭhāsu ca tathā surajyeṭheti cārcayet |
[704]        nādākhyāya namo nābhiḥ pūjyā mūlena śūlinaḥ ||
āṣāḍhayugale pārśve pārvatīpatayeti ca ||
śravaṇena tataḥ kukṣī pūjyau kāpāline namaḥ |
vakṣasthalaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu sadyojātāya vai namaḥ ||
vāmeti pūjayet pārtha hṛdayaṃ śatabhiṣāsu ca |
pūrvottarāyuge bāhū namaḥ khaṭṭāṅgadhāriṇe ||
pūjyaṃ rudrāya ca tathā revatīṣu karadvayam |
nakhāḥ pūjyāśvinīyoge namaskṛtya pinākine ||
bharaṇīṣu tataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣāṅkāya namo 'stv iti |
kṛttivastrāya vadanaṃ kṛttikāsu kṛkāṭikāṃ ||
vāk pūjyā rohiṇīyoge namo vācaspater api |
mṛgottamāṅge daśanān bhairavāyeti pūjayet ||
ārdrāsvoṣṭhādharau pūjyau sthānaveti yudhiṣṭhira |
nāsā punarvasau pūjyā pūṣṇo dantavighātine ||
puṣye netradvayaṃ pūjyaṃ namas te sarvadarśane |
aśleṣāyāṃ lalāṭaṃ tu tryambakāya namo namaḥ ||
maghāsu ca jaṭājūṭaṃ pūjayed andhakāraye |
pūrvaphālgunīyoge ca śravṇau somadhāriṇe ||
namo 'stu pāśāṅkuśaśūlapadma-
kapālasarpandudhanurdharāya ˘
gajāsurānaṅgapurāndhakādi-
[705]                vināśamūlāya namaḥ śivāya ||
śiraḥ saṃpūjayed dadyāt tato dhūpavilepane |
tatas tu rātrau bhoktavyaṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam ||
śāleyataṇḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam |
dadyāt sarveṣu nakteṣu brāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpottama ||
śaktyabhāve na doṣaḥ syād adhike hy adhikaṃ phalam |
nakṣatrayugale prāpte naktayugmaṃ samācaret ||
sūtakāśaucadoṣeṇa punar anyaḥ samācaret |
evaṃ krameṇa saṃprāpte vratasyaivāsya pāraṇe ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā guḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ |
kāñcanaṃ kāreyed devam umayā saha śaṅkaram ||
śayyāṃ sulakṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā virudhagranthivarjitām |
sopadhānakaviśrāmāṃ svāstarābharaṇāṃ śubhām ||
bhājanopāhachatracāmarāsanadarpaṇaiḥ |
bhūṣaṇair api saṃyuktāṃ phalavastrānulepanaiḥ ||
savastrāṃ kāṃsyadohanīṃ hemaśṛṅgivibhūṣitām |
dadyāt pūrvāhnasamaye na kiṃcid api laṅghayet ||
mantreṇānena rājendra hṛdi śambhuṃ nidhāya vai |
yathā na deva śayane tava parvatajānagha |
śūnyaṃ varteta satataṃ tathā me santu siddhayaḥ ||
yathā na deva śreyāṃs tu tvadṛte vidyate kvacit |
tathā mām uddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt ||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya visarjayet |
[706]        śayanādikaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ dvijasya bhavanaṃ nayet ||
naitad viśīlāya na nāstikāya
kutarkadṛṣṭāya vinindakāya |
prakāśanīyaṃ vratam indumauleḥ
paścāt tilebhyo 'pahatāntarātmā ||

pradeyam etac chivabhaktiyukte |
idaṃ mahāpātakināṃ narāṇām
aghakṣayaṃ vedavido vadanti ||
yā kācid etat kurute 'tha bhaktyā
bhartāram āśritya śubhaṃ guruṃ vā |

āpnoti duḥkhaṃ na suhṛtsamuttham ||
idaṃ vasiṣṭhena purārjunena
kṛtaṃ kubereṇa purandareṇ |
yatkīrtanād apy akhilāny aghāni
vidhvaṃsam āyānti na saṃśayo 'tre ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ śaivanakṣatrapuruṣavratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe nakṣatravratāni |
[707]
atha caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
tyaktvā vairaṃ ciraparicitaṃ mitrabhāvaṃ prapanne
bāṇau lakṣmīḥ kila vilasato yasya gehe 'nurāgāt |
yenāpūrvaṃ prakaṭitam idaṃ vaibhavaṃ puṇyabhājām
ko 'yaṃ yogavratasamudayaṃ vakti hemādrir asmin ||
atha yogavratāni
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
viṣkumbhādiṣu yogeṣu bhaved ekādaśī naraḥ |
yo dadāti kramāt pārtha ghṛtatailapalaikṣavam ||
yavagodhūmavaraṇaṃ niṣpāvāñ chālitaṇḍulān |
lavaṇaṃ dadhidugdhaṃ ca vastraṃ kanakam eva ca ||
kambalaṃ govṛṣaṃ chatram upānadyugalaṃ tathā |
karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva candanaṃ kusumāni ca ||
lauhaṃ tāmraṃ ca kāṃsyaṃ ca raupyaṃ ceti yudhiṣṭhira |
snātaḥ svaśaktyā vidhivat sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
na viyogam avāpnoti yogavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ yogavratam |
[708]                dharaṇy uvāca |
yas tvayokto vyatīpātaḥ kīdṛśaḥ sa svarūpataḥ |
kasya putraḥ kathaṃ pūjyaḥ pūjite tatra kiṃ (?) phalam ||
varāha uvāca |
yadā bṛhaspater bhāryāṃ tārāṃ jagrāha śītaguḥ |
mitratvāt prāha taṃ sūryas tyaja bhāryāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ||
cakre candro na tadvākyaṃ hitaṃ śiṣyo 'pi taṃ yadā |
ruṣṭas tadā kilādityo dīptadṛṣṭyā tad aikṣata ||

ubhayor dṛṣṭisaṃpāte kruddhayoḥ somasūryayoḥ |
udyatāsyo bhaved ghoraḥ puruṣaḥ piṅgalekṣaṇaḥ ||

sūryasomāv ūcatuḥ |

vyatīpātāya bhadraṃ te tvayi yaḥ pāpakārakaḥ ||

vyatīpātas tato nāma bhavān bhuvi bhaviṣyati ||
[709]                vyatīpāta uvāca |

[710]        kāñcanābje pratiṣṭhāpya haimam aṣṭabhujaṃ naram ||
aṣṭabhujam aṣṭādaśabhujam | utpattivākye vyatīpātamūrter aṣṭādaśabhujatvāt | utpattivākyānusāratvāc ca viniyogavākyasya yathā bhagavadgītāsu catvāro manavas tatheti catvāraś caturdaśa |
gandhapuṣpākṣatair dhūpadīpavastranivedanaiḥ |

namas te 'stu vyatīpāta sūryasomasuta prabho |
yad dānādikṛtaṃ kiṃcit tad anantam ihāstu me ||
ity uktvā pañcaratnāḍhyaṃ sapuṣpākṣatam añjalim |
prakṣipya tatkṣaṇād eva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet ||
yadi dvitīye 'pi dine vyatīpātā bhaven mahī |

ājyakṣīratilānāṃ ca hotavyaṃ vai śataṃ śatam ||
śarkarāghaṭapūrṇena sahasopaskarair yutām |
pratimāṃ kāñcanīṃ kṛtvā pradadyād vratadeśine ||
vande vyatīpātam ahaṃ mahāntaṃ
ravīndusūnaṃ sakaleṣṭasabdhai |
[711]        samastapāpasya mama kṣayo 'stu
puṇyasya cānantaphalaṃ mamāstu ||
iti samīkṣya guruḥ paripūjyate
kaṭakakuṇḍalakāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ |

upalabhyam ihāśnute mahīm ||

janasaubhāgyasaṃpanno yāvajjanmāṣṭakāyutam ||
darśe śataguṇaṃ dānaṃ tacchataghnaṃ dinakṣaye |
śataghnaṃ tac ca saṃkrāntau śataghnaṃ viṣuve tataḥ ||
yugādau tacchataguṇam ayane tacchatāhtam |
[712]        somagrahe tacchataghnaṃ tacchatghnaṃ ravigrahe ||
asaṃkhyeyaṃ vyatīpāte dānaṃ vedavido viduḥ |
utpattau tallakṣaguṇaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhramaṇanāḍikāyām |
arbudaguṇitaṃ patane japadānādyakṣayaṃ patite ||
janmadvāviṃśatināḍī bhramaṇan tv ekaviṃśatiḥ |
vyatīpātasya patanaṃ daśasaptasthitaṃ viduḥ ||
samarpitaṃ yad vyatipātakāle
punaḥ punas tad raviśītaraśmau |
prayacchataḥ kalpaśatārbudāni
vivardhamānaṃ na hi hīyate tat ||
tasmān mahitvaṃ vyatipātapūjāṃ
kuruṣva cet puṇyam anantam iṣṭam |
yadi sthiratvaṃ satataṃ taveṣṭaṃ
samastadhāritam abhīpsitaṃ ca ||
gaṇayitvā vyatīpātakālaṃ vā vetti yo naraḥ |
sarvapāpaharau tasya bhavato bhānubheśvarau ||
paṭhati likhati yaś śṛṇoti vai
tat kathayati paśyati kārayaty avaśyam |
raviśaśidivam āp so 'pi
divaiścarasamayaṃ paripūjyamāna āste ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktaṃ vyatīpātavratam |
[713]                yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yena vratena cīrṇena na paśyed yamaśāsanam |
paripṛcchāmy ahaṃ brahman pāpaghnaṃ vratam uttamam ||
tad vrataṃ brūhi viprarṣe kṛtvā jagati vai kṛpām |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śṛṇu. rājan vratam idaṃ haryaśvena purātanam |
tenaiva rājñā tad dattaṃ śūkarāya ca duḥkhine ||
ekadā tu mṛṣitvā sa haryaśvo rājasattamaḥ |
antaś caran bhave rājan dṛṣṭvā tatraiva śūkaram ||
dagdhapādakaṭiṃ caiva dagdhagrīvamukhodaram ||
dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ taṃ tu kṛpāṃ cakre dayāparaḥ |
kena karmavipākena asvasthāṃ prāptavān ayam ||
aho kaṣṭam aho kaṣṭaṃ sūkareṇopabhujyate |
avaśyam anusartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ||
ity uktvā tat svarūpeṇa rājā taṃ prāha śūkaram |
iyatī kim avasthā vai tan mama brūhi śūkara ||
tac chrutvā nṛpater vākyaṃ niḥśvasan śūkaro muhuḥ |
smṛtvā purākṛtaṃ karma pratyuvācātha taṃ nṛpam ||
śūkara uvāca |
śṛṇu rājann ahaṃ pūrvaṃ vaiśo viśvasakhābhavaḥ |
āśākārī na dātāham āśritebhyaś ca kiṃcana ||
śrutāś ca bahavo dharmāḥ purāṇaśrutinoditāḥ |
[714]         tathāpi pāpabuddhyāhaṃ na karomy ātmano hitam ||
āśāpāśam anuprāptā bhagnāśās te vinirgatāḥ |
kṛtavān pāpam evāhaṃ na kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
ekadā tu dvijaḥ kaścid vyatīpāte gṛhaṃ mama |
āgato yācate māṃ ca na kiṃcid dattavān aham ||
tataś ca kupito vipro mama śāpam athādadat |
āśāgnir dahate yadvan mamāṅgāni pṛthak pṛthak ||
tathaiva tu tavāṅgāni dāvāgniḥ puruṣādhama |
araṇye nirjane deśe nirjale drumavarjita ||
tatra śūkarayonau tvaṃ prasūtiṃ samavāpnuhi |
prasādito mayā vipraḥ punar apy uktavāṃs tadā |
jñānitvaṃ śūkaratve 'pi ity uktvātha jagāma saḥ ||
tena śāpena rājendra śūkaratvam avāpnuyāt |
ahaṃ duḥkhī ha saṃjāto nirjane nirjale vane ||
rājovāca |
kena tvaṃ mucyate pāpāt mamācakṣveha śūkara |
yena śakyo mayā kartuṃ tava śāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ ||
varāha uvāca |
śrūyatāṃ mama rājendra muktiḥ syād yena karmaṇā |
vyatīpātavrataṃ nāma kṛtaṃ rājaṃs tvayā purā ||
yathā mātā sutasyeha sarvasya hitakāriṇī |
tathā vratam idaṃ rājann iha loke paratra ca |
[715]        yathaivābhyuditaḥ sūryo hy aśeṣaṃ ca tamo dahet ||
idaṃ vrataṃ tathaiveha sarvapāpaṃ vyaphohati |
sakṛt smṛto yathā viṣṇur nṛṇāṃ paramanirvṛtim |
dadāty eva na saṃdehas tathā vratam idaṃ śubham ||
śatam indukṣaye dānaṃ sahasraṃ tu dinakṣaye |
viṣuve śatasāhasraṃ vyatīpāte tv anantakam ||
vyatīpātavratasyāsya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ |
māghe vā phālgune vāpi anyasmin māsi vā bhavet ||
vyatīpāto dine yasmin prārabhed vratam uttamam |
tilaiḥ pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ ca saguḍaṃ gurave 'rpayet ||
evaṃ dvitīye dātavyaṃ tṛtīye tu samāpayet |
saghṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva dātavyaṃ vottarottaram ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte devasyārcanaṃ tu kārayet |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ padmahastaṃ hiraṇmayam ||
vastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya kāṃsyabhājanam uttamam |
sthāpayed devadevasya sthānaṃ tatraiva kalpayet |
śayyā ca saṃnidhau tasya sthāpyā devam anusmaran ||
anantaśāyinaṃ devam anantaphaladaṃ śubham |
lakṣmyā sahānvitaṃ viṣṇuṃ bhaktyā saṃpūjayed gurum ||
vaidekenaiva mantreṇa jātīpuṣpaiḥ samarcayet |
pāyasenaiva naivedyaṃ śarkarāsaṃyutena ca ||
datvā nivedyaṃ devasya prārthanaṃ prārthayed vratī |
[716]        vyatīpātavrataṃ deva tvayānanta samarpitam ||
bhavatv anantaphaladaṃ mama janmani janmani |
devadevaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ prārthayitvā tato vratī ||
tat sarvaṃ gurave dadyāc chrotriyāya kuṭumbine |
vratopadeṣṭre viprāya brahmajñāya viśeṣataḥ ||
bhūmir vātha suvarṇaṃ vā dakṣiṇā tu vidhīyate |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu vratam etat samāpayet ||
idaṃ vrataṃ tvayā deva gṛhītaṃ pūrvajanmani |
svargāpavargadaṃ nṝṇām anantaphaladaṃ śubham ||
muñcehaṃ kilbiṣād asmāt śūkaratvān na saṃśayaḥ |
tenaiva mukto haryaśvaḥ śūkara vākyam abravīt ||
mayā kṛtam idaṃ sarvaṃ tat phalaṃ te dadāmy aham |
evam uktvā nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ śūkarasya phalaṃ dadau ||
tatkṣaṇāt tena puṇyena śūkaro muktakilbiṣaḥ |
muktaḥ śūkaradehāc ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
divyaṃ vimānam ākhyāya vākyaṃ cedam uvāca ha |
he janāḥ kiṃ na jānīdhvaṃ vyatīpātavratottamam ||
ihaiva sukhadaṃ nṝṇāṃ paratra ca parāṃ gatim |
dṛṣṭvā māṃ pāpanirmuktaṃ vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ |
viśvāsaḥ kriyatām asmin vyatīpātavratottame ||
ity uktvā svargataḥ so 'tha rājño vai paśyatas tadā |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito bhūtvā rājāpi śraddadhe vratam ||
tato rājā puraṃ gatvā vrataṃ vākārayaj janān |
[717]        sarvaṃ ca kṛtavāṃs tatra vyatīpātavrataṃ śubham ||
tato rājyaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
haryaśvaḥ prāptavāṃs tena viṣṇos tat paramaṃ padam |
atas tvaṃ kuru rājendra vyatīpātavratottamam ||
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ nṝṇām iha sukhapradam ||
idaṃ yaḥ kurute martyaḥ śraddhābhāvasamanvitaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyam āpnuyāt ||
yayā to purakāminyā kṛtaṃ sā labhate sutān |
strīkāmeneha tad vatsa labhen nārīm anuttamām ||
vyatīpātavratam idaṃ vyatīpātadine yajet |
jñānavān dhanavān śrīmān ihaiva sa sukhī bhavet ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
iti nāradīyapurṇoktaṃ vyatīpātavratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe yogavratāni |
[718]
atha pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha karaṇavratāni
yenedaṃ nijagauraveṇa dūrād
utkarṣañ jagad api nīyate sa eṣaḥ |
ācaṣṭe nikhilamanīṣitārthasiddhyai
hemādriḥ karaṇagaṇavratāni |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi karaṇavratam uttamam |
bavākhyaṃ bālavañ caiva kaulavantaitilaṅgaram |
vaṇijaṃ viṣṭir ity ahuḥ karaṇāni purāvidaḥ ||
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte śuklapakṣe yadā bhavet |
bavābhidhānakaraṇam upavāsas tadā bhavet ||
pūjayec cācyutaṃ devaṃ gandhamālyavilepanaiḥ |
sauvarṇī pratimā kāryā viṣṇoḥ karṣamitā śubhā ||
japed ahar niśaṃ tatra mantram aṣṭākṣaraṃ budhaḥ |
kalaśaṃ ca samānīya tāmrapātraṃ tathopari ||
vinyasya pūjayed devaṃ suvarṇakamalena ca |
vitānaṃ cāmaraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ devāya pratipādayet ||
[719]        evaṃ sapta vidheyāni bavākhyāny atha saptame |
bave tu karaṇe prāpte pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ samācaret ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cātra saptasaṃkhyān sadakṣiṇam |
athaivaṃ bālavādīni viṣṭyantāni yathākramam ||
uṣitvā sapta saptaiva pūrvoktavidhinā nṛpa |
samāpayed vrataṃ bhūrigobhūhemādidānataḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte vrate rājan rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ |
samastaṃ phalam āpnoti sukhaṃ kīrtiṃ mahac chriyam ||
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇoktaṃ karaṇavratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
kṛṣṇa keyaṃ janaiḥ sarvair viṣṭibhadreti cocyate |
kasyātmajeyaṃ kā jyeṣṭhā kathaṃ vā pūjyate naraiḥ ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
sutā mārtaṇḍadevasya chāyayā janitā purā |
śanaiścarasya bhaginī sodaryātibhaṅkarā ||
sā jātamātrā bhuvanaṃ grastaṃ samupacakrame |
niryāti yadi kāryeṇa kaś cittasya puraḥsthitā ||
vighnaṃ karoti svapato bhuñjānasya sthitasya ca |
yajñavighnakarī raudrī samājotsavanāśinī ||
nityodvegakarī pārtha vināśayati sā jagat |
tāṃ tu durvinayāṃ kasmai yacchāmy enāṃ sumadhyamām ||
[720]        kanyādurvinayād gehe pitā doṣeṇa gṛhyate |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kanyā deyā vijānatā ||
cintyaivam aśubhāṃ bhadrāṃ yasya yasya prayacchati |
taṃ tam eva kṣaṇenaiva surarākṣasakinnarāḥ ||
maṇḍapaṃ maṇḍapārambhe vināśayanti tatkṣaṇāt |
vivasvān cintayāmāsa kasyeyaṃ pratipādyate ||
virūpā duṣṭahṛdayā gardabhāsyā tripādikā ||
ūrdhvaromamahādaṃṣṭrī svecchācāravihāriṇī |
dattā yeṣām asaukhyāya bhavatīha kathaṃcana ||
evaṃ vitarkayan deva āste yāvad divaspatiḥ |
tāvat tayā jagat sarvaṃ dūṣṭayā samabhidrutam ||
athājagāma savituḥ pārśve brahmāṇḍasaṃbhavaḥ |
upālabhya dadau cāsya viṣṭer hauṣṭyam aśeṣataḥ |
bhāskaras tam uvācedaṃ svayaṃbhuṃ bhuvaneśvaram ||
bhavān kartā ca hartā ca kasmād evaṃ prabhāṣase |
evam uktas tadā brahmā bhāskareṇāmitadyutiḥ ||
tadovāca viṣṭim ārye śṛṇu bhadre mayoditam |
karaṇaiḥ saha vartasva bavabālavakaulavaiḥ ||
saptame 'rdhadine prāpte yad abhīṣṭaṃ kuruṣva tat |
yātrāpraveśamāṅgalyakṛṣivāṇijyakārakān ||
bhakṣayavābhimukhagān narān unmārgagāminaḥ |
nodvejanīyo hi jano bhavatyā (?) divasatrayam ||
pūjyā surāsurāṇāṃ tvaṃ divasārdhaṃ bhaviṣyati |
[721]        ullaṅghya ye pravartante bhadre tvāṃ nirbhayā narāḥ |
teṣāṃ vināśaya śubhaṃ kāryam ārye suniścitam ||
evam eṣā samutpannā viṣṭir iṣṭivināśanī |
nivediteti kaunteya tasmāt tāṃ parivarjaya ||
siṃhagrīva saptabhujā tripādā pucchasaṃyutā |
kharottamāṅgavadanā pretarūḍhā kṛśodarī ||
jvalaccakṣuś ca dadhatī haste pāśāsiśaktayaḥ |
naramuṇḍāś ca mālāś ca mudrā saptavidhā smṛtā ||
sajalajaladavarṇā dīrghanāsorudaṃṣṭrā
vipulahanukapolā piṇḍakodaṇḍajaṅghā |
analaśatasahasraṃ codgirantī samantāt
patati bhuvanamadhye kāryanāśāya viṣṭiḥ ||
bhānoḥ sutā kiṃ tu śatāgrajātā
kṛṣṇā kumūrtiḥ satataṃ kucelā |
devair niyuktā karaṇāntasasthā
viṣṭis tu sarvatra vivarjanīyā ||
mukhe tu ghaṭikāḥ pañca dve tu kaṇṭhe sadā sthite |
hṛdi caikādaśa proktāś catasro nābhimaṇḍale ||
pañca kaṭyāṃ tu vijñeyās tisraḥ pucche jayāvahāḥ |
mukhe kāryavināśāya grīvāyāṃ dhananāśanī ||
hṛdi prāṇaharā jñeyā nābhyāṃ tu kalahāvahā |
kaṭyām arthaparibhraṃśo viṣṭipucche dhruvaṃ jayaḥ ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāryāṇi aśubhāni śubhāni ca ||
[722]        tāni sarvāṇi sidhyanti viṣṭipucche nṛpottama |
jalānalendukrūreśa yāmyavātendradikkramāt ||
saṃkhyāsamānaiḥ praharair viṣṭir duṣṭā mukhe yataḥ |
karālī mandinī raudrī sumukhī surmukhī tathā ||
triśivā vaiṣṇavī haṃsī hy aṣṭa caitās tu viṣṭayaḥ |
dhanyā dadhimukhī bhadrā mahāmārī kharānanā ||
kālarātrir mahāraudrī viṣṭiś ca kulaputrikā |
bhairavī ca mahākālī asurāṇāṃ kṣayaṃkarī ||
dvādaśaitāni nāmāni prātar utthāya yaḥ paṭhet |
na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tasya rogī rogāt pramucyate ||
grahāḥ sarve 'nukūlāḥ syur na ca vighnādi jāyate |

etad bhradrāvrataṃ pūrvam etat te kathitaṃ mayā |

kāryas tenopavāsaḥ syād iti paurāṇiko vidhiḥ ||
[723]        praharasyopari yadā syād viṣṭiḥ praharatrayam |

sarvauṣadhijalasnānaṃ sugandhāmalakair atha |

devān pitṝn samabhyarcya tato darbhamayīṃ śubhām |

satailaṃ kṛśaraṃ bhuktvā paścād bhuñjīta kāmataḥ ||

pūjitāsi yathāśaktyā bhadre bhadrapradā bhava ||
upoṣya vidhinānena daśa sapta yathākramāt |
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt pūrvavat pūjya bhāminīm ||

paridhāya kṛṣṇavastrayugaṃ mantreṇa taṃ punaḥ ||
brāhmaṇāya punar dadyāl lauhatailāṃs tilāṃs tathā |

ya evaṃ kurute pārtha samyag bhadrāvrataṃ naraḥ |

rākṣasā vā piśācā vā pūtanā śākinī grahāḥ |
na pīḍayanti taṃ martyaṃ yo bhadrāvratam ācaret ||
na caiveṣṭaviyogaḥ syān na hānis tasya jāyate |
[724]        dehānte yāti sadanaṃ bhāskarasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
sūryātmajātibhayadābhaginī śaner yā

iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ viṣṭivratam |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |

nirvighnenārthasaṃsiddhir yathā teṣāṃ kṛtā tvayā |
tathā mamāpi bhaktāya bhadre bhadrapadā bhava ||
ajñānād atha vā darpāt tvām ullaṅghya kṛtaṃ hi yat |
tat kṣamasvāśubhe mātar dīnasya śaraṇārthinaḥ ||
iti kuryād yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
aśaktaḥ parakīyāṃ vā pūjayitvā narādhamaḥ |
abhāve lekhajāṃ kṛtvā vidhiṃ niṣpādayed budhaḥ ||
evaṃ hi kurute yas tu bhaktyā bhadrāvrataṃ naraḥ |
bhadrāyām api kāryāṇi tasya siddhyanty asaṃśayaḥ ||
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā putraiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
avidhnena naravyāghra dīrghāyur vyādhivarjitaḥ |
tato 'nte svargatiṃ prāpya modate surarāḍ iva ||
etat purā mahendreṇa cīrṇaṃ vṛtrajighāṃsayā |
vimānārthaṃ kubereṇa nītaṃ yatridaśāriṇā ||
śambhunā tripurāntāya pāñcajaṇyāya viṣṇunā |
bhadraṃ hi bhadraṃ bhavatīha sadaiva puṃsāṃ
[726]                ye bhaktipūrvakam idaṃ vratam ādareṇa |
bhadrābhidhānam abhidhāya manonugaṃ ye
kurvantu te hy akhilam eva nṛpāpnuvanti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ dvitīyabhadrāvratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe karaṇavratāni |
[727]
atha ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha saṅkrāntivratāni |
paro rajobhiś caritair yadīyair
ānandito vismayam eti lokaḥ |
sa eṣa hemādrisudhīr idānīṃ
prakrānti sakrāntigatavrataugham ||
vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇa kena tiryagyonau na jāyate |
mlecchadeśe ca puruṣas tan mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
meṣasaṃkramane bhānoḥ sopavāso narottama |
pūjayed bhārgavaṃ devaṃ rāmaṃ śaktyā yathāvidhi ||
vṛṣasaṃkramaṇe prāpte tathā kṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayet |
tathā mithunasaṃkrāṇtau pūjayed bhogaśāyinam ||
tathā kulīrasaṃkrāntau varāham aparājitam |
narasiṃhaṃ tathā devaṃ siṃhasaṃkramaṇe vibhum ||
kanyāsaṃkramaṇe devaṃ tathāśvaśirasaṃ yajet |
[728]        tathā makarasaṃkrāntau rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam ||
kumbhasaṃkramaṇe rājan rāmaṃ yādavanandanam |
mīnasaṃkramaṇe matsyaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu pūjayet ||
paṭe vā yadi vārcāyāṃ gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā |
prādurbhāvasya nāmnā ca homaṃ kurvīta pārthiva |
vratānte jaladhenuṃ tu chatropānatsamanvitām ||
vastrayugmayutāṃ dadyāt pratimāsaṃ sakāñcanām |
rātrau tu dīpamālābhir devadevaṃ prapūjayet ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ vatsaram etad iṣṭaṃ
mleccheṣu tiryakṣu na cāpi janma |
prāpnoty avāpnoti ciraṃ ca nākaṃ
kāmaṃ tathāpnoti mano'bhirāmam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sujanmāvāptivratam |
brahmovāca |
kuṅkumaṃ rocanā māṃsī surācandanabālakam |
haridrā saha saṃyuktaṃ meṣe snānaṃ grahāpaham ||
rocanā gorocanā | grahāpahaṃ grahadoṣāpaham |
priyaṅguḥ padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tvacaṃ māṃsī niśākaram |
rocanāgurusaṃyuktaṃ vṛṣasnānaṃ mahāphalam ||
priyaṅgu phalinī | niśākaraṃ karpūram |
uśīraṃ padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rocanā granthiparṇakam |
[729]        kuṅkumāgurusaṃyuktaṃ mithune rājyadaṃ matam ||
uśīraṃ bālakam |
rocanā bālakaṃ mustam urāśaileyadalabaṃ (?) |
siṃhasnānaṃ surādhyakṣa rājyāyuḥputravaddhanam |
haridrā bālakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī candanarocanā |
kanyāsnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ santānarativardhanam ||
rocanāraṅgakuṣṭhaṃ ca candanośīrapadmakam |
haridrābālasaṃyuktaṃ (?) tule duṣkṛtanāśanam ||
priyaṅgusphaṭikaṃ māṃsī padmakaṃ rocanāguruḥ |
mustākuṣṭhasamopetaṃ vṛścike rājyadaṃ matam ||
pravālaṃ mauktikaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rocanāghanapadmakam |
murāmāṃsī samopetaṃ dhanuḥsaṃkramaṇe śubham ||
ghano mustā |
rocanātāvakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ candanāgurukuṅkumam |
uśīraṃ padmakair yuktaṃ makare sarvasaukhyadam ||
granthiparṇaṃ tvacā vālā kesaraṃ jātipatrakāḥ |
rocanāsahasaṃyuktaṃ kumbhe putrāsurājyadam ||
kesaro nāgakesaraḥ |
karpūraphalamūlair vā sāṃsīcandanapadmakam |
bālakaṃ saghanośīraṃ tvacā mīne śubhāvaham ||
dvādaśaite samākhyātāḥ snātāḥ suravarārcitāḥ |
alakṣmīnāśanā dhanyā mahāpātakanāśanāḥ ||
devadārumahākuṣṭhaṃ candraśaileyakundaraḥ ||
[730]        padmakaṃ patrakambolaṃ surasā guggulus tathā |
mahiṣākhyam athānyaṃ tu dravyāṇy ekādaśeti vai ||
candraṃ karpūram | surasā tulasī |
nakṣatre somadaivatye yojanīyā niyantritaḥ ||
somadaivatye mṛgaśirasi |
vijayāvidyayā japtaṃ kṛtam aṅgena yojitam |
vijayaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam ||
alakṣmīśayanaṃ dhanyaṃ grahakṛtyadurāpaham |
bālānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya rājakāryeṇa siddhidam ||
etat tu kathitaṃ śakra samāsena mayā tava |
snānaṃ saṃkrāntidhūpas tu yathāvat paripṛcchataḥ ||
iti devīpurāṇoktāni saṃkrāntivratāni |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhānyavratam anuttamam |
yat kṛtvā hi naro rājan sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt ||
ayane viṣuve caiva snānaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
vratasya niyamaṃ kuryād dhyātvā devaṃ divākaram ||
kariṣyāmi vrataṃ deva tvadbhaktas tvatparāyaṇaḥ |
tadavighnena me jātu tava deva prasādataḥ ||
[731]        ity uccārya likhet padmaṃ kuṅkumenāṣṭapatrakam |
bhāskaraṃ pūrvapatreṣu āgneye ca tathā ravim ||
vivasvantaṃ tathā yāmye nairṛtye pūṣaṇaṃ tathā |
ādityaṃ vāruṇe patre vāyavye tapanaṃ tathā ||
mārtaṇḍam iti kauvere aiśāne bhānum eva ca |
evaṃ ca kramaśo 'bhyarcya viśvātmā madhyadeśataḥ ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sarvaṃ dadyāt samantrakam |
kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā vedātmā viśvatomukhaḥ |
vyādhimṛtyujarāśokasaṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ ||
ity arghamantraḥ |
puṣpadhūpaiḥ samabhyarcya śirasā praṇipatya ca |
raviṃ dhyātvā tato dadyād dhānyaprasthaṃ dvijātaye ||
pratimāsaṃ punas tadvat pūjyo devaḥ sahasrapāt |
evaṃ sadā pradātavyaṃ dhānyaprasthaṃ dvijanmane ||
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kuryād udyāpanakriyām |
arghyapātraṃ hi sauvarṇaṃ kārayen maṇḍalaṃ śubham ||
dvibhujaṃ pūjayed bhānuṃ raktavastrayugānvitam |
dhānyadroṇena sahitaṃ tadardhana (?) svaśaktitaḥ ||
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ (?) kāṃsadohāṃ payasvinīm |
ravirūpaṃ dvijaṃ dhyātvā tasmai vedavide tathā ||
vidyāpātrāya viprāya tat sarvaṃ vinivedayet |
agniṣṭomasahasrāṇāṃ phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ ||
[732]        saptajanmasahasrāṇi dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ |
nirvyādhir nirujo dhīmān rūpavān api jāyate |
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ dhānyasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi lavaṇasaṃkrāntim uttamam |
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya snānaṃ kṛtvā śubhair jalaiḥ ||
vastrālaṅkārasaṃvīte bhaktibhāvasamanvite |
kuṅkumena likhet padmam aṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ||
bhāskaraṃ pūjayed bhaktyā yathoktakramayogataḥ |
tadagre lavaṇaṃ pātraṃ saguḍaṃ sthāpayed budhaḥ ||
puṣpair dhūpaiḥ samabhyarcya naivedyair vividhais tathā |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā upaviśya yathāvidhi ||
dhyāyed dvijanmane rūpaṃ bhāskareṇa samanvitam |
pūjitas tu yathāśaktyā prasīda mama bhāskara ||
lavaṇaṃ saguḍaṃ pātraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe bhānuṃ kṛtvā hiraṇmayam ||
raktavastrayugacchannaṃ raktacandanacarcitam |
kamalaṃ lavaṇaṃ pātraṃ dhenvā sārdhaṃ dvijātaye ||
pradadyād bhānum uddiśya viśvātmā prīyatām iti |
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ prāpyate bhuvi mānavaiḥ ||
na kena gadituṃ śakyaṃ varṣakoṭiśatair api |
[733]        lavaṇācaladānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
sarvakāmasaṃṛddhātmā vimānavaramadhyagaḥ |
sūryaloke vaset kalpaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ lavaṇasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
vakṣye 'haṃ bhogasaṃkrāntiṃ sarvalokavivardhanīm |
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya yoṣitas tu samāhvayet ||
kuṅkumaṃ kajjalaṃ caiva sindūraṃ kusumāni ca |
sugandhīni ca sarvāṇi tāmbūlaṃ śaśisaṃyutam ||
śaśisaṃyutaṃ karpūrasaṃyutam |
taṇḍulān phalasaṃyuktān pradadyāc ca vicakṣaṇaḥ |
anyāny api hi vastūni bhogasādhanakāni ca ||
dadyāt prahṛṣṭamanasā mithunebhyaḥ prayatnataḥ |
bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā vastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet ||
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte raviṃ saṃpūjya pūrvavat |
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ (?) sarvopaskarasaṃyutām |
dhenuṃ sadakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt sapatnīkadvijātaye ||
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā bhogasaṃkrāntim ādarāt |
syāt sukhī sarvamartyeṣu bhogī janmani janmani ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ bhogasaṃkrāntivratam |
[734]                nandikeśvara uvāca |
athānyad api te vacmi rūpasaṃkrāntim uttamām |
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ snānaṃ tailaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
haimapātre ghṛtaṃ kṛtvā hiraṇyena samanvitaḥ |
surūpaṃ vīkṣya tatpātraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
ekabhaktaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhaktyā caiva samanvitam |
vratānte kāñcanaṃ dadyād ghṛtadhenusamanvitam ||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalam āpnoti mānavaḥ |
rūpayauvanasaṃpatyā āyurārogyasaṃpadā ||
lakṣmīś ca vipulān bhogān labhantīha na saṃśayaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ rūpasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
athānyāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tejaḥsaṃkrāntim uttamām |
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya snānaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
śālitaṇḍulasaṃyuktaṃ kāraṇaṃ kārayec chubham |
tanmadhye dīpakaṃ sthāpya prajvalantaṃ svatejasā |
tanmukhe modakaṃ sthāpya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
arghyaṃ ca pūrvavat kāryam ekabhaktaṃ tu pūrvavat |
saṃvatsare tu saṃpūrṇe kuryād udyāpanaṃ budhaḥ ||
śobhanaṃ dīpakaṃ kāryaṃ suvarṇena tu nārada |
[735]        tāmreṇa karakaṃ kāryaṃ tanmadhye dīpakaṃ nyaset ||
kapilā saha dātavyā karakeṇa dvijātaye |
suvarṇakoṭidānasya tat phalaṃ prāpyate 'nagha ||
tejasādityasaṅkāśo vāyor bhalam avāpnuyāt |
saṃkrāntivratamāhātmyāl labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇokaṃ tejaḥsaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
athānyāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi saubhāgyasaṃkrāntim uttamām |
śṛṇu nārada yatnena dhanaiśvaryapradāyinīm ||
ayane viṣuve yukte vyatīpātena bhānunā |
saṃkrāntidivase kuryād ekabhaktaṃ vimatsaraḥ ||
pūrvavad bhānum abhyarcya tathā caiva suvāsine |
saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ vastrayugmaṃ sayoṣite ||
viprāya vedaviduṣe bhaktyā tat pratipādayet |
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
parvataṃ lavaṇaṃ kṛtvā yathā vibhavasārataḥ ||
kāñcanaṃ kamalaṃ kṛtvā bhāskaraṃ caiva kārayet |
gandhapuṣpādinā pūjya viprāya pratipādayet ||
puṣkare ca kurukṣetre gosahasraphalaṃ labhet |
sā priyā martyalokeṣu yā karoti vrataṃ tv idam ||
[736]        śaṅkarasya yathā gaurī viṣṇor lakṣmīr yathā divi |
martyaloke yathā sāpi priyeṇa saha modate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ saubhāgyasaṃkrāntivratam |
skanda uvāca |
athānyām api te vacmi phalasaṃkrāntim uttamām |
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya snānaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvavat ||
saṃpūjya pūrvavad bhānuṃ puṣpadhūpādinā tathā |
śarkarāsahitaṃ pātraṃ phalāṣṭakasamanvitam ||
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet (?) |
tadante tu raviṃ kuryāt suvarṇena ca nārada ||
kumbhasyopari saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet |
phalāṣṭakaṃ tato dadyād bhakṣabhojyasamanvitam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ phalasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
dhanasaṃkrāntimāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu skanda vidhānataḥ |
yat kṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
kalaśaṃ nirvaṇaṃ gṛhya vāripūrṇaṃ nidhāpayet ||
suvarṇayuktaṃ taṃ kṛtvā pratimāsaṃ tu dāpayet |
vidhinānena varṣāṇte prīyatāṃ me divākaraḥ ||
[737]        pūjāvidhānaṃ sarvatra dhānyasaṃkrāntivad bhavet ||
udyāpanaṃ ca vakṣyāmi saṃpūrṇavratam uttamam |
sauvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ kṛtvā sūryaṃ copari vinyaset ||
haste suvarṇaghaṭitaṃ paṅkajaṃ vai nivedayet |
godānaṃ tatra dātavyam evaṃ saṃpūrṇabhāvane ||
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ phalaṃ khyātuṃ na cotsahe |
janmanāṃ śatasāhasraṃ dhanayukto bhaven naraḥ ||
āyurārogyasaṃpannaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ dhanasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
athānyāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi āyuḥsaṃkrāntim uttamām |
śṛṇu vatsa vidhānena yathā puṇyaṃ pravardhate ||
saṃkrāntidivase pūjya pūrvavac ca divākaram |
kāṃsyaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ dadyāt sahiraṇyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ ||
mantra eva pṛthag dāne pūjā saiva prakīrtitā |
sakṣīraṃ surabhījātaṃ pīyūṣasamarūpadhṛk ||
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ maho dehi dvijārpitam |
anena vidhinā samyak sarvaṃ dadyād atandritaḥ ||
udyāpanādikaṃ sarvaṃ dhānyasaṃkrāntivad bhavet |
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyaṃ śakyaṃ nedaṃ mayoditam ||
nirvyādhir api dīrghāyus tejasvī sarvajanmasu |
[738]        apamṛtyor bhayaṃ nāsti jīvec ca śaradaḥ śatam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktam āyuḥsaṃkrāntivratam |
brahmovāca |
ājñāsaṃkrāntimāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu skanda vidhānataḥ |
yāṃ kṛtvā sarvalokeṣu ājñāvān jāyate naraḥ ||
saṃkrāntidivase puṇye prārabhen niyamaṃ vrate |
padmam aṣṭadalaṃ kṛtvā kuṅkumena tu bhāskaram ||
pūjayen mantram uccārya vidhivad gurusaṃnidhau |
ājñā tejaskarī pṛṣṭhe prabhādīptiyaśaskarī ||
ājñāṃ sarvatra gāṃ deva mama dehi namo 'stu te |
pūjyaivaṃ kuṅkumenātha dadyād viprāya bhojanam |
udyāpane tu caṇḍāṃśuṃ sauvarṇaṃ sarathaṃ tathā ||
ekacakraṃ ca saptāśvam aruṇena samanvitam |
yaḥ kuryād vidhinānena ājñāsaṃkrāntim uttamām ||
athājñāsvaṇitā (?) loke sūryatas tasya jāyate |
gomantramitrasuteṣṭe ājñā sarvatra jāyate |
ripavaḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yānti sukhaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktam ājñāsaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
kīrtisaṃkrāntimāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu skanda vidhānataḥ |
[739]        saṃkrāntivāsaraṃ prāpya ravibimbaṃ likhed bhuvi ||
tasya madhye sthitaṃ devaṃ pūjayet sarvamantrataḥ |
yathāvibhavasāreṇa tato viprāya dakṣiṇām ||
pratimāsaṃ tu vai śvetaṃ vastrayugmaṃ pradāpayet |
udyāpane tu raupyaṃ ca sūryamantraṃ pradāpayet |
śvetavastrayugachannaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
evaṃ kṛte parākīrtir jāyate vāpi vahnija |
phalaṃ na śakyate vaktuṃ giṣyater (?) api jihvayā ||
vimalā kīrtī rājyaṃ ca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
āyurārogyasaṃpanno jīved varṣaśataṃ naraḥ ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ kīrttisaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
vakṣyāmy apāpasaṃkrāntiṃ śṛṇu skanda vidhānataḥ |
saṃkrāntyāṃ niyato bhūtvā tilaiḥ śvetaiḥ samanvitaiḥ ||
karakaṃ vardhamānaṃ ca pratipāsaṃ nivedayet |
vardhamāna iti śarāvaḥ |
mantreṇānena tu snāyād bhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ ||
tilo māṃ pātu pāpebhyas tava deva prasādataḥ |
tvaṃ ca māṃ takṣa deveśa vaṅmanaḥkāyakalmaṣāt ||
udyāpane ca devasya sauvarṇamāṣakeṇa tu |
dvibhujā pratimā kāryā rajatenātha kārayet ||
[740]        tiladhenuḥ pradātavyā vrate 'smin nātra saṃśayaḥ |
pūrvapāpapraṇāśāya āyurārogyahetave ||
etat sarvaṃ purā proktaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇave tathā |
viṣṇur indrāya jagade tathā provāca śambhave ||
śambhuś caiva mamācaṣṭe mayā proktaṃ prabho tava |
sarvasaṃkrāntidivase prārabhed vratam uttamam ||
dakṣiṇottarasaṃkrāntau sarvāsv iti ca kena ca |
adhruvatvāc charīrasya yaugapadyāt praśasyate ||
na cātra vidhilopaḥ syāt sarvatraikaṃ tu daivatam |
nānādevavratānāṃ tu naikakālaḥ praśasyate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktam apāpasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
athānyāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tāmbūlākhyām anuttamām |
vidhānaṃ pūrvavat kuryād dhānyasaṃkrāntivac ca tat ||
tāmbūlacandanādyaṃ ca pragṛhyājñāṃ dvijottamāt |
yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ rātrau rātrau tataḥ param ||
tāmbūlaṃ (?) bhakṣayed viprān kārayec (?) caiva nāntaram |
vatsarānte tu kamalaṃ kṛtvā caiva tu kāñcanam ||
patrakośaṃ ca kurvīta tathā pūgīphalālayam |
cūrṇabhāṇḍaṃ prakurvīta pūgasphoṭanaṃ tathā |
sukhavāsādicūrṇānāṃ bhāṇḍāni ca dvijarṣabha ||
[741]        dvijadāmpatyam āvāhya sarvopaskarasaṃyutaiḥ |
dravyaiś ca pūjayed bhaktyā bhojayet ṣaḍrasair dvijān ||
upakalpitaṃ ca yat kiṃcid brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
evaṃ karoti yā nārī tāmbūlākhyaṃ vratottamam ||
sarvakāmān avāpnoti martye jātikulodbhave |
saubhāgyaṃ teja atulaṃ prāpnoti dvijasattama ||
bhartrā putraiś ca pautraiś ca modate ca gṛhe gṛhe |
mṛtā kālāntare paścāt sūryaloke mahīyate ||
patinā devavad vipra yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam |
śṛṇoti yuvatī kācit sāpi tat phalam aśnute |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargaloke mahīyate ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ tāmbūlasaṃkrāntivratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkrāntiṃ ca manorathām |
guḍena pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca savastraṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ |
saṃkrāntivāsare dadyād brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ||
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe svaśaktyodyāpanaṃ śubham |
guḍena parvataṃ kāryaṃ vastraratnaiś ca bhūṣitam ||
ayane cottare dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet |
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate |
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ manorathasaṃkrāntivratam |
[742]                nandikeśvara uvāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viśokasaṃkrāntim uttamām |
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāto bhaved yadi ||
ekabhaktaṃ naraḥ kuryāt tilaiḥ snānaṃ tu kārayet |
kāñcanaṃ bhāskaraṃ kṛtvā yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ ||
snāpayet pañcagavyena gandhapuṣpaiḥ supūjayet |
veṣṭayed raktavastrābhyāṃ tāmrapātre nidhāpayet ||
bhāskarāya namaḥ pādau rave jaṅgheti vai namaḥ |
ādityāya namo jānu ūrū caiva divākaraḥ ||
aryamne tu kaṭiṃ pūjya bhānuṃ caivodare tathā |
namaḥ pūṣṇe tu bāhubhyāṃ aryamne tu punaḥ stanau ||
vivasvate namaḥ kaṇṭhe sahasrāṃśo mukhe smṛtam |
prabhākara namo netre tejorāśe namaḥ śiraḥ ||
varuṇāya namaḥ keśān pādādau pūjayed ravim |
arghyādi pūrvavat kāryaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kāñcanena divākaram |
sapadmahastaṃ saṃpūjya yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ ||
kārayet pūjayed bhaktyā raktavastraiś ca veṣṭayet |
tato homaṃ prakurvīta sūryamantraiś ca nārada ||
dvādaśa kapilā dadyād vastrālaṃkārasaṃyutāḥ |
aśaktaḥ kapilām ekāṃ vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ |
[743]        grahaṇe ca kurukṣetre satpātre ca pradīyate ||
koṭi koṭi suvarṇasya dattasya labhate phalam |
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ bhāryāputrasamanvitam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ viśokasaṃkrātivratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe saṃkrāntivratāni |
[744]
atha saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha māsavratāni
yena trilokī dharaṇī kṛteyaṃ
karpūratulyapratimair yaśobhiḥ |
hemādrisūriḥ sumahāprabhāvaṃ
māsavrataṃ vrātam iha bravīti ||
vajra uvāca
bhagavan karmaṇā kena rūpavān jāyate naraḥ |
etan me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ hi sarvavid ucyate ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
phālgunyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
yāvac caitrī mahārāja tāvat snāto dine dine ||
bahiḥ saṃpūjayed devaṃ keśavaṃ bhogaśāyinam |
ekabhaktāśano nityam adhaḥśāyī tathā bhavet ||
trirātropoṣitaḥ pūjāṃ caitryāṃ kuryāt tathaiva ca |
svaśaktyā rajataṃ dadyād vastrayugmaṃ tathaiva ca ||
rūpārthino māsam idaṃ mayoktaṃ (?)
vratottamaṃ nityam adīnasattvam |
kṛtvā tu nākaṃ manujas tv avāpa
mānuṣyam āsādya ca rūpavān syāt ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ rūpāvāptivratam |
[745]                brahmovāca |
dharmarāja nibodhedaṃ damanādimahotsavam |
pravṛttavaranārīkaṃ pañcamoccārasundaram ||
saṃyuto nandanavane āryayā saha bhāryayā |
vismayotpullanayanī babhrāmonmattavac chivaḥ ||
sa dadarśa vane phulle vidyādharagaṇān bahūn |
vasantartau nartamānān surāsuragaṇārcitān ||
santānapārijātābhyāṃ baddhvā vai mādhavīlatām |
kadācid dolanaṃ cakruḥ samāliṅgya ghanastanīm ||
gītamāndolakārūḍhā abhāsan paramastriyaḥ |
yenaivotpāṭayanti sma svanātham api manmatham ||
tad dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā bhavānī prāha śaṅkaram |
kautukaṃ me samutpannaṃ pannagābharaṇa prabho ||
āndolakaṃ mama kṛte kārayasva svalaṃkṛtam |
yathā samandolaye 'haṃ yathā caitre trilocana ||
tad gaurīvacanaṃ cāru śrutvāsau vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
āndolaṃ kārayāmāsa samāhūya mahāsuram ||
stambhadvayaṃ kārayitvā iṣṭakāṣṭamayaṃ dṛḍham |
satyaṃ caivoparitanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭham akalpayat ||
vāsukiṃ daṇḍikāsthāne baddhvānena susaṃvṛtam |
tat purā saṃcayaṃ pīṭhaṃ kṛtavān maṇimaṇḍitam ||
bhūrikārpāsakaiśeyaiḥ sahasrair veṣṭitena vai |
sragdāmālambitakaraṃ maṇimauktikaśekharam ||
[746]        cerayitvā vicitrāṃ tāṃ dolāṃ vaijālinotvarām |
saṃsiddhāṃ siddhagurave gauraveṇa nyavedayat ||
tatrārūḍhas tu bhagavān somaḥ somavibhūṣaṇaḥ |
maṇḍanān dolayāmāsa pārśvasthaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ saha ||
vāmapārśve tu vijayā dakṣiṇe tu jayā bhavet ||
cāmarākrāntabāhvaṃśasamāśliṣṭakucadvayam |
āndolayantyā pārvatyā tadgītaṃ gadgadākṣaram ||
yena devāsurastrīṇām āsīd ānandanirbharaḥ |
jagur gandharvapatayo nanṛtuś cāpsarogaṇāḥ ||
uttālavādyāni tathā vādayanti sma cāraṇāḥ |
celuḥ kulācalāḥ sarve cukṣubhuḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ||
vavur vātāḥ sanirghātā deve dolāsamanvite |
ālokya vyākulaṃ lokaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ |
upetya praṇipatyocuḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ param ||
upāramasva bhagavan bhavataḥ krīḍayānayā |
jagad vyāghūrṇitaṃ deva vicalaj jalasāgaram ||
gīrvāṇagīrbhiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ |
samuttatāra dolātaḥ praharṣotpullalocanaḥ ||
uvāca vacanaṃ śakraḥ surasārthasya paśyataḥ |
sānukampaṃ sulalitaṃ visphuṭārthapadākṣaram ||
śrīmahendra uvāca |
adya prabhṛti ye dolākrīḍāṃ puṣkariṇītaṭe |
vasante kārayiṣyanti maṇḍite tridaśāṅgaṇe ||
[747]        netrapaṭṭapaṭīcchannaṃ padmarāgavibhūṣitam |
chādyakair upasaṃpannāṃ vinyastakanakādukām ||
adukā śṛṅkhalā |
vicitrābharaṇāṃ bhūribhābhāsitadigantarām |
mālāvidyādharākrāntāṃ prāntāropitadarpaṇām ||
chatracāmarasaṃchannāṃ yathāśakty atha vā kṛtām |
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dikṣu dikṣu diśāṃ balim ||
tasyām āropayed devam iṣṭaśiṣṭajanāvṛtam |
mūlamantreṇa devānāṃ prāptaṃ dolādhirohaṇam ||
pārśvastho brāhmaṇo vidvān paṭhed vā mantram uttamam |
viśvataścakṣur viśvatomukho
viśvatobāhur uta viśvatasvāt |
saṃbāhubhyāṃ dhamati sampatatrair
dyāvābhūmī janayan deva ekaḥ ||
gambhīratūryanirghoṣaiḥ kalahānāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ |
stutimaṅgalaśabdaiś ca puṣpadhūpādivāsitam ||
kuṅkumakṣodatāmbūlapuṣpamālākulo janaḥ |
tāṃ vihāya jalakrīḍām anyāsāṃ vidadhīta ca ||
pītagītajalāghātatāḍito yajjanaḥ sukham |
manyate niyataṃ ko 'pi prabhāvo 'yam anaṅgajaḥ ||
evaṃ ye 'nugamiṣyanti naryo dolām upāgatām |
nirujas te bhaviṣyanti sukhinaḥ śaradaḥ śatam ||
putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamāyutāḥ |
vikṛtyeha sukhaṃ martye tato yāsyanty tatparam ||
prāpte vasantasamaye surasattamānām
[748]                āndolanaṃ suravarān anukurvate ye |
te prāpnuvanti bhuvi janmataroḥ phalāni
duḥkhārtitaḥ kulaśatāny api tārayanti ||
iti bhaviṣyottarokta āndolanavidhiḥ |
mahābhārate |
caitraṃ tu niyato māsam ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhyo kule mahati jāyate ||
viṣṇudharme |
caitraṃ viṣṇuparo māsam ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
suvarṇamaṇimuktāḍhyaṃ gārhasthyaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||
ahiṃsaḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet ||
atirātrasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
atha vaiśākhavratāni |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
vaiśākhe puṣpalavaṇaṃ varjayitvā tu gopradaḥ |

[749]        etat kāntivrataṃ nāma kāntisaubhāgyadāyinī ||
viṣṇur atra devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kāntivratam |

nirantaraikabhaktena vaiśākhaṃ yo jitendriyaḥ |
naro vā yadi vā nārī jñātīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet ||
viṣṇudharme |
yaḥ kṣiped ekabhaktena vaiśākhaṃ pūjayed dharim |
naro vā yadi vā nārī jñātīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet ||
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
atirātrasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||

vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena buddhiyukto bhaven naraḥ |
etad eva manuṣyāṇāṃ manuṣyatvam upāhṛtam ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |

[750] pūrvavad iti caitra[?]māsoktarūpāvāptivratavad ekabhaktabahiḥsnānabhūśayyādikaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ |
homaṃ ca pratyahaṃ kuryāt tathā siddhārthakair nṛpa |

trimadhuraṃ madhughṛtaśarkarāḥ |
vaiśākhyāṃ kanakaṃ dadyāt trirātropoṣito naraḥ |
jñānāvāptipradaṃ tv etad vrataṃ buddhivivardhanam ||

āsādya nākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ |

jñānena yuktaś ca tathā bhavec ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ jñāvāptivratam |
atha jyaiṣṭhavratāni

[753]                sañjaya uvāca |
kadāddha (?) śrāvaṇī pūjyā kriyate tu kadā vratam |

arghyamantraḥ |

[754]        dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśi ardhaśrāvaṇi namo 'stu te ||
śvetavastraṃ pradātavyaṃ dhautaṃ vā nirmale śubhe |
śrāvaṇānte tataḥ paścāt samāpya niyamaṃ śuciḥ ||
gauriṇīr bhojayec chaktyā miṣṭānnena jaye śubhe |

evaṃvidhavidhānena kṛtvārdhaśrāvaṇīvratam |
na tasya syāc ca dāridryaṃ na caiveṣṭaviyojanam ||
aṣṭa putrāṃl labhen nārī bhartāraṃ ca guṇādhikam |
surūpaṃ guṇinaṃ kāntaṃ paṇḍitaṃ priyavādinam ||

rohiṇī patim ālebhe candraṃ vrataniṣevaṇāt |

kathāśravaṇamātreṇa devo varṣati vāsavaḥ ||
durbhikṣe ḍāmare ghore sadgrāme rājavigrahe |
kathām etāṃ niśayamyāśu doṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ pramucyate ||
iti brahmāṇdapurāṇoktam ardhaśrāvaṇikāvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |

kadā praṇamya bhagavān vaśiṣṭhamunisattamaḥ ||
pṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ muniśreṣṭha saubhāgyam atulaṃ labhet |
brūhi me tilasaṃbandhaṃ kāraṇaṃ vratam uttamam ||

dhyātvā muhūrtam ācakhyau kokilāvratam uttamam ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
āṣāḍhapaurṇamāsyāṃ tu saṃdhyākāle hy upasthite |
saṃkalpayen māsam ekaṃ śrāvaṇīprabhṛti hy aham ||
snānaṃ kariṣye niyatā brahmacarye sthitā satī |
bhokṣyāmi naktaṃ bhūśayyāṃ kariṣye prāṇināṃ dayām ||
iti saṃkalpya puruṣo nārī vā brāhmaṇāntike |
prāpyānujñāṃ tataḥ prāhṇe sarvasāmagrisaṃyutaḥ ||
puruṣaḥ pratipatkāle dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
tulasīmṛttikāṃ gṛhṇan taḍāge girinirjhare ||
snānaṃ kuryād vratī pārtha sugandhāmalakaiḥ tilaiḥ |
[756]        dināṣṭakaṃ tataḥ paścāt sarvauṣadhyā punaḥ punaḥ ||
yavayā piṣṭayā cāṣṭau dināni pṛthag ācaret |
snātvā dhyātvā raviṃ saṃdhyāṃ tarpayitvā pitṝṃs tathā ||
tarpayitvā likhet piṣṭaiḥ kokilāṃ pakṣirūpiṇīm |
kalakambāṃ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayec campakodbhavaiḥ ||
pātrair vā dhūpanaivedyair dīpālaktakacandanaiḥ |
tilataṇḍulair dūrvāgraiḥ pūjayet tām kṣamāpayet ||
nityaṃ nityaṃ cared bhaktyā mantreṇānena pāṇḍava |
tilāt snehaṃ tilāt saukhyaṃ vilavarṇe tilapriye ||
saubhāgyadhanaputrāṃś ca dehi me kokile namaḥ |
ity uccārya tataḥ paścād gṛham abhyetya saṃyataḥ ||
kṛtvāhāraṃ svapet pārtha yāvan māsaṃ samāpyate |
māsānte tāmrapātre tu kokilāṃ tilapiṣṭajām ||
ratnanetrāṃ svarṇapakṣāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
vastrai ratnair guḍair yuktāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ kuṇḍale 'tha vā ||
śvaśruśvaśuravarge vā daivajñe vā purohite |
vyāse vā saṃpradātavyā vratibhiḥ śubhakāṅkṣayā ||
evaṃ yā kurute nārī kokilāvratam ādarāt |
saptajanmani saubhāgyaṃ sā prāpnoti suvistaram ||
niḥsapatnaṃ patiṃ bhavyaṃ sasnehaṃ prāpya bhūtale |
mṛtā gaurīpuraṃ yāti vimānenārkavarcasā ||
etad vrataṃ vasiṣṭhena muninā gaditaṃ purā |
tathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ pārtha samagraṃ kīrttimālayā ||
[757]        tayāptaṃ sarvasaṃpannaṃ vasiṣṭhavacanād iha |
putrasaubhāgyasatkāraṃ śatrughnasya prasādataḥ ||
evam anyāpi kaunteya kokilāvratam ādarāt |
cariṣyati dhruvaṃ tasyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ||
yo kokilāṃ kalaravākulakaṇṭhapīṭhāṃ
yacchanti sājyatilapiṣṭamayīṃ dvijebhyaḥ |
te nandanādiṣu vaneṣu vihṛtya kāmaṃ
martyaṃ sametya madhuradhvanayo bhavanti ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ kokilāvratam |
mahābhārate |
śrāvaṇaṃ niyato māsam ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
yatra tatrābhiṣekeṇa yujyate jñātivardhanaḥ ||
viṣṇudharme |
kṣapayec caikabhaktena śrāvaṇaṃ viṣṇutatparaḥ |
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ ||
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
vājapeyasya yajñasya samagraṃ phalam aśnute ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
vajra uvāca |
[758]        bhagavan karmaṇā kena nityaṃ dharmaparo bhavet |
dharmatattvaṃ mahābhāga janmasāphalyakāraṇam ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
āṣāḍhyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
pūrvavat pūjayed devaṃ dharmavigrahadhāriṇam ||
pūrvavad ity anena rūpāvāptivratānuktaviśeṣeṇa grahaṇam |
māsasya cānte nṛpa paurṇamāsyāṃ
kuryāt trirātraṃ kanakaṃ ca dadyāt |
vratottamaṃ dharmakaraṃ tavoktaṃ
sarvārthadaṃ nātra vicāram asti ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ dharmāvāptivratam |
atha bhādrapadavratāni |
mahābhārate |
prauṣthapādaṃ tu yo māsam ekāhāro bhaven naraḥ |
dhanāḍhyasphītam atulam aiśvaryaṃ pratipadyate ||\
viṣṇudharme |
ekāhāro bhādrapade yaś ca kṛṣṇavrataṃ nayet |
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ ||
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
[759]        rājasūyasy yajñasya phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena dhanavān puruṣo bhavet |
putravān devalokeṣu pūjyo bhavati mānavaḥ ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śrāvaṇyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
pūrvavat pūjayed viṣṇuṃ devaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ vibhum ||
ayuktaṃ tu rūpāvāptivratād vijñeyam |
nīlotpaladalaiḥ patrair bhṛṅgarājasya pārthiva |
ghṛtena paramānnena tathā bilvaiś ca pārthiva ||
trirātropoṣitaḥ samyak proṣṭhapadyāṃ tato naraḥ |
gāṃ ca dadyād dvijendrāya vratānte manujottama ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsam idaṃ tvayoktam
māsādyanākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ |
mānuṣyam āsādya dhanānvitaḥ syāt
vratena cīrṇena narendrasiṃhaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ dhanāvāptivratam |
athāśvinavratāni
[760]
brahmovāca |
māsi cāśvayuje śukla ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
gṛhṇīyāt tu vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kaumudākhyaṃ mahāphalam ||
ahiṃsakaḥ śucir bhūtvā dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ |
dvādaśyām arcayet snātvā vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum ||
vilipya tu sugandhaiś ca candanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ |
kamalotpalakahlārai raktotpalasugandhibhiḥ ||
arcayed acyutaṃ nityaṃ mālatyā ca sugandhayā |
ghṛtena pūrayet pātraṃ na tu tailena pūrayet ||
dīpaṃ dadyād divā naktaṃ vartyā tu cirayā śubham |
naivedyaṃ pāyasāpūpamodakair vinivedayet ||
nivedya vāsudevāya bhaktyā caiva jitendriyaḥ |
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā dharmaṃ dhyātvā kṣamāpayet ||
oṃ namo vāsudevāya satataṃ ca japed budhaḥ ||
viprāṃś ca bhojayed bhaktyā dadyāc caiva tu dakṣiṇām |
anenaiva vidhānena māsam ekaṃ vrataṃ caret ||
yāvad vibudhyate devaḥ kārttike garuḍadhvajaḥ |
vratam etan mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
samaṃ māsopavāsena phalam asyādhikaṃ hi vā |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ putrārogyadhanāvaham ||
vratam etan naraḥ kṛtvā viṣṇulokam avāpnuyāt ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktaṃ kaumudīvratam |
[761]                vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena naraś cārogyam āpnuyāt |
rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyaṃ saromasya nirarthakam ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
proṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
yādavāya divārcāyām aniruddhaṃ prapūjayet |
pūrvoktena vidhānena yāvad āśvayujī bhavet ||
pūrvoktena rūpāvāptivratoktena |
sārasair arcayed devaṃ jātīpuṣpair dine dine |
sārasaiḥ kamalaiḥ |
ghṛtena juhuyād vahniṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyād dvijātaye |
bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ tathā viprāṃś ca bhojayet ||
trirātropoṣitaḥ samyag āśvayujyāṃ tato naraḥ |
saghṛtaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ ca kāṃsyapātraṃ dvijātaye ||
dadyān nṛpatiśārdūla naras tv ārogyavṛddhaye |
vratam etad vinirdiṣṭaṃ svargalokapradaṃ śubham ||
na kevalaṃ rogaharaṃ pradiṣṭam
ājñākaraṃ rūpavivṛddhidaṃ ca |
vratottamaṃ te kathitaṃ nṛvīra
yatheṣṭakāmāptikaraṃ nṛloke ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam ārogyavratam |
[762] mahābhārate |
tathaivāśvayujaṃ māsam ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
bhṛtyavān vāhanāḍhyaś ca bahuputraś ca jāyate |
viṣṇudharmottare |
nayaṃś cāśvayujaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayan naktabhojanaḥ |
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ ||
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
atirātrasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
atha kārttikavratāni |
kārttiko māsaḥ sarvadaivatyo 'gniś ca sarvadevānāṃ mukhaṃ tasmāt kārttike māsi bahiḥ snāyīta gāyatrījapanirataḥ |
sarvadaivahaviṣyāśī saṃvatsarakṛtāt pāpāt pūto bhavati |
iti viṣṇusmṛtyuktaḥ kārttikasnānavidhiḥ |
maitreya uvāca |
kārttikaḥ khalu māso vai sarvadevamato mahān |
yāni kṛcchrāṇi coktāni sarvapāpaharāṇi hi ||
kṛtāni munibhis tāni bhavanti manujādhipa |
[763]        devapitṛmanuṣyebhyo dattaṃ ghṛtamadhuplutam ||
tatrānnam akṣayaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā |
samabhyarcya hariṃ bhaktyā dīpaṃ datvā divāniśam |
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā naro yāti divaṃ nṛpa ||
iti vahnipurāṇoktaṃ kārttikavratam |
sanatkumāra uvāca |
dāmodarasya vākyaṃ tu śrutvā praśnaṃ cakāra saḥ |
kenopāyena bhagavan naśyate tan mahattamaḥ ||
nākalokasamaṃ saukhyaṃ pretaloke bhavet katham |
bhagavan devakīputras tadvākyasyottaraṃ dadau ||
uvāca paramaṃ guhyaṃ manorathaphalapradam |
bho śṛṇuṣva mahābuddhe yat pravakṣyāmi te vacaḥ ||
pūrṇa āśvayuje māsi paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
prathame ca niśārambha manovākkāyasaṃyataḥ |
yamaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pretebhyo namo dharmāya viṣṇave |
namo yamāya rudrāya kāntārapataye namaḥ ||
dadyād anena mantreṇa dīpaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
yaḥ kārttikaṃ samagraṃ tu vartante tasya sampadaḥ ||
divākare 'stācalamaulibhūte
gṛhād adūre puruṣaḥ purāṇam |
yūpākṛtiṃ yajñīyavṛkṣadārum
[764]                āropya  bhūmāv atha tasya mūrdhni ||
yavāṅgulachidrayutās tu madhye
dvihastadīrghāś ca supaṭṭikāsu |
kṛtvā catasro 'ṣṭadalā kṛtis tu
yābhir bhaved aṣṭadigānusārī ||
yavair mitam aṅgulaṃ yathāṅgulam |
tatkarṇikāyāṃ tu mahāprakāśo
dīpaḥ pradeyo dalagās tathāṣṭau |
khadiṅmukhā dīpavarās tu taila-
ghṛtādiyuktās tu yathopalabdham ||
anaṅgalagnaṃ tv atha vastrakhaṇḍaṃ
navaṃ suraktaṃ tv atha vā suśuklam ||
anaṅgalagnaṃ aparihitam |
dhanyaṃ prayojyaṃ vasukaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ
snigdhaṃ sukhatvaṃ susamaṃ samastam |
tacchālipiṣṭoparisannidheyaṃ
yathā na naśyen na ca kampate vā ||
sarvaṃ prakuryāt triguṇapramāṇaṃ
madhye sthitasyāpy atha dīparājñaḥ |
daleṣu śobhāḍhyam atīva kuryāt
manorathānām upalabdhaye ca ||
ghaṇṭāṣṭakaṃ lambitapuṣpadāma
suvastraśobhānvitam atra paścāt |
[765]        saṃyojya bhūmiṃ tv atha gomayena
sacandanāktena jalena liptām ||
anekavarṇair atha maṇḍale tu
kṛtvāṣṭapatraṃ kamalapramāṇam |
phalāni mūlāni tathākṣatāni
jālā dadhikṣīram athānnapānam ||
nānāvidhaṃ bhakṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca
sunṛtyagītaṃ madhuraṃ ca vādyam |
nivedya dharmāya harāya bhūmau
dāmodarāyāpy atha dharmarājñe ||
prajāpatibhyas tv atha satpitṛbhyaḥ
pretebhya evātha tamasthitebhyaḥ |
nairṛtyakoṇād atha dakṣiṇāntaṃ
dharmādibhyaḥ pretaparyāntikebhyaḥ ||
tato jalaṃ śītalam ānayitvā
sarpiḥsamadhvaktam atīva hṛdyam |
āpūrya cāṣṭau kalaśān jalena
nairṛtyakoṇād atha sannidhāya ||
hemādipātraṃ tilam eva pūrṇaṃ
dadyāt pidhānaṃ ca sadakṣiṇaṃ ca |
gobhūhiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ ca vastraṃ
phalāni mūlāni yavaṃ ca dhānyam ||
gṛhaṃ rathaṃ śayanaṃ vāhanaṃ ca
[766]                yad vātha kiṃcid dhṛdaye manojñam |
nivedayed brāhmaṇasattamebhyo
nairṛtyakoṇād atha saṃsthitebhyaḥ ||
ekaikaśaḥ prīṇanaṃ cātha kuryāt
dharmādibhyaḥ pretapuryāntikebhyaḥ |
etat samagraṃ vidhivac ca kuryāt
svaśaktim ādau svadhanaṃ vicārya ||
dīpān samagrān atha varjayitvā
sarvaṃ nayeyus tv api vipramukhyān |
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vanāṅganāṃ tu
tato bhavet saṃyatanaktabhojī ||
vanāṅganāṃ vanadevatāṃ dīpastambhamūrtim |
itīdam īdṛgvyavahārayuktaṃ
niśāgame pratyaham eva kuryāt |
māsaṃ samagraṃ parayā ca bhaktyā
samāpyate kārtikapaurṇamāsyām ||
dinatrayaṃ dīpamahotsavaṃ vā
eko 'tha vā dīpavaraś ca deyaḥ |
tathāśvayujyādisamagramāsam
niśāgame pratyaham eva bhaktyā ||
namo 'stu kāntārakadevatābhyaḥ
itīvam (ity evam?) uktvā svagṛhasya śāntyai |
nāryā nareṇātha susaṃyatena
[767]                bhaktyā yutenātha niśāsu bhojyam ||
saṃdhyātraye dīpavarāś ca deyāḥ
rātryāṃ same kārtikapaurṇamāsyām |
daridraveśvasv atha gokuleṣu
śmaśānadevāyataneṣu caitye |
nadītaṭeṣu svagṛhāntare vā
athaikaliṅge pathi caikavṛkṣe ||
sahasram aṣṭādhikam atra taila-
palasya pātre suśubhe śataṃ vā ||
ye no tadardhair atha vā tadardhaiḥ
pramāpya riktās tv atha pūraṇīyāḥ |
hastān svakīyāṃś ca caturdaśaiva
pramāpya vastraṃ tv atha sūtravartim ||
prajvālayet tāṃ ca nirudhya dhīmān
strīṇām alaṃkāraśataiḥ prapūjya |
devī mahāvartir atīva nadyā
puṇyā ca sādyā bhuvanaprakāśī ||
etan na kuryād atha yas tu mandas
tasyāndhakārasya kuto 'pi śāntiḥ |
ayaṃ hi dīpaḥ kila kalpavṛkṣaś
cintāmaṇir bhadraghaṭo 'tha veṇuḥ ||
anena dīpena manorathānāṃ
saṃprāptir astīti na saṃśayo 'tra |
[768]        etāni uktvā katicid vacāṃsi
dāmodaraś cāntarito babhūva ||
ity ādipurāṇoktaḥ pradīpavidhiḥ |
vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena sarvatra jayam āpnuyāt |
vyavahāre rate dyūte vivāde ca dvijottama ||
jayāvāpteḥ paraṃ nāsti saukhyaṃ lokeṣu sattama |
jayāvāptiḥ paraṃ saukhyaṃ tad api vratam ucyatām ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
āśvayujyām atītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
pūrvavat pūjayed devaṃ lokanāthaṃ trivikramam ||
pūrvavad iti rūpāvāptivratavat |
trirātryante tu kārttikyāṃ dadyād bhakṣaṇam uttamam |
sarvaśasyadharaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā ratnair alaṃkṛtaḥ ||

prāpnoti lokaṃ suciraṃ nṛvīra |
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ
prāpnoti sarvatra jayaṃ triloke ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ jayāvāptivratam |
[769]                brahmovāca |
supuṇye kārttike māsi devarṣipitṛsevite |
kriyamāṇe vrate nṝṇāṃ svalpe 'pi syān mahāphalam ||
kṛtsnaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ puṇyas tasmād varṣāsu pūjitaḥ |
varṣāyāḥ kārttikaḥ puṇyaḥ kārttikād bhīṣmapañcakam ||
naivedyaṃ puṣpadhūpaṃ ca arcanaṃ suvilepanam |
datvaikaṃ kārttikaṃ viṣṇoḥ phalaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ labhet ||
ataḥ kārttikam āsādya sadaiva śubhakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
harim uddiśya kartavyaṃ suśaktyā sukaraṃ vratam ||
kārttikasyāsite pakṣe vāyubhakṣaś caturdaśīm |
samupoṣya naro bhaktyā pūjayed garuḍadhvajam ||
upavāsas tu kartavyo vārimadhye sthitena ca |
jalakṛcchram idaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
daśamyāṃ pañcagavyāśī ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
arcayec cācyutaṃ devaṃ niyataś ca vrataṃ caret ||
kārttikasyāsite kṛtvā naro devavrataṃ caret |
dāmodaraṃ samabhyarcya deyo vaimāniko bhavet ||
apaḥ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ saptamyādicaturdinam |
kārttikasyāsite pītvā ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ ||
kṛcchrapaitāmahaṃ nāma kurvan saṃpūjayed dharim |
prāpnoti paramaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthānaṃ trailokyapūjitam |
trirātraṃ payasaḥ pānam upavāsaparasya ca ||
ṣaṣṭyādau kārttike śukle kṛcchro māhendra ucyate |
[770]        dāmodaraṃ samabhyarcya kṛcchraṃ māhendram ācaret ||
prayātyasulabhaṃ deva viṣṇulokam uttamam |
tryahaṃ munyannam aśnīyād yāvakaṃ ca tryahaṃ tataḥ ||
munyannaṃ nīrvārānnam |
tryahaṃ copavased antyaṃ kṛcchro 'yaṃ vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kārttikasya tṛtīyād āvartayed (?) viṣṇum avyayam |
śuklapakṣe naro yāti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
pañcarātraṃ payaḥ pītvā pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
dadhyāhāro bhavet pañca ekādaśyām upāvaset ||
kārttikasya site kurvan pūjayed garuḍadhvajam |
bhāskarākhyam idaṃ kṛtvā śvetadvīpaṃ vrajen naraḥ ||
yavāgūṃ yāvakaṃ śākaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtaṃ jalam |
pañcamyādi site pakṣe kārttikasya samācaret ||
kṛcchraṃ saptarṣidaṃ cedaṃ kurvan viṣṇvarcane rataḥ |
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitam ||
palāśabilvapatraiś ca kuśapadmair uḍumbaraiḥ |
suśṛtaṃ ca pibet kṣīraṃ ṣaṣṭhyām upavased dinam ||
kurvan hi kārttike śukle kṛccham āgneyam uttamam |
viṣṇulokam avāpnoti bhaktyābhyarcya janārdanam ||
payo bilvāni padmāni mṛṇālakavalāni tu |
saptamyādau naraḥ kṛtvā ekādaśyām upāvaset ||
kārttikasyāmale pakṣe lakṣmīpradam idaṃ vratam |
keśavaṃ ca samabhyarcya vaiṣṇavīṃ gatim āpnuyāt ||
[771]        kṛcchrāṇy etāni sarvāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca |
kartavyāni narair bhaktyā kārttike tu viśeṣataḥ ||
gṛhastho vā vanastho vā mumukṣur vātha bhikṣukaḥ |
kṛtvā vratam avāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ padam avyayam ||
kṛcchrāṇi kurvan sarvāṇi vāṅmanoniyatendriyaḥ |
dhautavāsaḥ śucisnātaḥ pūjayed devam acyutam ||
ahiṃsako dānarato japahomaparāyaṇaḥ |
arcayed varadaṃ viṣṇuṃ kṛcchrāṇi tu samācaret ||
vratadravyāṇi sarvāṇi kṣīrādīni sadā vratī |
vipradattāni cāśnīyāc cecchayā na prakāmataḥ ||
yāni vai parakīyāni dravyāṇi kathitāni tu |
teṣāṃ puṇyatamaṃ dānaṃ yad dadāti dvijottame |
kurvan kṛcchrāṇi pīḍārtaḥ kṣudhayā muhyate 'tha vā ||
amṛtaṃ tu gavāṃ kṣīraṃ pāyayet pīḍitaṃ naram ||
aṣṭau tāny avrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ |
havir brāhmaṇakāmyā ca guror vacanam auṣadham ||
yathoktena vidhānena kṛcchrāṇi samupācaret |
kārttike kṛṣṇam abhyarcya yāti yatra janārdanaḥ ||
evaṃ nānāhvayair nityaṃ muktiphalabhāginaḥ |
vratopavāsaniyamais te muktiphalabhāginaḥ ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktāni kṛcchravratāni |
[772]                māndhātā uvāca |
saṃprāpya kārttikaṃ māsaṃ rājā rukmāṅgado mune |
mohinīṃ mohasaṃyuktāṃ kathaṃ sambubhuje vada ||
viṣṇubhaktastutiparaḥ pravaraḥ sa mahīkṣitāṃ |
tasmin puṇyottame māsi tasyāṃ kim akaron nṛpaḥ ||
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
saṃprāpya kārttikaṃ māsaṃ prabodhakaraṇaṃ hareḥ |
atimugdho 'py asau rājā mohinīṃ vākyam abravīt ||
vata devi tvayā sārdhaṃ bahūn saṃvatsarān mayā |
tavāpamānasya bhayān na tvaṃ muktā mayā kvacit ||
