sāṃprataṃ vratakāmo 'haṃ tan nibodha varānane |
tvayy āsaktasya me devi bahavaḥ kārttikā gatāḥ ||
na vratī kārttike jāto muktvaikaṃ harivāsaram |
so 'haṃ kārttikam icchāmi vratena parisarpitum ||
avratena gato yeṣāṃ kārttiko martyadharmiṇām |
iṣṭāpūrtaṃ vṛthā teṣāṃ dharmaṃ padmodbhavātmaje ||
māṃsāśino hi bhūpālā atyarthaṃ mṛgayāgatāḥ |
te māṃsaṃ kārttike tyaktvā gatā viṣṇvālayaṃ śubham ||
pravṛttānāṃ hi bhakṣāṇāṃ kārttike niyame kṛte |
avaśyaṃ viṣṇurūpatvaṃ prāpyate muktisādhanam ||
hṛdayāhlādakartṝṇi dīpadānād divaṃ vrajet |
tasyāpy abhāve subhage paradīpaprabodhanam ||
kartavyaṃ bhūtikāmena sarvadānādhikaṃ yataḥ |
[773]        ekataḥ sarvadānāni dīpadānaṃ hi caikataḥ ||
kārttike na samaṃ proktaṃ dīpako hy adhikaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kārttike kārttikīṃ kṛtvā viṣṇor nābhibhavodbhave ||
ā janmanaḥ kṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ kārttiko yasya gacchati ||
devo vaimāniko bhūtvā sa yāti paramaṃ padam |
tasmān mohini mohantu parityajya mamopari ||
bhava bhūdharapūjāyāṃ niratā nīrajekṣaṇe |
ahaṃ vratadharaś caiva bhaviṣye haripūjane ||
mohiny uvāca |
vistareṇa mamākhyāhi māhātmyaṃ kārttikasya ca |
sarvapuṇyādhikaḥ prokto māso 'yaṃ rājasattama ||
viśeṣāt puṣkare prokto (?) dvārāvatyāṃ tu saukare |
śrutvā kārttikamāhātmyaṃ kariṣye 'haṃ yathepsitam ||
rukmāṅgada uvāca |
māhātmyam abhidhāsyāmi māsasyāsya varānane |
yena te jāyate bhaktir bhaktyā yenārcyate hariḥ ||
kārttike kṛcchrasevī yaḥ pāyāpatyarato 'pi vā |
ṣaḍdvādaśāhaṃ pakṣaṃ vā māsaṃ vā varavarṇini ||
kṣapayitvā naro yāti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam |
ekabhakte 'tha vā nakte tathā subhru ayācite ||
kṛte narair dharāpāptir bhaved vai dīpamālayā |
tasmin haridine puṇyaṃ tathā vai bhīṣmapañcakam ||
[774]        prabodhanīṃ naraḥ kṛtvā jāgareṇa samanvitām |
na mātur jaṭhare yāti api pāpānvito naraḥ ||
tasmin dine varārohe maṇḍalaṃ yas tu paśyati |
vinā sāṃkhyena yogena sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
kārttike maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭvā saukare śūkaraṃ śubhe |
dṛṣṭvā kokavarāhaṃ tu na bhūyaḥ stanapo bhavet ||
trividhasya tu pāpasya dṛṣṭvā muktir bhaven nṛṇām |
mandāre capalāṅgi kubjake śrīdharaṃ tathā ||
kārttike varjayet tailaṃ kārttike varjayen madhu |
kārttike varjayet kāṃsyaṃ kārttike māsi sandhitam ||
tailaṃ rājikādisandhānam |
niṣpāvān kārttike devi yo bhuṅkte viṣṇutatparaḥ |
saṃvatsarakṛtāt (?) puṇyād dhānir bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||
prāpnoti rājakīṃ yoniṃ sakṛdbhakṣaṇasaṃbhavāt |
kārttike saukaraṃ māṃsaṃ yas tu bhuṅkte sudurmatiḥ ||
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi raurave paripacyate |
tanmukto jāyate pāpī viṣṭhāśī grāmaśūkaraḥ ||
na mātsyaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ na kaurmaṃ nānyad eva hi |
caṇḍālo jāyate rājan kārttike māṃsabhakṣaṇāt ||
kārttikaḥ sarvapāpaghnaḥ kiṃcidvratadharasya tu |
gacched yasya tu dharmātmā na sa śocyaḥ kṛtākṛte ||
kārttike tu kṛtā dīkṣā nṝṇāṃ janmanikṛntanī |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīkṣāṃ kurvīta kārttike ||
[775]        adīkṣitasya vāmoru kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ nirarthakam |
paśuyoniṃ samāpnoti dīkṣayā kulajanma ca ||
na gṛhe kārttikīṃ kuryād viśeṣeṇa tu kārttikīṃ |
tīrtheṣu kārttikīṃ kuryāt sarvayatnena bhāmini ||
kārttike śuklapakṣasya kṛtvā hy ekādaśīṃ naraḥ |
prātar datvā śubhān kumbhān sa yāti harimandiram ||
saṃvatsaravratānāṃ hi samāptiḥ kārttike smṛtā |
pañcāhā yatra dṛśyante viṣṇor nābhijasaṃbhave ||
dināni yatra catvāri tathaiva varavarṇini |
uttarāyaṇahīne 'pi śuddhir lagnaṃ vinā śubhe ||
dṛśyante yatra saṃbandhāḥ putrapautravivardhanāḥ |
tasmān mohini kartāsmi kārttikavratasevayā |
aśeṣapāpanāśāya tava prītivivṛddhaye ||
iti nāradīyoktaṃ kārttikamāsavratam |
brahmovāca |
kṣīrāśī kārttike yas tu devyā bhaktirato naraḥ |
śākapācakanaktāśī prātaḥsnāyī śivārataḥ ||
pūjayet tilahomas tu madhukṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ |
kāryas tu devīmantreṇa śṛṇu puṇyaphalaṃ hareḥ ||
mahāpātakasaṃyukto yukto vā tūpapātakaiḥ |
mucyate nātra saṃdeho yasmāt sarvagatā śivā ||\
[776]        anyo vā bhāvanāyukto anena vidhinā śivām |
svayaṃ vā anyato vāpi pūjayet pūjayeta vā ||
na tasya bhavati vyādhir na ca śatrukṛtaṃ bhayam |
notpātaṃ gṛhadusthaṃ vā na ca rāṣṭraṃ vinaśyati ||
mahāsvabhāvasaṃpannā ṛtavaḥ śubhadāyakāḥ |
niṣpattiḥ sarvaśasyānāṃ taskarā na bhavanti ca ||
prabhūtapayasī gāvo brāhmaṇāḥ satkriyāparāḥ |
striyaḥ pativratāḥ sarvā nṛpā nirvṛtavairiṇaḥ ||
phalapuṣpavatī devī vanaspatimatī mahī |
bhavane nātra saṃdehaś caṇḍikāvidhipūjanāt ||
jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī |
durgā kṣamā śivā dhātrī svadhā svāhā namo 'stu te ||
anenaiva tu mantreṇa japahomaṃ tu kārayet |
prātaḥ samyak smṛtā vatsa mahiṣaghno prapūjitā ||
aghaṃ nāśayati kṣipraṃ yathā sūryodayas tamaḥ |
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ devīvratam |
nārada uvāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi vratānām uttamasya ca |
vidhiṃ māsopavāsasya phalaṃ cāsya yathoditam ||
yathāvidhā naraiḥ karyā vratacaryā yathā bhavet |
ārabhyate yathāpūrvaṃ samāpyaṃ hi yathāvidhi ||
[777]        yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tāvad brūhi pitāmaha |
vratam etat suraśreṣṭha vistareṇa mamānagha ||
brahmovāca |
sādhu nārada yac caitat praṣṭaṃ cara tapodhana |
yādṛṅmatimatāṃ śreṣṭha tac chṛṇuṣva bravīmi te ||
surāṇāṃ ca yathā viṣṇus tapanāṃ ca yathā raviḥ |
meruḥ (?) śikhariṇāṃ yadvad vainateyas tu pakṣiṇām ||
tīrthānāṃ tu yathā gaṅgā prajānāṃ tu yathā vaṇik |
śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavratānāṃ tu tadvan māsopavāsanam ||
sarvavrateṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yat phalam |
sarvadānodbhavaṃ vāpi labhen māsopavāsakṛt ||
agniṣṭomādibhir yajñair vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ |
na tat puṇyam āpnoti yan māsaparilaṅghanāt ||
tena dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ snānaṃ caiva svadhā kṛtā |
yaḥ karoti vidhānena naro māsam upoṣaṇam ||
praviśya vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ tenābhyarcya janārdanam |
guror ājñāṃ tato labdhvā kuryān māsopavāsanam ||
vaiṣṇavāni yathoktāni kṛtvā sarvavratāni tu |
dvādaśyādīni puṇyāni tato māsam upācaret ||
atikṛcchraṃ parākaṃ ca kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ tataḥ |
māsopavāsaṃ kurvīta jñātvā dehabalābalam ||
vānaprastho yatir vāpi nārī vā vidhavā mune |
māsopavāsaṃ kurvīta guruviprājñayā tataḥ ||
[778]        āśvinasyāmale pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
vratam etat tu gṛhṇīyād yāvat triṃśad dināni tu ||
vāsudevaṃ samuddiśya kārttikaṃ sakalaṃ naraḥ |
māsaṃ copavased yas tu sa muktiphalabhāg bhavet ||
acyutasyālaye bhaktyā trikālaṃ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mālatīṃ dīvaraiḥ padmaiḥ kamalaiḥ susugandhibhiḥ ||
kuṅkumośīrakarpūrair vilipya varacandanaiḥ |
naivedyadhūpadīpādyair arcayeta janārdanam ||
manasā karmaṇā vācā pūjayed garuḍadhvajam |
kuryān naras trisavanaṃ bṛhadbhaktijitendriyaḥ ||
nāmnām eva tathālāpaṃ viṣṇoḥ kuryād aharniśam |
bhaktyā viṣṇoḥ stutir vācyā mṛṣāvādaṃ vivarjayet ||
sarvasattvadayāyuktaḥ śāntavṛttir ahiṃsakaḥ |
supto vāsanasaṃstho vā vāsudevaṃ prakīrtayet ||
smṛtyālokanagandhādisvādanaṃ parikīrtanam |
annasya varjayet sarvaṃ grāsānāṃ cābhikāṅkhanam ||
gātrābhyaṅgaṃ śiro'bhyaṅgaṃ tāmbūlaṃ suvilepanam |
vratastho varjayet sarvaṃ yac cānyatra nirākṛtam ||
vratastho na spṛhet kiṃcid vikarmasthān na cālayet |
devatāyatane tiṣṭhen na gṛhasthaś cared vratam ||
kṛtvā māsopavāsaṃ tu saṃbhṛtātmā jitendriyaḥ |
tato 'rcayet tataḥ puṇyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ garuḍadhvajam ||
pūjayet puṣpamālābhir gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
[779]        vastrālaṃkāravādyaiś ca toṣayed acyutaṃ naraḥ ||
snāpayeta hariṃ bhaktyā tīrthacandanavāriṇā |
candanenānuliptāṅgaṃ puṣpadhūpair alaṃkṛtam ||
vastradānādibhiś caiva bhojayec ca dvijottamān |
dadyāc ca dakṣiṇāṃ tebhyaḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ||
viprān kṣamāpayitvā tu visṛjyābhyarcya pūjya ca |
evaṃ vittānusāreṇa bhaktiyuktena śaktitaḥ ||
evaṃ māsopavāsaṃ tu kṛtvābhyarcya janārdanam |
bhojayitvā dvijāṃś caiva viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
evaṃ māsopavāsaṃ hi samyak kṛtvā trayodaśa |
niryāpayet tatas tān vai vidhinānena tac chṛṇu ||
kārayed vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñam ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
pūjaytivā ca deveśam ācāryānujñayā harim ||
arcayitvā hariṃ bhaktyā abhivādya guruṃ tathā |
tato 'nubhojayed viprān bhojayīta yathāvidhi ||
viśuddhakulacāritrān viṣṇupūjanatatparān |
pūjayitvā dvijān samyag bhojayitvā trayodaśa ||
tāvanti vastrayugmāni bhājanāny āsanāni ca |
yogapaṭṭāni śubhrāṇi brahmasūtrāṇi caiva hi ||
dadyāc caiva dvijāgrebhyaḥ pūjayitvā praṇamya ca |
tato 'nukalpayec chayyāṃ śastāstaraṇasaṃskṛtām ||
sācchādanaśubhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sopadhānām alaṃkṛtām |
kārayitvātmano mūrtiṃ kāñcanīṃ tu svaśaktitaḥ ||
[780]        nyaset tasyāṃ tu śayyāyām arcayitvā sragādibhiḥ |
āsanaṃ pāduke chatraṃ vastrayugmam upānahau ||
pavitrāṇi ca puṣpāṇi śayyāyām upakalpayet |
evaṃ śayyāṃ tu saṃkalpya praṇipatya ca tān dvijān ||
prārthayec cānumodārthaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ vrajāmy aham |
evam abhyarcitā viprā vadeyur vratinaṃ sadā ||
vraja vraja naraśreṣṭha viṣṇoḥ sthānam anāmayam |
vimānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ saśayyāparikalpitam ||
tena viṣṇupadaṃ yāhi sadānandam anāmayam |
tato visarjayed viprān praṇipatyānugamya ca ||
tatas tu pūjayed bhaktyā guruṃ jñānapradāyakam |
tāṃ śayyāṃ kalpitāṃ samyag guruṃ vratasamāpakam ||
praṇamya śirasā śāṇto gurave pratipādayet |
evaṃ pūjya hariṃ viprān guruṃ jñānaprakāśakam ||
kṛtvā māsopavāsāṃś ca naro viṣṇutanuṃ viśet |
kṛtamāsopavāsaś ca viṣṇupūjanatatparaḥ ||
na cec chāntamanāḥ kālaṃ dharmasthaḥ sujitendriyaḥ |
kṛtvā māsopavāsāṃś ca nirvāpya vidhivan mune ||
kulānāṃ śatam uddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ vrajen naraḥ |
tasmin jātau mahāpuṇye kule māsopavāsakṛt ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
naro māsopavāsānāṃ kartā puṇyavatāṃ naraḥ ||
pitṛmātṛkulābhyāṃ ca samaṃ viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet |
[781]        nārī vā sumahābhāgā yathoktaṃ vratam āsthitā |
kṛtvā māsopavāsāṃś ca vrajed viṣṇuṃ sanātanam ||
nārada uvāca |
suduṣkaraṃ idaṃ deva mūrcchāglānikaraṃ nṛṇām |
vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyaṃ bhaktiṃ janayate 'cyute ||
pīḍitasya bhṛśaṃ deva mumūrṣor vratinas tadā |
tyāgo vānugraho vātha kiṃ tu kāryaḥ pitāmaha ||
brahmovāca |
vratasthaṃ kathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumūrṣuṃ vā tapodhana |
dṛṣṭvā tu brāhmaṇas tasya kuryāt samyag anugraham ||
amṛtaṃ pāyayet kṣīram icchamānaṃ sakṛn niśi |
yatheha na viyujyet prāṇaiḥ kṣutpīḍito vratī ||
atumūrchānvitaṃ kṣīṇaṃ mumūrṣuṃ kṣutprapīḍitam |
pāyayitvā śritaṃ kṣīraṃ rakṣed datvā phalāni ca ||
ahorātraṃ ca yo nityaṃ vratasthaṃ paripālayet |
payo mūlaṃ phalaṃ datvā viṣṇulokaṃ vrajeta saḥ ||
evaṃ māsopavāsastham ārūḍhaṃ prāṇasaṃśaye |
avrataghnagunair dviyaiḥ parīpsed brāhmaṇājñayā ||
kṣīrauṣadhaṃ guror ājñayāpo mūlaphalāni ca ||
evaṃ kṛtvābhibhakṣeta saguḍaṃ pāyasaṃ tadā |
[782]        pāyayed rakṣito yasmāt samāpnoti punar vratam ||
atha viṣṇur vrataṃ viṣṇur dātā viṣṇur vratī tathā |
sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jñātvā vratasthaṃ kṣīṇam uddharet ||
yathā mumūrṣur niśceṣṭaḥ pariglāno 'timūrchitaḥ |
tadā samuddharet kṣīṇam icchantaṃ vimukhasthitam ||
paripālya vratī dehaṃ vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet |
yathoktaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya phalaṃ vipramukhoditam ||
indriyārtheṣv asaṃsaktā sadaiva vimalā matiḥ |
paritoṣayate viṣṇuṃ nopavāso 'jitātmanām ||
kiṃ tasya bahubhis tīrthaiḥ snānahomajapavrataiḥ |
yenendriyagaṇo ghoro nirjito hṛṣṭacetasā ||
jitendriyaḥ sadā śāntaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
vāsudevaparo nityaṃ na kleśaṃ kartum arhati ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ yathoktaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ puruṣottamam |
viṣṇulokam avāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabham ||
ye smaranti sadā viṣṇuṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā |
te prayānti bhayaṃ tyaktvā viṣṇulokam anāmayam ||
prabhāte cārdharātre ca madhyāhne divasakṣaye |
acyutaṃ ye 'nukīrtanti te taranti bhavārṇavam ||
ānandito 'tha duḥkhārtaḥ kruddhaḥ śānto 'tha vā harim |
yo hi kīrtayate bhaktyā sa gacched vaiṣṇavīṃ purīm ||
[783]        garbhajanmajarārogaduḥkhasaṃsārabandhanaiḥ |
na bādhyate naro nityaṃ vāsudevam anusmaran ||
sthāvare jaṅgame (?) sattve sthūle sūkṣme śubhāśubhe |
viṣṇuṃ paśyati sarvatra yaḥ sa viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ naraḥ ||
sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jñātvā trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
yasya śāntā matis tena pūjito garuḍadhvajaḥ ||
atikalpānukalpābhyāṃ vratānām uttamasya ca |
viṣṇulokam avāpnoti prasādāc cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
vidhir māsopavāsasya yathāvat parikīrtitaḥ |
sutasnehād dvijaśreṣṭha sarvalokahitāya ca ||
kṛtvā śrutvā ca yaṃ bhaktyā tato viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet |
nābhaktāya pradātavyaṃ na deyaṃ duṣṭacetase ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktaṃ māsopavāsavratam |
mahābhārate |
kārttikaṃ tu naro māsaṃ yaḥ kuryād ekabhojanam |
śūraś ca bahubhāgyaś ca kīrttimāṃś caiva jāyate ||
viṣṇudharme |
kārttike ekadā bhuṅkte yaś ca viṣṇuparo naraḥ |
śūraś ca kṛtavidyaś ca bahuputraś ca jāyate ||
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
[784]        namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
atirātrasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
ity ekabhaktavratam |
atha mārgaśīrṣavratāni |
mahābhārate |
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu yo māsam ekabhaktena saṃkṣipet |
bhojayet tu dvijān bhaktyā mucyate vyādhikilbiṣaiḥ ||
sarvakalyāṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ |
upoṣya vyādhirahito vīryavān abhijāyate |
kṛṣibhāgī bahudhano bahudhānyaś ca jāyate ||
viṣṇudharme |
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu yo māsam ekabhaktena saṃkṣipet |
kurvan vai viṣṇuśuśrūṣāṃ sa deśe jāyate śubhe ||
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
vājapeyasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
[785]                vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena naro lāvaṇyam āpnuyāt |
lāvaṇyarahitaṃ rūpaṃ niṣphalaṃ pratibhāti me ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
kārttikyāṃ samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
paṭe vā yadi vārcāyāṃ pradumnaṃ pūjayed vibhum ||
bahiḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kuryān naktam aśnīta vāgyataḥ |
ekabhaktaṃ mahārāja haviṣyaṃ prayataḥ sadā ||
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tataḥ prāpya trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ |
saṃpūjya deva pradyumnaṃ hutvāgnau ghṛtam eva ca ||
bhojayed brāhmaṇāṃś cātra bhojanaṃ lavaṇotkaṭam |
cūrṇitasya tataḥ prasthaṃ lavaṇasya dvijātaye ||
mahārajataraktaṃ ca vastrayugmaṃ tathā guroḥ |
dadyāc ca kanakaṃ rājan kāṃsyapātraṃ tathaiva ca ||
māsena lāvaṇyakaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ
vratottamaṃ nākagatipradaṃ ca |
na kevalaṃ yādava sarvakāmān
narasya dadyāt puruṣapradhānam ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ lāvaṇyāvāptivratam |
[786]
atha pauṣavratāni |
mahābhārate |
pauṣamāsaṃ tu kaunteya bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣipet |
subhago darśanīyaś ca yaśobhāgī ca jāyate ||
viṣṇudharma |
pauṣamāsaṃ tathā dālbhya ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
śuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ śaurerarogī jāyate naraḥ ||
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
aśvamedhasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena śīlavān puruṣo bhavet |
kulajātiśrutebhyas tu śīlam eva viśiṣyate ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
āgrahāyaṇyatītāyāṃ māsam ekaṃ dine dine |
pūrvavat pūjayed devaṃ varāham aparājitam ||
ghṛtena snāpayed devaṃ ghṛtena juhuyād dharim |
ghṛtaṃ dvijebhyo dadyāc ca ghṛtam eva nivedayet ||
trirātropoṣitaḥ pauṣyāṃ ghṛtapātreṇa ca dvijam |
[787]        pūjayec ca suvarṇena yathāśakti narādhipa ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsam idaṃ yathoktam
āsādya nākaṃ suciraṃ manuṣyaḥ |
mānuṣyam āsādya ca śīlavān syāt
prāpnoti puṣṭiṃ cirajīvitaṃ ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ śīlāvāptivratam |
atha śuklacaturdaśyāṃ pauṣamāse samāhitaḥ |
cāndrāyaṇavrataṃ māsaṃ grāhayet sarvapāpajit |
pūrṇendupaurṇamāsyāṃ tu pūjayet pratyahaṃ jalaiḥ ||
pauṣa iti sāmīpye saptamī | caturdaśīpūrṇamāsyoḥ pūrvamāsāvayavatvā |
manorathāya svāheti tathā sante payāṃsi ca |
tarpayed agnir etābhis tisṛbhiś ca sadaiva hi ||
annāhutibhir aṣṭābhir hutābhiś ca niśākaram |
yad devād eva ity etaiś caturbhir mantrasattamaiḥ ||
ājyena tarpayed bāhuṃ sarvapāpopaśāntaye |
tathā devakṛtasyeti samidbhir nityam eva hi ||
caruṃ bhaikṣyaṃ tathā saktuṃ takraṃ yāvakam eva ca |
śākaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ phalamūlodakāni ca ||
paurṇamāsyām ārabhya pratyahaṃ tarpaṇaṃ homaṃ ca karayed ity arthaḥ |
hutaśiṣṭaṃ ca vai paścāt prāśayed annam ādarāt ||
[788]        kukkuṭāṇḍopamān grāsān paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhakṣayet |
kṛtvā pañcadaśaivātha hrāsayet tu dine dine ||
viṃśatyā sahitaṃ yena kṛṣṇapakṣe bhavec chatam |
amāvāsyādine caiva vipraś copavaset tataḥ ||
śuklapratipad ārabhya candravṛddhikrameṇa tu |
viṃśatyā sahitaṃ bhūyo grāsānāṃ syāc chataṃ yathā ||
māsena dve śate yena bhavetāṃ dve ca viṃśatī |
ekasya praṇavo mantro bhūrdvayoś ca bhaved api ||
bhuvas trayāṇāṃ svaś cāpi caturṇāṃ maha eva ca |
bhaved atha ca pañcānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ jana udāhṛtaḥ ||
saptānāṃ tu tapaḥ satyam aṣṭānāṃ parikīrtyate |
oṃ navānām iṣā vātha daśānāṃ mantra eva ca ||
ekādaśānāṃ yojasva vijayasva paraṃ bhavet |
trayodaśānāṃ puruṣas tato dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
śivaḥ pañcadaśānāṃ tu grāsānāṃ mantra ucyate |
svāhākāranamaskārayuktair mantraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
abhimantrya grased grāsān dinasaṃkhyākrameṇa ca ||
oṃ namaḥ svāhā bhūr namaḥ svāhetyādimantrāḥ |
samāpte ca vrate dadyād gāṃ vṛṣaṃ ca dvijātaye |
cāndrāyaṇena caikena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet ||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā candralokam avāpnuyāt |
iha loke dhanārogyaṃ sukhaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadam ||
[789]        bhaved amaraloke ca śakrasya sadane gatiḥ |
bhavec chivaṃ tadabhyāsāj janma brāhmaṇajanmani ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktaṃ cāndrāyaṇavratam |
atha māghamāsavratāni |
nāradīyapurāṇe |
kāṣṭhakīla uvāca |
saṃprāpto māghamāso 'yaṃ tapasvijanavallabhaḥ |
yasmin krośanti pāpāni yajñasnānavatāṃ sadā ||
kṛtāni sarvadeheṣu brahmahatyāsamāny api |
durlabho māghamāsas tu bahudānapradāyakaḥ ||
devais tejaḥ parikṣiptaṃ māghamāse jale sadā |
na vahniṃ sevayet snāto hy asnāto 'pi varānane ||
homārthaṃ sevayed vahniṃ śītārthaṃ na kadācana |
yāvat prabhā varārohe tāvat sūryodaye smṛtā ||
sarittoyādyabhāve tu navakumbhasthitaṃ jalam |
vāyunā tāḍitaṃ rātrau gaṅgātoyasamaṃ viduḥ ||
tan nāsti pātakaṃ loke yan na snānād vinaśyati |
agnipraveśād adhikaṃ māghasnānaṃ varānane ||
[790]        jīvatā bhujyate duḥkhaṃ mṛto duḥkhaṃ na paśyati |
etasmāt kāraṇāt subhru māghasnānaṃ viśiṣyate ||
ahany ahani dātavyās tilāḥ śarkarayānvitāḥ |
tribhāgas tu tilānāṃ hi caturthaḥ śarkarānvitaḥ ||
anabhyaṅgo varārohe sarvaṃ māsaṃ nayed vratī |
sūryo me prīyatāṃ devo viṣṇumūrtir nirañjanaḥ ||
māghāvasāne subhage ṣaḍrasaṃ saṃpradāpayet |
dampatyor vāsasī śukle saptadhānyasamanvite ||
triṃśat tu modakā deyāḥ kṛtās tilamayāḥ śubhāḥ |
maricair nirmitāḥ ślakṣṇāḥ nāraṅgāṇi ca dāpayet ||
saritaḥ prabhavas tvaṃ hi paraṃ dhāma jale mama |
tvattejasā paribhraṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ yātu sahasradhā ||
divākara jagannātha prabhākara namo 'stu te |
paripūrṇaṃ kuruṣveha māghasnānam uṣaḥpate ||
evaṃ māghaplavo yāti bhittvā bimbaṃ divākaram |
parivrāḍ yogayuktaś ca raṇe vābhimukho hataḥ |
tṛtīyo 'tra varārohe māghasnāyī prakīrtitaḥ ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
māghamāse mama brūhi snānaṃ yadukulodvaha |
yena duḥkhāmbupaṅkaughād uttaranti bhavārṇavāt ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
brāhmaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatriyaṃ smṛtam |
[791]        vaiśyaṃ dvāparam ity āhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ tathā ||
kalau rājan manuṣyāṇāṃ śaithilyaṃ snānakarmaṇi |
tathāpi māghavyājena kathayiṣyāmi tac chṛṇu ||
yasya hastau ca pādau ca vāṅ manaś ca susaṃyatam |
vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrthaphalam aśnute ||
aśraddadhānaḥ pāpātmā nāstiko 'cchinnasaṃśayaḥ |
hetunindārataś caite na tīrthaphalabhāginaḥ ||
prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāpya kurukṣetram athāpi vā |
yatra vā tatra vā snāyān māghe nityam iti sthitiḥ ||
trirātraphaladā nadyo yāḥ kāścid asamudragāḥ |
samudragās tu pakṣasya māsasya saritāṃ patiḥ ||
apāṃ samīpe yat snānaṃ saṃdyāyām udite ravau |
prājāpatyena tat tulyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
prātar utthāya yo vipraḥ prātaḥsnāyī bhavet sadā |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
vṛthā coṣṇodakasnānaṃ vṛtā jāpyam avaidikam |
aśrotriye vṛthā śrāddhaṃ vṛthā bhuktam asākṣikam ||
snānaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ snānavidbhir yudhiṣṭhira |
vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmyaṃ divyaṃ ceti pṛthak śṛṇu ||
vāyavyaṃ gorajasnānaṃ vāruṇaṃ sāgarādibhiḥ |
brāhmyaṃ brāhmaṇamantroktaṃ divyaṃ medhāmbu bhāskarāt ||
snānānām api sarveṣāṃ vāruṇaṃ śreṣṭham ucyate |
[792]        brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho 'tha bhikṣukaḥ ||
ete sarve praśaṃsanti sarvadā māghamajjanam |
bālavṛddhayuvānaś ca naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ ||
snātvā māghe śubhe tīrthe prāpnuvantīpsitaṃ phalam |
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva mantravat snānam iṣyate ||
tūṣṇīm eva hi śūdrāṇāṃ tathaiva kurunandana |
namaskāreṇa vā kāryaṃ sarvapāpaughahānidam ||
māghamāse raṭanty āpaḥ kiṃcid abhyudite ravau |
brahmaghnaṃ vā surāpaṃ vā kaṃ patantaṃ punīmahe ||
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāḥ striyaś cāpsarasāṃ samāḥ |
dadhidugdhavahā yatra nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ||
tatra te yānti majjanti ye māghe bhāskarodaye |
yativat pathi gaccheta maunī paiśūnyavarjitaḥ ||
ya icched vipulān bhogān candrasūryagrahopamān |
puṣyaphālgunayor madhye prātaḥ snāyī bhavet tu saḥ ||
paurṇamāsīm amāvāsyāṃ prārabhya snānam ācaret |
triṃśad dināni puṇyāni makarasthe divākare ||
tata utthāya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyād vidhipūrvakam |
māghamāsam imaṃ puṇyaṃ snāsye 'haṃ deva mādhava ||
tīrthe śītajale nityam iti saṃkalpya cetasi |
aprāvṛtaśarīras tu yaḥ sākṣāt snānam ācaret ||
pade pade 'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
[793]        tataḥ snātvā śubhe tīrthe datvā śirasi vai mṛdam |
vedoktavidhinā rājan sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet ||
pitṝn saṃtarpya tatrasthaḥ avatīrya tato jalāt |
iṣṭadevaṃ namaskṛtya pūjayet puruṣottamam ||
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ mādhavaṃ nāma pūjayet |
vahniṃ hutvā vidhānena tatas tv ekāśano bhavet ||
bhūśayyābrahmacaryeṇa śaktaḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
aśakto brahmacaryādau svecchā tasyaiva kalpyate ||
avaśyam iti kartavyaṃ māghasnānam iti śrutiḥ |
īśvareṇa yathākāmaṃ balaṃ dharmo 'nuvartate ||
tilasnāyī tilodvartī tilahomī tilodakī |
tilabhuk tiladātā ca ṣaṭtilāḥ pāpanāśanāḥ ||
tailam āmalakāś caiva tīrthe deyāś ca nityaśaḥ |
tathā prajvālayed vahniṃ nivātāṃ kārayet kuṭim ||
evaṃ mādhavamāse tu śakto bhojyam avāritam |
kārayed atha śaktyā vā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitam ||
dampatyāni dvijāgryāṇāṃ pūjyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
bhūṣayitvā pradeyāni dānāni vividhāni ca ||
kambalājinavastrāṇi nānāratnāni śaktitaḥ |
colakāni ca deyāni pracchādanapaṭāni ca ||
upānahau pādaguptyai mocakau pāpamocakau |
tathānyad dayitaṃ kiṃcin māghasnāne pradīyate |
[794]        tan māghasnāyināṃ deyaṃ viprāṇāṃ bhūtim icchatā ||
svalpe 'pi dānaṃ vaktavyaṃ mādhava prīyatām iti ||
agamyāgamanāt steyāt pāpebhyaś ca pratigrahāt |
rahasyācaritāt pāpān mucyate snānam ācaran ||
māghamāse vidhānena cetasy ādhāya mādhavam |
pituḥ pūrvān samuddhṛtya mātuḥ pūrvān pitṝn atha |
ekaviṃśakulaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān ||
māghasyoṣasi snātvā vai viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
yo māghamāsy uṣasi sūryakarābhitāmre
snānaṃ samācarati cārunadīpravāhe |
uddhṛtya pūrvapuruṣān pitṛmātṛtaś ca
svargaṃ prayāty amaradehadharo naro 'sau ||
iti māghasnānavidhiḥ |
māghamāsy uṣasi snānaṃ kṛtvā dampatyam arcayet |
bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā bālavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
saubhāgyapadam āpnoti śarīrārogyam uttamam |
sūryalokapradaṃ nūnaṃ sūryavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ sūryavratam |
brahmovāca |
kṛcchraikabhaktaṃ hemante māghamāsam atandritaḥ |
māsānte ca rathaṃ kuryāc citravastropaśobhitam ||
[795]        śvetaiś caturbhir yuktaṃ tu taragaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam |
śvetadhvajapatākābhiḥ chatracāmaradarpaṇam ||
taṇḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā bhānuṃ narādhipa |
vinyasya taṃ rathaprasthe saṃjñayā saha bhūpate ||
taṃ rātrau rājamārgeṇa śaṅkhabheryādibhiḥ svanaiḥ |
bhrāmayitvā śanaiḥ paścāt sūryāyanam ānayet ||
tatra cāgurupiṣṭena pradīpādyupaśobhitam |
prekṣaṇīyapradāmaiś ca kṣapayitvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
prabhāte snapanaṃ kṛtvā payasā vā ghṛtena vā |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
rathaṃ saṃvāhanopetaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet ||
bhuktvā ca brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇamyārkaṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet ||
sarvavratānāṃ paramaṃ śakradharmāsthitaḥ sadā |
tatra sūryavrataṃ nāma sarvakāmārthasādhakam ||
sarvavrateṣu yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yat phalam |
sarvaṃ sūryaratheneha tat puṇyaṃ labhate nṛpa ||
sūryāyutapratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
trisaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogān sarvalokeṣv anuttamān |
kalpāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ tato rājā bhavet kṣitau ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ sūryavratam |
[796] mahābhārate |
māghamāsaṃ tu yo māsam ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
śrīmān kulajñātimāṃs tu sa mahattvaṃ prapadyate ||
viṣṇudharma |
māghamāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet |
viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇaparaḥ satkule jāyate satām ||
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ |
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
atirātrasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena vidyāvān puruṣo bhavet |
savidya eva vijñeyaḥ puruṣaḥ paśur anyathā ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
pauṣyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
prāgvat tu pūjayed devaṃ turaṅgaśirasaṃ harim ||
[797] prāgvad iti rūpāvāptivratoktavidhinā turaṅgaśirasaṃ hayagrīvam |
tilāṃś ca juhuyād vahnau tilair devaṃ samarcayet |
trirātropoṣito māghaṃ tilān kanakam eva ca ||
dadyād brāhmaṇamukhyāya samyak prayatamānasaḥ |
mukhyān yajñopavītāṃś ca prabhūtam api candanam ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsam idaṃ yathoktaṃ
vidyānvitaḥ syāt puruṣaḥ sadaiva |
svarlokam āsādya sukhāni bhuktvā
kāmān abhīṣṭān puruṣo 'śnute ca ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ vidyāvāptivratam |
atha phālgunavratāni |
mahābhārate |
bhagadevaṃ tu yo māsam ekabhaktena vikṣipet |
aiśvaryam atulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pumān strī vā prapadyate |
strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti tasyāś caiva bhavanti te ||
viṣṇudharme |
kṣapayed ekabhaktena śuśrūṣur yasya phālgune |
śuśrūṣuḥ viṣṇuśuśrūṣāparaḥ |
saubhāgyaṃ svajanānāṃ ca sarveṣām eva sonnatiḥ |
[798]        ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ ||
namo 'stu vāsudevāyety ahaś cāṣṭaśataṃ japet |
atirātrasya yajñasya tataḥ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
iti ekabhaktavratam |
varāha uvāca |
phālgunasya tu māsasya puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca |
karmaṇyāni śubhānīha gṛhītvā bhaktimān naraḥ ||
tataḥ vakṣyamāṇaślokoktād ācāryāt |
yas tu jānāti karmāṇi sarvakarmaviniścitaḥ |
udāharati mantrāṃś ca naktādiniyamasthitaḥ ||
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā karābhyām aṅgulaiḥ puṭam |
gṛhītveti śeṣaḥ, puṭaṃ puṣpapūrṇapātrapuṭam |
namo nārāyaṇāyety uktvā imaṃ mantram udīrayet ||
namo 'stu devadeveśa cakranirmathanāya te |
namo 'stu lokanāthāya supravīra namo 'stu te ||
ādimadhyāvasānaṃ te na jānātīha kaścana ||
vasantāgamapuṣpāṇi gṛhāṇa puruṣottama |
ya etena vidhānena kurān māse tu phālgune |
na ca gacchati saṃsāraṃ paraṃ lokaṃ ca gacchati ||
iti varāhapurāṇoktaḥ phālgunavidhiḥ |
[799]                vajra uvāca |
bhagavan karmaṇā kena saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt |
lāvaṇyarūpasaubhāgyaṃ vinā jñeyaṃ nirarthakam ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
māghyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
paṭe vā yadi vārcāyāṃ kṛṣṇa saṃpūjayet sadā |
pūrvokaṃ sakalaṃ kuryād vidhiṃ cātra narādhipa ||
pūrvoktam iti caitramāsasaṃbandhirūpāvāptivratoktam ity arthaḥ |
nityaṃ samācaret snānaṃ tathā gandhapriyaṅgunā |
caruṃ priyaṅgunā kuryād dhomaṃ kuryāt priyaṅgunā ||
gandhaḥ priyaṅgusadṛśagandhadravyam, priyaṅguḥ kuṅkumasadṛśagandhadravyaṃ priyaṅguḥ kaṅguḥ |
phālgunyāṃ tu tato dadyāt trirāropoṣito naraḥ ||
vastre ca deye nṛpa kuṅkumākte
kṣaurasya pātraṃ ca tathaiva kāṃsyam |
saubhāgyadaṃ hy etad anuttamaṃ te
vrataṃ mamaitat kathitaṃ nṛvīra ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ saubhāgyāvāptivratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe māsavratāni |
[800]
atha aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha nānāmāsavratāni
aśrāntaṃ cārucāmīkar . . . pariprīṇitaprāṇivargaḥ
svargaṅgāsaṅgabhūmīruhatilavilasatkinnarīgītakīrtiḥ |
hemādriḥ saṃpratīha sphuraduruduritavrātaghātaikahetuṃ
nānāmāsavratānāṃ kramanm atha kalākovidaḥ saṃvidhatte ||
tatra cāturmāsīvratāni |
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
atha svapiti dharmātman devadevo janārdanaḥ |
lakṣmīsahāyaḥ satataṃ śeṣaparyaṅkam āsthitaḥ |
ekādaśyām āṣāḍhasya śuklapakṣe janārdanam |
devāś ca ṛṣayaś caiva stuvanti dinapañcakam ||
tataś ca caturo māsān yoganidrām upasthitām |
sapta ca tam upāsanti ṛṣayo brahmasaṃmitāḥ ||
kārttikasya site pakṣe tad eva dinapañcakam |
vibodhayanti deveśaṃ gatvā sendrā divaukasaḥ ||
tasmād etāś caturmāsīr naraḥ kuryān mahotsavam |
bhaviṣyottarāt |
[801]                yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
govindaśayanaṃ kiṃ tu kimarthaṃ svapitīty asau |
kathaṃ tac chayanaṃ tasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ||
ke cātra mantrāḥ pūjā ca dānārthaṃ niyamāś ca ke |
kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca moktavyaṃ supte devajagatpatau ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi govindaśayanavratam |
kaṭidānaṃ samutthānaṃ cāturmāsīvratakramam ||
mithunasthe sahasrāṃśau sthāpayen madhusūdanam |
tulāṃ prāpte mahārāja punar utthāpayec ca tam ||
adhiprayatate deva eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ |
nānyathā sthāpayet kṛṣṇa nānyathotthāpayet tathā ||
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
sthāpayet pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ śaṅkhacakragadhādarām ||
kāñcanīṃ rājatīṃ tāmramayīṃ pittalajāṃ tathā |
pītāmbaradhārāṃ saumyāṃ paryaṅke cāśrite śubhe |
śuklavastrapaṭacchanne sopadhāne supūjite ||
brahmapurāṇāt |
ekādaśyāṃ tu śuklāyām āṣāḍhe bhagavān hariḥ |
bhujaṅgaśayane śete yadā kṣīrārṇave sadā ||
tadā tatpratimā kāryā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā |
suptā tu śeṣaparyaṅke śailamṛdbhiś ca dārubhiḥ ||
[802]        tāmrārakūṭarajataiḥ kṛtā citrapaṭeṣu vā |
lakṣmyā svahastavinyastamanojñacaraṇāmbujā ||
nānāvidhopakaraṇaiḥ pūjyā tu vidhipūrvakam |
upavāsaś ca kartavyo rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā ||
tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ pūjayec ca tām |
trayodaśyāṃ tato gītanṛtyavādyaṃ nivedayet ||
bhaviṣyottare |
itihāsapurāṇajño vedavettātha vā pumān |
snāpayitvā dadhikṣīraghṛtakṣaudrasitādibhiḥ ||
samālabhya śubhair gandhair dhūpair vastrair alaṃkṛtām |
jātīkusumamālābhir mantreṇānena pūjayet ||
supte tvayi jagannāthe jagat suptaṃ bhaved idam |
vibuddhe ca vibudhyeta prasanno me bhavācyuta ||
evaṃ tāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ sthāpayitvā svayaṃnaraḥ |
prabhāṣec cāgrato viṣṇoḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭas tathā ||
caturo vārṣikān māsān devasyotthāpanāvadhiḥ |
imaṃ kariṣye niyamaṃ nirvighnaṃ kuru me 'cyuta ||
strī vā naro vā madbhakto dharmārthaṃ sudṛḍhavrataḥ |
gṛhṇīyān niyamān etān dantadhāvanapūrvakān ||
teṣāṃ phalāni vakṣyāmi tatkartṝṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
madhusvaro bhaved rājā puruṣo guḍavarjanāt ||
tailasya varjanād deva sundarāṅgaḥ prajāyate |
[803]        kaṭutailaparityāgāc chatrunāśam avāpnuyāt ||
madhūkatailatyāgena saubhāgyam atulaṃ labhet |
yogābhyāsī vedatas tu sa brahmapadam āpnuyāt ||
kaṭukās tu tiktamadhukṣārakaṣāyasaṃcayaḥ |
yo varjayet sa vairūpyaṃ daurgandhaṃ nāpnuyāt kvacit |
tāmbūlaṃ varjayed bhogī raktakaṇṭhaś ca jāyate ||
ghṛtatyāgāc ca lāvaṇyaṃ sarvasnigdhatanur bhavet |
phalatyāgāc ca matimān bahuputraś ca jāyate ||
śākapatrāśanād bhogī apakvād amalo bhavet |
pādābhyaṅgaparityāgāc chiro'byaṅgaṃ vivarjayet ||
dīptimān dīptakāyena so 'pi kṣaudrapatir bhavet |
dadhidugdhaikaniyamī gobhakto gopatir bhavet |
indrātithitvam āpnoti sthālīpākasya varjanāt ||
labhate saṃgatiṃ dīrghāṃ tailapakvasya varjanāt |
bhūmau prastaraśāyī ca vipro munivaro bhavet ||
sadā muniḥ sadā yogī madhumāṃsaṃ ca varjayet |
nirvyādhir nīrugojasvī surāmadyaṃ vivarjayet ||
evamādiparityāgāt dharmaḥ syād dharmanandana |
ekāntaropavāsena brahmaloke mahīyate |
dhāraṇān nakharomnāṃ ca gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ||
dhāraṇādyaṣṭayogāṅgam |
maunavratī bhaved yas tu tasyājñā phalitā bhavet |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti japan yajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
[804] ayaṃ cāturmāsyavratārambho gurvastamayādāv api kāryaḥ | yad āha vṛddhagargaḥ |
na śaiśavaṃ na mauḍhyaṃ ca śukragurvor navā titheḥ |
khaṇḍatvaṃ cintayec cādau cāturmāsyavidhau naraḥ |
pādābhivandanād viṣṇor labhed godānajaṃ phalam ||
bhūmau bhuṅkte sadā yas tu sa pṛthivyāḥ patir bhavet |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti japan yajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
viṣṇupādābjasaṃsparśād dinapāpāt pramucyate |
pādodakābhiṣekād vai gaṅgāsnānaṃ dine dine ||
parṇeṣu yo naro bhuṅkte kurukṣetraphalaṃ labhet |
nityaṃ śāstrasamākhyānāl lokān yas tu prabodhayet ||
vyāsas tuṣyati tasyāśu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati |
kṛtvā prekṣaṇakaṃ viṣṇor lokam apsarasāṃ labhet ||
tīrthāmbusnāpanād viṣṇor nirmalaṃ deham āpnuyāt |
pañcagavyāśanāt pārtha cāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet ||
ayācitena prāpnoti putrān dharmyān aśeṣataḥ |
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhoktā yaḥ kalpasthāyī bhaved divi ||
upavāsadvayāntaritaikabhaktaḥ |
śilocchikhena bhuñjānaḥ prayāgasnānam āpnuyāt |
viṣṇudevakule kuryād upalepanamārjane ||
kalpasthāyī bhaved rājā sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaśataṃ yas tu karoti stutipāṭhakaḥ ||
haṃsayuktavimānena sa tu viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet |
gītavādyakaro viṣṇor gāndharvaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
[805]        yāmadvayaṃ jalatyāgān na rogair abhibhūyate |
guḍavarjī naro dadyād adbhutaṃ tāmrabhājanam |
sahiraṇyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha lavaṇasyāpy ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
brahmavaivarte |
nārada uvāca |
kathaṃ supte tu govinde vratacaryā surottama |
kartavyā mānavair bhaktyā viṣṇupūjanatatparaiḥ ||
tithayaḥ kāś ca puṇyā vai niḥśeṣaphaladāyikāḥ |
saṃtuṣyate harir yāsu svalpena tapasā nṛṇām ||
dānahomajapasnānaṃ vratacaryārcanaṃ hareḥ |
samācakṣya suraśreṣṭha upavāsavidhikriyām ||
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi cāturmāsyavidhikriyām |
yāṃ nirvartya naro bhaktyā prayāti paramāṃ gatim ||
avagamya vidhānena samarcanavidhiṃ hareḥ |
vratapūjādikaṃ kuryāt tato bhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
avijñāya vidhānoktāṃ hareḥ pūjāvidhikriyām |
kurvan bhaktyā samāpnoti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
yas tu viṣṇuparo nityaṃ dṛḍhabhaktir jitendriyaḥ |
sa gṛhe 'pi vasan yāti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
śive vā bhaktisaṃyukto bhānau vā gaṇanāyake |
kṛtvā vratasya niyamaṃ yathoktaphalabhāg bhavet |
narasya kṣayam āpnoti pāpaṃ janmaśatodbhavam ||
[806]        āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
naktaṃ kuryād dvijaśreṣṭha gṛhṇīyān niyamaṃ vratī ||
kuryād iti, niyamaṃ naktaṃ gṛhṇīyād ity anvayaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt saṃkrāntau karkaṭasya ca ||
āṣāḍhādau naro bhaktyā cāturmāsīvratakriyām |
cāturmāsīvratānāṃ tu kurvīta parikalpanām ||
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva gṛhītaṃ puratas tava |
nirvighnāṃ siddhim āyātu prasādāt tava keśava ||
gṛhīte 'smin vrate deva pañcatvaṃ yadi me bhavet |
tadā bhavatu saṃpūrṇaṃ tvatprasādāj janārdana ||
gṛhīte 'smin vrate deva yady apūrṇe mriye tv aham |
tan me bhavatu saṃpūrṇaṃ (?) tvatprasādāj janārdana ||
evam abhyarcya govindaṃ vratārcanajapādikam |
sarvatra parigṛhṇīyāt paripūrṇaṃ yathā bhavet ||
vratāni vaiṣṇavānīha śaivānīha dvijottama |
ekabhaktaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā nityasnāyī dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
yo 'rcayec caturo māsān vāsudevaṃ sa nākabhāk |
samāptau bhojayed viprān baktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
yas tu supte hṛṣīkeśe naktam ācarate vratī |
vastrayugmaṃ naro datvā śivaloke mahīyate ||
apūpavarjanaṃ kṛtvā bhojane vratam ācaret |
kārttike svarṇagodhūmān vastraṃ datvāśvamedhakṛt ||
annaṃ datvā ca viprāya brahmalokam avāpnuyāt |
[807]        raupyaṃ datvā brāhmaṇāya vratī tadgatamānasaḥ ||
annadānaṃ vrataṃ kuryād raupyadānaṃ ca pāraṇam |
ekāntaropavāsena viṣṇupūjanatatparaḥ ||
gāṃ datvā vāsudevasya loke saṃpūjyate naraḥ |
yas tu supte hṛṣīkeśe kṣitiśāyī bhaven naraḥ ||
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ datvā indraloke mahīyate |
vārṣikāṃś caturo māsān madyaṃ māṃsaṃ ca yas tyajet ||
svarnādau harim uddiśya sa bhaved vedavid dvijaḥ |
yah kṣipet kṛcchrapādena āṣāḍhādiṛtudvayaṃ ||
viṣṇupūjanakṛn martyaḥ sa labhet tanniketanam |
gopradānād bhavet so 'hi samāpte dvijasattama ||
yas trirātrakṛtāhāro nityasnāyī jitendriyaḥ |
vāsudevārcane yuktaḥ sa lokaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vrajet ||
pūrvoktaṃ godānapāraṇam |
vrīhīṃ yo varjayitvā tu kārttike māsi mānavaḥ |
hiraṇyaṃ śālinā datvā padaṃ prāpnoti vaiṣṇavam ||
yas tu keśavabhakto hi viṣṇoḥ pādodakaṃ pibet |
varṣārātraṃ naro bhaktyā sa viṣṇoḥ sadma saṃviśet ||
raupyaṃ candanasaṃyuktaṃ dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm |
vārṣikāṃś caturo māsān prājāpatyaṃ caren naraḥ ||
samāpte goyugaṃ dadyād datvā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
parākena naro nityaṃ yaḥ kṣiped vārṣikīṃ sakṛt ||
arcayitvācyutaṃ bhaktyā sa gacched viṣṇulokatām |
[808] pūrvoktaṃ pāraṇam |
gomūtrayācakāhāro [yāvakā-?] yo 'rcayec ca ṛtudvayam |
viṣṇum abhyarcya sadbhaktyā naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet |
samāptau govṛṣaṃ dadyād vastraṃ kāñcanasaṃyutam ||
śākamūlaphalair vāpi varṣārātraṃ nayen naraḥ |
samāptau goprado bhūtvā sa yāti viṣṇumandiram ||
payovratī tathāpnoti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam |
vratānte ca tathā dadyād gām ekāṃ ca payasvinīm ||
varjayitvā maghuṃ yas tu dadhikṣīraghṛtānvitam |
dadyād vastrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi kārttikyāṃ goprado bhavet ||
saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ gaurī me prīyatām iti |
dadyāc ca kāñcanaṃ śaktyā gaurīloke mahīyate ||
brahmacaryeṇa yo māsāṃś caturaḥ kṣapayen naraḥ |
pratimāṃ kāñcanīṃ dadyād dampatyor brahmalokabhāk ||
tāmbūlavarjanād gīro (?) raktakaṇṭhaś ca jāyate |
samāptau vastrayugmaṃ tu vastraṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||
sandhyābhīnaṃ (?) tataḥ kṛtvā samāptau ghṛtakumbhadaḥ |
vastrayugmaṃ tilān ghaṇṭāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
sārasvataṃ padaṃ yāti vidyāvān dhanavān bhavet |
kṛtvā pralepanaṃ śambhor agrataḥ keśvasya ca ||
vārṣikāṃś caturo māsān dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm |
aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamyeśaṃ ca vāgyataḥ ||
ekabhaktaṃ naraḥ kuryāc cāturmāsyam atandritaḥ |
[809]        vratānte vipramithunaṃ pūjyaṃ dhenusamanvitam |
vṛkṣān hiraṇmayān dadyāt so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
vṛkṣān aśvatthān |
ghṛtena snāpanaṃ kṛtvā śambhor vai keśavasya ca |
akṣataiś ca samaṃ kuryāt padmaṃ gomayamaṇḍale ||
samāptau hemakamalaṃ tiladhenusamanvitam |
brāhmaṇāya vratī dadyāc chivaloke mahīyate ||
saṃdhyādīpaprado yas tu prāṅgaṇe dvijasattama |
samāptau dīpikāṃ dadyāc cakaś (?) caturasre gṛhāṅgane ||
vastrayugmānvite vatsa sa tejasvī bhaved iha |
vaimāniko bhaved devo gandharvāpsarasevitaḥ ||
bhūmiṃ tu bhājanaṃ kṛtvā yo bhuṅkte tu ṛtudvayam |
kāṃsyapātraṃ ca gāṃ datvā pṛthvīśo bhavate naraḥ ||
parṇasaṃstarasaṃbhojī samāptau kāṃsyabhājanam |
datvā svargagato brahman pūjyate tridivaukasā ||
upoṣaṇaphalaṃ bhuṅkte rambhāpalāśavṛkṣajaiḥ |
anyāni yāny abhīṣṭāni varjayed viṣṇutatparaḥ |
viśuddhamānaso brahman sarvam evākṣayo bhavet ||
pādābhivandanaṃ kṛtvā keśavasya narottama |
prāpnoty atulam ānantyaṃ prasanne garuḍadhvaje |
tacchuddhamanasaḥ puṃsas toṣaṃ yānti divaukasaḥ ||
evaṃ vratāni puṇyāni janmaduḥkhaharāṇi ca |
harim uddiśya cīrṇāni bhuktimuktipradāni tu ||
[810]        aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
naktaṃ samācared yas tu dīpaṃ dadyāc catuṣpathe ||
prāṅgaṇe tu tathā dīpaṃ datvā caiva gavāhnikam |
cāturmāsyavrataṃ kṛtvā vratānte govṛṣapradaḥ ||
sa yāti bhavanaṃ śambhoḥ pūjito devasattamaiḥ |
viṣṇoḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā śambhor vātha dvijottama ||
vratānte vastrado bhūtvā datvā svargam āpnuyāt |
yas tu vai caturo māsān karoti ca jagatpateḥ ||
keśavasya mahābhāga pādapūjāṃ dvijottama |
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ śāśvataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yas tu keśavam uddiśya nityam eva tilapradaḥ |
tilatyāgo bhaven nityaṃ cāturmāsyam atandritaḥ ||
samāpte tu vrate vipra tiladhenuprado bhavet |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate |
tadante ca bhaved rājā bhārate bhūbhṛtāṃ varaḥ ||
gītaṃ tu devadevasya keśavasya śivasya ca |
karoti nityam āpnoti naro yogasya vai phalam ||
vratānte sa vratī dadyād ghaṇṭāṃ devāya susvarām |
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṃś ca varjayed yas tu mānavaḥ ||
sa bhaved rūpasaṃpanno vyādhibhir nābhibhūyate |
vratānte ca dvijaṃ pūjyaṃ śaktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
patitālāpam anṛtaṃ varjayec ca ṛtudvayam |
pādābhyaṅgaṃ naro dadyād brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam |
[811]        dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā sa gacched viṣṇumandiram ||
yas tu vai caturo māsān varjayed ghṛtam uttamam |
mahālāvaṇyam āpnoti gātrasaurabhyam eva ca ||
vratānte harim uddiśya datvā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
gandhena pūjya govindaṃ brāhmaṇāya dvijottama |
vastrayugmaṃ tato datvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
tejasvī jāyate vipra tailapakvasya varjanāt |
viprān saṃbhojya viprarṣe yāti lokaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ||
yas tyajed dharim uddiśya snānam uṣṇena vāriṇā |
gaṅgāsnānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena nityam eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
yas tu saṃsmarate nityaṃ gaṅgāṃ bhāgīrathīṃ śubhām |
sa nityaṃ snānam āpnoti gaṅgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yas tu supte hṛṣīkeśe puṣpāṇi ca vivarjeyet |
vratānte tu bhavec cātaḥ sa vratī svarṇapuṣpadaḥ ||
sa yāti bhuvanaṃ śubhraṃ viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ |
prasupte tu jagannāthe śivasyāṅgaṇam arcayet ||
pañcavarṇais tu yo nityaṃ svastikaiḥ padmakais tathā |
sa yāti rudralokaṃ hi gāṇapatyam avāpnuyāt ||
yas tu supte hṛṣīkeśe pūjayen madhusūdanam |
sāyaṃprātas (?) tu bhuktvā vai prājāpatyapuraṃ vrajet ||
yas tu supte hṛṣīkeśe tṛtīyāyāṃ narottamam |
pratipakṣaṃ guḍaṃ dadyād gorī me prīyatām iti ||
samāpte vipramithune pūjayitvā dvijottamam |
[812]        vastrair ābharaṇaiś caiva bhojayitvā bhavet sukhī ||
pañcamyāṃ pratipakṣaṃ tu taṇḍulaiḥ pūritaṃ ghaṭam |
yaḥ pradadyād vratasyānte pūjayitvā dvijottamān ||
vastrair ābharaṇaiś caiva taṇḍulaprastham eva ca |
datvā sārasvataṃ yāti padaṃ gandharvapūjitam |
vidvān sa pūrṇavibhavo dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ||
rūpavān guṇavāṃś caiva raktakaṇṭhaś (?) ca jāyate |
caturdaśyāṃ tu saṃpūjya umāmāheśvaraṃ vibhum ||
pratipakṣaṃ tu saṃpūjya puṣpair gandhair nivedanaiḥ |
cāturmāsye tato vṛkṣe raupyaṃ kṛtvā vṛṣottamam |
tatropari ca sauvarṇam umāmāheśvaraṃ vibhum ||
pūjayitvā dvijaśreṣṭha brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
vratī sa yāti bhuvanaṃ vimānena hi śāṅkaram |
kalpānte tatra vai sthitvā pṛthvīpālo bhaved iti ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
evamādivrataiḥ pārtha toṣam āyāti toṣitaḥ |
keśavaḥ kleśahā kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃsakeśinisūdanaḥ ||
supte yasmin nivartante kriyāḥ sarvāḥ śubhodayāḥ |
vivāhavratabandhādicūḍāsaṃskāravīkṣaṇam |
yajñagṛhapraveśaś ca pratiṣṭhādevabhūbhṛtām ||
puṇyāni yāni karmāṇi na syuḥ supte jagatpatau |
asaṃkrāntaṃ tathā māsaṃ daive paitrye ca karmaṇi ||
malamāsam aśaucaṃ ca varjayen matimān naraḥ |
[813]        prāpte bhādrapade māsi ekādaśyāṃ site 'hani ||
kaṭidānaṃ bhaved viṣṇor mahāpātakanāśanam |
kaṭidānam iti śayitasya viṣṇor aṅgaparivṛttikaraṇam |
yed etad devaśayanaṃ tatredaṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ||
purā tapaḥprabhāveṇa toṣito 'haṃ mahābhuja |
prārthitaḥ sthānam aṅgeṣu prītyarthaṃ yoganidrayā ||
tato mayātmano dehaṃ tat sthānārthaṃ nirīkṣitam |
uro lakṣmyā mama vyāptaṃ hṛdayaṃ kaustubhena tu ||
śaṅkhacakragadāśārṅgair bāhavothāhavakṣasāḥ (?) |
adho nābher niruddhaṃ me vainateyena pakṣiṇā |
mukuṭena śiro ruddhaṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ śrutidvayam ||
tato dattaṃ mayā pārtha netrayoḥ sthānam ādarāt |
caturo vārṣikān māsān vasuḥ prīto bhaviṣyati ||
yoganidrāpi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā prītābhavat tu sā |
cakāra locanāvāsam atorthaṃ (?) me yudhiṣṭhira ||
ahaṃ ca tāṃ bhāvayitvā mānayāmy ātmasaṃsthitām |
yoganidrāṃ mahānidrāṃ śeśāhiśayaṇe svapan |
kṣīrodatrovīcyovairdhautapādaḥ (?) samāhitaḥ ||
lakṣmyāḥ karāmbujaiḥ ślakṣṇair mṛdyamānapadadvayaḥ |
tasmin kāle ca madbhakto yo māsāṃś caturaḥ kṣipet ||
vratair anekair niyamaiḥ pāṇḍava śreyase 'nagha |
kalpam ekaṃ viṣṇuloke pūjyamāno naro vaset ||
tato vibudhyate deva śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
[814]
brahmapurāṇāt |
ekādaśyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ kārttike māsi keśavam |
prasuptaṃ bodhayed rātrau śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
nṛtyair gītais tathā vādyaiḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmamaṅgalaiḥ |
vīṇāpaṭahaśabdaiś ca purāṇaśravaṇena ca ||
vāsudevakathābhiś ca stotrair anyaiś ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ |
subhāsitair indrajalair bhūriśobhābhir eva ca ||
puṣpair dhūpaiś ca naivedyair dīpair vṛkṣaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
homair bhakṣyair apūpaiś ca phalaiḥ śarkarapāyasaiḥ ||
ikṣor vikārair madhurair drākṣākṣudraiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ |
kuṭherakasya mañjaryā mālatyā kamalena ca ||
kuṭherakaḥ kṛṣṇatulasī |
hṛdyābhyām śvetaraktābhyāṃ candanābhyāṃ ca sarvadā |
kuṅkumālaktakābhyāṃ ca raktasūktaiḥ sakaṅkaṇaiḥ ||
tathā nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpair dravair vīra kramāhṛtaiḥ |
raktayuktena prathamaṃ mālyena grahaṇaṃ tathā ||
tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ dvādaśyām aruṇodaye |
ādau ghṛtenaikṣaveṇa madhunā snāpayet tataḥ ||
dadhnā kṣīreṇa ca tataḥ pañcagavyena śāstravat |
udvartanaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ masūrāmalakāni ca ||
sarṣapāś ca priyaṅguś ca sarvabījāni kāñcanam |
maṅgalāni yathākāmaṃ raktāni ca kuśodakam ||
evaṃ saṃśodhya deveśaṃ dadyād gorocanāṃ śubhām |
tatas tu kalaśā deyā yathā prāptāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
[815]        jātīpallavasaṃyuktāḥ saphalāś ca sakāñcanāḥ |
puṇyāhaveṇuśabdena vīṇāveṇuraveṇa ca ||
evaṃ saṃsnāpya govindaṃ svanuliptaṃ svalaṃkṛtam |
suvāsasaṃ tu saṃpūjya sumanobhiḥ sukuṅkumaiḥ |
dīpair dhūpair manojñaiś ca pāyasena ca bhūriṇā ||
pātrebhyaś cānnadānaiś ca homaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ |
vāsobhir bhūṣaṇair anyair gobhiś caiva manojavaiḥ ||
brāhmaṇāḥ pūjanīyāś ca viṣṇor hṛdyāś ca mūrtayaḥ |
yat tu śiṣṭāmṛtaṃ paścād bhoktavyaṃ brāḥmaṇaiḥ saha ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
kārttike śuklapakṣasya ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
mantreṇa caiva rājendra devam utthāpayed dvijaḥ ||
mantrās tu varāhapurāṇoktāḥ |
oṃ brahmendrarudrāgnikuberasūrya-
somādibhir vanditavandanīyaḥ |
budhyasva deveśa jagannivāsa
mantraprabhāveṇa sukhena deva ||
iyaṃ tu dvadaśī deva prabodhārthaṃ tu nirmitā |
tvayaiva sarvalokānāṃ hitārthaṃ śeṣaśāyinā ||
tvayi supte jagannātha jagat suptaṃ bhaved idam |
utthite ceṣṭate sarvam uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha mādhava ||
gatā meghā viyac caiva nirmalaṃ nirmalā diśaḥ |
śāradāni ca puṣpāṇi gṛhāṇa mama keśava ||
[816]        idaṃ viṣṇur iti prokte mantram utthāpane hareḥ |
samutthite tato viṣṇau pravartante śubhāḥ kriyāḥ ||
tatraiva devadevasya snānaṃ tu pūrvavad bhavet |
mahātūryaravai rātau bhrāmayed devam utthitam ||
vimānākārayānena nagare pārthivaḥ svayam |
dīpodyotakare mārge nṛtyagītajanākule ||
yo yo dāmodaraṃ paśyed utthitaṃ dharaṇīdharam |
sa sa prāṇo mahārāja sarvaḥ svargāya kalpayet ||
rātrau prajāgare deva ekādaśyāṃ surālaye |
prabhāte vimale snātvā dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇum arcayet ||
homayed dhavyavāhaṃ ca homadravyair ghṛtādibhiḥ |
tato viprān nṛpaśreṣṭha bhojayed annavistaraiḥ ||
ghṛtakṣīradadhikṣaudrakāsāraguḍamodakaiḥ |
yajamānayutas tuṣṭas tvarāṃ hāsya vivarjayet ||
ekādaśa daśāṣṭau vā pañca dvau vā kurūttama |
carcayec candanair gandhair (?) vastramālyādibhir dvijān ||
śāstroktavidhinā pārtha śraddhayā vidhitatparaḥ |
pitaras toṣitās tena toṣitas tena keśavaḥ ||
na hi kaścit samaḥ sākṣād dharmaḥ śrāddhena pāṇḍava |
pitṝn uddiśya yat kiṃcid dīyate śraddhayānvitaiḥ |
tat prītyā bhujyate devair brahmādibhir asaṃśayam ||
ataḥ śrāddhoktavidhinā vratānte pūjayed dvijān |
ācānte tu tato dadyāt tyaktaṃ yat kiṃcid eva hi ||
[817]        svavācā svamanobhīṣṭaṃ snehadhānyaphalādikam |
caturo vārṣikān māsān niyamo yena yaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
kathayitvā dvijebhyas tad dadyād bhaktyā sadakṣiṇam |
datvā visarjayed viprān tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
yat tyaktaṃ caturo māsān pravṛttiṃ tasya vācayet |
ya enaṃ kurute pārtha so 'nantaphalabhāg bhavet ||
prativarṣaṃ ca yaḥ kuryād devaṃ saṃsmarate harim ||
dehānte 'tipradīptena vimānenārkavarcasā |
modate viṣṇuloke 'sau yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
yasyāvighnaiḥ samāpyeta cāturmāsīvrataṃ nṛpa |
sa bhavet kṛtakṛtyas tu tuṣṭo yasya janārdanaḥ ||
yo devaśayane bhaktyā anuṣṭhānaṃ samācaret |
gaṅgāditīrthayātrāyās tulyaṃ phalam avāpnuyāt ||
utthānaṃ vāpi kṛṣṇasya sa harer lokam āpnuyāt |
śṛṇoti dhyāyati stauti samākhyāty anumodate |
vratam etan naro bhaktyā sa gacched vaiṣṇavaṃ puram ||
dugdhābdhibhogiśayane bhagavān ananto
yasmin dine svapiti vātha vibudhyate vā |
tasminn ananyamanasām upavāsabhājāṃ
puṃsāṃ dadāti sugatiṃ garuḍāṅgasaṅgaḥ ||
iti devaśayanotthānavidhiḥ |
[818]        āṣāḍhādicaturmāsān abhyaṅgaṃ varjayen naraḥ |
pārite ca punar dadyāt tilatailayugaṃ ghaṭam ||
bhojanaṃ pāyasājyaṃ ca sa yāti bhavanaṃ vibhoḥ |
lokaprītikaraṃ hy etat snehavratam ihocyate ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ snehavratam |
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsyāṃ varjayen nakhakṛntanam |
vṛntākabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhusarpirghaṭānvitam ||
kārttikyāṃ tat punar haimaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
rudralokam avāpnoti śivavratam uttamam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ śivavratam |
mahāphalāni yas tyaktvā cāturmāsyāṃ dvijātaye |
haimāni kārttike dadyād goyugena samaṃ naraḥ ||
sitavastrayugenātha saṃpūrṇājyaghṛtena ca |
etat phalavrataṃ nāma sarvakāmaphalapradam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ phalavratam |
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsān prātaḥ snāyī bhaven naraḥ |
viprāya bhojanaṃ datvā kārttikyāṃ goprado bhavet ||
ghṛtakumbhaṃ tathā dadyāt sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt |
vaiṣṇavavratam ity uktaṃ viṣṇulokapradāyakam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ vaiṣṇavavratam |
[819]        aśvaṃ vai mārgaśīrṣe tu yas tu piṣṭamayaṃ dadet |
śivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivat sūryaloke mahīyate ||
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tadante syān mahīpatiḥ |
pauṣe piṣṭamayī dantī śivasyāgre nivedayet ||
triḥsaptakulasaṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tadante syān mahīpatiḥ ||
cakravartī mahāvīraḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
māghe cāśvarathaṃ yas tu śivāya vinivedayet ||
uccaret so 'pi narakāt svapitṝn rauravād itaḥ |
śivaloke tu vasati divyavarṣāyutatrayam ||
tadante tu mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ na ca khaṇḍāṃ bhunakti saḥ |
phālgune vṛṣayūthaṃ tu piṣṭotthaṃ rudrasaṃkhyayā ||
nivedya tu śivasyāgre trailokyādhipatir bhavet |
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tadante syān mahīpatiḥ ||
cakravartī mahāvīraḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
caitre gṛham indumayaṃ (?) dāsadāsīsamanvitam ||
gṛhopakaraṇair yuktaṃ vicitrāṅgaṇacarcitam |
pūjānte parayā bhaktyā śivāya vinivedayet ||
divyavarṣaśatāny aṣṭau rudraloke mahīyate |
jātismaras tadante tu cakravartitvam āpnuyāt |
māsi vaiśākhasaṃjñe tu saptavrīhisarāvakān ||
śivāya purato dadyāt pūjānte prīticetasā |
sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ bandhubhiḥ sahito naraḥ ||
[820]        phalānāṃ dve śate yas tu guggulaṃ tu dahet sudhīḥ |
jyaiṣṭhe māsi śivasyāgre pūjānte bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||
triḥsaptakulasaṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate |
tadante pṛthivīṃ bhuṅkte na ca khaṇḍāṃ sasāgarām ||
balimaṇḍalakaṃ kāryaṃ āṣāḍhe śūlapāṇinaḥ |
nānābhakṣyair virarcitaṃ (?) nānābhakṣasamanvitam ||
nānācitrasamākīrṇaṃ kartavyaṃ balimaṇḍalam |
saṃpūjya parameśānaṃ tatas tasya nivedayet ||
pitṝn pitāmahāṃś caiva uddhṛtya prapitāmahān |
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||
divyavarṣasahasrāṇi tadante pṛthivīpatiḥ |
śrāvaṇe māsi devasya vimānaṃ puṣpasaṃbhavam ||
pūjāvasāne dātavyaṃ vicitraracanākulam |
varṣāyutapramāṇaṃ tu rudraloke mahīyate ||
yogīśo jāyate śānto yena mokṣaṃ vrajet tu saḥ |
māsi bhādrapade yas tu rudrapūjāṃ caret tadā ||
guggulaṃ prathamaṃ dhūpaṃ suradāru tato dahet |
bilvayojam (?) ghṛtaṃ tadvat tathā nānāghṛtānvitam ||
pañcamaṃ hy aguruṃ deyaṃ dhūpaṃ sarvātmanā vibhoḥ ||
māsam ekaṃ dahed yas tu nairantaryeṇa bhaktitaḥ |
yāti sāyujyatāṃ śambhoḥ saputraḥ sahabāndhavaḥ ||
yas tv arkapatrapuṭakaṃ pūrayet kṣīrasarpiṣā |
[821]        māsam aśvayujaṃ śambhor nairantaryeṇa bhaktitaḥ ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakto 'smi vaḍānana |
tatkule patitā ye tu ḍimbhāḍimbahatā punaḥ ||
te prayānti mahābhāgā rudraloke yathāsukham ||
varṣāyutāyutaṃ sāgraṃ tadante tu nareśvarāḥ |
jāyante śivabhaktāś ca jñānino vītakalmaṣāḥ ||
śivadīkṣāṃ samāsādya te yānti parmāṃ gatim |
vastrāvṛtam ikṣurasaṃ puṭakaṃ tu śivāgrataḥ |
pūjānte dāpayed yas tu māsi prāpte ca kārttike ||
dehānte rudraloke tu modate saha bāndhavaiḥ |
vratānte caiva saṃpūjya śivabhaktān yathāvidhi ||
haimavastrānnapānaiś ca vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā suta |
iti kālottaroktaṃ śivavratam |
ekabhaktena yā nārī kārttikaṃ tu kṣapen nṛpa |
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃjātā brahmacāriṇī ||
guḍānnamiśraṃ śālyannaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet |
puṣpāṇi karavīrāṇi guggulaṃ sājyam ādarāt ||
saptamyāṃ cātha ṣaṣṭyāṃ vā upavāsaratir bhavet |
pakṣayor ubhayor eva śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ ||
indranīlapratīkāśaṃ vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
nārīyugaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
tathā ca sarvalokeṣu bhogān āsādya yatnataḥ |
[822]        tasmād āgatya loke 'smin yatheṣṭaṃ vindate patim ||
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
sūryapūjāgnihavanaṃ saṃtoṣasteyavarjanam ||
sarvavrateṣv ayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyena sadā sthitaḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi vyomapiṣṭena nirmitam ||
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya bhāskarāya nivedayet |
gairikeyair mahāsthānair apsarogaṇasevitaiḥ ||
māsaikādaśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate |
gairikeyaiḥ mahāsvarṇaiḥ |
kramād āgatya loke 'smin rājānaṃ patim āpnuyāt |
pauṣe tu garuḍaṃ kṛtvā bhānave vinivedayet ||
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya bhāskaraṃ vibudhottamam |
tāmrapātre 'tha kāṃsye vā tat sarvaṃ vinivedayet |
mahāpadmakadānena divyagandhapravāhinā ||
athaikādaśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate |
saṃprāpyaivaṃ kramāl lokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vindate patim ||
māghe rathaṃ cāśvayutaṃ dīpamālyavibhūṣitam |
paiṣṭaṃ bhānusamāyuktaṃ kṛtvāyatanam ānayet ||
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśair gītavādyasamākulaiḥ |
saptaikādaśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate |
punar etya imā lokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vindate patim ||
devārcāṃ phālgune māsi kṛtvā piṣṭamayīṃ raveḥ |
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya khyāpayet bhāskarālaye ||
[823]        vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśair gītavādyasamākulaiḥ |
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
kramād āgatya loke 'smin yatheṣṭaṃ vindate patim |
kṛtvā kṣaṇaṃ tathā caitre gandhamālyopaśobhitam ||
sthāpya pātre yathoktaṃ tu bhāskarāya nivedayet |
śaradindupratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate |
karmakṣayād ihāgatya putrapautrasamanvitā ||
abhīṣṭaṃ patim āsādya tatra bhogān sudurlabhān |
taṇḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā vai meruparvatān ||
nikṣubhārgaṃ samāyuktaṃ sarvadhātuvibhūṣitam ||
nānālaṃkārasaṃpannam nānāmālyavibhūṣitam |
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayed bhāskarālaye ||
mahāvyomavrataṃ hy etat vaiśākhe yaḥ samācaret |
nānāvidhair vimānaiś ca suryaloke mahīyate ||
kramād āgatya loke 'smin krīḍate mānase 'cale |
piṣṭena paṅkajaṃ kṛtvā jyaiṣṭhe māsi savedikam ||
paṅkajaṃ padmam |
pātraiḥ saṃpūjya gandhādyair nānāmālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
kramād āgatya loke 'smin rājānaṃ patim āpnuyāt |
visnāya (?) ca tathā padmam āṣāḍhe paiṣṭam uttamam ||
[824]        sarvabījarasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu śubhalakṣaṇam |
nānākesaragandhāḍhyaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitam ||
bhāskarāya nivedayed iti śeṣaḥ |
haṃsavāhair mahāyānaiḥ sarvabhogānvitair nṛpa |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ vradhnaloke mahīyate ||
vradhnaloke sūryaloke |
kramāl lokam imaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ vindate patim |
nivedayet tu sūryāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam ||
svachandagāmibhir yānair nānāratnavibhūṣitaiḥ |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ||
saṃprāpya vividhān bhogān bahvāścaryasamanvitān |
kramāl lokam imaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ vindate patim ||
kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi vyomaśālimayaṃ nṛpa |
vitānadhvajavastrādyaṃ nānāmālyavibhūṣitam ||
niśākarakaraprasthair mahāyānaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
kramād āgatya loke 'smin rājānaṃ vindate patim |
kṛtvā vāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam |
suvarṇavastragandharvyaṃ sūryasyāgre nivedayet ||
sā vicitrair mahāyānair varabhogasamanvitaiḥ |
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||
asmin lokam anuprāptā rājānaṃ vindate patim |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ strīputrakāmāvāptivratam |
[825]                pulastya uvāca |
āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣānte bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ |
bhogibhoge nijāṃ māyāṃ yoganidrāṃ tu mānayet ||
śaite 'sau caturo mānān yāvad bhavati kārttikī |
viśiṣṭās tu pravartante tadā yajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
tatrāṣāḍhasitānte tu yo naro dinapañcakam |
adhaḥśāyī bahiḥsnāyī māsam abhyaṅgavarjitaḥ ||
samastamandirāvarjo sakṛn naktāśano bhavet |
brahmacārī jitakrodho japahomaparāyaṇaḥ |
hariṃ saṃpūjayen nityaṃ gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā ||
gītavādyais tathā nṛtyair dīpamālābhir eva ca |
sārdhanāṃ jaladhenūnāṃ pradānena tathaiva ca |
tathā kārttikaśuklānte tṛtīye pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
prasvāpe ca prabodhe ca dināni daśa vai dvija |
hiṃsātmakais tu kiṃ tasya yajñaiḥ karyaṃ mahātmanaḥ ||
prasvāpe ca probodhe ca pūjito yena keśavaḥ |
daśāham etat kṛtvā tu vrataṃ viṣṇuparo naraḥ ||
agniṣṭomam avāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet |
agnir mukhaṃ devānām agnidevaṃ ca kṛttikā ||
kārttikaś cāgnidaivatyo māso devamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ |
āśvayujyām atītāyāṃ yāvat syād dvija (?) kārttikī ||
vrataṃ daśāhābhihitaṃ kṛtvā svarge mahīyate |
pauṇḍarīkam avāpnoti kulam uddharati svakam ||
[826]        pratyahaṃ dīpadānena kārttike 'bhimikhī bhavet |
cakṣuṣmān brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhas tathā sarvatra pūjitaḥ ||
etāvantaṃ tathā kālaṃ sūryamāsavivarjakaḥ |
svargalokāt paribhraṣṭo mānuṣe sukham āpnuyāt ||
ārogyarūpasaṃpattyā yuktaś ca subhago bhavet |
prasupte devadeveśe daśarātroditaṃ vratam ||
kṛtvā tu caturo māsān prasupte madhusūdane |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate ||
asidhārāvrataṃ kṛtvā tathā saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ |
sarvayajñān avāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati ||
yena yena tu kāmena khaḍgadhārāvraṃ caret |
taṃ taṃ kāmam avāpyātha viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
tathā samartho bhavati dāne ca varaśāpayoḥ |
ādityatejā bhavati nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
dālbhya uvāca |
asidhārāvratavidhiṃ samācakṣva mahādyute |
etan me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ hi sarvavid ucyate ||
pulastya uvāca |
snātaś cālaṃkṛtaḥ sragvī bhuktavān māsavarjitam |
kṛtadaivatyapūjaś ca strīsahāyaḥ svapen niśi ||
brahmacārī dvijaśreṣṭha khaḍgadhārāvrataṃ caret |
apūrvaṃ cātha pūrvaṃ ca samāliṅgya svapen niśi ||
brahmacārī śataguṇaṃ phalam āpnoty asaṃśayam |
[827]        atīvaduṣkaram idaṃ khaḍgadhārāvrataṃ smṛtam ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ dvādaśavatsarāṇi
trailokyarājyaṃ dhruvam āpnuyāc ca |
bhuktvāciraṃ te dvijamukhyam ante
sāyujyam āyāti janārdanasya ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktam asidhārāvratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
vidyākāmena yat kāryaṃ nareṇa suvipaścitā ||
bahiḥ snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā kṛtaṛgvedapūjanaḥ (?) |
ṛgvedaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ māsadvayam atandritaḥ ||
caitrād ārabhya dharmajño nityaṃ naktāśano bhavet |
tato nṛpavara prāpte jyaiṣṭhasya carame 'hani ||
vāsoyugaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tathā dhenuṃ payasvinīm |
dhṛtapūrṇaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ tu dakṣiṇām ||
āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu yajurvedavrataṃ caret |
aśvinādiṣu māseṣu sāmavedavrataṃ caret ||
tathāpy atharvavrataṃ nāma pauṣādiṣu vidhīyate |
sarveṣu sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ ṛgvedavratakīrtitam ||
vedātmano vāsudevasya pūjāṃ
kṛtvā naro dvādaśavatsarāṇi |
[828]        viṣṇor lokaṃ yāti lokair viśiṣṭaṃ
yasmin prāpte sarvaduḥkhaṃ jahāti ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ vedavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
caitrasyāmalapakṣe tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
vāsudevaṃ tu saṃpūjya brāhmaṇāya vicakṣaṇaḥ |
dakṣiṇārthaṃ tu vai dadyād dravyaṃ yojñopayogivit ||
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ tu saṃpūjya vaiśākhe dharmavatsala |
kṣatriyāya tathā dadyād dravyaṃ sāṃgrāmikaṃ śubham ||
pradyumnaṃ pūjayitvā tu jyeṣṭhe māsi dvijottama |
vaiśyāya dadyād vāṇijye dravyaṃ yad upayujyate ||
kṛtvāniruddhapūjāṃ tu māsy āṣāḍhe yathāvidhi |
karmopakaraṇaṃ dravyaṃ dadyāc chūdrāya gārgava ||
māsaiś caturbhir bhavati pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ dvija |
kṛtvā naras triṣv atha pāraṇāni
lokaṃ samāpnoti purandarasya |
tatroṣya rājan suciraṃ ca kālaṃ
mānuṣyam āsādya bhavet samṛddhaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ varṇavratam |
[829]                mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
nityaṃ caturṣu māseṣu śrāvaṇādyeṣu yādava ||
catuḥsāgaracihnāni pūrṇakumbhāṃs tu pūjayet |
caturātmā harir jñeyaḥ sāgarātmā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
snānaṃ samācaren nityaṃ nadītoyena yāvada |
homaṃ ca pratyahaṃ kuryāt satataṃ tailavarjitam ||
kārttikasyāvasānāhni pūjayitvā dvijottamān |
tailaṃ datvā tu viprāya nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya labhate phalam ||
mānuṣyam āsādya mahīpatiś ca
bhuktvā mahīṃ sāgaramekhalāntām |
tatrāpi dharmasya manoniviṣṭo
bhavaty arogaś ca balena yuktaḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ sāgaravratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
vāsudevasya garuḍas tālaḥ saṅkarṣaṇasya ca ||
pradyumnasya tathā cihnaṃ makaro vyāditānanaḥ |
devāniruddho dharmajña ṛṣyaketuḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
pītaṃ nīlaṃ tathā śvetaṃ raktaṃ ca yadunandana |
[830]        teṣāṃ tu kathitaṃ vāsaḥ patākā tādṛg iṣyate ||
yasya devasya yac cihnaṃ sa cātmanā prakīrtitaḥ |
patākā tādṛśī tasya vasanaṃ tasya tādṛśam |
caitreṣu pratyahaṃ māsi garuḍaṃ pūjayen naraḥ ||
pītena gandhanaivedyamālyavastrādinā dvija |
vaiśākhe ca tathā māsi tālaṃ saṃpūjayet sadā ||
nīlena gandhanaivedyamālyavastrādinā dvija |
jyaiṣṭhe ca pratyahaṃ māsi makaraṃ pūjayet sadā ||
śvetena gandhanaivedyamālyavastrādibhir dvija |
ṛṣyaṃ saṃpūjayed devaṃ māsy āṣāḍhe yathāvidhi |
raktena gandhanaivedyamālyavastrādinā dvija ||
bahiḥ snānaṃ tathā kuryād vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ tathā |
nityaṃ ca kuryād dharmajña tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
pāraṇārthe tathā kuryān naktaṃ tailavivarjitam ||
adhaḥśāyī tathā ca syād brahmacārī sadā bhavet |
vratam etan naraḥ kuryāt samyaṅ māsacatuṣṭayam ||
brāhmaṇān pūjayec chaktyā āṣāḍhe carame 'hani |
vastrāṇy uktāni dharmajña dadyād vipreṣu dakṣiṇām ||
kṛtvaikaṃ pāraṇaṃ rājan svargaloke mahīyate |
dvitīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā śakraloke mahīyate ||
tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmaloke mahīyate |
kṛtvā pāraṇaṣaṭkaṃ tu rudraloke mahīyate ||
[831]        viṣṇulokam avāpnoti kṛtvā dvādaśapāraṇam |
dhvajavrataṃ dvādaśavatsarāṇi
kṛtvā naro bhārgavavaṃśamukhya |
sāyujyam āyāti janārdanasya
devasya viṣṇoḥ parameśvarasya ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ dhvajavratam |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
idam anyat pravakṣyāmi caturmūrtivrataṃ tava |
śaṅkhacakraṃ gadāpadmaṃ caturātmā prakīrtitaḥ ||
vāsudevaḥ smṛtaḥ śaṅkhaḥ cakraḥ saṅkarṣaṇas tathā |
pradyumnaś ca gadāpadmam aniruddho jagadguruḥ ||
śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu bahiḥsnātas tu naktabhāk |
teṣāṃ tu pūjanaṃ kuryāt pratimāsam anukramāt ||
gandhamālyanamaskāradīpadhūpānnasaṃpadā |
tatas tu kārttikasyānte samāpte tu tathā vrate ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayed bhaktyā dadyāc chaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
kāṃsyapātraṃ ca saghṛtaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ tathaiva ca ||
kṛtvā vrataṃ māsacatuṣṭayaṃ ca
prāpnoti lokaṃ tridaśeśvarasya |
mānuṣyam āsādya tathaiva paścāt
vasundhareśo bhavatīha vīraḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ āyudhavratam |
[832]                brahmovāca |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvābhyudayavardhanam |
yat kṛtvā jāyate rājā sārvabhauma ihānagha ||
māse nabhasi saṃprāpte naktāhāro jitendriyaḥ |
prātaḥ snāyī sadādhyāyī agnikāryaparāyaṇaḥ |
devīṃ saṃpūjayed vatsa bilvapuṣpaṃ nāgacampakaiḥ ||
dhūpaṃ tu guggulaṃ dadyān naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam |
kṣīrānnaṃ dadhibhaktaṃ ca atha vā śākayāvakam ||
japaṃ ca kuryān mantrasya sahasram atha vā śatam |
devyās tatra samarpyeta (?) yāvat pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ bhavet ||
pūrṇe vrate tato vatsa kanyācāryadvijastriyaḥ |
bhojayet pūjayec chaktyā hemagocarabhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
abhāvān mantrajapyaṃ ca nityaṃ kāryaṃ nṛpottama |
yaḥ kuryāt śataṃ bhaktyā sāpi tattulyatām iyāt ||
na ca vyādhijarāmṛtyur na bhayaṃ cārisaṃbhabham |
jāyate devi bhaktasya ante ca phalam avyayam ||
atra mantrapadāni bhavanti |
oṃ nandane nandani sarvārthasādhanī namaḥ |
mūlamantraḥ |
oṃ nandane hṛdayāya namaḥ, hṛdayam | nandinī śirase namaḥ, śiraḥ | sarvāyai namaḥ | śikhā | oṃ arthasādhinī namaḥ, kavacam | oṃ namaḥ, hūṃ phaṭ, astram | oṃ netrāya namaḥ | oṃ nandinī upacārahṛdayam |
tṛtīyāyāṃ ca pañcamyāṃ caturthyām aṣṭamīṣu ca |
[833]        navamyāṃ paurṇamāsyām ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśīṣu ca |
ṣaṣṭyāṃ sā caiva vidyeśā pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ ||
nandām uddiśya yo dadyāc chrāvaṇe govṛṣaṃ sitam |
sa labhed iṣṭakāmārthaṃ devīlokaṃ ca śāśvatam ||
nabhasy etāṃ samuddiśya dadyād gāṃ kāñcanaṃ pi vā (?) |
sa vrajed dhūtapāpas tu nandālokaṃ ca nirbhayam ||
āśvine navarātraṃ ca upvāsam ayācitam |
kṛtvā devīṃ prapūjyātha aṣṭamyām apare 'hani ||
hemapuṣpamaṇir vastraṃ nānācitravibhūṣitam |
dānaṃ ca kāñcanaṃ deyaṃ nandāyai svārthasiddhaye ||
vidhūtapāpasaṅghātaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ |
gacchante taṃ tu lokaṃ vai yatra devī surārihā |
vasate kalpakoṭis tu apsarogaṇasevitaḥ ||
nandate 'py āgataś cātra pṛthivyām ekarāḍ bhavet |
kārttike pūjayitvā tu devīṃ jātīgajāhvayaiḥ ||
annadānaṃ dadad vipre kanyāsu strīṣv athāpi vā |
śvetāni caiva vastrāṇi tathā deyāni dakṣiṇā ||
mucyate sarvapāpais tu janmāntarakṛtair api |
ihaiva jāyate yogī paratra padam avyayam ||
mārge tu vidhivat snātvā devīṃ pūjya ca kuṅkumaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūpāś ca deyāḥ kanyāsu ca dvije ||
bhojayed dakṣayed vatsa vastraiḥ kīṭakulodbhavaiḥ |
prāpnuyāt sarvakāmāṃś ca sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
[834]        pauṣe devīṃ samādhāya jalajair abhipūjayet ||
naivedyaṃ śālibhaktaṃ ca kanyāṃ saṃbhojya dakṣayet |
pītavastrais tathā śayyā devyā deyāsiśobhanā ||
anena vidhinā vatsa sākṣād devī prasīdati |
dadāti kāmikān bhogān ante ca svapuraṃ nayet ||
māghe tu pūjayed devīṃ kundajasragbhir ādarāt |
kuṅkumena sadarpeṇa tathā samupalepitam (?) ||
sadarpyeṇa kastūrikāsahitena |
snāpitāṃ vidhivat pūrvaṃ tataḥ kanyās tu pūjayet |
dvijāṃś ca caṇḍikāṃ bhaktyā vidhivad ghṛtapāyasaiḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ tilahomaṃ ca yathāśaktyā pradāpayet ||
vidhūtapāpakalikaḥ sarvabhogasamanvitaḥ |
viśatrur bahuputraś ca jāyate narasattamaḥ ||
dehānte nandinīlokaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam |
prayāti nātra saṃdeho anena vidhinā nṛpa ||
phālgune pūjayed devīṃ kusumaiḥ sahakārakaiḥ |
tathā nivedya bhakṣyāṇi śarkarāmadhunā saha ||
bhojayet kanyakān viprān dakṣiṇāsitavāsasī |
anena jāyate bhogī devīlokaṃ ca gacchati |
saṃprāpte caitramāse tu devī pūjyā damānakaiḥ ||
naivedyaṃ laḍḍukā deyā tathā kanyāś ca bhojayet |
striyaś ca raktavastraiś ca pūjitavyāḥ yathāvidhi ||
[835]        anena sarvakāmān vai prāpnuyād avicāraṇāt |
devīlokaṃ vrajed vatsa yatra bhogā nirantarāḥ ||
vaiśākhe pūjayed devīṃ puṣpair vaikarṇikārajaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ saktavaḥ khaṇḍaṃ kanyām bhojyātha dakṣayet |
śubhāni hemachatrāṇi deyāni dvijasattame ||
devīṃ tu praṇamed vatsa sarvadeveṣv anūttamām |
jyaiṣṭhe tu śaṅkarī pūjyā raktāśokakaraṇṭakaiḥ ||
tathā deyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūraiś ca kanyakāḥ |
bhojanīyās tathā dakṣā gobhūdānādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
jalakumbhās tathā deyāḥ saṃpūrṇā vā sitāmbhasā |
anena vāruṇān bhogān teṣāṃ kṣipraṃ prayacchati ||
āṣāḍhe pūjayed devīṃ padmair nīlotpalair dalaiḥ |
naivedyaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ dadhi bhaktaṃ ca pāyasam |
kanyā dvijā striyo bhojyā dakṣayec ca tathārcanāt ||
nānāhemaṅgarāgādyais tilabhūmyaiḥ samauktikaiḥ |
pūjyā bhagavatī śaktyā sarvakāmaprasiddhaye ||
nandā sunandā kanakā umā durgā kṣamāvatī |
gaurī yogeśvarī śvetā nārāyaṇī sunāśikā ||
ambiketi ca nāmāni śrāvaṇād dvādaśa kramāt |
saṃkīrtayanti utthāya ye narā dhautakalmaṣāḥ ||
bhavanti naraśārdūla pṛthivyāṃ dhanasaṃkulāḥ |
etāni pathi saṃgrāme ripupīḍāsu nityaśaḥ ||
samuttarati durgāṇi carciketi surottama |
[836]        vratānāṃ pravaraṃ kāryam ardhaṃ vā pādam eva vā ||
māsaṃ vāpi pradātavyaṃ śrāvaṇādikrameṇa tu |
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ nandāvratam |
gauramukha uvāca |
devakī nāma rājendra devakasyābhavat sutā |
anapatyā tapas tepe putrārthe kila bhāminī ||
bhāryā sā vasudevasya satyadharmaparāyaṇā |
na ca tuṣyati govinda tapas tām āha bhārgavaḥ ||
bhārgava uvāca |
kim arthaṃ tapyate bhadre tapaḥ paramaduṣkaram |
ko 'rthas tavābhilaṣito vada kutra tavepsitam ||
devy uvāca |
aputrāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha patyur me nāsti santatiḥ |
sāham ārādhya govindaṃ putram icchāmi śobhanam ||
tapas tāvat kariṣyāmi parameṇa samādhinā |
yāvad ārādhito viṣṇur dāsyatparimatambaram ||
bhārgava uvāca |
govindārādhane yatno yadi te kulanandini |
tad idaṃ vratam āsthāya toṣayasva janārdanam ||
[837]        prathame kārttikasyāhni saṃprāpte devaki svayam |
pañcagavyakṛtasnānaḥ pañcagavyakṛtāśanaḥ ||
bāṇapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya vāsudevam ajaṃ vibhum |
datvā ca candanaṃ dhūpaṃ paramānnaṃ nivedayet ||
ghṛtaṃ nivedayed vipre gṛhṇīyāc ca tato vratam |
adyaprabhṛty ahaṃ māsaṃ virataḥ prāṇināṃ vadhāt ||
asatyavacanāt steyān madhumāṃsādibhakṣaṇāt |
svapan vibudhyan gacchaṃś ca smariṣyāmy aham acyutam ||
parāpavādaṃ paiśūnyaṃ parapīḍākaraṃ tathā |
sacchāstradevatāyajñanindām anyasya vā bhuvi ||
na vakṣyāmi jagaty asmin paśyan sarvagataṃ harim |
atyanto vādhiśakto 'pi yasmin voḍhuṃ yaśasvini ||
kurvīta niyamaṃ tasya tyāgo dharmopavṛddhaye |
kṛtvaivaṃ purato viṣṇor nirvṛtiṃ pāpataḥ śubhe |
naivedyaṃ svayam aśnīyān maunī nityam udaṅmukhaḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe tathā māsi jātīpuṣpair janārdanam |
samabhyarcya punar dhūpaṃ candanaṃ ca nivedayet ||
paramānnaṃ ca devāya viprāya ca punar ghṛtam |
datvā tathaiva gṛhṇīyān niyamaḥ yo 'sya rocate ||
tathaiva naktaṃ bhuñjīta naivedyaṃ kulanandini |
sarveṣv eva caturmāsaṃ pañcagavyādikaṃ samam |
puṣpadhūpāpahāreṣu viśeṣo dakṣiṇāsu ca ||
snānaprāśanayoḥ sāmyaṃ tathaiva naktabhojanam |
[838]        arcayet pratimāsaṃ ca yaiḥ puṣpais tāni me śṛṇu ||
ye ca dhūpāḥ pradātavyā naivedyānnaṃ ca yat tathā |
bāṇasya jātikusumaiḥ tathaiva ca mukundajaiḥ ||
kundātimuktakai raktai raktavīraiś ca raktakaiḥ |
śvetaiḥ śubhrair mallikāyās tathā mallikayā tathaḥ ||
dadhipadmābhaketakyāḥ padmaraktotpalena ca |
krameṇābhyarcito viṣṇur dadāti manasi sthitam ||
kārttike mārgaśīrṣe ca dhūpaṃ pauṣe ca candanam |
māghaphālgunacaitreṣu dadyād viṣṇos tathā gurum ||
vaiśākhādiṣu māseṣu triṣu devaki bhaktitaḥ |
karpūraṃ devadevāya guggulaṃ śrāvaṇādiṣu ||
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu paramānnaṃ śubhe triṣu |
kāsāraṃ māghapūrveṣu yavānnaṃ ca tatas triṣu ||
ghṛtaṃ tilān jalaghaṭaṃ hiraṇyam atha vā vratī |
pratimāsaṃ tathā dadyād brāhmaṇāya śubhavrate ||
yathoktaniyamānāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ pratimāsikam |
kurvan jagatpatir viṣṇuḥ prīyatām iti mānavaḥ ||
yoṣid apy amalaprajñā vratam etad yathāvidhi |
karoti māsān sakalān avāpnoti manorathān ||
vratenārādhito viṣṇur anena jagataḥ patiḥ |
dadāty abhimatān kāmān kṣiprakālena bhāmini ||
dhānyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ saubhāgyārogyadaṃ tathā |
vratam etat priyataraṃ vratebhyo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ ||
[839]        vratenānena śuddhātmā padenaikena mādhavaḥ |
sukhadṛśyo na saṃdeho dīpena vāgyataḥ sthitaḥ ||
kāyavāṅmanasā buddhyā karoty etan mahāvratam |
śuddhānām amalo devo dṛśya eva janārdanaḥ ||
tasminn ekāgracittānāṃ prāṇināṃ varavarṇini |
prāpnuvanti prayatnena muktibhājo vibhūtayaḥ ||
yathā kalpataruṃ prāpya yad yad icchati cetasā |
tat tat phalam avāpnoti yathā saṃprāpya taṃ vibhuṃ ||
śubhavratam idaṃ tasmān mahāpātakanāśanam |
ārādhanāya kṛṣṇasya kuru devaki pāvanam ||
tasmiṃś cīrṇe hṛṣīkeśo nūnaṃ yāsyati darśanaṃ |
dṛṣṭe cābhimataṃ yat te tad aśeṣaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ viṣṇudevakīvratam |
nārada uvāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi snānadānavratakriyāḥ |
hemante śiśire caiva yathā pūjyo janārdanaḥ ||
mārgaśīrṣe tathā puṣye māghe caivātha phālgune |
yat phalaṃ prāpyate puṃbhiḥ praṇamya madhughātinam ||
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu vatsa mahāpuṇyaṃ hemantaśiśirāv ubhau |
atra saṃpūjitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svalpenāpi pratuṣyati ||
[840]        mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe pratipatprabhṛti kramāt |
vratacaryāṃ vigṛhṇīyād dhemante śiśirātmikām ||
snātvābhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ praṇipatya naro vratī |
varaṃ yācayed bhaktyā carācaraguruṃ (?) tataḥ ||
bhagavan capalā hy eṣā prāṇināṃ prāṇasaṃsthitiḥ |
dhruvaṃ mṛtyur manuṣyāṇāṃ durvijñeyaṃ kadā bhavet ||
atas tvāṃ prārthayāmy eva varam etad adhokṣaja |
yathā khaṇḍaṃ vrataṃ na syāt prasanne tvayi me vibho ||
vratam etan mayā deva gṛhītaṃ tava śāsanāt |
jīvato 'pi mṛtasyāpi paripūrṇaṃ bhavatv iti ||
evam abhyarcya lokeśaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim |
tato nu buddhimān kuryāt vratacaryāṃ ca śaiśirīm ||
mārgaśīrṣasya kṛṣṇādau pratipatprabhṛtiṃ naraḥ |
ahiṃsakaḥ kriyāyuktaḥ prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhavet ||
arcayed devadeveśaṃ madhyāhne keśavaṃ sadā |
vilipya kuṅkumośīraṃ candanenātha śaktitaḥ ||
pūjayen mālatīpuṣpair ghṛṅgabilvādikena ca |
dīpaṃ sadojjvalaṃ dadyāt saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dahet ||
śālyodanaṃ dadhiyutaṃ naivedyaṃ saṃnivedayet |
praṇamec ca tathā bhaktyā śirasā keśavaṃ muhuḥ ||
anena vidhinā caiva saṃpūjya guruḍadhvajam |
oṃ namaḥ kesavāyeti japed aṣṭottaraṃ śatam ||
evaṃ pūjya surādhyakṣaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tato naraḥ |
[841]        akāṃsyapātre bhuñjīta datvā bhikṣāṃ dvijāya ca ||
varjayen madhumāṃsāni sadādhvānaṃ kubhojanam |
anṛtasteyapāruṣyaṃ saṃparkaṃ patitaiḥ saha ||
gavāhnikaṃ sadā dadyāt kṣitiśāyī bhaven niśi |
sadābhivanded aśvatthaṃ guruṃ jñānapradaṃ tathā ||
evaṃ puṣye tathā māghe phālgune ca naro vratī |
vrataṃ samāpayec chaktyā na ca karṣet kathaṃcana ||
hemantāṃś caturo māsān vratenānena nartayet |
viśeṣo 'tra vidhis tatra dvādaśī ca pṛthak śṛṇu ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
pūjayej jagatām īśaṃ keśavaṃ kalmaṣāpaham ||
dvādaśyāṃ snāpayed devaṃ kṣīreṇa puruṣottamam |
rasena sarpiṣa caiva pañcagavyena ca kramāt ||
dvādaśyāṃ snāpayed devaṃ puṣye māghe ca phālgune |
naivedyaṃ puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ pūjayec ca tato harim ||
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ keśavaṃ keśipātana |
bhaktyā kṛtāñjalir bhūtvā yāayet pravaraṃ varam ||
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ ca keśava |
yat pūjitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ tad astame ||
evam abhyarcya deveśaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ |
tato 'nubhojayed viprān bhaktyā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
anenaiva vidhānena puṣye māghe ca phālgune |
sanāmnā praṇamed īśaṃ prārthayet pūjya vai harim ||
[842]        bhojayec ca dvijān bhūyas tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām |
vrīhivastratilān sārghyair (?) dadyān māsakrameṇa tu ||
dvādaśyām devam uddiśya dvijāgrebhyaś ca bhaktitaḥ |
samāpyaivaṃ vraṃ bhaktyā nāmnā tvanarakan (?) naraḥ ||
na gacchen narakaṃ yāti yatrāste garuḍadhvajaḥ |
vratam etan mahāpuṇyaṃ vratebhyo 'bhyadhikaṃ mune |\
duṣkaraṃ calacittānāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam |
surāpo brahmahā steyī gurugāmī sadānṛtī ||
kṛtvā naro vraṃ bhaktyā sadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate |
maharṣibhiḥ sadā cīrṇaṃ bhṛgatribhujagotamaiḥ (?) ||
jñānārthibhir mahābhāgair vratam etat prapūjitam |
svargaṃ te hy akṣayaṃ prāptaḥ saṃpūjya garudadhvajam ||
vratenānena deveśo dakṣādyair ṛṣibhis tataḥ |
bhārgaveṇāvaniṃ prāpya akrūreṇa yayātinā ||
paritoṣya suraśreṣṭaṃ vratenānena keśavam |
sadā namaṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ muktilakṣaṇam ||
anenārcya vidhiṃ bhaktyā saṃprāpte sanakādibhiḥ |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ nāmnā tv anarakaṃ vratam |
kṛtvā śrutvā tathā dhyātvā na gacchen narakaṃ naraḥ ||
iti viṣṇurahasyoktam anarakavratam |
caitrādicaturo māsān ūle (?) kuryād ayācitam |
[843]        vratānte maṇikaṃ dadyān navavastrasamanvitam ||
tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca brahmaloke mahīyate |
kalpānte bhūpatir nālam ānandavratam ucyate ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktam ānandavratam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathāṣāḍhyāṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ |
upavītaṃ śive dadyāc chivabhaktāṃś ca bhojayet ||
punar eva ca kārttikyāṃ pūjya śaṃbhuṃ kṣamāpayet |
yatīnāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā sūtravastrādipūrvikām ||
yaḥ kuryāt sakṛd apy evaṃ cāturmāsyāṃ pavitrakam |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
puṇyakṣayāt paribhraṣṭaḥ caturvedaḥ prajāyate |
icchayā tu bhaved rājā gururūpasamanvitaḥ ||
iti śivadharmoktaṃ śivopavītavratam |
pratimāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śivavratam anuttamam |
dharmakāmārthamokṣārthaṃ naranāryādidehinām ||
puṣye māse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
satyavādī jitakrodhaḥ śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ ||
pakṣayor aṣṭamīṃ yatnād upavāsena vartayet |
trisaṃdhyam arcayed īśam agnikāryaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ||
[844]        bhūmiśayyāṃ ca māsānte paurṇamāsyāṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ |
kṛtvā snānaṃ mahāpūjāṃ śive yatnāt prakalpayet ||
naivedyaṃ yāvakaprasthaṃ kṣīrasiddhaṃ nivedayet |
bhojayitvā dvijān aṣṭau śivabhaktān sadakṣiṇān |
śive gomithunaṃ caiva kapilaṃ ca nivedayet ||
alaṃkṛtya surūpaṃ ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||
rudrakanyāsamākīrṇair mahāvṛṣabhasaṃyutaiḥ |
sagītanṛtyavādyaiś ca apsarogaṇasevitaiḥ |
cāmarair dhūpamālyaiś ca stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ ||
trinetraḥ śūlapāṇiś ca śvaiścaryasamanvitam |
gacchec chivapuraṃ ramyaṃ yatrāste śaṅkaraḥ svayam ||
yāvat tadromasaṅkhyānaṃ tatpraśastiḥ kuleṣu ca |
tāvad yugasahasrāṇi sukhī śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogān bhuṅkte yathepsitān |
jñānayogaṃ samāsādya sa tatraiva vimucyate ||
ity eṣa vaḥ samākhyātaḥ saṃsārārṇavavartinām |
śivamokṣakramopāyaḥ śivāśramaniṣeviṇām ||
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
kṛśarāṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktāṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ ||
sopavāsaś caturdaśyāṃ bhaved ubhayapakṣayoḥ |
śivāya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu pradadyād ghṛtakambalam ||
kṛṣṇaṃ gomithunaṃ cātra surūpaṃ vinivedayet ||
[845]        śeṣaṃ kṛtvā yathoddiṣṭaṃ pūrvoktaṃ tu phalaṃ labhet |
indranīlapratīkāśair vimānaiḥ śikhisaṃyutaiḥ ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ ramyaṃ bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān |
saṃprāpte phālgune māse yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
śyāmākakṣīranīvārair jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ |
caturdaśyām athāṣṭamyām upavāsarato bhavet ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ mahāsnānaṃ pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ |
valmīkāgrādimṛdbhiś ca gomūtragomayādibhiḥ ||
tvagbhiś ca kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ dhātrīgandhādibhis tathā |
dadyād gomithunaṃ bhaktyā tāmrābhaṃ parameṣṭhine ||
śeṣam anyad yathoddiṣṭaṃ prāpnoti sumahat phalam |
padmarāgapratīkāśair vimānair gajasaṃyutaiḥ ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ ramyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam |
caitramāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
piṣṭakaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ ||
dadyād gomithunaṃ cātra pāṭalaṃ samalaṃkṛtam |
śivāyātisurūpaṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret ||
puṣparāgaprabhair yānair divyaiś ca rathasaṃyutaiḥ |
gatvā śivapuraṃ ramyaṃ duṣprāpaṃ tridaśair api ||
vaiśākhe māsi saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
piṣṭakaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ |
goṣṭhaśāyī śivadhyāyī niśāyāṃ vastram ekadhṛk ||
niyamaṃ ca yathoddiṣṭaṃ sāmānyaṃ sarvam ācaret |
[846]        vaiśākhapaurṇamāsyāṃ ca kuryāt snānaṃ ghṛtādibhiḥ ||
śivāyālaṃkṛtaṃ śvetaṃ dadyād gomithunaṃ śubham |
haṃsakundenduvarṇābhair mahāyānair alaṃkṛtaiḥ ||
śvetavṛṣabhasaṃyuktaiḥ prayātīśvaramandiram |
sarvābhiḥ sarvarūpābhiḥ sa strībhiḥ parivāritaḥ ||
nīlotpalasugandhābhiḥ krīḍate kālam akṣayam |
jyaiṣṭhe māse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
śālyannaṃ payasā yuktam ājyakṣīreṇa saṃyutam |
vīrāsano niśārdhaṃ syād divā gām anugacchati ||
anupaviśyāvasthānaṃ vīrāsanam |
hitakārī gavāṃ nityam ahaṃkāravivarjitaḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ kuryāt snānādikaṃ vidhim ||
deyaṃ gomithunaṃ cātra dhūmravarṇam alaṃkṛtam |
nīlotpalasamaprakhyair mahānānair manoramaiḥ ||
mahāsiṃhanibaddhaiś ca krīḍate kālam akṣayam |
āṣāḍhamāse saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam ||
bhūrikhaṇḍāmbusaṃmiśraṃ saktuṃ dadyāt sagorasam |
dadyād gomithunaṃ gauraṃ śivāyālaṃkṛtaṃ śubham ||
sāmānyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ vai prakhya coditam |
iti puṣyamāsoditam |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśair yānaiḥ sārasavāhanaiḥ |
aṇimādiguṇair yuktaḥ śivavad vicaret svayam ||
saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
[847]        kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ||
śvetāmrapādapoṇḍraṃ ca dadyād gomithunaṃ śive |
sāmānyam akhilaṃ kuryād vidhinā yat prakīrtitam ||
savicitrair mahāyānair vicitrāśvaniyojitaiḥ |
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam ||
prāpte bhādrapade māse yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
hutaśeṣaṃ tu bhuñjāno vṛkṣamūlāśrito divā ||
rātrau vāyatane vāsaḥ sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ |
nīlaskandhaṃ vṛṣaṃ gāṃ ca śivāya vinivedayet ||
niśākarakaraprakhyair vajravaidūryaśobhanaiḥ (?) |
cakravākasamāyuktaiḥ vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||
gatvā śivapuraṃ ramyam amarāsuravanditam |
krīḍate sa saha bhogair yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
śrīmān aśvayue māsi yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
ghṛtāśanaṃ prabhuñjānaḥ prasannātmā jitendriyaḥ ||
vṛṣabhaṃ nīlavarṇābham urodeśe samunnatam |
vimucya bhagavatyagre gām ekāṃ samalaṃkṛtām |
vidhiśeṣaṃ hi pūrvoktaṃ tat sarvaṃ samupācaret ||
prāṇānte ca paraṃ sthānaṃ prayāti śivavad vaśī (?) |
svacchamauktikasaṃkāśair indranīlopaśobhitaiḥ ||
jIvaṃ jīvakasaṃyuktair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
prakrīḍate mahābhāgair yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
śubhe ca kārtike māse yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
[848]        kṣīrodanaṃ ca bhuñjīta satyavādī jitendriyaḥ ||
dadyād gomithunaṃ cātra kapilaṃ kajjalaprabham |
pūrvoktavidhivat kṛtvā śivatulyaḥ prajāyate ||
kalpānalaśikhāprakhyair (?) mahāyānair manoramaiḥ |
mahāsiṃhakṛtāṭopaiḥ śivavac ceṣṭate sukhī ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māse yaḥ kuryān naktabhojanam |
yavānnaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ saṃjitendriyaḥ ||
dadyād gomithunaṃ divyaṃ pāṇḍuraṃ samalaṃkṛtam |
śivāya śeṣaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā samupakramet ||
sitapadmanibhair yānaiḥ śvetāśvarathasaṃyutaiḥ |
gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ śivatulyabalo bhavet ||
ahiṃsā satyam asteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṣamā dayā |
trisnānaṃ cāgnihavanaṃ bhūśayyā naktabhojanam ||
pakṣayor upavāsena caturdaśyaṣṭamīṃ kṣipet |
ityevamādiniyamair ācareta śivavratam ||
śivabhaktā tu yā nārī dhruvaṃ sā puruṣaṃ bhavet |
strītvam atyuttamaṃ sā cet kāṅkṣate śṛṇuyād vratam ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ śaivamahāvratam |
kārttike tu śubhe māse ekabhaktena vartayet |
kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyatā vratacāriṇī ||
guḍājyamiśrapiṇyākaṃ māsānte vinivedayet |
[849]        aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyām upavāsarato bhavet ||
indranīlapratīkāśair vimāṇaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
varṣāṇām ayutaṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
yathāvat sarvalokeṣu bhogān āsādya yatnataḥ |
kramād āgatya loke 'smin yatheṣṭaṃ patim āpnuyāt ||
ity evaṃ sarvamāseṣu vidhis tulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
ekabhaktopavāsasya phalaṃ tu sadṛśaṃ viduḥ ||
kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
śivapūjāgnihomaś ca saṃtoṣasnehabhāvanam ||
sarvavrateṣv ayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māse vṛṣapṛṣṭhaṃ sunirmalam |
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya śivāya vinivedayet ||
vṛṣayuktair mahāyānair apsarogaṇasevitaiḥ |
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
puṣye māsi pinākaṃ ca śūle kṛtvā pinākine |
tāmrakāṃsyādipātre vā datvā dadyāt pinākine ||
mahāpuṣpakayānena divyagandhaprabhāvataḥ |
varṣāṇām ayutaṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
rathaṃ cāśvayutaṃ māghe dīpamālāpraśobhitam |
piṣṭaṃ liṅgasamāyuktaṃ kṛtvāyatanam ānayet ||
mahārathopamair yānaiḥ śvetāśvarathasaṃyutaiḥ |
varṣāyutaṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate ||
[850]        phālgune pratimāṃ paiṣṭīṃ kṛtvā carusamanvitām |
gandhamālyair alaṃkṛtya sthāpayed īśvarālayam |
yanair apratimair divyair gāyanādyasamākulaiḥ ||
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate |
caitre bhavakumāraṃ ca kṛtvā puṣpair alaṃkṛtam |
sthāpya pātre yathokte ca ānayec chivamandiram ||
śaradindupratīkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ |
varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
taṇḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena (?) kṛtvā kailāsaparvatam |
īśvaromāsamāyuktaṃ sarvadhātuvibhūṣitam ||
kandarair vividhaṃ citraṃ lavaṇaprasthasaṃyutam |
sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayed īśvarālaye ||
kailāsavratam ity evaṃ vaiśākhyāṃ yaḥ samācaret |
kailāsakalpayānaiḥ sa śivaloke mahīyate ||
liṅgaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā jaiṣṭhamāse savedikam |
bhaktyā saṃpūjya gandhādyair vastrayugmena veṣṭayet |
upaśobhāviśeṣaiś ca tatra jāgaram ācaret ||
prabhāte dhvajaśaṅkhādyaiḥ śivāya vinivedayet |
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate |
gṛhaṃ piṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā āṣāḍhe pitṛbhūmikam ||
sarvabījarasaiś cāpi saṃpūrṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam |
gṛhopakaraṇair yuktaṃ muśalolūkhalādibhiḥ |
[851]        sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ dāsīśayyādyalaṃkṛtam |
etaiḥ piṣṭamayaiḥ sādyaiḥ pradīpādyupaśobhitam ||
