caturvidhena asaṃyuktaṃ caruṇā sarṣapeṇa tu |
āṣāḍhe paurṇamāsyāṃ tu gṛhaṃ sthāpya śivāgrataḥ ||
sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ praṇipatya nivedayet |
śatabhūmair mahāyānair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ ||
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
sudhādhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam |

svacchendranīlasaṃkāśair yānair apratimaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||

vitānadhvajachatrādyaiḥ śivāya vinivedayet ||
divākarakaraprakhyair mahāyānaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ śikhiparvatam |
suvarṇavastrasaṃyuktaṃ śivāya vinivedayet |
suvicitrair mahāyānair varabhogasamanvitaiḥ ||
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate |
sarvadhānya samāyuktaṃ sarvabījarasādibhiḥ ||
sarvadhātusamāyuktaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam |
[852]        śṛṅgaiś caturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vitānachatraśobhitam ||
gandhamālyais tathā dhūpaiḥ pradīpaiś cātiśobhitam |

brahmaghoṣais tathā puṇyair māṅgalyaiś ca viśeṣataḥ |
mahādhvajāṣṭakayutaṃ vicitrakusumojjalam ||
nagendramerunāmānaṃ trailokyādhāram uttamam |
tasya mūrdhni śivaṃ kuryāt sarvadevasamāyutam ||
daityagandharvabhūtāś ca siddhayakṣagaṇās tathā |
vidyādharāpsaronāgā ṛṣayaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
śālipiṣṭamayaṃ liṅgaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ |
deyaṃ ca dakṣiṇe haste śūlaṃ tridaśapūjitam ||
evaṃ sarveṣu deveṣu kuryād astraṃ yathākramam |
śivasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā carusamanvitām ||
pūjayet sarvadevāṃś ca daśadikṣu baliṃ haret |
vratānte bhojayet paścāt śivabhaktān sadakṣiṇān ||
sarvārambhasamāyuktaṃ yathāvibhavakalpitam |
nivedayīta rudrāya kārttike nagam uttamam ||
yaḥ kuryāt sakṛd apy evaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu |
devatulyagaṇo bhūtvā guṇarūpasamanvitaḥ ||
śivavad vicaren nityaṃ niścalaṃ bhuvanaṃ sadā |
sadāgameṣu yat puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ munibhiḥ purā ||
tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnuyān nātra saṃśayaḥ |
mahāratnaprabhair yānaiḥ sarvaratnasamanvitaiḥ ||
[853]        gītanṛtyādivādyaś ca apsarobhiḥ samanvitaiḥ |
sūryakoṭisamaprakhyair vimānair marusaṃbhavaiḥ ||
naranārīsamākīrṇair gandhavāhaiḥ śubhais tathā |
devadānavagandharvaiḥ stūyamānā gaṇādibhiḥ ||
svacchandā sarvagā bhūtvā prayātīśvaramandiram |
kalpakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ modate sā mahātapāḥ ||
evaṃ sarveṣu deveṣu bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān |
puṇyakṣayād ihāgatya rājānaṃ patim āpnuyāt ||
surūpā subhagā nityaṃ bhavatīśvarabhāvitā |
iti śivadharmoktam aparaśaivamahāvratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
caitrārabhya pibaṃs toyaṃ jaladhārāṃ prapātayet |
varṣānte ghṛtasaṃpūrṇāṃ dadyād vardhanikāṃ navām ||
etad dhārāvrataṃ nāma sarvodvegaharaṃ param |
kāntisaubhāgyajananaṃ sapatnīdarpyanāśanam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ dhārāvratam |
devīpurāṇe |
mārge rasottamaṃ dadyād ghṛtaṃ pauṣe mahāphalam |
rasottamaṃ lavaṇam |
[854]        tilān māghe muniśreṣṭha saptadhānyāni phālgune |
vicitrāṇi ca vastrāṇi caitre dadyād dvijātaye ||
vaiśākhe dvija godhūmān jyaiṣṭhe toyabhṛtaṃ ghaṭam |
āṣāḍhe candanaṃ deyaṃ sakarpūraṃ mahāphalam ||
navanītaṃ nabhomāsi kḷtraṃ (?) pauṣthapade matam |
guḍaśarkaravarṇāḍhyān laḍḍukān āśvine mune |
dīpadānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ kārttike yaḥ prayacchati ||
sarvakāmān avāpnoti krameṇa tu udāhṛtam |
vratānte sasrajaṃ vatsa dāpayed vidhinā mune |
devīṃ virañcim ādityaṃ viṣṇuṃ vātha yathāvidhi ||
svabhāvaśuddho vidhivat pūjayitvā dvijottama |
dātavyā vītarāge tu kāmakrodhavivarjite ||
ayācake sadācāre vinīte vinayānvite |
godānāl labhate kāmān golokeṣu manoramān ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ māsavratam |
vasiṣṭha uvāca |
śṛṇu bhūpāla yair viṣṇur vratair ārādhyate naraiḥ |
nārībhiś cāpi ghore 'smin patitābhir bhavārṇave |
samabhyarcya jagannāthaṃ vāsudevaṃ samādhinā ||
ekam aśnāti yo bhaktaṃ dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇārpaṇam |
[855]        karoti keśavaprītyair kārttikaṃ māsam āptavān ||
pūrve vayasi yat tena jānatājānatāpi vā |
pāpam ācaritaṃ tasmān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
anenaiva vidhānena mārgaśīrṣe 'pi mādhavam |
samabhyarcyaikabhaktaṃ (?) vai varṇibhyo yaḥ prayacchati |
bhagavat prīṇanārthāya phalaṃ tasya śṛṇuṣva me ||
madhye vayasi yat pāpaṃ yoṣitā puruṣeṇa vā |
kṛtaṃ tasmāc ca tenokto vimokṣaḥ paramātmanā ||
tathā caivaikabhaktaṃ vai yas tu gobhyaḥ prayacchati |
puṇḍarīkākṣam abhyarcya pauṣamāse mahīyate ||
tat prīṇanāya yat pāpaṃ vārdhike tena vai kṛtam |
sa tasmān mucyate rājan pumān yoṣid athāpi vā |
traimāsikaṃ vratam idaṃ yaḥ karoti nareśvara ||
saviṣṇuprīṇanāt pāpair laghubhiḥ parimucyate |
dvitīye vatsare rājan mucyate copapātakaiḥ ||
tadvat tṛtīye 'pi kṛtaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam |
vratam etan naraiḥ strībhis tribhir māsair anuṣṭhitam ||
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiś caiva pradadāti phalaṃ nṛṇām |
tribhir māsais trayo 'vasthās trividhāt pātakān nṛpa ||
trīṇi nāmāni devasya mocayanti trivārṣikaiḥ ||
yatas tato vratam idaṃ trivikramam udāhṛtam |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ keśavārādhanaṃ param ||
iti viṣṇudharmoktaṃ trivikramavratam |
[856]                sumantur uvāca |
samabhyarcya jagannāthaṃ devam arkam athāpi vā |
ekam aśnāti yo bhaktaṃ dvitīyaṃ brāhmaṇārpaṇam ||
karoti bhāskaraprītyai kārttikamāsam āptavān |
pūrve vayasi yatnena jānatājānatāpi vā ||
pāpam ācaritaṃ tasmān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
anenaiva vidhānena mārgaśīrṣe vibhākara ||
samabhyarcya ekabhaktaṃ viprebhyo yaḥ prayacchati |
bhagavatprīṇanārthāya phalaṃ tasya śṛṇuṣva me ||
madhye vayasi yat pāpaṃ yoṣitā puruṣeṇa ca |
kṛtaṃ tasmāc ca tenokto vimokṣaḥ paramātmanā ||
tathā caivaikabhaktaṃ ca yaś ca viprāya yacchati |
divākaraṃ samabhyarcya pauṣe māsi mahīpate ||
tadvat tṛtīye 'pi kṛtaṃ mahāpātakanāśana |
vratam etan naraiḥ strībhis tribhir māsair anuṣṭhitam ||
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiś caiva pradadāti phalaṃ nṛṇām |
tribhir māsais tryavasthās tu trividhāt pātakān nṛpa ||
trīṇi nāmāni devasya mocayanti trivārṣikān |
yatas tato vratam idaṃ trivikramam udāhṛtam |
sarvabhūtapraśamanaṃ bhāskarārādhanaṃ param ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ sauratrivikramavratam |
[857]        caitrādicaturo māsān jale kuryād ayācitam |
jyaiṣṭhāṣāḍhe tathā māghe pauṣe vā rājasattama ||

tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca brahmaloke mahīyate |
tadante rājarājaḥ syād vārivratam ihocyate ||
iti padmapurāṇe vārivratam |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe māsavratāni |
[858]
athonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha ṛtuvratāni
upakriyāyai suhṛdām idānīṃ
hemādrisūriḥ prakaṭīkaroti |
ṛtuvrataśreṇim akalpasampat-
saṃpādayitrīṃ duritāpahantrīm ||
markaṇḍeya uvāca |
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ṣaṇmūrter arcanaṃ param |
vasantaṃ pūjayen nityaṃ dvau māsau munipuṃgava ||
phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kaṣāyais tu grīṣme grīṣmaṃ ca pūjayet |
madhureṇa mahārāja prāvṛṭkāle ṛtuṃ caret ||
anena pūjayen nityaṃ śaradaṃ lavaṇena ca |
kaṭvaslena ca hemantaṃ tiktena śiśiraṃ tathā ||
naktāśanas tathā tiṣṭhet pañcakaṃ varjayed rasam |
brāhmaṇān bhojayec cāpi prabhūtavasanādibhiḥ ||
saṃvatsaram idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ paramapāvanam |
aśvamedham avāpnoti rājasūyaṃ ca vindati ||
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
phalaṃ akṣayam āpnoti vratasyāsya karottama ||
[859]        caitre samārabhya site tu ṣaṣṭīṃ
saṃpūjayed yas tv ṛtuṣaṭkam ekam |
kṛtopavāsaḥ sa naro yathoktaṃ
labhet phalaṃ śāśvatam eva śīghram ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ ṣaṇmūrtivratam |
kṛtvaikabhaktaṃ hemante māghamāse tu yantritaḥ |
māghānte ca rathaṃ kurāc citravastropaśobhitam ||
śvetaiś caturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vṛṣabhaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam |
śobhitaṃ dhvajamālābhiś citracāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ||

bhrāmayitvā tataḥ paścāc chivāyatanam ānayet ||
tatra jāgarapūjābhiḥ pradīpādyupaśobhitaiḥ |

varṣasyānte tu sauvarṇaṃ phalapatraṃ tu rājatam |
muktāphalamayaṃ cūrṇaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ vā prayacchati ||
na sā prāpnoti daurbhāgyaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ sukhasya vā |
etat patravrataṃ nāma gaurīlokapradāyakam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ patravratam |
[865]        pañcāmṛtena snāpanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya vā |
vatsarānte punar dadyād dhenuṃ pañcāmṛtair yutam ||
viprāya kanakaṃ śaṅkhaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca pāṇḍaram |
svargalokapradaṃ divyaṃ dhṛtivratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇoktaṃ dhṛtivratam |
pulastya uvāca |
varjayitvā pumān māṃsam abdānte goprado bhavet |
tadvad dhemamṛgaṃ datvā so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
ahiṃsāvratam ity uktaṃ kalpānte bhūpatir bhavet ||
iti padmapurāṇoktam ahiṃsāvratam |
sukhavāsaṃ parityajya samānte goprado bhavet |
yakṣādhipatyam āpnoti mukhavratam ihocyate ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ mukhavratam |
yaś ca nīlotpalaṃ haimaṃ śarkarāpātrasaṃyutam |
ekāntaritanaktāśī samānte vṛṣasaṃyutam |
dadyād iti śeṣaḥ |
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti nīlavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ nīlavratam |
[866]        vatsaraṃ tv ekabhaktāśī sabhakṣyaphalakumbhadaḥ |
śivaloke vaset kalpaṃ prāptivratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ prāptivratam |
saṃdhyādīpaprado yas tu samāṃ tailaṃ ca varjayet |
samāṇte dīpakān dadyāc cakraṃ śūlaṃ ca kāñcanam ||
vastrayugmaṃ ca viprāya sa tejasvī bhaved iha |
rudralokam avāpnoti dīptivratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ dīptivratam |
ākāśāśī samāṃ dadyād dhenum ante payasvinīm |
śakralokam avāpnoti śaktravratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ śakravratam |
yas tv ekabhaktena samāṃ kṣiped dhenuṃ vṛṣānvitām |
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyāt sa padaṃ yāti śāṅkaram |
etad rudravrataṃ nāma pāpaśokavināśanam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ rudravratam |
dve sahastre palānāṃ tu māhiṣākhyaṃ tu yo dahet |
devi saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ sa me nandisamo bhavet |
[867]        palaṃ nava samārabhya payaḥ pratidinaṃ dahet ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ śambhuvratam |
dakṣiṇāyāṃ ca yo mūrtau pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca vai |
nivedayed varṣam ekaṃ so 'pi nandisamo bhavet ||
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇaṃ sopavāso 'tha jāgaram |
kṛtvābhyarcya maheśānaṃ mahāsnānādibhir vṛtam ||
dadyād viprāya prthivīṃ śayyāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm |
nandinā caritaṃ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ pātakanāśanam |
kṛtaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ bhaktyā tāvad eva niveditam ||
iti skandapurāṇoktaṃ maheśvaravratam |
saṃvatsaraṃ tu yo bhuṅkte nityam eva hy atandritaḥ |
nivedya pitṛdevebhyaḥ pṛthivyām ekarāḍ bhavet ||
bhuṅkte pṛthivyām ity anvayaḥ |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ bhūbhājanavratam (?) |
śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite iti caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe saṃvatsaravratāni |
[868]
atha ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha prakīrṇavratāni |
hemādrir unnidramurāribhaktir
adhītavedākhiladharmavedaḥ |
aśeṣalokoddharaṇāvatīrṇaḥ
prakīrṇakaṃ varṇayati krameṇa ||
śvetadvīpe sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum |
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sthitisaṃhārakārakam ||
praṇipatya mahādevaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim |
śarīrārogyam aiśvaryaṃ kāmadevasamaḥ patiḥ ||
sukhāvabodhane nityam aviyogaś ca tena vai |
taddānaṃ vā vrataṃ vāpi pūjām ārādhanādikam ||
lakṣmīḥ provāca śanakair bhartāram asitekṣaṇā |
bhagavan devadeveśa lokānām anukampayā |
praṣṭuṃ tvāṃ kiṃcid icchāmi dayāṃ kuru mamopari ||
vrataṃ kathaya me kiṃcid rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam |
kṛtena yena deveśa sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet ||
yena putrāś ca pautrāś ca gṛhaṃ sarvasaṃṛddhidam |
śarīrārogyam aiśvaryaṃ kāmadevasamaḥ patiḥ ||
sukhāvalokane nityam aviyogaś ca tena vai |
[869]        taddānaṃ vā vrataṃ vāpi tīrthamāhātmyam eva ca ||
yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa sarvasiddhir bhaved dhruvam |
kathayasva suraśreṣṭha guhyād guhyataraṃ mama ||
viṣṇur uvāca |
kathayāmi na saṃdeho vratānām uttamaṃ vratam |
pradyumnāyāpi nākhyātaṃ putraprītyā vrataṃ tv idam ||
tejasvināṃ yathādityaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā |
yatha nadīnāṃ gaṅgā ca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā |
tathā vratam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathyate tava bhāmini ||
na gaṅgā na kurukṣetraṃ na kāśī na ca puṣkaram |
pāvanāni mahābhāge yathedaṃ vratam uttamam ||
gauryā devyā kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
rāmeṇa sītayā sārdhaṃ damayantyā narena ca |
kṛṣṇena pāṇḍavaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ vratam uttamam ||
rambhayā menayā cāpi paulomyā satyabhāmayā |
śāṇḍilyayāpy arundhatyā ūrvaśyā devadattayā ||
gāyatryā caiva sāvitryā vrataṃ śreṣṭham anuttamam |
anyābhiś caiva nārībhir devi vratam idaṃ kṛtam ||
tasmāt te 'haṃ kariṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
viṣṇuprītikaraṃ ramyaṃ vratānāṃ pravaraṃ śṛṇu ||
brahmahā mucyate pāpāt surāpo rukprahārakaḥ |
gurubhāryābhigāmī ca eteṣāṃ saṃgamī ca yaḥ ||
mānakūṭas tulākūṭaḥ kanyānṛgavavikrayī |
[870]        agamyāgamano yas tu māṃsāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ ||
bhūmihartā kūṭasākṣī kanyādūṣayitā ca yaḥ |
ebhiḥ sarvair mahāpāpair mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ vratam uttamam ||
kāñcanākhyā putrī nāma vrataṃ tailakyapāvanam |
śuklatṛtīyā kṛṣṇā ca ekādaśy atha pūrṇimā ||
saṃkrāntir vā mahābhāge kuhur vā cāṣṭamī tithiḥ |
parvasv eteṣu dātavyā kāñcanākhyā purī śubhā ||
vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale |
mṛttikālambhanaṃ kāryaṃ vidhinānena tat priye ||
uddhṛtāsi dhare pūrvaṃ viṣṇunā krīḍarūpiṇā |
lokānām upakārāya vanditā siddhikāmadā |
tasmāt tvaṃ vanditā pāpaṃ hara me 'nekajanmajam ||
mṛttikālambhanamantraḥ |
āpo yūyaṃ sarvayonir viṣṇunā nirmitāḥ svayam |
sāṃnidhyaṃ tīrthasahitāḥ kurudhvaṃ sāṃprathaṃ mama ||
udakābhimantraṇam |
anena vidhinā snātvā gṛham āgatya sadvratī |
nālapet piśunān caṇḍān pāpinaḥ pāpasaṅginaḥ ||
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān devabrāhmaṇanindakān |
prakṣālya pāṇipādaṃ ca kuryād vai dantadhāvanam ||
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryān naktasya vā punaḥ |
śaṅkhapravaram ādāya hemayuktaṃ tato jalam ||
[871]        namo bhagavate vāsudevāyety abhimantrya ca |
vande toyaṃ śucir bhūtvā harir ity akṣaraṃ japan ||
śamīvṛkṣamayī vedī catuḥstambhaiḥ samanvitā |
caturhastapramāṇā tu kāryā caiva suśobhanā ||
vastreṇāveṣṭitāḥ stambhā vitānavaramaṇḍitāḥ |
puṣpamālānvitāḥ karyā divyarūpādhivāsitāḥ ||
madhye tu maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmākhyaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
maṇḍalasya tu madhye tu bhadrapīṭhaṃ suśobhanam ||
āsanaṃ tatra vinyasya kamalaṃ tatra vinyaset |
tasyopari nyased devaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ janārdanam ||
agre tu sthāpayet kumbhaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ suśobhanam |
kṣīrasāgaranāmāsya kalpitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ |
sāmānyaikapalāḥ kāryā ātmavittānusārataḥ ||
catvāripalāny asyām iti vīpsāyāṃ bahuvrīhiḥ saptavarṇavat | vīpsāyāṃ ca gṛhāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca patataḥ ṣoḍaśamadhya ekam iti saptadaśa tāvad brāhmaṇavidhānāt | madhyagṛhaṃ cāṣṭamācāryagṛhatvāt | tatprakāras tadvat | bahiḥprakāro bahirgṛhavat | evaṃ catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatapalaṃ hema | tāvac ca rūpyam |
[872]        stambhā ratnamayāḥ kāryā daśaurasasamanvitāḥ |
prākāraṃ kārayed dhaimaṃ raupyaṃ paiṣṭam athāpi vā ||
paiṣṭaṃ sīsam |
modakān sthāpayed vidvān prāsādaśikhareṣu ca |
samantād veṣṭayet tāṃ tu purīṃ vastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ||
tadagre kadalīstambhais toraṇaṃ parikalpayet |
puṣpaśobhānukartavyā vibhāvād vistareṇa ca ||
catuścaraṇikair vipraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpyā purī śubhā |
tasyā madhye nyased viṣṇuṃ haimalakṣmyā samanvitam ||
netre ratnamaye kārye daśanāś ca subhūṣitāḥ |
muktāphalamayaṃ tatra bhūṣaṇaṃ parikalpayet ||
aṅgaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kāryaṃ śaṅkhacaktragadāyutam |
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ||
brāhmaṇo vaidikair mantraiḥ purāṇoktais tathottaraiḥ |
vāsudevāya pādau tu gulphau saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ||
trailokyajananāyeti jānunī pūjayed dhareḥ |
jānu trailokyanāthāya guhyaṃ jñānamayāya ca ||
kaṭiṃ dāmodarāyeti udaraṃ viṣṇurūpiṇe |
padmanābhāya nābhiṃ tu uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe ||
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanābhāya āsyaṃ yajñamukhāya ca |
daityāntakāriṇe bāhū svanāmne cāyudhāni ca ||
śikhāṃ caiśāṇamantreṇa devadevasya pūjayet |
[873]        śriyaṃ svamantraiḥ saṃpūjya lokapālāṃs tato 'rcayet ||
navagrahāś ca pūjyā vai homaṃ teṣāṃ tu kārayet |
durgāgaṇapatī pūjyau tayor homaṃ prakalpayet ||
agne naivedyam atulaṃ dāpayed ghṛtapācitam |
pāyasaṃ ghṛtapūrāṃś ca modakān pūpakāṃs tathā ||
deśakālodbhavāny atra phalādīni prakalpayet |
dīpān daśadiśaṃ dadyāt pārśvataḥ puṣpacarcitān ||
ghṛtena tu viśālākṣi mūlamantreṇa dāpayet |
kumbhāḥ ṣoḍaśa kartavyāḥ śvetavastrair vibhūṣitāḥ ||
miṣṭānnena samāyuktāḥ sahiraṇyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
pakvānnani tu hṛdyāni ṣoḍaśaiva pradāpayet ||
phalāni tatra deyāni nānārūpāṇi sundari |
dīpāṃs tāmramayāṃś caiva teṣu kumbheṣu vinyaset ||
brāhmaṇān bhūṣayet tais tair alaṃkārair yathāvidhi |
sapatnīkān prayatnena japaṃ kuryāt tu ṣoḍaśa ||
sahasraśīrṣa ityādi kañcikābhis tu mantrayet |
viṣṇuṃ matvā brāhmaṇaṃ tu lakṣmīrūpā striyo 'rcayet ||
chatraṃ copānahau caiva vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca |
phalāni saptadhānyaṃ ca bhojanaṃ ca yathepsitam |
dātavyaṃ tu sabhāryāṇāṃ viṣṇur me prīyatām iti ||
tatra ācārya utthāya pravṛtte gītamaṅgale |
dhṛtvā bāhū yajamānaṃ devasamīpam ānayet ||
śvetavastreṇa netre tu yajamānasya śreyase |
[874]        ācāryaḥ sarvavit prājño bandhayet sadasyena ca ||
ābaddhanetre suprājña ācāryas tu idaṃ vadet |
sarvakāmapradāṃ paśya kāñcanākhyāṃ purīm imām ||
varavastrayutāṃ ramyāṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśanīm |
evam uktvā mahābhāge vastram utsarjayet tataḥ ||
puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ kṣiptvā sa paśyen nagarīṃ śubhām |
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nagarīṃ devi yajamānaḥ purohitaḥ ||
sauvarṇapātram ādāya raupyaṃ tāmram athāpi vā |
atha vā śaṅkham ādāya pātrālābhe tu sundari ||
pañcaratnaṃ kṣipet tatra jalagandhāṃs tathā phalam |
siddhārthaṃ cākṣataṃ dūrvāṃ rocanāṃ ca dadhi priye ||
tatas tv arghyaḥ pradātavyo mantreṇānena suvrate |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau devau bhaktipūtena cetasā ||
jānubhyām dharaṇīṃ gatvā mantram enam udīrayet |
svarṇasya nirmitā devī viṣṇunā śaṅkareṇa ca ||
pārvatyā caiva gāyatryā skandavaiśravaṇena ca |
yamena pūjitā devī dharmasya vijigīṣayā ||
saubhāgyaṃ dehi putrāṃś ca dhanaṃ rūpaṃ ca pūjitā |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ devi saukhyaṃ prayaccha me |
evam arghyaṃ tadā datvā dīpān prajvālayet (?) tataḥ ||
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta gītanṛtyādinā tathā |
viṣṇor jāgaraṇe puṇye śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
prabhāte vimale jāte kṛtvā nityādipūjanam |
[875]        ācāryaṃ pūjayet tadvad vastrair ābharaṇais tathā ||
sapatnīkaṃ saputraṃ ca yatnāt saṃbhojya pūjayet |
śayyā sopaskarā tasmai vastracandanasaṃyutā ||
pradeyā gurave tatra sarvopaskarasaṃyutā |
tāṃ purīṃ kāñcanīṃ dadyān mantreṇānena suvratī ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau devau sarvakāmaphalapradau |
rukmapuryāḥ pradānena yacchatāṃ mama vāñchitam ||
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa jñānajñeya nirañjana |
rukmapuryāḥ pradānena yaccha me bhuktidaṃ param ||
datvā tv anena mantreṇa gaur deyā gurave tataḥ |
tebhyas tu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt saṃtuṣṭyā yad bhavanti te ||
evaṃ kṣamāpayitvā tān praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
anāthān badhirān paṅgūn andhāṃś caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
gavāhnikaṃ ca dātavyaṃ gobhyaḥ sakṛt prayatnataḥ |
evam uccārayet tatra viṣṇur me prīyatām iti ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tu tat sarvaṃ pāraṇaṃ tatra kārayet |
iṣṭair mantraiḥ kuṭambaiś ca putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte tu yat puṇyam aśakyaṃ kathituṃ mayā |
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca ||
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya vratī modati brahmavat |
brahmalokād rudralokam indralokam ataḥ param ||
kṣīnalokas tato devi madīyaṃ lokam āpnuyāt |
tatra bhuktvā tu vistīrṇān bhogāṃs trailokyasundari ||
[876]        maddehe līyate caiva pumān amṛtatāṃ vrajet |
sārvabhaumas tu rājā vai jāyate vipule kule ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ vācyamānaṃ vrataṃ tv idam |
sahasrakulam uddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
tvayā kāñcanapuryākhyaṃ vratam etat kṛtaṃ purā |
vrataprasādād bhartāhaṃ labdhas trailokyapūjitaḥ ||
iti gāruḍapurāṇoktaṃ kāñcanapurīvratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
saṃpūrṇatāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vratānāṃ ca janārdana |
kuru pradādaṃ guhyārtham etan me vaktum arhasi ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
sādhu sādhu mahābāho kururāja yudhiṣṭhira |
rahasyānāṃ rahasy ante kathayāmi vratottamam ||
saṃpūrṇaṃ nāma tac cāpi vrataṃ samyak phalapradam |
yac cīrṇaṃ naranārībhir yāvat saṃpūrṇakālakam ||
avaśyaṃ tac ca kartavyaṃ saṃpūrṇaphalakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
kiṃcid bhagnaṃ pramādena yad vrataṃ vratināṃ bhavet ||
tat saṃpūrṇaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ vratenānena pāṇḍava |
upadravair bahuvidhair mahāmohāc ca pārthiva ||
yad bhagnam kiṃcid eva syāt vrataṃ vighnavināyakaiḥ |
tat saṃpūrṇaṃ bhavet sarvaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
kāñcanaṃ raupyakaṃ rūpaṃ śilpinā tu ghaṭāpayet |
[877]        bhagnavratasya yo devas tat svarūpaṃ sunirmitam ||
rūpaṃ strīpuṃsayor vāpi prārabdhaṃ tad vrataṃ kila |
na ca niṣpāditaṃ kiṃcid daivāt sarvaṃ tathā sthitam ||
dvibhujaṃ paṅkajārūḍhaṃ saumyaṃ prahasitānanam |
dvibhujādīni strīpuṃsayo rūpasya viśeṣaṇam |
tac ca rūpam ajñāteṣu vrateṣu, janmāntarakṛtānāṃ vismṛtānāṃ ca jñātavyaṃ teṣv apīdaṃ prāyaścittam iti |
niṣpāditaṃ śilpinā ca tasminn eva dine punaḥ |
tasmān māse punaḥ prāpte brāhmaṇo vidhinā gṛhe ||
snāpayet payasā dadhnā ghṛtakṣīrarasāmbubhiḥ |
gandhacandanapuṣpaiś tu pūjayet kusumādinā ||
toyapūrṇasya kumbhasya mukhe vinyasya candanaiḥ |
dhūpadīpākṣatair vastrair astrair balyupahārakaiḥ ||
arghyaṃ dadyāc ca tannāmnā mantreṇānena pāṇḍava |
upavāsena hīnasya prāyaścittaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
śaraṇaṃ ca prapannasya kuruṣvātha dayāṃ punaḥ |
paratra bhayabhītasya bhagnavarjyavratasya ca ||
kuru prasādaṃ saṃpūrṇam vrataṃ saṃpūrṇam astu me |
tapaśchidraṃ vratachidraṃ yac chidraṃ bhagnake vrate |
tava prasādāt tad deva sarvam achidram astu me ||
svāhā amukadevāya namaḥ |
pūrvato dakṣiṇata uttarato vidhiṃ kuryāt |
uparyadhastāddikpālebhyo namaḥ |
[878]        idam arthyam idaṃ pādyaṃ naivedyaṃ te namo namaḥ |
evaṃ proktvā tataḥ pādau jānunī kaṭiśīrṣake ||
vakṣaḥkukṣī ca hṛdayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ vāsyaśiroruhān |
tato dvijāya kaunteya vidhivat pratipādayet ||
pūjayet tasya devasya tataḥ paścāt kṣamāpayet |
pūjitas tvaṃ yathāśaktyā namas te 'stu surottama ||
aihimāmuṣyikīṃ nātha kāryasiddhiṃ diśasva me |
evaṃ kṣamāpayitvā tāṃ devamūrtīṃ vidhānataḥ ||
sthitvā pūrvamukho vipro gṛhṇīyād darbhapāṇinā |
viprasya haste yacchet tu dātā caivottarāmukhaḥ ||
brāhmaṇo 'pi prayacheta mantreṇānena tad vratam |
vākyaṃ pūrṇaṃ manaḥ pūrṇaṃ kāyā pūrṇā vratena tu |
saṃpūrṇasya prasādena tava pūrṇo manorathaḥ ||
brāhmaṇā yāni bhāṣante anumodanti devatāḥ |
sarvadevamayā viprā na tad vacanam anyathā ||
jalasya kṣīratāṃ nītaḥ pāvakaḥ sarvabhakṣatām |
sahasranetraḥ śakro 'pi kṛto viprair mahātmabhiḥ ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vacanād brahmahatyā praṇaśyati |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ sāgraṃ prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
vyāsavālmīkiracanāt parāśaravasiṣṭhayoḥ |
gargagautamadhaumyātrivasiṣṭhāṅgirasāṃ tathā |
vacanān nāradādīnāṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavatu me vratam ||
evaṃvidhavidhānena gṛhītvā brāhmaṇo vrajet |
[879]        dātā tat prerayet sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasya gṛhe svayam ||
tataḥ pañcamahāyajñān nirvaped bhojanādibhiḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratam etat sakṛd budhaḥ ||
tasya saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti tad vrataṃ yat purā sthitam |
khaṇḍaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti prasanne vratadaivate ||
saṃpūrṇe ca tataḥ kartā saṃpūrṇāṅgo bhaved vratī |
bhogī bhavyollasatkīrtiḥ sa saṃpūrṇamanorathaḥ ||
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye tataḥ svarge (?) 'maro bhavet |
yatheṣṭaceṣṭācārī ca brahmaviṣṇvīśapūjitaḥ ||
svargaloke ciraṃ sthitvā punar mokṣam avāpnuyāt |
prāyaścittaṃ idaṃ proktaṃ purā gargeṇa me prabho ||
gokule gokulākīrṇe mayā bālye hy upoṣitam |
evaṃ tvam api kaunteya cara saṃpūrṇakaṃ vratam ||
bhagnāni yāni madamohavaśād gṛhītvā |
janmāntareṣv api nareṇa samatsareṇa ||
saṃpūrṇapūjanaparasya puro bhavanti \
sarvavratāni paripūrṇaphalapradāṇi ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ saṃpūrṇavratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
sādhu sādhu mahāvipra śivabhakto 'si suvrata |
maunaṃ vakṣyāmi tattvajña devair api niṣevitam ||
[880]        śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi maunaṃ sarvārthasādhakam |
maunavrataṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ huṃ huṃ tatra vivarjayet ||
puṃsāṃ bhojanakāle tu huṅkāro yadi nirgataḥ |
sarvam eva surāmāṃsaṃ tasmān maune vivarjayet ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā tatra hiṃsāṃ vivarjayet |
maunasyāsya prabhāvena devāś ca tridivaṃ gatāḥ ||
ahiṃsakaḥ kṣamī bhuṅkte śānto maunavrate sthitaḥ |
aṣṭamāsaṃ caren maunaṃ yaḥ ṣaṇmāsam athāpi vā ||
māsatrayasamāyukto māsam ekaṃ tathaiva ca |
māsārdhaṃ tu punaḥ kuryād divasān dvādaśātha vā ||
ṣaṭ pañca trīṇi ekaṃ vā maunī bhūñjīta yatnataḥ |
samāpte tu vrate tasmin maunavratasamāhitaḥ ||
liṅgaṃ candanajaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅgena tu prokṣayet |
gorocanāṃ samārabhya gandhaiḥ puṣpais tu pūjayet ||
dhūpaṃ cāgurukaṃ dadyān namaskāraṃ tataḥ punaḥ |
karapādaśirobhis tat praṇipatya nivedayet ||
ātmavittānusāreṇa hemaghaṇṭāṃ pradāpayet |
śivāgrato nibadhnīyāc chivasyātīva vallabham ||
śobhitāṃ dhvajamālābhiḥ pañcaratnaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
puṣpadāmavilambaiś ca bahuvarṇair anekadhā ||
vidiśāsu vimānasya kāṃsyaghaṇṭāṃ nibandhayet |
badhnīyāc caturas trīṇi devaikāṃ śaktitas tathā ||
kāṃsyalohamayīṃ vāpi suśobhāṃ ca nivedayet |
[881]        śivasya purato viprāṃś chivabhaktāṃś ca bhojayet ||
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ madhumāṃsapariplutam |
anekabhakta(bhakṣya?)bhojyānnair lehyapeyasapichalaiḥ ||
mañjulakṣīrasaṃmiśrair maṇḍakaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ |
bhuktvā pravratijānāṃ ca niruccheṣaṃ samāpayet ||
śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
krameṇa jāyete vipra yasya yasya tu tad bhavet ||
śivabhaktāgrato nityaṃ śāntivākyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
tāmrapātre tu tal liṅgaṃ sthāpya puṣpair alaṃkṛtam ||
śirasādhārya tat pātraṃ svayaṃ maunī samāhitaḥ |
sa gacchen nṛpamārgeṇa yāvat tu śivagocaram ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śive trīn vārāṃś ca samantataḥ |
praviśed garbhagṛhakaṃ sthāpayed devadakṣiṇe ||
punaḥ punaḥ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpaiś ca sarvataḥ |
namaskārais tataḥ paścāt praṇamya śirasā bhuvi ||
maunasyaiva vidhiḥ prokto mayā tava mahāmune |
asya maunasya māhātmyād devatāḥ śivatāṃ gatāḥ ||
divyavarṣasahasrāṇi divyavarṣaśatāni ca |
divyavarṣaśataṃ koṭi rudrakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ ||
koṭikoṭivimānānām asaṃkhyākoṭisaṃkulaiḥ |
vajrasphaṭikasopānaiḥ stambhair marakataprabhaiḥ ||
sarvair hemamayair divyair vanamālāvibhūṣitaiḥ |
cāmarāsaktahastāgraiḥ koṭikoṭinarair vṛtaḥ ||
[882]        divyagandhasusaṃpūrṇair yuktamālāphalānvitaiḥ |
evaṃvidhair vimānais tu āste śivapure sukhī ||
kālakṣayād ihāgatya rājā hy amitavikramaḥ |
vaktā ca subhagaḥ śrīmān surūpaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ||
dharmabuddhiyutaś caiva sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
evaṃ maunavrataṃ proktaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam |
bhuvi sarvāsamarthānāṃ sukaraṃ prakaṭīkṛtam ||
jñānam adharmavināśanam ādyaṃ
mokṣam anādim anantaram ekam |
śivaṃ sarvajagatprabhuṃ śāntikaraṃ
prabhum avyayasūkṣmam asūkṣmatanum ||
tanulambitanaramukhamāladharaṃ
paripiṅgajaṭārdhaśaśāṅkadharam |
daśabāhutrilocanapāpaharaṃ
śravaṇojvalakuṇḍalanāgadharam |
varanūpurasuṣṭusupādadharaṃ
kamalopari saṃsthitapādatalam ||
surāsuraśiraśreṇīmaṇinīrājitaṃ hvaye |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya kāraṇatrayahetave ||
paṭhyate sarvaśāstreṣu vedaiś caiva viśeṣataḥ |
dhyānadhāraṇayogātmā parāparavibhūtaye ||
ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ bhaktyā caiva tu pūjayet |
[883]        na tasya pīḍāṃ kurvanti grahāś cāpi grahottamāḥ ||
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
iti maunavrataṃ puṇyaṃ yas tanoti maheśvaram |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati ||
iti śivadharmoktaṃ maunavratam |
śrutismṛtipurāṇebhyo yan mayā hy avadhāritam |
tat te vacmi suraśreṣṭha kasyānyasyopadiśyate ||
snātvā prabhātasaṃdhyāyām upaspṛśya ca pippalam |
tilapātraṃ tu yo dadyāt sa na śocyaḥ kṛtākṛte ||
vratānām uttamaṃ hy etat sarvapāpapraṇāśanam |
putravratam iti khyātaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacin mayā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ putravratam |
kṛcchrānte goyugaṃ dadyād bhojanaṃ śaktitaḥ padam |
viprāṇāṃ śāṅkaraṃ yāti prājāpatyam idaṃ smṛtam ||
śāṅkaraṃ padaṃ yātīty anvayaḥ |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ prājāpatyavratam |
trisaṃdhyaṃ pūjya dampatyam upavāsī vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
dadyād gāṃ dhanam āpnoti mokṣam induvratād iha ||
iti padmapurāṇoktam induvratam |
[884]        gaurīsamanvitaṃ śambhuṃ lakṣmyā saha janārdanam |
rājñīsamanvitaṃ sūryaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi |
dhūpocchrayeṇa sahitaṃ ghaṇṭhāṃ pātreṇa saṃyutām ||
pātraṃ dīpapātram |
yo dadāti dvijendrāṇāṃ puṣpair abhyarcya pāṇḍaraiḥ |
dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ datvā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
dvijendrāṇām iti bahuvacanād eva yugmānāṃ pṛthag dānaṃ dhūpāditrayaṃ ca pratiyugmam |
etad devīvrataṃ nāma divyadehapradāyakam ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ devīvratam |
māsopavāsī yo dadyād dhenuṃ viprāya śobhanām |
sarveśvarapadaṃ yāti bhīmavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ bhīmavratam |
cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca yaḥ kṛtvā haimaṃ candraṃ nivedayet |
candravratam idaṃ proktaṃ candralokapradāyakam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ candravratam |
pakṣopavāsī yo dadyād viprāya kapilādvayam |
brahmalokam avāpnoti devāsurasupūjitaḥ |
[885]        tadante rājarājaḥ syāt prabhāvratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ prabhāvratam |
brahmāṇḍaṃ kāñcanaṃ kṛtvā tilarāśisamanvitam |
tyahaṃ tilaprado bhūtvā vahniṃ saṃtarpya ca dvijān ||
saṃpūjya vipradampatyaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣitam |
śaktitas tripalād ūrdhvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatām iti ||
puṇye 'hni dadyāt sa paraṃ brahma yāty apunarbhavam |
etad brahmavrataṃ nāma nirvāṇaphaladaṃ nṛṇām ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ brahmavrartam |
yaś cobhayamukhīṃ dadyāt prabhūtakanakānvitām |
dinaṃ payovratī tiṣṭhet sa yāti paramaṃ padam |
etad vasuvrataṃ nāma punarāvṛttidurlabham ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ vasuvratam |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi nandādevyāḥ padadvayam |
yena sā prīyate vatsa acireṇa mahāvratāt ||
hemotthe pāduke kārye yathāśantyanusārataḥ |
[886]        āmradūrvākṣatair bilvapatraiḥ pūjyte tu mantrataḥ ||
devīṃ saṃpūjya bhaktyā tu sthaṇḍile pratimāsu ca |
tadbhaktyā ca viprāya kanyāsu nivedayet |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo durgālokaṃ ca gacchati ||
tataḥ kṣaye mahāprājño vidyādharapatir bhavet |
kālenaivam ihāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ nṛpasattamaḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ nandāpadadvayavratam |
saptarātroṣito dadyād ghṛtakumbhaṃ dvijāyaye |
varavratam idaṃ proktaṃ brahmalokapradāyakam ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ varavratam |
ekabhaktā ca saptāhaṃ gauriṇīr atra bhojayet |
saṃpūjya pārvatīṃ bhaktyā gandhapuṣpavilepanaiḥ ||
tāmbūlasindūravarair nārikelaphalena ca |
prīyatāṃ kumudā devī praṇipatya visarjayet ||
ekaikāṃ pūjayed devīṃ saptāhaṃ yāvad eva tu |
punaś ca saptame prāpte tāḥ saptaiva nimantrayet ||
ṣaḍbhyaḥ saṃbhojayitvānnaṃ yathāśaktyā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
bhūṣayitvā mālyavastraiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṅgulīyakaiḥ ||
kumudā mādhavī gaurī bhavānī pārvatī umā |
ambikā (?) ceti saṃpūjyā darpaṇaṃ dāpayet pṛthak ||
[887]        brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayet tv ekaṃ vācyaṃ saṃpannam astu me |
saptasundarakaṃ nāma vrataṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham |
kṛtvā prāpnoti saundaryaṃ saubhāgyam atulaṃ tathā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ saptasundaravratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
ataḥ parma idaṃ guhyaṃ vakṣyāmi munisattama |
puṇyātiśayasaṃyuktaṃ sarvadevair anuṣṭhitam ||
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā devyā skandendreṇa yamena ca |
varuṇādityasomāgnimaruddhanadanāradaiḥ ||
dharmastrīśukranakṣatrair vilohitaśanaiścaraiḥ |
viśvāmitravasiṣṭhātribṛhaspatibudhādibhiḥ ||
śvetāgastyadadhīcādyaiḥ sarvaiś ca munisattamaiḥ |
bhārgavātrimahākālaiś caṇḍeśvaragaṇādhipaiḥ ||
vṛṣavāsukikarkoṭakulikānantatakṣakaiḥ |
śaṅkhapadmamahāpadmair anyaiś cāpi mahoragaiḥ ||
siddhair yakṣaiḥ kiṃpuruṣair vasubhiś ca mahātmabhiḥ |
apsarodaityagandharvai rakṣobhūtagaṇair api ||
śivā gatir yathā prāptā sarvagatyatiśāyinī |
mayā śivaprasādena tathā vidhiparaṃ śṛṇu ||
sitacandanatoyena snāpya liṅgaṃ vilepya ca |
śvetair vikasitaiḥ padmaiḥ saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca ||
[888]        paṅkaje vimale some nicchidre puṣpite dhane |
some ramye |
madhye kesarajālasya sthāpya liṅgaṃ kanīyasam ||
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ vidhivat sarvagandhamayaṃ śubham |
snāpya dakṣiṇāmūrtau tu bilvapatraiḥ samarcayet ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtisamīpe |
aguruṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve paścimena manaḥśilam |
uttare candanaṃ dadyād dharitālaṃ ca pūrvataḥ ||
śubhagandhaiś ca kusumair vicitraiś caiva pūjayet |
dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ dadyāt saghṛtaṃ cāpi guggulam ||
vāsāṃsi cāpi sūkṣmāṇi vikāśāni navāni ca |
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ ghṛtadīpāṃś ca kārayet ||
sarvaṃ nivedya mantreṇa tato gacchet pradakṣiṇam |
praṇamya bhaktyā deveśaṃ stutvā cānte kṣamāpayet ||
sarvopahārasaṃyuktaṃ tac ca liṅgaṃ nivedayet |
śivāya śivamantreṇa dakṣiṇāmūrtim āśritaḥ ||
dakṣiṇāmūrtim āśrito yas tasmai śivāya |
anena vidhinā devāḥ sarvadevatvam āgatāḥ |
devīm devītvam āpannā skandaḥ svāmitvam āgataḥ ||
indraś ca devarājatvaṃ gaṇāś ca gaṇatāṃ gatāḥ |
evaṃ yo 'rcayate liṅgaṃ padme gandhamayaṃ śubham ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivam evābhigacchati |
[889]        etad vratottamaṃ guhyaṃ śivaliṅgaṃ mahāvratam |
bhaktasya te mayākhyātaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit ||
iti śivadharmottaroktaṃ śivaliṅgavratam |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
devadeva mahābhāga bālānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
vardhāpanavidhiṃ brūhi rājñām api viśeṣataḥ ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
pitṛkarmasamudbhūtaḥ pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ |
gatvā prayāgaṃ sattīrthaṃ gaṅgāyamunayos taṭe |
kṛtvā snānaṃ ca vidhivat kṛtvāpi pitṛtarpaṇam |
natvā tu mādhavaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra mahāmunim ||
sanatkumāraṃ yogīndraṃ satyalokanivāsinam |
pūjitas tena vidhivat kathāś cakre manoharāḥ ||
kathānte tu mahābhāga muniḥ papraccha sādaram |
vyāsaḥ satyavarīsūnuḥ sarvalokahitāya vai ||
sanatkumāra uvāca |
māsi māsi prahṛṣṭaṃ tu bālavardhāpanaṃ budhaiḥ |
ā samāntāt samantāc ca samāntāt saṃvidhīyate ||
kumudā mādhavī gaurī rudrāṇī pārvatī umā |
kālī sarasvatī caiva sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ||
[890]        satī saṃjñā tathā medhā puṣṭituṣṭisamanvitā |
nṛpaḍimbhaparitrāsā jayantī nāma ṣaḍaśī ||
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena sūryamadhye vilikhya tāḥ |
rajanīpiṣṭato vāpi likhed vā kuṅkumena vā ||
gandhapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiś ca dīpavastranivedanaiḥ |
phalair manoharair bhakṣaiḥ pakvānnair vividhair api ||
tūryaghoṣair brahmaghoṣaiḥ kuryāt tatra mahotsavam |
sopalipte śucau deśe sthāpya sūryaṃ vidhānataḥ ||
akṣataiś candanaiḥ sthāpya kumudādyāḥ pṛthak pṛthak |
nāmabhiḥ pūjanīyās tāḥ snāpayitvā ca bālakam ||
bhūpatiṃ vā muniśreṣṭha sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitam |
pūjetāṃ mātṛpitarau bālavardhāpane sati ||
purodhāḥ pūjayed brahman rājavardhāpane vidhau |
kumudādyāḥ samuddiśya vaṃśapātrāṇi kalpayet ||
ekaikasyai dhanāḍhyaṃ tu dadyāt ṣoḍaś ṣoḍaśa |
tadardhāni tadardhāni dve caikaikam athāpi vā ||
bahupakvānnayuktāni phalapuṣpayutāni ca |
suvāsinībhyo viprāṇāṃ dadyād bhaktipuraḥsaram ||
prīyatāṃ kumudādyā me bālatrāṇavivardhanī |
bālena yaśasā puṣṭyā bālaṃ me vardhayantu vai ||
prayacchantu sadārogyaṃ saukhyaṃ saubhāgyam eva ca |
śrīś ca te itimantreṇa arghyaṃ tābhyaḥ prakalpayet ||
evaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtya viprāśīrvādapūrvakam |
[891]        bhuñjīta gotrajaiḥ sārdhaṃ hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanā nṛpa ||
vastratāmbūlapuṣpādi dine tasmin prakalpayet |
suvāsinīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ kumudā prīyatām iti ||
athātharvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇe |
atha varṣaśataṃ pravardhamāne saṃvatsare rājānam abhivardhayiṣyann āyuṣā varcasā tejasā yaśasā prajayā śriyā vijayena kīrtyopacitair maṅgalair abhyukṣya rukmair arcayitvā māhendraṃ havir nirūpya lokapālebhyaś ca śrāpayet | māhendro yat tujaseti lokapālāṃś ceṣṭvā rājānam anvālabhya juhuyāt | arvācam indra trātāram indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ ma iti śitaṃ jīva śarado vardhamāno 'bhivardhasva prajayā vāvṛdhāneti dvābhyām, rakṣantu tvā girayaḥ iti catasṛbhī rakṣāṃ kṛtvā saguṇa āsata iti rocanenālaṃkuryāt | nā vai sa tantum iti sūktaṃ sampātavṛtaṃ kṛtvā dhātā te granthim ity uktam abhivardhasvety asapatno bhaved ity etat karma mausalaputraḥ paiṭhīnasiḥ \
skandapurāṇe |
evaṃ vardhāpanaṃ caiva janma vā prāptavāsare |
māse māse vyatīte tu bālānāṃ vṛddhihetave ||
na bālarogāḥ prabhavanti tasya
na skandarogā na tu śākinībhyaḥ |
bhaya bhaven naiva jalāgnidigbhyo
bālasya rājño 'pi viśeṣataś ca ||
[892]        saṃprāpya rājyaṃ nṛpatiḥ samānte
kuryād imaṃ śāntiṃ (?) mahotsavaṃ ca |
grahān susaṃpūjya vināyakaṃ ca
durgā ca bhaktyā kumudādidevī |
yaḥ pūjayed bhaktipuraḥsaraṃ vai
jetā ripūṇāṃ balabuddhiyuktaḥ ||
iti vardhāpanavidhiḥ |
atharvaṇagopathabrāhmaṇe |
atha ghṛtāvekṣaṇam |
prātaḥ prātaḥ śaṅkhadundubhinādena brahmaghoṣeṇa vā prabodhito rājā śayanagṛhād utthāyāparājitāṃ diśam abhikramyopādhyāyaṃ pratīkṣet | atha purodhāḥ snātānuliptaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ kṛtamaṅgalaracitoṣṇīṣaḥ śāntigṛhaṃ praviśya devānāṃ namaskāraṃ kṛtvā svastivācanam anujñāpya vinītopaviśed yamasya lokād yathākālaṃ yo na jīvo 'sīti svastyayanaṃ kṛtvollikhyābhyukṣya paristīrya śāntātīyena tilān ghṛtāktān juhuyāt śāntaḥ sauvarṇarājatam audumbaraṃ vā pātraṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ghṛtasya jutisahasraṃ śṛṅgoruviṣṇo vikramasv ity abhimantrya ājyaṃ teja iti tadā labhate |
ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddiṣṭam ajyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param |
ājyena devās tṛpyanti ājye lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
bhaumāntarīkṣadivyaṃ vā yat te kalmaṣaṃ āgatam |
sarvaṃ tad ājyasaṃsparśāt praṇāśam upagacchatu ||
[893]        tasmin sarvam ātmānaṃ paśeyd akṣṇā | śiro hṛdayam anvālabhed uccāpatantam iti
dvābhyām | sūryasyāvṛtam iti pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya śeṣaṃ sādhayed iti |
tatra ślokāśḥ |
ayaṃ ghṛtāvekṣaṇasya prokto vidhir atharvaṇaḥ |
evaṃ samācaret samyak prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ||
upāsyodayakāle tu sa rājā jayam icchayā |
sa rājā jayate rāṣṭraṃ na paśyante tu śatravaḥ ||
paścād ānīya kapilāṃ rājā dadyād dvijātaye |
āśīrvādaṃ tataś caiva śrutvā tanmukhaniḥsṛtam ||
guruṇāvedite tasmād dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt |
putrān pautrāṃś ca mitrāṇi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
āyuṣyam atha varcasyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ śatrutāpanam |
duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ dhanyaṃ ghṛtāvekṣaṇam ucyate ||
iti ghṛtāvvekṣaṇavidhiḥ |
atha agastyārghyavidhiḥ |
padmapurāṇāt |
bhīṣma uvāca |
bhūrloko 'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarloko 'tha mahar janaḥ |
tapaḥ satyaṃ ca saptaite devalokāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
paryāyeṇa tu sarveṣām ādhipatyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
[894]        iha loke śubhaṃ rūpam āyur ārogyam eva ca |
lakṣmīś ca vipulā brahman kathaṃ syāt surapūjita ||
pulastya uvāca |
vasiṣṭho yo bhavet tasmin jalakumbhe ca pūrvavat |
tataś cetaś caturbāhuḥ sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍaluḥ ||
agastya iti śāntātmā babhūva ṛṣisattamaḥ |
malayasyaiva deśe ca vaikhānasavidhānataḥ ||
sabhāryaḥ sasuto viprais tapaś cakre suduṣkaram |
tataḥ kālena mahatā tārakādinipīḍitam ||
jagad vīkṣya sa kopena pītavān varuṇālayam |
tato 'sya varadāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ śaṅkarādayaḥ ||
brahmā viṣṇuś ca bhagavān varadānāya jagmatuḥ |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yaś cābhīṣṭo 'tra vai mune ||
agastya uvāca |
yāvad brahmasahasrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśatikoṭayaḥ |
vaimāniko bhaviṣyāmi dakṣiṇāmbaravartmani ||
madvimānodayāt kuryād yaḥ kaścit pūjanaṃ mama |
sa caiva puṇyatāṃ yātu vara eṣa vṛto mayā ||
śrāddhaṃ ye tu kariṣyanti piṇḍapūrvaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ |
teṣāṃ pitṛgaṇaḥ sarvo mayā sārdhaṃ divi sthitaḥ ||
etat kālaṃ ca tiṣṭheta eṣa eva varo mama |
evam astv iti te 'py uktā jagmur devā yathāgatam |
tadarghyaḥ saṃpradātavyo agastyasya sadā budhaiḥ ||
[895]
viṣṇudharmottare agastyasya mahāmuniṃ prati pitāmahavākyam |
devakāryam ahaṃ brahman tvayā kṛtam idaṃ śubham |
tasmāt sthānaṃ tu te vacmi vaiśvānarapathād bahiḥ ||
divyadeho bhavāṃs tatra vimānavaram āsthitaḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ diśam āśritya astodayasamanvitaḥ ||
prasādam ambhasāṃ śaityaṃ nirviṣatvaṃ tavodaye |
bhaviṣyaty amalaprajña matprasādāt sadaiva tu ||
śaratsamudito bhūtvā vasante 'stamayaṃ dvija |
prākāmyayuktaś ca tathā samagrāṃ vasudhāṃ cara ||
śaratsamayam āsādya tasmād vipra tavodaye |
pūjāṃ tvam āpsase loke matprasādād dvijottama ||
ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyanti gandhamālyaphalākṣataiḥ |
dadhikāñcanaratnaiś ca paramānnena bhūriṇā ||
pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sakūṣmāṇḍaiś chatropānahayaṣṭibhiḥ |
dhenvā vṛṣeṇa bhakṣaiś ca vāsobhiḥ kanakena ca ||
saṃvatsaraṃ ca tyāgena phalasyaikasya vāpy atha |
pūjanair brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tvanmantraparikīrtanaiḥ |
vidhānaṃ yad agastyasya pūjane tad vadasva me ||
pulastya uvāca |
pratyūṣasamaye vidvān kuryād asyodaye niśi |
snānaṃ śuklatilais tavac chuklamālyāmbaro gṛhī ||
[896]        niśy udaye niśi dinamukhe snānaṃ samācaret |
sthāpayed avraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣitam ||
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ ghṛtapātrānnasaṃyutam |
nānābhakṣaphalair yuktaṃ tāmrapātrasamanvitam ||
aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ tathaiva
sauvarṇam atyāyatabāhudaṇḍam |
caturbhujaṃ kumbhamukhe nidhāya
dhānyāni saptāmbarasaṃyutāni ||
sakāśapuṣpākṣataśuktiyuktaṃ
mantreṇa dadyād dvijapuṅgavāya |
utkṣipya lambodaradīrghabāhum
ananyacetā yamadiṅmukhasthaḥ ||
sakāśapuṣpākṣatayā śuktyā yuktaṃ prayuktam arghyam utkṣipya dadyād ity anvayaḥ | atyāyatabāhudaṇḍam ity utkṣepaṇakriyāviśeṣaṇam | lambodaradīrghabāhum iti pratimāviśeṣaṇam | dvijapuṅgavo 'gastyaḥ |
śvetāṣṇa dadyāc chucimuktiraupya- (?)
śravakṣurāṃ hemamukhīṃ savatsām |
dhenuṃ naraḥ kṣīravatīṃ praṇamya
savastraghṇṭābharaṇāṃ dvijāya ||
bhaviṣñottarāt |
kāñcanaṃ kārayitvā ca yathāśaktyā suśobhanam |
puruṣākṛtiṃ praśāntaṃ ca jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇam ||
kamaṇḍalukaraṃ śiṣyaiḥ svargaiś ca parivāritam |
[897]        mṛtyūgraviṣahantāraṃ darbhākṣasragdharaṃ munim |
tasmin kumbhe samālagnaṃ candanena tato nyaset ||
snāpitaṃ cānuliptaṃ ca candanena sugandhinā |
pūjitaṃ jātikusumair hṛdyair dhūpaiś ca dhūpitam ||
atha viṣṇurahasye |
kāśapuṣpamayīṃ ramyāṃ kṛtvā mūrtiṃ tu vāruṇaiḥ |
pradoṣe vinyasat tāṃ tu pūrṇakumbhe svalaṃkṛte ||
iha pūrvoktasuvarṇarūpyeṇa saha śaktyanusārād vikalpaḥ | pūrṇakumbho jalapūrṇakumbhaḥ |
kumbhasthaṃ pūjayet taṃ tu puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ |
dadhyakṣatabaliṃ dadyād rātrau kuryāt prajāgaram ||
pūjā ca vakṣyamāṇair arghyamantrair vidheyā |
prabhāte taṃ samādāya yāvat puṇyajalāśayam |
niśāvasāne tān paśyan jalānte pratimāṃ muneḥ ||
arghyaṃ dadyād agastyāya bhaktyā samyag upoṣitaḥ |
puṣpair mūlaiḥ phalair gandhair dhūpair atha sugandhibhiḥ ||
drākṣākharjūrakarkandhūnārikelādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ hemarūpyasamanvitam ||
saptadhānyabṛtaṃ pātraṃ candanena samāyutam |
tat tu tāmramayaṃ kṛtvā dadyād arghyaṃ dvijātaye ||
agastyaḥ khanamāneti paṭhan mantram imaṃ mune |
yathā lābhakṛtārthena sarvair vātha svaśaktitaḥ ||
arghyaṃ dadyur agastyāya śūdre mantravidhis tv ayam |
[898]        kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa vahnimārutasaṃbhava |
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kumbhayone namo 'stu te ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
tataś cārghyaḥ pradātavyo yair dravyais tān śṛṇuṣva me |
kharjūrair nālikelaiś ca kuṣmāṇḍais trapusair api ||
karkoṭaiḥ kāruvellaiś ca karmarair bījapūrakaiḥ |
vṛntākair dāḍimaiś caiva nāraṅgaiḥ kadaliphalaiḥ ||
dūrvāṅkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ kāśaiḥ padmair nīlotpalais tathā |
nānāprakārair bhakṣaiś ca gobhir vastrai rasaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānaiś ca vaṃśapātre nidhāpitaiḥ |
sauvarṇarūpapātreṇa tāmravaṃśamayena ca ||
mūrdhni sthitena namreṇa jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ |
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā dhyātvāgastyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ nṛpa ||
dadyād arghyaṃ prayatnena cetasāgurucandanaiḥ |
śuktyākāram arghyapātraṃ sakāśapuṣpākṣataśuktīti vacanāt |
kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa vahnimārutasaṃbhava |
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kumbhayone namo 'stu te ||
vātāpir bhakṣito yena samudraḥ śoṣitaḥ purā |
lopāmudrāpatiḥ śrīmān yo 'sau tasmai namo namaḥ ||
yenoditena pāpāni vilayaṃ yānti vyādhayaḥ |
tasmai namo 'stv agastyāya saśiṣyāya ca putriṇe ||
brāhmaṇo vedamantreṇa dadyād arghyaṃ nṛpottama |
agastyaḥ khanamānaḥ khaniraiḥ
prajām apatyaṃ balam icchamānaḥ |
[899]        ubhau varṇāvṛṣir ugraḥ pupoṣa
satyā deveṣv āśiṣo jagāma ||
datvaivam arghyaṃ kauravya praṇipatya visarjayet |
arcitas tvaṃ yathāśaktyā namo 'gastyamaharṣaye |
aihikāmuṣmikīṃ datvā kāryasiddhiṃ vrajasva me ||
visarjanamantraḥ |
visarjayitvāgastyaṃ taṃ viprāya pratipādayet |
daivajñe vyāsarūpāya vedavedāṅgavādine ||
agastyo me manasyo 'stu (?) agastyo 'smin ghaṭe sthitaḥ |
agastyo dvijarūpeṇa pratigṛhṇātu satkṛtaḥ ||
agastyaḥ saptajanmotthaṃ nāśayatv avayor agham |
atulaṃ vimalaṃ saukhyaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ mahāmune ||
pratigrahamantraḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā hy agastyavratam ādarāt |
phalam ekaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ rasaṃ caikaṃ parityajet |
saṃpūrṇe ca tathā varṣe punar apy anupakramet ||
viṣṇurahasye |
datvārghyaṃ tu vidhānena naraḥ kumbodbhavāya ca |
tyajed agastyam uddiśya dhānyam ekaṃ phalaṃ rasam ||
atha māse 'py agastyārghyam abhidhāya |
pratyabdaṃ ca phalatyāgam evaṃ kurvan na sīdati |
homaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścād varjayen mānavaḥ phalam ||
homaś ca svāhāntena praṇavādinā arghamantreṇa sarpiṣā vidheyaḥ |
[900]        tato 'nupūjayed viprān ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ |
gāḥ suvarṇaṃ ca vāsāṃsi tebhyo dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
ghṛtapāyasayuktena pātreṇa sthagitānanam |
sahiraṇyaṃ ca taṃ kumbhaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
aprāpte bhāskare kanyām arvāg vai saptabhir dinaiḥ |
arghyaṃ dadyur agastyāya ye vasanti mahodaye ||
pūrvānakṣatrāntargate 'rka ity arthaḥ | ujjayanyāṃ tv arvāk | yad āha varāhamihiraḥ |
saṃkhyāvidhānāt pratideśam asya
vijñāya saṃdarśanam ādiśed jñaḥ |
tac cojjayantyām agatasya kanyāṃ
bhāgaiḥ svarākhyaiḥ sphuṭabhāskarasya ||
svarākhyair bhāgaiḥ saptabhir aṃśaiḥ kanyām agatasya sphuṭasyādityasya maghādvitīyacaraṇāntargatasyety arthaḥ | tathā |
īṣatprakāśe 'ruṇarasmijāle
naiśe 'ndhakāre diśi dakṣiṇasyām |
saṃvatsarāveditadigvibhāgo
bhṛto 'rghyamūrvā prayataḥ prayacchet ||
bhaviṣyottare kṛṣṇavākyam |
tasyaivaṃ ceṣṭitasyārṣeḥ prayacchārghyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
kanyāyām āgate sūrye arvāg vai saptame dine |
kanyāyāṃ samanuprāpte arghyakālo nivartate (?) ||
[901] yudhiṣṭhire pure pūrvyāṃ tṛtīyacaraṇaṃ jihā (?) satyakarṇa udaye ity arthaḥ | yasmin deśe yasmin dine agastyasaṃdarśanaṃ bhavati | tasmin deśe tasminn arghyadānam iti saṃkṣepaḥ | kanyāyāṃ samanuprāpte ityādinā saptamād dinād ārabhya saṃkrāntim avadhīkurvatā udayād ārabhya saptadinābhyantare 'pi yuktam arghadānam ity etad darśitam |
tathā ca padmapurāṇe |
ā saptarātrād udayād yamasya
dātavyam etat sakalaṃ nareṇa ||
yamasya agastyasya | udayād ūrdhvam ā saptarātrāt | saptarātram avadhīkṛtya ekasmin dine arghyo dātavya ity arthaḥ |
saptarātrād ūrdhvaṃ tu arghyadānam anarthakam || iti |
brahmapurāṇe |
agastyo dakṣiṇām āśām āśritya nabhasi sthitaḥ |
varuṇasyātmajo yogī vindhyapādavimardanaḥ ||
kanyāṃśebhyaḥ paścimebhyaḥ ṣaḍbhyaḥ prārabhya saṃkhyayā |
aṃśān dvisaptatiṃ yāvad bhuṅkte sūryas tu rāśiṣu ||
udeti tāvad bhagavān agasthyo vyomni dhāmabhṛt |
ukṣāṃśebhyaḥ paścimebhyaḥ prārabhya pūrvavat kramāt ||
ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ ca yāvac ca bhuṅkte bhānur yathākramam |
tāvac chrāntasya pātālaṃ pratyāty astam upaiti ca ||
ukṣā vṛṣabhaḥ | aṃśaś caraṇaḥ | navacaraṇo rāśiḥ | sapādanakṣatradvayabhogāt (?) | uttarātṛtīyacaraṇādayaḥ | tad dhi saptatir aśvinī tṛtīyacaraṇāntāḥ etāvat sūryabhāgenodayakālaḥ | śeṣo 'tre kālaḥ |
[902]        kṛtopavāsaḥ saṃpaśyed agastyam uditaṃ munim |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvabhāgyapravardhanam ||
arcanīyaś ca bhagavān śraddhābhaktisamanvitaiḥ |
pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sakūṣmāṇḍair yavair dhyānair ghṛtena ca ||
jātipadmotpalaiḥ puṣpaiś candanena sitena ca |
gobhir ghṛtais tathā vastrai ratnaiḥ sāgarasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
upānacchatradaṇḍaiś ca pādukāñjanavalkalaiḥ |
haviṣā paramānnena phalaiḥ puṣpaiś ca śobhanaiḥ ||
anyaprakārair bhakṣaiś ca homair brāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ |
āśāsya ca śubhaṃ kālam uddiśyaikaṃ manogatam ||
yady ahaṃ prāpnuyām kāmaṃ bhagavan manasi sthitam |
tvatprasādād avighnena bhūyas tvāṃ pūjayāmy aham ||
ity uktvā pūjayet paścād daivajñāṃś ca tathā gurūn |
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
atha padmapurāṇe |
ā saptarātrād udayād yamasya
dātavyam etat sakalaṃ nareṇa |
yāvatsamāḥ saptadaśāś ca vā syur
athordhvam apy atra vadanti kecit ||
anena vidhinā yas tu pumān arghaṃ nivedayet |
imaṃ lokam avāpnoti rūpārogyasamanvitaḥ ||
dvitīyena bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca tataḥ param |
saptaiva lokān āpnoti saptārghān yaḥ prayacchati ||
[903]        yāvadāyuś ca yaḥ kuryāt sa paraṃ brahma gacchati |
varāhasaṃhitāyām |
narapatir imam arghyaṃ śraddadhāno dadānaḥ |
pravigatamadadoṣair nirjitārātipakṣaḥ (?) |
bhavati yadi hi dadyāt saptavarṣāṇi samyak |
jalanidhirasanāyāḥ svāmitām eti bhūmeḥ ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
datvārghyaṃ saptavarṣāṇi krameṇānena pāṇḍava |
pumān yat phalam āpnoti tad ekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu ||
brāhmaṇaḥ syāt caturvedaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ prāpnoty arṇavamekhalām ||
vaiśyānāṃ dhānyaniṣpattir godhanaṃ cāpi vindati |
śūdrāṇāṃ dhanam ārogyaṃ sasyānnaṃ cādhikaṃ bhavet ||
strīṇāṃ putrāḥ prajāyante saubhāgyaṃ gṛham ṛddhimat |
vidhavānāṃ mahat puṇyaṃ vardhate pāṇḍunandana ||
kanyā bhartāram āpnoti vyādher mucyeta duḥkhitaḥ |
yeṣu deśeṣv agastyārghaḥ pūjeyaṃ kriyate janaiḥ ||
teṣu deśeṣu parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī prajāyate |
ītayaḥ praśamaṃ yānti naśyanti vyādhayas tathā ||
paṭhanti ye tv agastyarṣer vrataṃ śṛṇvanti (?) cāpare ||
te sarve pāpanirmuktāḥ ciraṃ sthitvā mahītale |
haṃsayuktavimānena svargaṃ yānti narottamāḥ ||
martye yadīcchasi gṛhaṃ paramarddhiyuktaṃ
[904]                bhogān śarīram atulaṃ paśuputrapuṣṭim |
tad ratnavallabha muner udaye mahārghyam
arghaṃ prayaccha phalavastrarasaiḥ sadhānyaiḥ ||
padmapurāṇe |
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya etad
vasuyugalāṅgabhavasya saṃpradānam |
matim api ca dadāti so 'pi viṣṇor
bhavanagataḥ paripūjyate maroghaiḥ ||
brahmovāca |
sitacandanatoyena vyoma sthāpya vilipya ca |
karṇikākalpitaiḥ padmaiḥ saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca ||
karṇikākalpitaiḥ karṇikāmaṇḍitaiḥ |
vakule vimale saumye nicchidre puṣpite sati |
puṣpite vikasite |
madhye kesarajālasya syoma sthāpyaṃ suśobhanam ||
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ tu sarvagandhasamanvitam |
agre saṃsthāpayitvā ca bhāskarasya surottama ||
pūjayet karavīrais tu tathā raktaiś ca candanaiḥ |
dhūpaṃ ca guggulaṃ dadyāt praṇamya śirasā ravim ||
kuṅkumaṃ pūrvapārśve tu dadyād vyomasamāhitaḥ |
dakṣiṇe cāguruṃ datvā paścime candanaṃ sitam ||
catuḥsamaṃ cottare tu dadyād vyomavicakṣaṇaḥ |
dadyān madhye śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ raktacandanam ādarāt ||
[905]        pūjayed vividhaiḥ puṣpais tathā sāgurucandanaiḥ |
dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ dadyāt saghṛtaṃ vāpi guggulam ||
vāsāṃsi ca susūkṣmāṇi vikeśāni nivedayet |
pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ ghṛtadīpāṃś ca dāpayet ||
sarvaṃ nivedya mantreṇa tato gacchet pradakṣiṇam |
praṇamya śirasā bhānum bhānum utthāyainaṃ kṣamāpayet ||
sarvopahārasaṃyuktaṃ baliṃ devāya cāharet |
khakholkāyeti mantreṇa sūryāyāmitatejase ||
anena vidhivad devaṃ cārcayitvā purā ravim |
ahaṃ brahmatvam āpannaḥ prasādād bhāskarasya tu ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ vyomavratam |
niśi kṛtvā jale vāsaṃ prabhāte goprado bhavet |
vāruaṇaṃ lokam āpnoti varuṇavratam ihocyate ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ varuṇavratam |
yo 'bdam ekaṃ prakurvīta naktaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi |
parva pañcadaśī |
brahmacārī jitakrodhaḥ śivārcanarataḥ sadā |
vatsarānte ca viprendra śivabhaktān samāhitān ||
[906]        bhojayitvā tato brūyāt prīyatāṃ bhagavān prabhuḥ |
evaṃ vidhisamāyuktaḥ śivalokaṃ ca gacchati |
na ca mānuṣatāṃ loke adhruvāṃ prāpnute naraḥ ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaṃ parvanaktavratam |
pṛthivībhājane bhuṅkte nityaṃ parvasu yo naraḥ |
atirātraphalaṃ devi ahorātreṇa vindati ||
pṛthivībhājane bhūvāv annaṃ nidhāyety arthaḥ, śivo 'tra devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ parvabhūbhājanavratam |
yo viṃśatipalād ūrdhvaṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā tu kāñcanīm |
dinaṃ payovrataṃ dadyād rudraloke mahīyate |
dharāvratam idaṃ proktaṃ saptakalpaśatānugam ||
dinaṃ devānām uttarāyaṇam | payovratam ity anantaraṃ kṛtvety anusaṅgaḥ | rudro devatā dharādānaṃ pāraṇam |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ dharāvratam |
nandikeśvara uvāca |
tathā sarvaphalatyāgamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu nārada |
[907]        yad akṣayaṃ pare loke sarvakāmaphalavratam ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ munivratam |
dvādaśyām atha vāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyām athāpi vā ||
ārabhec chuklapakṣasya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
anyeṣv api ca māseṣu puṇye 'hni munisattama ||
sadakṣiṇāṃ pāyasena śaktitaḥ pūjayed dvijān |
aṣṭādaśānāṃ dhānyānām anyatra phalamātrakam ||
varjayed aṣṭam ekaṃ tu vinaivauṣadhakāraṇāt |
savṛṣaṃ kāñcanaṃ rudraṃ dharmarājaṃ ca kārayet ||
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ mātuliṅgaṃ ca vṛntākam panasaṃ tathā |
āmrāmrātakapitthāni kāliṅgam atha vārukam ||
śrīphalāśvatthabadaraṃ jambīraṃ kadalīphalam |
karmaraṃ dāḍimaṃ śaktyā kaladhautāni ṣoḍaśa ||
kaladhautaṃ hema |
mūlakāmalakaṃ jambūtindiḍīkaramandakam |
kaṅkailakaṃ ca tuṇḍīrakarīrakuṭajaṃ samī ||
elakam elāphalam |
udumbaraṃ nārikelaṃ drākṣātha bṛhatīdvayam |
raupyāni kārayec chaktyā phalānīmāni ṣoḍaśa ||
tāmraṃ tālaphalaṃ kuryād agastiphalam eva ca |
piṇḍīrakāśmaryaphalaṃ tathā sūraṇakandakam ||
kāśmaryaḥ śrīparṇī |
raktālukākaṇṭakaṃ ca ketakāmlīkacirbhaṭam |
[908] ketakaḥ ambuprasādanaphalam | amlīkaṃ ciñcā |
citravallīphailaṃ tadvat kūṭaśālmalijaṃ (?) phalam (?) |
kūṭhaśālmaliḥ rohītakaḥ |
grāmaniṣpāvamadhukavaṭeṅgudapaṭolakam |
madhuko madhūkaḥ | īṅgudo hiṃguṇaḥ |
tāmrāṇi ṣoḍaśaitāni kārayec chaktito naraḥ |
udakumbhadvayaṃ kuryād dhānyopari savastrakam ||
tataś ca kārayec chayyāṃ śayyopari savāsasam |
bhakṣapātradvayopetaṃ yamaṃ rudravṛṣānvitam ||
dhenvā sahaiva śāntāya viprāyātha kuṭumbine |
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇye 'hni vinivedayet ||
yathā phaleṣu nivasanty amarā rasarūpiṇaḥ |
tathā sarvaphalatyāgavratād bhaktiḥ śive 'stu me ||
yathā śivaś ca dharmaś ca sadānandaphalapradaḥ |
tadyuktaphaladānena tau syātāṃ me phalapradau ||
yathā phalāni kāmāḥ syuḥ śivabhakteṣu sarvadā |
tathānantaphalaprāptir me 'stu janmani janmani ||
yathā bhedena paśyāmi śivaviṣṇvarkapadmajām |
tathā mamāstu viśvātmā śaṅkaraḥ śaṅkaraḥ sadā |
iti vatsarataḥ sarvam alaṃkṛtya ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
vatsarataḥ varṣāt param |
śaktaś cec chayanaṃ dadyāt sarvopaskarasaṃyutam |
aśaktas tu phalāny eva yathoktāni vidhānataḥ ||
[909]        tathodakumbhayugmaṃ ca śivadharmau ca kāñcanaiḥ |
viprāya datvā bhuñjīta vāgayatas tailavarjitam ||
anyān api yathāśaktyā bhojayed dvijapuṅgava |
etasmān na paraṃ kiṃcid iha loke paratra ca ||
vratam asya muniśreṣṭha yad anantaphalapradam |
sauvarṇatāmraraupyeṣu yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ ||
bhavanti cūrṇamāneṣu phaleṣu munisattama |
tāvad yugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
etat samastakaluṣāpaharaṃ janānām
ājīvanāya manujeṣu ca sarvadā syāt |
janmāntareṣu na ca putraviyogaduḥkham
āpnoti dhāma ca purandaradevajuṣṭam ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ phalatyāgavratam |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
vṛntākasya vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārtha samāhitaḥ |
saṃvatsaraṃ vā ṣaṇmāsān trīn māsān vā na bhakṣayet ||
atha bharaṇyāṃ maghāyāṃ vā ekarātropavāsaṃ kṛtvā sthaṇḍile devatām āhūya gandhapuṣpanaivedyādinā ca saṃpūjya darbhapāṇir gandhodakenāvāhayet | yamarājam āvāhayāmi | kālam āvāhayāmi | citraguptam āvāhayāmi | mṛtyum āvāhayāmi | parameṣṭhinam āvāhayāmi iti | tato 'gniṃ samādhāya tilājyaṃ juhuyāt | yamāya svāhā | nīlāya svāhā | nīlakaṇṭhāya svāhā | yamarājāya svāhā | [910] citraguptāya svāhā | vaivasvatāya svāhā | agnim ūrdhvavyāhṛtīr aṣṭaśataṃ juhuyāt |
prāyaścittaṃ datvā brāhmaṇaḥ svayam eva itareṣām ācāryaḥ | atha svaśaktyā sauvarṇaṃ vṛntākaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet |
kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ tathā vṛṣaṃ ca tathaiva karṇaveṣṭāṅgulīyakaiḥ, chatropānahau kṛṣṇavastrayugaṃ kṛṣṇakambalaṃ dadyāt | brāhmaṇān bhojyāśiṣo vācayet |
anena vidhinā yas tu vṛntāktaṃ ca prayacchati |
trīn māsān ṣanmāsaṃ vā varṣam ekaṃ na bhakṣayet ||
atha vainaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā janmāvadhi tyāgaṃ karoti sa tu viṣṇulokaṃ prayāti pauṇḍarīko 'śvamedhaphalam āpnoti |
saptajanmasahasrāṇi nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate |
saptalokottaraṃ yāvad yamalokaṃ na paśyati ||
vṛntākam apratihataṃ varahemasiddhaṃ
dadyād dvijāya ghṛtavastrasamanvitaṃ yaḥ |
kṛtvā tu varṣam api māsam athaikam eva
yāmyaṃ na paśyati puraṃ puruṣaḥ kadācit ||
iti bhaviṣyottarokto vṛntākatyāgavidhiḥ |
tryahaṃ payovrate sthitvā kāñcanaṃ kalpapādapam |
palād ūrdhvaṃ yathāśaktyā taṇḍulaṃ sūrpasaṃyutam ||
sūrpaṃ droṇadvayam |
datvā brahmapadaṃ yāti kalpavṛkṣavrataṃ smṛtam ||
[911] brahmātra devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kalpavṛkṣavratam |
haimaṃ paladvayād ūrdhvaṃ ratham aśvayugādikam |
dadan kṛtopavāsaḥ syād divi kalpaśataṃ vaset |
tadante rājarājaḥ syād aśvavratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
indro 'tra devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktam aśvavratam |
tadvad dhemarathaṃ dadyāt karibhyāṃ saṃyutaṃ punaḥ |
satyaloke vaset kalpasahasram atha bhūmipaḥ |
bhaved upoṣito bhūtvā karivratam idaṃ smṛtam ||
upoṣito bhūtvā dadyād ity anvayaḥ | tadvat kalpadvayād ūrdhvam | brahmātra (?) devatā |
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ karivratam |
ghṛtābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryād ahorātraṃ śivasya tu |
niyataṃ ślakṣṇadhārābhiḥ puṣyamāse samudyataḥ ||
gītanṛtyopahāreṇa śaṅkhavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ |
kuryāj jāgaraṇaṃ tatra pradīpādyupaśobhayā ||
samastapāpanirmuktaḥ samastakulasaṃyutaḥ |
[912]        jvaladbhiḥ sa mahāyānair asaṃkhyeyair nagottamaiḥ ||
yuktaḥ śivapure nityaṃ modate śivavat sukhī |
grahaṇe viṣuve caiva puṇyeṣu divaseṣu ca ||
ghṛtābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ paśyed āsamāptim upoṣitaḥ |
vidhūya sarvapāpāni śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
ekaḥ pūjayate bhaktyā anyo bhaktyā praśasyati |
tulyam eva phalaṃ tābhyāṃ bhaktir evātra kāraṇam ||
iti śivadharmokto ghṛtasnapanavidhiḥ |
sūta uvāca |
durlabhā khalu yā muktir anāyāsena dehinām |
jāyate karmaṇā yena śṛṇudhvaṃ tad dvijottamāḥ ||
gocarmamātram ālikhya maṇḍalaṃ gomayena ca |
caturasraṃ vidhānena caruṇābhyukṣya mantravit ||
alaṃkṛtya vitānādyaiś chatraiś cāpi manoramaiḥ |
budbudair ardhacandraiś ca svarṇair aśvatthapatrakaiḥ ||
sitair vikasitaiḥ padmaiḥ raktair nīlotpalais tathā |
vimānena vicitreṇa muktā dāmnā dvijottamāḥ |
sitanṛtyātmakaiś caiva suślakṣṇaiḥ pūrṇakumbhakaiḥ ||
phalapallavamālābhir vaijayantībhir aṃśukaiḥ |
pañcāśaddīpamālābhir dhūpaiś ca vividhais tathā ||
pañcāśaddalasaṃyuktaṃ likhitvā padmam uttamam |
tattadvarṇais tathā cūrṇaiḥ śvetacūrṇair athāpi vā (?) ||
[913]        ekahastapramāṇena kṛtvā padmaṃ vidhānataḥ |
karṇikāyāṃ nyased devaṃ dadyād deveśvaraṃ bhavam ||
tatra varṇān akārādīn nyaset prāgādyanukramāt |
praṇavādinamo'ntāṃś ca sarvavarṇān hi suvrataḥ ||
saṃpūjyaiva muniśreṣṭha gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra pañcāśad vidhipūrvakam ||
akṣamālopavītaṃ ca kuṇḍalāni kamaṇḍalum |
āsanaṃ ca tathā daṇḍam uṣṇīṣaṃ vastram eva ca ||
datvā teṣāṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ devadevāya  śambhave |
mahācaruṃ ca naivedyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gomithunaṃ tathā ||
annaiś ca devadevāya datvā tadvarṇamaṇḍalam |
yogopayogidravyāṇi śivāni vinivedayet ||
oṃkārādyaṃ japed dhīmān prativarṇam anukramāt ||
evam ālikhya yo bhaktyā varṇamaṇḍalam uttamam |
yat phalaṃ labhate martyas tad vadāmi samāsataḥ ||
sāṅgān vedān yathānyāyam adhītya vidhipūrvakān |
iṣṭvā yajñair yathānyāyaṃ jyotiṣṭomādibhiḥ kramāt ||
tato viśvajitaṃ ceṣṭvā putrān utpādya tādṛśān |
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā sadāraḥ sāgnir eva ca ||
cāndrāyaṇādikān kṛtvā saṃnyasya vai dvijaḥ kramāt |
brahmavidyām adhītyaiva jñānam āpādya yatnataḥ ||
jñānena jñeyam ālokya yogī yat phalam āpnuyāt |
tat phalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ varṇamaṇḍaladarśanāt ||
[914]        yena kenāpi vā likhya pralipyāyatanāśrayam |
uttare dakṣiṇe vāpi pṛṣṭhato vā dvijottamāḥ ||
catuṣkoṇe 'pi vā varṇair alaṃkṛtya samantataḥ |
vikīrya gandhakusumair dhūpadīpaiś caturvidhaiḥ |
prārthayed devam īśānaṃ śivalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān kalpakoṭiśataṃ naraḥ |
svadehagandhaiḥ sa śubhaiḥ pūrayec chivamandiram ||
kramād gāndharvam āsādya gardharvais tatra pūjitaḥ |
kramād āgatya loke 'smin rājā bhavati vīryavān ||
iti saurapurāṇoktaṃ varṇamaṇḍalam |
śuklapakṣe navaṃ dhānyaṃ pakvaṃ jñātvā subhobhanam |
sutithau ca sunakṣatre muhūrte ca śubhe sati ||
gacchet kṣetraṃ vidhāne ca (vidhānena?) gītavādyapuraḥsaraḥ ||
tatra vahniṃ tu prajvālya gāndhaiḥ saṃstīrya śāstravat |
kṛtvā homaṃ (?) tataḥ paścān nayed dhānyaṃ vibhūṣitam ||
puṣpair vastraiḥ phalair mūlair hastyaśvarathasaṃyutam |
tena devān pitṝn bandhūn tarpayitvā yathākramam ||
vibhajya ca yathāśaktyā daivajñāḥ sasyarakṣitaḥ |
navavastrāvṛtaḥ sragvī svanuliptaḥ svalaṃkṛtaḥ ||
sthitaḥ pūrvamakhas tuṣṭā brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaraḥ |
śṛṇvan vā paramaṃ hṛṣṭo maṅgalālambhanādayuk ||
prāśnīyād dadhisaṃyuktaṃ navamantrābhimantritam |
kṛtāhāraś ca kurute gītavādyair mahotsavam ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktaṃ sasyotsavaḥ
[915]        kṣīrodasāgarāt pūrvaṃ mathyamānāt purātanāt |
śyāmā devī samutpannā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā ||
nārāyaṇī yāsāv uktā sukumārā yaśasvinī |
satīdehasamudbhūtā satī paramaśobhanā ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakitās tatra tataḥ sarve surāsurāḥ |
manojñā sumukhī caiṣā hanta drakṣāmahe vayam ||
evam uktvā vacas tāṃ ca dadṛśuḥ sarva eva tat |
caturnāmātha (?) tasyāste drākṣeti bhuvi vistaram ||
ato 'rdhaṃ sā supakvā ca pūjitavyā prayatnataḥ |
puṣpadhūpānulepādyais tathā brāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ ||
dvau vālakau tathā vṛddhau saṃpūjya tadanantaram |
dharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ ca samuddiśya kuṛīrakaiḥ |
strīsahāyena hṛṣṭena bhṛtyamitrasutaiḥ saha ||
svanuliptena vidhivat sragviṇā ca suvāsasā |
niveditā gurubyaś ca svayaṃ bhojyā na cānyathā |
utsavaś cāpi kartavyo nṛtyagītasamākulaḥ ||
iti ādityapurāṇoktaḥ śyāmāmahotsavaḥ |
brahmovāca |
ṛgvedam ātreyagotraṃ somadevaṃ vidur mune |
kāśyapaṃ ca yajurveda ugradevaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
sāmavedo 'pi gotraiś ca bhāradvājaḥ purandaraḥ |
[916]        adhidevaṃ vijānīyād rūpāṇy asmāc chṛṇuṣva tu ||
ṛgvedaḥ padmapakṣāyatākṣaḥ pralaṅghitāmbaraḥ |
suvibhaktagrīvaḥ kuñcitakeśaśmaśruḥ pramāṇenāpi vitastayaḥ pañca |
sa rājato mauktikajo 'tha pūjyo
varaprado bhaktiyutadvijāya ||
yajurvedaḥ piṅgalākṣaḥ kuśamadhyasthūlagalakapolaḥ tāmravarṇaḥ prādeśāt ṣaḍ dairghyeṇa |
citre liṅte 'tha vā pūjya sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt | sāmavedo nityasragvī suvrataḥ śuciḥ śucivāsā kṣamī dāntaś ca daṇḍī kācanayanaḥ ādityavarṇo varṇena ṣaḍratnimātraḥ | tāmreyamaṇāv indrādyākhyeḍvā pūjitaḥ śubhado bhavet | atharvavedas tīkṣṇaś caṇḍaḥ kāmarūpī viśvātmā viśvakṛt krūra ūrdhvajvālāvān kṣudrakarmā vaṃśasukṛtotthāpī (?) nīlotpalavarṇo varṇena svadāratuṣṭaḥ sauvarṇaḥ padmarāge vā rudrākṣe vā pūjanīyaḥ prapūjya sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
atharvavedavihitāni |
yāvanti vedagītāni puṇyayajñavratāni ca |
tāvanti śravaṇād asya prāpnuyād bhaktibhāvitaḥ ||
aputro labhate putrān adhano dhanam āpnuyāt |
vidyām avidvān āpnoti duḥkhī duḥkhāt pramucyate ||
paṭhitvā sarvadevānāṃ saṃmato dvijavallabhaḥ |
jāyate nātra saṃdeho devī ca varadā sadā ||
iti devīpurāṇoktaṃ devavratam |
[917] saurapurāṇāt |
athātmacaraṇau sthitvā śivakṣetre vasen naraḥ |
dehānte śivasāyujyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇāt |
bhittvā padadvayaṃ vāpi śivakṣetre vaset tu yaḥ |
sa yāti śivatāṃ caitre nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
iti tīvravratam |
śaṅkara uvāca |
ādityagrahaṇe rāma grahaṇe ca niśābhṛtām |
upavāsād avāpnoti sarvasaṃkalpanāśanam ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ tathā jāpyam akṣayyaṃ tat tadā smṛtam |
śrāddhaṃ ca bhārgavaśreṣṭha vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ tathā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktko grahaṇopavāsaḥ |
atha mahātapovratāni |
māse māse ca yaḥ kuryāt trirātrakṣapaṇaṃ budhaḥ |
kauveraṃ lokam āsādya sa vindet paramaṃ padam ||
caturthe 'hani yo bhuṅkte vratavāṃś ca śucir naraḥ |
gāndharvaṃ sa padaṃ prāpya modate śakravad divi ||
pañcame 'hani yo bhuṅkte pratimāsam atandritaḥ |
[918]        vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaiś ca sa gacched divam ūrjitaḥ ||
yo bhuṅkte divase ṣaṣṭhe nityaṃ niyamavān śuciḥ |
vāruṇaṃ lokam āsādya sa vindet paramaṃ padam ||
saptame 'hani yo bhuṅkte jitadvandvo dṛḍhavrataḥ |
ādityalokam āsādya so 'pi vinden mahāśriyam ||
jitadvandvaḥ sahiṣṇuḥ |
aṣṭame 'hani yo bhuṅkte jitadvandvo dṛḍhavrataḥ |
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam āśādya sa bhavet paramadyutiḥ ||
navame 'hani yo bhuṅkte naro niyamam āsthitaḥ |
sa vasūnāṃ priyo bhūtvā carate vasubhiḥ saha ||
daśame 'hani yo bhuṅkte dvādaśāhaphalaṃ labhet |
aśvibhyāṃ ca samo bhūtvā avyayaṃ khelate tathā ||
dvādaśāhaḥ kratuviśeṣaḥ |
ekādaśe tu yo bhuṅkte divase mānavaḥ śuciḥ |
ekādaśāhaṃ saṃprāṣya sa rudragaṇatāṃ vrajet ||
yo dvādaśe tu divase bhuṅkte devi sadā naraḥ |
dvādaśāhaṃ tu saṃprāpya śakraloke mahīyate ||
trayodaśe tu yo nityam aśnāti divase naraḥ |
vaset sa bhārgavasthānaṃ prāpya divyasukānvitam ||
caturdaśe tu divase nityam aśnāti yo naraḥ |
sa vased rudraloke tu śivasāyujyatāṃ vrajet ||
ardhamāsaṃ kṣiped yas tu nityam eva jitendriyaḥ |
devarājena tulyo 'sau bhūtvā svargaṃ ca tiṣṭhati ||
[919]        yas tu māsaṃ kṣiped vīro jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ |
vimānena sa divyena apsarobhiḥ samanvitaḥ ||
sarvalokeṣu vasate janmāny aṣṭāyutāni ca |
tato brahmāsanaṃ prāpya brahmaṇā ca supūjitaḥ |
brahmaloke nivasate yathā brahma narottamaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
māsi māsi trirātrāṇi kṛtvā varṣāṇi dvādaśa |
gaṇādhipatyaṃ prāpnoti niḥsapatnam anāvilam ||
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ ekāhāro bhaven naraḥ |
atirātrasya yajñasya samaṃ phalam upāśnute ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate |
tatkṣayād iha cāgatya māhātmyaṃ pratipadyate ||
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ caturthaṃ bhaktam aśnute |
ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ satyavāg vijitendriyaḥ ||
vājapeyasya yajñasya sa phalaṃ samupāśnute |
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate ||
aṣṭamena tu bhaktena jīvet saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ |
gavāṃ medhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
haṃsasārasayuktena vimānena sa gacchati |
pañcāśat tu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi divi modate ||
pakṣe pakṣe gate rājan yo 'śnīyād varṣam eva tu |
ṣaṇmāsānaśanaṃ tasya bhagavān aṅgirābravīt ||
ṣaṣṭir varṣasahasrāṇi divam āvasate sa ca ||
[920] aśnīyād dvitīye pakṣe sarvadineṣv iti viśeṣaḥ |
vīṇānāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca veṇūnāṃ ca niśāmyate |
sughoṣair madhuraiḥ śabdaiḥ susuptaḥ pratibudhyate ||
saṃvatsaram ihaikaṃ tu māsi māsi pibet payaḥ |
phalaṃ viśvajitas tāta prāpnoti sa narottamaḥ ||
siṃhavyāghraprayuktena vimānena sa gacchati |
gataṃ cāṣṭau surakanyā ramayanti ca taṃ naram ||
saptatiṃ ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇṃ divi modate |
māsād ūrdhvaṃ naravyāghra nopavāso vidhīyate ||
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
yo daridrair api vidhiḥ śakyaḥ prāptuṃ bhavet prabho |
tulyo yajñaphalair eva tan me brūhi pitāmaha ||
bhīṣma uvāca |
yas tu kalyaṃ tathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet |
ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ||
yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇaṃ yo vāsavapriyam āharet |
satyavāk dānaśīlaś ca brahmaśāsanasūcakaḥ ||
kṣānto dānto jitakrodho yat phalaṃ samavāpnuyāt |
pāṇḍurābhapratīkāśe vimāne haṃsalakṣaṇe ||
kalyām iti prātaḥ | pibed udakam apīti śeṣaḥ |
ṣaḍbhir eva ca sa varṣaiḥ sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
devastrīṇām api vasen nṛtyagītaninādite |
prājāpatyaṃ vaset padmaṃ varṣāṇām agnisaṃbhavam ||
[921] padmaṃ koṭiśatam |
trīṇi varṣāṇi yaḥ prāśet satataṃ tv ekabhojanam |
dharmapatnīrato nityam agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet ||
dvitīye divase yas tu prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśa māsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇaṃ yo vāsavapriyam ācaret |
satyavāg dānaśīlaś ca brahmaṇyāś canasūyakaḥ (?) ||
kṣānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ yat phalaṃ samavāpnuyāt (?) |
pāṇḍurābhrapratīkāśe vimāne haṃsalakṣaṇe ||
dve samāpte tataḥ padme so 'psarobhir vaset saha |
samāpte paripūrṇe |
tṛtīye divase yas tu prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
agnikāryaparo nityaṃ nityakāryaprabodhanam |
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam ||
saptarṣīṇāṃ sadā loke so 'psarobhir vaset saha |
nivartanaṃ ca tatrāsya trīṇi padmāni vai viduḥ ||
āsyeti sthitvā |
divase yaś caturthe tu prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sa ca dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam |
sāgarasya ca paryante sarvaloke ca veśayet ||
devarājasya ca krīḍāṃ nityakālam avekṣate |
[922] sāgarasya ca paryantaṃ samudrasaṃkhyāviśeśāntam |
divase pañcame yas tu prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sa ca dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
alubdhaḥ satyavādī ca brahmaṇyaś cāvihiṃśakaḥ |
anasūyur apāpastho dvādaśāhaphalaṃ labhet ||
jāmbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇam |
sūryamālāsamābhāsam ārohet pāṇḍuraṃ gṛham ||
āvartanāni catvāri | tulāpadmāni dvādaśa |
śarāgniparimāṇaṃ ca tathāsau vasate ciram ||
āvartanāni manvantarāṇi tulāpadmāni śataṃpramāni (?) | śarāgniparimāṇaṃ śarāḥ pañca, agnayas trayaḥ | idam api parimāṇaṃ manvantarāṇām eva |
divase yas tu ṣaṣṭe tu muniḥ prāśnīta bhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
sadā triṣavaṇasnāyī brahmacāry anasūyakaḥ |
muniḥ saṃyatavāk |
gavāṃ medhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam |
tathaivāpsarasām aṅke prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate ||
nūpurāṇāṃ ninādena mekhalānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ |
koṭīsahasravarṣāṇi yugakoṭiśatāni ca ||
padmāny aṣṭādaś tathā patāke dve tathaiva ca |
ayutāni ca pañcāśad vṛkṣacarmaśatasya (?) ca |
lomnā pramāṇena samaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ||
[923] patākāḥ saṃkhyāviśeṣaḥ |
divase saptame yas tu prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
sarasvatīṃ gopayāno brahmacaryaṃ samācaret |
sumanovarṇakaṃ caiva madhumāṃsaṃ ca varjayet ||
puruṣo marutāṃ lokam indralokaṃ ca gacchati |
tatra tatra ca siddhārthau devakanyābhir arcyate ||
phalaṃ bahusuvarṇasya yajñasya labhate naraḥ |
saṃkhyām atiguṇāṃ vāpi teṣu lokeṣu modate |
kuṅkumādi atiguṇam | atikrāntaguṇānām aparimitām iti yāvat |
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ bhuṅkte 'hany aṣṭame naraḥ |
devakāryaparo nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam ||
pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anukramam |
padmavarṇanibhaṃ caiva vimānam adhirohati ||
kṛṣṇāḥ kanakagaurāś ca nāryaḥ śyāmās tathā parāḥ |
vayorūpasamāyuktā labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte navame navame 'hani |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai huhvāno jātavedasam ||
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
puṇḍarīkaprakāśaṃ vai vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ ||
dīptasūryāgnitejobhir divyamālābhir eva ca |
[924]        nīyate rudrakanyābhiḥ so 'ntarikṣaṃ sanātanam ||
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ kalpam eva ca |
koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca teṣu lokeṣu modate ||
yas tu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte daśāhe vai gate gate |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
gate prāpte tathā brahmakanyā cāmaravijitā |
kurute tatra sā krīḍā sarvabhūtamanohare ||
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam |
rūpavatyaś ca taṃ kanyā ramayanti sadā naram ||
ekādaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ |
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃś ca juhvāno jātavedasam ||
parastriyaṃ nābhilaṣed vācātha manasāpi vā ||
anṛtaṃ ca na bhāṣeta mātāpitroḥ kṛte 'pi ca |
abhigacchen mahādevaṃ vimānasthaṃ mahābalam ||
rudrāṇāṃ tam adhīvāsaṃ divi divyaṃ manoramam |
varṣāṇāṃ parimeyāni yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ ||
koṭīśatasahasraṃ ca koṭiśataśatāni ca |
rudraṃ nityaṃ praṇamate devadānavasaṃmataḥ ||
sa tasmai darśanaṃ prāpto divase divase bhavet |
divase dvādaśe yas tu prāpte vai prāśate haviḥ ||
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam |
ādityadvādaśābhāsaṃ vimānaṃ so 'dhirohati ||
aṣṭamaharddhisaṃyuktaṃ brahmaloke pratiṣṭhitam |
[925]        nityam āvasathaṃ rājan naranārīsamākulam |
trayodaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte bhuñjate haviḥ ||
sadā dvādaśamāsāṇ vai devasattraphalaṃ labhet |
ratnapadmodayaṃ nāma vimānaṃ sādhayen naraḥ ||
tatra śaṅkupatāke dve yugāntaṃ kalpam eva ca |
ayutāyutaṃ tathā padmaṃ samudraṃ ca tathā vaset ||
śaṅkupatākāprabhṛtayaḥ patākāviśeṣaḥ |
gītagandharvaghoṣaiś ca bherīpaṇavaniḥsvanaiḥ |
sadā pramuditas tābhir devakanyābhir ījyate ||
caturdaśe tu divase yaḥ sadā prāśayed dhaviḥ |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai mahāmedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
anirdeśyavayorūpā devakanyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ |
mṛṣṭataptāṅgadadharā vimānai rūpayānti tam ||
kalahaṃsavinirghoṣair nūpurāṇāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ |
kāṃcīnāṃ ca samutkarṣais tatra tatra vibodhyate ||
devakanyānivāse ca tasmin vasati mānavaḥ |
jāhnavīvālukākīr me (?) pūrṇasaṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ||
yas tu pakṣe gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ jitendriyaḥ |
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃs tu juhvāno jātavedasam ||
rājasūyasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam |
yānam ārohate dviyaṃ haṃsabarhiṇasevitam ||
manimaṇḍalakaiś citraṃ jātarūpasamāvṛtam |
divyābharaṇaśobhābhir varastrībhir alaṃkṛtam ||
[926]        ekastambhaṃ caturdvāraṃ saptabhaumaṃ sumaṅgalam |
vaijayantīsahasraiś ca śobhitaṃ gītanisvanaiḥ ||
divyadivyaguṇopetaṃ vimānam adhirohati |
maṇimuktāpravālaiś ca bhūṣitaṃ vaidyutaprabham ||
vased yugasahasraṃ ca khaḍgakuñjaravāhanaḥ |
ṣoḍaṣe divase prāpte yaḥ kuryād ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai somayajñaphalaṃ labhet ||
somakanyānivāseṣu so 'dhyāvasati nityaśaḥ |
saumyagandhānuliptaś ca kāmācāragatir bhavet ||
sudarśanābhir nārībhir mudhurābhis tathaiva ca |
arcyate vai vimānasthaḥ kāmabhogaiś ca sevyate ||
phalaṃ padmaśataprakṣyaṃ mahākalpaṃ daśādhikam |
āvartanāni catvāri sādhayec cāpy asau naraḥ ||
divase saptadaśame yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
sthānaṃ vāruṇam aindraṃ ca rudraṃ cāpy adhigacchati |
mārutośanasaṃ caiva brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
tatra daivatakanyābhir āsane nopacaryate |
bhūr bhuvaś cāpi devarṣiṃ viśvarūpam avekṣate ||
tatra devādhidevasya kumāryo ramayanti taṃ |
dvātriṃśadrūpadāriṇyo madhurāḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
candrādityāv ubhau yāvad gagaṇe carataḥ prabho |
tāvac caraty asau vīraḥ sudhāmṛtarasāśanaḥ ||
[927]        aṣṭādaśe yo divase prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai saptalokān sa paśyati ||
rathaiḥ sanandighoṣaiś ca pṛṣṭhataḥ so 'nugamyate |
devakanyābhir ūḍhais tu bhrājamānaiḥ svalaṃkṛtaiḥ ||
vyāghrasiṃhaprayuktaṃ ca meghasvananināditam |
vimānam uttamaṃ divyaṃ sumukhī hy adhirohati ||
tatra kalpasahasraṃ sa kanyābhiḥ saha modate |
sudhārasaṃ ca bhuñjīta amṛtopamam uttamam ||
ekonaviṃśatidine yo bhuṅkte ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai saptalokān sa paśyati ||
uttamaṃ labhate sthānam apsarogaṇasevitam |
gandharvai rūpagītaṃ ca vimānaṃ sūryavarcasam ||
tatrāmaravarastrībhir modate vigatajvaraḥ |
divyāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān ayutānāṃ śataṃ śatam ||
pūrṇe 'tha viṃśe divase yo bhuṅkte tv ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃs tu satyavādī dhṛtavrataḥ ||
amāṃsāśī brahmacārī sarvabhūtahite rataḥ |
sa lokān vipulān ramyān ādityānām upāśnute ||
gandharvair apsarobhiś ca divyamālyānulepanaiḥ |
vimānaiḥ kāñcanair divyaiḥ pṛṣṭhataś cānugamyate ||
ekaviṃśe tu divase yo bhuṅkte hy ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
lokarbhośanasaṃ (?) divyaṃ śakralokaṃ ca gacchati |
[928]        aśvinor marutāṃ caiva sukheṣv abhirataḥ sadā |
anabhijñaś ca duḥkhānāṃ vimānavaram āsthitaḥ ||
sevyamāno varastrībhiḥ krīḍaty amaravat prabhuḥ |
dvāviṃśe divase prāpte yo bhuṅkte hy ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
ahiṃsānirato dhīmān satyavāg anasūyakaḥ (?) |
lokān vasūnām āpnoti divākarasamaprabhaḥ ||
kāmacārī sudhāhārī vimānavaram āsthitaḥ |
ramate devakanyābhir divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
trayodaśe tu divase yaḥ prāśed ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsāṃs tu mitāhāro jitendriyaḥ ||
vāyorusanaś caiva rudralokaṃ ca gacchati |
kāmacārī kāmagamaḥ pūjyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ ||
anekaguṇaparyantaṃ vimānavaram āsthitaḥ |
ramate devakanyābhir divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
caturviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāśed ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
ādityānām adhīvāse modamāno vasec ciram |
ramate devakanyānāṃ sahasrair (?) vāyutais tathā |
pañcaviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāśed ekabhojanam ||
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai puṣkalaṃ yānam āruhan |
rathaiḥ sanandaghoṣais tu pṛṣṭhato hy anugamyate ||
devakanyāsamārūḍhaiḥ rājatair vimalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
[929]        tatra kalpasahasraṃ vai ramate strīśatāvṛtaḥ ||
bhojyaṃ rasaṃ ca labhate sadā te amṛtopamam |
ṣaḍviṃśe divase yas tu prāśnīyād ekabhojanam ||
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai niyato niyatāśanaḥ |
jitendriyo vītarāgo juhvāno jātavedasam ||
saṃprāpnoti mahābhāga pūjyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ |
saptānāṃ marutāṃ lokān vasūnāṃ ca samaśnute ||
gandharvair apsarobhiś ca pūjyamānaḥ samaśnute |
dve yugānāṃ sahasre tu divi divyena tejasā ||
saptaviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāśed ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai juhvāno jātavedasam ||
phalam āpnoti vipulaṃ devaloke ca modate |
amṛtāśī vasaṃs tatra sa vai tṛptaḥ prapūjyate ||
strībhir manobhir āmābhī ramamāṇo madotkaṭaḥ |
yugakalpasahasrāṇi trīṇy āvasati vai sukham ||
yo 'ṣṭāviṃśe tu divase prāśnīyād ekabhojanam |
sadā dvādaśamāsān vai jitātmā ca jitendriyaḥ ||
phalaṃ devarṣicaritaṃ vipulaṃ samupāśnute |
bhogāṃs tejasāyuktaḥ svarge ravir ivāmalaḥ ||
sukumāryaś ca taṃ nāryo ramamāṇāḥ suvarcasaḥ |
ramayanti manaḥkānte vimāne sūryavarcase ||
sarvakāmayute divye kalpāyutaśataṃ samāḥ |
ekonatriṃśe divase yaḥ prāśed ekabhojanam ||
[930]        sadā dvādaśamāsān vai satyavrataparāyaṇaḥ |
tasya lokāḥ śubhā divyā divyagandhaguṇānvitāḥ ||
tatra vaitaṃ śubhā nāryo divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
mano'bhirāmā madhurā ramayanti madotkaṭāḥ ||
bhogavāṃs tejasā yukto vaiśvānarasamaprabhaḥ |
divyo divyena vapuṣā bhrājamāna ivāmaraḥ ||
vasūnāṃ marutāṃ caiva sādhyānām aśvinos tathā |
rudrāṇāṃ ca tathā lokān brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
yas tu māse gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ samātmakaḥ |
sadā dvādaś vai māsān brahmaloke gatir bhavet ||
sudhārasakṛtāhāraḥ śrīmān sarvamanoharaḥ |
tejasā vapuṣā yukto bhrājate raśmimān iva ||
svayaṃprabhābhir nārībhir vimānastho mahīyate ||
rudradevarṣikanyābhiḥ satataṃ cābhipūjyate |
yāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu jambūdvīpe 'bhivarṣati ||
tāvat saṃvatsarāḥ proktā brahmalokasya dhīmataḥ |
vipruśaś caiva yāvantyo nipatanti nabhasthālāt ||
varṣāsu varṣatas tāvan nivasaty amaraprabhaḥ |
yāvadityādi | jambūdvīpeṣu ca varṣāsu varṣasahasraṃ dhīmato devasya vṛṣṭikurvato yāvanto vipruṣo jalakaṇā nabhasthalān nipatanti tāvantaḥ saṃvatsarān brahmaloke vasatīty arthaḥ |
māsopavāsī varṣais tu daśabhiḥ svargyam uttamam |
maharṣitvam athāsādya saśarīragatir bhavet ||
[931]        munir dānto jitakrodho jitaśiśnodaras tathā |
juhvann agnau niyamataḥ saṃdhyopāsanasevitā ||
bahubhir niyamair evaṃ māsam aśnāti yo naraḥ |
abhrāvakāśaśīlasya tasya vāso nirupyate ||
divaṃ gatvā śarīreṇa svena rājan yathāmaraḥ |
svarge puṇyaṃ yathākāmaṃ nṛpa bhuṅkte yathāvidhi ||
upavāsaniyamān kṛtvā gacchec ca paramāṃ gatim |
tathā vaiśyāś ca śūdrāś ca upavāsaṃ prakurvate ||
trirātraṃ dvitrirātraṃ ca tayoḥ puṣṭir na vidyate |
caturthabhaktakṣapaṇaṃ vaiśyaśūdre 'bhidhīyate ||
trirātraṃ tu na dharmajñair vihitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ |
iti mahātapovratāni |
rāma uvāca |
kṛcchrāṇāṃ śrotum icchāmi nāmāni ca vidhiṃ tathā |
etam me brūhi dharmajñatvaṃ hi vetsi yathātatham ||
puṣkara uvāca |
kṛcchrāṇy etāni karyāṇi rāma varṇatrayeṇa ca |
kṛcchreṣv eteṣu śūdrasya nādhikāro vidhīyate ||
ādau tu maṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ sarvakṛcchreṣu bhārgava |
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānaṃ keśavasya ca pūjanam ||
homaḥ pavitramantraiś ca tathā tadgata eva ca |
[932]        strīśūdrapatitānāṃ ca tathālāpaṃ vivarjayet ||
etat kṛcchreṣu sarveṣu kartavyam aviśeṣataḥ |
vīrāsanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ kāmato 'tha yathāvidhi ||
vīrāsanena hīnaṃ ca vidhihīnaṃ prakīrtitam |
rāma uvāca |
vīrāsanam ahaṃ tattvaṃ śrotum icchāmi suvrata |
vīrāsanena sahitaṃ kṛcchraṃ bahuguṇaṃ yathā ||
puṣkara uvāca |
utthitas tu divā tiṣṭhed upatiṣṭhet tathā niśi |
etad vīrāsanaṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
āmikṣayā tu dvau māsau pakvena payasā tathā |
aṣṭarātraṃ tathā dadhnā trirātram api sarpiṣā ||
nirāhāras trirātraṃ tu kuryād uddālakavratam |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā ||
snāpayed ātmano 'rthāya pāvakaṃ bhṛgunandana |
vahnau tato 'nujuhuyād aghātena ca kasyacit ||
brahmadeveti mantreṇa sādyamāno vicakṣaṇaḥ |
darbhāṃs tu khalu badhnīyād rakṣārtham iti ca stutiḥ ||
śritaṃ ca snāpyamānaṃ ca bhāṇḍe nyastaṃ tathā punaḥ |
anena rāma mantreṇa naras trir abhimantrayet ||
yavo 'si dhānyarājo 'si vāruṇaṃ madhusaṃyutam |
vicchede sarvapāpānāṃ pavitram ṛṣibhiḥ stutam ||
ghṛtaṃ yavā madhu yavā āpo hi amṛtaṃ yavāḥ |
[933]        sarvaṃ punīta me pāpaṃ yan mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ durvicintatam |
alakṣmīṃ nāśayaty eva sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ ||
śvaśūkarāvalīḍhaṃ ca uṣṭrādyupahataṃ ca yat |
mātur guroś ca śuśrūṣā sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ ||
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca śūdrānnaṃ śrāddhasūtakam |
caurasyānnaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ |
bālavṛddham adharmaṃ ca rājadvāragataṃ ca yat ||
suvarṇastainyajaṃ vrātyam ayājyasya ca yājanam |
brāhmaṇānāṃ parīvādaṃ sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ ||
bhāṇḍe nyastasya mantro 'yaṃ tatas tu parikīrtayet ||
ye devā madano jātāḥ manoyutāḥ te sudakṣā dakṣapitāras te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tubhyaḥ |
anenātmani dharmajña juhuyād ātmanaḥ sadā |
na kuryād atisauhityaṃ brahma etad dhi yāvakam ||
ye cārthinas trirātraṃ tu ṣaḍrātram api yāpitaḥ |
upapātakinā proktaṃ saptarātram ariṃdama |
mahāpātakayuktas tu ṣaḍrātraṃ dviguṇaṃ smṛtam ||
ekaviṃśatirātreṇa kāmān āpnoti vāñchitam ||
māsena sarvapāpebhyo mokṣam āpnoty asaṃśayam |
gavāṃ nihāranirmuktair yavaiḥ kṛtvātaitad eva (?) tu ||
phalaṃ prāpnoti dharmajña tathā daśaguṇaṃ dhruvam |
māsena mokṣān tridaśāṇ vedān vidyāś ca paśyati ||
[934]        varaśāpasamarthaś ca tathā bhavati bhārgava |
ekaikavṛddhyā hy aśayān piṇḍāṃś chikhyaṇḍasaṃmitān ||
ekaikaṃ hrāsayet kṛṣṇe pratipratprabhṛti kramāt |
haviṣyaṃ ca mahābhāga nāśnīyāc candrasaṃkṣaye ||
etac cāndrāyaṇaṃ proktaṃ yavamadhyaṃ mahāmuniḥ |
etad eva viparyastaṃ vājimedhyaṃ (-madhyaṃ ?) prakīrtitam ||
aṣṭabhiḥ pratyahaṃ grāsair yavaiś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
tathā kathaṃcit piṇḍānāṃ catvāriṃśac chatadvayam ||
māsena bhakṣayed etat suracāndrāyaṇaṃ bhavet |
gokṣīraṃ saptarātraṃ ca dve sure ca caṣṭayam (?) ||
surātrayāt saptarātraṃ saptarātrāt surādvayam |
surā eyeṇa (trayeṇa?) ṣabhrātraṃ (ṣaḍrātraṃ?) trirātraṃ vāyunā bhavet ||
etat somāyanaṃ nāma vrataṃ kalmaṣanāśanam |
tryahaṃ pibed apas tūṣṇāḥ tryaham uṣṇaṃ payaḥ pibet ||
tryahaṃ uṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavet tryaham |
taptakṛcchram idaṃ proktaṃ śītaḥ śītaṃ prakīrtitam ||
kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasān ekaviṃśatiḥ |
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam ||
ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ smṛtam |
etac ca pratyahābhyastaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ smṛtam ||
tryahābhyastam athaikaikaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ smṛtam |
kṛtsnaṃ parākasaṃjñaṃ syāt dvādaśāham abhojanam ||
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca |
[935]        upavāsena caikena kṛcchrapādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
etad eva trir abhyastaṃ śiśukṛcchraṃ prakīrtitam |
tryahaṃ prātas tryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryaham adyād ayācitam ||
tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyāt prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ |
piṇyākacanatakrāmbusaktūnāṃ prativāsaram ||
ekaikam upavāsaś ca saumyakṛcchraṃ prakīrtitam |
ambusiddhais tathā māsaṃ kevalaṃ vāruṇaṃ samaiḥ ||
phalair māsena kathitaṃ phalakṛcchraṃ manīṣibhiḥ |
śrīkṛcchraṃ śrīphalaiḥ proktaṃ padmākṣair aparaṃ tathā |
māsam āmalakair eva śrīkṛcchram aparaṃ smṛtam ||
patrair yutaṃ patrakṛcchraṃ puṣpais tat kṛcchram ucyate |
mūlakṛcchraṃ tathā mūlais toyakṛcchraṃ jalena tu ||
dadhnā kṣīreṇa takreṇa piṇyākacanakais tathā |
śākaṃ māsaṃ tu kāryāṇi svanāmāni vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
sāyaṃ prātaś ca bhuñjāno naro yenāntarā pibet |
ṣaḍbhir varṣair idaṃ proktaṃ kṛcchraṃ nityopavāsinā ||
ekabhaktena māsena kathitaṃ caikabhaktakam |
naktena bhojayed yas tu naktakṛcchraṃ ca vatsarāt ||
naktoṣitas (?) tu dharmajña ekabhaktaś ca vā punaḥ |
tryahaṃ sopavased yas tu snāyīta savanatrayam ||
nimagnaś ca tathaivāpsu triḥ paṭhed aghamarṣaṇam |
devatābhāvavṛttaṃ tu chandaś caivāpy anuṣṭubham ||
saṃsmaret tasya ca tathā ṛṣīṃ caivāghamarṣaṇam |
[936]        caturthe 'hani dātavyā brāhmaṇāya payasvinī ||
tryahaṃ japed yathāśakti śuciś caivāghamarṣaṇam |
bhāvavṛttaḥ smṛto devas tathā ca puruṣa paraḥ ||
taddaivatyaṃ vijānīyāt sūktaṃ tad aghamarṣaṇam |
yathāśvamedhe kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ ||
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ vā kutapaṃ parīdhāyātha valkalam ||
