saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kuryāt sacitraṃ rāma bhārgava |
gṛhaṃ na praviśet tatra bhaved ākāśaśāyakaḥ ||
aśakto vā bhaved rāma mahāśailaguhāśayaḥ |
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī tathāsya dviśvasaṃbhava ||
bhaikṣaśākaphalāhāraḥ kāmaṃ syād dvijasattama |
vīrāsanaṃ tathā kuryāt kāṣṭhamaunaṃ tathaiva ca ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ hy etat sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
vāyavyaṃ kṛcchrasūktaṃ tu pāṇipūrānnabhojanam ||
māsenaikena dharmajña sarvakalmaṣanāśanam |
tilair dvādaśarātreṇa kṛcchram āgneyam ucyate ||
rājaprasṛtim apy ekaṃ kanakena samanvitam |
bhuñjānasya tathā māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ canadadaivatam ||
sarvān harītakīyuktair yavaiḥ saktūn samagrataḥ |
yāmyakṛcchraṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ māsena bhṛgunandana ||
gomūtreṇa caret snānaṃ vṛttiṃ gomayam ācaret |
gavāṃ madhye sadā tiṣṭhed gopurīṣe ca saṃviśet ||
[937]        gosv apītāsu na pibed udakaṃ bhṛgunandana |
abhuktavatsu nāśnīyād utthitāsūtthito bhavet ||
tathā caivopaviṣṭāsu sarvāsūpaviśen naraḥ |
māsenaikena kathitaṃ govrataṃ kalmaṣāpaham ||
anākṛcchraṃ tadaivetad ajāmadhye tu vartinaḥ |
trirāśinas tuṣād ātmā santulpe na phalair ubhe ||
dvādaśāhena kathite sarvapātakanāśane |
upoṣitaś caturdaśyāṃ pañcadaśyām anantaram ||
pañcagavyaṃ samaśnīyād dhaviṣyāśī tv anantaram |
brahmakūrcam idaṃ kuryād uktapraśamanāya vai ||
pakṣānte tv atha vā kāryaṃ māsamadhye 'tha vā punaḥ |
brahmakūrcaṃ naraḥ kuryāt paurṇamāsīṣu yaḥ sadā |
tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti durbhuktādi na saṃśayaḥ ||
māsena dvir naraḥ kṛtvā brahmakūrcaṃ samāhitaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmukto yatheṣṭāṃ gatim āpnuyāt ||
brahmabhūtam amāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tathaiva ca |
yogabhūtaṃ paricaran keśavaṃ sahasāpnuyāt ||
evam etāni kṛcchrāṇi kathitāni mayā tava |
śamitānīha pāpāni duritāni ca bhārgava ||
saṃvatsarasyaikam api caret kṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ |
ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ ||
ajñātaṃ yadi vā jñātaṃ kṛcchrapāpaṃ viśodhayet |
[938]        kṛcchrasaṃśuddhapāpānāṃ narakaṃ na vidhīyate ||
śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaś ca svargakāmas tathaiva ca |
devatārādhanaparas tathā kṛcchraṃ samācaret ||
rasāyanāni mantrāś ca tathā caivauṣadhāś ca ye |
tasya sarve 'pi siddhyanti yo naraḥ kṛcchakṛd bhavet ||
vaidikāni ca karmāṇi yāni kāmyāni kānicit |
siddhyanti sarvāṇi tadā kṛcchrakartur bhṛgūttama ||
tejasas tasya saṃyogo mahataś caiva jāyate |
vāñchitān mānasān kamān sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||
jñāto bhavati deveṣu tathā ṛṣigaṇeṣv api |
vipāpmā vitamaskaś ca saṃśuddhaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
ārādhanārthaṃ puruṣottamasya
kṛcchrāṇi kṛtvā madhusūdanasya |
pāpair vimuktaḥ pariśuddhacittaḥ
kāmān avāpnoti yathepsitāṃś ca ||
āyātu bhagavān brahmā sa munir haṃsavāhanaḥ |
tapoyajñavratānāṃ tu bhartā devaś caturmukhaḥ ||
āhvaya padmayoniṃ tu mantreṇānena mantravit |
devasya ceti mantreṇa bhaktitas taṃ samarcayet ||
arghyair dhūpaiḥ pavitraiś ca mātrayā kusumaiḥ phalaiḥ |
mūlair balyupahāraiś ca naivedyair vividhair api |
dīpadānair yathāśaktyā japena stutimaṅgalaiḥ |
tadagre pañcagavyaṃ tu kurvīta susamāhitaḥ ||
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyās tv aṣṭamāṣakasaṃkhyayā |
[939]        puṇyaṃ varuṇadaivatyaṃ gāyatryā cābhimantraṇam ||
gomūtraṃ śvetavarṇāyāś caturmāṣakamātrakam |
gṛhṇīyād agnidevasya gandhadvāreti vai śanaiḥ ||
payaḥ kāñcanavarṇāyā somadaivatyam eva ca |
āpyāyasveti mantreṇa māṣakadvādaśāntikam ||
gṛhṇanti vāyudaivatyaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇodbhavaṃ dadhi |
daśamāṣakamātraṃ tu dadhikrāvṇa iti smaran ||
ghṛtaṃ tu nīlavarṇāyāḥ pañcamāṣakasaṃkhyayā |
gṛhṇanti sūryadaivatyaṃ tejo 'sīti japan kramāt ||
śatatrayaṃ māṣakānāṃ catvāriṃśac ca pañca ca |
kuśodakasya gṛhṇīta devasya tveti kīrtayet ||
tāmrapātre palāśe vā pātre miśrīkṛtaṃ ca yat |
āpohiṭheti cāloḍya praṇavena pibanti ca ||
udaṅmukhas trir ācamya tato gacchet sa tadgṛham |
tatrāgnihomaṃ prāgūḍhaṃ kṛtvā dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
brāhmaṇebhyo yathāśaktyā bhojanaṃ ca manoharam |
gavāṃ varṇās tu śuklādyāḥ santi śeṣeṣu yatra ca |
tatra varṇavibhāgena pañcagavyāni cāharet ||
varṇālābhān na doṣo 'sti mātrāhīnaṃ vivarjayet |
tyājyāni dūṣitānāṃ ca na vinmūtrapayāṃsi ca ||
prasaktānāṃ ca śukreṇa prakṣatānāṃ ca śoṇitam |
cailakeśyāś ca bhakṣāṇām abhaktaiḥ saṃpṛtān tathā ||
rogārtānāṃ ca pūrṇādyair mṛtāṇḍānām amaṅgalaiḥ |
[940]        niṣphalatvena vṛddhānāṃ kṛśānāṃ kṛmibhis tathā ||
anatiprītidattāni sādhanāprabhavāṇi ca |
śuddhabhāṇḍe manojñe tu bhūmāv apatitāni tu ||
gṛhītavyāni vidhinā khedattāsāṃ na kārayet |
brahmakūrcavratam idaṃ sarvapāpapranāśanam ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ rūpārogyayaśaskaram |
mahatām api pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ śrīvivardhanam ||
iti brahmapurāṇoktaṃ brahmakūrcavratam |
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ |
karmaṇā kena puruṣaḥ kim āpnoti mahāmate |
etan me saṃśayaṃ chindhi dvijānāṃ dvijasattama ||
haṃsa uvāca |
dānena bhogī bhavati tapasā vindate mahat |
vṛddhopasevayā vipra prājño bhavati mānavaḥ ||
yajñena lokān āpnoti satyena ca parāṃ gatim |
snānena śuddhim āpnoti prāṇāyāmād viśeṣataḥ ||
dhyānena dhāraṇābhis tu padam āpnoty anuttamam |
damane sarvam āpnoti yat kiṃcin manasi sthitam ||
śaucena devāḥ prīyante prīyante copavāsataḥ |
upavāsavratasthānāṃ kāmāvāptir dhruvaṃ bhavet ||
bhavanti vipulā bhogāḥ saṃgrāmeṣv apalāyinām |
[941]        madhumāṃsanivṛttasya sarva eva manorathāḥ ||
māṃsāśananivṛtto 'pi paraṃ saukhyam upāśnute |
ahiṃsayā tv arogī syād dīrghāyuś cāpy ahiṃsayā ||
rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyadhanadhānyayutaḥ sadā |
tīrthānusaraṇād viprāḥ pāpanāśam avāpnuyāt ||
sarvakalmaṣahīnas tu yān lokān manasīcchati |
pratiśrayapradānena sthānam āpnoty anuttamam ||
pūjya pūjayitā viprā yaśasā yujyate naraḥ |
abhivādanaśīlasya nityaṃ vṛddhopasevinaḥ ||
samaṃ kṛtvā vivardhante kīrtim āyur yaśo balam |
ṛtukālād ṛte bhāryāṃ tathaiva parivarjayet ||
pānīyam api viprendrā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati |
anenaiva vidhānena deśakālaśanair naraḥ ||
sarvakāmān avāpnoti gatiṃ prāpnoty abhīpsitām |
tathā bhojanakāle tu yas tu maunaṃ samācaret ||
upavāsaphalaṃ tasya pratyahaṃ bhojanasya tu |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti maunī naktāśanaḥ sakṛt ||
nāpnoti narakaṃ duḥkhaṃ nityasnāyī naro yadi |
yo dadyād aparikliṣṭam annam adhvanivartine ||
śāntāyādṛṣṭapūrvāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat |
pādyam āsanam evātha dīpam annaṃ pratiśrayam ||
dadyād atithipūjārthaṃ sa yakṣaḥ pañcadakṣiṇaḥ |
cakṣur dadyān mano dadyād vācaṃ dadyāc ca sūnṛtām ||
[942]        anuvrajed upākṣīṇaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ |
puṣpāśināṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ dhanaṃ śākāśināṃ mahat ||
payobhakṣā divaṃ yānti abhakṣāś cāmitāṃ gatim |
dattolūkhalako vipro yaś cāpy uñchena jīvati ||
kāpotī māsy ito vṛttiṃ yatheṣṭāṃ gatim āpnuyāt |
prāyopaveśanāḍ rājyaṃ sarvatra phalam ucyate |
yena prīṇāti pitaraṃ tena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
prīṇāti mātaraṃ yena pṛthivī tena pūjitā |
yena prīṇāty upādhyāyaṃ tena syād brahmapūjitam ||
sarve tasyādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ |
anādṛtās tu yasyaite sarvā tasyāphalā kriyā ||
guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā nityaśrāddhena santatiḥ |
nityasnāyī bhaved dakṣaḥ saṃdhye tu dve japet sadā ||
dvijaśuśrūṣayā rājyaṃ dvijatvaṃ vāpi puṣkalam |
devaśuśrūṣayā kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ prāpnuyāt tataḥ ||
sāntvadaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokaiḥ prapūjyate ||
paricaryāturaṃ samyak na rogaiḥ paribhūyate |
gogokam āpnoti tathā gavāṃ ca paricaryayā ||
devamālyāpanayanāt pādaśaucād dvijasya tu |
śrāntasaṃvāhanād viprāḥ sukham atyantam aśnute ||
jale saptasahasrāṇi ekādaśa hutāśane |
bhṛguprapāte ca daśa saṃgrāme viṃśatis tathā ||
naro varṣasahasrāṇi tanuṃ tyaktvā tu modate |
[943]        anāśake tu dharmajñāḥ parisaṃkhyā na vidyate ||
meroḥ sādhayate rājyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhuvi jāyate |
puṇyaprasthānam āviśya yatheṣṭāṃ gatim āpnuyāt ||
vahnipraveśe niyatam abhīṣṭaṃ lokam aśnute |
vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnoti tyaktvāmbhasi tanuṃ naraḥ ||
śaṣpaṃ mṛgamukhotśṛṣṭaṃ (?) yo mṛgaiḥ saha sevate |
dīkṣito vai mudā yuktaḥ sa gacchaty amarāvatīm ||
śaivalaṃ śīrṇaparṇaṃ vā tad vrataṃ yo niṣevate |
śītayogavahe nityaṃ sa gacchet paramāṃ gatim ||
vāyubhakṣorubhokṣo (?) vā phalamūlāśano 'pi vā |
yākṣam aiśvaryam āpnoti modate 'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ||
agniyogavahe grīṣme vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
dīrghadvādaśavarṣāṇi rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ||
āhāraniyamaṃ kṛtvā munir dvādaśavārṣikam |
vrataṃ samāpya kālena rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ||
sthaṇḍile śuddham ākāśaṃ parigṛhya samantataḥ |
praviśya ca mudāyukto dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm ||
sthaṇḍilasya phalāny āha yānāni śayanāni ca |
gṛhāṇi śayanārhāṇi candraśubhrāṇi brāhmaṇa ||
ātmānam upajīvan yo niyato niyatāśanaḥ |
dehaṃ vānaśane tyaktvā sa svargaṃ samupāśnute ||
ātmānam upajīvan yo dīrghadvādaśavārṣikī
aśmanā caraṇau datvā guṇakeṣu ca modate ||
[944]        sādhayitvātmanātmānaṃ nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ |
tīrtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi dīkṣām ekāṃ manogatām |
svargalokam avāpnoti pitṛbhiḥ saha modate ||
svātmānam upajīvan yo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣikīm |
tyaktvā mahāhave dehaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokam āpnuyāt ||
ātmānam upajīvan yo dīkṣāṃ dvādaśavārṣiṅīṃ |
hutāgnau deham utsṛjya vahniloke mahīyate ||
yas tu vipro yathānyāyaṃ dīkṣito niyatendriyaḥ |
ātmanātmānam ādhāya nirdvandvo dharmalālasaḥ ||
tīrtvā dvādaśavarṣāṇi dīkṣām etām arogatām |
araṇīsahitaḥ skandhe tīrthāṭanavidhiṃ caret ||
vīrādhvānam avānītya vīrāsanagataḥ sadā |
vīrasthāyī ca satataṃ sa vīragatim āpnuyāt ||
vīraloke gate vīro vīrayogāvahaḥ sadā |
mattvasya sarvam utsṛjya dīkṣito niyataḥ śuciḥ |
śakralokagataḥ śrīmān modate divi devavat ||
upavratāḥ śucir dāntā ahiṃsāḥ satyavādinaḥ |
saṃsiddhāḥ pretya gandharvaiḥ saha modanty anāmayam ||
maṇḍūkayogaśayano yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhi |
dīkṣāṃ carati dharmātmā sa nāgaiḥ saha modate ||
ārdravāsās tu śiśire vrataṃ vahati yo naraḥ |
dvādaśābdāni niyataṃ rājā bhavati pārthivaḥ ||
vṛkṣavanagatān prāṇān saptapūrvāparāṃs tathā |
[945]        narāṃs tārayate duḥkhād ātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
yena yena śarīreṇa yat yat karma karoti yaḥ |
tena tena śarīreṇa tat phalaṃ hi samaśnute ||
yasyāṃ yasyām avasthāyāṃ yat karoti śubhāśubham |
tasyāṃ tasyām avasthāyāṃ tat phalaṃ samupāśnute ||
mahābhāratāt |
phalamūlāśināṃ rājyaṃ svargaḥ parṇāśināṃ bhavet |
payobhakṣo divaṃ yāti sthānena draviṇodakaḥ ||
gavādyaḥ śākadīkṣābhiḥ svargam āhus tṛṇāśinām |
striyas triṣavaṇasnānād vāyuṃ pītvā kratuṃ labhet ||
nityasnāyī labhed rājyaṃ sandhye tu dve jayaṃ dvijaḥ |
sendraṃ sādhayate rājyaṃ nākapṛṣṭham anāśakaḥ ||
sthaṇḍile tu śayānānāṃ gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca |
rasānāṃ pratisadvāre saubhāgyam abhividyate (?) ||
āmiṣapratisaṃhāre prajā āyuṣmatī bhavet |
udavāsaṃ vased yas tu sa narādhipatir bhavet ||
pratisaṃhāraḥ parityāgaḥ, udavāsaḥ udake vāsaḥ |
satyavāsī naraśreṣṭho daivataiḥ saha modate ||
gandhamālyānuvṛttyā tu kāntir bhavati puṣkalā |
keśaśmaśru dhārayati tām agryāṃ vasatiṃ labhet ||
upavāsaṃ ca dīkṣāṃ cāpy abhiṣekaṃ ca parthivaḥ |
kṛtvā dvādaś varṣāṇi vāsavatvād viśiṣyate ||
avākśirās tu yo lambed udavāsaṃ vasec ca yaḥ |
[946]        satataṃ caikasādhī yaḥ sa labhed īpsitāṃ gatim ||
paraṃ vindati dānena maunenātmā pratīcchati |
upabhogāṃś ca tapasā brahmacaryeṇa jīvitam ||
rūpam aiścaryam ārogyam ahiṃsāphalam ucyate |
prāyopaveśanād rājyaṃ sarvatra phalam aśnute ||
svargaṃ satyena labhate dīkṣayā kulam uttamam |
adhītya sarvavedān vai sadyo duḥkhāt pramucyate ||
mānasaṃ tu varaṃ dharmaṃ svargalokam avāpyate |
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ |
kaṃ lokaṃ karmaṇā kena saṃprāpnoti narottamaḥ |
tattvam asmākam ācakṣva tvaṃ hi sarvavid ucyate ||
haṃsa uvāca |
jyeṣṭhaṃ svasāraṃ pitaraṃ guruṃ mātaram eva ca |
nityaṃ saṃpūjayed bhaktyā yāmyaloke mahīyate ||
bhojanāvasathādyena tv atithiṃ caiva pūjayet |
rājarājasya lokeṣu modate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
meroḥ samīpaṃ gacchanti yathā caivottarān kurūn |
nityaṃ dānaparāḥ śāntā lokaṃ (?) gacchanti śītagoḥ ||
ādityalokaṃ gacchanti yathā yena paristhitāḥ |
tīrthayātrāṃ parāṃ yānti tathā lokaṃ pracetasaḥ ||
saṃgrāme nihatā yānti śakralokam asaṃśayam |
prājāpatyaṃ tathā yānti samyag datvā mahīkṣitaḥ ||
gavāṃ bhaktyā tathā yānti golokaṃ mānavottamāḥ |
[947]        yānti lokaṃ tu sādhyānāṃ nityaṃ ye satyabhāṣiṇaḥ ||
pratigrahān nivṛttāś ca vasūnām api mānavāḥ |
vāyuloke mahīyante rogiṇāṃ paricārakāḥ ||
lokaṃ gacchanty athāgneyaṃ vahniśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ |
yānti te nairṛtaṃ lokaṃ pararakṣaṇatatparāḥ |
bhṛgūṇām atha lokeṣu modanty ākāśaśāyinaḥ ||
yānti cāṅgirase loke vratino nātra saṃśayaḥ |
mārutāṃ ca tathā lokaṃ yānti yānapradā narāḥ ||
nāsatyaloke modante tathaivauṣadhidāyinaḥ |
rudralokaṃ prapadyante goviprāturavatsalāḥ ||
svavāci niratā yānti vaiśvadevaṃ asaṃśayam |
ādityaiḥ saha madante dayāvantas tu ye narāḥ ||
brahmalokaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ rudralokaṃ tathaiva ca |
tadgauraveṇa labhyante nānyathā dvijasattamāḥ ||
yasya devasya yāṃ bhaktiṃ sadā vahati mānavaḥ |
saṃpradas tasya sālokyaṃ yāti nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||
lokeṣu divyeṣu gatir mayoktā
karmānurūpā puruṣasya viprāḥ |
ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmy ahaṃ vai
tan me vadadhvan tapasi pradhānāḥ ||
iti nānāśubhaphalāni |
[948] atha śarīrotsargavidhir abhidhīyate | te cānaśanāgnipraveśabhṛgupatanadayaḥ |
tata viṣṇudharmottarāt |
naro na vyādhirahitaḥ saṃtyajed ātmanas tanum |
adhamā nāma ye lokā andhena tamasāvṛtāḥ |
tāṃs te pretyābhigacchanti ye ke cātmahano janāḥ ||
aniṣṭair ātmano jñātvā mṛtyukālam upasthitam |
vyādhito bhiṣajā tyaktaḥ pūrṇe vāyuṣi cātmanaḥ ||
yathā yugānusāreṇa saṃtyajed ātmanas tanum |
tasmin kāle tanutyāgād yathoktaṃ phalam āpnuyāt ||
āyuṣas tu purā dṛṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca |
kṣatriyasya tu saṃgrāme mṛtabhartari yoṣitaḥ ||
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā saṃtyajed ātmanas tanum |
sarvo hy aprāptakālo 'pi gatim agryām avāpnuyāt ||
ādityapurāṇāt |
samāyukto bhaved yas tu pātakair mahadādibhiḥ |
duścikitsyair mahārogaiḥ pīḍito vā bhavet tu yaḥ ||
svayaṃ dehe vināśasya kāle prāpte mahāmatiḥ |
ā brāhmaṇo 'pi svargādimahāphalajigīṣayā ||
prātar ujjvalanaṃ (?) dīptaṃ karoty anaśanaṃ tathā |
agādhatoyarāśiṃ vā bhṛgoḥ patanam eva vā ||
gacchen mahāpathaṃ vāpi tuṣāragirim ādarāt |
prayāgavaṭaśākhāgre dehatyāgaṃ karoti vā ||
[949]        uttamān prāpnuyāl lokān nātamghātī bhavet kvacit |
mahāpāpakṣayāt sarvo divyān bhogān samaśnute ||
eteṣām adhikāras tu tapasā sarvajantuṣu |
narāṇām atha nārīṇāṃ sarvavarṇeṣv ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
śvaśruṃ ca mātaraṃ caiva bhaginīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ satīm |
māsopavāsinīṃ gatvā gurupatnīṃ tathaiva ca |
karīṣāgniṃ viśed vipro gacchec caiva mahātapam ||
tathā revākhaṇḍe |
ye mṛtā narmadātīre saṃgame liṅgadarśane |
teṣāṃ gṛhāś ca ramyāś ca pūrvabhāgavyavasthitāḥ ||
narmadāmedamadhye tu sāvitrīsaṃgame tathā |
tripurāsannidhāne ca viṣṇau saṃnihite tathā ||
oṃkāradakṣiṇe bhāge pūrvato marakaṇṭake |
jalādhāre koṭitīrthe ye mṛtāḥ skandhamānuṣāḥ ||
harmyair imair manoramyair vasanti ca narottamāḥ. |
bhṛgāv agnau jale vāpi nadyāḥ sakalasaṃgame ||
ātreyyāṃ caiva bhāratyāṃ vārāṇasyāṃ tathaiva ca |
drumālaye gogṛhe ca gokarṇe ca mahālaye ||
hariścandre purīścandre sīśile tripurāntake |
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tuṅgabhadrāyāṃ mahārathyāṃ mahānadīm (?) ||
kārttike svāmikuṇḍe ca ye mriyante ca putraka |
sarasvatyāṃ tyajet prāṇān prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇe ||
[950]        pāriyātre mahākāle jāyante tattvavartinaḥ |
anaśanaṃ tāvad ucyate | viṣṇudharmāt |
tad etad uktaṃ tapasām aśeṣāṇāṃ mahāmate |
guṇair anaśane brahmā pradhānatamam abravīt ||
tyajed anaśanastho hi prāṇān yaḥ saṃsmaran harim |
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
atītānāgatānīha kulāni puruṣarṣabha |
punāty anaśanaṃ kurvan sapta sapta ca sapta ca ||
nānyat sukṛtam uddiṣṭaṃ taptair anaśanāt param |
tasyāhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yac ca japyaṃ mumūrṣatā ||
yādṛg rūpaś ca bhagavān cintanīyo janārdanaḥ |
āsannam ātmanaḥ kālaṃ jñātvā prājño mahāsura ||
nidhūtamaladoṣaś ca snāto niyatamānasaḥ |
samabhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhis tathā ||
praṇipātaiḥ stavaiḥ puṇyair dhyānayogaiś ca pūjayet |
datvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo vikalāditya eva ca ||
sabhāyogi brāhmaṇauko devaukas tapayogi ca |
bandhau putre kalatre ca kṣetradhānyadhanādiṣu ||
mitravarge ca daityendra mamatvaṃ vinivartayet |
mitrāṇy amitramadhyasthān parāṃś cāśu punaḥ punaḥ ||
abhyarthanopacāreṇa kṣamayet sukṛtaṃ svakam |
tataś ca prayataḥ kuryād utsargaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ||
[951]        śunāśunānāṃ daityendra vākyaṃ vedam udāharet |
parityajāmy ahaṃ dānaṃ yajāmi suhṛdo 'khilān ||
bhojanādi mayotsṛṣṭuṃ tāmbūlam anulepanam |
śuśrūṣaṇādikaṃ tyaktaṃ dānaṃ cādānam eva ca ||
homādayaḥ padārthā ye ye ca nityakramā mama |
nimittāś ca tathā kāmyāḥ śrāddhakarmakriyoditā ||
tyaktāś cāśramiṇāṃ dharmā varṇadharmās tathā hitāḥ |
padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ viharan kurvan vā kāmamatyahaṃ ||
na pāpaṃ kasyacid dāsye prāṇinaḥ santu nirbhayāḥ |
nabhasi prāṇino ye ca ye jaleṣv api bhūtale ||
kṣitau vivaragā ye ca ye ca pāṣāṇasaṅkūṭe |
ya dhānyādiṣu vastre ca śayane hy āsaneṣu ca ||
na svayaṃ kiṃ ca bhuddhyā tu dattaṃ tebhyo bhayāvaham |
na me 'sti bāndhavaḥ kaścid viṣṇuṃ tyaktvā jagadgurum ||
mitrapakṣe ca me viṣṇur adhaś cordhvaṃ tathāgrataḥ |
pārśvato mūrdhni hṛdaye bāhubhyāṃ vāpi cakṣuṣoḥ ||
śrotrādiṣu tathāṅgeṣu mama viṣṇuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
iti sarvaṃ samutsṛjya dhyātvā sarvagam acyutam ||
vāsudevasya niyataṃ nāma deveśa kīrtayet |
dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu śayīta prākśirās tataḥ ||
udakśirā vā daityendra cintayan jagataḥ patim |
viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ keśavaṃ madhusūdanam ||
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ sauriṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam |
[952]        vārāhaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ pauṇḍarīkam athācyutam ||
vāmanaṃ śrīdharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nṛsiṃham aparājitam |
padmanābham ajaṃ śrīśaṃ dāmodaram adhokṣajam ||
sarveśvareśvaraṃ śuddham anantaṃ rāmam īśvaram |
cakriṇaṃ gadinaṃ śāntaṃ śaṅkhinaṃ garuḍadhvajam ||
kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ praṇamāmy aham avyaya |
aham asmin jagannāthe mayi vāstu (?) janārdanaḥ ||
āvayor antaraṃ māstu śamīrākāśayor iva |
ayaṃ viṣṇur ayaṃ saurir ayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ purī mama |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ||
eṣa dṛśyatamo hīśaḥ paśyāmy aham atho harim |
yato na vyatirikto 'haṃ yanmano 'haṃ yadāśrayaḥ ||
itthaṃ japed ekamanāḥ smaran sarveśvaraṃ harim |
atītaḥ sarvaduḥkheṣu samo mitrāhiteṣu ca ||
namo 'stu vāsudevāya vratoktaṃ satataṃ japet |
yad vodīrayituṃ nāma samarthas tad udīrayet |
tathā dhyāyec ca devasya viṣṇo rūpaṃ manoramam ||
prasannanetrabhrūvaktraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam |
śrīvakṣasaṃ sumanasaṃ caturbāhuṃ kirīṭinam ||
pītāmbaradharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cārukeyūradhāriṇam |
cintayec ca sadā rūpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvaikaniścaye ||
yādṛśe vāmanaḥ sthairyaṃ rūpe vadhnāti cakriṇaḥ |
tad eva cintayed rūpaṃ vāsudeveti kīrtayet |
[953]        itthaṃ japan smaran nityaṃ svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ ||
ā prāṇoparamād vīras taccitas tatparāyaṇaḥ |
sarvapātakayukto 'pi puruṣaḥ puruṣarṣabha |
prayāti devadeveśe layam īḍyatame 'cyute ||
yathāgnis tṛṇajātāni dahaty anilasaṃgataḥ |
tathānaśanasaṃkalpaḥ puṃsāṃ pāpāny alaṃkṛtāḥ ||
pṛṣṭhataś cāmaradharā vimānair anuyānti tam |
devakanyā nivāse ca tasmin vasati mānavaḥ |
jāhnavīvālukāpūrṇe pūṇasaṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ ||
balir uvāca |
utkrāntikāle bhūtānāṃ muhyante cittavṛttayaḥ |
jarāvyādhivihīnānāṃ kiṃ nu vyādhyādidoṣiṇām ||
atyantaṃ vayasā vṛddho vyādhinā rogapīḍitaḥ |
yadi sthātuṃ na śaknoti kṣitistho darbhasaṃstare ||
tat kim anyo py upāyo 'sti narānaśanaṃ karmaṇi |
vaiphalyaṃ yena nāpnoti tan me brūhi pitāmaha ||
prahlāda uvāca |
nātra bhūmir na ca kuśāś cāstaraś ca na kāraṇam |
cintasyālambanībhūto viṣṇur evātra kāraṇam ||
tiṣṭhan vrajan svapan budhyan tathā dhāvann itas tataḥ |
utkrāntikāle govindaṃ saṃsmaran tanmayo bhavet ||
kiṃ japaiḥ kiṃ nu vā kṛtyaiḥ kiṃ kuśair daityasattama |
tathāpi kurvato yasya hṛdaye na janārdanaḥ ||
[954]        tasmāt putra sadā kāryaṃ vāsudevasya cintanam |
tanmayatvena daityendra tasyopāyaś ca vistarāt ||
ity etat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yat pṛṣṭo 'haṃ tvayānagha |
utkrāntikāle smaraṇaṃ kuṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te ||
bhaviṣyottarāt |
samāsahasrāṇi tu sapta vai jale
daśaikam agnau patane ca ṣoḍaśa |
gavāṃ gṛhe ṣaṣṭir aśītir āhave
anāśane bhārata cākṣayā gatiḥ ||
tathā ca śātapatho śrutiḥ |
tam etaṃ vedānuvacanena vividiṣanti brahmacaryeṇa
tapasā śraddhayā yajñenānāśanena |
saurapurāṇāt |
śivakṣetre nirāhāro bhūtvā prāṇān parityajet |
śivasāyujyam āpnoti prabhāvāt parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
liṅgapurāṇāt |
yāvat tāvan nirāhāro bhūtvā prāṇān parityajet |
śivakṣetre muniśreṣṭhāḥ śivasāyujyam āpnuyāt ||
iti anaśanavidhiḥ |
atha mahāyātrāprakaraṇam |
krīḍanty ākāśagaṅgāyām aṣṭame vātavartmani |
[955]        gajendrāḥ kumudādyāś ca yena prāptā janārdanam ||
tasmāt pradhānam atroktaṃ vāsudevasya cintanam |
nirmalaṃ brahmasaṃbhūtaṃ karair taj jāhnavījalam ||
gṛhītvā pratimuñcanti phutkāraṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
pluṣṭāḥ pṛṣṭhe 'ṃśupātaiś ca sāmīpyāt sūryaraśmibhiḥ ||
bubudhastambhasāmarthyaṃ dāhasya śamanāya ca |
mahāprapātaṃ nīlābhaṃ patamānaṃ tu taj jalam ||
vāyunā sthāpyamānas tu sthānatvam upagacchati |
tat puṇyaṃ himavatsānau patate ca yadā himam ||
prathamaṃ tatra saṃpūjyo himavāṃś chiśiras tathā |
hemantaś ca tathā nāgo nīlanīlābjasaṃbhavaḥ ||
sthānanāgāś ca saṃpūjyāḥ kālapātrair na merujaiḥ |
tvarkapuṣpāṇi deyāni dhūpo guggulasaṃbhavaḥ ||
madhyājyatilasaṃmiśraṃ pitṛbhiś ca himaṃ bahu |
yasmin deśe himaṃ na syāt tatra brūyād dhimaṃ himam ||
mahāprasthānayātrā ca kartavyā tu homopari |
āśritya sarvaṃ dhairyaṃ ca sadyaḥ svagapradā (?) ca sā ||
yāvat purandaraṃ loke na yātaḥ kāryagauravāt |
tāvat tuṣāramadhye tu svaṃ tanuṃ tyaktum utsahet ||
yatas tuṣāradagdhas tu muñcan prāṇān vicetasaḥ |
pradakṣiṇāvartaśaṅkhaṃ paśyed dīptahutāśanam |
sākarṣaṇaṃ vapur viṣṇoś candrāgnibhavadāhakam ||
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇoktaṃ mahāprasthānam |
[956]
athāgnipraveśaḥ |
vāyupurāṇe |
yo vāhitāgnipravaro vīrādhvānaṃ gato 'pi vā |
samādhāya manaḥ pūrvaṃ mantram uccārayec chanaiḥ ||
tvam agne rudras tvam uromahodivas
tvaṃ śarddhomārutaṃ pṛkṣa iśiṣe |
tvaṃ vātair aruṇair yāsi śaṅgayas
tvaṃ pūṣā vidhataḥ pāsi ātmanā ||
ity evaṃ manasā mantraṃ samyag uccārayan dvijaḥ |
agniṃ praviśate yas tu rudralokaṃ sa gacchati ||
agnis tu bhagavān kālaḥ kālo rudra iti smṛtaḥ |
tasmād yaḥ praviśed agniṃ sa rudram ativartate ||
liṅgapurāṇāt |
ādhāyāgniṃ śivakṣetre saṃpūjya parameśvaram |
svadehapiṇḍaṃ juhuyāt sa yāti paramaṃ padam ||
saurapurāṇāt |
śivasya purato vahniṃ saṃsthāpyābhyarcya keśavam |
juhuyād ātmano dehaṃ sa yāti śivasaṃnidhim ||
atha strīṇśm agnipraveśo vidhīyate | tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
ārtārte mudite hṛṣṭā proṣite malinā kṛśā |
mṛte mriyeta sā patyau sā strī jñeyā pativratā ||
atha aṅgirāḥ |
sādhvīnām iha nārīṇām agniprapatanād ṛte |
[957]        nānyo dharmo hi vijñeyo mṛte bhartari karhicit |
tāvan na mucyate nārī strīśarīrāt kathaṃcana ||
sadvṛttabhāvārpitabhartṛkāṇāṃ
strīṇāṃ viyogaḥ kṣitikātarāṇām |
tāsāṃ patāv astamite yataḥ syād
agnipraveśād apro hi mārgaḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
mṛte bhartari yā nārī dharmaśīlā dṛḍhavratā |
anugacchati bhartāraṃ śṛṇu tasyās tu yat phalam ||
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī vā yāvad romāṇi mānuṣe |
tāvad abdasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ caiva yatra kanyā pradīyate |
kulatrayaṃ punāty eṣā bhartāraṃ yānugacchati ||
vyāsaḥ |
brahmaghne vā kṛtaghne vā mitraghne yac ca duṣkṛtam |
bhartta punāti sā nārī tam ādāya mṛtā tu yā ||
ādāyāliṅgyety arthaḥ | evaṃ kalpasūtrakāraḥ |
bhartṛśarīreṇa saha saṃveśanam āhuḥ patrī saṃveśayantīti |
ādityapurāṇāt |
juhoty agnau śarīraṃ vā mṛtena patinā saha |
sattvodrekāṃ mahabdhīrā yā kācit sā pativratā ||
pitṛmedhamahāyajñaḥ strīṇām eṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
dehaḥ sajīvo yatra syād dhaviḥ prāṇās tu dakṣiṇā ||
[958]        aviruddham ṛgarthaṃ tu devaraḥ sārvakālikam |
ārādhayed bhrātṛjāyāṃ saha bhartrā samanvitām ||
citām āropayan prājñaḥ prasṛtaṃ dharmam uttamam |
imāḥ pativratāḥ puṇyāḥ striyo jātāḥ pativratāḥ ||
avaidhavyam anuprāptāḥ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
kuṅkumājyāñjanāḥ sragbhir arcitāḥ kṛtamaṇḍanāḥ ||
susthiraṃ bhartṛsaṃyogaṃ prāpnuvantu svayaṃ balāt |
duṣṭapravādarahitā susthās tv avyādhidūṣitāḥ |
saha bhartṛśarīreṇa saṃviśantu vibhāvasum ||
evaṃ śrutvā tato nārī śraddhābhaktisamanvitā |
pitṛmedhena yajñena yad vā svargam avāpnuyāt ||
mṛte bhartari sustrīṇāṃ na cānyā vidyate gatiḥ ||
nānyad bhartṛviyogāgnidāhasya śamanaṃ bhavet |
ṛgvedavacanāt sādhvī na bhaved ātmaghātinī ||
tad evedaṃ ṛgvedavacana |
imā nārīr avidhavāḥ supatnīr
añjanena sarpiṣā sa viśantu |
anasravo anamīrāḥ suratnā
ārohantu janayo yonim agne ||
deśāntaramṛte tasmin sādhvī tatpādukādvayam |
vidhāyorasi saṃśuddhā praviśej jātavedasam ||
vyāsaḥ |
dayitaṃ yānty adeśasthaṃ vṛttaṃ śrutvā pativratā |
[959]        samārohati dīpte 'gnau tasyāḥ śaktiṃ nibodhata ¦¦
vṛttaṃ mṛtam ity arthaḥ |
yadi praviṣṭo narakaṃ baddhaḥ pāśaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
saṃprāpyā yātanās tatra gṛhīto yamakiṅkaraiḥ ||
tiṣṭhate vivaso dīno veṣṭyamānaḥ svakarmabhiḥ |
vyālagrāhī yathā vyālaṃ balād uddharate balāt |
tadvad bhartāram ādāya divaṃ yāti tapobalāt ||
tatra sā bhartṛparamā stūyamānāpsarogaṇaiḥ |
krīḍate patinā sārdhaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
varāhapurāṇe |
tato divyāmbaradharaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitam |
divi divyavimānasthaṃ bhartāraṃ svaṃ dadarśa sā ||
kūrmapurāṇāt |
brahmaghnaṃ vā surāpaṃ ca mahāpātakadūṣitam |
bhartāram uddhared nārī praviṣṭā saha pāvakam ||
etad eva paraṃ strīṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidur budhāḥ |
sarvapāpaṃ samudbhūtaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
ādityapurāṇāt |
mṛte bhartari yā vahniṃ samārohati karhicit |
sārundhatīsamācārā svargaloke mahīyate ||
mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ vāpi yatra kanyā pradīyate |
punāti trikulaṃ nārī bhartāraṃ yānugacchati ||
krīḍate patinā yatra yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
[960]
atha kārīṣāgnisādhanam |
kārīṣaṃ sādhayed yas tu puṣkare tu vane naraḥ |
sarvalokān parityajya brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
brahmaloke vaset tāvad yāvat kalpakṣayo bhavet |
naiva bhraśyati martyeṣu kliśyamānaḥ svakarmabhiḥ ||
gatiś cāsyāpratihatā tiryag ūrdhvam adhas tathā |
saptarṣisarvalokeṣu svavaśo vicaran vaśī ||
upacāravidhijñaś ca sarvendriyamanoharaḥ |
nṛtyavāditragītajñaḥ subhagaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ||
saṃsevyamanaḥ kusumaiḥ divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmo nīlakuñcitamūrdhajaḥ ||
ajeyatanumadhyāś ca sarvasaubhāgyapūjitāḥ |
sarvaiśvaryaguṇopetāḥ yauvanenātigarvitāḥ ||
striyaḥ sevanti taṃ nityaṃ śayane ramayanti ca |
vīṇāveṇuninādaiś ca suptaḥ sa pratibudhyate ||
mahotsavasukhaṃ bhuṅkte duṣprāpam akṛtātmabhiḥ |
prasādād devadevasya brahmaṇaḥ śubhakāriṇaḥ ||
iti padmapurāṇoktaṃ kārīṣāgnisādhanam |
[961]
revākhaṇḍāt |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
bhṛgoḥ patanti ye śūrāḥ kāṃ gatiṃ vai prayānti te |
śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ hy etat kathaya tvaṃ mahāmune ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
ekāntaropavāsaiś ca bhṛgugograhasaṃgrahaiḥ |
prāṇāṃs tyajanti ye śūrā gatiṃ teṣāṃ nibodhata ||
pṛthak pṛthak nivāsaṃ ca teṣāṃ karmānusārataḥ |
caturviṃśatikoṭyās tu saptadaśa tathāparāḥ ||
ubhāyām tu purā śaptā madhyamottamakalpakāḥ |
anena vidhinā yas tu prāṇāṃs tyajati mānavaḥ ||
sa tu bhartā mayā datto yuṣmākaṃ tu prasādataḥ |
amareśvaraṃ pramītāś ca bhartṛtāṃ vo vrajanti vai ||
bhṛguṃ dṛṣṭvānvayaśreṣṭha mucyate brahmahatyayā |
caturaśītibhṛgavo jambūdvīpe prakīrtitāḥ ||
tathānye sapta nirdiṣṭāḥ svargasopānam uttamāḥ |
bhairavaś ca bhṛguśreṣṭho jñeyaś cāmarakaṇṭake ||
śūdrāś ca kṣatriyā vaiśyā antyajāś cādhamās tathā |
ete tyajeyuḥ prāṇān vai varjayitvā dvijaṃ nṛpa ||
patitvā brāhmaṇas tatra brahmahā cātmahā bhavet ||
[962]        dvātriṃśac ca sahasrāṇi rāhusomasamāgame |
varṣāṇāṃ jāyate rājan rājā vidhyādhare pure ||
graste tu rāhuṇā sūrye dviguṇaṃ phalam aśnute |
avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi jalapūrānalair hataḥ |
nṛpate yo bhṛguṃ prāpya sa vidyādhararāḍ bhavet ||
bhṛguṃ bhairavarūpeṇa viddhi kailāsasaṃbhavam |
garhayanti bhṛguṃ ye tu te liṅgabrahmavādinaḥ |
bhairavaḥ kṣamate teṣām iti skandena kīrtitam ||
saṃnyāsāc ca cyuto vipro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā |
śvaśrugo patanaṃ śastaṃ kāṣāgniś ca prasādhanam |
mucyate tena pāpena śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ||
vatsaraṃ vatsarārdhaṃ tu trimāsaṃ māsam eva ca |
saptatrīṇi dinānīha vased yo vai yudhiṣṭhira ||
ekāntaropavāsād vai sa gacchec chivamandiram |
hariścandre purīścandre śrīśaile tripurāntare ||
dhautapāpe mahāpuṇye vārāhe vindhyaparvate |
kāveryās tu tathā kuṇḍe patanāt svargam āpnuyāt ||
bhṛgos tu dakṣiṇe bhāge liṅgaṃ vai cāpaleśvaram |
kṣetrasaṃrakṣaṇāyeha vikhyātaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
bhṛguḥ ṣaṣṭyā bhṛtos tad dhi vijñeyaṃ cāpaleśvaram |
ārohati giriṃ yas tu tam adṛṣṭvā tu mānavaḥ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ sarvaṃ sa gṛhṇāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
[963]        ālikhya ca paṭe sūryaṃ patākādaṇḍamaṇḍitam |
balayaṃ ca kare kṛtvā vījyamanas tu cāmaraiḥ |
vīrai rudrapatatachatra ārohed bhṛguparvatam |
pade pade yajñaphalaṃ tasya syāc chaṅkaro 'bravīt ||
parvakālaṃ pratīkṣante 'psarasaḥ kāmamohitāḥ |
divyayānasamārūḍhā divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||
vīras tu patitas tatra svayaṃ tyaktvā kalevaram |
tatkṣaṇād divyalokeṣu śakratulyo bhaven nṛpa ||
kāmadaṃ yānam āruhya vivādena parasparam |
gacchec chivapuraṃ sārdham apsarobhir mudā yutaḥ ||
klībasya sattvahīnasya hy uttīrṇasya bhṛgoḥ punaḥ |
pade pade brahmahatyā bhavet tasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
na cirāyur yato martyo mṛtyoḥ kasmād bibhety asau |
ke 'pi dhārayituṃ śaktāḥ kālamṛtyuvaśaṃ naram ||
sa pāpiṣṭho durācāraś cāṇḍālo lokagarhitaḥ |
saṃnyāsādikam āruhya cyavate yas tu mānavaḥ ||
saṃnyāsapracyutaṃ vipraṃ dṛṣṭvā naro 'rkavīkṣaṇam |
kuryāt sarvaprayatnena sparśaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||
satyānṛtaṃ na vaktavyaṃ tena sārdhaṃ kadācana |
prasthātavyaṃ hi maunena na cet pāpam avāpnuyāt ||
niścite maraṇe prāpte kathaṃ bhṛtur upekṣyate |
jarāmṛtyuś ca rogaś ca saṃsārodadhisaṅkaṭe |
evaṃ kṛtvā nṛpaśreṣṭha hy ārohed bhṛgum uttamam ||
[964]
bhaviṣyottarāt |
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi taṃ vidhiṃ pāṇḍunandana |
yat kṛtvā prathamaṃ karma nipatet tadanantaram ||
kṛtvā kṛcchratrayaṃ pūrvaṃ japan lakṣān daśaiva tu |
śākayāvakāhārasthaḥ śucis triṣavaṇo naraḥ ||
trikālam arcayed īśaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam |
daśāṃśena tu rājendra homaṃ tatraiva kārayet ||
lakṣavāraṃ japed evaṃ gandhamālyaiś ca pūjayet |
rātrau svapne tadā paśyed vimānastham tataḥ kṣipet |
ātmānaṃ manyate tāta akṛtārthaṃ kathaṃcana ||
anenaiva vidhānena ātmānaṃ yas tu nikṣipet |
svargalokam anuprāpya modate tridaśaiḥ saha ||
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśatkoṭyas tathaiva ca |
krīḍitvā vividhān bhogān tadā gacchen mahītalam ||
pṛthivīm ekachatreṇa bhuṅkte sa dvijapūjitaḥ |
vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvec ca śaradāṃ śatam ||
devīpurāṇāt |
parameśvara uvāca |
yadi vai bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtaṃ bhūtakṣayaṃ prati |
anugrahāya bhūtānāṃ bhūdharendro bhaviṣyati ||
tasmin ye bhāvam āpannā matputrā mayi bhāvitāḥ |
[965]        patanti te ca bhartāro mama tulyā bhavanti vai ||
bhuktvā bhogāṃs tathā tena rājñā rājapurocitān |
kramād anudbhavaṃ yānti tatra mokṣapradaṃ dhruvam ||
brahmovāca |
evaṃ tāsāṃ vaco dattaṃ devadevena śūlinā |
nārīṇāṃ bhartṛkāmānāṃ nityam ānandakārakam ||
sanatkumāra uvāca |
kiṃ rūpaṃ bhairavaṃ hy etat kathaṃ kāyaṃ goto vibho |
pātayātrāphalaṃ deva kathayasva prasādataḥ ||
brahmovāca |
ye te saṃbhāvasaṃpannāḥ kṛtvā manasi vai śivam |
bhairavaṃ yānti te rudraṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam ||
ye vā snehād bhayāl lobhāt kautukād yānti bhairavam |
te 'pi vai tatprasādena bhuvanānāṃ mahāmune |
śivatvaṃ kramayogena rudratvaṃ yānti te dvijāḥ ||
atha vā bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ pāvanaṃ surapūjitam |
kṛtvā sthālyāṃ mahāvāhye bhairavaṃ sarvakāmadam |
pañcaviṃśabhujaṃ devaṃ rudratvaṃ yānti te dvijāḥ ||
atha vā bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ paṭagaṃ surapūjitam |
kṛtvā sthālyāṃ mahāvāhye bhairavaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
pañcaviṃśabhujaṃ devaṃ pītāṅgaṃ surapūjitam |
khaḍgakheṭadharaṃ kāryaṃ śūlodyatakaraṃ param ||
[966]        gajacarmadharaṃ caiva cakrodyatabhujaṃ tathā |
khaṭāṅgaṃ ca kapālaṃ ca vajraṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā ||
evaṃvidhena rūpeṇa bhīmadaṃṣṭraṃ dharānanam |
andhakaṃ bhindamānaṃ tu śaṅkaraṃ tu trilocanam ||
kurvantu bhairavaṃ devaṃ sasurāsurapūjitam |
nānāśivaśivair yuktaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
navayauvanaśobhāṭyaṃ sarvaśobhāprakāśakam |
kṣurikānāgarājena vāsukiś copavītakam ||
kulikas tu jaṭābandhe śaṅkhapālena kaṅkaṇam |
takṣakaḥ padmanāgaś ca kāryo keyūramaṇḍane ||
padmakarkoṭakau nāgau nūpurau pādagau śubhau |
evaṃ devaṃ prakurvīta bhairavaṃ sarvakāmadam ||
tasya dvāsthau prakartavyau pītāṅgau sarvalakṣaṇau |
śūlahastau śubhau devau gajavājiravau parau ||
dvārapau tatra gaṅgādyā dvāre kāryās tu bhairave |
udvejitās tu pīḍādyaiḥ prakuryur iha pātakam ||
evaṃ cātra prasaṅgena kathitaṃ tava suvrata |
kapālaśūlahastau tu utpalāṅkuradhāriṇau |
dvāsthau devasya kartavyau sarvābharaṇabhūṣitau ||
bhairavaṃ cordhvavadanaṃ brahmaviṣṇvādibhir yutam (?) |
śūlabhinnāndhakaṃ rūpaṃ dhāryamānaṃ tu kalpayet ||
evaṃ paṭagataṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā paraṃ vibhum |
sānugaṃ saha mantreṇa raktamālyāmbarādibhiḥ ||
[967]        ātmānaṃ bhūṣayitvā tu mudrālaṃkṛtapāṇinā |
prāpya tad vai gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ bhogamokṣapradāyakam ||
pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu deveśe gayāndhakamadāpahe |
ārohed amaraṃ sthānaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ||
ākāraṃ cintayitvā tu rūpaṃ svacchandadāyakam |
tasya vaktrānale homam ātmāhutyā tu kārayet ||
devavaktraṃ hutāśas tu svayaṃ hutatilādikam |
hotavyaṃ tena bhāvena parāṃ siddhim abhīpsakaiḥ ||
pātaṅgakena vīro vai yathāvartaṃ nibodhata |
pataṅga iva cātmānaṃ dīpāgnau nikṣipet tu yaḥ |
pātaṅto nāma pāto 'yaṃ haṃsasaṃjñam ataḥ śṛṇu ||
saṃyamya pakṣasaṅghātaṃ kṛtvā vegavatīṃ tanum |
taṃ pātaṃ haṃsanāmānaṃ sādhakecchāphalapradam (?) ||
mṛgo 'pi yūthe gartādilaṅghanais tu yathā vrajet |
samapādamatir yas tu mṛgapātaḥ sa ucyate ||
mauśalaṃ muśalībhūtvā pated yadvad udūkhale (?) |
vimānaṃ dhvajamālādiśākhādolādikaṃ labhet ||
vṛṣabhasyeva kṛtvā tu dhūnanaṃ suciraṃ dvija |
vṛṣapātaṃ vijānīhi rudralokaphalapradam ||
siṃho gajendranidhane yathā vikramate tanum |
evaṃ tatkṛtabhāvas tu pātaḥ siṃhakramo mataḥ ||
kṛtvā tu bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ sāyudhaṃ vigatajvaraḥ |
śivānane kṣipet kāyaṃ taṃ pātam bhairavapradam ||
[968]        pātaṅgādyā yathā pātāḥ svātmabhāvagatā dvijāḥ |
tathā te phaladāḥ sarve kramante bhairavaṃ padam ||
bhuvanāni vicitrāṇi asaṃkhyeyāni saṃkhyayā |
annapānāni yānīha kramaśaḥ sīmni tāni tu ||
dīkṣādinā virahitā ye 'pi bhaṅgavaśaṃ gatāḥ |
te 'pi bhuktvā varān bhogān prayānti paramaṃ padam ||
pāpo 'pi hi pumāṃs tatra varṇāśramavivarjitaḥ |
prabhāvāc caiva devasya bhuṅkte caiva varaṃ sukham ||
nandakedāradevasya tathā rudramahālayam |
bhairaveṇa tu tulyāṇi bhogānte mokṣadāni tu ||
catvāri devaśārdūla sarvāniṣṭaharāṇi tu |
prasaṅgenāpi nudyante tatra ye kupitair narāḥ |
te 'pi yānaṃ samāruhya tv āyānti ca śivaṃ padam ||
svargatāḥ kramayogena bhuktvā tu bahudhā parān |
vicitrarūpasaṃpannāḥ sarvakāmasukhapradāḥ ||
kanyā dviraṣṭavarṣāś ca pīnonnatapayodharāḥ |
bhuñjanti suvicitrās tāḥ pātaṃ yuñjanti mānavāḥ ||
nāryo vā patanaṃ kuryus tadā bhuñjanti bhairavān |
prabhutvaṃ divyabhogādyāḥ apsarogaṇasaṃyutāḥ ||
gāndharvaṃ ca yathā yakṣaṃ kinnaraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā |
tathā vidyādharaṃ sauraṃ raudraṃ ca kramaśaḥ sthitam ||
svakāmabhogasaṃpannaṃ patanād bhūvanaṃ (?) labhet |
svakāmato 'pi tad bhuktvā cānte yāti paraṃ padam ||
[969]        vaiṣṇavāsthimayīṃ mālāṃ kambukaṃ śāmbhavaṃ sadā |
dhārayed devadeveśaṃ lokānugrahakāraṇāt ||
ye citradhātukāṣṭhotthaṃ ratnaśailamayaṃ ca vai |
pūjayanti kṛtapuṇyās te 'pi yānti śivaṃ padam ||
evaṃ gṛhe 'tha śaile vā nadīvindhyāṭavīṣu ca |
bhairavaṃ pūjayed yas tu sa labhed īpsitaṃ phalam ||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ maṭhaṃ kūpam ārāmāṇi ca bhairave |
kṛtvā ca tāni catvāri deyāni sukhasiddhaye ||
yad datvā sarvadevānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ |
vipre vā vedaviduṣe tat phalaṃ bhairavāl labhet ||
iti bhṛgupatanavidhiḥ |
atha saṃgrāmavidhiḥ |
dharmadhvaja uvāca |
śūrāṇāṃ me samākhyātā svargatir yudhisaṃstarāt |
kṛte tvayā muniśreṣṭha tasmāt tvaṃ vaktum arhasi ||
maitreya uvāca |
agniṣṭomādibhir yajñair iṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ |
na tat phalam avāpnoti saṃgrāme yad avāpnuyāt ||
[970]        iti yajñavidaḥ prāhur yajñakarmaviśāradāḥ |
tasmāt tat te pravakṣyāmi yat phalaṃ śastrajīvinām ||
dharmalābho 'rthalābhaś ca yaśolābhas tathaiva ca |
yaḥ śūro vidyate puṃsāṃ vimṛdya paravāhinīṃ ||
tasya dharmārthakāmaś ca yajñāś caivāptadakṣiṇāḥ |
paraṃ hy abhimukhaṃ hatvā tad yānaṃ yo 'dhirohati ||
viṣṇukrāntaṃ sa yatate evaṃ yudhyan raṇājire |
aśvamedhān avāpnoti caturas tena karmaṇā ||
yas tu śastram anutsṛjya vīryavān vāhanīmukhe |
saṃmukho vartate śūraḥ sa svargān na nivartate ||
rājā vā rājaputro vā senāpatir athāpi vā |
hataḥ kṣatreṇa yenāśu tasya loko 'kṣayo dhruvam ||
yāvanti tasya śastrāṇi bhindanti tvacam āhave |
tāvato labhate lokān sarvakāmaduho 'kṣayān ||
vīrāsanaṃ vīraśayyā dhīrasthānasthitisthirā |
gavārthe brāhmaṇasyārthe gosvābhyarthe tu ye hatāḥ |
te gacchanty amalaṃ sthānaṃ yathā sukṛtinas tathā ||
abhagnaṃ yaḥ paraṃ hanyād bhagnaṃ ca parirakṣati |
pṛṣṭhasthitaḥ pālayati so 'pi gacchati tadbhatim ||
anuttīrṇas tathā sadyaḥ prāṇān saṃtyajate yudhi |
hatāśvaḥ patate yuddhe saḥ svargān na nivartate ||
daṃṣṭribhiḥ śṛṅgibhir vāpi hatā mlecchaiś ca taskaraiḥ |
svāmyarthe ye mṛtā rājan teṣāṃ svargo na saṃśayaḥ ||
[971]        bhayena lajjayā vāpi snehena ca raṇājire |
saṃmukho mriyate rājan tadā svargo na saṃśayaḥ ||
yasya cihnīkṛtaṃ gātraṃ śaraśaktyṛṣṭitomaraiḥ |
devakanyās tu taṃ vīraṃ ramayanty anuyānti ca ||
parāpsaraḥ sahasrāṇi śūram āyodhane hatam |
tvaritaṃ taṃ vidhāvanti mama bhartā mameti ca ||
yatra tatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |
akṣayāṃl labhate lokān yadi kṣīvaṃ na bhāṣate ||
jite ca labhate lakṣmīr mṛtenāpi surāṅgaṇām |
kṣaṇavidhvaṃsikāyāś ca kā cintā maraṇe raṇe ||
hatasyābhimukhasthasya patitasyānivartinaḥ |
hriyate yat parair dravyaṃ svam eva saphalaṃ hi tat ||
viṣṇudharmāt |
śakyantv iha sadharmais tu yad uktaṃ tu śatair naraiḥ |
ātmadehaṃ tu viprārthe tyaktuṃ yuddhe suduṣkaram ||
yāṃ yajñasaṅgais tapasā ca viprāḥ
svargaiṣiṇaḥ satracayaiś ca yānti |
kṣaṇena tām eva gatiṃ prayānti
mahāhave svāṃ tanum uttyajanti ||
sarve ca vedāḥ saha ṣaḍbhir aṅgaiḥ
sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ tapasā ca puṃsām |
etān guṇān ekapade 'tiyeta
saṃgrāmadhanyātmatanuṃ tyajed yaḥ ||
[972]        imāṃ giraṃ citrapadāṃ śubhākṣarāṃ
subhāṣitāṃ vṛtrabhidāṃ divaukasām |
raṇonmukhe yaḥ smarate dṛḍhavrataḥ
na hanyate hanti ca saṅgare ripūn ||
eṣaḥ puṇyatamaḥ svargaḥ suyajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ |
sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ kṣatriyasya viśeṣataḥ ||
bhūyaṃ caiva pravakṣyāmi bhīṣmavākyam anuttamam |
yādṛśo yaḥ prahartā taṃ tādṛśaṃ parivarjayet ||
ātatāyinam āyāntam api vedāntakṛd raṇe |
jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsīyān na tena brahmahā bhavet ||
hatāśvaś ca hantavyaḥ pānīyaṃ yaś ca bhāṣate |
vyasanārto bhaved yaś ca bhuñjānaś ca mahāmate ||
palāyanaparaś caiva prāṇeṣu kṛpaṇaṃ tyajan |
vimuktakeśo dhāvaṃś ca yaś conmattākṛtir bhavet ||
parṇaśākhātṛṇagrāhī tavāsmīti ca yo vadet |
brāhmaṇo 'smīti yaś cāhaṃ bālo vṛddho napuṃsakaḥ |
tasmād etān parihared yathoddiṣṭān raṇājire ||
kālikāpurāṇāt |
ṛṣayas tu purā khyātaṃ narāṇāṃ nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ |
āturaṃ bhītam udvignaṃ kāyasthaṃ śaraṇāgatam ||
striyam apy atha bālaṃ vā gāvaṃ paṅguṃ tapasvinam |
vilapantaṃ tathonmattaṃ visrastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ||
patantaṃ prapalāyantaṃ ekākinaṃ nirastrakam |
[973]        nagnaṃ dīnaṃ tathā vṛddhaṃ hatāśābhyāsamādana ||
muktakeśaṃ tathā mattaṃ suptaṃ bhūrivanaukasam |
sūdayiṣyanti ye mūḍhā nūnaṃ te narakārṇavāt ||
anutthānā vividhyante patitaḥ kuñjaro yathā ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
rāma uvāca |
sāṃgrāmikaṃ mahat tattvaṃ śrotum icchāmi bhūbhujām |
sarvaṃ vetsi mahābhāga tvaṃ deva parameṣṭhivat ||
puṣkara uvāca |
dvitīye 'hani saṃgrāmo bhaviṣyati yadā tadā |
gajāṃś ca snapayed rājā sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
gandhamālyair alaṃkuryāt pūjayec ca yathāvidhi |
nṛsiṃhaṃ pūjayed viṣṇuṃ rājaliṅgāny aśeṣataḥ ||
chatraṃ dhvajaṃ patākaṃ ca dharmaṃ caiva mahābhuja |
āyudhāni ca sarvāni tathā pūjyāni bhūbhujā ||
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā rātrau prathamapūjanam |
kṛtvā tu prārthayet svapnaṃ vijayāyetarāya vā ||
prathamaṃ ca mahāpārtha dharaṇyāṃ ca mahīpatiḥ |
bhiṣakpurohitāmātyamantrimadhye tadā svapet ||
saṃyato brahmacārī ca nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃsmaran harim |
rātrau dṛṣṭe śubhe svapne samarārambham ācaret ||
rātriśeṣe samutthāya snātaḥ sarvauṣadhījalaiḥ |
pūjayitvā nṛsiṃhaṃ tu vāhanādyam aśeṣataḥ ||
[974]        purodhasā hutaṃ paśyan jvālitaṃ jātavedasam |
purodhāḥ pūrvavat tatra mantrāṃs tu juhuyāc chuciḥ ||
dakṣiṇābhis tato viprān pūjayet pṛthivīpatiḥ |
tato 'nulimped gātrāṇi gandhadvāreti pārthiva ||
candanāgurukarpūraṃ kāntakālīyakaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mūrdhni kaṇṭhe samālabhya rocanāṃ ca tathā śubhām ||
āyuṣyaṃ varcasyaṃ ceti mantreṇānena mantritam |
alaṃkaraṇam āvadhyāc chriyaṃ dhotur iti srajam ||
dhyātvauṣadhaya ity evaṃ dhārayed oṣadhīḥ śubhāḥ |
navo naveti vastraṃ ca kārpāsaṃ bibhṛyāc chubham ||
aindrāgneti tato dharmaṃ dhvanvanāgeti vai budhaḥ |
tato rājā samādadyāt sarasvantv abhimantritam ||
kuñjaraṃ vā rathaṃ vāśvaṃ duhed ity abhimantritam |
āruhya siddhimad rājā niṣkramya tu samaprabhe ||
deśe ca dṛśyaḥ śatrūṇāṃ kuryāt prakṛtikalpanām |
saṃhatān yodhayed alpān kāmaṃ vistārayed bahūn ||
sūcīmukham anīkaṃ syād alpāṇāṃ bahubhiḥ saha |
vyūhāḥ prāṇyaṅgarūpāś ca dravyarūpāś ca kīrtitāḥ ||
garuḍākāravyūhaś ca cakrasyenas tathaiva ca |
ardhacandraś ca vajraś ca śakaṭavyūha eva ca ||
vyūhaś ca sarvatobhadraḥ sūcīvyūhas tathaiva ca |
padmaś ca maṇḍalavyūhaḥ prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ ||
vyūhānām atha sarveṣāṃ pañcadhā sainyakalpanā |
[975]        dvau pakṣau bandhapakṣau tu dvārasya pañcame bhavet ||
ekena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ tatsamaṃ yuddham ācaret |
bhāgatrayaṃ sthāpayeta teṣāṃ rakṣārtham eva ca ||
na vyūhe kalpanā kāryā rājño bhavati karhicit |
patrachede phalachede vṛkṣachedāvakalpane ||
punaḥ praroham āyāti mūlachede vinaśyati |
svayaṃ rājñā na yoddhavyam api sarvāstraśālinā ||
nityam loke hi dṛśyante śaktebhyaḥ śaktimattarāḥ |
sainyasya paścāt tiṣṭhet tu krośamātre mahīpatiḥ ||
bhagnasandhāraṇaṃ tatra yodhānāṃ parikīrtitam |
pradhānatvena sainyasya nāvasthānaṃ vidhīyate ||
na bhagnān pīḍayec chatrūn naikāyanagatā hi te |
maraṇe niścitāḥ sarve hanyuḥ śatrucamūm iti ||
baṭabhaṅgachalenāpi nayanti svabhuvaṃ parān |
teṣāṃ svabhūmisaṃsthānāṃ badhaḥ syāt sukaras tathā ||
na saṃhatān na viralān yodhān vyūhe prakalpayet |
āyudhānāṃ tu saṃmardo yathā na syāt parasparam ||
tathā ca kalpanā kāryā yodhānāṃ bhṛgunandana |
bhedakāmaḥ parānīkaṃ saṃhatair eva bhedayet ||
devarakṣāpareṇāpi kartavyā saṃhatā tathā |
svecchayā kalpayet vyūhaṃ jñātvā cāraprakalpanam ||
vyūhān tadā bahūn kuryād ripuvyūhasya pārthivaḥ |
gajasya deyā rakṣārthaṃ catvāraḥ surathā dvija ||
[976]        rathasyāśvāś ca catvāras tāvantas tasya carmiṇaḥ |
carmibhiś ca samās tatra dhanvinaḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
purastāc carmiṇo deyā deyās tad anu dhanvinaḥ |
dhanvinām anu cāśvīyaṃ rathāṃs tad anu yojayet ||
rathānāṃ kuñjarāś cānu dātavyāḥ pṛthivīkṣitā |
padātikuñjarākhyānāṃ varma kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
āvarjayitvā yo vāham ātmānaṃ varmayen naraḥ |
śūrā maraṇakaṃ yānti sukṛtenāpi karmaṇā ||
śūrāḥ pramukhato deyā na deyā bhīravaḥ kvacit |
śūrā vā mukhato dattā tanumātrapradarśanam ||
kartavyaṃ bhīrusaṅghena śatruvidrāvakārakam |
dānayante purastāt tu vidrutā bhīravaḥ puraḥ ||
ya utsāhayante raṇe bhīruṃ śūrāḥ purā sthitāḥ |
prāṃśavaḥ sukanāsāś ca yojibrahmekṣaṇā narāḥ ||
saṃhṛtabhrūyugāś caiva krodhanāḥ kalahapriyāḥ |
nityadṛṣṭyā na hṛṣṭāś ca śūrā jñeyāś ca kāminaḥ ||
pañcālāḥ śūrasenāś ca ratheṣu kuśalā narāḥ |
dākṣiṇātyāś ca vijñeyāḥ kuśalāḥ khaḍgacarmiṇaḥ ||
kaṅkalā dhanvino jñeyā parvatīyās tathaiva ca |
pāṣāṇayuddhakuśalāḥ tathā parvatavāsinaḥ ||
kāmbojā ye ca gāndhārāḥ kuśalās te hayeṣu ca |
prāyaśaś ca tathā mlecchā vijñeyāḥ prāsayojinaḥ ||
[977]        aṅgā vaṅgāḥ kaliṅgāś ca jñeyā mātaṅgayodhinaḥ |
āhatānāṃ ca patane raṇād ānayanakriyā ||
pratiyuddham ajānāṃ ca toyadānādikaṃ ca yat |
āyudhānayanaṃ caiva pattikarma vidhīyate ||
ripūṇāṃ bhettukāmānāṃ svasainyasya tu rakṣaṇam |
bhedanaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca carmiṇāṃ carmakīrtanam ||
vimukhīkaraṇaṃ yuddhe dhanvināṃ ca tathocyate |
dūrāpasaraṇaṃ yat tad aśvinaś ca tathocyate ||
prāsanaṃ ripusainyānāṃ rathakarma (?) tathocyate |
bhedanaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca bhinnānām api saṃhatiḥ ||
prāsādāt gomukhād vāladrumabhaṅgāś ca bhārgava |
gajānāṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ yad asahyaṃ tathā paraiḥ ||
patrī ca viṣamā jñeyā rathāśvasya tathā samā |
śakyadrumā ca nāgānāṃ yuddhabhūmir udāhṛtā ||
evaṃ viracitavyūhaḥ kṛtapṛṣṭhadivākaraḥ |
tathānulomaśukrāgnir dikpālarudhamārutaḥ ||
yodhān atr jayet sarvān namavān nāvadānataḥ |
bhogaprāptyā ca vijayāḥ svargaprāptyā mṛtasya ca |
dhanyāni tu nimittāni vadanti vijayaṃ dvija ||
mṛdanaṃ śubhagātrāni śubhasvapnanidarśanam |
nimittaṃ ca gajāśvāś ca sarvato dṛśyate śubham ||
śatrūṇāṃ maṅgalāś caiva dṛśyante hi mano'nugaiḥ |
viparītam ariḥ sarvam atra paśyati nānyathā ||
[978]        bhavanto 'pi kule jātāḥ sarvaśāstrāstrapāragāḥ |
nanu dharmaparā nityaṃ nityaṃ sanmārgam āśritāḥ ||
anāhāryāḥ parair nityaṃ kathaṃ na syāj jayo mama |
rājyaśrīr bhavatām eva bhavadbhiḥ kevalaṃ mama ||
dve cāmare 'dhike śūrāḥ chatraṃ candrābham eva ca |
jitvāribhāgasaṃprāptir mṛtasya ca parā gatiḥ |
niṣkṛtiḥ svāmipiṇḍasya nāsti yuddhaparā gatiḥ ||
śūrāṇāṃ yad viniryāti raktaṃ sāmbādhataḥ kvacit |
tenaiva saha pāpmānaṃ sarvaṃ tyajati dhārmikaḥ ||
tathā cikitsāṃ kuryād vā vedanāṃ harate tu yaḥ |
tato nāsty adhikā loke bādhā paramadāruṇā ||
mṛtasya nāgnisatkāro nāśaucaṃ nodakakriyā |
kartum icchati yasyeha saṃgrāmād adhikaṃ tu kim ||
tapasvino dānaparā yajvāno bahudakṣiṇāḥ |
śūrānāṃ gatim icchanti dṛṣṭvā bhogān anuttamān ||
varāpsaraḥsahasrāṇi śūram āyodhane hatam |
abhidravanti kāmārtā mama bhartā bhaviṣyati ||
svāmī sukṛtam ādatte 'bhagnānāṃ vinivartanāt |
phalaṃ teṣāṃ tathā proktam āśvamedhaṃ pade pade ||
jitvāribhogasaṃprāptir mṛtasya ca parā gatiḥ ||
saparyāṃ tasya kurvanti devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ proktaṃ bhagnānāṃ vinivartanāt ||
pade pade mahābhāga sanmukhānāṃ mahātmanām |
[979]        devastriyas tathālakṣmīr apāpmānamayas tathā |
pratīkṣante mahābhāga saṃgrāme samupasthite ||
parāmayo mayā grāhyo jīvaty athātha vā mṛte |
ity evam āmayas tasya pāpmanā saha tiṣṭhati ||
lakṣmīḥ saṃtiṣṭhate tasya jīvataḥ kṛtakarmaṇaḥ |
mṛtasya copatiṣṭhanti vimānasthāḥ surastriyaḥ ||
evam uddharṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dharmeṇecchec jayaṃ raṇe |
adharmavijaye rājño yamaloko bhayāvahaḥ ||
adharmavijayād arthe yac chidram abhidhīyate |
chidrād evāparaṃ chidraṃ tasya syān nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
na karṇī na tathā digdhaḥ śarasyārdham ayodhinām |
nāstaśalyaḥ śaraḥ kāryo dattaśalyaś ca bhārgava |
samaḥ samena yoddhavyo nānopacāranair dvija ||
saṃnaddhena ca saṃnaddhaḥ śāśvaś cāśvāgatena ca |
rathī ca rathinā nāma padātiś ca padātinā ||
kuñjarastho gajasthena yoddhavyo bhṛgunandana |
vimukho bhagnaśastro ca strībālaparirakṣitā ||
vyāyudho bhagnagātraś ca tathaiva śaraṇāgataḥ |
pareṇa yuddhamānaś ca yuddhaprekṣaka eva ca ||
ārtitoyapradātā ca daṇḍapāṇis tathaiva ca |
ete raṇe na hantavyā kṣatradharmam abhīpsatā |
pāpiṣṭhe kūṭayuddhe tu kartavyo mukhavāhanaḥ ||
śrāntena prātibhūtena arddhottīrṇabalena ca |
[980]        durdine na ca yuddhāni kartavyāni mahābala ||
pravṛtte samare rāma pareṣāṃ nāma kāraṇāt |
bāhū pragṛhya vikrośed bhagnābhagnān parenvitān ||
prāptacitrabalo bhūrināyako 'tra nipātitaḥ |
senānīr nihataḥ so 'yaṃ senānīś cāpi vaikṛtaḥ ||
evaṃ citrāsanaṃ kuryāt pareṣāṃ bhṛgunandana |
vidrutānāṃ tu yodhānāṃ suvighāto vidhīyate |
dhanurvedavidhānena kalpanā ca tathā bhavet ||
vapāś ca deyā dharmajñās tathā ca paramohinī |
etayābhyucchrayaḥ kāryaḥ svasthale ca tathā śubhaḥ ||
saṃbhāraś caiva kartavyo vāditrāṇāṃ jayāvahaḥ |
etat sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhavopaniṣadi dvija ||
saṃprāpya vijayaṃ yuddhe kāryaṃ caiva tu pūjanam |
pūjayed brāhmaṇāṃś cātra gurūn api tu pūjayet ||
ratnāni rājagāmīni vartma vāhanam eva ca |
sarvam anyad bhavet tasya yad yenaiva raṇe hatam ||
kulastriyas vijñeyās tathā rāma na kasyacit |
svadeśe paradeśe vā sādhvī yatra ca dūṣayet ||
anyathā saṅgaro ghoro bhavatīha jayāvahaḥ |
śatruṃ prāpta raṇe muktaḥ putras tasya prakīrtitaḥ ||
punas tena na yoddhavyaṃ tasya dharmavidāṃ matam |
deśe deśe ya ācāraḥ pāramparyakramāgataḥ ||
sa eva paripālyaḥ syāt prāpya deśaṃ samīkṣitaḥ |
[981]        nṛṇāṃ pradarśayed rājā samare 'pi hate ripau ||
na me priyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenāyaṃ samare hataḥ |
kiṃ tu pūjāṃ karoty asya macchandam avijānataḥ ||
hato 'yaṃ maddhitārthāya priyam adyāpi no mama |
aputrāṇāṃ striyaś caiva nṛpatiḥ paripālayet ||
tatas tu svapuraṃ prāpya muhūrte praviśed gṛham |
yātrāvidhānavihitaṃ bhūyo daivatapūjanam ||
dvijānāṃ pūjanaṃ caiva tathā (?) kuryād viśeṣataḥ |
saṃvibhāgaṃ parāvāpteḥ kuryād vittajanasya tu ||
vijitya dharmeṇa nṛpas tu pṛthvīṃ
yajñīyayūpādisurālayāṅkām |
kṛtvā tathānyān vijayāṃś ca śaktyā
lokaṃ jayaty apy amarādhipasya ||
āha parāśaraḥ |
lalāṭe rudhirasnātaḥ patito bhuvi saṅgare |
somapānaṃ tad evāsya sarvadevagaṇo bhavet ||
lalāṭadeśe rudhiraṃ sravat tu
yac chastraghātāt tu mukhe praviṣṭam |
tat somapānena tu tasya tulyaṃ
saṃgrāmayajñe vidhir eva dṛṣṭaḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
ānīya vipra sarvasvaṃ hataṃ ghātita eva vā |
[982]        tannimittaṃ kṛtaḥ śastraiḥ kurvann api viśudhyati ||
saṃgrāme vāhano yas tu mṛtaḥ śuddhim avāpnuyāt |
mṛtakalpaprahārair vā jīvann api viśudhyati ||
yatra yatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |
akṣayān labhate lokān yadi klībaṃ na bhāṣate ||
manuḥ |
dvāv imau puruṣau loke sūryamaṇḍalabhedinau |
parivrāḍ yogayuktaś ca raṇe vābhimukho hataḥ ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇāt |
yo brāhmaṇārtham udyuktaḥ prāṇair yadi vimucyate |
prāpnoti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ ||
brahmavaivartāt |
gobrāhmaṇasvāmidhane mahārṇave
tyaktvā śarīrāny abhayās tu ye narāḥ |
na yoginas tatparamātmacintakāḥ
phalaṃ labhante śamatāṃ janādibhiḥ ||
yad āha śālihotraḥ |
yā saṃkhyā romakūpāṇāṃ vāhakasya hayasya ca |
tāvatsamā vaset svarge hayapṛṣṭhahato naraḥ ||
yaṃ lokaṃ vājipṛṣṭheṣu hatā gacchanti mānavāḥ |
taṃ lokam adhigacchanti vaḍavāsu hatāś ca ye ||
pālakāpyaḥ |
gajaskandhahatā yānti svarga svarge 'pi mattataḥ |
[983]        tundhānogatrayaṃ vīcir vāridher iva mandiraḥ ||
śaratomaracakraiś ca nāgaskandhahatā narāḥ |
kṣaṇāt svargaṃ prayānty eva yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam ||
iti saṃgrāmavidhiḥ |
atha vṛṣotsargaḥ |
kārttikyām aśvayujyāṃ vā | tatrādau vṛṣabhaṃ parikṣeta | jīvavatsāyāḥ putraṃ sarvalakṣaṇopetaṃ nīlalohitaṃ vā pucchapādeṣu sarvaśuklaṃ yūthasyācchādakam |
tato gavāṃ madhye susamiddham agniṃ paristīrya pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ śrapayitvā pūṣā gā avantu na iharād iti ca hutvā vṛṣabham ayaskāram āhvayet | ekasmin pārśve cakreṇa aparasmin śūlenāṅkitaṃ ca hiraṇyavarṇeti catasṛbhiḥ śan no devīti ca snāpayet | snātālaṃkṛtaṃ snātālaṃkṛtābhiś catasṛbhir vatsatarībhiḥ sārdham ānīya rudrān puruṣasūktaṃ kūṣmāṇḍīṃ ca japet | pitā vatseti mantre vṛṣabhasya dakṣiṇe karṇe |
vṛṣo hi bhagavān dharmaś catuṣpādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
vṛṇomi tam ahaṃ bhaktyā sa māṃ rakṣatu sarvataḥ ||
evaṃ yuvānaṃ patiṃ vo dadāni tena krīḍantīś caratha priyeṇa |
mānaḥ āptajanuśeti |
[984]        mahāsma hi prajayāmātunūbhir
māradhāmadviṣate somarājan |
vṛṣaṃ vatsatarīyuktam aiśānyāṃ kārayed diśi |
hotur vastrayugaṃ dadyāt suvarṇaṃ kāṃsyam eva ca ||
ayaskārasya dātavyaṃ vetanaṃ manasepsitam |
bhojanaṃ bahusārpiṣyaṃ brāhmaṇāṃś cātra bhojayet ||
utsṛṣṭo vṛṣabho yasmin pibaty atha jalāśaye |
śṛṅgenollikhate bhūmiṃ yatra kvacana darpitaḥ |
pitṝṇām (?) annapānādi prabhūtam upatiṣṭhate ||
brahmapurāṇe |
anyac caitryāṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ kārttikyāṃ vā prayatnataḥ |
kartavyaḥ ślakṣṇaś cetas tribhir varṇair dvijātibhiḥ ||
vṛṣabhaḥ kṛṣṇasāras tu pratyagras tu trihāyanaḥ |
manojño darśanīyaś ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ ||
aṣṭābhir dhenubhir yuktaṃ caturbhir atha vā kramāt |
trihāyanībhir dhanyābhiḥ surūpābhiś ca śobhitaḥ ||
sarvopakaraṇopetaḥ sarvasasyacaro mahān |
utsṛṣṭo vidhinānena api smṛtividhānataḥ ||
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe manojñe nirjane vane |
na ca bāhyo na tatkṣīraṃ pātavyaṃ kenacit kvacit |
svadhā pitṛbhyo mātṛbhyo bandhubhyaś cāpi tṛptaye ||
mātṛpakṣāś ca ye kecid ye cānye pitṛpakṣajāḥ |
guruśvaśurabandhūnāṃ ye kuleṣu samudbhavāḥ |
ye pretabhāvam āpannā ye cānye śrāddhavarjitāḥ ||
[985]        vṛṣotsargena te sarve labhante tṛptim uttamām ||
dadyād anena mantreṇa tilākṣatayutaṃ jalam |
pitṛbhyaś ca samāsena brāhmaṇebhyaś ca dakṣiṇām ||
tataḥ pramuditās tena vṛṣabheṇa samanvitāḥ |
vaneṣu gāvaḥ krīḍanti vṛṣotsargaprasiddhaye ||
apravṛtte vṛṣotsarge dātā vakroktibhiḥ padaiḥ |
brāhmaṇān āha yat kiṃcin mayotsṛṣṭaṃ tu nirjane ||
tat kaścid anyo na nayed vibhājyaṃ tu yathākramam |
vṛṣotsargād ṛte nānyat puṇyam asti mahītale ||
matsyapurāṇe |
manur uvāca |
bhagavan śrotum icchāmi vṛṣabhasya tu lakṣaṇam |
vṛṣotsargavidhiṃ caiva tathā puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ||
dhenum ādau parīkṣeta suśīlāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
avyaṅgām apariklinnāṃ jīvavatsām arogiṇīm ||
snigdhavarṇāṃ snigdhakṣurāṃ snigdhaśṛṅgāṃ tathaiva ca |
manoharātisaumyāṃ ca supramāṇām anudvṛtām ||
āvarttair dakṣiṇāvarttair yuktā dakṣiṇataś ca yā |
vāmāvarttair vāmataś ca vistīrṇajaghanastanā ||
mṛdusaṃhatatāmauṣṭhī raktajihvā supūjitā |
āsyāvadīrghā sphuṭitaraktajihvā tathā ca yā ||
tāmrābhavalinetrā ca śaphair aviralair dahaiḥ |
[986]        vaidūryamadhuvarṇaiś ca jalabudbudasaṃnibhaiḥ ||
raktasnigdhaiś ca nayanais tathā raktakanīlakaiḥ |
saptacaturdaśadantā bhaved aśyāmatālukā ||
ṣaḍunnatā supārśvorupṛthupañcasamāyutā |
aṣṭāyataśirogrīvāyutā sā śubhalakṣaṇā ||
ṣaḍunnatā bhavet keṣu keṣu pañcasu cāyatā |
āyatāś ca tathaivāṣṭau dhenūnāṅke śubhāvahāḥ ||
matsya uvāca |
uraḥ pṛṣṭaṃ śiraḥ kukṣiḥ śroṇī ca vasudhādhipa |
ṣaḍunnatāni dhenūnāṃ kathayanti vicakṣaṇāḥ ||
karṇau netre lalāṭaṃ ca pañcaiva ravinandana |
samāyatāni śasyante pucchaṃ śastaṃ cāmaram ||
catvāraś ca stanā rājan evam aṣṭau manīṣibhiḥ |
śirogrīvāyutāś caiva bhūmipālāyatā bhṛśam ||
tasyāḥ sutaṃ parīkṣeta vṛṣabhaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam |
unnataskandhakakudam ṛjulāṅgūlakambalam ||
mahākaṭiṃ taṭaskandhaṃ vaidūryamaṇilocanam |
pravālavarṇaśṛṅgāgraṃ sudīrghamaṇibāladhim ||
navāṣṭadaśasaṃkhyair vā tīkṣṇāgrair daśanaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
mallikākṣaś ca bhoktavyo gṛhe 'pi dhanadhānyadaḥ ||
varṇatas tāmrakapilo brāhmaṇasya praśasyate |
śveto raktaś ca gauraś ca kṛṣṇaḥ pāṭala eva ca ||
indranīlābhapṛṣṭhaś ca śabalaḥ pañcakālakaḥ |
[987]        pṛthukarṇo mahāskandhaś cakṣūromā ca yo bhavet ||
raktākṣaḥ kapilo yaś ca raktaśṛṅgaś ca yo bhavet |
śvetodaraḥ kṛṣṇapṛṣṭho brāhmaṇasya ca śasyate ||
snigdharaktena varṇena kṣatriyasya praśasyate |
kāñcanābhena vaiśyasya kṛṣṇenāpy antyajanmanaḥ ||
yasya prāg āyate śṛṅge svamukhābhimukhe sadā |
sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ sa ca sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||
mārjārapādakapilo dhanyaḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ |
śveto mārjārapādas tu dhanyo maṇinibhekṣaṇaḥ ||
karaṭaḥ piṅgalaś caiva śvetapādas tathaiva ca |
svacchapādaśirā yas tu dvipādaḥ śveta eva ca ||
kapiñjalanibho dhanyas tathā timirasaṃnibhaḥ |
ākarṇamūlācchannaṃ tu mukhaṃ yasya prakāśate |
nāndīmukhaḥ sa vijñeyo raktavarṇo viśeṣataḥ ||
śvetaṃ ca jaṭharaṃ yasya bhavet pṛṣṭhaṃ ca gopate |
vṛṣabhaḥ sa samudrākṣaḥ satataṃ kulavardhanaḥ ||
mallikāpuṣpacitraś ca dhanyo bhavati puṅgavaḥ |
kamalair maṇḍalaiś cāpi citro bhavati gopradaḥ ||
atasīpuṣpavarṇaś ca tathā dhanyataraḥ smṛtaḥ |
ete dhanyās tathādhanyān kīrtayiṣyāmi te nṛpa ||
kṛṣṇatālvoṣṭhadaśanā rūkṣaśṛṅgaśaphāś ca ye |
avyaktavarṇā hrasvāś ca vyāghrabhasmanibhāś ca ye ||
dhvāṅkṣagṛdhrasavarṇāś ca tathā mūṣakasaṃnibhāḥ |
[988]        kuṇṭhāḥ kāṇās tathā khañjā kekaḥrākhyās (?) tathaiva ca |
viṣamaśvetapādāś ca udbhrāntanayanās tathā ||
na te vṛṣāḥ pramoktavyā na te dhāryās tathā gṛhe |
bhoktavyānāṃ ca dhāryāṇāṃ bhūyo vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||
svastikākāraśṛṅgāś ca meghaughasadṛśasvanāḥ |
mahāprāṇāś caiva tathā mattamātaṅgagāminaḥ ||
mahoraskā mahocchāsā mahābalaparākramāḥ |
śiraḥ karṇau lalāṭaṃ ca bāladhiś caraṇās tathā ||
netre pārśve ca karṇāni śasyante candrasaṃnibhāḥ |
śvetāny etāni śasyante kṛṣṇasya tu viśeṣataḥ ||
bhūmau karṣati lāṅgūlaṃ susthūlaṃ caiva bāladhi |
purastād udyato nālo vṛṣabhas tu praśasyate ||
śaktidhvajapatākābhā yeṣāṃ rājī virājate |
anaḍvāhas tu te dhanyā vittasiddhijayāvahāḥ ||
pradakṣiṇā nivartante svayaṃ ye vinivartitāḥ |
samunnataśirogrīvā dhanyās te yūthavardhanāḥ ||
raktaśṛṅgogranayanāḥ śvetavarṇo bhaved yati |
śaphaiḥ pravālasadṛśair nāsti dhanyatamas tataḥ ||
ete dhāryāḥ prayatnena moktavyā yadi vā vṛṣāḥ |
dhāritāś ca tathā muktā dhanadhānyavivardhanāḥ ||
caraṇāś ca mukhaṃ pucchaṃ yasya śvetāni gopate |
lākṣārasasavarṇaś ca taṃ nīlam iti nirdiśet ||
vṛṣa eva sa moktavyo na sa dhāryo gṛhe bhavet |
[989]        tadartham eṣā viralā loke gāthā purāṇakī |
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yady apy eko gayāṃ vrajet ||
evaṃ vṛṣaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃprayuktaṃ
gṛhodbhavaṃ krītam athāpi rājan |
muktā na śocen maraṇaṃ mahātmā
no vā vidhiṃ vai mahate vidhāsyet ||
ādipurāṇāt |
bhānur uvāca |
bhuñcanti vṛṣabhaṃ ye tu nīlaṃ caiva suśobhanam |
lāṅgūlākarṣasarvāṅgaṃ śṛṅgayuktaṃ manoharam ||
kārttikyāṃ dadate yas tu datvā pūjāṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
trivarṣās tv atha gurvinyo dadyād gāvo vṛṣasya ca ||
sāvitrīṃ ca japet tatra tathā caivāghamarṣaṇam |
karṇajāpyaṃ pradadyāt tu vṛṣabhasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
ghaṇṭāṃ lohakṛtāṃ dadyāt śṛṅgaiś ca paṭalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
rudrasyāgre bhojayec ca brāhmaṇān vai yathāvidhi ||
yāvanti romakūpāṇi vṛṣabhasya bhavanti vai |
gavāṃ caiva tathā loma yāvac chayati vai mune |
tāvatkoṭisahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate ||
yat kiṃcit kurute pāpaṃ puruṣo vṛttikarṣitaḥ |
te sarve vilayaṃ yānti gopate parimocanāt ||
vṛṣabhasyaiva śabdena pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ |
ākhaṇḍalena dṛśyante svargaloke na saṃśayaḥ ||
[990]        jale prakṣipya lāṅgūlaṃ toyaṃ coddharate vṛṣaḥ |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi pitaras tena tarpitāḥ ||
kūle samucchritā yāvac chaṅge likhati mṛttikām |
bhakṣyabhojyamayaiḥ śailaiḥ pitaras tena tarpitāḥ ||
gavāṃ madhye yadā caiva vṛṣabhaḥ krīḍate tu yaḥ |
apsarasāṃ sahasreṇa krīḍante pitaraḥ sadā ||
lāṅgūlam utsṛjan yāvat toye saṃkrīḍate tu saḥ |
apsarogaṇasaṅghaiś ca sevyante pitaras tadā ||
sahasradattamātreṇa taḍāgena yathāvidhi |
tṛptis tu yā pitṝṇāṃ vai sā vṛṣeṇa samocyate ||
devīpurāṇāt |
manur uvāca |
aśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛṣotsargād avāpyate |
revatyāṃ vāśvine māsi kṛttikāṃ kārttikasya vā ||
govivāho 'tha vā kāryo māghyāṃ vai phālgune 'pi vā |
śivomāmaṅgalaṃ caitre tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāphalam ||
aśvatthodumbarīyogaṃ vivāhavidhinā bhavet |
satoraṇaṃ bhavet tīrthe utsaṅge gokule 'pi vā ||
catasro vatsikā bhadrā dvau vā saṃbhavato 'pi vā |
vatsaṃ sarvāṅgasaṃpūrṇaṃ kanyā sā vatsikā bhavet ||
alaṃkṛtvā yathāśobham utsargaṃ kārayet mune |
vivāham ekavātsaryaṃ nīlena ca labhate sadā ||
[991]        vṛṣeṇa aśvamedhasya yāgasya labhate phalam |
jāyeran bahavaḥ putrā yady eko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet ||
yajeta cāśvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣam utsṛjet ||
rohito yas tu varṇena śaṅkhavarṇasvaro vṛṣaḥ |
salāṅgūlaṃ śiraḥ śvetaṃ sa vai nīlavṛṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
aṅkaṃ cotsṛjya vai pūrvaṃ gāṃ vālaṃkṛtya sarvataḥ ||
tadāpte vāmataś cakraṃ yāmye śūlaṃ samālikhet ||
dhātunā hematāreṇa āyasenātha vāṅkayet |
evaṃ kṛtvā avāpnoti phalaṃ vājimakhoditam ||
yam uddiśyotsṛjed vatsaṃ sa labhetāvicāraṇāt |
yathā śivomayor arcā pūjitā sarvakāmadā ||
evaṃ devatrayaṃ yaṣṭvā anantaṃ labhate phalam |
kratoḥ sahasraṃ kṛtvā yat vṛṣotsargād avāpnuyāt ||
varāhapurāṇāt |
muktvā tu nīlakaṇṭhaṃ tu kaumudyāḥ samupāgame |
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tu suśroṇi tarpayitvā dvijātayaḥ ||
datvā tilodakaṃ piṇḍaṃ pitṛpaitāmaheṣu ca |
narā ye cātra tiṣṭhanti pititāḥ pitṛbāndhavāḥ ||
teṣāṃ trātā bhaviṣyanti nīlotsṛṣṭau yathāvidhi |
gṛhītvoḍumbaraṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇatilodakam ||
vipāṇāṃ vacanaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām |
nīlakaṇṭasya lāṅgūle toyam abhyutsṛjed yadi ||
[992]        ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi pitaras tena tarpitāḥ ||
muktamātreṇa śṛṅgeṇa nīlakaṇṭhena bhedinam |
uddhṛtaṃ yadi suśroṇi paṅkaṃ śṛṅgagataṃ bhavet ||
bāndhavāḥ pitaras tasya narake ye vasanti ca |
uddhṛtā narakāt sarve somalokaṃ vrajanti te |
nīlakaṇṭhasya muktasya bahupuṇyena sundari ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca |
somaloke tu bhuñjanti sarve 'mṛtarasaṃ sadā ||
kālikāpurāṇāt |
anilāda uvāca |
nīlotpalasamaprakhyaḥ śvetāṅgaś candramastakaḥ |
subhrūr yuvā lohitākṣo vṛṣabho nīla ucyate ||
atha vā lohitaṃ piṅgaṃ suśvetaṃ vā vimocayet |
catuṣpāt sakalo dharmo vṛṣo 'yaṃ haravāhanaḥ ||
tam uddiśya samo kūpyo vidhinā yena me śṛṇu |
sopavāsaḥ śuciḥ snātvā gavāṃ caiva harālayam ||
vitānadvīpam ucchādya vinyasec chivamūrdhani |
gavyena śubhagandhena snānaṃ saṃkārayec chive ||
palais tu pañcatriṃśadbhiḥ sarpiṣā yatnato budhaḥ |
samuddhṛtya kaṣāyais tu kṣālya koṣṇena vāriṇā ||
bhūyo 'py abhyaṅgya yatnena pañcagavyena śaṅkaram |
tataḥ snāpya śivaṃ bhaktyā karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ ||
[993]        pūjayet kusumaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ samālipya ca candanaiḥ |
sauvarṇapaṅkajaṃ kāryaṃ pañcatriṃśaddalākulam ||
saratnaṃ ca nyasen mūrdhni kesarāḍhyaṃ sakarṇikam |
vastrayugmaṃ tathā śvetaṃ sūkṣmaṃ dadyāt suśobhanam ||
datvārghyaṃ bodhayed dīpaṃ tataḥ ṣaḍviṃśasaṃkhyayā |
raupyatāmrādipātrasthaṃ nīrājanaṃ tu kārayet ||
tato bhūtabaliṃ dadyāt sarvadikṣu prayatnataḥ |
pūjānte pūjayed viprān aṣṭau dadyāc ca dakṣiṇām ||
tato vedīṃ vitānaṃ ca caturhastaṃ prakalpayet |
tatraivāgniṃ samādhāya carutrayaṃ nyased budhaḥ ||
sthālīpākaṃ ca rudrāya yāvakaṃ carupāyasam |
tathā cāhutaye datvā ebhī raudrabaliṃ tataḥ ||
hareḥ sarvāsu kāṣṭāsu mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam |
sārdhaṃ vatsatarībhiś ca brahmaghoṣeṇa vai tataḥ ||
abhiṣicya vṛṣaṃ taṃ tu vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā |
raktapītasitaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ puṣpaiś cāpi vibhūṣayet ||
saṃyukte vastrayugmābhyāṃ hemavaidūryasaṃbhave |
ghaṇṭike kaṇṭhikābhyāṃ ca vāsitvā vibhūṣayet ||
vikirec ca tato lājān jātavedaḥ pradakṣiṇam |
parītāñjalinā pucchaṃ sahemena tu dhārayet ||
harāya parameśāya puṣpodakayutena ca |
hastād utkṣipya moktavyo mayā dattam udīraayet ||
jaṅghāmūrdhasphicāv ūrdhvaṃ mocayitvā pradakṣiṇam |
[994]        aṅkayet tu triśūlena kuṅkumena vipaścitaḥ ||
dadyād arcayate kumbhaṃ praṇamyeśaṃ ca sodakam |
karṣārdhahemavinyastaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ tilasaṃyutam ||
taṃ cāsya vastrayugmena sahācāryāya dāpayet |
śivavratadharān viprān saṃyatāṃś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
hiraṇyavastradānena vratasthān bhojya dakṣayet |
dīnāndhaduḥkhitānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cānivāritam ||
araṇye catvare vāpi goṣṭhe vā mocayet vṛṣam |
na gṛhe mocayed vidvān puṣkalaṃ kāmanāphalam ||
viṣṇudharmottarāt |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
aśvayuk śuklapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ narādhipa |
kārttike 'py atha vā māsi vṛṣotsargaṃ tu kārayet ||
grahaṇe dve mahāpuṇye tathā caivāyanadvaye |
viṣuvaddvitaye caiva mṛtāhe bāndhavasya ca ||
mṛtāho yasya yasmin vā tasminn ahani kārayet |
mātaraṃ sthāpayitvāgraṃ pūjayet kusumākṣataiḥ ||
mātṛśrāddhaṃ tataḥ kuryād vaṃśābhyudayakārakam |
akālamūlaṃ kalasam aśvatthadalasevitam ||
tatra rudrān samāvāhya japayed rudradevatāḥ |
susamiddhaṃ gavāṃ madhye suvistīrya hutāśanam |
payasā śrapayed vidvān caruṃ pauṣṇaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
[995]        tathaiva pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ kūṣmāṇḍāni tathaiva ca |
tato 'ṅkayīta vṛṣabham ayaskāraḥ suśilpavān ||
śūlena dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme cakreṇa nirdiśet |
aṅkitaṃ snapayet paścāt snāne tasya yathā paṭhet ||
hiraṇyavarṇeti ṛcaś catasro manujeśvara |
āpohiṣṭeti tisraś ca śan no devīti vāpy uta ||
vatsataryaś catasras tu taṃ vṛṣaṃ ca narādhipa |
alaṃkuryāt tataḥ paścād gandhamālyaiś ca śaktitaḥ ||
kiṅkiṇībhiś ca ramyābhis tathā cīnāṃśukaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
tato 'ṅkite japen mantram imaṃ prayatamānasaḥ ||
vṛṣo hi bhagavān dharmaś catuṣpādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
vṛṇomi tam ahaṃ bhaktyā sa māṃ rakṣatu sarvataḥ ||
etaṃ yuvānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dadāmi
gavāṃ patiṃ yūthapatiṃ mahārgham |
anena sārdhaṃ carata prakāmaṃ
kāmaṃ tathā prāpnuta vatsataryaḥ ||
etaṃ yuvānaṃ patiṃ vo dadāmi
tena krīḍantyaś carata priyeṇa |
sahasmahi prajayā mātanūbhis
taṃ māriṣāma dviṣate somarājam ||
mantraṃ pitā vatsa iti pratītaṃ
japeta karṇe vṛṣabhasya savye |
[996]        pracālayet taṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tatas tu
pūrvāṃ diśaṃ vatsatarīs tu sarvāḥ ||
vāsoyugaṃ hotur atha pradeyaṃ
suvarṇayuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ ca kāṃsyam |
śilpipradhānasya tathaiva mūlyaṃ
deyaṃ tathā puṣṭim upaiti rājan ||
viprās tathānnaṃ dadhisarpiṣā yutaṃ
saṃbhojanīyāḥ payasā ca miśram |
utsṛṣṭamātre vṛṣabhe vrajanti
tṛptiṃ parāṃ tasya pitāmahā ye ||
yasmiṃs taḍāge sa jalaṃ tṛṣārtaḥ
pātuṃ samāgacchati tat pitṝṇām |
divyāṃ tu pūrṇāṃ sakalāṃ mahīpate
loke pare tṛptim asau vidhatte ||
sarid varāṃ kāṃcid athopayāti
tṛṣṇānvitas tasya pitāmahānām ||
tṛptiṃ vidhatte saritāṃ variṣṭhā
sudīrghakālaṃ (?) vividhāmbuvāhā ||
darpeṇa pūrṇaḥ sa viṣāṇaghātair
dharāṃ yadā dārayate narendra |
pitrādayas tasya tad atra kūṭāṃ
dhruvaṃ labhantīti na saṃśayo 'tra ||
romnāṃ ca tulyāni śatāni rājan
[997]                moktā tathā tasya divaṃ prayāti |
saṃvatsarāṇāṃ paripūrṇakāmaḥ
saṃsevyamānas tridaśāṅganābhiḥ ||
iti vṛṣotsargavidhiḥ |
śatānīka uvāca |
bhagavan kena vidhinā śrotavyaṃ bhārataṃ naraiḥ |
caritaṃ ramabhadrasya purāṇāni viśeṣataḥ ||
kathaṃ ca vaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ śivadharmā aśeṣataḥ |
saurāṇāṃ vāpi viprendra śravaṇe ucyatāṃ vidhiḥ (?) ||
sumantur uvāca |
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi purāṇaśravaṇe vidhiṃ |
itihāsapurāṇāni śrutvā bhaktyā viśāmyate |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmahatyādibhir vibho ||
sāyaṃ prātas tathā rātrau śucir bhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ |
tasya viṣṇus tathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṅkaras tathā ||
pratyūṣe bhagavān brahmā dinānte tuṣyate hariḥ |
mahādevas tathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ tuṣṭim āpnuyāt |
purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca tad ekaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ vibho ||
bhārataṃ rājaśārdūla śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yat phalam |
vidhānaṃ vācakasyedaṃ śṛṇu tāvad viśāmpate ||
śuddhavāsā gṛhādeś ca sthānaṃ yat samayānvitam |
[998]        pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā yā tasmin devataiva hi ||
tāṃ vidhānena sarveṣāṃ aśeṣaguruvan nṛpa |
namaskṛtya yathā śrāvyaṃ śivam astv iti cāntataḥ |
nānyato nṛpaśārdūla sarvair varṇair mahīpate ||
śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyā vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriyās tathā |
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā viprāḥ śṛṇvanty ete 'grataḥ sadā ||
madhyasthito 'tha sarveṣāṃ vācako vācayen nṛpa |
ye ca saṃkarajā rājan dūrāt tac chūdrapṛṣṭhataḥ ||
brāhmaṇaṃ vācakaṃ vidyān nānyavarṇajam ādarāt |
śrutvānyavarṇajād rājan vācakān narakaṃ vrajet ||
itthaṃ hi śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ varṇānām anupūrvaśaḥ |
māsi māsi bhaved rājan pāraṇaṃ kurunandana ||
śreyo'rtham ātmano rājan pūjayed vācakaṃ nṛpa |
māsi pūrṇe nṛpaśreṣṭha dātavyaḥ svarṇamāṣakaḥ ||
brāhmaṇena mahābāho dvau deyau kṣatriyeṇa tu |
vācakasya nṛpaśreṣṭha vaiśyenāpi trayas tathā ||
śūdreṇāpy atha catvāro dātavyāḥ svarṇamāṣakāḥ |
māsi māsi nṛpaśreṣṭha śraddhayā vācakasya tu ||
prathame pāraṇe rājan vācakaṃ pūjya śaktitaḥ |
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
kārttikādi mahābāho kārttikaṃ yāvad eva tu |
agniṣṭomaṃ gosavaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomaṃ tathaiva ca ||
maitrāvaruṇaṃ vājapeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā vibhum |
[999]        māheśvaraṃ tathā brāhmaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca bhūpate ||
ādityayajñasya yathā rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ |
phalaṃ prāpnoti rājendra māsair dvādaśabhiḥ kramāt ||
itthaṃ yajñaphalaṃ prāpya yāti lokān athottamān ||
samāpte parvaṇi tathā svaśaktyā tarpayan nṛpa |
vācakaṃ brāhmaṇaś caiva sarvakāmaiḥ prapūjayet ||
gandhamālyāni dviyāni vastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca |
vācakāya pradadyāt tu tato (?) viprān prapūjayet ||
hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ gāvaḥ kāṃsyopadohanīḥ |
datvā tu vācakāyeha śrutasya prāpnute phalam ||
vācakaḥ pūjito yena prasannās tasya devatāḥ |
tasmād dhanaṃ sadā pūrvaṃ deyaṃ tasya vidur budhāḥ ||
śrāddhe tasya dvijo bhuṅkte vācakaḥ śraddayānvitaḥ |
bhavanti pitaras tasya tṛptā varṣaśataṃ nṛpa ||
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu granthārthaṃ vācayen nṛpa |
ya evaṃ vācayed rājan sa vipro vyāsa ucyate ||
ato 'nyathā vācayāno jñeyo 'sau pitṛnāmataḥ |
ittyaṃbhūto vased yasmin vācako vyāsasaṃmitaḥ ||
deśeṣu pattane rājan sa deśaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ |
praṇamya vācake bhaktyā yat phalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ ||
na tat kratusahasreṇa prāpyate kurunandana ||
yathaikato grahāḥ sarve ekatas tu divākaraḥ |
tathaikato dvijāḥ sarve ekatas tu sa vācakaḥ ||
[1000]        daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pāvanaṃ paramaṃ nṛpa |
vācakaś ca yatiś caiva tathā caiva ṣaḍaṅgavit ||
ete sarve nṛpaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ |
trividhaṃ vācakaṃ vidyāt sadāraguṇabhedataḥ ||
śrāvakaś ca mahābāho trividho guṇabhedataḥ |
dvāv etau kathyamānau tvaṃ nibodha gadato mama ||
atidrutaṃ tathāspaṣṭaṃ khurasarvavivarjitam |
padacchedavihīnaṃ ca tattadbhāvavivarjitam ||
abudhyamāno granthārthaṃ lolaś cotsāhavarjitaḥ |
īdṛśaṃ vācayed yas tu sa vipraś ca nareśvara ||
krodhano 'priyavādī ca ajñāto granthadūṣakaḥ |
na ca truṭyati kaṣṭāni sa jñeyo vācako 'dhamaḥ ||
vispaṣṭam adbhutaṃ śāntaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā |
tārasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvavivarjitam ||
abudhyamāno granthārthaṃ vācayed yas tu vācakaḥ |
sa jñeyo rākṣaso rājan idānīṃ sātvikaṃ śṛṇu ||
granthārthaṃ budhyamānas tu samagraṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa |
brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu arcayed vidhivan nṛpa ||
ya evaṃ vācayed rājan sa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ |
śraddhābhaktivihīno 'sau lobhī ca dūṣakas tathā ||
hetuvādaparo rājan tathāsūyāsamanvitaḥ |
nityāṃ naimittikīṃ kāmyām adadad dakṣiṇāṃ nṛpa ||
vācakāya mahābāho śṛṇuyād yad tu mānavaḥ |
[1001]        sa jñeyas tāmaso rājan tāmaso mānavaḥ sadā |
na tasya purato vīra vācayet prājña eva hi ||
prasaṅgāt śṛṇuyād yas tu śraddhābhaktivivarjitaḥ |
śrotā kautukamātras tu sa jñeyo rājaso budhaiḥ ||
saṃtyajya sarvakarmāṇi bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
satataṃ pūjayānas tu vācakaṃ śraddhayā nṛpa ||
nitye naimittike kāmye gurave ca dadat tathā |
ya eva vacako vīra sa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ ||
vyāsaḥ pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ yathā vyāsavaco nṛpa |
tasmāt pūjyo nṛpaśreṣṭha prathamaṃ vācako budhaiḥ ||
āpatkāle ca vṛddhau ca tathāsau guruvat smṛtaḥ ||
vaiśākhasamaye vīra tṛtīyāyāṃ tu suvrata |
kārttikyām atha māghyāṃ ca saṃpūjyaḥ prathamo bhavet ||
parvasv eteṣu ca vibho saṃpūjya dharmataḥ smṛtaḥ ||
hiraṇyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathaiva ca |
annaṃ cāpi tathā pakvaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kurunandana |
dātavyaṃ prathamaṃ tasmai śrāvakair atibhaktitaḥ ||
datvā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ patram indhanam eva ca |
sārasvataṃ ca yac cānyat tasmai deyaṃ samantataḥ ||
atha sarvais tathā kāryaṃ śrāvakaiḥ pūjanaṃ nṛpa |
vācakas tu yathā nityaṃ sukham āste narādhipa ||
na pīḍyate yathā dvandvais tathā kāryaṃ narādhipa |
hemante lomaśaṃ deyaṃ chatraṃ prāvṛṣi cottamam ||
[1002]        upānahau kālayoge kālau vai kuśalomaśau ||
yadā dātuṃ na śaknoti māṣakaṃ kāñcanasya tu |
tatas tasya tadā dadyān māṣakaṃ śreyase 'nagha ||
tadabhāve hiraṇyaṃ tu vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet |
mṛttikāpi hi dātavyā kurvatā saphalaṃ śrutam ||
ity eṣā kathitā nityā māsi māsi bhavet tataḥ |
naimittikī bhaved rājan grahaṇādiṣu parvasu ||
amale vāsasī rājan gandhamālyavibhūṣaṇe |
samāpte parvaṇi vibho dātavye bhūtim icchatā ||
jñātvā parvasamāptiṃ tu vācakaṃ pūjayed budhaḥ |
ātmānam api vikrīya ya icchet saphalaṃ śrutam |
nīmittikīṃ ca nityāṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ na dadāti vaḥ ||
śṛṇoti ca sadā tāta tasya tat niṣkalaṃ phalam |
caturguṇā bhaved rājan yā nityaṃ dakṣiṇā vibho ||
aicchakaṃ bhogam āpnoti ity āha bhagavān śivaḥ |
ity eṣa kathito rājan purāṇaśravaṇe vidhiḥ ||
śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe prakīrṇavratāni |
[1003]
atha śāntikapauṣṭikāni |
nītaḥ śāntimanaḥ svadānasalilasrāvaiḥ sahasrai raso
yenātyarthakadarthitārthinivaho dāridradāvānalaḥ |
lokaṃ yaḥ satataṃ kṛpāluhṛdayaḥ puṣṇāti tṛṇāturaṃ
so 'yaṃ śāntikapauṣṭikāni gadituṃ hemādir adyodyataḥ ||
tatra vināyakasnapanam ucyate |
āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
vināyakaḥ karmavighnasiddhyarthaṃ viniyojitaḥ |
gaṇānām ādhipatye ca rudreṇa brahmaṇā tathā ||
tenopasṛṣṭo yas tasya lakṣaṇāni nibodhata |
svapne 'vagāhate 'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ śuṇḍāṃś ca paśyati ||
atyartham iti srotasi hriyate nimajjati vā avagāhamātrasya ca balavatvāt |
kāṣāyavāsasaś caiva kravyādaś cādhirohati ||
kravyādaḥ gṛdhravyāghrādīn |
antyajair gardabhair uṣṭraiḥ sahaikatrāvatiṣṭhati |
vrajamānaṃ tathātmānaṃ manyate 'nugataṃ paraiḥ ||
paraiḥ śatrubhiḥ, pṛṣṭhato dhāvadbhir abhibhūyamānaṃ manyate |
vimānāni phalārambhāḥ saṃśatyeti nimittataḥ |
tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanandanaḥ ||
[1004]        kumārī na ca bhartāram apatyaṃ garbhasaṃgatā |
ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaś ca na śiṣyo 'dhyayanaṃ tathā ||
vaṇik lābhaṃ na vāpnoti kṛṣiṃ caiva kṛṣīvalaḥ |
snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye 'hni vidhipūrvakam ||
puṇye 'hni, anukūlanakṣatrādiyute 'hni na rātrau |
gaurasarṣapakalkena sājyenotsāditasya tu |
utsādanam udvartanam |
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhair viliptaśirasas tathā|
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svastivācyāḥ dvijāḥ śubhāḥ ||
śubhā anūcānāḥ | catvāro dvijāḥ svasti bhavanto bruvantv iti vācyāḥ | asmin samaye gṛhyoktavidhinā puṇyāhavācanam kuryād ity arthaḥ |
aśvasthānād gajasthānād valmīkāt saṃgamāt hradāt |
mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gandhān guggulaṃ cāpsu nikṣipet ||
yā āhṛtā hy ekavarṇaiś caturbhiḥ kalaśair hradāt |
carcaṇy ānaḍuhe rakte sthāpya bhadrāsaṃ tathā ||
tata uktodakamṛttikāṃ gandhādisahitāṃś cūtādipallavopaśobhitān tān sragdāmaveṣṭitakaṇṭhān candanena carcitān navāhṛtavasubhūṣitāṃś caturaḥ kalaśāṃś ca tisṛṣu pūrvādiṣu dikṣu sthāpayitvā śucau sulipte sthaṇḍile racitapañcavarṇasvastike lohitam ānaḍuhaṃ carmottaralomaprācīnagrīvam āstīrya tasyopari śvetavastrapracchāditam āsanaṃ sthāpya tatropaviṣṭasya svastivācanānantaraṃ jīvatpatiputrābhiḥ rūpaguṇaśālinībhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalasya gurur abhiṣekaṃ kuryāt |
[1005]        sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāram ṛṣibhiḥ pāvanaṃ kṛtam |
tena tvām abhiṣiñcāmi pāvamānāḥ punantu te ||
bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ |
bhagam indraś ca vāyuś ca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo viduḥ ||
yat te keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmaṃ te yac ca mūdhani |
lalāṭe karṇayor akṣṇor āpas tat ghnantu te sadā ||
kalaśatraye mantratrayam uktam, caturthaṃ tu sarvamantrair abhiṣekaḥ |
snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ śruveṇaudumbareṇa tu |
juhuyān mūrdhani kuśān savyena parigṛhya ca ||
savyapāṇigṛhītakuśān antardvāraṃ juhuyāt |
mitaś ca saṃmitaś caiva tathā śālakaṭaṃ kaṭau |
kūṣmāṇḍo rājaputraś cety aśvavāhasamanvitaiḥ |
nāmabhir balimantraiś ca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ ||
praṇavādibhir ity śeṣaḥ |
anantaraṃ laukike 'gnau sthālīpākavidhinā caruṃ śrapayitvā tair eva ṣaḍbhir mantrais tasminn evāgau hutvā taccheṣaṃ ca balimantrair indrāgniyamanirṛtivaruṇavāyusomeśāna-brahmānantānāṃ nāmabhiś caturthyantair namo'ntais tebhyo baliṃ dadyāt |
dadyāc catuṣpathe sūrpaṃ kuśān āstīrya yatnataḥ |
kṛtākṛtāṃs taṇḍulāṃś ca palalodanam eva ca ||
kṛtākṛtāḥ sakṛdavahatāḥ taṇḍulāḥ palalaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ tanmiśrodanaṃ palalodanam |
[1006]        matsyān pakvāṃs tathaivāmān māṃsam etāvad eva tu |
citraṃ puṣpaṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāṃ ca trividhām api ||
mūlakaṃ pūrikāṃ pūpāṃs tathaivoṇḍarakasrajaḥ |
dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva guḍapiṣṭaṃ samodakam ||
uṇḍarakā piṣṭādimayyaḥ tāḥ protāḥ srajaḥ, guḍapiṣṭaṃ guḍamiśraṃ śālyādipiṣṭam |
etān sarvān upāhṛtya upāhṛtya bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ |
etāny āhṛtya,
oṃ tat puruṣāya vidmahe vakratuṇḍāya dhīmahi tan no dantī pracodayāt |
iti vighneśam |
subhagāyai vidmahe kāmamālinyai dhīmahi tan no gaurī pracodayāt |
iti ambikāṃ namaskuryāt |
evaṃ vināyakaṃ tajjananyai saṃpūjyopahāraśeṣam āstīrya kuśe sūrpe nidhāya catuṣpathe nidadhyāt |
baliṃ gṛhṇantv imaṃ devā ādityā vasavas tathā |
maruto 'athāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ ||
asurā yātudhānāś ca piśācā mātaro nagāḥ |
śakinyo yakṣavetālayoginyaḥ pūtanā śivāḥ ||
jambhakāḥ siddhagandharvā mālāvidyādharānaghāḥ |
dikpālā lokapālāś ca ye ca vighnavināyakāḥ ||
[1007]        mā vighno mā ca me pāpaṃ mā santu paripanthinaḥ |
saumyā bhavanti tṛptāś ca bhūtapretāḥ sukhāvahāḥ ||
ity ete catuṣpathe baliharaṇamantrāḥ |
vināyakasya jananīm upatiṣṭhet tato 'mbikām |
dūrvāsarṣapapuṣpāṇāṃ dartvārghyaṃ pūrṇam añjalim ||
sa kusumenodakenārghyaṃ datvā dūrvāsarṣapapuṣpāṇāṃ pūrṇam añjaliṃ ca datvopatiṣṭheta vakṣyamāṇamantreṇa |
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhagavati dehi me |
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvān kāmāṃś ca dehi me ||
vināyakopasthāne bhagavann ity ūhaḥ |
tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhojayed dadyād vastrayugmaṃ guror api ||
guror dakṣiṇādānam apy apiśabdāt | vināyakoddeśena brāhmaṇebhyaś ca |
evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃś caiva vidhānataḥ |
karmaṇāṃ phalam āpnoti śriyaṃ prāpnoty anuttamām ||
ādityasya sadā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminas tathā |
mahābhogapataś caiva kurvan siddhim avāpnuyāt ||
vināyakopasṛṣṭādhikāre bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
karaṇe mūḍham ātmānam anīlāntaragas tathā |
pitṛbhiś cāvṛto yāti śmaśānanikaṭaṃ nṛpa ||
karaṇe vidheye kārye anīlāntaragaḥ bhūmyādāv asaṃlagnaḥ sann antarīkṣe gacchatīty arthaḥ |
[1008]        paśyate nṛpaśārdūla svapnānte nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tailārdragātravidhuraṃ karavīravibhūṣitam ||
svapnānte svapnamadhye | tathā |
snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye 'hni vidhipūrvakam |
gaurasarṣapakalkena saktunotsādito naraḥ ||
śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ ca vāreṇa dhiṣaṇasya ca |
tathau vīrajanakṣatre tasyaiva purato nṛpa ||
utsādita udvartitaḥ | dhiṣaṇo bṛhaspatiḥ |
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhair viliptaśirasas tathā |
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svastivācyā dvijāḥ śubhāḥ ||
vyomakeśaṃ tu saṃpūjya pārvatīṃ bhīmajaṃ tathā |
kṛṣṇasya pitaraṃ vātha akarmāraṃbhinaṃ tathā ||
dhiṣaṇaṃ kledaputraṃ ca koṇalakṣmīṃ ca bhārata |
viprastakaṃ bāhuleyaṃ navakasya ca dhāriṇam ||
aśvasthānagajasthāna ityādiko grantho yājñavalkyasamānaḥ |
ambikopasthānamantras tu |
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhagavati dehi me |
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvakāmāṃś ca dehi me ||
acalāṃ kuru me devi vipulāṃ khyātisaṃbhavām |
khyātisaṃbhavā lakṣmī |
iti vināyakasnapanam |
[1009]
puṣkara uvāca |
snānam anyat pravakṣyāmi tavāhaṃ duritāpaham |
rājan māheśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ satataṃ vijayāhavam ||
dānavendrāya tu vane yaj jagāda manuḥ purā |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ sarvaśatrukṣayaṃkaram ||
prabhātāyāṃ ca śarvaryāṃ bhāskare 'bhyudite tathā |
snāyīta dānavaśreṣṭha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kumbhaṃ atha vāpi mahīmayam |
nādeyaiḥ sārasais toyaiḥ kalpayitvā yathāvidhi ||
auṣadhīr vinyaset tatra samābhyaṅgāḥ sucūrcitāḥ |
jayā ca vijayā caiva tathā sūkṣmaphaleti ca ||
dhūpanaṃ mukhavījā ca bhaṇḍī ca kusumāni ca |
kṣīrajaṃ patranirmālyaṃ devīniḥsāram eva ca ||
phalinī varāṅganā caiva gajendrasya ca mañjarī |
kṣudrajāṅkurajāś caiva ghane dve dve vibhāvarī ||
mahodyaṃ mūrtike caiva tumbaṃ yajñabhuvaṃ tathā |
śaśāṅkamṛgadarpaṃ ca dānaṃ ca kariṇas tathā |
oṣadhyaḥ kathitās tubhyaṃ snānamantram ataḥ śṛṇu ||
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya dhavalapāṇḍuropacitabhasmānuliptagātrāya |
tad yathā |
jaya jaya vijaya sarvācchannam amuṣya kalahavigrahavivādeṣu | janma janma matha matha sarvapratyarthikām |
[1010]        yo 'sau yugāntakāle tu didhakṣati imāṃ punaḥ |
raudrīṃ mūrtiṃ sahasrākṣaḥ sa tvāṃ rakṣatu jīvitam ||
saṃvartakāgnitulyaś ca tripurāntakaraḥ śaraḥ |
sarvadevamayaḥ so 'pi sa tvāṃ rakṣatu jīvitam ||
nikhinarmityani svāhā |
evaṃ snānaṃ tu tenaiva mantreṇa tilataṇḍulam |
ghṛtāktaṃ jvalate vahnau juhuyāt prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
tataḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kuryād devadevasya śūlinaḥ |
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekeṇa gandhapuṣpaphalākṣataiḥ ||
dīpadhūpanamaskārais tathā cānnena bhūriṇā |
gītavādyais tu madhurair brāhmaṇasvastivācanaiḥ ||
māheśvarasnānam idaṃ hi kṛtvā
rakṣohaṇaṃ śatrunibarhaṇaṃ ca |
sarvān avāpnoti naras tu kāmān
yān nāma kāṃścin manasi sthitāṃśca |
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktaṃ māheśvarasnānam |
puṣkara uvāca |
snānāny anyāni te vacmi nibodha gadato mama |
rakṣoghnāni yaśasyāni maṅgalyāni viśeṣataḥ ||
snānaṃ ghṛtena kathitam āyuṣo vardhanaṃ param |
rāma gośakṛtā snānaṃ paraṃ lakṣmīvivardhanam ||
[1011]        gomūtreṇa tathā snānaṃ sarvapāpavibarhaṇam |
pañcagavyajalasnānaṃ sarvavyādhiniṣūdanam ||
snānaṃ kṣīreṇa kathitaṃ balabuddhivivardhanam |
snānaṃ ca kathitaṃ dadhnā paraṃ lakṣmīvivardhanam ||
tathā dharbhodakasnānaṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam |
pañcagavyajalasnānaṃ sarvakāryārthasādhanam ||
gavāṃ śṛṅgodakasnānaṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam |
palāśabilvakamalapuṣpasnānaṃ purohitam ||
vacā haridrā mañjiṣṭhā tagaraṃ vācake tathā |
snānam etad vinirdiṣṭaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ pāpasūdanam ||
vacā haridre dve muste snānaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ param |
āyuṣyaṃ ca yathā śasyaṃ dhanyaṃ medhāvivardhanam ||
snānaṃ pavitraṃ māṅgalyaṃ tathā kāñcanavāriṇā |
kramād ūnatare kiṃcid rūpyatāmrodakais tataḥ ||
tathā ratnodakaiḥ snānaṃ saṃgrāme vijayān kuru |
vaikuṇṭhamadhyataḥ kṛtvā prabālaiḥ paricārayet ||
tena pātreṇa yat snānaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ bhavet |
tathā puṣpodakasnānaṃ bhaved ārogyakārakam ||
tathā bījodakasnānaṃ sarvabījaprasādakam |
tathaivāmalakasnānam alakṣmīnāśanaṃ param ||
tilasiddhārthakaiḥ snānam amāṅgalyapranāśanam |
kevalair vā tilaiḥ snānam atha vā gaurasarṣapaiḥ |
snānaṃ priyaṅgunā proktaṃ tathā saubhāgyavardhanam ||
[1012]        vandhyākarkoṭakīmūlaṃ kumārī padmavāriṇī |
snānaṃ rogavināśāya smṛtaṃ pratyekaśo dvija ||
māṃso surā (?) corakanāgapuṣpaiḥ
sanāmadānair arināśakaiś ca |
kuruṣva kaṅkolakajātipūgaiḥ
samastasaukhyaṃ ca sutapradaṃ syāt ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktanānāsnānavidhiḥ |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
rudrasnānaṃ vidhānena kathayasva janārdana |
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ sarvaśāṇtipradaṃ nṛṇām ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
devasenāpatiskandaṃ rudraputraṃ ṣaḍānanam |
agastyo muniśārdūlaḥ sukhāsīnam uvāca ha ||
sarvajño 'si kumara tvaṃ prasādāc chaṅkarasya vai |
snānaṃ rudravidhānena brūhi kasya kathaṃ bhavet ||
skanda uvāca |
mṛtavatsā tu yā nārī durbhagā ṛtuvarjitā |
yā sūte kanyakāṃ vandhyāṃ snānam āsāṃ vidhīyate ||
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyām upavāsaparāyaṇā |
ṛtau śuddhe caturthe 'hni prāpte sūryadine 'tha vā ||
[1013]        nadyos tu saṃgame kuryān mahānadyo viśeṣataḥ |
śivālaye 'tha vā goṣṭhe vivikte vā gṛhāṅgaṇe ||
āhitāgniṃ dvijaṃ śāntaṃ dharmajñaṃ satyaśālinam |
snānārthaṃ prārthayed devaṃ nipuṇe raudrakarmaṇi ||
tatas tu maṇḍapaṃ kuryāc caturasram udakplavam |
baddhacandanamālyaṃ ca gomayenānulepitam ||
tanmadhye śvetarajasā saṃpūrṇaṃ padmam ālikhet |
madhye tasya mahādevaṃ sthāpayet karṇikopari ||
dadyād daleṣu nandyādīn caturṣu vidhipūrvakam |
indrādilokapālāṃś ca daleṣv anyeṣu vinyaset ||
devīṃ vināyakaṃ caiva sthāpaet tatra pārthiva |
datvārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ guḍodanam ||
bhakṣān nānāvidhān dadyāt phalāni vividhāni ca |
catuṣkoṇeṣu śṛṅgārān aśvatthadalabhūṣitam ||
ekaikaṃ vinyased brahman sarvauṣadhisamanvitam |
caturdiṣu maṇḍapasya dadyād bhūtabaliṃ tataḥ ||
āgneyyāṃ diśi kartavyaṃ maṇḍalasya samīpataḥ |
agnikāryaṃ śubhe kuṇḍe patrapuṣpair alaṃkṛte ||
lavaṇaṃ sarpiṣā yuktaṃ ghṛtena madhunā saha |
māsaṃ stokena juhuyāt kṛtahome navagrahe ||
dvitīyasyāgnikāryasya kartā ca brāhmaṇo bhavet ||
