rudrajāpyakṛd ācāryaṃ sitacandanacarcitam |
sitavastraparīdhānaṃ sitamālyavibhūṣitam ||
[1014]        śobhayet kaṅkaṇaiḥ kaṇṭhaiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṅgulīyakaiḥ |
maṇḍapasya samīpastho japed rudrān vimatsaraḥ ||
yāvad ekādaśa gatāḥ punar eva japec ca tān |
devamaṇḍalavat kāryaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubham ||
tasya madhye (?) tu yā nārī śvetapuṣpair alaṃkṛtā |
śvetavastraparīdhānā śvetagandhānulepanā ||
sukhāsanopaviṣṭā yā ācāryo rudrajāpakaḥ |
abhiṣiñcet tataś cainām arkapattrapuṭāmbunā ||
catuḥṣaṣṭisaṃkhyānām ekādaśakṛtyaḥ |
pavitrām indrakīṭājagṛhagodāvarīmṛdam |
sarvauṣadhī rocanāṃ ca nadītīrthodakāni ca ||
etat saṃkṣipya kalaśe śivasaṃjñasupūjite |
āpādatalakeśāntaṃ kukṣideśe viśeṣataḥ ||
sarvāṅgaṃ lepayed bhaktyā suśīlā kācid aṅganā |
rudrābhijaptena tataḥ snāpayet lalanāṃ ca tām ||
toyapūrṇāṣṭakalaśair aśvatthadalapūritaiḥ |
sarvatodiksthitaiḥ paścāt sthāpayet kalaśākṣataiḥ ||
evaṃ snātā snāpakāya dadyād gāṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā |
hotur evātra nirdiṣṭā dakṣiṇā gauḥ payasvinī ||
brāhmaṇānām athānyeṣāṃ svaśaktyā munipuṅgava |
govastrakāñcanādīni datvā sarvān kṣamāpayet ||
kṛtenānena viprendra rudrasnānena bhāmini |
subhagā kāntisaṃyuktā bahuputrā prajāyate ||
[1015]        sarveṣv api hi māseṣu brāhmaṇānumate śubham |
tasmād avaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ putrān strī sukham ṛcchati ||
yā snānam ācarati rudram iti prasiddhaṃ
śraddhānvitā dvijavarānumatā natāṅgī |
doṣān nihatya sakalāṃś ca śarīrabhājo
bhartuḥ priyā bhavati bhārata jīvavatsā ||
iti bhaviṣyottaroktaṃ rudrasnānam |
īśvara uvāca |
śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha tattvena snānaṃ ghaṭikayā param |
dhārayiṣyanti ye vatsa ghaṭikāṃ devanirmitām ||
teṣām arthaś ca kāmaś ca saubhāgyaṃ vṛddhim eṣyati |
pūrvoktaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā gaurīṃ tatraiva pūjayet ||
kuṅkumāgurukarpūracandanena vilepayet |
aiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthāpya ghaṭikāṃ madhupūritām |
puṣpamālyair alaṃkṛtya raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayet ||
hiraṇyaṃ nikṣipet tatra na śūnyāṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
vastreṇa tu samādṛtya gandhāṃs tatraiva nikṣipet ||
kuṅkumāgurukarpūracandanena vilepayet ||
uśīraṃ candanaṃ mustāṃ bālakaṃ sarvam auṣadham |
tathā cāmalakīṃ dūrvāṃ kṣiped gorocanāṃ budhaḥ ||
śatam aṣṭottaraṃ kṛtvā gauryā vai mūlavid yathā |
[1016]        tato 'bhimantrya ghaṭikāṃ gaurīmantreṇa tāṃ punaḥ |
śatāṣṭādhikajaptena abhimantrodakaṃ guha ||
tato 'bhiṣekaṃ kuryād vai yoṣito vā narasya vā |
ghaṭikābhiṣiktā caiva yā nārī maṇḍale guha |
subhagā sā bhaven nityaṃ naraś ca vidhivad guha ||
aputrā labhate putraṃ ajīvā jīvinī bhavet |
anenaiva vidhānena gurviṇī yadi kārayet ||
putraṃ prasūyate sā tu mahāvīryaparākramam |
rājā vijayam āpnoti dhārayitvā susaṅgare ||
yā yā rūpavatī kanyā varaṃ na labhate sadā |
sā ghaṭikābhiṣekeṇa saubhāgyam atulaṃ labhet ||
yena yena hi bhāvena ghaṭikāṃ kārayed budhaḥ |
yan me noktaṃ yaś coktaṃ ca saṅkṣepeṇa kathaṃcana |
tat sarvaṃ mūlam āśritya anenaiva tu kārayet ||
mūlam āśritya pūrvoktamulamantreṇāety arthaḥ |
na ghaṭikāparaṃ kiṃcit saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ matam |
na ghaṭikāparaṃ skanda dharmakāmārthamokṣadam ||
ghaṭikāṃ (?) dhārayed yas tu sa kāmān akhilān labhet |
aputrī labhate putram adhano dhanam āpnuyāt ||
iti bhaviṣyatpurānokto ghaṭikābhiṣekaḥ |
[1017]                kārttikeya uvāca |
pūrvam eva tvayā jñātaṃ santi vandhyā na hi striyaḥ |

īśvara uvāca |
grahadoṣān pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu putra yathārthataḥ |
dvātriṃśatir grahāḥ proktā nārīpīḍākarās tu te ||
grahāḥ kaumārikāś cānye te 'pi dvātriṃśakīrtitāḥ |
catuḥṣaṣṭiś ca saṃkhyā vai grahāṇāṃ krūrakarmaṇām ||
catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ekaikasya pravistaraḥ |

doṣair dvādaśabhir vatsa grahā gṛhṇanti yoṣitam |
ekapātreṇa yānena paraśayyāsanena tu ||
parapuruṣasaṃyogena paravastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||
lālocchiṣṭakamālyena na ekabhājanabhojanaiḥ ||
keśodakena saṃsiktād anyanāryavagūhanāt |

prathamaṃ gṛhyate puṣpaṃ garbhaṃ ca tadanantaram |
paścāt kṣīraṃ tato bālam (?) evam āhur na saṃśayaḥ ||
grahanāmāni vakṣyāmi sacarī revatī śivā |
sukhamandī ca lambā ca pūtanā kaṇḍapūtanā ||
gomukhī ca biḍālī ca tathā caiva mahāchalā |
kākolī ca hasantī ca ahaṅkārī jayā tathā |
[1018]        muktakeśī tridaṇḍī ca ajāmukhī ca rocanā ||
mukulā piṅgalā nāma piṭanāsā tathāparā |
skandagrahās tathā cānye sarveṣāṃ nāyakāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
rajanī kumbhakarṇī ca tāpasī rākṣasī parā |
modanī rodanī cātra dhanadā ca kulā tathā ||
catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ samākhyātā mātaro bālamātaraḥ |
ārjako jambhako bhāsa upaskandaś ca pañcamaḥ ||
bālānāṃ pīḍanāḥ sarve bhramante balikāṃkṣiṇaḥ |
baliṃ dadyād vidhānena tato muñcanti nānyathā ||
caturasraṃ kṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ samasūtraṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ |
saptabhāgān samān sarvān kṛtvā homaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
teṣām antarakoṣṭheṣu navapadmāni kārayet |
sabāhyābhyantare vatsa cakramālikhya yatnataḥ ||
aṣṭapatraṃ sitaṃ śubhraṃ kesaraiḥ saha karṇikaiḥ |
teṣu pātreṣu ca gaṇāḥ sarve tuṣṭiṃ yathākramam ||
pūrvādau pūjayet sarvān tathāṣṭāṣṭakam aṣṭadhā |
śivaṃ tu karṇikāmadhye padmeṣu navasu sthitam ||
kamale madhye vatsa aṅgais tu sahitaṃ śivam |
pūjayet pūvavidhinā kalpayitvā tu vāsanam ||
asya karmāṇi vakṣyāmi yena muñcanti yoṣitaḥ |
jñātvā tāsāṃ vikārāṃś ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||
sthāpayec ca vidhānajñaḥ sopavāsaparāyaṇaḥ |
vyatīpātavinirmukte snānaṃ kuryāc chubhe 'hani ||
[1019]        triṣūttareṣu revatyāṃ prājāpatye punarvasau |
aśvinyām atha puṣye ca nakṣatre rohiṇī tathā ||
mātṛgṛhe gṛhe vāpi tripathe vā catuṣpathe |
jīrṇakūpe taḍāge vā nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣu ca ||
ekavṛkṣe śmaśāne vā devatāyatane 'pi vā |
aṣṭamyāṃ rājapatnīṃ tu madhyāhne snāpayet tataḥ ||
putrakāmāṃ tu gotīrthe rājapatnīṃ tu saṃgame |
mātṛsnāne tu daurbhāgyāṃ śmaśāne mṛtaputrikām ||
kākavandhyāṃ jīrṇakūpe vandhyāṃ puṣkariṇīṣu ca |
abhicārakṛtāṃ nārīṃ puruṣaṃ ca viretasam |
snāpayet tāṃ prayatnena śivāyatanasaṃgame ||
ācāryas tu susaṃpūrṇaḥ śaktavastraḥ śuciḥ sadā |
aṣṭahastapramāṇena caturhastam athāpi vā ||
caturhastaṃ caturdvāraṃ toraṇadhvajaśobhitam |
candrābhaṃ tu kṛtādīpaṃ puṣpamālyopaśobhitam |
snānapānaiś ca naivedyair vividhaṃ kārayed balim ||
trirajobhiḥ samālikhya maṇḍalaṃ sarvakāmikam |
śvetaraktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ varṇānāṃ ca krameṇa tu ||
īśo brahmā tathā viṣṇuḥ rajasām adhipāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
maṇḍalasyottare bhāge kuryāt snapanamaṇḍalam |
caturhastapramāṇena carṇakair upāśobhitam ||
akālamūlakalasāṃś caturaṣṭapramāṇataḥ |
cūtapallavasaṃyuktān tatheṣṭapariceṣṭitān |
[1020]        hiraṇyakṛtadūrvābhir oṣadhīsaṅgasaṃyutān ||
nadyāś cobhayakūlāt tu valmīkavṛkṣamūlataḥ |
gṛhītvā mṛdam alpāṃ tu sthāpayet prathame ghaṭe ||
dvitīya gomayaṃ sthāpya tṛtīye gandhavāri ca |
caturthe hemarajate pañcame sarvam auṣadham ||
ṣaṣṭhe tīrthāmbuvinyāsaḥ saptame saptasāgaram |
kalaśe cāṣṭame nyasya śaṅkaraṃ mātṛbhiḥ saha |
anena vidhinā mantrī tv abhiṣekaṃ pradāpayet ||
mṛtavatsā jīvaputrā vandhyā cāpi prasūtikā |
abījā bījatāṃ yāti strī vātha puruṣo 'pi vā |
abhicārakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ mantro 'yaṃ nāśayed iti ||
anenaiva hi yogena mukhyena sarvabandhunā |
durbhagā subhagā vāpi kanyā prāpnoti sadvaram ||
hastyaśvarathayānaṃ vā mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍalāni ca |
dhanadhānyahiraṇyāni yena vai tuṣyate guruḥ |
yena tuṣṭena tuṣyanti devatā mātaro grahāḥ ||
athābhiṣekavidyā bhavati | oṃ rauṃ hauṃ sauṃ vauṣaṭ | abhiṣeko 'nena kīlite garbhe oṃ vraṅ kṣaḥ | śrī svāhā | anenābhiṣekabhuktakṣaye puruṣaḥ sthātu | oṃ śrīlayuṃ svāhā |
puṣpakṣaye tu nārīṇām abhiṣekaṃ ca dāpayet ||
oṃ rauṃ hāṃ svāhā | anena kīlite garbhe abhiṣekaṃ deyam |
yo jīvati tasyāpy etena mṛtaṃ vā patiṃ dhruvam |
oṃ sāṃ phaṭ | raiṃ svāhā |
[1021]        sarṣapair akṣatair vāpi taṃ dehaṃ tāḍayec chiśoḥ |
maunaś cen mriyate bālo rudate jīvate dhruvam ||
iti vandhyābhiṣekavidhiḥ |
manur uvāca |
indrādityoparāge ca yan mānam abhidhīyate |
tat sarvaṃ śrotum icchāmi dravyaṃ mantravidhānataḥ ||
matsya uvāca |
yasya rāśiṃ samāsādya bhaved grahaṇasaṃbhavaḥ |
tasya snānaṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrauṣadhisamanvitam ||
candroparāgaṃ saṃprāpya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
saṃpūjya caturo viprān śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ ||
sarvam evoparāgasya samānīyauṣadhādikam |
sthāpayec caturaḥ kumbhān avraṇān salilānvitān ||
gajāśvarathavalmīkasaṅgamād dhradagokulāt |
rājadvārapradeśāc ca mṛdam ānīya nikṣipet ||
pañcagavyaṃ ca kumbheṣu pañcaratnāni caiva hi |
rocanāpadmaśaṅkhaṃ ca pañcabhaṅgasamanvitam ||
sphaṭikaṃ candanaṃ caiva tīrthavāri sasarṣapam |
gajadantaṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca tathaivośīraguggulam |
etat sarvaṃ vinikṣipya kumbhe 'thāvāhayet surān ||
sarve samudrāḥ saritas tīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ |
[1022]        āyāntu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ ||
yo 'sau bahutaro deva ādityānāṃ prabhur mataḥ |
sahasranayanaś cendraḥ pīḍām atra vyapohatu ||
mukhaṃ yaḥ sarvadevānāṃ saptārcir amitadyutiḥ |
candroparāgasaṃbhūtām agnipīḍāṃ vyapohatu ||
yaḥ karmasākṣī lokānāṃ dharmarājeti viśrutaḥ |
rakṣogaṇādhipaḥ sākṣāt pralayānalasaṃprabhaḥ |
khaḍgavyagro 'tibhīmaś ca rakṣaḥpīḍāṃ vyapohatu ||
nāgapāśadharo devaḥ sadā makaravāhanaḥ |
sa jalādhipatiś candraḥ grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu ||
yo 'sau nidhipatir heyaḥ khaḍgaśūlagadādharaḥ |
candroparāgakaluśaṃ dhanadevo vyapohatu ||
yo 'sāv indudharo devaḥ pinākī vṛṣavāhanaḥ |
candroparāgapāpāni vināśayatu śaṅkaraḥ ||
trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
brahmaviṣṇvarkasūktāni tāni pāpaṃ harantu te ||
pūjayed vasugodānair brāhmaṇāniṣṭadevatām |
etān eva tato mantrānvitaś ca kanakānvitām |
prāṅmukhaḥ pūjayitvā tu sampaśyatīṣṭadevatām ||
kalaśaṃ dravyasaṃyuktaṃ prāptaṃ grahaṇaparvaṇi |
candragrahe nivṛtte tu kṛte godohamaṅgale |
kṛtasnānaś ca taṃ ghaṭaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ||
[1023]        anena vidhinā yas tu sagrahaṃ snānam ācaret |
na tasya grahapīḍā syān na ca bandhudhanakṣayaḥ ||
paramāṃ siddhim āpnoti punarāvṛttiṃ (?) durlabhām |
sūryagrahe sūryanāma sadā mantreṣu kīrtayet ||
dravyais tair eva kathitaṃ snānaṃ nṛpakulodvaha |
asmiṃs tu padmarāgaḥ syāt kapilā ca suśobhanā ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śrāvayed vāpi mānavaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate ||
candragrahe nṛpa ravigrahaṇe 'grajanmā
mantrair imaiḥ samabhimantrya śubhodakumbhān |
snānaṃ karoti niyamena narasya pīḍā
na tasya taṃ grahakṛtā puruṣaṃ dunoti ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktaṃ candrasūryoparāgasnānam |
athāto yamalajananaśāntiṃ vyākhyāsyāmo yasya bhāryā gaur dāsī vaḍavā vikṛtiṃ prasavet | prāyaścittī bhavet pūrṇe daśāhe caturṇāṃ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ kaṣāyam upasaṃharet | plakṣavaṭodumbarāśvatthaśamīdevadārugaurasarṣapās teṣāṃ sahiraṇyadūrvāṅkuraiś ca pallavair aṣṭau kalaśān pūrayitvā sarvauṣadhinā dampatī snāpayet | āpohiṣṭeti tisṛbhiḥ, kayānaś citreti pañcendreṇa pañcavāruṇenedam āpaḥ pravahatety apādyam iti snāpayitvālaṃkṛtya tau darbheṣu upaveśayet | mārutaṃ sthālīpākaṃ [1024] śrapayitvājyabhāgāv iṣṭvājyāhutīr juhoti | pūrvoktasnapanamantraiḥ sthālīpākaṃ juhoti | agnaye svāhā | pavanāya svāhā | mārutāya svāhā | yamāya svāhā| antakāya svāhā| mṛtyave svāhā | brahmaṇe svāhā | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā | gṛyotpāteṣūlūkaḥ kapoto gṛdhraḥ śyeno vāviśeṣas tataḥ prarohe valmīko vā bhaved udakumbhaprakṣalaṇe, āsanaśayanayānabhaṅge, gṛhagodhikākṛkalāśasarīsṛpasarpane, chatradhvajavināśe 'py anye utpāte py etad eva prāyaścittaṃ grahaṇaśāntiṃ proktena vidhinā kṛtvācāryāya varaṃ datvā svasti vācyāśiṣaḥ pratigṛhya śāntir bhavatīti |
iti kātyāyanoktayamalajananaśāntiḥ |
puṣkara uvāca |
dantajanmaviśālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tan nibodha me |
upari prathamaṃ yasya jāyante hi śiśor dvijāḥ ||
dantair vā saha yasya syāj janma bhārgavasattama |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vātha khāded ātmānam eva vā |
tatra śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||
gajapṛṣṭhagataṃ bālaṃ nausthaṃ vā sthāpayed dvija |
tadabhāvena dharmajña kāñcanena varāsane ||
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhair bījaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalais tathā |
pañcagavyena ratnaiś ca patākābhiś ca bhārgava |
sthālīpākena dātāraṃ pūjayet tadanantaram ||
[1025]        saptāhaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam |
aṣṭame 'hani viprāṇāṃ tathā deyā ca dakṣiṇā ||
kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ gāś ca bhuvam ātmānam eva vā |
dantajanmani sāmānye śṛṇu snānam ataḥ param ||
bhadrāsane niveśyaṃ ca mṛdbhir mūlaiḥ phalais tathā |
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvabījaiḥ sarvagandhais tathaiva ca |
snāpayet pūjayec cātra vahniṃ somaṃ samīraṇam ||
prathamaṃ sthāpayet tatra devadevaṃ ca keśavam |
sa teṣām eva juhuyād ghṛtam agnau yathāvidhi ||
brāhmaṇānām tu dātavyā tataḥ pūjā ca dakṣiṇā |
tataḥ svalaṃkṛtaṃ bālam āsaneṣūpaveśayet ||
bhāsantaṃ chatramūrdhānaṃ bījaiḥ susnapayet tataḥ |
susvinnair bālakānāṃ ca taiś ca kāryaṃ ca pūjanam |
pūjyāś cāvidhavā nāryo brāhmaṇāḥ suhṛdas tathā ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaroktadantotpattiśāntiḥ |
janamārasamutpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi vasantikām |
yadā lobhasamāviṣṭaḥ pīḍayāno dhanaiḥ prajāḥ ||
ramaty abhidravan rājā na ca dharmeṇa tiṣṭhati |
vacas tasyānuvartante prajā dharme vihāya tāḥ ||
krodhalobhasamāviṣṭāḥ sādhvācāravivarjitāḥ |
pūjayante na cābhīṣṭaṃ devān viprāṃs tathā pitṝn ||
[1026]        tāsv adharmābhibhūtāsu tato rudraḥ prakupyati ||
antako eṣa bhagavān bhūtānāṃ pirya eva ca |
kurute 'sau vikārāṃś ca hetubhūtaḥ pṛthagvidhān ||
tārāgrahān ketudaṇḍān rāhukākavalāhakān |
sasūryasaṃdhyāvikṛtiṃ ghorāṃ śvamṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
bhūmikampolkanirghātāḥ śītoṣṇatilavikrayāḥ ||
ativarṣam avarṣaṃ ca tathaivartuviparyayāḥ |
oṣadhyo rasahīnāś ca bhavantīha viparyaye ||
rasavīryavihīnās tā rogān utpādayanti ca |
rudraprakopanaṃ tasmāj janamāraṃ pracakṣate ||
tasmāt prasādayed yatnād devadevaṃ maheśvaram |
daivajñānapradiṣṭena vidhinā susamāhitaḥ ||
gāṇapatyena vidhinā atharvaśirasā tathā |
yāmalena vidhānena kuryād evaṃ prasādanam ||
śivasūktam umāsūktaṃ japec ca śatarudriyam |
balyupahāravividhān catvareṣu nivedayet ||
āvāhayet taṃ sagaṇaṃ rudraṃ rātrāvahaḥ śuciḥ |
brāhmaṇān bhakṣyabhojyaiś ca dakṣiṇābhiś ca pūjayet ||
prasādite tato rudre janamāro nivartate |
japya evāsa nirato nṛpatiś ca yatendriyaḥ ||
yukto homam upāśritya niyamena yathāvidhi |
evaṃ yuktasya nṛpateḥ karmasiddhiḥ praśasyate ||
karmaṇas tasya mūlaṃ hi śraddadhāno nṛpaḥ smṛtaḥ |
[1027]        upoṣito nṛpaḥ snātaḥ śuklavastrasamāhitaḥ ||
ātmarakṣāṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śāntiṃ prayojayet ||
dharmātmā dharmavid yeṣāṃ rājā rājapurohitaḥ |
rājavaṃśaguṇo yeṣāṃ kuśalaṃ tatra vardhate ||
iti gargoktajanamāraśāntiḥ |
atha gośāntiḥ gargaproktā |
vyādhayas tu daśa proktā gavāṃ vakṣyāmi yādṛśāḥ |
udvigno hṛdayagrāhī patanī mohanas tathā
teṣāṃ rūpasamutthānaṃ tādṛśaṃ tad bravīmi vaḥ |
śāntikarma ca nirdiṣṭaṃ yādṛśaṃ tatra nirmitam ||
rātrau goṣṭheṣu yā gāvo vitrasanti yatas tataḥ |
udvigno nāma sa vyādhis tena caiva prajāyate ||
aśrupramocaṃ kurvanti nayanāt prapatanti ca |
hṛdrogaṃ taṃ vijānīyād goṣu rogaṃ vinirdiśet ||
śoṇitaṃ yatra kurvīta purīṣaṃ mūtrayanti vā |
pravepamānās valitāḥ patitā vyādhir ucyate ||
huṅkāram atra kurvanti maṇḍalāni tathaiva ca |
bhaviṣyāt saṃpriyantī ca mūḍhasaṃjñaṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
purīṣaṃ pūtikaṃ yāsāṃ kṣaudram arvat (?) pravartate |
taṃ pūtanāgṛhaṃ vidyād goṣu rogasamutthitam ||
yadi jihvāṃ vinirbharjya gauryāṃ samabhidhāvati |
[1028]        kalilo nāma nāmneha goṣu vyādhir bhavaty api ||
raktāni javanetrāni viplavanti śravanti ca |
makṣikāś cāpi līyante vyādhiṃ vidyāt sudāruṇam ||
utthāś ca maṇḍalaṃ yāti vātena kṣipyate ca yā |
karṇakṣepagatir jñeyo goṣu vyādhiḥ samutthitaḥ ||
kṣureṇa yā na śaknoti yātum ullaṅghasaṃsthitā |
svairako nāma sa jñryo goṣu rogaḥ samutthitaḥ ||
yasyāḥ sphuranti gātrāṇi romāny ūrddhāni santi ca |
ubhau ca karṇau lambete vidyāt taṃ karṇalambakam ||
ity ete vyādhayo diṣṭā yathejyā eva cāpare |
teṣu teṣu yathoddiṣṭaṃ nirāhāraḥ kṣamī śuciḥ |
ātmarakṣāṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śāntiṃ prayojayet ||
nagnāḥ kaṣāyavasanā mūḍhā ye paricāriṇaḥ |
vyaṅgāś ca svalitāś caiva dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||
kāṇāṃś citrāṃś ca kuṣṭhāṃś ca tathā pakṣahatān api |
antyāvasāyinaś caiva dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||
aśvatthe vā palāśe vā samadeśe tv anūṣare |
mahāsthānaikavṛkṣe vā devagoṣṭhe 'pi vā bhavet ||
gaṇakas tu śucir bhūtvā devatādy upakalpayet |
pratiṣṭhāpya tato devān vedīṃ kuryāt pramāṇataḥ ||
pūrvaṃ kumbhān kuśān mālyaṃ lājān ullomikāṃs tathā |
māṃsaṃ pakvāśanaṃ cāpi tathaiva himapiṇḍikām ||
[1029]        ghṛtasarṣapatailena sarṣapān akṣatāṃs tathā |
muktapratisarān gandhān samidhas tu samāharet ||
udumbaraṃ palāśaṃ ca khadiraṃ bilvam eva ca |
aśvattaṃ ca śamīṃ caiva samidhas tatra kārayet ||
catvāry atra sahasrāṇi parvamātrāṇi kārayet |
hayāsthivāraṇāsthīna ulūkasya samāharet ||
etāny asthīni dhūpāṃś ca sarvāṇy eva samāharet |
vacasā saha saṃyuktaṃ dhūpaṅgīṣu (?) samānayet ||
surārudhirasaṃyuktaṃ māṃsaṃ pakvāmiṣaṃ tathā |
diśāṃ ca vidiśāṃ caiva baliṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇām ||
gāvas tu sarvagoṣṭhāt tu devagoṣṭham upānayet |
ājyadhūpaś ca gandhāś ca grāhayitvā pradakṣiṇām ||
agniṃ praṇīya vidhivat paristīrya samantataḥ |
balena vijayec cāpi muhūrte karma kārayet ||
śāntim etāṃ prayuñjānaḥ sāvitrīṃ manasā japet |
eṣā hi vedamātā tu dvijaiḥ pūrvam udāhṛtā ||
kṛṣṇachāgasya dehena karṇābhyāṃ gṛhya śoṇitam |
samidho juhuyāc chānto sarpakṣaiś (?) ca ghṛtena ca ||
rakṣoghnatailaṃ kṛśaraṃ raktamālyena saṃyutam |
evaṃ tu juhuyād vipro hṛdrogasya vināśanam ||
puṣpakarṇasya chāgasya śoṇitaṃ hāvayet tataḥ |
yāvanaṃ kaṭutailaṃ ca vyādhiṃ dṛṣṭānupātanam ||
śamīmayyas tu samidhaḥ kṛśaraṃ yāvakaṃ tathā |
[1030]        rakṣātailena saṃyuktaṃ vyādhiḥ syāc cātra mohakaḥ |
pāṇḍurasya tu chāgasya vasāṃ hṛdayam eva ca |
madhu sarpiś ca jihvāṃ ca juhuyāt pūtanāgṛhe ||
aśvatthodumbaraḥ samit |
palāśakhādirīmāṃsaiḥ vyādhiḥ sāmyati dāruṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇagrīvasya chāgasya chāgalyā vā tathā bhavet ||
śoṇitaṃ sarpiṣā yuktaṃ juhuyād dāruṇāmaye |
vayovṛddhasya chāgasya vasāṃ hṛdayaśoṇitam ||
ariṣṭākṛtasaṃyuktaṃ kaṇḍvakṣemasya nāśanam |
ghṛtaṃ sarṣapatailaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ kukkuṭasya ca ||
yathopanītāḥ samidho hāvayec cambakarṇike |
gavāṃ śāntiṃ yathoddiṣṭāṃ yaḥ prayuktāṃ dvijarṣabha ||
kārayec ca gavārthe vā japeyuś ca śatair varam |
tasya putrāś ca pautrāś ca dhanadhānyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
gāvaś ca samyag vardhante loke kīrtim avāpnuyāt |
śivadharmāt |
brahmaṇā brahmapādena stūyate praṇavena saḥ |
sa śivaḥ śāśvato devo goṣu mārīṃ vyapohatu ||
lambodareṇa devena gajavakreṇa sustutaḥ |
sa śivaḥ śāśvato devo goṣu mārīṃ vyapohatu ||
yo 'rcyate ca sadā bhaktyā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā |
[1031]        sa śivaḥ śāsvato devo goṣu mārīṃ vyapohatu ||
sarvarogahareṇāpi raviṇā yaḥ praṇamyate |
sa śivaḥ śāsvato devo goṣu mārīṃ vyapohatu ||
śrīmatāṃ rucirāṅgeṇa ghaṇṭākarṇagaṇena yaḥ |
nityaṃ praṇamyate bhaktyā hṛṣṭenānanyacetasā ||
sa śivaḥ śāsvato devo goṣu mārīṃ vyapohatu |
nityaṃ rudrabalopeto rudrabhaktisamanvitaḥ ||
ghaṇṭākarṇagaṇo devaḥ śivajñānavidhāyakaḥ |
śivayogānubhāvena goṣu mārīṃ vyapohatu ||
namaḥ śivāya devāya mahādevāya bhāvine |
rudrāya sthānave nityaṃ harāyogrāya te namaḥ ||
parameśāya siddhāya mantrasiddhipradāyine |
tryambakāya maheśāya anantāya namo namaḥ ||
abhimantrya sadā toyam etair mantrair yathākramam |
prārthayīta gavāṃ devaṃ tataḥ siddhir bhaviṣyati ||
ya idaṃ paṭhate goṣu prasthāne vā samāgame |
āyuṣmān balavān bhogī śrīmān arthapatir bhavet ||
dehānte ca paraṃ sthānaṃ sa gacchen nātra saṃśayaḥ |
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ gośāntikam idaṃ paṭhet ||
iti gośāntiḥ |
suśruto radarājaś ca gargo mitrajid eva ca |
[1032]        pṛcchanti vāhanāgāraṃ śālihotraṃ taponidhim ||
hayānāṃ maḍako ghoraḥ kathaṃ jāyeta vai prabho |
kathaṃ vā śāntikaṃ teṣāṃ etac chuśruta tāṃ vada ||
tān uvāca mahātejāḥ śālihotras taponidhiḥ |
sthāne 'śubhe sthāpitānāṃ saśalye vāghasaṃgrahe ||
hayānāṃ marako ghoro jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
yasya vā janmanakṣatraṃ karmajaṃ vātha mānasam ||
maghādikaṃ sānudāyaṃ vaināśikam athāpi vā |
janmanakṣatrāc caturthadaśamaṣōḍaśāṣṭādaśānāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ mānasādayaḥ saṃjñāḥ |
pīḍyate saurisūryādyair yadi vāpy atha rāhuṇā |
trividhair vā tathotpātais tasya syād vājimāraṇam ||
yasya vai brāhmaṇāḥ kruddhā devā vā pitaro 'py atha |
vināyakopasṛṣṭo vā kruddhā vā yasya vājinaḥ ||
hayamāras tu tasya syāt sa tu śāntikaro bhavet |
na vardhante hayāt putrā rogaiḥ pīḍyanti cāpare ||
sthānād vivartanaṃ kāryaṃ śalyoddharaṇam eva vā |
kṛvā kurvīta tatraiva vāsudaivatapūjanam ||
tathā nakṣatrapīḍāyāṃ snānaṃ vihitam ācaret |
pīḍakaś ca grahaḥ pūjyo nakṣatram api pīḍakam ||
vināyakopasṛṣṭena pūjyo gaṇapatir bhavet |
mitaś ca saṃmitaś caiva tathā śālakaṭaṃkaṭau ||
kūṣmāṇḍo rājaputraś ca pūjyā vai cāmbikā tathā |
[1033]        yasya vai brāhmaṇāḥ kruddhāḥ pūjyās tv ete na cānyathā |
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ yasya kruddhā divaukasaḥ ||
rātrau ca vāhanāgāre yadālindāpakarṣaṇam |
kṛte syāt tatra kartavyaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ ca pūjanam ||
adīpe sthāpite sthāne tathā śucivivarjite |
sthānāpakarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śriyaḥ pūjā vidhīyate ||
uccaiḥśravādayaḥ pūjyā yasya kruddhās turaṅgamāḥ ||
hayamāre tu saṃprāpte hayānāṃ vāpy upadrave |
imāṃ śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||
gomayenānulipte tu śubhe deśe purohitaḥ |
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā śāntikarma samācaret ||
dhautaśuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ |
soṣṇīṣālaṃkṛtaḥ śaktyā hayais taiḥ śucibhiḥ saha ||
catvāro brāhmaṇāś cāsya sahāyāś cyūtatandritāḥ |
ṛgvedapāragaś caiko dvitīyo yajuṣāṃ varaḥ |
tṛtīyaḥ sāmavin mukhyaś caturthaś cāpy atharvaṇaḥ ||
sarve 'vyaṅgāḥ (?) kulīnāś ca śucayaḥ śīlasaṃyutāḥ |
gṛhītāmbarasaṃvītāḥ pavitrakakarās tathā |
madhye 'gnikuṇḍaṃ kurvīta maṇḍalaṃ tu samāyatam ||
tridikṣu vinyaset kumbhān pūrṇān oṣadhivāriṇā |
rasapātraṃ nyaset teṣu aiśānyādikrameṇa tu ||
sarpiṣaṃ payaso dadhno madhunaś ca yathākramam |
kuṇḍasya pūrvabhāge tu kuryād deveśvaraṃ pade ||
[1034]        dakṣiṇe tu yamaṃ kuryād varuṇaṃ paścime tathā |
uttare ca tathā bhāge kuryād vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum ||
sarvāṃs tān pūjayed viprā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ |
vastrair dhūpair alaṃkārais tathaiva vaidyapūjanam ||
teṣām avāpya tal liṅgaṃ mantrarājyena pāvakam |
yajurvedavidaḥ pūrve japed aindrān viśārada ||
yāmye somaṃ sāmagas tu vāruṇaṃ bahvṛco 'pi ca |
mantraṃ kuverasaṃyuktaṃ japed vidvān atharvaṇaḥ ||
suvarṇam adbhutaṃ vāsaḥ kāṃsyaṃ gāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak |
pañcānāṃ dakṣiṇā datvā hayamārāt pramucyate ||
hayamāre tu saṃprāpte hayānāṃ vāpy upadrave |
imāṃ śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||
pūrvokte tu śubhe sthāne pūrvoktanidhinā tataḥ |
agnikuṇḍaṃ diśīśānyāṃ pūrve vai pūrvadakṣiṇe |
bhūmau kurvīta devānāṃ maṇḍaleṣv api pūjanam ||
atra vipratrayaṃ kāryaṃ naiva kāryas tv atharvaṇaḥ |
āgneye tv atha digbhāge vahnipūjā vidhīyate ||
aiśānyāṃ pūjanaṃ vāyoḥ pūrve tu savitur bhavet |
sāvitraṃ tu japen mantraṃ yajurvedaviśāradaḥ ||
āgneye bahvṛcaṃ caiva somaṃ sāmaviśāradaḥ |
sarvam anyat tu kartavyaṃ pūrvoddiṣṭaṃ vijānatā ||
utpāteṣu nimitteṣu vājinām iṅgiteṣu ca |
prāyaścittaṃ prakurvīta tataḥ sarvaṃ praśāmyati ||
[1035]        hayaśālottare bhāge sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kalpayet |
trirātropoṣitas tatra śāntiṃ kuryāt purohitaḥ ||
navavāsobhir ākṣiptaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ tu caturdiśam |
udakumbhās tu catvāraḥ sthāpanīyāś caturdaśa ||
rasapātrāṇi deyāni pūrṇe kumbhe ca suśrita |
śiraḥsnātaḥ kṛtoṣṇīṣo yathāvat kṛtamaṇḍalaḥ ||
śuklavāsā jitakrodho bahutvena samīritaḥ |
āhutīr juhuyād vahnau jñānena susamāhitaḥ ||
pitāmahāya rudrāya skandāya varuṇāya ca |
aśvibhyāṃ caiva sūryāya śakrāya ca tathāgnaye ||
vāhāya vātha haraye śriyai devyai tathaiva ca |
gandharvebhyaś ca somāya uccaiḥśravasa eva ca ||
devatā yā bhavat tatra utpātasya tu kāraṇī |
maṇḍale tāṃ viditvā tu balibhiś cāpi pūjayet ||
śatam aṣṭādhikaṃ hutvā pratidevaṃ putrohitaḥ |
tatas tu pūjanaṃ kuryād devānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||
pāyasollepakādīpadhūpadīpādilepanaiḥ |
madhupāyasasaṃmiśraṃ viprā bhojyāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ ||
ekaikadevam uddiśya daś sapta ca pañca vā |
suvarṇasahitaṃ vāso gāṃ ca kāṃsyaṃ ca (?) dakṣiṇām ||
niṣkṛtyarthaṃ tadā deyaṃ trirātraṃ tu mahībhujā |
purohitāya tuṣṭyarthaṃ yena tuṣyatv asau dvijaḥ ||
vāhanān pūjayet sarvān svasti vācya dvijottamān |
[1036]        etad dhi śāntikaṃ kāryaṃ nityam autpātike sadā ||
rakṣoghnaṃ tu yaśasyaṃ tu sarvotpātavināśanam |
rājño vijayadaṃ puṇyaṃ dhanadhānyavivardhanam ||
iti śālihotrāśvaśāntiḥ |
atha gajaśāntiḥ |
tatra pālakalakṣaṇāni pālakagṛhītagajalakṣaṇāni cābhidhayāha pālakāpyaḥ |
kṣaras tatropasargāya caratīty abhilakṣayet |
vahan sa kuñjarān hanti śreṣṭhaṃ vāpi mataṅgajam ||
imāṃ tatra kriyāṃ kuryāt śreyo'rthī nṛpatiḥ svayam |
pūjayed yatnato rudraṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvāś ca devatāḥ ||
rātrau bhūtabaliś cāpi kartavyo māṃsaśoṇitaiḥ |
sarvāsu gajaśālāsu catvareṣv avareṣu ca ||
nagarāt sahasā rātrau nirṇayed vāraṇān bahiḥ |
diśi prācyām udīcyāṃ vā snānaṃ janamanoramam ||
manoramatarān deśān apare 'hni mataṅgajān |
saṃcāryacaraṇā rājan vṛkṣabhaṅgatṛṇāśanāḥ ||
yathāvidhi mahāmantrair ekāhārais tu saṃyataiḥ |
saptāham eva sañcāryā japahomaparāyaṇaiḥ ||
putrohitas tu kurvīta śāntiṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm |
tarpayitvā dvijāṃs tatra dakṣiṇābhiś ca pūjayet ||
[1037]        mahīmātrāś ca saptāhaṃ śucayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ |
ekaśataṃ niśi snātvā bhuñjīran haviṣodanaiḥ ||
vṛkṣabhaṅgatṛṇāhārān ekasthāne niveśayet |
āraṇyakatvaṃ teṣāṃ tu saṃkalpaṃ manasā bhavet ||
haviḥsthāneṣu (?) yūnyas tu gāvaḥ saptāham eva ca |
vāsayet saha vatsaiś ca vṛṣabhair vihitais tathā ||
dvitoraṇaṃ niveśyātha jalasyobhayanīrajam |
svastikas teṣu caikaiko bhaved droṇo 'tha kāñcanaḥ ||
mahāmātrāś ca tatraiva syus te sthaṇḍilavāsinaḥ |
suvarṇānāṃ śataṃ cātra vinyasyam udakaṃ dvija ||
sāmānyayajñaproktaṃ yat snānaṃ tad upakalpayet |
toraṇe ca bhavet kāryaṃ (?) caturmāsavidhau tathā ||
mantrair juhuyād vipras tu samidbhir jātavedasam |
sāmānyayajñaṃ nirvartya yathā proktaṃ vidhānavit ||
mantrais tu juhuyād etaiḥ samidbhir jātavedasam |
indraiḥ saha marudbhiś ca gajenairāvatena ca ||
utpātaṃ tu nigṛhṇīyād udīcyāṃ snāpayed gajān |
evaṃ kṛtvā haviḥśeṣair baliṃ pratidiśaṃ haret ||
mantrais tair eva pūvoktair devebhyas tebhya eva ca |
dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi vipro tato homaṃ samācaret ||
nāmāgnaye viśvebhyaś ca bhūtebhyo 'tha balir mayā |
dakṣiṇāyāṃ vāruṇaṃ tu haridrāktodanaṃ balim |
dvijo mantram imaṃ rājan niyataiḥ susvanair japan ||
[1038] ye ca paścimāyāṃ diśi samāśritā rudrā rudramanuṣyāḥ raudrāṇi ca bhūtāni romāṇi vyādhayaś ca ye tv ārogyaṃ vyādhayo jīvitaṃ cāyattaṃ tebhya eṣa baliḥ |
pūrvottarāyāṃ diśi tu hutvā harendrāyodanam |
susamāhito baliṃ hared yathānyāyam imaṃ mantraṃ vipro yatnena yojayed iti namo rākṣasapiśācagandharvarakṣobhyo yeṣu pitraṃ saṃsparśa eṣa prāṇāś cāyattās tebhya eṣ balir iti baliṃ sarvebhyo diśam imaṃ mantram udīrayet |
agnaye pārthivānāṃ sarvānām apārthivānāṃ satvānām adhipataye eṣa te baliḥ vāyor antarikṣāṇāṃ satvānām adhipataye eṣa te baliḥ |
rudrāya ca yathānyāyaṃ krameṇopahared balim |
ye vṛkṣeṣu ye tīrtheṣu ye vīthiṣu tebhyo namo 'stu rudrebhyo harāmy aham |
ye 'ntarikṣe ye niviṣṭās tu pṛthivyāṃ ye ca saṃśritāḥ |
tebhyo namo 'stu rudrebhyo balim ebhyo harāmy aham ||
hutvā hutvā baliṃ samyag dvijātīn svati vācya ca |
pūrvoktena vidhānena rāgān nīrājate kramāt ||
datvāvagāhan teṣāṃ tu tatas toraṃ paraṃ nayet |
dvāre dvitīye nīrājyās te naiva vidhinā punaḥ ||
nīrā japec ca pañcāhaṃ ythā rājajanaṃ tataḥ |
saptame saṃpraveśyaitān kṛtakautumamaṇḍalān ||
gītavāditraśabdaiś ca saddvijān svasti vācya ca |
sarvabījaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śālagandhaiś ca pūjitān ||
[1039]        sahiraṇyāṃs tataḥ kumbhān śālādvāreṣu vinyaset |
saṃsṛṣṭālaṅkṛtān kṛtvā sarvasaṃbhārapūjitān ||
bharadvājo marudbhiś ca hrado bhūpa udāhṛtaḥ |
tathā punaś ca śālāyāṃ kṣemamaṅgalasaṃbhṛtām ||
praviśaṃś cāniruddhas tu stambhe tiṣṭhan śaracchatam |
arogo balavān bhūyo rājñaś ca vijayāvahaḥ ||
tathā |
aṅgas tu rājā campāyāṃ pālakāpyaṃ sma pṛcchati |
cāturmāsīṣu sarvāsu kathaṃ nīrājayed gajān ||
prabrūhi pṛṣṭam etan me yathāvan munisattama |
saṃpṛṣṭas tv aṅgarājena pālakāpyas tato 'bravīt ||
idaṃ śṛṇu mahārāja yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
rogāś ca nairṛtiś caiva tathā rakṣāṃsi pannagāḥ ||
piśācā guhyakāś caiva gandharvā rākṣasās tathā |
dānavāś caiva yakṣāśca kaumārāś cāpi ye grahāḥ ||
ye aghorā jayādyāś ca ye ca rudrāś ca devatāḥ |
upasargāś ca ye kecit pīḍānakṣatrajāś ca ye ||
baliṃ vā bhoktukāmāś ca hantukāmās tathāpare |
tathā kroḍitukāmāś ca ghorarūpā mahāgrahāḥ ||
devopaghātā ye cānye tatra śāntiṃ vrajanti te |
etadarthe mahīpāla gajanīrājanī smṛtā ||
kārttikī prathamā rājan dvitīyā phālgunī tathā |
āṣāḍhī tu tṛtīyā syāt tisro nīrājanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
[1040]        caturmāsī bhavet kuryād gajānāṃ hitam icchatā |
yathārhaṃ devatānāṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca baliṃ haret ||
uṣṭrān pikāṃś ca jālāṃś ca dānyaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu |
pāyasaṃ madhu kalmāṣaṃ lohitānnaṃ guḍodanam |
supratiṣṭhaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ divyamālyānulepanam ||
dīrghāgrān haritān darbhān viprāṇāṃ caiva ca bhojanam |
navaṃ śivaṃ ca vidhivad gajopaskaram āharet ||
ākrāntaṃ tagarośīraṃ priyaṅguṃ coparājayet |
sarvaratnauṣadhaiś cāpi dhūpamālyāñjanāni ca ||
rakṣāvidhānaṃ kurvīta gajānāṃ svastivācanaiḥ |
gamāgame'pi kartavyā śāntiḥ saṃdhyādvaye 'pi ca ||
purohito dakṣiṇato juhuyād dhavyavāhanam |
uttare juhuyād vaidyaḥ śucivastraḥ samāhitaḥ ||
āhatakṣaumavasanaḥ śucir bhūtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ |
aṣṭau devān namaskṛtya gajānāṃ savasti vācya ca ||
prajāpatiṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca yamaṃ caiva śacīpatim |
rudraṃ ca baladevaṃ ca varuṇaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā ||
senāpatiṃ namasyāmi gajānāṃ svāmināṃ prabhum |
yajñabhāṇḍam athānīya yajñabhūmiṃ prakalpayet ||
pūrveṇāntarato vāppi brāhmmaṇānumate śive |
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe snigdhauṣadhinage same ||
pradakṣiṇodake caiva sarvataḥ suparikrame |
[1041]        gomayenopalipyātha yajñabhūmiṃ praveśayet ||
tasmāt tv anarakaṃ tatra bhūmād aṣṭād aratnayaḥ (?) |
nodyānadevopahatān nordhvaśuṣkān dṛḍhān samān ||
anugamyān navān vṛkṣān ṛjuvṛkṣān asusthitān |
utsedhān dvādaśāratīn vārayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
hastyāgārāṇi sarvāṇi gomayenopalepayet |
śucīni kārayitvā ṣaṭ balibhiś ca vibhūṣayet ||
sthāneṣu puṣpamālāś ca karaṇe toraṇāni vā |
rājātha prājanān sarvān gṛhītvā cākṣatodakam ||
prokṣayet stambhamūlāni dharaṇīṃ paridhās tathā |
parikarmiṇaḥ susnātāḥ śucayaḥ śuklavāsasaḥ ||
yāvan nirvāṇakāle tu jalābhyāsaṃ nayed gajam |
śāntiṃ ca juhuyāt tatra brāhmaṇaś caiva vācaret ||
dravyāṇi hastyāgārāṇi tathā praśravaṇāni ca |
varuṇaṃ tīrthakanyāṃ ca nāgān udakadaivatān ||
sāgarān saritaś caiva udapānaṃ sarāṃsi ca |
taḍāgāni ca sarvāṇi surān abhyarcayec (?) chuciḥ ||
prāyaścittāni kṛtvā ca tataḥ prasthāpayed gajam |
sarvaratnauṣadhair bījaiḥ pūrṇaiś caiva vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
candanaiś ca yathāproktaiḥ snāpayed ṛtupūrvaśaḥ |
snātasya tasya nāgasya kārayed āhatāni tu ||
hāridraṃ piṣṭam ādāya pūryāt pañcāṅgulāny atha |
[1042]        maṅgalāni ca sarvāṇi kārayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
rocanayā priyaṃ yac ca samyag grāmaṃ samālabhet |
ahni svalaṃkṛtaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ turyābhiḥ samavatsaret ||
śobhitaṃ vaijayantībhir na baddhaiḥ pañcarajjubhiḥ |
kāñcanā rājatā vāpi divyavāsaḥ samanvitā ||
grathitā kṣaumasūtreṇa nāgarośīramiśritā |
saṃbhūtā parvatāgre ca sarvadevanamaskṛtā ||
śatapāsīnamuktvarṣe (?) gajānāṃ svastaye bhavet |
ārogyāyaiva nāgānāṃ nṛpasya vijayāya ca ||
madhe ca svastikaṃ kuryāt svasti gacchati kuñjarāḥ |
avakīrya tu lājaiś ca yajñabhūmiṃ samantataḥ ||
kuśodumbaraśākhābhiḥ sarvataḥ paritāḍayet |
kāṣṭhaiḥ palāśajaiś cāpi siddhakodumbarais tathā ||
jyotīṃṣi janayed yāvat samiddhaṃ vācakaṃ tataḥ |
gṛhītvā codakaṃ pātraṃ prokṣayed dhavyavāhanam ||
adite namas te | sarasvati namas te | devasavitar namas te |
uttiṣṭhāya vivardhasva prabhāvaṃ tvaritaṃ mama |
vibodhayaty apsarasaḥ śubhahastāś ca brāhmaṇāḥ ||
yogaṃ mama prayacchasva prasanno havyavāhanaḥ |
sruveṇājyaṃ (?) gṛhītvātha śāntir bhavatu hastinām ||
svāhā | samidhe svāhā | sruvāya svāhā |
bhū svāhā | bhuvaḥ svāhā |
buddho bodhaya bhūtāni brahmānaṃ cāmitaujasam |
[1043]        sahasrākṣaṃ bhūtapatiṃ kuberaṃ varuṇaṃ yamam ||
viṣṇuṃ caiva mahātmānaṃ tathā nāradaparvatau |
uddālakaṃ kāśyapaṃ ca marīciṃ bhṛgum eva ca ||
ṛṣimukhyān namasyāmi sarvān eva kṛtāñjaliḥ |
āsicyājyāhutiṃ teṣāṃ bhūyaḥ svasti gaje punaḥ ||
bhavanty arogāḥ rājānaḥ samṛdhyantāṃ ca yājakāḥ |
dvije dānaṃ prayacchantu balārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
dakṣaṃ bhūtāni gandharvāḥ oṣadhyaś ca diśogaṇāḥ |
ādityamarutaś caiva aśvinyau ca tathā grahāḥ |
gajānāṃ saṃprayacchanti balārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
airāvataṃ puṣpadantaṃ kumudaṃ vāmanaṃ tathā |
pauṇḍarīkaṃ nīlavantaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ sutejasam ||
supratīkaṃ ca nāgendraṃ mahābalinam eva ca |
mahāgajāṃs tathaivānyān namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
āsicyājyāhutiṃ teṣāṃ bhūyaḥ svasti gaje punaḥ |
bhavantv arogāś ca gajāḥ samṛdhyantāṃ ca yājakāḥ |
prayacchantu ca nāgānāṃ balārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
ātreyaṃ jamadagṇiṃ ca vasiṣṭhaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
dīrghaṃ varavaraṃ caiva pulastyaṃ cyavanaṃ tathā ||
vedottamāṃ ca svāhāṃ ca parvataṃ cātra mālinam |
[1044]        himavatpramukhaṃ cāpi saptaitān kulaparvatān ||
tathaiva sarvato 'nantān namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ |
diśo daśa ca ye nāgā sarvakālam adhiṣṭhitāḥ ||
bhūmidharāḥ bhujaṅgāś ca namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ |
āsicyājyāhutiṃ teṣāṃ bhūyaḥ svasti gaje punaḥ ||
bhavantv arogāś ca gajā samṛdhyantāṃ yājakāḥ |
prayacchantu ca nāgānāṃ varṇārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
bhūmidharān abhimatān mahātejān mahābalān |
devadattaunmahābhogyān (?) śucir bhūtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
anantaṃ prathamaṃ vande sarvalokābhipūjitam |
karkoṭakaṃ dhūmaviṣaṃ vāsukiṃ ca mahābalam ||
kālīyaṃ cāpi vanditvā balam utpalam eva ca |
hariṃ ca vidyujjihvaṃ ca kavalāśvatarāv ubhau ||
udayantam athādityaṃ jihvāyāṃ parilehati |
praṇataṃ taṃ punaś cāpi lāṅgulena niṣevate ||
anur nāma mahābhāgaḥ pañcaśīrṣo mahābalaḥ |
nāgo maṇigrahaś caiva ye cāpi dharaṇīdharāḥ ||
kurvantu svasti nāgānāṃ nirvāṇe taraṇe tathā |
antarbhūmau ca ye nāgā ye ca ye diśi gocarāḥ ||
āsicyājyāhutiṃ teṣāṃ bhūyaḥ svasti gaje punaḥ |
bhavantv arogāś ca gajāḥ samṛdhyantāṃ ca yājakāḥ ||
saṃprayacchantu nāgānāṃ balārogyayaśāṃsi ca |
[1045]        uttareṇa japed vipraḥ senānyam api kīrtanam ||

saṃprayacchatu nāgānāṃ varṇārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
[1046]        vyapohatu ca pāpāni iha rājñaḥ śataṃ samāḥ |

saṃprayacchantu nāgānāṃ varṇārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
pādāyudhaṃ tāmracūḍaṃ śatapatraṃ manoramam |

saṃprayacchasva nāgānāṃ varṇārogyavaśāṃsi ca ||

saṃprayacchasva nāgānāṃ varṇārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||

nairājinīṃ tv imāṃ mālāṃ sahasrākṣeṇa dhāritām |

surā sugandhā surasā madīkaramanoramā ||

saṃprayacchasva nāgānāṃ varṇārogyayaśāṃsi ca ||
svāhā |
ime śaṅkā mṛdaṅgāś ca kāṃsyavādyāni yāni ca |
vīṇāsarpāṇi praṇavā godhā parivadantakāḥ ||
āhutā maṅgalārthaṃ vai vādyante madhurasvarāḥ |

vividhāni ca rūpāṇi samyag buddhvā hutāśane |
hūyamānanimittajñaḥ rakṣaṇārthaṃ vinirdiśet ||
hriyamāne kṣayaṃ yānti yaś cāgniḥ sudṛḍhāyate |
[1048]        citraghnaḥ puruṣaś cāpi vasugandhas tathaiva ca ||
ativarṇo vicitraś ca valmīkākṛtisaṃsthitaḥ |
hotridāyī ca yo vahnir dvijānāṃ kṣayam ādiśet ||
kūjamānaḥ sphuliṅgādyaiḥ rājño rūkṣo virūpavān |
dhūmavātayutaś cātha vargagandhaḥ samaś ca yaḥ ||
gomukhākṛtasaṃsthāno gavāṃ saṃkṣayam ādiśet |
cireṇottiṣṭhate yaś ca kṣipraṃ caiva praśāmyati ||
kṛṣṇavarṇo vidhūmāś ca kṛśarāgandha eva ca |
hūyamānas tadā vahnir ākhyati nṛpater vadham ||
gṛdhrolūkanibhaś cāpi rājño maraṇam ādiśet |
avyaktavarṇo durgandho viprakīrṇaśiko 'nalaḥ ||
kṣipraṃ vināśayed rāṣṭraṃ sāmānyaṃ sapurohitam |
rājño maraṇam evāpi śavagandho yadānalaḥ ||
hīnasvano yadā vahniḥ kuṇapaś ca hutāśanaḥ |
sagandhaḥ syād vivarṇaś (?) ca hatam ākhyāti pārthivam |
śyāvaḥ pāṭalakaś caiva vahnir vaidhanam ādiśet ||
viprakīrṇaśikhaś cāpi vāyasapratinisvanaḥ |
rājñaḥ koṣasya nāśāya yuvarājavadhāya ca ||
tadvidhaṃ kurute vahnir atidhūmo hy atisvanaḥ |
kare corasi dāho ca hotṛvāhī ca yo bhavet ||
tatrārthahāniṃ jānīyāt tasminn utpātadarśane |
karīṣadhūmasaṅkāśa indrāyudhasamadyutiḥ ||
hastyaśvasya kṣayaṃ kṣipraṃ tadvidho vahnir ādiśet |
[1049]        karvūravarṇo vikṛtas tu tathā carmasugandhikaḥ ||
jananāśaṃ tadākhyāti hūyamāno hutāśanaḥ |
havir haridrāvarṇābho lepamāno yathānalaḥ ||
nigaḍākṛtisaṃsthānas tathā śaṅkhanibhākṛtiḥ |
pāśākṛtinibhaś cāpi rājño bandhanam ādiśet ||
vicchinnaśatasūryāṇām ākṛtīr uditasvanaḥ |
vāmato yasya gatvā ca dhūmaḥ pratinivartate ||
matsyaśoṇitagandhānāṃ tuṅgo yajñaś ca jāyate |

aśubhāny avamādīni na nivedyāni bhūpate |
prāsādādrinibhaś cāpi strīpaśuḥ kalaśākṛtiḥ ||
pradakṣiṇākṛtiśikho haṃsaratnodadhisvanaḥ |
śaṅkhaprabham athāśvānām eva dundubhinisvanaḥ |
suvarṇarajataprakhyaḥ kṣīrapāyasagandhavān ||
śastrāṇāṃ kavacānāṃ ca vāraṇānāṃ mahīpate |
bhāsate yasya cātparthaṃ saṃgrāme jayam ādiśet ||
prahṛṣṭamanasaś cāpi śuklāmbaradharā yadi |
īśayeyuḥ śubhāgāraṃ tad bhavej jayalakṣaṇam ||
yadā gurus tv aprasanno juhuyād dhavyavāhanam |
mahābhayaṃ vijānīyān nṛpaṃ cāpi gajādikam ||
ananyavāhanān pūjyān divyalakṣaṇasaṃyutān |
gadādīni viśiṣṭena toyena snāpayed budhaḥ (?) ||
anyavāhān dvipahayān sarvāṃs tena samāhitān |
[1050]        bāhyakumbodakenaiva snāpayet tatra sādhakaḥ ||
rājñe nīrājanaṃ kuryāt tadahaḥṣu ca mantravit |
anyeṣv evaṃvidhaḥ kāryaḥ sa hi ratnākaraḥ paraḥ ||
rājānaṃ vāhanān yāṃś ca tathānyāṃś ca purohitaḥ |
sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktān sarvamaṅgalasaṃyutān |
kṛtvānuvācayet paścād brāhmaṇair āśiṣo bahu ||
dakṣiṇām atulāṃ dadyād ṛtvigbhyo gurave nṛpaḥ |
vāhanaṃ ca sabhūṣāḍhyam ācāryāya pradāpayet ||
dāsadāsīkabhṛtyeṣu grāmādiṣu ca sarvaśaḥ |
sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktān rājā vāhoparisthitān ||
sārohaiś cāpi saṃyuktān mattadvipahayottamaiḥ |
brāhmaṇaiḥ svastivacanair ṛtvigbhiḥ saha saṃyutaiḥ ||
ācāryo rājabhavanaṃ nṛpaṃ saṃveśayet svayam |
pūrvasnānaviśiṣṭena kumbhatoyena mantravit ||
gajaśālāṃ ca saṃprokṣya vājiśālāṃ tathaiva ca |
siddhārthataṇḍulatilaiḥ puṣpaiś cāpy avakīrya ca ||
śālāmadhye nṛsiṃhaṃ ca sudarśanam anāmayam |
pūjayed gandhapuṣpādisarvālaṃkārasaṃyutaiḥ |
saktubhiḥ (?) kṛśarānnena kuryād bhūtabaliṃ bahiḥ ||
tataḥ śālāsu sarvāsu brāhmaṇān bhojayed alam |
tataḥ saveśane kuryād ācāryo gajavājinam ||
evaṃ śāntiṃ prakurvīta nimitte sati tad guruḥ |
paricchadasya nṛpater mantravit susamāhitaḥ ||
[1051]        sarvakalyāṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ |
supuṣṭaṃ rājyatantraṃ tu nṛpas tena mahīyate ||
iti gajaśāntiḥ |
gṛhamadhye sthūṇā virāhet kapoto vāgāramadhye nipatet | vāyaso vā gṛhaṃ praviśet | gaur gṛhaṃ ārohet | gaur ātmānaṃ pratidhāyet | anaḍvān vā mudita ullikhed anagno vā dhūmo jāyate valmīkaṃ copajāyate chatrākaniryāsaṃ copajāyate | maṇḍūko avṛṣṭo vāsayet | svapne 'sthidantapatane gṛhapatijāyāṃ sahopatayad vindeta anyeṣu vā gṛhotpāteṣu agadeyajanollekhanapratyagnimukhān kṛtvā sthālīpākaṃ juhoti | yata indrabhayāmaha iti puro'nūcya svastidāv iśaspatir iti yājyayā juhoty ājyāhutīr upajuhoti vyaste vyākhyāte | śan na indrāgnī bhavatām avobhiḥ śan na indrāvaruṇārātahavyā | śamintāso māsuvitāyaśaṃyoḥ śan naḥ indrāpūṣaṇāv ājasātī | kayānaś citra ābhuvako adyayukte bhavānatraḥ samanasāv iti | sviṣṭikṛtprabhṛtituṣṭām ā dhenuvarapradānan (?) |
athāmreṇa śamīpatreṣu hutaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti |

iti sthālīsaṃkṣālanam ājyaśeṣam udakaśeṣaṃ ca pātryāṃ samānīya eteṣūtpāteṣu utpanneṣu vinayet | prokṣed vā tac chaṃ you āvṛṇīmaha iti |
[1052]         antaṃ saṃskṛtya brāhmaṇān saṃpūjyāśiṣo vācayitvā śivaṃ śivam ity adbhuto vyākhyātaḥ |
aruṇa uvāca |
nānārogahatānāṃ ca ārditānāṃ tathāribhiḥ |
ādityārādhanaṃ muktvā nānyac chreyaskaraṃ param ||
tasmād ārādhayādityaṃ sarvarogavināśanam |

mahāśāntir iti khyātaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam |
grahopaghātahantāraṃ dṛḍhakāyakaraṃ param ||
yatkṛte mama sūryeṇa purā śāntyartham ādarāt |

uttarādiṅmukhāyeha mahādeva priyāya ca ||

śāntāya śāntarūpāya pinākavaradhāriṇe ||
īśānadiṅmukhāyeha svāhā īśāna āhutim |
[1053]        visṛjet khagaśārdūla vidhivat pāvakopama ||
hute devaṃ mahātmānaṃ pāvakaṃ vidhivad nṛpa |
lokapālamukhaṃ devaṃ viśārdhaṃ yāvad ādarāt ||
evaṃ hutāgnikāryaṃ ca svairaṃ khagavarottama |
lakṣahomaṃ ca vidhivat tataḥ śāntiṃ samācaret ||
bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti svāhā lakṣahomavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
mahāhome ca vai saura eṣa eva vidhiḥ paraḥ ||
kṛtvaivam agnikāryaṃ tu sauraṃ khagavarottama |
lakṣahomaṃ ca vidhivat tataḥ śāntiṃ samācaret ||
sindūrāruṇaraktābhaḥ padmaraktāntalocanaḥ |
sahasrakiraṇo devaḥ saptāśvarathavāhanaḥ ||

karoti te mahāśāntiṃ grahapīḍānivāriṇīm ||
sucakraratham ārūḍhaḥ apāṃ sāramayo 'mbujaḥ |
saptāśvavāhano devaḥ śāntaye tv amṛtaprabhuḥ ||
śītāṃśur amṛtāṃśuś ca kṣayavṛddhisamanvitaḥ |
somaḥ saumyena bhāveṇa grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu ||
taptagairikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ |
sarvadevagurur vipro atharvarṣivaraḥ paraḥ ||
bṛhaspatir iti khyāto arthaśāstraparaś ca yaḥ |
śāntena cetasā śāntiḥ pareṇa susamāhitaḥ ||
grahapīḍāṃ vinirjitya karotu tava śāntika |
sūryārcanaparo nityaṃ (?) prasādād bhāskarasya ca ||
[1054]        himakundenduvarṇābhadaityadānavapūjitaḥ |

[1055]        yajñadevottamo devo mādhavo madhusūdanaḥ (?) ||

mayūravāhanā devī siṃhavāhanavigrahā (?) |
[1056]        śaktihastā mahākāyā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā ||

āraktapiṅganayanā gajacarmāvaguṇṭhitā |

cāmuṇḍā caṇḍarūpeṇa sadā rakṣāṃ karotu me |
[1057]        caṇḍamuṇḍakarā devī caṇḍamuṇḍagatā satī ||
ākāśamātaro devyas tathā lokasya mātaraḥ |

vṛddhaśuddhais tu pūjyante tās tu devyo manīṣibhiḥ |

ity etās tu pitāmahyaḥ śāntiṃ te pitṛmātaraḥ ||
sarvamātṛmukhā devyaḥ khāyudhāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ |
jagad vyāpya pratiṣṭhantyo balikāmā mahodayāḥ ||
śāntiṃ kurvantu te nityam ādityārādhane ratāḥ |
śāntena cetasā śāntā śāntā tvaṃ bhava śāntidā ||
sarvāvayavayuktena gātreṇa tanumadhyamā |
pītaśyāmādisaumyena citralekheva śobhitā ||
lalāṭatilakopetacandralekhāṃ ca dhāriṇī |
citrāmbaradharā devī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ||
varā strīmayarūpāṇāṃ śubhā guṇamahāspadam |
sarvamantre tu saṃtuṣṭā umā devī varapradā ||
sākṣād āgatya rūpeṇa śāntenāmitatejasā |
śāntiṃ karotu te prītyā ādityacaraṇe ratā ||
abalābālarūpeṇa ṣaḍvaktraḥ śikhivāhanaḥ |
pūrṇenduvadanaḥ śrīmān triśikhaḥ śaktimān vibhuḥ |
kṛttikāpatyarūpeṇa samuddīptaḥ surārcitaḥ |
kārttikeyo mahātejā ādityād varadarpitaḥ ||
[1058]        śāntiṃ karotu satataṃ phalaṃ saukhyaṃ ca sampadaḥ |
ātreyīm abalāṃ janma tathārogyaṃ khagādhipaḥ ||
śvetavastraparīdhānas tārkṣyaś ca kanakaprabhuḥ |
śūlahasto mahāprājño nandīśo ravibhāvitaḥ ||
śāntiṃ karotu te śānto dharme matim anuttamām |
dharma taratu bho nityam acalaṃ saṃprayacchatu ||
mahodaro mahākāyo gajavaktro mahābalaḥ |
nāgayajñopavītena nāgābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
sarvārthasaṃpadādhāro gaṇādhyakṣā varapradaḥ |
bhīmagātro bhavo devo nāyako 'tha vināyakaḥ |
karotu te mahāśantiṃ (?) prītiṃ prītena cetasā ||
pītāmbaradharā kanyā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā |
yamunā stāmbikā puṇyā sarvalokanamaskṛtā ||
sarvasiddhikarā devī prasādāt paramā parā |
śāntiṃ karotu te mātā bhuvanasya khagādhipa ||
triguṇātmena sarveṇa mahāmahiṣamardanī |
dhanuḥśaktipraharaṇakhaḍgapaṭṭiśadhāriṇī ||
ārjavenodyatakarā sarvopadravanāśinī |
śāntiṃ karotu te saurā durgā bhagavatī śivā ||
nirmāṃsena śarīreṇa snāyurajjunibandhanaḥ |
atisūkṣmo 'tivyakto yaḥ akṣobhaḥ kirīṭī mahān ||
sūryātmako mahāvīryo sūrye ca kṛtamānasaḥ |
sūryabhaktiparo nityaṃ sa te śāntiṃ prayacchatu ||
[1059]        pracaṇḍagaṇasainyo 'sau mahākaṭākṣadhārakaḥ |
akṣamālārpitakaras tryakṣaś caṇḍeśvaro varaḥ ||
caṇḍapāpaharo nityaṃ brahmahatyādināśanaḥ |
śāntiṃ krotu te nityam ādityārādhane rataḥ |
karotu ca mahāyogī kalpāntarās tāḥ parasparam ||
ākāśe mātaro devyas tathā lokasya mātaraḥ |
bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvās tathā devasya mātaraḥ ||
sūryārcanaparā devyo jagad vyāpya vyavasthitāḥ |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te nityaṃ mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ ||
ye raudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudrasthānanivāsinaḥ |
mātaro raudrarūpāś ca gaṇānām adhipāś ca ye ||
vighnabhūtās tathā cānye divi dikṣu samāśritāḥ |
siddhiṃ kurvantu te nityaṃ bhayebhyaḥ pāntu sarvadā ||
aindryāṃ diśi gatā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ |
himakundendupaṭṭīśanīlakṛṣṭāṅgalohitāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ |
sūryārcanaratā aindrāḥ śāṇtiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
āgneyyāṃ ye sthitāḥ sarve śrutahastānuṣaṅginaḥ |
sūryabhaktās tu raktās tu tathā vai raktabhūṣaṇāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca āgneyā bhāskarapriyāḥ |
ādityārādhanaparāḥ śaṃ prayacchantu te sadā ||
yāmyāṃ diśi gatā ye tu satataṃ daṇḍapāṇayaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṅgāḥ kṛṣṇanepathyāḥ varā vai kṛṣṇalohitāḥ ||
[1060]        divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca yamasyānucarāḥ khaga |
ādityārādhanaparāḥ śaṃ prayacchantu te sadā ||
nairṛtyāṃ saṃkṛtā ye tu rākṣasā mṛtyupāṇayaḥ |
nīlāṅgā nīlavarṇā tathā vai nīlalohitāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca virūpākṣānugāminaḥ |
ādityasyārcane nityaṃ kurvantv ārogyam uttamam ||
aparasyāṃ varā ye tu satataṃ karmapāṇayaḥ |
karmābhāḥ karmarūpāś ca sadā kṣaṇikavīkṣaṇāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca ādityārādhane ratāḥ |
kurvantu te sadā śāntiṃ vāruṇā varuṇānugāḥ ||
vāyavyāṃ saṃsthitā nityaṃ mahāvegāś carāḥ khagāḥ |
pītākṣāḥ pītanirbhāsās tathā vai pītalohitāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca ādityārādhane ratāḥ |
sūryavratāḥ sumanasaḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
uttarāyāṃ diśi gatāḥ satataṃ nidhipāṇayaḥ |
girikākṣāḥ kastūrikā tathā vai kṛṣṇalohitāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca alakādhipavallabhāḥ |
ādityārādhanaparāḥ śaṃ prayacchantu te sadā ||
aiśānyaṃ saṃsthitā ye ca praśāntāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ |
bhasmoddhūlitadehāś ca nīlakaṅkaṇalohitāḥ ||
divyāntarikṣā bhaumāś ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ |
sūryapūjāparā nityaṃ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
lokapālānyā hy ete mahābalaparākramāḥ |
[1061]        ādityaṃ pūjayitvā tu balim eṣāṃ vinikṣipet ||
tataḥ suśāntamanaso lokapālasamanvitāḥ |
ātreyīsabalāḥ sarve śaṃ prayacchantu pūjitāḥ ||
amarāvatī nāma purī pūrvabhāge vyavasthitā |
vidyādharagaṇākīrṇā siddhagandharvasevitā |
ratnaprākārarucirā (?) mahāratnopaśobhitā ||
tatra devapatiḥ śrīmān vajrapāṇir mahābalaḥ |
gopatir gosahasreṇa śobhamānena śobhate ||
airāvatagajārūḍho gaurikābho mahādyutiḥ |
indraḥ sahasranayanaḥ ādityārādhane rataḥ ||
sūryadhyānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhaktisamanvitaḥ |
sūryapraṇāmaparamaḥ śāntiṃ te śīghram ṛcchatu ||
āgneya digvibhāge tu purī tejavatī sadā |
nānādevagaṇākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā ||
tatra jvālāsamākīrṇā dīptāṅgārasamadyutiḥ |
purā godehināṃ dehe jvalanaṃ pāpanāśanam ||
ādityārādhanaparā ādityagatamānasāḥ |
śāntiṃ karotu te devā atha (?) pāpaparikṣayam ||
vaivasvatī purī ramyā dakṣiṇe ca mahātmanaḥ |
suranāthagaṇākīrṇā pitṛrakṣogaṇākulā ||
tatrendranīlasaṅkāśo raktāntāyatalocanaḥ |
mahāmahiṣam ārūḍho raktasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
antako 'tha mahātejāḥ sauradharmaparāyaṇaḥ |
[1062]        ādityārādhanaparaḥ kṣemārogyaṃ dadātu me ||
narṛte tu diśo bhāge purī kṛṣṇeti viśrutā |
mahārakṣogaṇākīrṇā piśācapretasaṃkulā ||
tatra skandanibho devo raktasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ |
khaḍgapāṇir mahātejāḥ karālavadanojjvalaḥ ||
rākṣasendro vasen nityam ādityārādhane rataḥ |
karotu te mahāśāntiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca yatnataḥ ||
paścime tu diśāṃ bhāge purī śuddhavatī śubhā |
ṛṣisiddhagaṇākīrṇā nānāratnasuśobhitā ||
tatra kundendusaṃkāśo hariḥ piṅgalalocanaḥ |
śuklāmbaradharo devo pāśahasto mahābalaḥ ||
varuṇaḥ parayā bhaktyā ādityagatamānasaḥ |
rogakāśādisaṃkāśaṃ tāpaṃ nirvāpayatv atha ||
vāyavye digvibhāge tu purī gandhavatī śubhā |
ṛṣisiddhagaṇākīrṇā hemaprākāratoraṇā ||
tatra hīśvaradehas tu kṛṣṇaḥ piṅgalalocanaḥ |
pṛthivyāḥ prāntasantāno dhvajayaṣṭyāyudhocchritaḥ ||
caramaḥ paramo devo graheśaś ca parāt paraḥ |
kṣemārogyaṃ balaṃ śāntiṃ karotu satataṃ tava ||
mahodayā nāma purī mandareṇa mahodayā |
nānāyakṣasamākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā ||
tatra devo gadāhastaś citrasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ |
hrasvabāhur mahātejā hariḥ piṅgalalocanaḥ ||
[1063]        śāntiṃ karotu te prītaḥ śāntaḥ śāntena cetasā |
yaśovatī purī ramyā aiśānīṃ diśam āśritā ||
nānāgaṇasamākīrṇā nānākṛtasurālayā |
tejaḥprākāraparyantā anaupamyā mahojjvalā ||
tatra kundendusaṃkāśo aṅgarāgavibhūṣitaḥ |
trinetraḥ śāntarūpātmā akṣamālādharo varaḥ |
īśānaḥ paramo devaḥ sadā te śāntim ṛcchatu ||
umāpatir mahātejāś candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ |
bhūrloke ca bhuvarloke svarloke nivasanti ye |
devī devīsamākīrṇā śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
maharloke janoloke tapoloke ca ye sthitāḥ |
te sarve muditā devāḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
satyaloke tu ye devās tv atha bhojjvalavigrahāḥ |
sūryabhaktāḥ sumanaso bhayaṃ nirnāśayantu te ||
girikandaradurgeṣu vaneṣu nivasanti ye |
sūryārcanaparā devā rakṣāṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
śaraccandrātigaureṇa dehenāmalatejasā |
sarasvatī sūryabhaktā śāntiṃ yacchantu te sadā ||
yā tu cāmīkarachāyā sarojakarapallavā |
sūryabhaktā sriyā devī śāntiṃ yacchantu te sadā ||
hāreṇa suvicitreṇa bhāsvatkanakamekhalā |
aparājitā sūryaparā karotu vijayaṃ tava ||
kṛttikā paramā devī rohiṇī ca varānanā |
[1064]        śrīmanmṛgaśiro bhadramārdrā ca paramojjvalā ||
punarvasus tathā puṣpāḥ aśleṣā ca tathā khaga |
sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ sūryabhāvena bhāvitāḥ ||
pūrvabhāge sthitā hy etāḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā |
nakṣatramātaro hy etāḥ kurvantu ravinoditāḥ ||
anurādhā tato jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ sūryaparaṃ tathā |
pūrvāṣāḍhā mahāvīryā āṣāḍhā cottarā tathā ||
abhijin nāma nakṣatraṃ śavaṇaṃ ca bahuśrutam |
etāḥ paścimato dīptā rājante cānumūrtayaḥ ||
bhāskaraṃ pūjayanty etāḥ sarvakālaṃ subhāvitāḥ |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca mahādhikām ||
dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā yā tu pūrvabhādrapadā tathā |
uttarabhādrarevatyāv aśvinī ca mahāmate |
bharaṇī ca mahādevī nityam uttarataḥ sthitāḥ ||
sūryārcanaratā nityam ādityagatamānasāḥ |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca mahārhakāṃ ||
vṛṣo vṛṣādhipaḥ siṃharāśir dīptimatāṃ varaḥ |
pūrveṇa bhāsayanty ete sūryayogaparāḥ śubhāḥ |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te bhaktyā sūryapādābjapūjakāḥ ||
dhanuḥ kanyā ca paramā makaraś cāpi ṛddhimān |
ete dakṣiṇabhāge tu pūjayanti raviṃ sadā ||
tulā mithunakumbhāś ca paścimena vyavasthitāḥ |
sūryapādārcanaratāḥ śāntiaṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
[1065]        karkaṭo vṛściko mīna ete uttarataḥ sthitāḥ |
yajanty ete mahākālam ādityaṃ grahanāyakam |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te nityaṃ svasvoktajñānatatparāḥ ||
yatayaḥ kṛtapuṇyāś ca ye smṛtāḥ satataṃ budhaiḥ |
ṛṣayaḥ saptaviṃśādyāḥ praśāntāḥ paramojjvalāḥ |
sūryaprasādasaṃpannāḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
kaśyapo gālavo gārgyo viśvāmitro mahāmuhiḥ |
manur dakṣo vasiṣṭhaś ca mārtaṇḍaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ||
nārado bhṛgur ātreyo bharadvājo 'ṅgirā muniḥ |
vālmīkaḥ kauśikaḥ kaṇvaḥ śālavyo 'tha punarvasuḥ ||
śālaṅkāyana ity ete ṛṣayo vai khagādhipa |
sūryadhyānekaparamā ādityārādhane ratāḥ ||
tārako 'gnimukho daityaḥ kālanemir mahābalaḥ |
ete daityā mahātmānaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitāḥ ||
puṣṭiṃ balaṃ tathārogyaṃ prayacchantu surārayaḥ |
vairocano hiraṇyākṣaḥ suparvā vasulocanaḥ ||
madhukando mukundaś ca daityo raivatakas tathā |
bhāvena parameṇāpi vaktrāntāyatalocanaḥ ||
mahābhogakṛtāṭopaḥ śaṅkhāntakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ||
ananto nāgarājendra ādityārādhane rataḥ |
mahāpāpacayaṃ hatvā śāntim āśu karotu te ||
atiśvetaśarīreṇa sphuranmauktikasaṃnibhaḥ |
nityaṃ rājaśriyā yukto vāsukiḥ śāntim ṛcchatu ||
[1066]        atipītena vastreṇa visphuran bhogasaṃpadā |
tejasā cāpi divyena kṛtasvastikalāñchanaḥ ||
nāgarāṭ takṣakaḥ śrīmān nāyakaughasamanvitaḥ |
karotu te mahāśāntiṃ sarvadoṣaviṣāpahaḥ ||
atikṛṣṇena varṇena jaṭāvikaṭamastakaḥ |
kaṇṭhe rekhātrayopeto ghoradaṃṣṭrāyudhodyataḥ ||
karkoṭako mahābhāgo viṣadarpādvalānvitaḥ |
vivasan sarvasaṃtāpaṃ hatvā śāntiṃ karotu te ||
padmavarṇena dehena cārupadmāyatekṣaṇaḥ |
pañcabindukṛtābhāso grīvāyāṃ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||
vyomapadmo mahābhāgaḥ sūryapādārcane rataḥ |
karotu te mahāśāntiṃ mahāpāpabhayāpahām ||
puṇḍarīkanibhenāpi dehenāmitatejasā |
śaṅkhaśūlāṅkaracitair bhūṣito mūrdhni sarvadā ||
mahāpadmo mahānāgo nityaṃ bhāskarapūjakaḥ |
sa te śāntiṃ śriyaṃ janma nirmalaṃ saṃprayacchatu ||
śyāmena dehabhāreṇa śrīmān kamalalocanaḥ |
viṣadarpabalonmatto grīvāyāṃ rekhayānvitaḥ ||
śaṅkhapālaḥ śriyā yuktaḥ sūryapādakapūjakaḥ |
mahāviṣaharo hṛṣṭaḥ sa ca śāntiṃ karotu te ||
atidehena gaureṇa candrārdhakṛtamastakaḥ |
dīptābhogakṛtāṭopaḥ śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||
kuliśo nāma nāgendro nityaṃ sūraparāyaṇaḥ (?) |
[1067]        apahṛtya viṣaṃ ghoraṃ karotu tava śāntikam ||
antarikṣe ca ye nāgā ye nāgāḥ svargasaṃsthitāḥ |
pātāle ye sthitā nāgāḥ sarve 'py atra samāśritāḥ |
sūryapādārcanaratāḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
nāgiṇyo nāgakanyāś ca tathā nāgakumārakāḥ |
sūryabhaktāh sumanasaḥ śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
ya imaṃ nāgasaṃsthānaṃ kīrtayec chṛṇuyāt tathā |
na tasya sarpā hiṃsanti na viṣaṃ kramate sadā ||
gaṅgā puṇyā mahādevī yamunā narmadā nadī ||
gomatī cāpi śonā ca varuṇā devikā tathā |
sarvagrahapatiṃ devaṃ deveśaṃ lokanāyakam ||
pūjayanti sadā nadyaḥ sūryavad bhāvabhāvitāḥ |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te nityaṃ sūryadhyānaikamānasāḥ ||
nairañjanā nāma nadī śonaś cāpi mahānadaḥ |
mandākinī ca paramā tathā satyānvitā śubhā ||
etāś cānyāś ca bahvyo vai bhuvi divy antarīkṣagāḥ |
sūryārcanaparā nadyaḥ kurvantu tava śāntikam ||
mahāvaiśravaṇo devo yajñarājo mahābalaḥ |
yajñakoṭiparo vāro yakṣasaṃkṣepasaṃyutaḥ ||
mahāvibhavasaṃpannaḥ sūryapādārcane rataḥ |
sūryadhānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitaḥ ||
śāntiṃ karotu te prītaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ||
maṇibhadro mahāyakṣo maṇiratnavibhūṣitaḥ |
[1068]        manohareṇa hāreṇa kambulagnena rājate ||
yakṣiṇīyakṣakanyābhiḥ parivāritavigrahaḥ |
sūryārcanasamāyuktaḥ karotu tava śāntikam ||
suvīro nāma yakṣendro maṇikuṇḍalabhūṣitaḥ |
lalāṭe hemapaṭṭena pravṛddhena virājate ||
vāpiko nāma yakṣendraḥ kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
mukuṭena vicitreṇa bahuratnānvitena ca ||
yakṣavṛndasamākīrṇo yakṣakoṭisamanvitaḥ |
sūryārcanaparaḥ śrīmān karotu tava śāntikam ||
dhṛtarāṣṭro mahārājā nāgayakṣādhipaḥ khaga |
divyapaṭṭo 'gurucchanno maṇikāñcanabhūṣitaḥ ||
sūryabhaktaḥ sūryarataḥ sūryapūjāparāyaṇaḥ |
sūryaprasādasaṃpannaḥ karotu tava śāntikam ||
pūrṇabhadro mahāyakṣaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ |
lalāṭe hemapaṭṭena pravṛddhena virājate ||
bahuyakṣasamākīrṇo yakṣakoṭiśatena ca |
sūryapraṇāmaparamaḥ sūryabhaktyā samanvitaḥ |
sūryārcanasamāyuktaḥ karotu tava śāntikam ||
virūpākṣākhyayakṣendro śvetavāsā mahādyutiḥ |
nānākāñcanamālābhir upaśobhitakāñcanaḥ ||
sūryapūjāparo nityaṃ kañcākṣaḥ kañcasaṃnibhaḥ |
tejasādityasaṃkāśaḥ karotu tava śāntikam ||
antarikṣagatā yakṣāḥ ye yakṣā sūryavāsinaḥ |
[1069]        giridurgeṣu ye yakṣāḥ pātālatalavāsinaḥ |
nānārūpadharā yakṣā sūryabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ ||
ye tadbhaktās tanmanasaḥ sūryapūjāsamutsukāḥ |
śāntiṃ kurvantu te hṛṣṭāḥ śāntāḥ śāntiparāyaṇāḥ ||
yakṣiṇyo vividhākārās tathā yakṣakumārakāḥ |
yakṣakanyā mahābhāgā sūryasyārcanatatparāḥ ||
śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ kṣemaṃ balaṃ kalyāṇam uttamam |
siddhim āśu prayacchentu nityāṃ ca susamāhitāḥ ||
arcitāḥ sarvataḥ sarve yakṣāś caiva mahādhipāḥ |
sūryabhaktā sadākālaṃ śāntiṃ kurvantu te parām ||
sāgarāḥ sarvataḥ sarve graharatnāni sarvaśaḥ |
sūryasyārādhanaparāḥ kurvantu tava śāntikam ||
rākṣasāḥ sarvataś caiva ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ |
sthūlāś ca rākṣasā ye tu antarikṣacarāś ca ye ||
pātāle rākṣasā ye tu nityaṃ sūryārcane ratāḥ |
pretānām adhipāḥ sarve pretāś ca sarvatomukhāḥ |
atidīptāś ca ye pretā ye pretā rudhirāśanāḥ ||
antarikṣacarāḥ pretās tathānye svargavāsinaḥ |
pātāle bhūtale vāpi ye pretāḥ kāmacāriṇaḥ ||
ekacakro ratho yasya yas tu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
tejasā tasya devasya śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
ye piśācā mahāvīryā ṛddhimanto mahābalāḥ |
nānārūpadharāḥ sarve nānā ca guṇavattarāḥ ||
[1070]        antarikṣe piśācā ye svarge ye ca mahābalāḥ |
pātāle bhūtale ye ca bahurūpā manojavāḥ ||
yasyāhaṃ sārathir vīra yasya tvaṃ suragaḥ sadā |
tejasā tasya devasya śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
apasmāragrahāḥ sarve sarve vāpi jvaragrahāḥ |
garbhabālagrahā ye ca dantarogagrahāś ca ye |
antarikṣagrahā ye ca śāntiṃ kurvantu te sadā ||
iti devādayaḥ sarve sūryajñānavidhāyinaḥ |
kurvantu jagataḥ śāntiṃ sūryabhaktyaiva sarvadā ||
jayaḥ sūryāya devāya tamomohavirodhine |
jagatām ekasūryāya bhāskarāya namo 'stu te ||
grahottamāya śāntāya jayaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇe |
tamoghnāya ajeyāya ajitāya namo namaḥ ||
jayo vājeyadīpteśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala |
rayanirjitalokāya bahurūpāya te namaḥ ||
gāyatrīvedarūpāya sāvitrīdayitāya ca |
dharādharāya sūryāya mārtaṇḍāya namo namaḥ ||
sumantur uvāca |
evaṃ hi vihitā śāntir aruṇena mahīpate |
śreyase vainatendrāya garuḍāya mahātmane ||
[1071]        evam anye 'pi rājendra mānavāś cāṅgarogiṇaḥ |
asmin kṛte 'gnikārye tu nīrujās te bhavanti hi ||
tasmād yatnena kartavyo agnikāryo vidhānataḥ |
karaṇīyaṃ tu rājendra yad idaṃ śāntilakṣaṇam ||
grahotpāteṣu durbhikṣe utpāteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ (?) |
avarṣamāne parjanye lakṣahomasamanvitaṃ ||
japitvā ye 'gnisūktaṃ tu dhyātvā raviṃ prayatnataḥ |
evaṃ kṛte dhruvaṃ devo varṣate kāmato nṛṇām ||
ity evaṃ śāntikādhyāyaṃ yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyād api |
vihāya sarvalokāṃs tu sūryaloke mahīyate ||
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ jayakāmo jayaṃ labhet |
arthakāmo labhed arthaṃ putrakāmaḥ sutaṃ labhet ||
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ śṛṇute mānavo nṛpa |
taṃ sarvaṃ śīdhram āpnoti bhāskarasya priyo bhavet ||
śrutvā śāntim imāṃ puṇyāṃ samagrāṃ kurunandana |
saṃgrāmaṃ praviśed yas tu dhyāyamāno divākaram |
sarvān jitvā raṇe śatrūn ānandaparamo bhavet ||
akṣayaṃ modate kālam atiraskṛtaśāsanaḥ |
vyādhibhir nābhibhūyeta putrapautrapratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
bhaved ādityasadṛśas tejasā prabhayā tathā ||
yam uddiśya paṭed vīra vācako mānavaṃ prati |
na pīḍyate tvasī doṣair vātakampakaphātmakaiḥ ||
nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya sarvapāpair na duṣyate |
[1072]        na viṣaṃ kramate dehe na jaḍo nāndhamūkatā |
na cotpātabhayaṃ tasya na caivāribhayaṃ bhavet ||
ye rogā ye mahotpātā ye grahā yan mahāviṣam |
te sarve praśamaṃ yānti śravaṇād asya bhārata ||
yat puṇyaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ gaṅgādiṣu niveṣitaḥ |
tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnoti śravaṇādibhiḥ ||
daśānāṃ rājasūyānām aneṣāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
jīved varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ ||
śīghraś caiva kṛtaghnaś ca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ |
śaraṇāgatahantā ca ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ ||
duṣṭapāpasamācāraḥ pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā|
śravaṇāc caiva pāṭhena mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
itihāsam idaṃ puṇyam agnikāryam anuttamam |
sūryabhakte sadā deyaṃ sūryeṇa kathitaṃ purā ||
aruṇasya mahābāho aruṇenānujasya tu |
anujena purā proktaṃ bhojakānāṃ mahātmanām ||
sūryaśarmamukhānāṃ tu śākadvīpe mahīyate |
tenāpi kathitaṃ mahyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham ||
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇoktā mahāśāntiḥ |
athādbhutaśāntayaḥ |
tatra matsyapurāṇe |
divy antarikṣe bhaumeṣu yā śāntir abhidhīyate |
[1073]        tām ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi mahotpāteṣu keśava ||
matsya uvāca |
sthātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi trividheṣv adbhuteṣu ca |
viśeṣeṇa tu bhaumeṣu śāntiṃ kuryān narādhipa ||
abhayā cāntarikṣeṣu bhaumā divyeṣu pārthiva |
vijigīṣuparād rājan bhūtikāmaś ca yo bhavet ||
vijigīṣupareṇaiva abhiyuktas tathā paraiḥ |
tathābhicāraśaṅkāyāṃ śatrūṇām api nāśane |
bhaye mahati saṃprāpte abhayā śāntir iṣyate ||
bhūteṣu dṛśyamāneṣu raudrī śāntis tatheṣyate |
vedanāśe samutpanne jane jāte ca nāstike |
apūjyapūjane jāte brāhmī śāntis tatheṣyate ||
bhaviṣyaty abhiyoge ca paracakrabhaye 'pi ca |
rāṣṭrabhede ca saṃprāpte raudrī śāntiḥ praśasyate ||
trāhātirikte pavane kakṣe sarvadigutthite |
vaikṛte vātaje vyādhau vāyavī śāntir iṣyate ||
anāvṛṣṭibhaye jāte tathā vikṛtavarṣaṇe |
jalāśayavikāre ca vāruṇo śāntir iṣyate ||
abhiśāpabhaye prāpte bhargavī ca tathā dvija |
jāte prasavavaikṛtye prājāpatyā mahābhuja |
upaskārāṇāṃ vaikṛtye tvāṣṭrī pārthivanandana ||
bālānāṃ śāntikāmasya kaumārī ca tathā nṛpa |
āgneyīṃ kārayec chāntiṃ saṃprāpte vahnivaikṛte ||
[1074]        ājñābhaṅge tathā jāte jāyābhṛtyādisaṃkṣaye |
aśvānāṃ śāntikāmasya tadvikāre samutthite |
aśvānāṃ kāmamānasya gāndharvī śāntir iṣyate ||
gajānāṃ śāntikāmasya tadvikāre samutthite |
gajānāṃ kāmamānasya śāntir āṅgirasī bhavet ||
piśācādibhaye jāte śāntis tu nairṛtī smṛtā |
apamṛtyubhaye jāte duḥsvapne 'pi mahābhuja ||
kāmyāṃ tu kārayec chāntiṃ saṃprāpte makare tathā |
dhananāśe samutpanne kauverī śāntir iṣyate ||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tathārthānāṃ vaikṛtye samupasthite |
bhūmikāmas tathā śāntiṃ pārthivīṃ ca prayojayet ||
prathame dinayāme ca rātrau vā manujottama |
haste svātyāṃ ca citrāyām āditye vāśvine tathā ||
āryamne sīmajāteṣu vāyavyeṣv adbhuteṣu ca |
dvitīye dinayāme ca rātrau ca ravinandana ||
puṣpāgneyaviśākhāyāṃ pitrājabharaṇīṣu ca |
utpātā ye tathā bhāgye āgneyīṃ teṣu kārayet ||
tṛtīye dinayāme ca rātrau ca ravinandana |
rohiṇyāṃ vaiṣṇave brāhme vāsave viśvadaivate ||
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca tathā maitre ye bhavanty adbhutāḥ kvacit |
aindrī bhayeṣu (?) proktavyā mahāśāntiḥ kulodvaha ||
caturthe dinayāme ca rātrau ca ravinandana |
sārpe pauṣṇe tathārdrāyām ahivradhne ca dāruṇe ||
[1075]        mūle varuṇadaivatye ye bhavanty adbhutās tathā |
vāruṇī teṣu kartavyā mahāśāntir mahīkṣitā ||
bhinnamaṇḍalavelāsu ye bhavanty adbhutāḥ kvacit |
śāntiḥ śāntidvayaṃ kāryaṃ nimitte sati nānyathā |
nirnimittakṛtā śāntir nimittam upajāyate ||
bāṇaprahārā na bhavanti yadvad
rājan nṛṇāṃ saṃmohanair yutānām |
daivopaghātā na bhavanti tadvad
dharmātmanāṃ śāntiparāyaṇānām ||
manur uvāca |
adbhutānāṃ phalaṃ deva śamanaṃ ca tathā vada |
tvaṃ hi vetsi viśālākṣa jñeyaṃ sarvam aśeṣataḥ ||
matsya uvāca |
atra te varṇayiṣyāmi yad uvāca mahātapāḥ |
atra me vṛddhagargas tu sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||
sarasvatyāṃ samāsīnaṃ gārgaṃ pārthivanandana |
papraccheti mahātejā gargo munivarapriyaḥ ||
atrir uvāca |
paśyatāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi janānāṃ kathayasva me |
nagarāṇāṃ tathā rājñāṃ tvaṃ hi sarvavid ucyate ||
garga uvāca |
puruṣāpacāraniyamād aparādhyanti devatāḥ |
tato 'parādhād devānām upasargaḥ pravartate ||
[1076]        divyāntarikṣaṃ maumaṃ ca tridhaṃ parikīrtitam |
graharkṣavaikṛtaṃ divyam āntarikṣaṃ nibodha me ||
ulkāpāto diśāṃ dāhaḥ pariveśas tathaiva ca |
gandharvanagaraṃ caiva vṛṣṭiś ca vikṛtā ca yā |
evamādīni loke 'smin ākāśāni vinirdiśet ||
carasthitabhayaṃ bhaumaṃ bhūkampam api bhūmijam |
jalāśayānāṃ vaikṛtyaṃ bhaumaṃ tad api kīrthitam ||
bhaumaṃ cālpaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ cireṇa paripacyate |
abhayaṃ madhyaphaladaṃ madhyakālaphalaṃ drutam ||
adbhute tu samutpanne yadi vṛṣṭiḥ śivā bhavet |
saptāhābhyantare jñeyam aśubhaṃ niṣphalam bhavet ||
adbhutasya vipākaś ced vinā śāntyā na dṛśyate |
tribhir varṣais tu tad bhavyaṃ sumahadbhayakārakam ||
rājñaḥ śarīre loke ca pure dāre purohite |
pākam āyāti putreṣu tathā vai kośavāhane ||
ṛtusvabhāvād rājendra bhavanty adbhutasaṃjñitāḥ |
śubhāvahāś ca vijñeyās tāṃs tvaṃ me vadataḥ śṛṇu ||
vajrāśanimahīkampasaṃdhyānirghātaniḥsvanāḥ |
pariveṣarajodhūmaraktārkāstamanodayāḥ ||
drumebhyo (?) 'tha rasasnehī bahuśasyaphalodgamāḥ |
gopakṣimadavṛddhiś ca śubhāni madhumādhave ||
[1077]        tārolkāpātakaluṣaṃ kapilārkendumaṇḍalam |
anagnijvalanaṃ sphoṭaṃ dhūmadivyānilāhatam ||
raktapadmāruṇā saṃdhyā nabhaḥ kṣubdhārṇavopamam |
saritāṃ cāmbusaṃśoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā grīṣme śubhaṃ vadet ||
śakrāyudhapariveśī vidyucchuṣkavirohaṇam |
kampodvartanavaikṛtyaṃ rasanaṃ daraṇaṃ kṣiteḥ ||
nadyudapānasarasāṃ vṛṣṭyarddhyābharaṇaplavāḥ |
śīrṣāṇi vārirodhānāṃ varṣāsu śubhadāni ca ||
divyastrīrūpagandharvavimānādbhutadarśanam |
grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ darśanaṃ vāg amānuṣī ||
gītavāditranirghoṣo vanaparvatasānuṣu |
śasyavṛddhīrasotpattiḥ śaratkāle śubhāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
śītānilatuṣāratvaṃ nandanaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām |
rakṣoyakṣādisattvānāṃ darśanaṃ vāg amānuṣī ||
diśo dhūmāndhakārāś ca śalabhā vanaparvatāḥ |
uccaiḥ sūryodayāstatvaṃ hemante śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
himapātānilotpātavirūpādbhutadarśanam |
dṛṣṭvāñjanābham ākāśaṃ tārolkāpātapiñjaram ||
[1078]        citrāgarbhodbhavās strīṣu go'jāśvamṛgapakṣiṇām |
patrāṅkuralatānāṃ ca vikārāḥ śiśire śubhāḥ ||
ṛtusvabhāvena vinādbhutasya
jātasya dṛṣṭasya tu śīghram etat |
kṛtāgamā śāntir anantaraṃ tu
kāryā yathoktā vasudhādhipena ||
ity adbhutaśāntau cautpātikam |
garga uvāca |
devatārcāḥ pranṛtyanti vepante prajvalanti ca |
āraṭanti ca rodanti pratiṣṭhanti hasanti ca ||
utpattiṃ ca niṣīdanti pradhāvanti vasanti ca |
bhūñjato vikṣipante vā śākapraharaṇadhvajān ||
avāṅmukhā vā tiṣṭhanti sthānāt sthānaṃ bhramanti ca |
vamanty agniṃ tathā dhūmaṃ sneharakte tathā vasām |
evamādīni dṛśyante vikārāḥ sahasotthitāḥ ||
liṅgāyatanakṣetreṣu tatra vāsaṃ na rocayet |
rājño vā śamanaṃ tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati ||
devayātrāsu cotpātān dṛṣṭvā deśabhayaṃ vadet |
pitāmahasvadharmeṣu tatra vāsaṃ na rocayet ||
vasūnāṃ babhrujaṃ jñeyaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ lokapālajam |
[1079]        jñeyaṃ senāpatīnāṃ ca yasmāt skandaśikhaṇḍijam ||
lokānāṃ viṣṇuvāyvindraṃ viśvakarmasamudbhavam |
vināyakodbhavaṃ jñeyaṃ gaṇānāṃ caiva nāyakam ||
devadeva nṛpaśreṣṭha devastrīṣu nṛpastriyaḥ |
vāstudeveṣu vijñeyaṃ gṛhāṇām eva nānyathā ||
devatārcāvikāreṣu śrutivettā purohitaḥ |
devatārcāṃ tu gatvā vai tāṃs tām ācchādya bhūṣayet ||
pūjayet tāṃ mahābhāga gandhamālyānnasaṃpadā |
madhuparkeṇa vidhivad upatiṣṭhed anantaram ||
talliṅgārcanamātreṇa sthālīpākaṃ yathāvidhi |
purodhā juhuyād vahnau saptarātram atandritaḥ ||

sadakṣiṇaiḥ saptadinaṃ dvijendra |
prāpte 'ṣṭame ca kṣitigopradānaiḥ
sakāñcanaiḥ śāntim upaiti pāpam ||
ity adbhutaśāntau arcāvaikṛtopaśamanam |
garga uvāca |
anagnir dīpyate yatra rāṣṭre bhṛśam atisvaraḥ |
na dīpyate cendhanavān sa rāṣṭraḥ pīḍyate nṛpa ||
prajvaled adrumaṃ yatra tathārdram vā kathaṃcana |
prāsādatoraṇadvāraṃ nṛpaveśmasurālayam |
[1080]        etāni yatra dahyante tatra rājabhayaṃ bhavet ||
vidyutā vā pradahyante tatrāpi nṛpater bhayam |
anaiśāni tamāṃsi syuḥ viśālam upapadyate |

taḍidvinābhre gagane bhayaṃ syād vṛṣṭivarjite |

trirātropoṣitas tatra purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ |
samidbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarṣapaiś ca ghṛtena ca ||

yad agnivaikṛtyabhayaṃ dvijendra ||
ity adbhutaśāntau agnivaikṛtyam |
garga uvāca |

vadanto vā hasanto vā sravanto vā rasaṃ bahu ||
purohā vā vinā bādhaṃ śākhā muñcanty asaṃkramam |
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tathākālaṃ darśayanti tryahāyanāḥ ||

[1081]        puṣpanty arogāḥ sahasā śuṣkaṃ rohanti vā punaḥ |
uttiṣṭhantīha patitāḥ patanti ca tathotthitāḥ ||

rodane vyādhim abhyeti hasane deśavibhramam ||
śākhāprapātane kuryāt saṃgrāme yoddhapātanam |
bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ kuryād bālānāṃ phalapuṣpataḥ ||
svarāṣṭrabhedaṃ kurute phalapuṣpam anantaram |
kṣayaṃ sarvatra gokṣīraṃ snehaṃ durbhikṣalakṣaṇam ||
śuṣkeṣu saṃprahāreṣu vīryamantraṃ na rohati |

gītena nṛtyena tathārcanena
devaṃ haraṃ pāpavināśahetuoḥ ||
ity adbhutaśāntau vṛkṣotpātaśamanam |
[1082]                garga uvāca |
ativṛṣṭir anāvṛṣṭir durbhikṣādibhayaṃ matam |
anṛtau tu dinād ūrdhvaṃ vṛṣṭir jñeyā bhayāya tu ||
analpe vikṛtā caiva vijñeyā rājamṛtyave |
śītoṣṇatāviparyāse ṛtūnāṃ ripujaṃ bhayam ||
śoṇitaṃ varṣate yatra tatra śastrabhayaṃ bhavet |
aṅgārapāṃśuvarṣeṣu nagaraṃ saṃvinaśyati |
majjāsthisnehamāṃsānāṃ janamārabhayaṃ bhavet ||
garga uvāca |
praviśanti yadā grāmam āraṇyamṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
araṇyaṃ yānti vā grāmyāḥ sthalaṃ yānti jalodbhavāḥ ||
sthalajā vā jale yānti ghoraṃ vā santi nirbhayāḥ |
rājadvāre puradvāre śivā vāpy aśivapradāḥ ||
divā rātricarā vāpi rātrau vāpi divācarāḥ |
grāmyās tyajanti grāmaṃ vā taṃ cotpātaṃ vinirdiśet ||
dīptā vā santi saṃdhyās tu maṇḍalāni ca kurvate |
rasante vipriyaṃ yatra tadā pretaphalaṃ labhet ||
pradoṣe kukkuṭāvāso hemante vāpi kokilaḥ |
arkodaye 'rkābhimukho śivā yamabhayaṃ vadet ||
gṛhaṃ kapotaḥ praviśet kravyāḍ vā mūdhni līyate |
madhu vāmakṣikā kuryān mṛtyur gṛhapater bhavet ||
prākāradvārageheṣu toraṇāpaṇavīthiṣu |
ketuchatrāyudhākhyeṣu kravyāt saṃpatate yadi ||
[1083]        jāyante vātha vālmīkā madhu vā syandane yadi |
pradeśo nāśam āyāti rājā ca mriyate tadā ||
mūṣikān śalabhān dṛṣṭvā prabhūtaṃ kṣudbhayaṃ bhavet |
kāṣṭholmūkāsthiśṛṅgāsyāḥ śvānomarakavedinaḥ ||
durbhikṣavedanā jñeyāḥ kākā dhānyamuṣo yadi |
janā abhibhavanti sma nirbhayā raṇavedinaḥ ||
kāko maithunayuktaś ca śvetaḥ sa yadi dṛśyate |
rājā vā mrityate tatra tadā deśo vinaśyati ||
ulūko vaste yatra nipated vā tathā gṛhe |
jñeyo gṛhapater mṛtyur dhananāśas tathaiva ca ||
mṛgapakṣivikāreṣu kuryād dhomaṃ sadakṣiṇam |
devāḥ kapota iti ca japtavyaṃ pañcabhir dvijaiḥ ||
sudeva iti caikena devā gāvaḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ |
japec chākunasūktaṃ ca manovedaśirāṃsi ca ||
devāḥ kapotādayo mantrā ṛgvede prasiddhāḥ |
gāvaś ca deyā vidhivad dvijānāṃ
sakāñcanā vastrayugottarīyāḥ |
evaṃ kṛte śāntim upaiti pāpaṃ
mṛgair dvijair vā viniveditaṃ yat ||
ity adbhutaśāntau mṛgapakṣivaikṛtopaśamanam |
garga uvāca |
prāsādatāraṇaṃ chādaṃ dvāraṃ prākāraveśmanām |
[1084]        animittaṃ tu patitaṃ dṛḍhānāṃ rājamṛtyave ||
rajasā bāṣpadhūmena diśo yatra samākulāḥ |
ādityacandratārāś ca vivarṇā bhayavṛddhaye ||
rākṣasā yatra dṛśyante brāhmaṇāś ca vidharmiṇaḥ |
ṛtavas tu vparyastā apūjyaṃ pūjayej janaḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi viyogāni tan mahadbhayalakṣaṇam ||
ketūdayoparāge ca chidratā śaśisūryayoḥ |
phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ hiraṇyābharaṇāni ca ||
pāṃśujantuphalānāṃ ca varṣaṇe rogajaṃ bhayam |
chidraṃ cātipravarṣāyāṃ śasyānāṃ prītivardhanam ||
virajaske ravāvabhre yadā chāyā na dṛśyate |
dṛśyante na pradīpe vā tatra deśabhayaṃ bhavet ||
nirabhre vāpi rātrau vā śvetaṃ yāmyottareṇa ca |
indrāyudhaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā ulkāpātaṃ tathaiva ca ||
digdāhapariveṣau ca gandharvanagaraṃ tathā |
paracakrabhayaṃ brūyād deśopadravam eva ca ||
sūryenduparjanyasamīrāṇāṃ
homas tu kāryo vidhivad dvijendraiḥ |
dhānyāni gokāñcanadakṣiṇāś ca
deyā dvijānām aghanāśahetoḥ ||
ity adbhutaśāntau vṛṣṭivaikṛtapraśamanam |
[1085]                garga uvāca |
nagarād apasarpante samīpam upayānti vā |
nadyā hradapraśravaṇā virasā hi bhavanti ca ||
vivarṇakaluṣaṃ taptaṃ phenavarjaṃ tu saṅkulam |
kṣīrasnehasurāraktaṃ vahante bahulodakāḥ |
ṣaṇmāsābhyantare tatra paracakrabhayaṃ bhavet ||
jalāśayā nadante ca prajvalanti kathanti vā |
vijalpante 'tijihmaṃ ca jvālādhūmaṃ sṛjanti ca ||
akhāte vā jalotpātaḥ samarthā vā jalāśayāḥ |
sagītaśabdā dṛśyante janamāro 'tra saṃbhavet ||
divyāmbhogobhayaṃ sarpirmadhunātrāvasecanam |
japtavyā vāruṇā mantrās tais tu homā jale bhavet ||
madhvājyayuktaṃ paramānnam atra
deyaṃ dvijānāṃ dvijabhojanārtham |
gāvaś ca deyāḥ sitavastrayuktās
tathodakumbhāḥ sakalāghaśāntai [-śāntyai?] ||
ity adbhutaśāntau salilāśayavaikṛtam |
garga uvāca |
akālaprasavā nāryaḥ kālātītaprajās tathā|
vikṛtaprasavāś caiva yugmaprasavanās tathā ||
amānuṣāś ca ṣaṇḍāś ca saṃjātā vyañjanās tathā |
[1086]        hīnāṅgā adhikāṅgāś ca jāyante yadi vā trayaḥ ||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaś caiva tathaiva ca sarīsṛpāḥ |
vināśaṃ tasya deśasya kulasya ca vinirdiśet ||
nirvāsayet tāṃ nṛpatiś ca rāṣṭrāt
striyaś ca pūjyāś ca tato dvijendrāḥ |
yadṛcchakair brāhmaṇatarpaṇaṃ ca
loke tataḥ śāntim upaiti pāpam ||
iti vaikṛtaśāntau prasavavaikṛtam |
garga uvāca |
yānti yānāny ayuktāni yuktāny api na yānti cet |
codyamānāni tatra syān mahadbhayasamutthitam ||
vādyamānā na vādyante vādyante vāpy anāhatāḥ |
acalāś ca calanty eva na calāni calanti ca |
upaskārādivikṛte ghoraṃ śastrabhayaṃ bhavet ||
vāyos tu pūjā dvijapuṅgavaiś ca
kṛtvā taduktāṃś ca japec ca mantrān |
dadyāt prabhūtaṃ paramānnamantraṃ
sadakṣiṇaṃ tena śamo 'sya bhūpateḥ ||
ity upaskaravaikṛtopaśamaḥ |
[1087]        graharkṣavikṛtir yatra tatrāpi bhayam ādiśet |
striyaś ca kalahāyante vācā nighnanti bālakān ||
kriyāṇām ucitānāṃ ca visthitir yatra dṛśyate |
agnir yatra na dīpyeta hūyamānāṣu śāntiṣu ||
pipīlikāś ca kravyādā yānti vāntaritās tataḥ |
pūrṇakumbhāḥ sravante ca havir vā vipralupyate ||
maṅgalyāḥ svāmino yatra na śrūyante samantataḥ |
vepathur bādhate vāpi protsāhe sati ninditaḥ ||
na ca deveṣu vartante yathāvad brāhmaṇeṣu ca |
mandaghoṣāni vādyāni vādyante visvarāṇi ca ||
gurumitradviṣo yatra śatrupūjāratā janāḥ |
brāhmaṇān suhṛdo mānyān jano yatāvamanyate ||
śāntimaṅgalahomeṣu nāśtiko yatra jāyate |
rājā va mriyate yatra sarvadeśo vinaśyati ||
rājño vināśe saṃprāpte nimittāni nobodha me |
brāhmaṇān prathamaṃ dveṣṭi brāhmaṇāṃś ca vinindati ||
brāhmaṇān avamanyeta brāhmaṇāṃś ca jighāṃsati |
na tān smarati kṛtyeṣu yācitaṃ cāvasīyate ||
namanaṃ ca na cāśiś ca praśaṃsāṃ nābhinandati |
apūrvaṃ tu karaṃ lobhāt tathā saṃpīḍite jane ||
[1088]        etāṃś cābhyarcayet samyak sapatnīkān dvijottamān |
bhojyāni caiva kāryāṇi surāṇāṃ balayas tathā ||
gāvaś ca deyā dvijapuṅgavebhyo
bhuvaṃ tathā kāṅcanam ambaraṃ ca |
homaś ca karyo dvijapūjanaṃ ca
evaṃ kṛte śāntim upaiti pāpam ||
iti matsyapurāṇoktany adbhutaśāntikāni samāptāni |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevasya samastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-
śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau vratakhaṇḍe adbhutaśāṇtikāni smāptāni |
